1904.04821|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中所有样本被平等对待、以平均性能为目标的问题，重新审视了不同样本对mAP的贡献。作者提出了Prime Sample的概念，并设计了Prime Sample Attention (PISA)采样与学习策略，将训练重点引向这些关键样本。在MSCOCO数据集上，PISA在单阶段和两阶段检测器上均比随机采样及OHEM、Focal Loss等难例挖掘方法稳定提升约2% mAP，即使使用ResNeXt-101强骨干网络。
1904.04821|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the common paradigm of treating all samples equally in object detection and proposes the notion of Prime Samples that critically drive mAP. It develops a simple yet effective sampling and learning strategy called PISA to focus training on such samples. On MSCOCO, PISA consistently outperforms random sampling and hard mining schemes like OHEM and Focal Loss by around 2% mAP on both single-stage and two-stage detectors, even with a strong ResNeXt-101 backbone.
1904.04821|v2.assessment: 该工作深入分析了样本重要性对mAP的影响，提出的PISA策略简单有效，在多个检测器上均带来显著提升，对目标检测训练策略有重要启发。
1904.04821|v2.contribution: 提出了Prime Sample概念及PISA采样与学习策略，显著提升了目标检测性能。
1904.04821|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地指出样本对mAP的贡献不均，并设计了针对Prime Samples的注意力机制。
1904.04821|v2.result: 在MSCOCO上比随机采样和难例挖掘方法稳定提升约2% mAP。

2003.12063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频目标检测中单帧质量退化导致遮挡目标难以识别的问题，提出人类识别视频目标依赖全局语义和局部定位两种线索。作者设计了记忆增强的全局-局部聚合网络（MEGA），并引入长程记忆（LRM）模块，使关键帧能访问远超以往方法的内容。在ImageNet VID数据集上取得了当时的最优性能。
2003.12063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video object detection where deteriorated single-frame quality hinders occluded object recognition, arguing that global semantic and local localization cues are essential. It proposes the Memory Enhanced Global-Local Aggregation (MEGA) network with a Long Range Memory (LRM) module, enabling key frames to access much more content than previous methods. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on ImageNet VID.
2003.12063|v2.assessment: MEGA网络有效融合了全局与局部信息，并通过长程记忆扩展了时序上下文，在视频目标检测任务上表现优异，对多帧聚合方法有借鉴意义。
2003.12063|v2.contribution: 提出了MEGA网络和LRM模块，实现了视频目标检测中全局与局部信息的有效聚合。
2003.12063|v2.innovation: 首次同时考虑全局语义和局部定位信息，并通过长程记忆模块大幅扩展了关键帧可访问的内容范围。
2003.12063|v2.result: 在ImageNet VID数据集上取得了当时的最优性能。

2001.03398|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于图像的3D目标检测与LiDAR方法之间存在巨大性能差距的问题，提出了深度立体几何网络（DSGN）。DSGN在可微的3D几何体积（3D geometric volume）上检测3D目标，该表示有效编码了3D规则空间的几何结构，并同时学习深度信息和语义线索。这是首个简单有效的一阶段立体3D检测流程，以端到端方式联合估计深度和检测3D目标。在KITTI 3D目标检测基准上，DSGN比之前基于立体的3D检测器AP高出约10，甚至与部分LiDAR方法性能相当。
2001.03398|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the large performance gap between image-based and LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing Deep Stereo Geometry Network (DSGN). DSGN detects 3D objects on a differentiable 3D geometric volume that encodes 3D geometric structure, jointly learning depth and semantic cues. It is the first simple and effective one-stage stereo-based 3D detection pipeline that jointly estimates depth and detects 3D objects end-to-end. On KITTI, it outperforms previous stereo-based detectors by about 10 AP and achieves comparable performance to several LiDAR-based methods.
2001.03398|v2.assessment: DSGN通过可微3D几何体积表示显著缩小了立体与LiDAR方法在3D检测上的差距，其一阶段端到端设计简洁高效，对纯视觉3D检测有重要推动作用。
2001.03398|v2.contribution: 提出了DSGN，一种基于可微3D几何体积的一阶段立体3D目标检测网络。
2001.03398|v2.innovation: 首次在可微3D几何体积上联合学习深度与语义，实现端到端立体3D检测。
2001.03398|v2.result: 在KITTI上比之前立体方法AP高约10，与部分LiDAR方法性能相当。

2006.12884|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对弱监督目标检测（WSOD）中基于多实例学习（MIL）的方法倾向于定位判别性部位而非完整目标的问题，提出了空间似然投票（SLV）模块。SLV在训练中让所有区域提议作为投票者，对每个类别的空间似然进行投票，经膨胀对齐后将投票结果正则化为边界框，用于最终分类和定位。基于SLV，作者进一步提出端到端多任务学习框架，使分类和定位任务相互促进。在PASCAL VOC 2007和2012数据集上取得了优越性能。
2006.12884|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue in weakly supervised object detection (WSOD) where MIL-based methods tend to localize discriminative parts instead of whole objects. It proposes a Spatial Likelihood Voting (SLV) module where all region proposals vote for the spatial likelihood of each category, and the voting results are regularized into bounding boxes for final classification and localization. An end-to-end multi-task learning framework is further proposed to mutually promote classification and localization. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2007 and 2012 demonstrate superior performance.
2006.12884|v2.assessment: SLV通过投票机制有效缓解了弱监督检测中的部分定位问题，端到端多任务框架进一步提升了性能，对弱监督目标检测有积极贡献。
2006.12884|v2.contribution: 提出了空间似然投票（SLV）模块及端到端多任务学习框架，用于弱监督目标检测。
2006.12884|v2.innovation: 利用所有区域提议进行空间似然投票，并将投票结果正则化为边界框，无需边界框标注。
2006.12884|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2007和2012上取得了优越性能。

1912.01106|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动设备上目标检测架构设计多依赖手工、现有自动化搜索未考虑设备延迟的问题，提出了MnasFPN——一种面向移动端的检测头搜索空间，并结合延迟感知架构搜索生成高效目标检测模型。学习到的MnasFPN头与MobileNetV2主干结合，在Pixel上相似延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite高1.0 mAP且快10%。消融实验表明大部分性能增益来自搜索空间的创新，并揭示了搜索空间设计与搜索算法之间的有趣耦合。
1912.01106|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of on-device object detection architectures and the lack of latency guidance in existing automated searches. It proposes MnasFPN, a mobile-friendly search space for the detection head, combined with latency-aware architecture search. The learned MnasFPN head with MobileNetV2 body outperforms MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.8 mAP at similar latency on Pixel, and is 1.0 mAP more accurate and 10% faster than NAS-FPNLite. Ablation studies show most gains come from search space innovations and reveal coupling between search space and algorithm.
1912.01106|v2.assessment: MnasFPN通过延迟感知的架构搜索和移动友好的搜索空间，在移动端目标检测上实现了精度与速度的良好平衡，对高效检测模型设计有实用价值。
1912.01106|v2.contribution: 提出了移动友好的MnasFPN检测头搜索空间，并结合延迟感知搜索生成高效目标检测模型。
1912.01106|v2.innovation: 设计了面向移动端的检测头搜索空间，并揭示了搜索空间与搜索算法之间的耦合关系。
1912.01106|v2.result: 在Pixel上相似延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.8 mAP，比NAS-FPNLite高1.0 mAP且快10%。

A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中现有方法未能充分利用点云间结构化关系的问题，提出了一种层次化图网络（Hierarchical Graph Network）。方法通过构建点级、提案级和类别级的多层次图结构，显式建模点云中局部几何与全局语义之间的关联，并利用图卷积进行特征聚合与推理。相比已有仅依赖局部体素或点特征的方法，该工作通过层次化图消息传递增强了上下文建模能力。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度，尤其在小目标和远距离场景下表现更优。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D object detection on point clouds by proposing a Hierarchical Graph Network that explicitly models structured relations among points at multiple levels. The method constructs point-level, proposal-level, and category-level graphs to aggregate local geometric and global semantic features via graph convolutions. It improves contextual reasoning over prior voxel- or point-based methods and achieves competitive performance on KITTI, particularly for small and distant objects.
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.assessment: 层次化图建模思路对点云检测的上下文推理有参考价值，但需关注其计算开销与实时性。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.contribution: 提出层次化图网络，在点、提案和类别三个层级上建模点云结构化关系以增强3D检测。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.innovation: 将图神经网络的多层级消息传递机制引入点云3D检测，实现局部几何与全局语义的联合推理。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI 3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度，尤其在小目标和远距离场景下优于基线方法。
A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Obje._arxiv_id: A Hierarchical Graph Network for 3D Object Detection on Point Clouds.

2003.00504|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中遮挡样本因信息缺失而检测困难的问题，提出MonoPair方法，利用相邻物体对之间的空间关系来编码约束。具体地，检测器对相邻物体对的位置和3D距离进行不确定性感知预测，并通过非线性最小二乘联合优化，同时将单阶段预测结构与后优化模块集成以保证运行效率。在KITTI 3D检测基准上大幅超越当时最优方法，尤其在困难样本上提升显著。
2003.00504|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection for occluded samples by proposing MonoPair, which exploits pairwise spatial relationships between adjacent objects. The detector performs uncertainty-aware prediction of object locations and 3D distances for adjacent pairs, jointly optimized via nonlinear least squares, with a one-stage structure integrated with a post-optimization module for runtime efficiency. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark with large margins, especially on hard samples.
2003.00504|v2.assessment: 利用成对空间约束提升遮挡场景下的单目3D检测，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶感知有直接应用价值。
2003.00504|v2.contribution: 提出MonoPair，通过建模相邻物体对的空间关系来增强遮挡样本的单目3D检测。
2003.00504|v2.innovation: 将不确定性感知的成对预测与非线性最小二乘后优化结合，编码物体间空间约束。
2003.00504|v2.result: 在KITTI 3D检测基准上大幅超越当时最优方法，困难样本上提升尤为显著。

1912.04799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中缺乏准确深度信息、传统2D卷积无法捕捉物体局部尺度的问题，提出深度引导的动态深度可分离空洞局部卷积网络D⁴LCN。方法不依赖伪LiDAR表示，而是让卷积核及其感受野从图像深度图中自动学习，使不同图像的不同像素拥有不同的滤波器，从而弥合图像表示与3D点云表示之间的差距。大量实验表明D⁴LCN在KITTI等基准上显著优于基于伪LiDAR的方法，验证了深度引导卷积的有效性。
1912.04799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection where accurate depth is unavailable and conventional 2D convolutions fail to capture local object scale. It proposes D⁴LCN, a depth-guided dynamic-depthwise-dilated local convolutional network that learns filters and receptive fields from image-based depth maps, allowing different pixels to have different filters without relying on pseudo-LiDAR. Extensive experiments show D⁴LCN substantially outperforms pseudo-LiDAR-based methods on KITTI, narrowing the gap between image and 3D point cloud representations.
1912.04799|v2.assessment: 从卷积算子层面改进单目3D检测，避免伪LiDAR的深度误差传播，思路新颖且实验充分。
1912.04799|v2.contribution: 提出深度引导的动态局部卷积D⁴LCN，使卷积核和感受野从深度图自适应学习以增强单目3D检测。
1912.04799|v2.innovation: 用深度图驱动卷积核与感受野的动态生成，替代伪LiDAR表示，弥合2D图像与3D点云的表征差距。
1912.04799|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著优于基于伪LiDAR的方法，验证了深度引导卷积的有效性。

2003.09119|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于关键点的检测器中角点匹配错误频发、严重影响检测性能的问题，提出CentripetalNet，利用向心偏移（centripetal shift）来配对同一实例的角点。方法预测角点位置及向心偏移，将偏移后对齐的角点进行匹配，比传统嵌入方法更准确；同时设计十字星可变形卷积网络进行特征自适应，并扩展出实例分割模块。在MS-COCO test-dev上以48.0% AP超越所有现有anchor-free检测器，Mask AP达40.2%，与最优实例分割方法相当。
2003.09119|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incorrect keypoint matching in keypoint-based detectors by proposing CentripetalNet, which uses centripetal shift to pair corner keypoints from the same instance. It predicts corner positions and centripetal shifts, matching corners whose shifted results align, and introduces a cross-star deformable convolution for feature adaptation, plus a mask prediction module for instance segmentation. On MS-COCO test-dev, it achieves 48.0% AP, outperforming all existing anchor-free detectors, and 40.2% Mask AP, comparable to state-of-the-art instance segmentation methods.
2003.09119|v2.assessment: 向心偏移匹配策略有效解决了角点配对歧义，对anchor-free检测和实例分割均有参考意义。
2003.09119|v2.contribution: 提出CentripetalNet，利用向心偏移实现高质量角点配对，并扩展至实例分割。
2003.09119|v2.innovation: 用向心偏移替代嵌入向量进行角点匹配，并设计十字星可变形卷积增强角点特征。
2003.09119|v2.result: 在MS-COCO test-dev上达到48.0% AP和40.2% Mask AP，超越所有anchor-free检测器。

2006.04356|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云目标检测中因空间遮挡和点密度随距离变化导致同一物体外观差异大、特征鲁棒性不足的问题，提出Associate-3Ddet，采用类域自适应的方法增强特征表示。方法在来自真实场景的感知域与来自无遮挡、信息丰富的增强场景的概念域之间建立桥接，模拟人脑物体感知的功能。大量实验表明该简单有效的方法从根本上提升了3D点云目标检测性能，并达到当时最优结果。
2006.04356|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of robust feature representation in 3D point cloud object detection, where spatial occlusion and distance-dependent point density cause large appearance variations. It proposes Associate-3Ddet, a domain-adaptation-like approach that bridges the perceptual domain from real scenes and the conceptual domain from augmented non-occluded point clouds, mimicking human object perception. Extensive experiments show it fundamentally boosts 3D point cloud detection and achieves state-of-the-art results.
2006.04356|v2.assessment: 将域自适应思想引入点云检测以应对遮挡和密度变化，视角新颖，但需关注增强场景构建的合理性。
2006.04356|v2.contribution: 提出Associate-3Ddet，通过感知域与概念域的关联增强点云特征对遮挡和密度变化的鲁棒性。
2006.04356|v2.innovation: 以类域自适应方式桥接真实场景与无遮挡增强场景的特征表示，模拟人类物体感知机制。
2006.04356|v2.result: 在3D点云检测基准上达到当时最优结果，显著提升了对遮挡和密度变化场景的鲁棒性。

1908.01998|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统目标检测需要大量标注数据、难以检测未见类别的问题，提出一种少样本目标检测网络，仅需少量标注样本即可检测新类别。核心包括Attention-RPN、Multi-Relation Detector和对比训练策略，利用支持集与查询集之间的相似性检测新物体并抑制背景误检；同时贡献了一个包含1000类高质量标注的新数据集。方法训练后无需微调即可检测未见类别，在多个数据集上取得少样本设置下的最优性能。
1908.01998|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection, aiming to detect unseen categories with only a few annotated examples. It proposes an Attention-RPN, a Multi-Relation Detector, and a contrastive training strategy that exploit similarity between support and query sets to detect novel objects while suppressing background false positives, and contributes a new 1000-category dataset with high-quality annotations. The trained network detects unseen categories without further fine-tuning and achieves state-of-the-art performance in few-shot settings across multiple datasets.
1908.01998|v2.assessment: 少样本检测的经典工作，Attention-RPN与多关系检测器设计合理，配套数据集对领域有长期价值。
1908.01998|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力RPN和多关系检测器的少样本目标检测网络，并贡献大规模少样本检测数据集。
1908.01998|v2.innovation: 利用支持集与查询集的相似性进行注意力RPN和多关系推理，实现无需微调的未见类别检测。
1908.01998|v2.result: 在多个数据集上取得少样本设置下的最优性能，并发布了包含1000类的高质量标注数据集。

Taking a Deeper Look at Co-Salient Objec.summary_cn: 该论文研究共显著性物体检测（Co-Salient Object Detection），即在一组相关图像中共同检测出重复出现的显著物体。由于摘要为空，无法确认其提出的具体方法、与已有工作的对比以及实验效果。该方向与自动驾驶中的多帧/多相机一致性感知有微弱关联，但任务设定差异较大。

Due to the missing abstract, the proposed method, comparisons with prior work, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The task has only marginal relevance to autonomous driving perception.

2004.08515|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 RGB-D 显著性物体检测中 RGB 与深度信息被独立处理、易受训练数据量限制和训练流程依赖的问题，提出了联合学习与密集协作融合框架 JL-DCF。方法上采用 Siamese 网络同时学习 RGB 和深度输入，并设计联合学习（JL）模块进行鲁棒显著性特征学习、密集协作融合（DCF）模块发现互补特征。在六个挑战性数据集上，JL-DCF 在 S-measure 指标上平均超越当时最优的 D3Net 约 1.9%，展现出良好的泛化能力。
2004.08515|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses RGB-D salient object detection where RGB and depth are typically processed independently, leading to data-hungry and training-sensitive pipelines. It proposes JL-DCF, a Siamese-based joint learning and densely-cooperative fusion framework with a JL module for robust saliency feature learning and a DCF module for complementary feature discovery. Across six challenging datasets, JL-DCF surpasses the top-1 D3Net by ~1.9% in S-measure on average, demonstrating strong generalization.
2004.08515|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态融合策略上有一定设计，跨模态互补思路对自动驾驶多传感器融合有参考价值，但任务本身与车载感知距离较远。
2004.08515|v2.contribution: 提出了联合学习与密集协作融合的 RGB-D 显著性检测框架 JL-DCF。
2004.08515|v2.innovation: 通过 Siamese 网络实现 RGB 与深度的联合学习，并用密集协作融合模块挖掘跨模态互补特征。
2004.08515|v2.result: 在六个数据集上 S-measure 平均超越 D3Net 约 1.9%。

1912.05384|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 FPN 多尺度特征学习中存在的设计缺陷——不同层级语义鸿沟大、最高层特征信息损失严重、RoI 特征选择次优——提出了 AugFPN 特征金字塔架构。方法包含三个组件：一致性监督（Consistent Supervision）在融合前缩小不同尺度特征的语义差距，残差特征增强（Residual Feature Augmentation）提取比例不变上下文信息以减少最高层特征图的信息损失，软 RoI 选择（Soft RoI Selection）在融合后自适应学习更好的 RoI 特征。在 Faster R-CNN 中用 AugFPN 替换 FPN，以 ResNet50 和 MobileNet-v2 为骨干时 AP 分别提升 2.3 和 1.6 个点。
1912.05384|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies design defects in FPN's multi-scale feature learning, including semantic gaps across levels, information loss at the highest pyramid level, and suboptimal RoI feature selection, and proposes AugFPN. AugFPN comprises Consistent Supervision to narrow semantic gaps before fusion, Residual Feature Augmentation to extract ratio-invariant context and reduce information loss, and Soft RoI Selection for adaptive RoI feature learning after fusion. Replacing FPN with AugFPN in Faster R-CNN improves AP by 2.3 and 1.6 points with ResNet50 and MobileNet-v2 backbones, respectively.
1912.05384|v2.assessment: AugFPN 对 FPN 的缺陷分析清晰，三个改进模块设计合理且即插即用，对自动驾驶中的多尺度目标检测有直接参考价值。
1912.05384|v2.contribution: 提出了改进多尺度特征学习的 AugFPN 特征金字塔架构。
1912.05384|v2.innovation: 通过一致性监督、残差特征增强和软 RoI 选择三个组件系统性地修复 FPN 的设计缺陷。
1912.05384|v2.result: 在 Faster R-CNN 上以 ResNet50 和 MobileNet-v2 为骨干分别提升 AP 2.3 和 1.6 个点。

2003.11818|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测 NAS 方法仅搜索检测器单一组件（骨干或特征融合层）而其余部分仍需手工设计、导致搜索组件与手工组件不一致从而限制性能的问题，提出了层次化三位一体搜索框架 Hit-Detector。方法上以端到端方式同时搜索检测器的骨干、颈部和头部三个组件，并发现不同组件偏好不同算子，因此设计了自动筛选不同子搜索空间的方案以高效进行端到端搜索。搜索得到的 Hit-Detector 在 COCO minival 上以 27M 参数达到 41.4% mAP。
2003.11818|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of prior detection NAS methods that search only a single component while leaving others manually designed, causing inconsistency that caps performance. It proposes a hierarchical trinity search framework, Hit-Detector, that simultaneously discovers architectures for the backbone, neck, and head in an end-to-end manner, with a scheme to automatically screen different sub-search spaces per component. The searched architecture achieves 41.4% mAP on COCO minival with 27M parameters.
2003.11818|v2.assessment: 该工作将 NAS 从单组件搜索推进到检测器全组件联合搜索，思路完整且有实证支撑，对自动化检测器设计有参考意义。
2003.11818|v2.contribution: 提出了同时搜索检测器骨干、颈部和头部的层次化三位一体 NAS 框架 Hit-Detector。
2003.11818|v2.innovation: 端到端联合搜索检测器全部核心组件，并为不同组件自动筛选不同子搜索空间。
2003.11818|v2.result: 在 COCO minival 上以 27M 参数取得 41.4% mAP。

Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_cn: 该论文标题为基于点云的结构感知单阶段 3D 目标检测，针对点云 3D 检测中结构信息利用不足的问题提出方法。由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体网络设计、改进点和实验数据。从标题判断，该工作属于单阶段点云 3D 检测方向，与自动驾驶感知高度相关。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper presents a structure-aware single-stage 3D object detection method from point clouds. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific architecture, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be verified. Based on the title, it targets single-stage point-cloud 3D detection, which is highly relevant to autonomous driving perception.
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.assessment: 单阶段点云 3D 检测是自动驾驶感知的核心方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.contribution: 提出了一种结构感知的单阶段点云 3D 目标检测方法（具体内容因摘要缺失无法确认）。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.innovation: 创新点因摘要缺失无法准确判断，推测在点云结构信息建模或单阶段检测头设计方面有所贡献。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D.result: 因摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object D._arxiv_id: Structure Aware Single-Stage 3D Object Detection From Point Cloud.

1912.04986|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR等3D传感器数据本质上是2.5D而非真3D、主流方法（如PointNet）将其视为(x,y,z)点集从而丢失自由空间可见性信息的问题，提出通过3D raycasting高效恢复可见性信息，并将其体素化为可见性图作为额外输入流，融入基于体素的3D检测网络。该方法还可与虚拟物体合成数据增强及多帧LiDAR时序聚合这两种SOTA检测器常用技术结合。在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，仅增加一路可见性输入流即可显著提升检测性能（摘要中具体数值被截断）。
1912.04986|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that representing 2.5D LiDAR data as (x,y,z) point sets destroys hidden freespace visibility information, and proposes recovering it via 3D raycasting and feeding a voxelized visibility map as an additional input stream to voxel-based detectors. The approach is compatible with synthetic virtual-object augmentation and temporal LiDAR aggregation. On the NuScenes 3D detection benchmark, adding the visibility stream significantly improves detection performance.
1912.04986|v2.assessment: 该工作从传感器数据本质出发重新审视3D表示，思路简洁且即插即用，对基于体素的LiDAR检测器有普适增益，值得关注。
1912.04986|v2.contribution: 提出将3D raycasting得到的体素化可见性图作为额外输入流，显式恢复并利用LiDAR数据中被点集表示丢弃的自由空间信息。
1912.04986|v2.innovation: 揭示2.5D传感器数据中点集表示会丢失可见性信息，并证明该信息可高效恢复且能与数据增强、时序聚合等SOTA技术协同。
1912.04986|v2.result: 在NuScenes 3D检测基准上，仅增加可见性输入流即显著提升检测精度。

2011.09094|v2.summary_cn: DETR 从零训练需要极长 schedule 和大规模数据，收敛慢。本文提出无监督预训练方法 UP-DETR，通过随机裁剪图像 patch 作为 query 输入 decoder，让模型在预训练阶段检测这些 query patch，并解决多任务学习与多 query 定位问题（冻结 CNN backbone、引入 attention mask）。相比从零训练，UP-DETR 显著加速收敛并提升检测性能，同时为微调检测和 one-shot 检测提供统一视角。
2011.09094|v2.summary_en: DETR suffers from slow convergence and requires large-scale data when trained from scratch. This paper proposes UP-DETR, an unsupervised pre-training method with a random query patch detection pretext task, where randomly cropped patches are fed as queries to the decoder. By freezing the CNN backbone and using attention masks for multi-query localization, UP-DETR accelerates convergence and improves detection performance, also offering a unified view for fine-tuning and one-shot detection.
2011.09094|v2.assessment: 首次将无监督预训练引入 DETR 类检测器，思路简洁有效，对后续 DETR 预训练工作有启发意义。
2011.09094|v2.contribution: 提出随机 query patch 检测的无监督预训练范式，解决 DETR 从零训练收敛慢的问题。
2011.09094|v2.innovation: 将 NLP 中预训练 transformer 的思想迁移到 DETR，并设计多 query patch 检测与 attention mask 机制。
2011.09094|v2.result: 显著加速 DETR 收敛并提升检测性能，同时支持 one-shot 检测。

Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_cn: 该论文提出 Dynamic DETR，旨在通过动态注意力机制改进端到端目标检测。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题推断，其核心是让注意力在解码过程中动态调整，以提升 DETR 类模型的检测精度与效率。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.summary_en: This paper proposes Dynamic DETR for end-to-end object detection with dynamic attention. Due to the missing abstract, specific method details and experimental results are unavailable. The core idea appears to be dynamically adjusting attention during decoding to improve DETR-based detection accuracy and efficiency.
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.assessment: 动态注意力用于 DETR 的思路有一定价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.contribution: 提出 Dynamic DETR，将动态注意力机制引入端到端目标检测。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.innovation: 在 DETR 框架中引入动态注意力以自适应调整特征关注区域。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detectio._arxiv_id: Dynamic DETR: End-to-End Object Detection with Dynamic Attention.

2010.04159|v2.summary_cn: DETR 虽简化了检测流程，但存在收敛慢和特征空间分辨率受限的问题。本文提出 Deformable DETR，其注意力模块仅在参考点周围的一小部分采样点上进行注意力计算，从而缓解上述问题。在 COCO 上，Deformable DETR 以少 10 倍的训练 epoch 达到优于 DETR 的性能，尤其在小目标上提升明显。
2010.04159|v2.summary_en: DETR suffers from slow convergence and limited feature spatial resolution due to transformer attention limitations. This paper proposes Deformable DETR, whose attention modules attend only to a small set of key sampling points around a reference. On COCO, it achieves better performance than DETR, especially on small objects, with 10× fewer training epochs.
2010.04159|v2.assessment: Deformable DETR 是 DETR 系列里程碑式工作，可变形注意力设计优雅且效果显著，被后续大量工作沿用。
2010.04159|v2.contribution: 提出可变形注意力模块，使 DETR 仅关注参考点周围的少量采样点。
2010.04159|v2.innovation: 将可变形卷积的稀疏采样思想引入 Transformer 注意力，解决 DETR 收敛慢和分辨率受限问题。
2010.04159|v2.result: 以少 10 倍训练 epoch 超越 DETR，小目标检测提升显著。

2104.02628|v2.summary_cn: 显著目标检测（SOD）与伪装目标检测（COD）任务目标相反，本文提出利用两者的矛盾信息互相增强检测能力。方法包括：将 COD 中的易正样本作为 SOD 的难正样本以提升鲁棒性，引入相似性度量模块显式建模两任务的矛盾属性，并针对标注不确定性提出对抗学习网络实现高阶相似性度量和置信度估计。在基准数据集上两个任务均达到 SOTA。
2104.02628|v2.summary_en: SOD and COD aim at opposite targets. This paper proposes leveraging their contradictory information to enhance both tasks: using easy positives from COD as hard positives for SOD, introducing a similarity measure module to model contradicting attributes, and an adversarial learning network for higher-order similarity and confidence estimation under label uncertainty. Experiments show SOTA on both tasks.
2104.02628|v2.assessment: 跨任务矛盾信息利用的思路有新意，但与自动驾驶/3D 感知领域相关度较低。
2104.02628|v2.contribution: 提出联合显著目标与伪装目标检测框架，利用两任务的矛盾信息互相增强。
2104.02628|v2.innovation: 将 COD 易正样本用作 SOD 难正样本，并用对抗学习处理标注不确定性。
2104.02628|v2.result: 在 SOD 和 COD 基准数据集上均达到 SOTA 性能。

2104.02323|v2.summary_cn: 单目 3D 检测中，现有方法对所有目标采用统一处理方式，导致截断目标性能受限。本文提出 MonoFlex 灵活框架，显式解耦截断目标，并自适应融合多种深度估计方法：将特征图边缘解耦以预测长尾截断目标，同时将目标深度估计建模为直接回归深度与关键点求解深度的不确定性引导集成。在 KITTI 测试集上，中等难度相对提升 27%，困难难度提升 30%，并保持实时性。
2104.02323|v2.summary_en: Existing monocular 3D detectors treat all objects uniformly, limiting performance on truncated objects. This paper proposes MonoFlex, a flexible framework that explicitly decouples truncated objects and adaptively combines multiple depth estimation approaches: decoupling feature map edges for long-tail truncated objects and formulating depth estimation as an uncertainty-guided ensemble of direct regression and keypoint-solved depths. It outperforms SOTA by 27% (moderate) and 30% (hard) on KITTI while maintaining real-time efficiency.
2104.02323|v2.assessment: MonoFlex 针对截断目标和深度估计融合提出有效方案，在 KITTI 上提升显著且保持实时，对单目 3D 检测有重要参考价值。
2104.02323|v2.contribution: 提出灵活的单目 3D 检测框架 MonoFlex，解耦截断目标并自适应融合多种深度估计。
2104.02323|v2.innovation: 特征图边缘解耦处理长尾截断目标，以及不确定性引导的深度集成策略。
2104.02323|v2.result: KITTI 测试集中等难度提升 27%、困难难度提升 30%，保持实时。

2103.11402|v2.summary_cn: 监督目标检测依赖大量人工标注，半监督目标检测（SSOD）可利用无标注数据提升性能。本文提出 Instant-Teaching，一个完全端到端的 SSOD 框架，在每次训练迭代中使用即时伪标签和扩展的弱-强数据增强进行教学；进一步提出基于协同矫正的 Instant-Teaching* 以缓解确认偏差并提升伪标注质量。在 MS-COCO 上使用 2% 标注数据时超越 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下仍超越约 1.0 mAP；在 PASCAL VOC 上提升超过 5 mAP。
2103.11402|v2.summary_en: Supervised object detection requires laborious annotations. This paper proposes Instant-Teaching, a fully end-to-end semi-supervised object detection framework using instant pseudo labeling with extended weak-strong augmentations during each training iteration. It further introduces Instant-Teaching* with a co-rectify scheme to alleviate confirmation bias. It surpasses SOTA by 4.2 mAP on MS-COCO with 2% labels, by ~1.0 mAP under full supervision, and by over 5 mAP on PASCAL VOC.
2103.11402|v2.assessment: Instant-Teaching 在半监督检测中提出即时伪标签与协同矫正，实验充分且提升显著，对减少标注依赖有实用价值。
2103.11402|v2.contribution: 提出端到端半监督目标检测框架 Instant-Teaching 及其协同矫正版本 Instant-Teaching*。
2103.11402|v2.innovation: 即时伪标签结合扩展弱-强数据增强，以及基于协同矫正的确认偏差缓解机制。
2103.11402|v2.result: MS-COCO 2% 标注下超越 SOTA 4.2 mAP，全监督下超越约 1.0 mAP，PASCAL VOC 提升超 5 mAP。

2104.07434|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱半监督目标检测中标注成本高的问题，论文提出了一种新的点标注设定：少量全标注图像加大量仅点标注图像。为此设计了Point DETR，在DETR基础上增加点编码器以充分利用点标注。在MS-COCO上，使用20%全标注数据时达到33.3 AP，比FCOS基线高2.0 AP，且点标注在多种AR指标上带来超过10个点的提升。
2104.07434|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a point-annotated setting for weakly semi-supervised object detection, combining a small fully annotated set with a large point-annotated set. It proposes Point DETR, which extends DETR with a point encoder to better exploit point annotations. On MS-COCO with 20% fully labeled data, it achieves 33.3 AP, outperforming FCOS by 2.0 AP, and point annotations improve various AR metrics by over 10 points.
2104.07434|v2.assessment: 该工作为降低目标检测标注成本提供了实用方案，点标注设定新颖且实验充分，对半监督检测研究有参考价值。
2104.07434|v2.contribution: 提出了点标注的弱半监督检测设定及Point DETR检测器。
2104.07434|v2.innovation: 在DETR中引入点编码器，有效利用点标注信息。
2104.07434|v2.result: 在COCO 20%全标注下达到33.3 AP，超越FCOS 2.0 AP，AR指标提升超10点。

2103.17202|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中NMS仅在推理阶段使用导致训练与推理不匹配的问题，论文提出了GrooMeD-NMS，一种分组可微NMS。该方法将NMS表述为矩阵操作，并通过无监督分组和掩码获得闭式表达，使网络能端到端训练并优化NMS后的框。在KITTI基准上取得了当时最优的单目3D检测结果，性能与基于单目视频的方法相当。
2103.17202|v2.summary_en: To address the mismatch between training and inference caused by using NMS only at inference in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes GrooMeD-NMS, a grouped mathematically differentiable NMS. It formulates NMS as a matrix operation and derives a closed-form expression via unsupervised grouping and masking, enabling end-to-end training with a loss on post-NMS boxes. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection on KITTI, comparable to monocular video-based methods.
2103.17202|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将NMS融入单目3D检测的训练流程，解决了训练推理不一致问题，对3D检测端到端优化有重要启发。
2103.17202|v2.contribution: 提出了可微分的分组NMS并集成到单目3D检测训练中。
2103.17202|v2.innovation: 将NMS表达为矩阵操作并分组掩码，实现闭式可微表达。
2103.17202|v2.result: 在KITTI上取得最优单目3D检测结果，媲美单目视频方法。

2012.04355|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测标注成本高的问题，论文提出了3DIoUMatch，一种适用于室内外场景的半监督3D检测方法。该方法采用教师-学生互学习框架生成伪标签，并引入基于预测物体性和类别概率的置信度过滤，进一步提出使用估计的3D IoU作为定位度量并设置类别自适应阈值来过滤低质量伪标签。在室内VoteNet和室外KITTI PV-RCNN上均取得一致提升。
2012.04355|v2.summary_en: To reduce the annotation burden in 3D object detection, this paper proposes 3DIoUMatch, a semi-supervised method for both indoor and outdoor scenes. It uses a teacher-student mutual learning framework to generate pseudo-labels, with confidence-based filtering and a novel 3D IoU-based localization metric with category-aware self-adjusted thresholds. It consistently improves performance on indoor (VoteNet) and outdoor (KITTI, PV-RCNN) benchmarks.
2012.04355|v2.assessment: 该工作系统解决了半监督3D检测中伪标签噪声问题，提出的3D IoU过滤机制有效，对降低3D标注依赖有重要价值。
2012.04355|v2.contribution: 提出了基于3D IoU过滤的半监督3D目标检测框架3DIoUMatch。
2012.04355|v2.innovation: 利用估计的3D IoU作为定位度量并设置类别自适应阈值过滤伪标签。
2012.04355|v2.result: 在室内外3D检测基准上均取得一致性能提升。

2106.11346|v2.summary_cn: 针对不同下游任务对预训练模型的需求差异（如延迟约束、特定数据分布）以及大规模预训练成本高的问题，论文提出了GAIA，一个目标检测迁移学习系统。GAIA能自动高效地根据下游需求提供预训练权重、选择符合延迟和数据域约束的模型，并为数据稀缺的任务收集相关数据。在COCO、Objects365、Open Images、Caltech、CityPersons及UODB等多个数据集上取得了有前景的结果。
2106.11346|v2.summary_en: To address the high cost of large-scale pre-training for diverse downstream object detection needs (e.g., latency constraints, specialized data distributions), this paper presents GAIA, a transfer learning system. GAIA automatically provides pre-trained weights, selects models satisfying downstream constraints, and collects relevant data for data-scarce tasks. It achieves promising results on COCO, Objects365, Open Images, Caltech, CityPersons, and UODB.
2106.11346|v2.assessment: 该工作从系统角度解决目标检测迁移学习中的实际部署问题，具有工程应用价值，但方法创新性相对有限。
2106.11346|v2.contribution: 提出了面向多样化下游需求的目标检测迁移学习系统GAIA。
2106.11346|v2.innovation: 自动化地根据延迟约束和数据域选择模型并收集相关数据。
2106.11346|v2.result: 在多个检测数据集上取得有前景的迁移学习效果。

2106.13381|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中如何从距离图像直接学习3D表示的问题，论文设计了一种2D卷积网络架构，在网络中携带每个像素的3D球坐标，并支持使用任意卷积核替代默认内积核以利用局部几何。论文提出了四种核：基于词袋的密集核以及受图神经网络启发的Transformer、PointNet和Edge Convolution图核，并探索了与相机图像的跨模态融合。在Waymo Open Dataset上，行人检测AP从69.7%提升至75.5%，且最小模型比PointPillars质量更好，FLOPS和参数量少180倍。
2106.13381|v2.summary_en: To learn 3D representations directly from range images for 3D object detection, this paper designs a 2D convolutional network that carries 3D spherical coordinates per pixel and supports arbitrary convolution kernels. It introduces four kernels: a dense bag-of-words kernel and three graph kernels (Transformer, PointNet, Edge Convolution), and explores cross-modality fusion with camera images. On Waymo Open Dataset, it improves pedestrian AP from 69.7% to 75.5%, and its smallest model outperforms PointPillars with 180x fewer FLOPS and parameters.
2106.13381|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将图卷积核应用于距离图像，在Waymo上取得显著提升且计算高效，对3D检测的表示学习有借鉴意义。
2106.13381|v2.contribution: 提出了在距离图像上携带3D坐标并支持多种图卷积核的3D检测网络。
2106.13381|v2.innovation: 将Transformer、PointNet、Edge Convolution等图核引入距离图像卷积。
2106.13381|v2.result: Waymo行人AP从69.7%提升至75.5%，最小模型比PointPillars高效180倍。

2103.12605|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中3D定位困难且依赖难以获取的物体几何真值的问题，论文提出了MonoRUn框架，以自监督方式学习密集对应和几何，仅需简单的3D框标注。方法采用区域重建网络回归像素相关的3D物体坐标并感知不确定性，通过将预测的3D坐标投影回图像平面进行自监督训练，并提出鲁棒KL损失最小化不确定性加权的重投影误差。测试时通过不确定性传播驱动PnP算法估计物体位姿及其协方差。
2103.12605|v2.summary_en: To address the difficulty of 3D localization and reliance on hard-to-obtain object geometry ground truth in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoRUn, which learns dense correspondences and geometry self-supervisedly with only 3D bounding box annotations. It employs a regional reconstruction network with uncertainty awareness, projects predicted 3D coordinates back to the image for self-supervision, and uses a robust KL loss to minimize uncertainty-weighted reprojection error. At test time, uncertainty is propagated through an uncertainty-driven PnP algorithm to estimate object pose and covariance.
2103.12605|v2.assessment: 该工作将不确定性传播与自监督重建结合用于单目3D检测，方法新颖且无需物体几何真值，对实际自动驾驶场景有重要价值。
2103.12605|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督学习密集对应和不确定性传播的单目3D检测框架MonoRUn。
2103.12605|v2.innovation: 利用不确定性驱动的PnP算法和鲁棒KL损失实现自监督几何学习。
2103.12605|v2.result: 在仅用3D框标注下实现了高精度单目3D定位。

Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_cn: ①针对单样本目标检测（one-shot object detection）中查询图像与支持图像之间尺度、外观差异大导致匹配困难的问题。②提出自适应图像Transformer（Adaptive Image Transformer），通过自适应特征聚合与跨图像注意力机制，在单一支持样本条件下增强查询-支持特征对齐。③相比已有单样本检测方法，改进了对尺度变化和类内差异的鲁棒性。④摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文验证。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.summary_en: This paper addresses one-shot object detection, where large scale and appearance variations between query and support images hinder matching. It proposes an Adaptive Image Transformer that performs adaptive feature aggregation and cross-image attention to enhance query-support alignment under a single support example. Compared with prior one-shot detectors, it improves robustness to scale changes and intra-class variation, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.assessment: 单样本检测与Transformer结合的方向有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验规模与泛化性。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.contribution: 提出自适应图像Transformer用于单样本目标检测，增强查询-支持特征对齐。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.innovation: 将自适应注意力机制引入单样本检测以应对尺度与外观差异。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，效果需正文验证。
Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot._arxiv_id: Adaptive Image Transformer for One-Shot Object Detection.

2103.16148|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测模型对抗攻击鲁棒性不足、已有防御方法多聚焦分类任务的问题。②提出类感知鲁棒对抗训练范式，为每张图像生成同时攻击所有目标的通用对抗扰动，并将总损失按类别分解、按类内目标数归一化。③相比以往防御方法，类加权损失平衡了各类别影响，更均匀地提升所有类别的对抗鲁棒性。④摘要未给出具体mAP或鲁棒性数值，需正文确认。
2103.16148|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of adversarial robustness in object detection, where prior defenses mainly target classification. It proposes a class-aware robust adversarial training paradigm that generates a universal perturbation attacking all objects simultaneously and decomposes the total loss into class-wise terms normalized by per-class object counts. This class-weighted loss balances class influence and more evenly improves robustness across all object classes compared with previous defenses, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2103.16148|v2.assessment: 对抗鲁棒性在检测任务中的系统性研究较少，类加权对抗训练思路合理，值得关注其鲁棒性-精度权衡。
2103.16148|v2.contribution: 提出类感知对抗训练范式，通过类加权损失提升检测器对所有类别的对抗鲁棒性。
2103.16148|v2.innovation: 将总损失按类别分解并按类内目标数归一化，实现类别均衡的对抗训练。
2103.16148|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，需正文验证鲁棒性提升幅度。

2103.17220|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测中数据增强策略依赖人工设计、缺乏尺度感知自动搜索的问题。②提出Scale-aware AutoAug，定义同时包含图像级与框级增强的尺度感知搜索空间，并提出Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标以高效搜索。③相比已有自动增强方法，搜索代价更低，且策略可迁移至其他数据集与框级任务（如实例分割、关键点估计）。④在RetinaNet、Faster R-CNN、Mask R-CNN、FCOS上取得显著且一致的提升，甚至优于强多尺度训练基线。
2103.17220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of scale-aware automatic augmentation policies for object detection. It proposes Scale-aware AutoAug, which defines a scale-aware search space covering both image- and box-level augmentations and introduces a Pareto Scale Balance metric for efficient search. The searched policies yield significant and consistent gains on RetinaNet, Faster R-CNN, Mask R-CNN, and FCOS, even outperforming strong multi-scale training baselines, and transfer to other datasets and box-level tasks with much lower search cost than prior automated augmentation methods.
2103.17220|v2.assessment: 自动增强在检测中的系统性工作，搜索空间与指标设计合理，实验充分且策略可迁移，实用价值高。
2103.17220|v2.contribution: 提出尺度感知自动增强框架Scale-aware AutoAug及Pareto Scale Balance搜索指标。
2103.17220|v2.innovation: 同时设计图像级与框级增强的尺度感知搜索空间，并实现低代价高效搜索。
2103.17220|v2.result: 在多种检测器上取得一致提升，优于多尺度训练基线，且策略可迁移至实例分割与关键点估计。

2007.06919|v2.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测在极低位宽（如2-bit）量化下性能严重下降、且难以在通用硬件上验证效率的问题。②提出AQD，在卷积层、归一化层和跳跃连接中全部使用定点运算，实现纯整数推理，彻底去除浮点计算。③相比已有量化方法，AQD在极低位宽下仍保持精度，并展示更好的延迟-精度权衡。④在MS-COCO上，RetinaNet与FCOS在极低位宽下达到与全精度模型相当甚至更好的性能。
2007.06919|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses severe performance degradation and unverifiable efficiency of aggressive low-bit (e.g., 2-bit) quantization for object detection. It proposes AQD, which uses fixed-point operations in convolutional layers, normalization layers, and skip connections to enable integer-only inference without any floating-point computation. Applied to RetinaNet and FCOS, AQD achieves comparable or even better performance than full-precision counterparts under extremely low-bit schemes on MS-COCO, demonstrating a better latency-vs-accuracy trade-off.
2007.06919|v2.assessment: 面向边缘部署的检测量化工作，整数-only推理的完整实现具有工程价值，极低位宽下精度保持值得关注。
2007.06919|v2.contribution: 提出全定点、整数-only推理的量化目标检测方案AQD。
2007.06919|v2.innovation: 在卷积、归一化与跳跃连接中统一使用定点运算，实现极低位宽下的精度保持。
2007.06919|v2.result: 在MS-COCO上RetinaNet与FCOS在极低位宽下达到与全精度相当甚至更优的性能。

2103.13886|v2.summary_cn: ①针对数据增强在目标检测中潜力未被充分挖掘、分类器增强收益在检测微调后衰减的问题。②提出在检测器微调阶段引入对抗样本作为模型相关数据增强，动态从分类与定位分支选择更强的对抗图像，并随检测器演化更新增强策略。③相比AutoAugment等模型无关增强，该方法对不同检测器泛化更好。④在COCO上使EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP，同时提升检测器鲁棒性。
2103.13886|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored potential of data augmentation for object detection, noting that classifier gains diminish after detector fine-tuning. It augments the fine-tuning stage with adversarial examples as model-dependent augmentation, dynamically selecting stronger adversarial images from classification and localization branches and evolving with the detector. This generalizes better across detectors than AutoAugment, boosting EfficientDets by +1.1 mAP on COCO while also improving robustness.
2103.13886|v2.assessment: 将对抗样本作为模型相关增强用于检测微调，思路新颖且实验扎实，对鲁棒性与精度双重提升有参考价值。
2103.13886|v2.contribution: 提出基于对抗样本的模型相关数据增强方法，用于目标检测器微调。
2103.13886|v2.innovation: 动态从分类与定位分支选择更强对抗样本，并随检测器演化更新增强策略。
2103.13886|v2.result: 在COCO上使EfficientDets提升+1.1 mAP，并改善检测器鲁棒性。

2104.06114|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测中Hough投票策略仅能获得物体表面部分投票、且受背景离群投票干扰的问题。②提出BRNet（Back-tracing Representative Points Network），从投票中心反向回溯代表点，并重新访问这些点周围的互补种子点，以更好捕获原始点云中潜在物体的局部结构特征。③相比现有投票方法，BRNet通过自底向上再自顶向下的策略，强制预测投票中心与原始表面点之间的一致性。④摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但方法在点云3D检测基准上应取得更可靠、灵活的定位效果。
2104.06114|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of Hough voting in point-cloud 3D detection, where only partial surface votes and severe outlier votes from cluttered backgrounds are obtained. It proposes BRNet (Back-tracing Representative Points Network), which generatively back-traces representative points from vote centers and revisits complementary seed points around them to better capture fine local structural features. This bottom-up then top-down strategy enforces mutual consistency between predicted vote centers and raw surface points, achieving more reliable and flexible object localization.
2104.06114|v2.assessment: 针对投票式3D检测的投票不完整与离群问题提出回溯策略，思路清晰，对点云检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2104.06114|v2.contribution: 提出BRNet，通过反向回溯代表点与重访种子点改进投票式点云3D检测。
2104.06114|v2.innovation: 自底向上再自顶向下的回溯策略，强制投票中心与原始表面点的一致性。
2104.06114|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，方法在点云3D检测上实现更可靠、灵活的定位。

2106.08322|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对目标检测头中分类与定位难以统一建模的问题，提出Dynamic Head框架，将尺度感知（特征层级间）、空间感知（空间位置间）和任务感知（输出通道内）三种自注意力机制统一到检测头中。相比此前各自改进检测头的工作，该方法在不增加计算开销的前提下显著提升检测头表示能力。在COCO上，使用ResNeXt-101-DCN骨干达到54.0 AP的新SOTA，结合Transformer骨干与额外数据进一步将COCO最佳结果推至60.6 AP。
2106.08322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of unifying classification and localization in object detection heads by proposing the Dynamic Head framework, which coherently combines scale-aware, spatial-aware, and task-aware self-attention mechanisms. Without any computational overhead, it significantly improves the representation ability of detection heads. It achieves a new state-of-the-art of 54.0 AP on COCO with a ResNeXt-101-DCN backbone, and pushes the best COCO result to 60.6 AP with a transformer backbone and extra data.
2106.08322|v2.assessment: 该工作以统一注意力视角重新审视检测头设计，思路清晰且效果显著，是目标检测头设计的重要参考。
2106.08322|v2.contribution: 提出统一尺度、空间与任务注意力的Dynamic Head检测头框架。
2106.08322|v2.innovation: 首次将多种自注意力机制一致地组合进检测头且不增加计算开销。
2106.08322|v2.result: COCO上达到54.0 AP，结合Transformer骨干与额外数据达到60.6 AP。

2103.02340|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对检测蒸馏方法泛化性差且过度依赖GT、忽略实例间关系信息的问题，提出通用实例蒸馏（GID），不区分GT正负样本，通过通用实例选择模块（GISM）综合利用特征、关系和响应知识进行蒸馏。相比已有方法，GID对不同检测框架具有更强泛化性。在COCO上，ResNet-50的RetinaNet使用GID达到39.1% mAP，超过基线36.2%达2.9%，甚至优于ResNet-101教师模型的38.1% AP。
2103.02340|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the weak generalization and heavy GT reliance of existing detection distillation methods by proposing General Instance Distillation (GID), which selects discriminative instances without GT-based positive/negative distinction and leverages feature-, relation-, and response-based knowledge via a general instance selection module. GID generalizes better across detection frameworks. On COCO, RetinaNet with ResNet-50 achieves 39.1% mAP, surpassing the 36.2% baseline by 2.9% and even outperforming the ResNet-101 teacher at 38.1% AP.
2103.02340|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了实例关系知识在检测蒸馏中的价值，方法通用且学生可超越教师，对模型压缩方向有较强参考意义。
2103.02340|v2.contribution: 提出不依赖GT正负区分的通用实例蒸馏方法GID。
2103.02340|v2.innovation: 通过通用实例选择模块融合特征、关系与响应三类知识进行检测蒸馏。
2103.02340|v2.result: RetinaNet-ResNet-50在COCO上达39.1% mAP，超过基线2.9%并超越教师模型。

2104.01108|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对共显著目标检测（Co-SOD）问题，提出组协作学习框架GCoNet，通过组亲和模块挖掘组内紧凑性以刻画共显著目标的共享属性，并通过组协作模块保证组间可分性以抑制噪声目标影响，同时引入辅助分类监督优化嵌入空间。相比10个前沿模型，GCoNet在CoCA、CoSOD3k和Cosal2015三个基准上取得新SOTA，且推理仅需16ms。
2104.01108|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses co-salient object detection by proposing the Group Collaborative Learning framework (GCoNet), which mines intra-group compactness via a group affinity module and enforces inter-group separability via a group collaborating module, with auxiliary classification supervision to improve the embedding space. GCoNet outperforms 10 cutting-edge models and achieves new state-of-the-art on CoCA, CoSOD3k, and Cosal2015 while running in real time (16ms).
2104.01108|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限，但在共显著检测任务上方法简洁高效，实时性与精度兼顾。
2104.01108|v2.contribution: 提出兼顾组内紧凑性与组间可分性的组协作学习框架GCoNet。
2104.01108|v2.innovation: 通过组亲和与组协作模块在组级别同时挖掘共识表示并抑制噪声。
2104.01108|v2.result: 在三个共显著检测基准上超越10个前沿模型并达到新SOTA，推理耗时16ms。

2105.09491|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对少样本目标检测中仅关注新类性能、忽略基类遗忘的问题，指出实际测试样本可能包含任意类别，因此检测器需在学习新概念时不遗忘旧知识。作者基于迁移学习方法的分析，提出Retentive R-CNN，包含Bias-Balanced RPN以去偏预训练RPN，以及Re-detector以在不遗忘的前提下检测少样本类。在少样本检测基准上，该方法在所有设置下整体性能显著超越SOTA，少样本类表现有竞争力且基类性能完全不下降。
2105.09491|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that few-shot object detection should detect all classes without forgetting base categories, since test samples may contain any instances. Based on an analysis of transfer-learning methods, the authors propose Retentive R-CNN with a Bias-Balanced RPN to debias the pretrained RPN and a Re-detector to detect novel classes without forgetting. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on overall performance across all settings, achieving competitive few-shot results with no degradation on base classes.
2105.09491|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了少样本检测的评价视角，强调不遗忘学习，方法简单有效，对实际部署中的增量检测有启发。
2105.09491|v2.contribution: 提出Retentive R-CNN实现少样本检测中基类不遗忘。
2105.09491|v2.innovation: 通过Bias-Balanced RPN去偏与Re-detector实现新旧类兼顾的检测。
2105.09491|v2.result: 在所有少样本设置下整体性能显著超越SOTA，基类性能无退化。
