2103.14259|v2.summary_cn: ①该论文针对目标检测中标签分配（label assignment）问题，指出现有方法通常为每个真值目标独立定义正负样本，缺乏全局视角。②作者创新性地将标签分配建模为最优传输（Optimal Transport, OT）问题，将每个anchor（需求方）与gt（供给方）之间的单位运输成本定义为分类损失与回归损失的加权和，并通过Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解最小运输成本下的最优传输方案，即OTA。③相比已有独立分配策略，OTA从全局最优角度进行分配，在拥挤场景下优势尤为明显。④在COCO上，配备OTA的FCOS-ResNet-50在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法；在COCO和CrowdHuman上的大量实验进一步验证了其有效性。
2103.14259|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses the label assignment problem in object detection, where existing methods typically define positive/negative samples for each ground-truth independently without a global perspective. ②The authors innovatively formulate label assignment as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem, defining the unit transportation cost between each anchor (demander) and gt (supplier) as a weighted sum of classification and regression losses, and solving for the optimal transport plan via Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration (OTA). ③Compared to existing independent assignment strategies, OTA performs globally optimal assignment and shows particular superiority in crowded scenarios. ④On COCO, a single FCOS-ResNet-50 detector with OTA reaches 40.7% mAP under the 1X scheduler, outperforming all existing assigning methods, with extensive experiments on COCO and CrowdHuman further validating its effectiveness.
2103.14259|v2.assessment: 该工作将最优传输理论引入目标检测标签分配，视角新颖且理论优雅，在拥挤场景下表现突出，对检测器训练策略研究具有较高参考价值。
2103.14259|v2.contribution: 提出将目标检测标签分配建模为最优传输问题，并利用Sinkhorn-Knopp迭代求解全局最优分配方案OTA。
2103.14259|v2.innovation: 首次从全局最优传输视角重新审视标签分配，将分类与回归损失加权和作为运输成本，实现anchor与gt的全局最优匹配。
2103.14259|v2.result: 在COCO上FCOS-ResNet-50配合OTA在1X调度下达到40.7% mAP，超越所有现有分配方法，并在CrowdHuman拥挤场景中验证了优越性。

2203.16220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对红外与可见光图像融合用于目标检测时，现有方法未充分考虑下游检测任务需求且缺乏多场景多模态基准的问题。作者提出了目标感知的双对抗学习框架，通过设计目标感知的对抗损失来引导融合过程保留有利于检测的模态特征，并构建了一个涵盖多种场景的多模态融合基准数据集。相比传统融合方法仅优化视觉质量，该方法将融合与检测任务端到端联合优化，显著提升了融合图像在目标检测上的性能。在自建基准上，该方法在多个场景下取得了优于现有融合算法的检测精度，验证了任务驱动融合的有效性。
2203.16220|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing infrared and visible image fusion methods for object detection often neglect downstream detection requirements and lack multi-scenario multi-modality benchmarks. The authors propose a target-aware dual adversarial learning framework that employs target-aware adversarial losses to guide the fusion process toward preserving detection-friendly modality features, and construct a multi-scenario multi-modality benchmark. Compared to traditional fusion methods that only optimize visual quality, this approach jointly optimizes fusion and detection end-to-end, significantly improving detection performance on fused images. On the proposed benchmark, the method achieves superior detection accuracy over existing fusion algorithms across multiple scenarios, demonstrating the effectiveness of task-driven fusion.
2203.16220|v2.assessment: 该工作将图像融合与目标检测任务紧密结合，并提供了多场景多模态基准，对自动驾驶中多传感器融合感知有重要参考价值。
2203.16220|v2.contribution: 提出了目标感知的双对抗学习框架及多场景多模态红外-可见光融合基准。
2203.16220|v2.innovation: 将目标检测损失嵌入对抗融合过程，实现任务驱动的红外与可见光融合。
2203.16220|v2.result: 在自建基准上多个场景的检测精度优于现有融合算法。

2203.16089|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有目标检测方法依赖大量精确标注数据、难以利用弱监督或半监督数据的问题，提出了Omni-DETR，一种基于Transformer的通用半监督目标检测框架。该方法通过设计伪标签生成与过滤机制，统一处理全监督、半监督和弱监督（如点标注、图像级标签）等多种监督信号，并利用DETR的集合预测特性进行端到端训练。相比传统半监督检测方法，Omni-DETR能够灵活整合不同粒度的标注，在多个半监督和弱监督检测基准上取得了显著性能提升，尤其在标注稀缺场景下优势明显。
2203.16089|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that existing object detection methods rely on large amounts of precise annotations and struggle to leverage weakly or semi-supervised data. It proposes Omni-DETR, a Transformer-based omni-supervised object detection framework that unifies fully, semi-, and weakly supervised signals (e.g., point and image-level labels) via pseudo-label generation and filtering, leveraging DETR's set prediction for end-to-end training. Compared to traditional semi-supervised detectors, Omni-DETR flexibly integrates annotations of varying granularity, achieving significant improvements on multiple semi- and weakly supervised detection benchmarks, especially in low-annotation regimes.
2203.16089|v2.assessment: 该工作利用Transformer架构统一多种监督形式，为降低目标检测标注成本提供了新思路，对自动驾驶数据高效利用有启发。
2203.16089|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的Omni-DETR框架，统一处理全监督、半监督和弱监督目标检测。
2203.16089|v2.innovation: 利用DETR的集合预测特性设计伪标签机制，灵活融合多粒度监督信号。
2203.16089|v2.result: 在多个半监督和弱监督检测基准上取得显著性能提升。

2206.11459|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对微弱目标（如低对比度、小尺寸物体）检测困难的问题，探索了时空聚合方法，并构建了一个专门的微弱目标检测基准数据集。作者提出了一个基线模型，通过融合视频序列中的时空信息来增强微弱目标的特征响应，从而提升检测鲁棒性。相比单帧检测方法，该基线在自建数据集上显著提高了微弱目标的召回率和精度，为后续研究提供了基准和思路。
2206.11459|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of detecting insubstantial objects (e.g., low-contrast, small targets) by exploring spatio-temporal aggregation and constructing a dedicated benchmark dataset. The authors propose a baseline model that fuses spatio-temporal information from video sequences to enhance feature responses of insubstantial objects, improving detection robustness. Compared to single-frame methods, the baseline significantly improves recall and precision on the proposed dataset, providing a benchmark and insights for future research.
2206.11459|v2.assessment: 该工作关注微弱目标检测这一细分问题，提供了数据集和基线，对特定场景（如航拍、监控）有参考价值。
2206.11459|v2.contribution: 构建了微弱目标检测基准数据集并提出基于时空聚合的基线方法。
2206.11459|v2.innovation: 利用视频时空信息聚合增强微弱目标特征，提升检测性能。
2206.11459|v2.result: 在自建数据集上微弱目标的召回率和精度较单帧方法显著提升。

2207.11169|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有小样本目标检测（FSOD）研究多局限于单一相似域、缺乏跨域评估的问题，提出了一个多域小样本目标检测基准MoFSOD，包含来自10个不同领域的数据集。作者系统分析了冻结层、不同架构和预训练数据集对FSOD性能的影响，发现微调（FT）在多域基准上是一个强有力的基线，性能与SOTA相当或更优；同时揭示了架构选择对下游小样本任务的显著影响，以及解耦预训练和小样本学习的重要性。该基准为FSOD的跨域泛化评估提供了标准化平台。
2207.11169|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing few-shot object detection (FSOD) works focus on a single similar domain, lacking cross-domain evaluation. It proposes MoFSOD, a multi-domain FSOD benchmark comprising 10 datasets from diverse domains, and systematically analyzes the impact of frozen layers, architectures, and pre-training datasets. Key findings include: fine-tuning (FT) is a strong baseline on multi-domain benchmarks, performing on par or better than SOTA; architecture choices significantly affect downstream few-shot tasks; and decoupling pre-training from few-shot learning is crucial. The benchmark provides a standardized platform for evaluating cross-domain generalization in FSOD.
2207.11169|v2.assessment: 该工作通过多域基准揭示了FSOD中被忽视的关键因素，对推动小样本检测的实用化评估有重要价值。
2207.11169|v2.contribution: 提出了多域小样本目标检测基准MoFSOD，并系统分析了影响FSOD性能的关键因素。
2207.11169|v2.innovation: 首次在多域设定下评估FSOD，发现微调是强基线且架构选择影响显著。
2207.11169|v2.result: 微调在多域基准上达到或超越SOTA，架构和预训练数据选择对性能影响显著。

A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_cn: 该论文针对大规模类别目标检测（21,000类）的挑战，提出了一个简单的方法和基准。作者构建了一个包含21,000个类别的检测数据集，并设计了一种基于现有检测框架的简单基线，通过类别层次结构和数据平衡策略来处理极端类别不平衡问题。相比传统检测方法，该基线在如此大规模类别下仍能保持合理的检测性能，为超大规模类别检测研究提供了基准和起点。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of large-scale object detection with 21,000 categories by proposing a simple approach and benchmark. The authors construct a detection dataset with 21,000 categories and design a simple baseline based on existing detection frameworks, employing category hierarchy and data balancing strategies to handle extreme class imbalance. Compared to traditional detectors, the baseline maintains reasonable performance under such a massive number of categories, providing a benchmark and starting point for ultra-large-scale category detection research.
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.assessment: 该工作构建了超大规模类别检测基准，对研究开放世界检测和长尾分布有参考意义。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.contribution: 构建了21,000类目标检测基准并提出简单基线方法。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.innovation: 利用类别层次结构和数据平衡策略应对极端类别不平衡。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,.result: 在21,000类检测任务上取得了合理的基线性能。
A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21,._arxiv_id: A Simple Approach and Benchmark for 21, 000-Category Object Detection.

Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于DETR的人-物交互（HOI）检测中查询（query）质量不高的问题，提出了硬正样本查询挖掘方法。作者分析了DETR中查询与真实交互的匹配机制，设计了硬正样本挖掘策略，通过筛选与目标交互更匹配的查询来提升检测精度。相比原始DETR-based HOI检测器，该方法在HICO-DET等基准上取得了性能提升，证明了查询质量对HOI检测的重要性。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of low-quality queries in DETR-based human-object interaction (HOI) detection by proposing hard-positive query mining. The authors analyze the matching mechanism between queries and ground-truth interactions in DETR and design a hard-positive mining strategy that selects queries better matched to target interactions to improve detection accuracy. Compared to original DETR-based HOI detectors, the method achieves performance gains on benchmarks like HICO-DET, demonstrating the importance of query quality for HOI detection.
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.assessment: 该工作聚焦DETR在HOI检测中的查询优化，对基于Transformer的检测器改进有借鉴意义。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.contribution: 提出了针对DETR-based HOI检测的硬正样本查询挖掘方法。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.innovation: 通过挖掘硬正样本查询来提升DETR中交互检测的匹配质量。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D.result: 在HICO-DET等基准上取得了性能提升。
Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for D._arxiv_id: Towards Hard-Positive Query Mining for DETR-Based Human-Object Interaction Detection.

Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中类别动态变化、DETR类方法难以泛化到未见类别的问题，本文提出Open-Vocabulary DETR，通过条件匹配机制将文本嵌入与查询动态关联。方法在DETR框架中引入类别条件查询和匹配策略，使模型能根据文本描述检测任意类别。相比固定类别分类器的DETR，该方法在开放词汇设定下显著提升新类别的检测精度，在LVIS等基准上取得了领先性能。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object detection where models must generalize to unseen categories. It proposes Open-Vocabulary DETR with a conditional matching mechanism that dynamically associates text embeddings with object queries. Compared to fixed-class DETR, it achieves superior performance on novel categories, setting a new state of the art on benchmarks like LVIS.
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.assessment: 将DETR的端到端检测能力扩展到开放词汇场景，条件匹配设计巧妙，对开放世界感知有重要参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.contribution: 提出条件匹配的开放词汇DETR框架，实现文本驱动的任意类别检测。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.innovation: 利用类别条件查询和动态匹配替代固定分类器，增强对未见类别的泛化。
Open-Vocabulary DETR with Conditional Ma.result: 在LVIS等开放词汇检测基准上取得领先性能，显著提升新类别AP。

X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言模型多局限于图像级任务、缺乏实例级理解的问题，本文提出X-DETR，一种通用的实例级视觉语言任务架构。方法将DETR的实例查询与多模态Transformer结合，统一处理指代分割、实例级图像描述等任务。相比任务专用模型，X-DETR在多个实例级视觉语言基准上取得有竞争力的结果，展示了统一架构的通用性。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of instance-level understanding in existing vision-language models. It proposes X-DETR, a versatile architecture that combines DETR-style instance queries with a multimodal Transformer to handle tasks like referring segmentation and instance captioning. Compared to task-specific models, X-DETR achieves competitive results across multiple instance-wise vision-language benchmarks.
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.assessment: 统一实例级视觉语言任务的架构设计具有前瞻性，对多模态感知与理解的融合有启发意义。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.contribution: 提出通用实例级视觉语言架构X-DETR，统一多种实例级多模态任务。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.innovation: 将DETR实例查询与多模态Transformer结合，实现任务无关的实例级视觉语言建模。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins.result: 在多个实例级视觉语言基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Ins._arxiv_id: X-DETR: A Versatile Architecture for Instance-wise Vision-Language Tasks.

2203.10638|v2.summary_cn: 针对车路协同（V2X）感知中信息异步、位姿误差和异构组件等挑战，本文提出V2X-ViT，一种基于视觉Transformer的鲁棒协同感知框架。方法设计交替的异构多智能体自注意力和多尺度窗口自注意力，统一融合车与路侧信息。在CARLA和OpenCDA构建的大规模V2X数据集上，V2X-ViT在3D目标检测上刷新SOTA，并在噪声环境下保持鲁棒性能。
2203.10638|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses challenges in V2X cooperative perception such as asynchronous sharing, pose errors, and heterogeneity. It proposes V2X-ViT, a vision Transformer with alternating heterogeneous multi-agent self-attention and multi-scale window self-attention for robust fusion across vehicles and infrastructure. On a large-scale CARLA/OpenCDA dataset, it sets new state-of-the-art 3D detection performance and remains robust under harsh noisy conditions.
2203.10638|v2.assessment: 将Transformer引入V2X协同感知并系统解决实际部署难题，实验扎实，对自动驾驶多车协同感知有重要推动。
2203.10638|v2.contribution: 提出V2X-ViT协同感知框架，统一处理异步、位姿误差和异构性。
2203.10638|v2.innovation: 设计异构多智能体自注意力与多尺度窗口注意力交替的Transformer架构。
2203.10638|v2.result: 在自建大规模V2X数据集上3D检测达到SOTA，噪声环境下仍保持鲁棒。

2111.14330|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器编码器计算量大、多尺度特征导致token数量激增的问题，本文提出Sparse DETR，选择性更新仅被解码器引用的token。方法通过可学习的稀疏化策略和辅助检测损失，在编码器中只更新部分token。相比Deformable DETR，Sparse DETR仅用10%的编码器token即取得更好性能，显著降低计算开销。
2111.14330|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of the encoder in DETR-based detectors, especially with multi-scale features. It proposes Sparse DETR, which selectively updates only tokens expected to be referenced by the decoder, using a learnable sparsity strategy and auxiliary detection loss. Compared to Deformable DETR, it achieves better performance with only 10% of encoder tokens, significantly reducing computation.
2111.14330|v2.assessment: 以可学习稀疏性大幅提升DETR效率，思路简洁有效，对实时目标检测和端到端检测器优化有实用价值。
2111.14330|v2.contribution: 提出Sparse DETR，通过可学习稀疏化选择性更新编码器token。
2111.14330|v2.innovation: 利用解码器引用预测和辅助损失实现编码器token的高效稀疏更新。
2111.14330|v2.result: 仅用10%编码器token即超越Deformable DETR，大幅降低计算量。

MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_cn: 针对零样本NAS在目标检测中搜索效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，本文重新审视最大熵原理，提出MAE-DET。方法利用最大熵准则设计零样本代理指标，无需训练即可评估检测架构。相比现有零样本NAS方法，MAE-DET在检测任务上以更低搜索成本获得更优架构，在COCO等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.summary_en: This paper revisits the maximum entropy principle for zero-shot NAS in object detection. It proposes MAE-DET, which uses a maximum-entropy-based proxy to evaluate detection architectures without training. Compared to existing zero-shot NAS methods, it finds better architectures at lower search cost, achieving competitive results on benchmarks like COCO.
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.assessment: 将最大熵原理引入检测NAS，为零样本架构搜索提供了新视角，但整体影响力相对有限。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.contribution: 提出基于最大熵原理的零样本NAS方法MAE-DET，用于高效目标检测架构搜索。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.innovation: 利用最大熵准则构建无需训练的检测架构评估代理。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin.result: 在COCO等检测基准上以低搜索成本获得有竞争力的架构性能。
MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Prin._arxiv_id: MAE-DET: Revisiting Maximum Entropy Principle in Zero-Shot NAS for Efficient Object Detection.

2210.05593|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测依赖大量标注、新类别样本稀缺的问题，本文提出少样本3D点云检测设定及Prototypical VoteNet。方法包含原型投票模块（PVM）和原型头模块（PHM），利用基类学习的类无关几何原型和类原型增强新类特征，并采用episodic训练。作者贡献了FS-ScanNet和FS-SUNRGBD两个基准，实验表明该方法在少样本设定下显著优于基线。
2210.05593|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot 3D point cloud object detection where only a few annotated samples of novel classes are available. It proposes Prototypical VoteNet with a Prototypical Vote Module (PVM) and Prototypical Head Module (PHM) that leverage class-agnostic geometric prototypes and class prototypes, trained episodically. It also contributes two benchmarks, FS-ScanNet and FS-SUNRGBD, and extensive experiments show clear improvements over baselines.
2210.05593|v2.assessment: 首次系统定义少样本3D点云检测并给出有效原型方法，基准贡献对领域发展有推动作用。
2210.05593|v2.contribution: 提出少样本3D点云检测方法Prototypical VoteNet及两个新基准数据集。
2210.05593|v2.innovation: 利用类无关几何原型和类原型增强新类特征，结合episodic训练。
2210.05593|v2.result: 在FS-ScanNet和FS-SUNRGBD上显著优于基线，推动少样本3D检测研究。

2210.01391|v2.summary_cn: 针对2D图像与3D点云异构表示难以直接融合的问题，提出Bridged Transformer（BrT）端到端3D目标检测架构。该方法利用object queries桥接3D与2D空间，统一Transformer中的数据表示，并通过point-to-patch投影增强图像与点云的相关性，且可无缝融合多视角图像。在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2数据集上超越当时最先进方法。
2210.01391|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge of fusing heterogeneous 2D image and 3D point cloud representations, this paper proposes Bridged Transformer (BrT), an end-to-end architecture for 3D object detection. BrT leverages object queries to bridge 3D and 2D spaces, unifying data representations in a Transformer, and uses point-to-patch projections to strengthen image-point correlations, seamlessly supporting multi-view image fusion. Experiments show BrT surpasses state-of-the-art methods on SUN RGB-D and ScanNetV2.
2210.01391|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态3D检测提供了一种简洁有效的Transformer融合范式，对自动驾驶中多传感器融合具有参考价值。
2210.01391|v2.contribution: 提出Bridged Transformer，利用object queries统一2D与3D表示实现端到端3D目标检测。
2210.01391|v2.innovation: 通过object queries桥接异构空间并引入point-to-patch投影增强跨模态关联。
2210.01391|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNetV2上超越当时最先进方法。

2104.06401|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测问题，提出利用音视频对应关系作为监督信号，用音频“教”检测器。设计对比学习自监督框架联合学习目标分类与定位，再用自监督伪标签和框训练图像检测器。无需任何监督即超越先前无监督和弱监督检测器，且仅需每伪类一个标签即可对齐真实类别，并能检测乐器之外的通用物体（如飞机、猫）。
2104.06401|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised object detection by extracting supervisory signals from audio-visual correspondence, using audio to 'teach' the detector. A contrastive self-supervised framework jointly learns to classify and localize objects, and the resulting pseudo-labels and boxes train an image-based detector without any supervision. It outperforms previous unsupervised and weakly-supervised detectors, aligns to ground-truth classes with as little as one label per pseudo-class, and generalizes beyond instruments to objects like airplanes and cats.
2104.06401|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了跨模态自监督检测的新范式，虽与自动驾驶直接关联有限，但对无标注数据利用有启发意义。
2104.06401|v2.contribution: 提出利用音视频对应进行无监督目标检测的自监督框架。
2104.06401|v2.innovation: 用音频作为监督信号训练检测器，并实现仅需极少标签的类别对齐。
2104.06401|v2.result: 超越先前无监督和弱监督检测器，且能检测乐器之外的通用物体。

2202.04639|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测预训练中定位与识别需求不同的问题，提出点级区域对比（point-level region contrast）自监督预训练方法。该方法直接从不同区域采样点对进行对比学习，相比区域聚合表示对区域质量变化更鲁棒，并通过在线知识蒸馏隐式改进初始区域分配。在多个任务和数据集上超越最先进预训练方法，并提供了充分的消融与可视化分析。
2202.04639|v2.summary_en: To address the differing needs of localization and recognition in detection pre-training, this paper presents point-level region contrast, a self-supervised approach that samples individual point pairs from different regions for contrastive learning. It is more robust to region quality changes than aggregated region representations and implicitly improves initial region assignments via online knowledge distillation. Experiments show improvements over state-of-the-art pre-training methods across multiple tasks and datasets, with extensive ablations and visualizations.
2202.04639|v2.assessment: 该工作为检测预训练提供了细粒度对比学习思路，对提升检测器初始化质量有实用价值。
2202.04639|v2.contribution: 提出点级区域对比自监督预训练方法用于目标检测。
2202.04639|v2.innovation: 直接采样点对进行对比学习，并结合在线知识蒸馏改进区域分配。
2202.04639|v2.result: 在多个检测和分割任务及数据集上超越最先进预训练方法。

2203.11496|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-相机融合在恶劣图像条件（如光照差、传感器错位）下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出TransFusion，一种基于Transformer的软关联融合方案。该方法使用卷积骨干和Transformer解码器检测头，第一层解码器从点云预测初始框，第二层自适应融合object queries与图像特征，利用空间和上下文关系决定从图像中取何信息。在nuScenes等基准上取得鲁棒且有效的融合性能。
2203.11496|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of robustness in LiDAR-camera fusion under inferior image conditions such as bad illumination and sensor misalignment, this paper proposes TransFusion, a soft-association fusion approach based on Transformers. It uses convolutional backbones and a transformer decoder head: the first layer predicts initial boxes from the point cloud, and the second layer adaptively fuses object queries with image features using spatial and contextual relationships. It achieves robust and effective fusion performance on benchmarks like nuScenes.
2203.11496|v2.assessment: 该工作针对自动驾驶多传感器融合的鲁棒性痛点提出优雅的软关联方案，是LiDAR-相机融合的重要进展。
2203.11496|v2.contribution: 提出TransFusion，基于Transformer软关联机制的鲁棒LiDAR-相机融合3D检测方法。
2203.11496|v2.innovation: 用注意力机制自适应决定从图像中取何信息，克服标定矩阵硬关联的脆弱性。
2203.11496|v2.result: 在恶劣图像条件下仍保持鲁棒且有效的融合检测性能。

2106.04550|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有自监督预训练方法仅关注检测器骨干而忽略检测架构关键部分的问题，提出DETReg，一种预训练整个检测网络（包括定位和嵌入组件）的自监督方法。预训练时DETReg预测目标定位以匹配无监督区域提议生成器的结果，同时对齐特征嵌入与自监督图像编码器的嵌入。基于DETR系列实现，在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship基准上微调均优于竞争基线，在仅1%标签和少样本设置下提升明显。
2106.04550|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing self-supervised pre-training methods focus only on the detector backbone while neglecting key detection architecture components, this paper introduces DETReg, a self-supervised method that pre-trains the entire object detection network including localization and embedding components. During pre-training, DETReg predicts object localizations to match an unsupervised region proposal generator and aligns feature embeddings with a self-supervised image encoder. Implemented with DETR-family detectors, it outperforms competitive baselines on COCO, PASCAL VOC, and Airbus Ship, with notable gains in low-data regimes such as 1% labels and few-shot settings.
2106.04550|v2.assessment: 该工作将自监督预训练扩展到整个检测网络，对低数据场景下的检测器训练有重要价值。
2106.04550|v2.contribution: 提出DETReg，预训练整个目标检测网络（含定位与嵌入组件）的自监督方法。
2106.04550|v2.innovation: 同时匹配无监督区域提议定位并对齐自监督图像编码器嵌入。
2106.04550|v2.result: 在COCO、PASCAL VOC和Airbus Ship上优于竞争基线，1%标签和少样本设置下提升明显。

2206.06608|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中mean teacher自训练存在的标签不匹配问题及其导致的确认偏差，提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级两个互补角度解决。分布级上引入重分布mean teacher，利用自适应标签分布感知置信度阈值生成无偏伪标签；实例级上提出proposal self-assignment标签分配机制，将学生提议注入教师以生成准确伪标签。在COCO和VOC上取得显著提升。
2206.06608|v2.summary_en: To address the label mismatch problem and resulting confirmation bias in mean-teacher self-training for semi-supervised object detection, this paper proposes the LabelMatch framework from two complementary perspectives: distribution-level and instance-level. At the distribution level, a re-distribution mean teacher uses adaptive label-distribution-aware confidence thresholds to generate unbiased pseudo-labels; at the instance level, a proposal self-assignment mechanism injects student proposals into the teacher to produce accurate pseudo-labels. It achieves significant improvements on COCO and VOC.
2206.06608|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地剖析了半监督检测中的标签不匹配问题，提出的双视角解决方案对自训练框架有普适参考意义。
2206.06608|v2.contribution: 提出LabelMatch框架，从分布级和实例级解决半监督目标检测的标签不匹配问题。
2206.06608|v2.innovation: 引入重分布mean teacher和proposal self-assignment标签分配机制。
2206.06608|v2.result: 在COCO和VOC半监督检测基准上取得显著提升。

2203.02112|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中伪LiDAR方法因图像到点云生成域差距大而导致精度受限的问题，本文提出Pseudo-Stereo框架，利用图像到图像生成域差距更小的特点，设计了图像级生成、特征级生成和特征克隆三种虚拟视图生成方法。进一步提出视差感知动态卷积，用视差特征图采样的动态核自适应滤波单张图像特征以生成虚拟图像特征，缓解深度估计误差带来的特征退化。分析表明深度损失仅在特征级虚拟视图生成中有效，而估计的深度图在图像级和特征级均有效。截至2021年11月投稿时，该Pseudo-Stereo 3D检测器在KITTI等基准上取得了领先的单目3D检测性能。
2203.02112|v2.summary_en: To address the large image-to-LiDAR generation gap in pseudo-LiDAR based monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes a Pseudo-Stereo framework with three virtual view generation methods: image-level generation, feature-level generation, and feature-clone. It introduces a disparity-wise dynamic convolution that samples dynamic kernels from the disparity feature map to adaptively filter single-image features, mitigating feature degradation from depth estimation errors. Analysis shows depth loss is effective only in feature-level generation, while the estimated depth map benefits both levels. The Pseudo-Stereo detector achieves state-of-the-art monocular 3D detection performance on KITTI at submission time.
2203.02112|v2.assessment: 将单目3D检测转化为伪立体范式，思路新颖且工程有效，动态卷积设计对缓解深度误差有实际价值，是单目3D检测方向值得关注的工作。
2203.02112|v2.contribution: 提出Pseudo-Stereo单目3D检测框架及三种虚拟视图生成方法与视差感知动态卷积。
2203.02112|v2.innovation: 利用图像到图像生成域差距更小的特性构建伪立体视图，并用视差动态核自适应滤波特征。
2203.02112|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得当时领先的单目3D检测精度，验证了伪立体范式的有效性。

2204.07300|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有半监督目标检测（SSOD）方法多基于anchor-based检测器、而实际应用中anchor-free检测器需求更大的问题，本文提出基于密集学习的anchor-free SSOD算法DSL。方法引入自适应过滤策略为多层级分配精确的密集像素级伪标签、聚合教师模型生成稳定精确的伪标签，以及跨尺度与打乱图像块的不确定性一致性正则项以提升泛化能力。在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上的实验表明DSL刷新了SSOD的最优性能，大幅超越现有方法。
2204.07300|v2.summary_en: To bridge the gap that most semi-supervised object detection (SSOD) methods are anchor-based while anchor-free detectors are more demanded in practice, this paper proposes a DenSe Learning (DSL) based anchor-free SSOD algorithm. It introduces an Adaptive Filtering strategy for multi-level dense pixel-wise pseudo-labels, an Aggregated Teacher for stable pseudo-labels, and an uncertainty-consistency regularization across scales and shuffled patches. Experiments on MS-COCO and PASCAL-VOC show DSL sets a new state of the art, surpassing existing methods by a large margin.
2204.07300|v2.assessment: 将SSOD扩展到anchor-free范式并系统设计伪标签与一致性正则，实验充分且性能提升显著，对半监督检测研究有较强参考价值。
2204.07300|v2.contribution: 提出面向anchor-free检测器的密集学习半监督目标检测算法DSL。
2204.07300|v2.innovation: 结合自适应过滤、聚合教师与跨尺度/打乱块不确定性一致性正则生成高质量伪标签。
2204.07300|v2.result: 在MS-COCO和PASCAL-VOC上刷新SSOD最优性能，大幅超越现有方法。

2204.12463|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏卷积网络对所有稀疏数据一视同仁、未考虑不同空间位置体素贡献差异的问题，本文提出两个基于位置重要性预测使特征稀疏性可学习的模块：焦点稀疏卷积Focals Conv及其多模态融合变体Focals Conv-F。这两个模块可直接替换现有稀疏CNN中的普通卷积并端到端联合训练，首次表明空间可学习稀疏性对复杂3D目标检测至关重要。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo基准上的大量实验验证了有效性，投稿时在nuScenes测试榜上超越所有单模型方法。
2204.12463|v2.summary_en: Observing that existing sparse convolutional networks treat all sparse data uniformly regardless of spatial position, this paper introduces two modules that make feature sparsity learnable via position-wise importance prediction: focal sparse convolution (Focals Conv) and its multi-modal fusion variant (Focals Conv-F). These modules can directly replace plain counterparts in existing Sparse CNNs and be jointly trained end-to-end, showing for the first time that spatially learnable sparsity is essential for sophisticated 3D detection. Extensive experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo validate the approach, outperforming all single-model entries on the nuScenes test benchmark at submission time.
2204.12463|v2.assessment: 以可学习稀疏性重塑稀疏卷积核心组件，通用性强、实验覆盖三大主流基准且性能领先，是3D检测方向高影响力工作。
2204.12463|v2.contribution: 提出可学习位置稀疏性的焦点稀疏卷积Focals Conv及其多模态融合变体Focals Conv-F。
2204.12463|v2.innovation: 通过位置重要性预测使稀疏卷积的特征稀疏性可学习，并支持多模态融合。
2204.12463|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes、Waymo上验证有效，投稿时nuScenes测试榜超越所有单模型方法。

2203.07363|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频伪装目标检测（VCOD）中目标与背景相似、难以从单帧识别的问题，本文提出利用短期动态与长期时序一致性的新框架。不同于现有方法依赖单应性或光流表示运动（会累积运动估计与分割误差），该方法将运动估计与目标分割统一到单一优化框架中，构建密集相关体隐式捕捉相邻帧运动，并用最终分割监督联合优化隐式运动估计与分割，同时用时空Transformer强化时序一致性。实验表明该方法在VCOD任务上取得优于现有方法的检测效果。
2203.07363|v2.summary_en: To address video camouflaged object detection (VCOD) where objects resemble the background and are hard to identify from still images, this paper proposes a framework exploiting short-term dynamics and long-term temporal consistency. Unlike methods relying on homography or optical flow that accumulate motion and segmentation errors, it unifies motion estimation and segmentation in a single optimization framework, building a dense correlation volume to implicitly capture inter-frame motion and jointly optimizing with segmentation supervision, plus a spatio-temporal transformer for consistency. Experiments show superior VCOD performance over existing methods.
2203.07363|v2.assessment: 隐式运动建模思路对视频分割有启发，但任务与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，适合作为视频理解方向的参考。
2203.07363|v2.contribution: 提出统一运动估计与分割的隐式运动处理视频伪装目标检测框架。
2203.07363|v2.innovation: 用密集相关体隐式捕捉运动并以分割监督联合优化，避免显式光流误差累积。
2203.07363|v2.result: 在视频伪装目标检测任务上取得优于现有方法的检测效果。

2203.09704|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云稀疏不规则导致3D检测精度受限、现有多视图方法（BEV与RV）融合时未考虑全局空间上下文的问题，本文提出双跨视图空间注意力模块VISTA，在全局空间上下文中自适应融合多视图特征。VISTA是可插拔融合模块，用卷积替换标准注意力中的MLP，并解耦分类与回归任务，额外施加注意力方差约束。实验表明VISTA能为候选框预测生成高质量融合特征，在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
2203.09704|v2.summary_en: To address the limited accuracy of LiDAR 3D detection caused by point cloud sparsity and the failure of existing multi-view (BEV and RV) methods to consider global spatial context, this paper proposes Dual Cross-View SpaTial Attention (VISTA), a plug-and-play fusion module that adaptively fuses multi-view features in a global spatial context. VISTA replaces the MLP in standard attention with convolution, decouples classification and regression, and applies an attention variance constraint. Experiments show VISTA produces high-quality fused features and achieves leading performance on 3D detection benchmarks.
2203.09704|v2.assessment: 多视图融合是LiDAR 3D检测的重要方向，VISTA以可插拔注意力模块提升融合质量，设计简洁且性能领先，值得关注。
2203.09704|v2.contribution: 提出双跨视图空间注意力VISTA用于BEV与RV特征的自适应全局融合。
2203.09704|v2.innovation: 以卷积替代注意力MLP并解耦分类回归、施加注意力方差约束实现高质量多视图融合。
2203.09704|v2.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得领先性能，验证了全局空间上下文融合的有效性。

2203.03800|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测器对分布外（OOD）目标过度自信、缺乏未知数据监督信号的问题，本文提出基于时空未知蒸馏（STUD）的未知感知目标检测框架。STUD先在空间维度识别未知候选目标提议，再跨多帧聚合候选以在决策边界附近形成多样化的未知目标集合，并采用基于能量的不确定性正则损失对比性地塑造分布内与蒸馏未知目标之间的不确定性空间。该方法在目标检测OOD检测任务上取得最优性能，相比此前最佳方法将FPR95降低超过10%。
2203.03800|v2.summary_en: To address overconfident predictions on out-of-distribution (OOD) objects caused by the lack of supervision from unknown data, this paper proposes an unknown-aware object detection framework via Spatial-Temporal Unknown Distillation (STUD). STUD identifies unknown candidate proposals spatially, aggregates them across video frames to form diverse unknown objects near the decision boundary, and employs an energy-based uncertainty regularization loss to contrastively shape the uncertainty space. It achieves state-of-the-art OOD detection performance, reducing FPR95 by over 10% compared to the previous best method.
2203.03800|v2.assessment: 利用野外视频蒸馏未知目标来正则化决策边界，为开放集检测提供了实用且有效的方案，对自动驾驶安全感知有参考意义。
2203.03800|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空未知蒸馏STUD的未知感知目标检测框架。
2203.03800|v2.innovation: 从视频中空间识别并跨帧聚合未知目标，用能量不确定性损失对比塑造不确定性空间。
2203.03800|v2.result: 在目标检测OOD任务上取得最优性能，FPR95相比此前最佳方法降低超过10%。

2203.14940|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标检测中依赖人工设计文本提示（prompt）的问题，提出了一种名为DetPro的连续提示表示学习方法。DetPro基于预训练的视觉-语言模型，包含两个核心设计：背景解释方案将图像背景中的候选区域纳入提示训练，上下文分级方案则区分不同候选区域以优化提示学习。相比面向图像分类的提示学习方法，DetPro更适配检测任务，避免了繁琐的提示工程。实验表明，该方法在开放词汇检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，验证了连续提示学习在检测任务中的有效性。
2203.14940|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the laborious prompt engineering problem in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing DetPro, a method that learns continuous prompt representations based on a pre-trained vision-language model. DetPro introduces a background interpretation scheme to include background proposals in prompt training and a context grading scheme to separate proposals for better prompt learning. Unlike classification-oriented prompt learning methods, DetPro is tailored for detection and achieves improved performance on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
2203.14940|v2.assessment: 该工作将提示学习从图像分类拓展到开放词汇检测，提出的背景解释与上下文分级方案针对检测任务特点设计，对开放世界感知研究有参考价值。
2203.14940|v2.contribution: 提出了面向开放词汇目标检测的连续提示表示学习方法DetPro，包含背景解释和上下文分级两个检测专用设计。
2203.14940|v2.innovation: 首次将连续提示学习引入开放词汇检测，并通过背景解释与上下文分级方案解决检测任务中候选区域与提示的适配问题。
2203.14940|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得了优于现有提示学习方法的性能，避免了人工提示工程。

2307.08095|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对半监督目标检测（SSOD）中DETR框架的两个核心问题：一对一匹配在伪标签不准确时产生错误匹配导致训练低效，以及DETR缺乏输入query与预测输出之间的确定性对应关系，阻碍了基于一致性的正则化方法的应用。作者提出了Semi-DETR，首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器，包含三个关键组件：Stage-wise Hybrid Matching策略结合一对多和一对一分配以提升第一阶段训练效率并为第二阶段提供高质量伪标签；Cross-view Query Consistency方法学习不同视图下object query的语义特征不变性而无需确定性query对应；以及Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining模块动态挖掘更多伪框。相比已有SSOD方法，Semi-DETR首次将DETR范式成功引入半监督检测，在COCO等基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
2307.08095|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two key issues of DETR-based frameworks in semi-supervised object detection: one-to-one assignment generates incorrect matching with inaccurate pseudo-labels, and the lack of deterministic query-prediction correspondence hinders consistency regularization. The authors propose Semi-DETR, the first transformer-based end-to-end semi-supervised object detector, featuring a Stage-wise Hybrid Matching strategy, Cross-view Query Consistency, and Cost-based Pseudo Label Mining. It achieves significant improvements over existing SSOD methods on standard benchmarks.
2307.08095|v2.assessment: 首次将DETR范式成功引入半监督目标检测，系统分析了DETR在SSOD中的核心瓶颈并给出有效解决方案，对半监督检测和Transformer检测两个方向都有重要参考价值。
2307.08095|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于Transformer的端到端半监督目标检测器Semi-DETR，包含阶段式混合匹配、跨视图查询一致性和基于代价的伪标签挖掘三个核心模块。
2307.08095|v2.innovation: 将一对多与一对一匹配策略分阶段结合以生成高质量伪标签，并通过跨视图查询一致性避免了对确定性query对应的需求。
2307.08095|v2.result: 在COCO等标准半监督检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能，验证了DETR范式在半监督目标检测中的有效性。

Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_cn: 本文针对野外场景下3D目标检测缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，提出了Omni3D——一个包含大量室内外场景、多种类别的大规模3D目标检测基准数据集，以及配套的检测模型Cube R-CNN。Omni3D统一了多个现有3D数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes、SUN RGB-D等）的标注格式，使模型能够在多样化的场景中进行训练和评估。Cube R-CNN通过预测3D立方体参数实现单目3D检测，并针对数据规模增大带来的挑战进行了专门设计。实验表明，在Omni3D上训练的模型在多个数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，展示了大规模统一基准对3D检测研究的推动作用。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale unified benchmark for 3D object detection in the wild by introducing Omni3D, a large benchmark spanning diverse indoor and outdoor scenes, along with a detection model Cube R-CNN. Omni3D unifies annotations from multiple existing 3D datasets, enabling training and evaluation across varied scenarios. Experiments show that models trained on Omni3D achieve significant performance gains across multiple datasets, demonstrating the value of large-scale unified benchmarks for 3D detection.
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.assessment: Omni3D填补了野外3D检测大规模统一基准的空白，对推动3D检测从单一数据集走向通用化具有重要意义，是3D视觉领域的里程碑式工作。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.contribution: 构建了大规模统一的3D目标检测基准Omni3D，并提出了配套的单目3D检测模型Cube R-CNN。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.innovation: 统一了多个异构3D数据集的标注格式，使模型能够在多样化场景中进行大规模训练和跨数据集评估。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for.result: 在Omni3D上训练的模型在多个3D检测数据集上取得了显著的性能提升，验证了大规模统一基准的有效性。
Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for._arxiv_id: Omni3D: A Large Benchmark and Model for 3D Object Detection in the Wild.

Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_cn: 本文针对目标检测与分割任务长期分离、缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了Mask DINO——一个统一的基于Transformer的检测与分割框架。Mask DINO在DINO（DETR的改进版）的基础上引入了掩码预测分支，通过共享的Transformer编码器-解码器架构同时完成目标检测、实例分割、全景分割和语义分割任务。其核心设计包括：在解码器中加入掩码嵌入（mask embedding）以支持掩码预测，以及通过查询选择和去噪训练提升性能。Mask DINO在COCO、ADE20K等基准上取得了当时最优的结果，在实例分割、全景分割和语义分割任务上均超越了专用方法，证明了统一框架在多任务上的潜力。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-standing separation between object detection and segmentation by proposing Mask DINO, a unified Transformer-based framework for detection and segmentation. Building on DINO, Mask DINO introduces a mask prediction branch with shared encoder-decoder architecture to simultaneously handle object detection, instance, panoptic, and semantic segmentation. It achieves state-of-the-art results on COCO and ADE20K, surpassing specialized methods across multiple segmentation tasks.
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.assessment: Mask DINO是统一检测与分割框架的代表性工作，在多个任务上达到SOTA，对多任务统一感知架构设计具有重要指导意义。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.contribution: 提出了统一的Transformer框架Mask DINO，通过共享架构同时支持目标检测、实例分割、全景分割和语义分割。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.innovation: 在DINO基础上引入掩码预测分支和掩码嵌入，实现了检测与分割任务的端到端统一训练。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer.result: 在COCO、ADE20K等基准上取得当时最优结果，在实例分割、全景分割和语义分割任务上均超越专用方法。
Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer._arxiv_id: Mask DINO: Towards A Unified Transformer-based Framework for Object Detection and Segmentation.

2304.07082|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对跨域弱监督目标检测（CDWSOD）问题，提出了一种基于DETR的方法DETR-GA。作者观察到DETR的编码器和解码器均基于注意力机制，能够聚合全图语义信息，其聚合结果（图像级预测）可自然利用弱监督进行域对齐。基于此，DETR-GA同时进行实例级和图像级预测，并利用强监督和弱监督进行训练。具体地，在编码器中添加多个类别查询以聚合语义为图像级预测，在解码器中添加前景查询。编码器中的弱监督类别查询能粗略定位对应位置并排除无关区域干扰。实验表明该方法在跨域弱监督检测任务上取得了优于现有方法的效果。
2304.07082|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-domain weakly supervised object detection (CDWSOD) by proposing DETR-GA, a DETR-based detector that simultaneously makes instance-level and image-level predictions using both strong and weak supervision. The key idea is to add class queries to the encoder and a foreground query to the decoder for image-level semantic aggregation, leveraging DETR's attention mechanism for domain alignment. Experiments demonstrate improved performance over existing CDWSOD methods.
2304.07082|v2.assessment: 将DETR的注意力聚合能力巧妙应用于跨域弱监督检测，思路新颖但应用场景相对小众，对该特定任务有参考价值。
2304.07082|v2.contribution: 提出了DETR-GA，通过添加全局聚合查询实现实例级与图像级联合预测，统一利用强监督和弱监督进行跨域弱监督目标检测。
2304.07082|v2.innovation: 利用DETR编码器/解码器的注意力聚合能力，通过类别查询和前景查询实现图像级预测以辅助域对齐。
2304.07082|v2.result: 在跨域弱监督目标检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的效果。

Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_cn: 本文针对RAW图像域目标检测研究不足的问题，提出了一个新的RAW图像目标检测基准数据集和一个新的检测模型。现有目标检测研究主要基于sRGB图像，而RAW格式保留了更多原始传感器信息，在低光照等挑战性场景下具有潜在优势。作者构建了包含配对RAW和sRGB图像的大规模检测基准，并提出了针对RAW域特性的检测模型，通过充分利用RAW图像的高动态范围和线性响应特性来提升检测性能。实验表明，所提方法在RAW域检测任务上优于直接在sRGB图像上训练的基线方法，揭示了RAW域检测的研究潜力。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses the underexplored problem of RAW-domain object detection by introducing a new benchmark with paired RAW and sRGB images and a new detection model. While existing detection research focuses on sRGB images, RAW format preserves richer sensor information beneficial for challenging scenarios like low-light conditions. Experiments show the proposed method outperforms sRGB-trained baselines, highlighting the potential of RAW-domain detection.
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.assessment: 开辟了RAW域目标检测这一新方向，基准和模型的提出对该领域有开创性意义，但整体影响力有待后续工作验证。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.contribution: 构建了RAW图像目标检测基准数据集，并提出了针对RAW域特性的检测模型。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.innovation: 首次系统性地研究RAW域目标检测问题，利用RAW图像的高动态范围和线性响应特性提升检测性能。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench.result: 在RAW域检测任务上优于直接在sRGB图像上训练的基线方法。
Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Bench._arxiv_id: Toward RAW Object Detection: A New Benchmark and A New Model.

2212.07289|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对基于DETR的3D点云检测器中大量误检（false positives）的问题，提出了ConQueR（Query Contrast Voxel-DETR）。作者观察到DETR类3D检测器通常使用远多于GT的query（如Waymo中300个query对40个目标），导致推理时产生大量误检，且这些误检在局部区域高度重叠，根源在于缺乏显式监督来区分局部相似的query。为此，作者提出了Query Contrast机制，通过为每个GT构建正负GT-query对，并基于特征相似度设计对比损失来增强正对、抑制负对。ConQueR缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的差距，减少了约60%的误检，在Waymo等基准上取得了更准确且更稀疏的预测。
2212.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the false positive problem in DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors by proposing ConQueR (Query Contrast Voxel-DETR). The authors observe that most false positives are locally overlapping due to the lack of explicit supervision to discriminate similar queries. They propose a Query Contrast mechanism that constructs positive and negative GT-query pairs and applies a contrastive loss based on feature similarity. ConQueR reduces false positives by up to ~60% and closes the gap between sparse and dense 3D detectors.
2212.07289|v2.assessment: 针对DETR类3D检测器误检问题的分析深入且解决方案简洁有效，对自动驾驶3D感知中稀疏检测器的发展有重要推动作用。
2212.07289|v2.contribution: 提出了Query Contrast机制，通过对比学习显式增强query与最佳匹配GT的关联，有效消除DETR类3D检测器中的误检。
2212.07289|v2.innovation: 构建正负GT-query对并设计对比损失，利用特征相似度区分局部相似的query预测，实现更稀疏准确的3D检测。
2212.07289|v2.result: 在Waymo等基准上减少了约60%的误检，缩小了稀疏与稠密3D检测器之间的性能差距。

Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中DETR类模型缺乏视觉-语言先验知识、难以泛化到未见类别的问题，本文提出将视觉-语言知识蒸馏到DETR框架中。方法通过从预训练的视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）中提取跨模态对齐知识，并设计蒸馏损失引导DETR的查询和分类头学习开放词汇表征。相比已有仅依赖类别文本嵌入的方法，该工作显式利用视觉-语言模型的细粒度对齐能力，提升了新类别上的检测性能。在开放词汇检测基准上取得了优于基线DETR的AP提升，具体数据需参见原文。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of open-vocabulary object detection where DETR-based models lack visual-linguistic priors and struggle to generalize to unseen categories. It proposes distilling visual-linguistic knowledge from pre-trained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) into the DETR framework via tailored distillation losses that guide query and classification learning. Compared to methods relying solely on class text embeddings, this approach explicitly leverages fine-grained cross-modal alignment, achieving improved AP on novel categories over DETR baselines.
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.assessment: 将视觉-语言蒸馏引入DETR开放词汇检测，思路清晰且实用，对开放世界感知有参考价值。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.contribution: 提出一种将视觉-语言知识蒸馏到DETR中的开放词汇目标检测框架。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.innovation: 利用预训练视觉-语言模型的跨模态对齐能力指导DETR查询学习，增强新类别泛化。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上优于DETR基线，提升了新类别检测AP。
Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic K._arxiv_id: Distilling DETR with Visual-Linguistic Knowledge for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

2304.11463|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于语言的目标检测缺乏统一评估基准的问题，本文提出OmniLabel任务定义、数据集和评估指标。该基准涵盖标准检测、开放词汇检测和指代表达，包含超过25K图像上的28K+独特物体描述，且描述可指向一个、多个甚至零个物体，从而提供自由文本形式的负样本。评估采用改进的平均精度指标处理大标签空间，并通过强语言基线验证了基准的挑战性。OmniLabel为语言驱动检测的未来研究提供了严格的测试平台。
2304.11463|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of proper evaluation for language-based object detection by introducing OmniLabel, a novel task definition, dataset, and metric. It subsumes standard, open-vocabulary, and referring expression detection, with over 28K unique object descriptions on 25K+ images, including descriptions that refer to one, multiple, or no objects, providing free-form negative examples. A modified average precision metric handles the large label space, and evaluations of strong baselines confirm the benchmark's challenging nature.
2304.11463|v2.assessment: OmniLabel填补了语言驱动检测评估的空白，数据集设计严谨，对开放词汇和指代理解研究有重要推动作用。
2304.11463|v2.contribution: 提出了一个统一的语言驱动目标检测基准，包含任务定义、数据集和评估指标。
2304.11463|v2.innovation: 支持自由文本描述且允许负样本，统一了标准、开放词汇和指代检测的评估。
2304.11463|v2.result: 构建了25K+图像、28K+描述的数据集，强基线在其上表现有限，证明其挑战性。

2307.11035|v2.summary_cn: 针对Transformer检测器在多样域上泛化性差且定位精度不足的问题，本文提出Cascade-DETR用于高质量通用目标检测。方法引入Cascade Attention层，将物体中心信息显式集成到解码器中，通过限制注意力到前一个框预测来逐步精化；同时重新设计查询评分，预测期望IoU而非分类分数，使置信度更校准。此外构建了包含10个不同域数据集的UDB10基准。在COCO上达到SOTA，在UDB10所有数据集上显著提升DETR类检测器，部分提升超过10 mAP。
2307.11035|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization and localization accuracy of Transformer-based detectors in diverse domains by proposing Cascade-DETR for high-quality universal object detection. It introduces a Cascade Attention layer that integrates object-centric information by limiting attention to the previous box prediction, and replaces classification scores with predicted expected IoU for better-calibrated confidences. A new benchmark UDB10 with 10 diverse datasets is also introduced. Cascade-DETR advances state-of-the-art on COCO and improves DETR-based detectors on all UDB10 datasets, with gains over 10 mAP in some cases.
2307.11035|v2.assessment: Cascade-DETR在通用检测和定位精度上均有显著提升，UDB10基准对跨域检测研究很有价值。
2307.11035|v2.contribution: 提出Cascade-DETR及UDB10基准，实现高质量通用目标检测。
2307.11035|v2.innovation: Cascade Attention层和基于期望IoU的查询评分机制。
2307.11035|v2.result: 在COCO上达SOTA，UDB10上部分数据集提升超10 mAP。

2310.15955|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR中定位与分类任务耦合导致优化冲突的问题，本文提出Decoupled DETR，在空间上解耦定位和分类。方法通过设计独立的解码器分支或空间分离的注意力机制，使定位和分类各自关注适合的特征区域，减少任务间的干扰。相比原始DETR及其变体，该解耦策略提升了端到端检测的收敛速度和精度。在COCO等基准上取得了优于基线DETR的AP，具体数值需参见原文。
2310.15955|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the optimization conflict between localization and classification in DETR by proposing Decoupled DETR, which spatially disentangles the two tasks. It designs separate decoder branches or spatially separated attention mechanisms so that localization and classification focus on suitable feature regions, reducing task interference. Compared to vanilla DETR and its variants, this decoupling strategy improves convergence and accuracy for end-to-end detection, achieving higher AP on COCO and other benchmarks.
2310.15955|v2.assessment: 解耦定位与分类是DETR改进的重要方向，本文思路合理，对端到端检测有参考意义。
2310.15955|v2.contribution: 提出空间解耦定位与分类的Decoupled DETR框架。
2310.15955|v2.innovation: 通过独立分支或空间分离注意力实现任务解耦，减少优化冲突。
2310.15955|v2.result: 在COCO等基准上优于基线DETR，提升了检测精度。

2303.16940|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达原始ADC信号目标检测中特征提取能力不足的问题，本文提出T-FFTRadNet，利用Swin Vision Transformer从原始ADC雷达信号中进行目标检测。方法将Swin Transformer作为骨干网络处理雷达距离-多普勒-天线张量，结合检测头输出3D框。相比基于CNN的雷达检测方法，Swin的层次化窗口注意力能更好地捕捉雷达信号中的长距离依赖和局部细节。在雷达检测基准上取得了优于CNN基线的检测性能，具体指标需参见原文。
2303.16940|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited feature extraction capability in object detection from raw ADC radar signals by proposing T-FFTRadNet, which employs Swin Vision Transformers on raw ADC data. The Swin Transformer backbone processes range-Doppler-antenna tensors and feeds a detection head for 3D box output. Compared to CNN-based radar detectors, the hierarchical window attention better captures long-range dependencies and local details, achieving improved detection performance on radar benchmarks.
2303.16940|v2.assessment: 将Swin Transformer应用于原始雷达信号检测具有新意，对自动驾驶雷达感知有参考价值。
2303.16940|v2.contribution: 提出基于Swin Transformer的原始ADC雷达信号目标检测网络T-FFTRadNet。
2303.16940|v2.innovation: 首次将Swin Vision Transformer用于原始ADC雷达信号的3D目标检测。
2303.16940|v2.result: 在雷达检测基准上优于CNN基线，提升了检测性能。

2302.11481|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中传感器融合3D目标检测的快速发展，本文提供了一篇深入的文献综述，重点聚焦基于Transformer的传感器融合方法。文章首先介绍Vision Transformer基础，然后系统梳理了近期基于Transformer的3D检测框架，包括CNN特征编码器与Transformer检测头的组合，并简要提及非Transformer的融合方法。最后总结了传感器融合趋势并指出未来研究方向。该综述为研究者提供了该领域的全面概览和参考。
2302.11481|v2.summary_en: This paper provides an in-depth literature survey on Transformer-based sensor fusion for 3D object detection in autonomous driving. It first introduces Vision Transformer basics, then systematically reviews recent Transformer-based 3D detection frameworks combining CNN feature encoders with Transformer detection heads, and briefly covers non-Transformer fusion methods. It concludes with sensor fusion trends and future research directions, offering a comprehensive overview for researchers.
2302.11481|v2.assessment: 综述覆盖了Transformer传感器融合的主要进展，适合作为入门参考，但缺乏原创方法。
2302.11481|v2.contribution: 系统综述了基于Transformer的自动驾驶传感器融合3D检测方法。
2302.11481|v2.innovation: 聚焦Transformer在传感器融合中的角色，并总结趋势与未来方向。
2302.11481|v2.result: 提供了该领域的全面文献梳理和参考资源链接。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，现有为卷积检测器设计的知识蒸馏方法无法直接适用。本文提出DETRDistill，包含匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和查询先验分配蒸馏三个组件，分别对齐师生预测、传递目标中心特征并加速学生收敛。在COCO数据集上，该方法在多种DETR架构上均取得一致的性能提升，验证了其通用性。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: Existing knowledge distillation methods designed for convolution-based detectors are not directly applicable to DETR-families due to their set prediction formulation. This paper proposes DETRDistill, a universal KD framework comprising Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation. Extensive experiments on COCO demonstrate consistent improvements across various DETR architectures.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个专门面向DETR系列检测器的通用知识蒸馏框架，三个蒸馏组件设计合理且互补，对模型压缩部署有实际价值。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出了面向DETR系列检测器的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 设计了匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和查询先验分配蒸馏三种互补的蒸馏策略。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO数据集上对多种DETR架构均取得一致的检测性能提升。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器收敛慢和去噪训练中噪声查询设计不佳的问题，本文提出DINO（DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes），通过对比去噪训练、混合查询选择以及两次前向传播的look-forward-twice方案来加速收敛并提升检测性能。DINO在COCO上达到63.3 AP，首次在端到端检测器中超越最优的基于CNN的检测器，并在多个基准上取得SOTA。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: This paper proposes DINO, an end-to-end object detector that improves DETR training via contrastive denoising, mixed query selection, and look-forward-twice. DINO achieves 63.3 AP on COCO, surpassing the best CNN-based detectors for the first time, and sets new state-of-the-art results on multiple benchmarks.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DINO是DETR系列检测器的里程碑式工作，在COCO上首次让端到端检测器超越CNN检测器，对后续DETR改进影响深远。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出了DINO端到端检测器，通过改进去噪训练和查询选择显著提升DETR性能。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 引入对比去噪训练、混合查询选择和look-forward-twice机制来加速收敛并提升检测精度。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.result: 在COCO上达到63.3 AP，首次使端到端检测器超越最优CNN检测器。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测（高IoU阈值）场景下排序不稳定、分类与定位不一致的问题，本文提出Rank-DETR，通过引入排序导向的架构设计和损失函数来提升检测质量。具体包括排序导向的查询选择、排序自适应的分类损失和排序导向的损失函数，使检测器在高IoU阈值下表现更优。在COCO数据集上，Rank-DETR在多个骨干网络上取得一致的AP提升，尤其在高IoU指标上改进显著。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: DETR-based detectors suffer from unstable ranking and misalignment between classification and localization under high-quality detection scenarios. This paper proposes Rank-DETR, which introduces ranking-oriented query selection, ranking-adaptive classification loss, and ranking-oriented loss to improve detection quality. Experiments on COCO show consistent AP improvements, especially under high IoU thresholds.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 从排序角度切入解决DETR高质量检测问题，思路新颖，对需要高精度定位的自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出了排序导向的Rank-DETR框架，提升DETR类检测器的高质量检测能力。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 引入排序导向的查询选择、排序自适应分类损失和排序导向损失函数来改善分类与定位的一致性。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: 在COCO数据集上取得一致的AP提升，尤其在高IoU阈值下改进显著。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中现有知识蒸馏方法因非自适应候选裁剪和单层特征模仿导致信息破坏与知识迁移效率低的问题，本文提出Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP)框架，包含目标感知知识提取模块和蒸馏金字塔机制。前者自适应变换目标候选并采用目标感知掩码注意力获取精确完整的物体知识，后者引入全局和块蒸馏补偿物体蒸馏中缺失的关系信息。实验表明该方法相比现有方法取得显著提升。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: Existing knowledge distillation methods for open-vocabulary object detection suffer from information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer due to non-adaptive proposal cropping and single-level feature mimicking. This paper proposes the Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP) framework with an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module and a Distillation Pyramid mechanism. Experiments show significant improvements over current methods.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 针对开放词汇检测中知识蒸馏的痛点提出系统性改进，目标感知提取和金字塔蒸馏设计合理，对开放世界感知有参考意义。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出了OADP框架，通过目标感知知识提取和蒸馏金字塔提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 设计了自适应目标候选变换与目标感知掩码注意力，以及全局和块蒸馏补偿关系信息。
2303.05892|v2.result: 相比现有开放词汇检测方法取得显著性能提升。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中知识蒸馏和样本回放直接应用于Transformer检测器（如Deformable DETR）效果不佳的问题，本文提出ContinuaL DEtection TRansformer (CL-DETR)。方法包括检测器知识蒸馏损失，聚焦旧模型中最有信息量和可靠的预测并忽略冗余背景，同时兼容真实标签；以及改进的样本回放校准策略，保持训练集标签分布以更好匹配训练测试统计。在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测的SOTA结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: Knowledge distillation and exemplar replay do not work well when directly applied to transformer-based object detectors for incremental object detection. This paper proposes CL-DETR, which introduces a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss focusing on informative predictions and a calibration strategy for exemplar replay. Extensive experiments on COCO 2017 demonstrate state-of-the-art results in incremental object detection.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 将增量学习与Transformer检测器结合的系统性工作，DKD损失和校准回放策略设计有针对性，对持续学习感知系统有参考价值。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出了CL-DETR，使知识蒸馏和样本回放有效适用于Transformer增量目标检测。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 设计了检测器知识蒸馏损失和校准样本回放策略，解决Transformer检测器增量学习中的灾难性遗忘。
2304.03110|v2.result: 在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测的SOTA结果。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在传统对应关系优化中被视为外点的问题，本文将物体视为对应关系优化中的一等公民，提出BA-Det——一种端到端可优化的目标检测器，包含目标中心时序对应学习和特征度量物体光束法平差。在Waymo Open Dataset上，BA-Det以极小的额外计算代价取得SOTA性能，并在多种基线3D检测器上验证了有效性。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: Moving objects violate multi-view geometry constraints and are treated as outliers in correspondence-based optimization for 3D video object detection. This paper proposes BA-Det, an end-to-end optimizable object detector with object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment. BA-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance on the Waymo Open Dataset with only marginal computation cost.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将光束法平差思想引入3D视频目标检测，以物体为中心的优化思路新颖，在Waymo上验证了有效性和效率，对自动驾驶3D感知有重要参考价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出了BA-Det，将物体作为一等公民进行对应关系优化以实现3D视频目标检测。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 引入目标中心时序对应学习和特征度量物体光束法平差，解决运动物体违反多视图几何约束的问题。
2303.15416|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上以极小额外计算代价取得SOTA性能。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中物体形状编码不充分、语义信息利用不足的问题，提出AShapeFormer，通过Transformer实现语义引导的物体级主动形状编码。方法利用语义先验指导形状特征的提取与聚合，增强对物体几何结构的建模能力。相比已有方法，改进了形状编码的语义一致性和物体级表征质量。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在3D检测基准上预期有提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient shape encoding and semantic utilization in 3D object detection by proposing AShapeFormer, a semantics-guided object-level active shape encoding framework via Transformers. The method leverages semantic priors to guide shape feature extraction and aggregation, enhancing geometric structure modeling. It improves semantic consistency and object-level representation quality compared to existing approaches.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将语义引导与Transformer结合用于3D形状编码，思路新颖，对3D检测中的形状建模有参考价值。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码框架AShapeFormer。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 利用语义先验指导Transformer进行物体级形状编码。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在3D检测基准上取得提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中未知物体隐藏在背景中难以发现、知识迁移不充分的问题，提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。方法引入广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，仅用已知样本监督即可泛化到未知物体，并提出负能量抑制损失抑制背景非物体样本，同时用图基判定方案替代NMS后处理。还发布了首个公开的未知物体检测基准。相比已有工作，显著提升了未知物体的召回能力。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of detecting unknown objects hidden in the background in open-world/open-set detection, where knowledge transfer from known to unknown classes is insufficient. It proposes Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer), introducing a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples that generalizes to unknowns, a negative energy suppression loss to suppress background non-objects, and a graph-based determination scheme replacing NMS. It also presents the first public Unknown Object Detection Benchmark, significantly improving unknown object recall.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 系统性地解决了开放集检测中未知物体被背景淹没的痛点，GOC分数和图基后处理设计巧妙，基准贡献也有价值。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer框架及首个公开未知物体检测基准。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 广义物体置信度(GOC)分数与负能量抑制损失，以及图基判定替代NMS。
2303.13769|v2.result: 显著提升未知物体检测召回率，并建立公开基准。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物体导致已知物体检测能力下降、伪标签机制利用先验不足且方向不可控的问题，提出CAT：定位与识别级联检测Transformer。方法通过共享解码器以级联解码方式解耦检测过程，先定位所有前景物体再逐一识别，并提出结合模型驱动与输入驱动的自适应伪标签机制。相比已有工作，缓解了已知-未知检测的冲突，提升了增量学习效果。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-world object detection (OWOD) issues where detecting unknowns degrades known object detection, and fixed pseudo-labelling mechanisms underutilize input priors and lack training direction guarantees. It proposes CAT, a Localization and Identification Cascade Detection Transformer that decouples detection via a shared decoder in cascade decoding, plus a self-adaptive pseudo-labelling mechanism combining model-driven and input-driven cues. It mitigates known-unknown conflicts and improves incremental learning.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 级联解耦思路符合人类认知，自适应伪标签机制设计合理，对OWOD方向有较强推动作用。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出CAT级联检测Transformer及自适应伪标签机制。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解耦定位与识别，结合模型与输入驱动的伪标签。
2301.01970|v2.result: 缓解已知-未知检测冲突，提升开放世界检测与增量学习性能。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多检测数据集联合训练时存在的类别体系差异和域间隙两大不一致性问题，提出Detection Hub。方法通过学习数据集嵌入来适配物体查询和检测头卷积核，实现数据集感知；同时用词嵌入替换one-hot类别表示，利用语言嵌入的语义一致性将不同数据集类别对齐到统一空间。相比单数据集训练，联合训练取得显著性能提升，并在UODB基准上达到SoTA。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two inconsistencies—taxonomy difference and domain gap—when jointly training on multiple detection datasets, proposing Detection Hub. It learns a dataset embedding to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels in detection heads (dataset-aware), and replaces one-hot category representations with word embeddings to align categories across datasets into a unified semantic space (category-aligned). Joint training yields significant gains over single-dataset training and achieves SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 利用语言嵌入统一多数据集类别体系是优雅的方案，数据集感知适配设计实用，对大规模检测数据利用有重要价值。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知且类别对齐的Detection Hub框架。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 用数据集嵌入适配查询与卷积核，用词嵌入对齐跨数据集类别。
2206.03484|v2.result: 联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，在UODB基准上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测(SOD)中多层级特征增强不足的问题，提出Pixels, Regions, and Objects多重增强方法。方法从像素、区域和物体三个层级对特征进行增强，以提升显著目标的检测精度。相比已有工作，改进了多尺度特征融合与增强策略。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-level feature enhancement in salient object detection (SOD) by proposing a Pixels, Regions, and Objects multiple enhancement method. It enhances features at pixel, region, and object levels to improve salient object detection accuracy, improving multi-scale feature fusion and enhancement over prior work. No specific experimental data is provided in the abstract.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 显著目标检测与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，方法创新性一般，参考价值有限。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域、物体三重增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 从像素、区域、物体三个层级进行特征增强。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略未充分利用课程学习潜力的问题，提出课程物体操作(COM)框架。方法将课程训练策略嵌入损失设计和数据增强：COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段强调不同难度物体；COMAug在GT-Aug基础上先基于启发式聚类物体，预测并更新组级难度，逐步将更难物体采样增强到训练样本中。相比已有工作，提升了模型性能和泛化能力，大量实验验证了有效性和通用性。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: This paper explores curriculum learning potential in LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing a Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) framework embedding curricular training into both loss design and augmentation. COMLoss dynamically predicts object-level difficulties and emphasizes objects by training stage, while COMAug clusters objects in the GT database via heuristics and predicts group-level difficulties for stable progressive augmentation. Extensive experiments show improved performance and generalization.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR检测的损失与增强两个环节，组级难度设计兼顾稳定性，对3D检测训练策略有实用参考价值。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出嵌入损失与增强的课程物体操作(COM)框架。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态物体级难度加权与COMAug组级难度渐进增强。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界目标检测（OWOD）要求模型在检测已知类别的同时发现未知目标，但标准检测器会把与标注不重叠的候选框直接判为背景，导致未知目标被误判为背景。本文提出 PROB，一个概率化的 objectness 估计框架，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知目标的 objectness 似然最大化，从而无需依赖伪标签即可区分未知目标与背景。相比此前依赖伪标签生成监督的 OWOD 方法，PROB 用生成式/概率建模替代了不可靠的伪标签监督，缓解了未知目标检测性能低的问题。摘要未给出具体数值，但作者声称该方法在未知目标检测上取得了提升。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: Open World Object Detection (OWOD) requires detecting both known and unknown objects, yet standard detectors classify proposals not overlapping with labeled objects as background, causing unknown objects to be missed. This paper introduces PROB, a novel probabilistic framework for objectness estimation that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space, avoiding unreliable pseudo-label supervision. Compared with prior OWOD methods that generate supervision via pseudo-labeling, PROB offers a more principled generative formulation for separating unknown objects from background.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 该工作针对 OWOD 中未知目标与背景难以区分这一核心痛点，用概率建模替代伪标签监督，思路新颖，对开放集检测与自动驾驶中的未知障碍物发现具有参考价值。
2212.01424|v2.contribution: 提出概率化 objectness 估计框架 PROB，通过分布估计与似然最大化的交替优化实现未知目标与背景的区分。
2212.01424|v2.innovation: 将生成式/概率建模引入 OWOD 的 objectness 估计，摆脱对伪标签监督的依赖。
2212.01424|v2.result: 在开放世界目标检测基准上改善了未知目标的检测能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不稳定、DETR类模型依赖密集查询的问题，本文提出Sparse Semi-DETR，利用稀疏可学习查询进行半监督检测。方法通过稀疏查询机制减少冗余候选，并结合一致性/伪标签策略提升未标注数据的利用率。相比已有半监督DETR方法，改进点在于查询稀疏化与半监督训练范式的结合，缓解了密集查询带来的噪声传播。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在标准半监督检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised object detection by proposing Sparse Semi-DETR, which leverages sparse learnable queries to reduce redundant candidates and improve pseudo-label quality. It integrates sparse query design with semi-supervised training to mitigate noise propagation from dense queries. The method claims competitive performance on standard semi-supervised detection benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 将稀疏查询引入半监督DETR是一个合理且实用的方向，对半监督检测与DETR结合的研究者有参考价值。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督DETR框架Sparse Semi-DETR。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 将稀疏查询机制与半监督伪标签训练结合，减少密集查询带来的噪声。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在标准半监督检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri._arxiv_id: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection.

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器知识蒸馏中蒸馏点采样不一致、难以对齐的问题，本文提出KD-DETR，引入一致性蒸馏点采样策略。方法通过在不同层级/查询间建立一致的蒸馏点对应关系，使教师与学生之间的特征对齐更稳定。相比已有DETR蒸馏方法，改进点在于解决蒸馏点采样不一致导致的监督信号噪声。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在检测蒸馏任务上取得优于基线的效果。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles knowledge distillation for DETR-based detectors by proposing KD-DETR with consistent distillation point sampling. It establishes consistent correspondence of distillation points across layers/queries to stabilize teacher-student feature alignment. The method claims improved performance over baseline distillation approaches, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: DETR蒸馏是一个实际且尚未充分解决的问题，一致性采样思路对检测蒸馏研究者有启发。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出面向DETR的一致性蒸馏点采样知识蒸馏方法KD-DETR。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 通过一致性蒸馏点采样解决DETR蒸馏中特征对齐不稳定的问题。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 在检测蒸馏任务上取得优于基线的效果（摘要未给出具体数值）。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器缺乏显式位置关系建模、难以区分空间相近目标的问题，本文提出Relation DETR，引入显式位置关系先验。方法通过编码目标查询之间的位置关系来增强注意力机制，使模型能更好利用空间结构信息。相比原始DETR及其变体，改进点在于将位置关系先验显式注入检测流程，而非仅依赖隐式学习。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在检测基准上取得提升。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit positional relation modeling in DETR-based detectors by proposing Relation DETR, which introduces an explicit position relation prior. It encodes relations among object queries to enhance attention and exploit spatial structure. The method claims improvements on detection benchmarks over DETR variants, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.assessment: 显式位置关系先验是DETR改进的一个有价值方向，对检测架构研究者有参考意义。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出引入显式位置关系先验的Relation DETR检测框架。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 将目标查询间的位置关系显式编码进DETR注意力机制。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.result: 在检测基准上取得优于DETR变体的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi._arxiv_id: Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Position Relation Prior for Object Detection.

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法在微小目标检测中查询位置信息不适配、固定查询数难以应对航拍数据实例数不均衡的问题，本文提出DQ-DETR。方法包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强和动态查询选择三部分，利用计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并改善查询位置信息。相比CNN与DETR类方法，改进点在于动态查询机制适配微小目标与不均衡实例分布。在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的SOTA结果。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: This paper targets tiny object detection with DETR-like methods, where query positional information is not tailored to tiny objects and fixed query numbers fail on imbalanced aerial datasets. It proposes DQ-DETR with a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection to adapt query number and positions. It achieves state-of-the-art 30.2% mAP on AI-TOD-V2.
2404.03507|v2.assessment: 动态查询与计数引导的结合对微小目标检测有实际价值，且给出了明确的SOTA数值，值得关注。
2404.03507|v2.contribution: 提出面向微小目标检测的动态查询DETR框架DQ-DETR。
2404.03507|v2.innovation: 利用类别计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并增强查询位置信息。
2404.03507|v2.result: 在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的SOTA性能。

Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中类别泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出Grounding DINO，将DINO检测器与基于语言的预训练相结合。方法通过将文本/语言 grounding 预训练融入DETR类检测框架，使模型能够根据文本提示检测任意类别目标。相比已有开放集检测方法，改进点在于将强检测器DINO与grounded预训练有效融合，实现零样本与开放词汇检测。摘要未给出具体数值，但该工作已成为开放集检测的重要基线。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set object detection by proposing Grounding DINO, which marries the DINO detector with grounded language pre-training. It integrates text-grounded pre-training into a DETR-like framework to detect arbitrary categories given text prompts. The method claims strong zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection performance and has become an important baseline, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.assessment: Grounding DINO是开放集检测领域的里程碑式工作，对多模态与开放词汇检测研究者极具参考价值。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.contribution: 提出将DINO与grounded预训练结合的开放集检测器Grounding DINO。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.innovation: 将语言grounding预训练有效融入DETR类检测框架，实现文本提示驱动的开放集检测。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.result: 在开放集/零样本检测任务上取得强性能并成为重要基线（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun._arxiv_id: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-training for Open-Set Object Detection.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中DETR类方法应用尚不充分、查询设计与点云稀疏性适配不佳的问题，本文提出SEED，一个简单有效的点云3D DETR。方法通过简洁的查询设计与点云特征交互，将DETR范式有效迁移到3D点云检测。相比已有3D检测方法，改进点在于以简单结构实现有效的3D DETR，降低复杂度同时保持性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在点云检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adoption of DETR-like methods in point-cloud 3D detection by proposing SEED, a simple and effective 3D DETR. It adapts the DETR paradigm to point clouds via a concise query design and feature interaction. The method claims competitive performance on point-cloud detection benchmarks with reduced complexity, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.assessment: 将DETR范式简洁有效地迁移到点云3D检测，对3D检测与DETR交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.contribution: 提出简单有效的点云3D DETR框架SEED。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.innovation: 以简洁查询设计将DETR范式有效适配到稀疏点云3D检测。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.result: 在点云3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in._arxiv_id: SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in Point Clouds.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR框架在点云3D目标检测中因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标点的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE)，在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框计算每个点的相对位置编码，从而引导模型聚焦目标附近点，符合局部性原则。同时从数据归一化等方面系统改进pipeline。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by limited training data and the violation of locality, where queries attend to points far from target objects. It proposes 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE), which computes per-point position encoding based on relative positions to the 3D boxes predicted by queries in each decoder layer, guiding the model to focus on nearby points. The pipeline is further improved with data normalization and other refinements. It achieves AP25/AP50 of 77.8%/66.0% on ScanNetV2, significantly surpassing 3DETR's 65.0%/47.0%, and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了DETR类3D检测器归纳偏置不足的核心问题，性能提升显著，对点云3D检测研究有重要参考价值。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码方法，显著提升DETR框架在点云3D检测中的性能并刷新多个基准纪录。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 在每个decoder层基于query预测的3D框动态计算点的相对位置编码，显式注入局部性归纳偏置。
2308.04409|v2.result: 在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50达77.8%/66.0%，大幅超越3DETR的65.0%/47.0%，并在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上取得新纪录。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测领域公开数据集规模小（多数少于2K图像且仅单类目标）且源码不可获取的问题，构建了SARDet-100K基准数据集，整合标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，成为首个COCO级别的大规模多类SAR目标检测数据集。通过全面实验揭示了RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上的显著差异，并提出多阶段滤波增强（MSFA）预训练框架来弥合这些差距。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large-scale public datasets and inaccessible source code in SAR object detection, this paper establishes SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by surveying, collecting, and standardizing 10 existing SAR datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial disparities between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning in both data domain and model structure. A Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework is proposed to bridge these gaps.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 该工作为SAR目标检测提供了首个大规模多类基准和开源方法，对推动该领域标准化研究具有重要意义。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 构建首个COCO级别大规模多类SAR目标检测数据集SARDet-100K并提出MSFA预训练框架。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 通过整合标准化10个现有数据集构建大规模基准，并针对RGB-SAR域差异设计多阶段滤波增强预训练策略。
2403.06534|v2.result: 建立了大规模SAR检测基准并验证了MSFA框架在弥合RGB预训练与SAR微调差距方面的有效性。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个边界框标注，远超现有唯一的OVTAO-val数据集（200+类别、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将运动特征集成到目标跟踪中，弥补了以往OVT方法忽略运动特征的不足。实验验证了基准的实用性和方法的有效性。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of benchmarks hindering open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT) research, this paper builds OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark containing 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 bounding box annotations, far exceeding the existing OVTAO-val dataset. A simple yet effective OVT baseline is also developed that integrates motion features for tracking, which were ignored in previous OVT methods. Experiments verify the usefulness of the benchmark and the effectiveness of the proposed method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了开放词汇多目标跟踪基准的空白，规模显著超越现有数据集，对推动OVT研究有重要价值。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出集成运动特征的有效基线方法。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次提供千类级别、近两千视频的OVT基准，并在基线中引入被以往方法忽略的运动特征。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B包含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608标注框，实验验证了基准和方法对OVT研究的推动作用。
