It likely designs orthogonal constraints to make feature representations of known and unknown classes mutually orthogonal, thereby improving the model's ability to identify unknown categories while reducing false detections on known classes.
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.assessment: 从正交性角度切入开放世界目标检测问题具有一定理论新意，但缺乏摘要信息无法充分评估其方法质量和实验效果。
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.contribution: 探索正交性在开放世界目标检测中的应用，以缓解已知类与未知类的特征混淆。
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.innovation: 将正交性约束引入开放世界目标检测，通过特征正交化区分已知与未知类别。
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Ob._arxiv_id: Exploring Orthogonality in Open World Object Detection.

2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇/开放端目标检测中类别定义受限、依赖人工标注类别的问题，本文提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，利用图像-文本对中的区域-语言对齐信号进行预训练。方法通过生成式建模将区域特征与语言描述联合学习，从而在推理时支持任意文本查询的开放端检测。相比固定类别集的传统检测器，该方法无需闭集类别监督即可泛化到新类别。在开放端检测基准上取得了优于现有开放词汇检测方法的性能，验证了生成式预训练范式的有效性。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-ended object detection where categories are not fixed, proposing a generative region-language pretraining paradigm that learns region-text alignment from image-caption pairs. By jointly modeling region features and language descriptions generatively, the model supports arbitrary text queries at inference without closed-set supervision. It outperforms existing open-vocabulary detection methods on open-ended benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of generative pretraining.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 将生成式预训练引入开放端检测，思路新颖，对开放世界感知有启发意义。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现无需闭集类别监督的开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 用生成式建模替代传统对比式区域-文本对齐，支持任意文本查询检测。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在开放端检测基准上超越现有开放词汇检测方法。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的目标检测性能远逊于LiDAR的问题，本文提出RadarDistill，通过从LiDAR特征进行知识蒸馏来提升雷达检测性能。方法设计了特征级蒸馏策略，将LiDAR教师网络的丰富几何与语义特征迁移到雷达学生网络，缓解雷达数据固有的稀疏与噪声问题。相比直接训练雷达检测器，该方法显著缩小了雷达与LiDAR检测之间的性能差距。在公开雷达检测基准上取得了明显的mAP提升，证明了跨模态蒸馏的有效性。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap between radar-based and LiDAR-based object detection caused by radar sparsity and noise, proposing RadarDistill, which distills LiDAR features into a radar detector. A feature-level distillation strategy transfers geometric and semantic knowledge from a LiDAR teacher to a radar student, mitigating radar data limitations. It substantially narrows the radar-LiDAR performance gap and achieves notable mAP gains on public radar detection benchmarks.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏思路实用，对低成本雷达感知方案有直接价值。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出RadarDistill，用LiDAR特征蒸馏提升雷达目标检测性能。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 设计特征级跨模态蒸馏策略，将LiDAR几何语义知识迁移至雷达检测器。
2403.05061|v2.result: 显著缩小雷达与LiDAR检测差距，在公开基准上取得明显mAP提升。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足、现有攻击多为局部扰动的问题，本文提出GLOW，一种全局布局感知的对抗攻击方法。方法通过优化图像的整体布局与目标空间分布，生成更具语义合理性和迁移性的对抗样本，而非仅扰动局部像素。相比传统局部扰动攻击，GLOW能更有效地欺骗检测器并保持视觉自然性。实验表明该方法在多种检测器上取得更高的攻击成功率，揭示了检测模型对全局布局的敏感性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of object detectors to adversarial attacks, noting that existing attacks mostly rely on local perturbations. It proposes GLOW, a global layout-aware attack that optimizes the overall image layout and object spatial distribution to generate semantically plausible and transferable adversarial examples. GLOW achieves higher attack success rates across multiple detectors than local perturbation methods, revealing detectors' sensitivity to global layout.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 从全局布局角度研究检测攻击，为鲁棒性评估提供新视角。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出全局布局感知的对抗攻击方法GLOW，提升对目标检测器的攻击效果。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 以全局布局优化替代局部像素扰动，生成语义合理的对抗样本。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 在多种检测器上取得更高攻击成功率，揭示全局布局敏感性。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj._arxiv_id: GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Object Detection.

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实标注数据稀缺、合成数据与真实数据存在域差距的问题，本文提出RadSimReal，通过仿真生成逼真雷达数据以弥合合成与真实数据之间的鸿沟。方法构建了高保真雷达仿真管线，生成带有精确标注的雷达点云用于训练检测模型。相比纯真实数据训练，该方法有效缓解了数据不足问题并提升了检测性能。实验表明在合成数据上预训练或混合训练能显著改善真实场景下的雷达检测效果。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotated real radar data and the synthetic-to-real domain gap in radar object detection, proposing RadSimReal, a high-fidelity radar simulation pipeline that generates realistic annotated radar point clouds. Training detectors with simulated data mitigates data scarcity and improves detection performance. Experiments show that pretraining or mixed training with simulated data significantly boosts real-world radar detection.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 仿真数据弥合域差距的思路对雷达感知数据瓶颈有实际意义。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出RadSimReal雷达仿真方法，生成逼真标注数据以弥合合成与真实域差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 构建高保真雷达仿真管线，用合成数据提升真实场景雷达检测。
2404.18150|v2.result: 合成数据预训练/混合训练显著改善真实场景雷达检测性能。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气条件下LiDAR性能退化、单一传感器鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出融合LiDAR与4D雷达的鲁棒3D目标检测方法。方法设计了跨模态融合架构，充分利用4D雷达在雨雾等恶劣天气下相对稳定的测距与测速能力，与LiDAR点云互补。相比仅用LiDAR或仅用雷达的方案，该方法在多种天气条件下均保持较高检测精度。实验表明融合方案在恶劣天气场景下显著优于单模态基线，提升了自动驾驶感知的鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: This paper tackles degraded LiDAR performance and limited single-sensor robustness in adverse weather, proposing a robust 3D object detection method fusing LiDAR and 4D radar. A cross-modal fusion architecture leverages 4D radar's stable ranging and velocity under rain and fog to complement LiDAR point clouds. The fused approach maintains high accuracy across weather conditions, significantly outperforming single-modality baselines in adverse weather and improving autonomous driving perception robustness.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: LiDAR与4D雷达融合应对恶劣天气，切中自动驾驶感知鲁棒性痛点。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出LiDAR与4D雷达融合的鲁棒3D检测方法，应对多种恶劣天气。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 利用4D雷达在恶劣天气下的稳定性与LiDAR互补进行跨模态融合。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在多种天气条件下显著优于单模态基线，提升感知鲁棒性。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型面临的延迟攻击威胁，本文提出Overload，一种针对检测器的延迟攻击方法。方法通过生成特定输入使检测器计算量激增，从而显著增加推理延迟，暴露边缘部署中的实时性安全隐患。相比传统精度攻击，该攻击聚焦于推理时延这一被忽视的安全维度。实验表明该方法能在保持检测精度的情况下大幅提升推理延迟，揭示了边缘检测系统在实时性方面的脆弱性。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses latency attacks on object detection for edge devices, proposing Overload, an attack that crafts inputs to drastically increase inference latency while preserving detection accuracy. Unlike traditional accuracy-oriented attacks, it targets the overlooked security dimension of real-time latency in edge deployment. Experiments show Overload substantially raises inference latency, exposing the real-time vulnerability of edge detection systems.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 关注边缘检测的延迟安全维度，视角独特但领域相关性相对有限。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出Overload延迟攻击方法，暴露边缘设备目标检测的实时性安全隐患。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 将攻击目标从检测精度转向推理时延，聚焦边缘部署实时性安全。
2304.05370|v2.result: 在保持精度的前提下大幅提升推理延迟，揭示边缘检测实时性脆弱性。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: 针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外/深度）目标检测中模态间空间错位导致特征融合退化的问题，本文提出一种弱错位自适应特征对齐方法。方法通过可学习的对齐模块在特征层面自适应校正跨模态偏移，无需精确像素级标注即可完成对齐。相比依赖严格配准或固定对齐假设的已有方法，该方案对真实场景中的弱错位更鲁棒。在无人机多模态检测基准上取得优于现有对齐策略的检测精度，验证了自适应对齐的有效性。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal spatial misalignment in UAV-based multimodal object detection, which degrades feature fusion. It proposes a weakly misalignment-free adaptive feature alignment module that learns to correct cross-modal offsets at the feature level without requiring precise pixel-level registration. Compared with methods relying on strict alignment assumptions, it is more robust to real-world weak misalignment and achieves improved detection accuracy on UAV multimodal benchmarks.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 面向无人机多模态检测的实际痛点，对齐思路对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出弱错位条件下的自适应跨模态特征对齐框架。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 在特征层面自适应校正跨模态偏移，摆脱对精确配准的依赖。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在无人机多模态检测基准上取得优于现有对齐策略的精度。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中模型难以泛化到任意类别、且需实时推理的问题，本文提出 YOLO-World，将 YOLO 检测器与视觉-语言预训练结合实现实时开放词汇检测。方法通过可重参数化的视觉-语言路径聚合与提示-检测范式，在推理时无需文本编码器即可高效运行。相比此前开放词汇检测器速度慢、部署难的问题，YOLO-World 在保持实时性的同时具备强零样本能力。在 LVIS 等基准上取得有竞争力的零样本检测性能，并支持开放词汇分割等下游任务。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles real-time open-vocabulary object detection, where models must generalize to arbitrary categories at low latency. YOLO-World integrates a YOLO detector with vision-language pretraining via re-parameterizable vision-language path aggregation and a prompt-then-detect paradigm, removing the need for a text encoder at inference. It achieves competitive zero-shot detection on LVIS while maintaining real-time speed, and supports downstream tasks such as open-vocabulary segmentation.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 把开放词汇能力带入实时 YOLO 框架，工程与学术价值兼具，影响力大。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出实时开放词汇检测器 YOLO-World。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 可重参数化视觉-语言路径聚合与提示-检测范式，推理无需文本编码器。
2401.17270|v2.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上实现有竞争力的零样本检测并保持实时速度。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: 针对单域泛化目标检测中模型在未见域上性能下降的问题，本文聚焦于数据多样性与特征对齐两个关键因素。方法通过增强训练域的风格与内容多样性，并引入对齐机制缩小域间特征分布差异，从而提升泛化能力。相比仅依赖数据增强或单一对齐策略的已有工作，本文系统性地结合了两者。在多个跨域检测基准上取得优于基线的单域泛化性能。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper studies single domain-generalized object detection, where models degrade on unseen domains. It focuses on diversification and alignment, enhancing style and content diversity of the training domain while aligning inter-domain feature distributions. Compared with methods relying solely on augmentation or alignment, it systematically combines both and improves single-domain generalization across multiple cross-domain detection benchmarks.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 对域泛化检测的多样性-对齐权衡给出系统分析，方法简洁实用。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出结合多样化与对齐的单域泛化检测框架。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 系统整合数据多样化与特征对齐以提升跨域泛化。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 在多个跨域检测基准上优于基线。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: 针对 RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测中模态鸿沟导致跨域迁移困难的问题，本文提出 D3T，一种独特的双域教师之字形训练框架。方法通过双域教师模型在 RGB 与热红外之间交替引导，逐步弥合模态差异并稳定域自适应过程。相比单教师或单向对齐方法，之字形双域策略更有效地缓解模态鸿沟。在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses the RGB-thermal modality gap in domain-adaptive object detection. It proposes D3T, a distinctive dual-domain teacher framework with zigzagging training that alternately guides adaptation across RGB and thermal domains to bridge the modality gap. Compared with single-teacher or unidirectional alignment methods, it more effectively mitigates the gap and achieves superior performance on RGB-T domain-adaptive detection benchmarks.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 双域教师之字形训练为多模态域自适应提供了新思路。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出双域教师之字形域自适应检测框架 D3T。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 以双域教师交替引导弥合 RGB-热红外模态鸿沟。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: 在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上优于现有方法。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: 针对目标检测在昼夜域偏移下性能下降的问题，本文提出一种零样本昼夜域自适应方法。方法在无目标域标注的情况下，通过图像翻译或风格建模将白天域知识迁移到夜间域，并配合检测器自适应策略。相比需要目标域标注或成对数据的域自适应方法，本文实现零样本迁移。在昼夜跨域检测基准上取得显著提升，验证了零样本域自适应的可行性。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper tackles day-night domain shift in object detection. It proposes a zero-shot day-night domain adaptation method that transfers daytime knowledge to nighttime without target-domain labels, using image translation/style modeling combined with detector adaptation. Unlike methods requiring target labels or paired data, it achieves zero-shot transfer and yields notable gains on day-night cross-domain detection benchmarks.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 零样本昼夜自适应对自动驾驶夜间感知有直接应用价值。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出零样本昼夜域自适应目标检测方法。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 无需目标域标注即可完成昼夜域知识迁移。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 在昼夜跨域检测基准上取得显著提升。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: 针对真实检测数据标注成本高、长尾类别样本稀缺的问题，本文提出 InstaGen，通过在合成数据集上训练来增强目标检测。方法利用生成模型合成带实例标注的图像，并将其与真实数据结合训练检测器，以扩充稀有类别与场景多样性。相比仅用真实数据或简单复制粘贴增强的方法，InstaGen 生成的合成样本更具多样性与语义一致性。在检测基准上提升了性能，尤其对稀有类别增益明显。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and long-tail scarcity in object detection by training on synthetic data. InstaGen leverages generative models to synthesize instance-annotated images and combines them with real data to train detectors, enriching rare categories and scene diversity. Compared with real-data-only or copy-paste augmentation, its synthetic samples are more diverse and semantically consistent, improving detection especially for rare classes.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 合成数据增强检测是当前热点，InstaGen 为数据稀缺问题提供可行路径。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出基于合成数据训练的检测增强框架 InstaGen。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 利用生成模型合成带实例标注图像以扩充稀有类别。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 在检测基准上提升性能，稀有类别增益尤为明显。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中标注数据稀缺、模型泛化能力不足的问题，探索如何利用大规模基础模型（如视觉-语言模型）提升少样本场景下的检测性能。方法上，作者提出将基础模型的知识迁移到少样本检测框架中，可能通过冻结主干、提示学习或特征对齐等方式实现。相比传统从零训练的FSOD方法，该工作借助预训练基础模型的强表征能力，减少了对大量标注样本的依赖。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在标准FSOD基准（如PASCAL VOC、COCO）上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of few-shot object detection (FSOD) where labeled data is scarce and model generalization is limited, by leveraging large-scale foundation models. The authors propose to transfer knowledge from foundation models into a few-shot detection framework, potentially via frozen backbones, prompt learning, or feature alignment. Compared to conventional FSOD methods trained from scratch, this approach exploits the strong representation power of pretrained foundation models to reduce reliance on annotated samples. While no specific experimental numbers are provided in the abstract, it is expected to outperform existing methods on standard FSOD benchmarks such as PASCAL VOC and COCO.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 该工作将基础模型与少样本检测结合，思路符合当前趋势，但需关注其是否在标准基准上取得显著提升以及计算开销是否可控。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出了一种利用基础模型进行少样本目标检测的框架，缓解了标注数据稀缺问题。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将大规模预训练基础模型的知识迁移到少样本检测任务中，可能通过提示或特征对齐实现。

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 现有 DETR 类模型普遍采用级联解码器，迫使 object query 只能沿级联方向更新，从图像特征中学到的信息相对受限，难以应对极小目标、严重遮挡和背景混淆等自然场景检测难题。本文提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries (MI) 解码器机制，让 object query 能更全面地学习图像特征。基于 MI 的 MI-DETR 在 COCO 上于不同 backbone 和训练 epoch 设置下均超越所有现有 DETR 类模型，在 ResNet-50 下相比代表性模型 DINO 和 SOTA 模型 Relation-DETR 分别提升 +2.3 AP 和 +0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验进一步验证了 MI 的有效性、合理性与可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: Existing DETR-like detectors rely on cascaded decoders that constrain object queries to update along the cascade direction, limiting the information they extract from image features, which is problematic for extremely small, heavily occluded, and background-confused objects. This paper proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) decoder mechanism that enables object queries to learn more comprehensive information. MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models on COCO across backbones and training schedules, achieving +2.3 AP over DINO and +0.6 AP over Relation-DETR with ResNet-50. Diagnostic and visualization experiments demonstrate the effectiveness, rationality, and interpretability of MI.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 对 DETR 解码器架构的反思具有普遍意义，改进幅度在 COCO 上较为显著且不依赖特殊 backbone，值得检测方向研究者关注。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries 解码器机制，打破级联解码器对 object query 信息获取的限制。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 以并行多轮查询替代传统级联更新，使 object query 能更充分、更全面地利用图像特征。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在 COCO 上不同 backbone 与训练轮数下均超越现有 DETR 类模型，ResNet-50 下较 DINO 提升 +2.3 AP、较 Relation-DETR 提升 +0.6 AP。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 事件流目标检测在低光、运动模糊和高速运动场景下具有优势，但现有基于 SNN、Transformer 或 CNN 的检测器分别存在性能受限、计算开销大或局部感受野有限的问题。本文提出基于 MoE 热传导的检测算法，先用 stem 网络嵌入事件数据，再通过 MoE-HCO 块（集成多种专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导）处理，随后用基于 IoU 的 query 选择模块提取 token 并送入检测头。同时发布基于 Prophesee EVK4-HD 采集的 EvDET200K 基准数据集，在精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: Event-stream object detection offers advantages in low-light, motion-blurred, and fast-motion scenarios, but existing SNN-, Transformer-, and CNN-based detectors suffer from limited performance, high computational cost, or restricted local receptive fields. This paper introduces a MoE heat-conduction-based detector that embeds event data via a stem network, processes it through MoE-HCO blocks with multiple expert modules mimicking heat conduction, and uses an IoU-based query selection module feeding a detection head. It also releases EvDET200K, a benchmark dataset captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD camera, striking a balance between accuracy and efficiency.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将物理热传导类比引入事件检测的 MoE 设计较有新意，配套数据集对事件相机检测社区有实用价值。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出 MoE 热传导检测算法并发布 EvDET200K 事件相机目标检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流中的热传导过程，并结合 IoU-based query selection 平衡精度与效率。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在精度与计算效率之间取得显著平衡，并提供大规模高清事件相机检测数据集。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 无人机 RGB-IR 多模态目标检测可实现全天候检测，但现有数据集成像条件覆盖有限，难以反映真实世界复杂度。本文构建高多样性数据集 ATR-UMOD，覆盖 80m–300m 高度、0°–75° 角度以及全天候、全年份的丰富天气与光照条件，并为每对 RGB-IR 图像标注 6 种条件属性。针对多样条件挑战，提出 prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF)，将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过任务特定的软门控变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，并用 prompt 引导的条件解耦模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: UAV-based RGB-IR object detection enables around-the-clock perception, but existing datasets cover limited imaging conditions and fail to capture real-world complexity. This paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning altitudes of 80–300 m, angles of 0°–75°, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination variations, with 6 condition attributes annotated per RGB-IR pair. It proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes imaging conditions as text prompts and adaptively reallocates multimodal contributions via task-specific soft gating, complemented by a prompt-guided condition-decoupling module.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集的条件属性标注与 prompt 引导融合思路对多模态鲁棒感知有参考价值，但整体更偏数据集与工程融合。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建带条件属性标注的高多样性 UAV RGB-IR 数据集 ATR-UMOD，并提出条件感知动态融合方法 PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过软门控变换自适应调节多模态融合权重。
2510.13620|v2.result: 在覆盖高度、角度、天气与光照的大范围条件下提升了多模态检测的鲁棒性。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 反无人机任务中的小目标检测受限于目标尺寸小与背景复杂，传统帧相机因帧率低、动态范围有限和数据冗余难以胜任。事件相机具备微秒级时间分辨率和高动态范围，但现有事件检测数据集规模小、目标尺寸大、背景单一，不适合小目标检测基准。本文发布首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测数据集 EV-UAV，含 147 个序列、超过 230 万事件级标注，目标平均仅 6.8×5.4 像素，覆盖城市杂乱与极端光照场景；并基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出 EV-SpSegNet 事件分割基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: Small object detection in anti-UAV tasks is hindered by tiny target size and cluttered backgrounds, and frame-based cameras struggle due to low frame rates, limited dynamic range, and data redundancy. This paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based small object detection benchmark, containing 147 sequences with over 2.3 million event-level annotations and extremely small targets averaging 6.8×5.4 pixels across urban clutter and extreme lighting. Observing that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds, it proposes EV-SpSegNet as a novel event segmentation baseline.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 填补了事件相机小目标检测基准的空白，数据规模与标注粒度对事件视觉与反无人机研究均有较高价值。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测数据集 EV-UAV，并提出 EV-SpSegNet 基线。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的特性进行事件分割式检测。
2506.23575|v2.result: 提供 147 个序列、230 万+ 事件级标注、平均 6.8×5.4 像素目标的基准，并给出有效基线。

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中ViT特征对像素级差异模式建模不足的问题，本文提出PiDiViT，将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）引入ViT架构以增强局部判别能力。方法通过显式编码相邻像素差异并与ViT token交互，弥补ViT在细粒度定位上的短板。相比已有基于CNN或纯ViT的FSOD方法，PiDiViT在少样本场景下提升了新类检测精度。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，但思路对FSOD与ViT结合有参考价值。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited sensitivity of ViT features to pixel-level difference patterns in few-shot object detection. It proposes PiDiViT, which integrates pixel difference patterns into the ViT architecture to enhance local discriminability for novel classes. Compared with existing CNN- or ViT-based FSOD methods, it improves few-shot detection accuracy, though specific benchmark numbers are not provided in the abstract.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将像素差异先验注入ViT以提升少样本检测的局部判别力，思路新颖，对FSOD与ViT结合方向有启发。

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中重训练成本高、域偏移大的问题，本文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将DETR与视觉基础模型（VFM）结合。方法利用VFM的开放词汇与泛化能力辅助DETR在目标域进行少样本适配，避免对模型进行全量重训练。相比需要重训练的CD-FSOD方法，该方案在跨域场景下降低了适配成本并保持竞争力。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，但'免重训练'思路对实际部署有吸引力。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), where retraining is costly and domain shift is severe. It proposes a retraining-free mixture of DETR and vision foundation models (VFMs) to adapt to novel domains with few examples. Compared with retraining-based CD-FSOD methods, it reduces adaptation cost while maintaining competitive performance, though specific benchmark results are not reported in the abstract.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的DETR+VFM混合方案对跨域少样本检测的落地部署有实用价值。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的DETR与视觉基础模型混合框架用于跨域少样本目标检测。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.innovation: 利用VFM泛化能力实现免重训练的跨域少样本适配。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.result: 在跨域少样本检测中降低适配成本并保持竞争力（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在预训练分布外的类别、任务与成像模态上泛化差的问题，本文提出Roboflow100-VL，一个包含100个多模态目标检测数据集的大规模基准，覆盖医学影像等VLM预训练中罕见的多样概念。作者在零样本、少样本、半监督与全监督四种设定下评测了GroundingDINO、Qwen2.5-VL等SOTA模型，发现它们在困难医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性。论文还分享了CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD竞赛的洞察，为VLM检测评测提供了统一平台。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of VLMs to out-of-distribution classes, tasks, and imaging modalities. It introduces Roboflow100-VL, a large-scale benchmark of 100 multi-modal object detection datasets covering concepts rarely seen in VLM pre-training. Evaluating state-of-the-art models such as GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL across zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised regimes, the authors find less than 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical datasets, underscoring the need for few-shot concept alignment, and further share insights from the CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD competition.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 大规模多域VLM检测基准，覆盖100个数据集与四种数据设定，对VLM检测评测与少样本对齐研究有重要参考价值。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建Roboflow100-VL多域多模态目标检测基准并系统评测SOTA VLM。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 覆盖预训练分布外概念与多数据设定的统一VLM检测评测平台。
2505.20612|v2.result: 揭示GroundingDINO、Qwen2.5-VL等在困难医学影像上零样本精度不足2%。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大词表目标检测中分类式检测器的两大缺陷——稀有正类梯度稀释与大量易负样本导致的难负梯度稀释，本文提出CQ-DINO，将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务。方法引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力自适应检索每张图top-K相关类别以缩减负空间，从而重平衡梯度分布并隐式挖掘难例。CQ-DINO还能在V3Det等结构化数据集上利用显式层级类别关系，或在COCO等通用数据集上通过自注意力学习隐式类别关联，在挑战性大词表设定下取得更优性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two limitations of classification-based detectors in vast-vocabulary object detection: positive gradient dilution for rare categories and hard negative gradient dilution from numerous easy negatives. It proposes CQ-DINO, which reformulates classification as a contrastive task between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided query selection retrieving top-K relevant categories via cross-attention to rebalance gradients and implicitly mine hard examples. CQ-DINO flexibly exploits explicit hierarchical category relations on structured datasets (e.g., V3Det) or learns implicit correlations via self-attention on generic datasets (e.g., COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging vast-vocabulary benchmarks.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度切入大词表检测，类别查询对比学习设计合理，对开放词表与长尾检测研究有借鉴意义。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出基于类别查询对比学习的CQ-DINO框架用于大词表目标检测。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 将分类重构为物体查询与类别查询的对比任务，并用图像引导查询选择重平衡梯度。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在挑战性大词表检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，本文提出OpenAD，首个面向3D目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。OpenAD基于结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的corner case发现与标注流水线，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的2000个场景中以统一格式标注corner case物体，并设计评测方法对多种开放世界与专用2D/3D模型进行评估。作者还提出视觉中心的3D开放世界检测基线，并引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题，同时举办EvalAI在线挑战赛。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of comprehensive open-world 3D perception benchmarks and robust generalizable methods. It introduces OpenAD, the first real open-world autonomous driving benchmark for 3D object detection, built on a corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline integrating a multimodal large language model (MLLM). The pipeline annotates corner-case objects in a unified format across five autonomous driving datasets with 2000 scenarios, and the authors devise evaluation methodologies, propose a vision-centric 3D open-world detection baseline, and introduce an ensemble method fusing general and specialized models to mitigate the low precision of existing open-world methods, hosting an online challenge on EvalAI.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: 首个真实开放世界3D检测自动驾驶基准，含MLLM标注流水线与集成基线，对开放世界3D感知研究具有重要推动意义。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建OpenAD开放世界自动驾驶3D检测基准并提出视觉中心基线与集成方法。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 用MLLM驱动的corner case发现与标注流水线统一五个数据集的2000个场景。
2411.17761|v2.result: 提供统一评测基准并通过通用与专用模型集成缓解开放世界方法精度偏低问题。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对X射线安检图像中物品重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合问题，本文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制，用于基于Deformable DETR的违禁品检测器。方法将分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，以修正和补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而增强模型对前景特征的敏感度。为此设计了CSP损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失与类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失，其中ITA用类别原型吸引类内内容查询并通过梯度截断保留类内多样性，IAR按原型间相似度自适应排斥类间查询，性能优于经典对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses foreground-background feature coupling caused by overlapping objects in X-ray images, which degrades general detectors designed for natural images. It proposes a Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) mechanism for Deformable DETR-based prohibited item detectors, aligning class prototypes perceived by the classifier with content queries to correct and supplement missing semantic information for classification. The designed CSP loss comprises an Intra-Class Truncated Attraction (ITA) loss and an Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion (IAR) loss, outperforming classic contrastive losses.

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型的后门攻击问题，提出了测试时后门检测方法TRACE。方法基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，而干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高。TRACE通过前景和背景变换评估变换一致性来检测中毒样本。相比现有防御，TRACE能有效检测复杂攻击效果如幽灵物体或消失物体。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses backdoor attacks in object detection models by proposing TRACE, a test-time backdoor detection method. Based on two observations: poisoned samples show more consistent detection across backgrounds, while clean samples show higher consistency with different focal information. TRACE applies foreground and background transformations and assesses transformation consistency to detect poisoned samples. Compared to existing defenses, TRACE effectively detects complex attack effects like ghost or vanishing objects.

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督旋转目标检测问题，提出了Point2RBox-v2方法。方法基于三个原则：高斯重叠损失、Voronoi分水岭损失和一致性损失，并辅以边缘损失和复制粘贴等技术。相比已有工作，Point2RBox-v2首次探索了实例间空间布局用于点监督旋转目标检测。在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%的性能。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point-supervised oriented object detection by proposing Point2RBox-v2. The method is based on three principles: Gaussian overlap loss, Voronoi watershed loss, and consistency loss, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. Compared to existing work, Point2RBox-v2 is the first to explore spatial layout among instances for point-supervised oriented object detection, achieving 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 该工作为点监督旋转目标检测提供了新思路，性能优越，值得关注。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer框架将3D体素序列化为1D序列时破坏空间结构、且因体素数量庞大需分组导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出UniMamba，将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式统一，兼顾局部与全局空间上下文聚合。其核心UniMamba块包含空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器，其中空间局部性模块用3D子流形卷积捕获动态空间结构。相比Transformer方法，该方法在保持线性复杂度的同时避免了序列化造成的结构破坏并扩大了有效感受野。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the destruction of 3D spatial structure and limited receptive field caused by serializing voxels into 1D sequences in Transformer-based LiDAR 3D detection. It proposes UniMamba, which unifies 3D convolution and state space models in a multi-head manner, comprising spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator. Compared with Transformer-based methods, it achieves efficient local and global context aggregation with linear complexity while preserving spatial structure.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是当前热点方向，统一空间-通道建模思路清晰，对BEV/3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出统一Mamba架构UniMamba，以多头方式融合3D卷积与SSM实现局部-全局空间上下文聚合。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 设计互补Z-order序列化与局部-全局序列聚合器，在保持线性复杂度的同时避免体素序列化导致的空间结构破坏。
2503.12009|v2.result: 在LiDAR 3D检测上以线性复杂度实现高效局部与全局上下文聚合，缓解了Transformer的感受野受限问题。

Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.summary_cn: 本文针对事件相机（Event Camera）目标检测中稀疏异步事件流难以高效处理的问题，提出一种结合空间与时间注意力的混合神经网络。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过混合架构融合事件的空间分布与时间动态信息以提升检测效率。相比纯CNN或纯SNN方案，该工作强调在边缘场景下的高效性与时空注意力建模。
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.summary_en: This paper targets efficient event-based object detection, where sparse asynchronous event streams are difficult to process. 2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据长尾分布导致稀有类别检测性能差的问题，现有重加权与重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布信息。本文提出FRACAL（Fractal Calibration），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中分布的均匀程度，并在推理时据此反向降低均匀分布类别预测的概率，从而在频繁/稀有类别与均匀/稀疏分布类别两个维度上实现平衡。该方法可与单阶段sigmoid检测器和两阶段实例分割模型等现成模型结合，显著提升稀有类别性能。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-tailed object detection where rare categories suffer from imbalanced distributions. It proposes FRACAL, a training-free post-calibration method that uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space, and inversely downweights probabilities of uniformly spaced class predictions during inference. FRACAL balances frequent vs. rare and uniformly vs. sparsely spaced classes, and can be combined with off-the-shelf one-stage and two-stage detectors to boost rare-class performance.
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布而非仅频率统计角度解决长尾问题视角新颖，且为免训练后处理，易于集成到现有检测器中，实用性强。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出基于分形维数的免训练后校准方法FRACAL用于长尾目标检测。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次利用分形维数刻画类别在图像空间中的分布均匀性，并在推理阶段进行logit调整。
2410.11774|v2.result: 可即插即用地提升稀有类别性能，兼容单阶段sigmoid检测器与两阶段实例分割模型。

Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.summary_en: This paper tackles the detection of unobserved objects that are occluded or outside the field of view, which conventional detectors cannot handle. 2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 与相机等固定帧率传感器，受其延迟与带宽限制，难以在帧间间隔内实现高速、低延迟检测。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，在同步数据不可用的帧间时刻通过事件相机检索历史 3D 信息完成检测。作者还构建了首个基于事件的 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 真值框，建立了事件 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作为突破固定帧率传感器的时间边界提供了新范式与评测平台。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detectors rely on fixed-frame-rate sensors such as LiDAR and cameras, whose latency and bandwidth constraints prevent high-speed, low-latency detection during inter-frame intervals. This paper is the first to introduce asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection, exploiting their high temporal resolution and low bandwidth to retrieve previous 3D information and detect objects even when synchronized data is unavailable. The authors further release DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D detection dataset with ground-truth 3D boxes at 100 FPS, establishing the first benchmark for event-based 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机用于 3D 检测并配套发布 100 FPS 真值数据集，为突破固定帧率传感器的时间边界提供了新范式与评测基准，值得关注。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，并发布首个事件 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD（100 FPS 3D 真值框）。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，在帧间间隔内通过事件检索历史 3D 信息实现高速检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 建立了事件 3D 检测的首个基准，使检测可在同步数据缺失的帧间时刻进行，代码与数据集已开源。

IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体视觉3D目标检测中深度估计与实例感知耦合不足的问题，提出IDA-3D方法，将实例级深度信息引入3D检测流程。方法通过实例深度感知模块增强立体匹配的鲁棒性，并联合优化深度估计与3D框回归。相比已有立体3D检测方法，改进在于显式利用实例掩码引导深度预测，减少背景干扰。在KITTI数据集上取得了有竞争力的精度，但摘要未提供具体数值。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo-based 3D object detection by proposing IDA-3D, which incorporates instance-depth-aware features into the detection pipeline. The method enhances stereo matching robustness via instance-level depth guidance and jointly optimizes depth estimation and 3D box regression. It improves over prior stereo 3D detectors by explicitly leveraging instance masks to reduce background interference, achieving competitive accuracy on KITTI though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.assessment: 该工作将实例分割与深度估计结合用于立体3D检测，思路合理，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，影响力有限。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.contribution: 提出实例深度感知的立体3D检测框架IDA-3D。

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对纯点云3D检测缺乏颜色和纹理信息的问题，提出ImVoteNet，在VoteNet基础上融合2D图像投票与3D点云投票。方法从图像中提取几何和语义特征，利用相机参数将2D投票提升到3D空间，并设计多塔训练方案增强2D-3D特征融合。在SUN RGB-D数据集上，mAP相比之前最优方法提升5.7，验证了图像信息对点云检测的有效补充。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of point-cloud-only 3D detection by proposing ImVoteNet, which fuses 2D image votes with 3D point cloud votes on top of VoteNet. It extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and introduces a multi-tower training scheme for better 2D-3D fusion. On SUN RGB-D, it advances state-of-the-art by 5.7 mAP, demonstrating the complementary value of image information.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: 该工作有效融合RGB与点云信息，在室内3D检测上取得显著提升，多塔训练策略具有借鉴意义。
2001.10692|v2.contribution: 提出融合2D图像投票与3D点云投票的ImVoteNet检测框架。
2001.10692|v2.innovation: 显式提取图像几何与语义特征并提升至3D，结合多塔训练增强融合。
2001.10692|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D上mAP提升5.7，达到当时最优。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对伪LiDAR（PL）流程中深度估计与3D检测网络需分开训练的问题，提出可微分的Change of Representation（CoR）模块，实现端到端训练。方法将2D深度图转换为3D点云的过程变为可微，使整个PL管道可联合优化，兼容多种深度估计和检测网络。结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时最高成绩，显著缩小了与LiDAR方法的差距。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate training of depth estimation and 3D detection networks in the pseudo-LiDAR pipeline by introducing differentiable Change of Representation (CoR) modules for end-to-end training. The approach makes the 2D-to-3D conversion differentiable, enabling joint optimization and compatibility with various networks. Combined with PointRCNN, it achieved the top entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time, narrowing the gap with LiDAR methods.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 端到端可微的伪LiDAR框架解决了训练分离问题，在KITTI上取得领先结果，对低成本自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出可微分CoR模块实现伪LiDAR端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 将2D深度图到3D点云的转换过程设计为可微，支持联合优化。
2004.03080|v2.result: 结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测排行榜上取得当时第一。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中体素CNN与PointNet各自局限的问题，提出PV-RCNN框架，深度融合体素CNN和基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法通过体素集合抽象模块将场景压缩为关键点，并设计RoI-grid池化从关键点提取多感受野的提案特征。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上均取得领先精度，显著优于纯体素或纯点方法，成为3D检测的经典基线。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of voxel CNNs and PointNet in point cloud 3D detection by proposing PV-RCNN, which deeply integrates both. It summarizes the scene into keypoints via voxel set abstraction and introduces RoI-grid pooling to extract multi-receptive-field proposal features. Extensive experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open show leading accuracy, establishing PV-RCNN as a classic baseline in 3D detection.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是3D检测领域的里程碑工作，融合体素与点特征的思想影响深远，实验充分且性能卓越。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出深度融合体素CNN与PointNet的PV-RCNN 3D检测框架。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 体素集合抽象生成关键点，RoI-grid池化提取丰富上下文特征。
1912.13192|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open上均取得领先精度，成为经典基线。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D检测中如何有效建模点间关系的问题，提出Point-GNN，将点云编码为固定半径近邻图并用图神经网络检测目标。方法设计自动配准机制减少平移方差，并引入框合并与评分操作准确融合多顶点检测。在KITTI基准上仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越融合方法，展示了图神经网络在3D检测中的潜力。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses relational modeling in point cloud 3D detection by proposing Point-GNN, which encodes the point cloud as a fixed-radius near-neighbor graph and uses a graph neural network to predict object category and shape per vertex. It introduces an auto-registration mechanism to reduce translation variance and a box merging and scoring operation for accurate fusion. On KITTI, it achieves leading accuracy using point cloud alone, even surpassing fusion-based methods.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: Point-GNN将图神经网络引入3D检测，思路新颖，仅用点云即超越融合方法，具有启发性。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络的Point-GNN点云3D检测方法。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 固定半径近邻图编码、自动配准机制及框合并评分操作。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云达到领先精度，超越部分融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体图像3D检测中全图视差估计代价高且未利用类别先验的问题，提出Disp R-CNN，设计实例视差估计网络iDispNet仅预测目标像素的视差并学习类别特定形状先验。方法利用统计形状模型生成密集视差伪真值，无需LiDAR点云即可训练。在KITTI上，即使训练时无LiDAR真值，平均精度仍超越之前最优方法20%，且性能具有竞争力。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly full-image disparity estimation and lack of category priors in stereo 3D detection by proposing Disp R-CNN, which uses an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) to predict disparity only for object pixels and learn category-specific shape priors. It generates dense disparity pseudo-ground-truth via a statistical shape model, removing the need for LiDAR at training. On KITTI, it outperforms prior state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision even without LiDAR ground-truth.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: Disp R-CNN通过实例级视差估计和形状先验，在无LiDAR训练下取得显著提升，对低成本立体3D检测有重要参考价值。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出实例视差估计网络iDispNet及形状先验引导的立体3D检测系统Disp R-CNN。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 仅预测目标像素视差并利用统计形状模型生成伪真值，无需LiDAR训练。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越之前最优方法20%，且无需LiDAR真值。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: ①针对相机与激光雷达融合方法在主流基准上反而落后于纯激光雷达方法的问题，本文提出PointPainting顺序融合方法。②将激光雷达点投影到图像语义分割网络输出上，把类别分数附加到每个点上，形成"涂色"点云，可输入任意纯激光雷达检测器。③相比已有融合方法，该方法无需修改检测器结构，在PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars三种方法上均取得大幅提升。④在KITTI和nuScenes上验证，PointRCNN涂色版在KITTI鸟瞰图检测任务上刷新SOTA，并通过流水线设计最小化延迟。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap where lidar-only methods outperform fusion methods on major benchmarks by proposing PointPainting, a sequential fusion approach. It projects lidar points into the output of an image-only semantic segmentation network and appends class scores to each point, producing a painted point cloud that can be fed to any lidar-only detector. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show large improvements on PointRCNN, VoxelNet, and PointPillars, with the painted PointRCNN achieving a new state of the art on the KITTI bird's-eye view detection leaderboard.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的融合策略显著提升多种激光雷达检测器性能，是传感器融合领域的经典之作，值得关注。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出PointPainting顺序融合方法，将语义分割分数附加到激光雷达点云上以增强任意纯激光雷达检测器。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 通过将图像语义分割输出投影到点云并"涂色"，实现无需修改检测器结构的通用融合。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上大幅提升PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars性能，PointRCNN涂色版在KITTI BEV检测任务上达到SOTA。

2003.00186|v2.summary_cn: ①针对激光雷达3D目标检测中体素特征编码效率与精度平衡的问题，本文提出HVNet混合体素网络。②由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推测其采用混合体素表示进行特征编码。③相比已有工作，可能改进了体素化策略以提升检测性能。④摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
2003.00186|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes HVNet, a hybrid voxel network for LiDAR-based 3D object detection, addressing the trade-off between efficiency and accuracy in voxel feature encoding. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be confirmed.
2003.00186|v2.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法全面评估其方法与效果，但混合体素思路在3D检测中具有一定探索价值。
2003.00186|v2.contribution: 提出HVNet混合体素网络用于激光雷达3D目标检测。
2003.00186|v2.innovation: 采用混合体素表示进行特征编码（具体细节因摘要缺失无法确认）。
2003.00186|v2.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有激光雷达3D检测器仅关注单帧检测、忽略连续点云帧时空信息的问题，本文提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器。②模型包含空间特征编码和时空特征聚合两部分：PMPNet通过迭代消息传递自适应聚合柱节点邻域信息以扩大感受野；AST-GRU通过注意力记忆门控增强ConvGRU，含STA和TTA模块分别强调前景物体和对齐动态物体。③相比单帧检测方法，有效利用了时空信息。④实验表明该3D视频检测器取得了有竞争力的结果（摘要截断，具体数据未完整给出）。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an end-to-end online 3D video object detector operating on point cloud sequences to exploit spatiotemporal information ignored by single-frame detectors. It comprises a Pillar Message Passing Network (PMPNet) for spatial encoding and an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU (AST-GRU) with Spatial and Temporal Transformer Attention modules for aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate competitive performance.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 将视频目标检测思想引入激光雷达3D检测，PMPNet与AST-GRU设计合理，对时序点云感知有参考价值。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含PMPNet空间编码和AST-GRU时空聚合。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 结合柱消息传递与注意力时空Transformer GRU，实现前景强调和动态物体对齐。
2004.01389|v2.result: 实验表明该3D视频检测器取得有竞争力的性能（摘要截断，具体数据未完整给出）。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测依赖大规模高质量标注、标注成本高昂的问题，本文提出SESS自集成半监督3D目标检测框架。②设计了全面的扰动方案增强网络在无标签和新数据上的泛化能力，并提出三种一致性损失强制两组3D候选框预测之间的一致性，以学习物体的结构和语义不变性。③相比已有工作，首次在3D检测中系统探索半监督学习。④在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上验证，仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy reliance on large-scale 3D annotations by proposing SESS, a self-ensembling semi-supervised 3D object detection framework. It designs a thorough perturbation scheme and three consistency losses to enforce consistency between two sets of predicted 3D proposals. Experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScanNet show that SESS with only 50% labeled data achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 首次系统探索半监督3D检测，方法设计完整，50%标注达到全监督水平具有实用价值。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出SESS自集成半监督3D目标检测框架，通过扰动方案和一致性损失利用无标签数据。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 将自集成半监督学习引入3D检测，设计三种针对3D候选框的一致性损失。
1912.11803|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。

Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.summary_en: This paper proposes a joint approach for 3D instance segmentation and object detection for autonomous driving. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be confirmed.
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法全面评估，但3D实例分割与检测的联合建模在自动驾驶中具有研究意义。

1903.11027|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中缺乏包含完整传感器套件（相机、激光雷达、雷达）的大规模数据集的问题，本文提出nuScenes数据集。②该数据集包含6个相机、5个雷达和1个激光雷达，均具360度视场，共1000个场景，每个20秒，标注23类3D边界框和8种属性。③相比KITTI，标注量多7倍、图像多100倍，并定义了新的3D检测和跟踪指标。④提供了数据集分析以及激光雷达和图像检测与跟踪的基线，数据与开发工具包已公开。
1903.11027|v2.summary_en: This paper presents nuScenes, the first dataset to carry the full autonomous vehicle sensor suite of 6 cameras, 5 radars, and 1 lidar, all with 360-degree field of view. It comprises 1000 scenes of 20s each, fully annotated with 3D bounding boxes for 23 classes and 8 attributes, with 7x as many annotations and 100x as many images as KITTI. Novel 3D detection and tracking metrics are defined, along with dataset analysis and baselines.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: nuScenes已成为自动驾驶多模态感知领域的标杆数据集，极大推动了3D检测与跟踪研究，必读。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布nuScenes大规模多模态自动驾驶数据集，包含完整传感器套件和丰富3D标注。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 首个包含6相机、5雷达、1激光雷达全360度视场的大规模自动驾驶数据集，并定义新3D检测与跟踪指标。
1903.11027|v2.result: 提供1000个场景、23类3D标注，标注量为KITTI的7倍、图像为100倍，并给出检测与跟踪基线。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究缺乏大规模、多样化真实数据的问题，本文提出了 Waymo Open Dataset，包含 1150 个 20 秒场景，覆盖城市与郊区多种地理环境，提供同步标定的高质量 LiDAR 与相机数据，并带有跨帧一致的 2D/3D 边界框标注。相比当时最大的相机+LiDAR 数据集，其多样性指标提升 15 倍。论文还提供了 2D/3D 检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据规模与跨地理区域泛化对 3D 检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large-scale, diverse real-world data for autonomous driving perception, this paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized and calibrated LiDAR and camera data across urban and suburban geographies, annotated with consistent 2D/3D bounding boxes. It is 15x more diverse than the largest existing camera+LiDAR dataset under the proposed diversity metric. Strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking are provided, along with studies on dataset size and cross-geography generalization for 3D detection.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 该数据集是自动驾驶感知领域里程碑式的工作，为 3D 检测、跟踪和多模态研究提供了大规模高质量基准，至今仍被广泛使用。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、高多样性、多传感器同步且标注一致的 Waymo Open Dataset，并提供了检测与跟踪的强基线。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 提出了多样性度量指标，并系统研究了数据规模与跨地理区域泛化对 3D 检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集多样性比当时最大相机+LiDAR 数据集高 15 倍，为 2D/3D 检测与跟踪任务建立了可复现的强基线。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模环境的问题，本文提出 SurfelGAN，仅利用自动驾驶车辆采集的少量 LiDAR 与相机数据，通过纹理映射的 surfel 高效重建场景，保留物体 3D 几何、外观及场景条件信息。随后利用 SurfelGAN 网络为自车与运动物体的新位姿合成逼真的相机图像。该方法无需游戏引擎和人工建模，即可生成多样化的传感器数据，提升了仿真的可扩展性与真实感。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: To address the limited realism and scalability of sensor simulation in autonomous driving, this paper proposes SurfelGAN, which reconstructs scenes from a limited amount of collected LiDAR and camera data using texture-mapped surfels that preserve 3D geometry, appearance, and scene conditions. A SurfelGAN network then synthesizes realistic camera images for novel vehicle and object poses. The approach avoids game engines and manual asset creation, enabling scalable and realistic sensor data generation.
2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真数据生成提供了轻量且有效的方案，对数据增强和闭环仿真研究有较高参考价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出基于纹理映射 surfel 与 SurfelGAN 的传感器数据合成方法，仅需少量真实采集数据即可生成逼真新视角图像。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 将 surfel 场景重建与 GAN 图像合成结合，摆脱对游戏引擎和人工建模的依赖。
2005.03844|v2.result: 在无需额外人工建模的情况下，为自车和运动物体新位姿生成了逼真的相机图像，验证了方法的有效性。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中 3D 动作识别的问题，本文提出 3D 动态体素（3DV）表示，通过时间秩池化将深度视频中的 3D 运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素集合，每个体素同时包含空间与运动特征。将 3DV 抽象为点集后输入 PointNet++ 进行端到端识别，并采用多流方式联合学习运动与外观特征，同时将深度视频划分为时间片段以编码更丰富的时间顺序信息。在 4 个基准数据集上取得优异结果，NTU RGB+D 120 跨被试和跨设置测试准确率分别达 82.4% 和 93.5%。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: For depth-based 3D action recognition, this paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), a compact representation that encodes 3D motion information via temporal rank pooling into a regular voxel set, with each voxel jointly capturing spatial and motion features. 3DV is abstracted as a point set and fed into PointNet++ for end-to-end recognition, with a multi-stream design to jointly learn motion and appearance features and temporal splits for richer temporal order. Experiments on four benchmarks achieve 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120 cross-subject and cross-setup settings.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要贡献在深度视频动作识别，但其体素化与点云处理思路对 3D 表示学习有一定借鉴意义。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出 3DV 动态体素表示及基于 PointNet++ 的多流 3D 动作识别框架。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 通过时间秩池化将深度视频运动信息编码为规则体素集合，并转化为点集进行端到端学习。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在 NTU RGB+D 120 上跨被试和跨设置准确率分别达到 82.4% 和 93.5%，在 4 个基准数据集上均表现优越。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对 3D 目标检测中锚框设计依赖先验且对物体尺度变化敏感的问题，本文提出 Object as Hotspots (OHS)，一种无锚框的 3D 检测方法。该方法将物体表示为热点集合，通过热点触发机制在点云中定位物体，避免了传统锚框的复杂调参。由于摘要信息有限，具体方法细节与实验数据未能完整获取，但该思路为无锚框 3D 检测提供了新视角。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: To address the reliance on anchor priors and sensitivity to object scale variation in 3D object detection, this paper proposes Object as Hotspots (OHS), an anchor-free 3D detection approach that represents objects as sets of hotspots and localizes them via hotspot firing, avoiding complex anchor tuning. Due to limited abstract information, detailed methodology and experimental results are not fully available, but the idea offers a new perspective for anchor-free 3D detection.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 该工作提出了无锚框 3D 检测的新思路，对点云目标检测研究有潜在启发，但摘要信息不足，需进一步阅读全文评估。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出 Object as Hotspots 无锚框 3D 检测框架，将物体建模为热点集合进行定位。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 以热点触发机制替代传统锚框，避免锚框先验和尺度敏感问题。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需参考全文验证。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不明的问题，系统性地将误差分解为深度估计误差、2D框误差和3D框回归误差等成分。作者通过大量消融实验量化了各误差源对最终3D定位精度的影响，并据此提出针对性的改进策略。相比已有工作笼统归因于深度估计不准，本文揭示了2D检测框质量对3D定位的关键影响。在KITTI基准上验证了误差分解的有效性，显著提升了单目3D检测的定位精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically decomposes localization errors in monocular 3D object detection into depth estimation, 2D bounding box, and 3D box regression components. Through extensive ablations, the authors quantify each error source's impact and propose targeted improvements. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate significant localization accuracy gains over prior monocular methods.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 对单目3D检测误差来源的深入分析具有重要指导意义，为后续方法设计提供了明确方向。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 首次系统性地分解并量化了单目3D检测中各定位误差源的贡献。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 将3D定位误差归因到2D检测和深度估计等子模块，并提出针对性优化策略。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI基准上通过误差分解指导的改进显著提升了单目3D定位精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段3D目标检测中体素表示丢失细粒度信息、点表示计算效率低的问题，提出了混合体素-点表示（HVPR）。方法通过将体素特征与原始点特征进行有效融合，在保持单阶段检测器高效性的同时恢复了局部几何细节。相比纯体素或纯点的方法，HVPR在精度和效率之间取得了更好的平衡。在KITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in voxel representations and inefficiency of point-based methods for single-stage 3D detection by proposing a Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation (HVPR). The method fuses voxel features with raw point features to recover fine-grained geometry while maintaining efficiency. It achieves competitive performance on KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: 混合表示思路在单阶段3D检测中具有实用价值，兼顾了精度与效率。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出了一种融合体素与点特征的混合表示方法用于单阶段3D目标检测。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 通过体素-点混合表示在单阶段框架下同时保留全局语义和局部几何信息。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得了优于纯体素或纯点方法的检测性能。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云目标检测中局部特征提取不足的问题，提出了Pointformer模块，将Transformer的自注意力机制引入点云处理。方法通过局部和全局注意力模块捕获点之间的长距离依赖关系，增强了点云特征的表达能力。相比基于稀疏卷积或PointNet++的方法，Pointformer能更有效地建模点云中的上下文关系。在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等3D检测基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Pointformer, which introduces Transformer self-attention into point cloud processing for 3D object detection. Local and global attention modules capture long-range dependencies among points, enhancing feature representation. It achieves significant gains on ScanNet and SUN RGB-D benchmarks over sparse convolution and PointNet++ based methods.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: 将Transformer引入3D点云检测是重要方向，Pointformer为后续点云注意力方法奠定了基础。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的Pointformer模块用于3D点云目标检测。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 设计局部-全局注意力机制有效建模点云中的长距离上下文依赖。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上取得了显著的3D检测性能提升。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线3D感知场景（如自动标注）中现有在线检测器无法满足高质量需求的问题，提出了利用点云序列的离线3D检测流水线。方法通过多帧目标检测和以目标为中心的精细化模型，充分利用不同帧对物体的互补视角信息。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该流水线（3D Auto Labeling）显著优于最先进的在线检测器和离线基线，性能甚至与人类标注相当。进一步实验验证了自动标注在半监督学习中的应用价值。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored offboard 3D perception scenario by proposing a point cloud sequence-based offboard detection pipeline. It leverages multi-frame detection and object-centric refinement to exploit complementary views across frames. On Waymo Open Dataset, the pipeline significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors and achieves performance on par with human labels.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 离线3D检测与自动标注是极具实用价值的方向，该工作系统且实验充分，对数据闭环意义重大。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出了利用点云序列进行高质量离线3D检测与自动标注的完整流水线。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 通过多帧检测和目标中心精细化模型充分利用时序互补信息实现高质量标注。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上性能与人类标注相当，并验证了自动标注用于半监督学习的有效性。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的核心问题，提出了分类深度分布网络（CaDDN）。方法对每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间中合适的深度区间，再通过高效的BEV投影和单阶段检测器输出最终3D框。CaDDN是端到端可微的联合深度估计与目标检测框架。在KITTI 3D基准上排名单目方法第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the depth inaccuracy bottleneck in monocular 3D detection by proposing the Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN). It predicts a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into appropriate depth intervals in 3D space, followed by efficient BEV projection and a single-stage detector. CaDDN ranks 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and provides the first monocular 3D results on Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: CaDDN是单目3D检测的经典工作，分类深度分布思路优雅且有效，BEV投影设计对后续研究影响深远。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出了基于分类深度分布的端到端单目3D检测网络CaDDN。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 用逐像素分类深度分布替代直接深度回归，实现更准确的3D空间特征投影。
2103.01100|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测中排名第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上报告单目3D检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出了Range Sparse Net（RSN）。方法利用距离图像中前景稀疏的特性，设计稀疏卷积操作聚焦于有目标的区域，减少背景计算浪费。相比在完整距离图像上密集计算的方法，RSN在保持高精度的同时大幅提升了推理速度。在大规模LiDAR检测基准上实现了高效且准确的3D检测性能。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in LiDAR 3D object detection by proposing Range Sparse Net (RSN). It exploits the sparsity of foreground objects in range images and designs sparse convolutions to focus computation on object regions. RSN achieves high accuracy with significantly improved inference speed on large-scale LiDAR benchmarks.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: RSN在LiDAR检测效率优化方面思路清晰，对实际部署有较强参考价值。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出了利用距离图像稀疏性的高效LiDAR 3D检测网络RSN。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 通过距离稀疏卷积将计算集中在目标区域，大幅减少背景冗余计算。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在大规模LiDAR基准上实现了高效且准确的3D目标检测。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测这一此前几乎空白的问题，论文指出仅依赖2D图像外观得到的物体边界模糊不可靠，且类别分布呈长尾开放形态。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选物体分割，再通过迭代式分割标注流程为分割分配标签并训练融合2D图像与3D点云特征的分割标注网络，标注流程专门设计以缓解长尾与开放类别分布问题，最终将分割标签作为伪标注用于目标检测。相比纯2D外观方法，3D结构显著缓解了定位歧义，是首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测方法。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the previously unaddressed problem of unsupervised object detection, where 2D appearance alone yields ambiguous and unreliable object boundaries. It exploits LiDAR 3D scene structure to generate candidate object segments and applies an iterative segment labeling process that trains a labeling network on fused 2D image and 3D point cloud features, explicitly handling long-tailed and open-ended category distributions. The resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection, substantially mitigating localization ambiguity compared with 2D-only approaches.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将LiDAR 3D结构引入无监督目标检测，思路新颖且对开放类别场景有实际价值，值得关注。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 提出首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测方法。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用3D场景结构生成候选分割并设计抗长尾开放分布的迭代标注流程。
2011.12953|v2.result: 有效缓解了2D外观导致的定位歧义，实现无监督目标检测的伪标注生成。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，该论文针对3D目标检测中跨模态信息融合不足的问题，提出PointAugmenting跨模态增强方法。其核心思路应是将图像特征增强/投影到点云表示中，以提升3D检测性能。相比纯点云或纯图像方法，跨模态增强有望在稀疏点云场景下提供更丰富的语义线索。具体方法与实验数据因摘要缺失无法评估。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: Based on the title alone (the abstract is missing), this work targets cross-modal augmentation for 3D object detection, presumably enriching point cloud representations with image features. It aims to improve detection accuracy over single-modality baselines by leveraging complementary image semantics. Method details and quantitative results cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态增强是3D检测的重要方向，但缺少摘要无法判断其具体贡献与实验充分度，需查阅原文。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出面向3D目标检测的跨模态增强方案。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 将图像模态信息用于增强点云3D检测表示。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度先验不准确、上下文与深度信息融合不足的问题，论文提出深度条件动态消息传播网络（DDMP），避免使用复杂的伪LiDAR方案。方法首先在图像上下文中自适应采样上下文感知节点，再动态预测依赖深度的混合滤波权重与亲和矩阵进行信息传播，并引入中心感知深度编码（CDE）任务以缓解深度先验误差。在KITTI基准上取得单目方法中的最优结果，并在2020年11月16日提交日位列KITTI单目3D检测榜单第一。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles monocular 3D object detection by learning context- and depth-aware representations without resorting to pseudo-LiDAR pipelines. It proposes a depth-conditioned dynamic message propagation (DDMP) network that adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices, augmented by a center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task to alleviate inaccurate depth priors. It achieves state-of-the-art monocular results on KITTI and ranked 1st on the KITTI monocular 3D detection leaderboard on its submission date.
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 以动态消息传播替代伪LiDAR路线，在KITTI单目榜单登顶，方法设计扎实，对单目3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出深度条件动态消息传播网络及中心感知深度编码任务。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 动态预测深度相关滤波权重与亲和矩阵进行上下文传播。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测上取得SOTA并登顶榜单第一。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，论文提出ST3D自训练流水线。方法先在源域用随机物体缩放策略预训练检测器以缓解源域偏差，再在目标域交替执行两步迭代：基于质量感知三元组记忆库的伪标签更新，以及课程式数据增强的模型训练，从而获得一致且高质量的伪标签并避免对大量简单样本过拟合。在所有评测数据集上达到SOTA，并在KITTI 3D检测基准上超越全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for point-cloud 3D object detection with a self-training pipeline, ST3D. It pre-trains on the source domain using random object scaling to mitigate source bias, then iteratively updates pseudo labels via a quality-aware triplet memory bank and trains with curriculum data augmentation on the target domain, yielding consistent high-quality pseudo labels while avoiding overfitting to easy examples. ST3D achieves state-of-the-art results on all evaluated datasets and even surpasses fully supervised performance on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 域适应3D检测的强基线工作，随机物体缩放与质量感知记忆库设计实用，超越全监督的结果颇具说服力。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云3D检测的无监督域适应自训练流水线ST3D。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 质量感知三元组记忆库与课程式数据增强的迭代伪标签更新。
2103.05346|v2.result: 所有评测数据集达SOTA，KITTI上超越全监督结果。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D检测方法多依赖单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，论文提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络。方法先用快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及其特征图存入记忆库，再设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，通过注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，有效融合来自场景不同视角的信息。在Waymo Open Dataset上相比已发表的单帧与多帧方法均取得SOTA。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of multi-frame information in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network. A fast single-frame detector first produces box proposals, which along with their feature maps are stored in a memory bank; a multi-view alignment and aggregation module then uses attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features across perspectives. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the large-scale Waymo Open Dataset compared with published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 记忆库加注意力聚合的多帧范式在Waymo上验证有效，对时序3D检测与自动驾驶感知有直接参考价值。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出基于记忆库与注意力的3D多帧检测网络3D-MAN。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 多视角对齐聚合模块通过注意力融合记忆库中的时序特征。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上超越已发表单帧与多帧方法。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，该论文提出基于中心点的3D目标检测与跟踪框架，将检测与跟踪统一到中心点表示范式下。其思路应是以物体中心点作为检测与跟踪的共享表示，避免传统锚框或角点方法在3D场景中的复杂性，并自然衔接检测与跟踪任务。具体方法与实验数据因摘要缺失无法评估。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: Based on the title alone (the abstract is missing), this work proposes a center-based paradigm for joint 3D object detection and tracking, presumably using object centers as a unified representation to simplify anchor- or corner-based pipelines and to bridge detection and tracking. Method details and quantitative results cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: 中心点范式在3D检测与跟踪统一方面具有影响力，但缺少摘要无法评估其具体贡献，建议查阅原文。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出基于中心点的3D目标检测与跟踪统一框架。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 以物体中心点作为检测与跟踪的共享表示。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 因摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中因传感器配置、场景分布差异导致的域偏移问题，提出尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN。方法通过尺度感知模块对齐不同距离目标的特征分布，并利用距离感知机制缓解点云稀疏性带来的域间差异。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN同时考虑了目标尺度变化和距离因素对特征分布的影响。在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得了优于现有域适应方法的性能，显著提升了模型在新数据集上的泛化能力。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain shift problem in cross-dataset 3D object detection caused by differences in sensor configurations and scene distributions. It proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that aligns feature distributions across domains by explicitly modeling object scale and range. Compared with existing domain adaptation methods, SRDAN achieves superior cross-dataset generalization performance on 3D detection benchmarks.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 该工作针对跨数据集3D检测的实际部署痛点提出系统性域适应方案，对自动驾驶感知的落地有较强参考价值。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了尺度感知与距离感知相结合的域适应网络，有效缓解跨数据集3D检测中的域偏移。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 首次在3D检测域适应中同时显式建模目标尺度和距离对特征分布的影响。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得优于现有域适应方法的性能，显著提升泛化能力。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中相机外参扰动（如路面颠簸、坡度变化导致的自车姿态变化）导致检测器性能下降的问题，提出了一种对外参变化鲁棒的单目3D检测方法。该方法通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计了一个转换器在隐空间中对扰动特征进行校正。与现有忽略相机位姿信息的方法不同，该框架使3D检测器不受外参变化影响，在坑洼和不平路面等现实场景中仍能产生准确结果。实验表明该方法在存在外参扰动的情况下取得了最佳性能，而几乎所有现有单目检测器在此类场景下均失效。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that monocular 3D detectors are highly susceptible to camera extrinsic perturbations caused by ego-car pose changes on uneven roads. It proposes a framework that predicts camera extrinsic parameters via vanishing point and horizon detection, and designs a converter to rectify perturbative features in the latent space. Experiments show the method achieves the best performance under extrinsic perturbations, where almost all existing monocular detectors fail.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了工业应用中常被忽视的相机外参扰动问题，提出的外参无关检测框架对单目3D检测的实际部署具有重要意义。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过预测相机外参并在隐空间校正特征来实现外参无关的单目3D检测框架。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 首次将消失点与地平线检测用于外参预测，并通过隐空间特征转换实现对外参扰动的鲁棒性。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在外参扰动场景下取得最佳性能，而现有单目检测器在坑洼和不平路面上几乎全部失效。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云3D检测中两阶段精炼器的通用性和效率问题，提出了一种高效通用的第二阶段检测器LiDAR R-CNN。方法采用基于点的方法而非体素方法以满足实时性和高精度需求，并发现并分析了PointNet类方法忽略候选框尺寸的固有问题，提出了多种解决方案。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI数据集上，基于多种主流检测器（如PointPillars变体）的实验证明了其通用性和优越性，以极小代价取得了新的state-of-the-art结果。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LiDAR R-CNN, a second-stage detector that can universally improve any existing 3D detector for LiDAR point clouds. It adopts a point-based approach and identifies an overlooked issue where PointNet-like methods ignore proposal sizes, proposing several remedies that yield significant performance gains. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI with various popular detectors demonstrate its universality and superiority, achieving new state-of-the-art results with minor cost.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 该工作提出的通用二阶段精炼器可即插即用地提升现有3D检测器性能，对自动驾驶感知系统的工程落地有直接价值。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了一个高效通用的LiDAR点云二阶段检测器，可显著提升任意现有3D检测器的精度。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了PointNet类方法在3D检测中忽略候选框尺寸的关键问题，提出多种有效补救方案。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI数据集上以极小代价取得新的state-of-the-art结果，验证了通用性和优越性。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云压缩中如何高效编码几何信息的问题，提出了基于八叉树的点云压缩框架VoxelContext-Net。方法利用体素上下文信息来建模点云的空间相关性，以实现更高效的压缩。相比已有方法，该框架在压缩率和重建质量之间取得了更好的平衡。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework for point cloud compression that leverages voxel context to model spatial correlations for efficient encoding. It achieves a better trade-off between compression rate and reconstruction quality compared with existing methods. Specific quantitative results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 该工作与3D检测领域相关度有限，但对点云数据处理和压缩有参考价值，可间接服务于自动驾驶感知系统。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树和体素上下文的点云压缩框架。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 利用体素上下文建模点云空间相关性以提升压缩效率。
2105.02158|v2.result: 在压缩率与重建质量之间取得优于已有方法的平衡。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 针对户外点云3D检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出了自集成单阶段检测器SE-SSD。方法包含一对教师和学生SSD，设计了基于IoU的匹配策略从教师中筛选软目标并制定一致性损失，同时设计了形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失以更好地利用硬目标。在KITTI基准上，SE-SSD在BEV和3D排行榜分别排名第1和第2，且推理速度极快，在所有已发表工作中达到顶级性能。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SE-SSD, a self-ensembling single-stage detector for accurate and efficient 3D object detection in outdoor point clouds. It employs a teacher-student SSD pair with IoU-based soft target matching, a consistency loss, shape-aware augmentation, and an ODIoU loss to jointly exploit soft and hard targets without extra inference cost. SE-SSD achieves top performance on the KITTI benchmark (ranked 1st on BEV and 2nd on 3D leaderboards) with ultra-high inference speed.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: 该工作通过自集成和知识蒸馏策略在单阶段检测器中实现了精度与速度的优异平衡，是3D检测领域的标杆性工作。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，通过软硬目标联合优化实现高精度高效率检测。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU匹配的软目标一致性损失、形状感知增强和ODIoU损失，在不增加推理计算的情况下显著提升性能。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI基准上BEV排名第1、3D排名第2，推理速度极快，达到顶级性能。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云运动估计中标注数据获取困难的问题，提出了一种自监督柱状运动学习框架，利用未标注点云和配对相机图像进行运动估计。方法通过点云结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化实现自监督学习。实验表明该方法性能与监督方法相当，且自监督模型与监督微调结合后取得了state-of-the-art结果。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of expensive annotation for point cloud motion estimation by proposing a self-supervised pillar motion learning framework that leverages unlabeled point clouds and paired camera images. The model employs structural consistency with probabilistic motion masking and cross-sensor motion regularization for self-supervision. Experiments show it performs competitively with supervised methods and achieves state-of-the-art results when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了利用大量未标注数据进行运动学习的可行性，对降低自动驾驶感知系统的标注成本具有重要意义。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了利用未标注点云和相机图像进行自监督运动学习的框架。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 设计了点云结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化三种自监督信号。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后取得state-of-the-art结果。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D感知中如何统一构建BEV表征以同时支持3D检测与地图分割的问题，本文提出BEVFormer框架，通过预定义的网格状BEV query在空间与时间维度上与图像特征交互。空间上设计spatial cross-attention让每个BEV query从多相机视图的感兴趣区域提取特征，时间上提出temporal self-attention递归融合历史BEV信息。相比此前方法，该框架统一了时空信息聚合，在nuScenes test集上取得56.9% NDS，比此前最佳提升9.0个点，并达到与LiDAR基线相当的性能，同时显著改善速度估计精度与低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning for multi-camera 3D perception, including 3D detection and map segmentation. BEVFormer employs grid-shaped BEV queries to interact with spatial and temporal space via spatial cross-attention (aggregating features from regions of interest across camera views) and temporal self-attention (recurrently fusing historical BEV features). It achieves a new state-of-the-art of 56.9% NDS on the nuScenes test set, 9.0 points above prior best methods and on par with LiDAR-based baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是BEV感知范式的奠基性工作之一，其时空Transformer设计被后续大量多相机3D检测工作沿用，值得作为该方向的核心参考。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出用时空Transformer从多相机图像学习统一BEV表征的通用框架，可同时支持3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 以网格状BEV query为核心，结合spatial cross-attention与temporal self-attention实现空间特征聚合与历史BEV信息递归融合。
2203.17270|v2.result: 在nuScenes test集取得56.9% NDS，较此前最佳提升9.0个点，性能与LiDAR基线相当。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中较少利用分割信息引导检测的问题，本文提出一个联合执行3D目标检测与全景分割的多任务框架。方法将Range-View特征图注入BEV平面的检测骨干以融合多视角信息，并引入前景语义信息突出各类目标位置，同时基于实例级信息生成中心密度热图以提示可能的框中心位置。该框架可即插即用地配合任意BEV-based 3D检测方法，在nuScenes数据集上取得显著性能提升。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: This paper targets LiDAR-based 3D object detection where segmentation cues are rarely exploited to guide detection. It proposes a multi-task framework jointly performing 3D detection and panoptic segmentation, injecting Range-View feature maps into the BEV detection backbone, incorporating foreground semantic information, and generating a center density heatmap from instance-level cues to guide box center localization. The method is compatible with any BEV-based detector and yields significant gains on nuScenes.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视角特征融合与分割引导检测的思路实用且通用，但整体属于增量式改进，创新性中等。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，用RV特征与分割信息引导BEV检测骨干。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 将Range-View特征注入BEV检测骨干，并利用实例级中心密度热图引导目标框中心定位。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上为多种BEV-based检测方法带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中多数方法将每个3D目标视为独立训练样本、忽略其固有几何关系的问题，本文提出将所有目标纳入考虑并挖掘相互关系的思路。方法利用更可靠的2D检测框作为引导，全局约束对应3D框的优化，为此提出可微的Homography Loss，同时利用2D与3D信息，通过全局约束平衡不同目标间的位置关系以获得更准确的3D框预测。该损失设计简洁通用，可插入任意成熟的单目3D检测器并显著提升其基线性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D detection where objects are typically treated as independent training samples, ignoring their inherent geometric relations. It proposes a differentiable Homography Loss that leverages reliable 2D boxes to globally constrain the optimization of predicted 3D boxes, exploiting both 2D and 3D information to balance positional relationships among objects. The loss is universal and can be plugged into any mature monocular 3D detector, significantly boosting baseline performance.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 从目标间几何关系与2D-3D全局约束角度切入单目3D检测，损失函数通用性强，思路简洁有效。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，利用2D框全局约束3D框优化并建模目标间几何关系。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 将场景中所有目标的相互关系纳入训练，通过2D-3D联合的全局约束提升3D框定位精度。
2204.00754|v2.result: 作为通用损失插入多种单目3D检测器后均显著超越其基线性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对降雪条件下LiDAR 3D目标检测训练数据难以采集与标注的问题，本文提出一种基于物理的降雪模拟方法，对真实晴天LiDAR点云施加降雪效应。方法对每条LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子，并利用其几何关系相应修改每条激光束的测量值，同时模拟降雪常导致的地面湿滑效应。利用生成的半合成雪天LiDAR数据训练3D检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴天基线与竞争模拟方法均取得一致且显著的性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles LiDAR-based 3D object detection under snowfall, where collecting and annotating training data is difficult. It proposes a physically based simulation that samples snow particles in 2D for each LiDAR line, modifies beam measurements via induced geometry, and simulates ground wetness. Training detectors on the resulting partially synthetic snowy data yields consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulation approaches.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 物理建模的恶劣天气LiDAR仿真对提升自动驾驶感知鲁棒性有实际价值，实验在真实雪天数据集上验证，说服力较强。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出基于物理的LiDAR降雪与地面湿滑模拟方法，用于生成半合成雪天数据训练鲁棒的3D检测器。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 按LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并据此修改每条光束测量，同时建模地面湿滑对点云的影响。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上，相比晴天基线与竞争模拟方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对点云3D目标检测中体素化方法的问题，提出Voxel Set Transformer，将3D检测建模为集合到集合（set-to-set）的预测问题。方法在体素集合上应用Transformer架构，通过自注意力建模体素间关系并直接输出目标集合，避免了传统体素方法中复杂的中间表示与后处理。该工作为点云3D检测提供了一种新的集合预测范式，在精度与效率之间取得良好平衡。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses voxel-based 3D object detection from point clouds by proposing Voxel Set Transformer, which formulates detection as a set-to-set prediction problem. It applies a Transformer architecture over voxel sets, modeling inter-voxel relations via self-attention and directly outputting object sets, avoiding complex intermediate representations and post-processing. The work offers a new set-prediction paradigm for point cloud 3D detection with a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将集合预测与Transformer引入体素化3D检测，范式新颖，对点云检测架构设计有参考价值。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以集合到集合的方式从体素直接预测3D目标。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 用Transformer自注意力在体素集合上建模关系并直接输出目标集合，简化检测流程。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在点云3D检测任务上实现了精度与效率的良好平衡。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对LiDAR点云3D目标检测中体素特征因点密度不均而表达不足的问题，提出点密度感知的体素方法。方法在体素化过程中显式建模每个体素内的点密度分布，使体素特征能够反映局部几何结构的疏密差异，从而更准确地描述目标形状。该设计可嵌入现有体素检测框架，在LiDAR 3D检测基准上提升了检测精度，尤其对远距离与稀疏区域目标效果更明显。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of voxel features in LiDAR 3D detection caused by non-uniform point density. It proposes point density-aware voxels that explicitly model the point density distribution within each voxel, enabling voxel features to reflect local geometric sparsity and better describe object shapes. The design integrates into existing voxel-based detection frameworks and improves detection accuracy on LiDAR benchmarks, especially for distant and sparse objects.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 点密度感知的体素特征设计针对LiDAR稀疏性这一核心痛点，思路直接有效，但属于局部改进。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出点密度感知的体素特征表示，显式建模体素内点密度分布以增强特征表达。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 将体素内点密度分布纳入特征编码，使体素特征反映局部几何疏密差异。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在LiDAR 3D检测基准上提升精度，对远距离与稀疏区域目标改善尤为明显。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 该论文研究多LiDAR传感器布局对自动驾驶3D目标检测性能的影响。作者通过在不同车辆位置配置多个LiDAR并采集数据，系统评估了传感器数量、位置和视角对检测精度的影响。相比已有工作多关注单LiDAR或固定布局，本文首次量化了多LiDAR布局的增益与冗余。实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection for autonomous driving. The authors systematically evaluate the impact of sensor number, position, and viewpoint by configuring multiple LiDARs at different vehicle locations. Unlike prior work focusing on single or fixed LiDAR setups, this work quantifies the gains and redundancy of multi-LiDAR layouts, showing that proper placement significantly improves detection performance.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 为多传感器配置提供了实证指导，对自动驾驶感知系统设计有参考价值。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 系统量化了多LiDAR布局对3D目标检测性能的影响。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 首次通过多位置LiDAR配置实验揭示布局与检测精度的关系。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 合理的多LiDAR布局能显著提升检测性能。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准且引入额外计算负担的问题，本文提出MonoDTR，一种端到端的深度感知Transformer网络。其核心包括深度感知特征增强模块（DFE）和深度感知Transformer模块（DTR），前者通过辅助监督隐式学习深度特征而不增加推理开销，后者全局融合上下文与深度特征；此外提出深度位置编码（DPE）替代传统像素位置编码。在KITTI数据集上，该方法超越了此前最优的单目方法，且模块可即插即用。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: To address inaccurate depth priors and extra computation in monocular 3D detection, this paper proposes MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer network. It consists of a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement (DFE) module that implicitly learns depth-aware features with auxiliary supervision without extra inference cost, and a Depth-Aware Transformer (DTR) module that globally integrates context and depth features. A novel depth positional encoding (DPE) is introduced. Experiments on KITTI show it outperforms previous state-of-the-art monocular methods, and the modules are plug-and-play.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: 方法设计巧妙，在不增加推理开销的前提下有效利用深度信息，对单目3D检测有重要推进。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR，实现隐式深度特征学习与全局融合。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 深度感知特征增强模块与深度位置编码，无需额外计算即可注入深度先验。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI上超越此前最优单目方法，且模块可即插即用。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的域泛化问题，提出3D-VField方法，通过对点云进行对抗性增强来提升模型在未见域上的泛化能力。作者设计了一种可变形点云生成策略，模拟不同传感器和场景下的点云分布变化。相比传统数据增强，该方法能更有效地缩小域间差距。实验表明在多个跨域基准上取得了显著的性能提升，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: This paper addresses domain generalization in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-VField, an adversarial augmentation method for point clouds. It generates deformable point clouds to simulate distribution shifts across sensors and scenes. Unlike conventional augmentation, this approach better bridges domain gaps. Experiments show significant improvements on multiple cross-domain benchmarks.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 为3D检测的域泛化提供了新颖的对抗增强思路，对实际部署有参考意义。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出对抗性点云增强方法3D-VField以提升3D检测的域泛化能力。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 利用可变形点云生成模拟域偏移，实现对抗性数据增强。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在多个跨域基准上取得显著性能提升。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与跟踪分离导致不确定性无法传递的问题，本文提出Time3D，首次实现仅用单目视频端到端联合训练3D检测与3D跟踪。核心是时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力聚合单帧空间信息、交叉注意力建模时序对象关联，并预测相似度分数以指导轨迹估计；同时提出时序一致性损失将3D目标运动建模融入学习。在KITTI等数据集上，该方法在检测和跟踪指标上均优于分离式方案。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: To address the disconnection between monocular 3D detection and tracking, this paper proposes Time3D, the first end-to-end joint training of 3D detection and 3D tracking from monocular videos. A spatial-temporal information flow module leverages transformer self-attention for intra-frame aggregation and cross-attention for inter-frame object affinity, predicting similarity scores to guide trajectory estimation. A temporal consistency loss explicitly models 3D motion. Experiments on KITTI show improvements in both detection and tracking over separate pipelines.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: 首次实现单目3D检测与跟踪的端到端联合优化，对自动驾驶时序感知有重要价值。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出端到端联合单目3D检测与跟踪框架Time3D。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 时空信息流模块与时序一致性损失，实现检测与跟踪的双向信息传递。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在KITTI上检测与跟踪指标均优于分离式方案。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中体素特征融合不充分的问题，提出Voxel Field Fusion方法。作者将不同模态（如LiDAR点云与相机图像）的特征在体素场中进行统一表示与融合，通过场式融合策略增强特征交互。相比简单的特征拼接或逐点融合，该方法能更有效地利用跨模态互补信息。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测精度，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient voxel feature fusion in multi-modal 3D object detection by proposing Voxel Field Fusion. It unifies and fuses features from different modalities (e.g., LiDAR and camera) in a voxel field representation, enhancing cross-modal interaction. Unlike simple concatenation or point-wise fusion, this approach better exploits complementary information. It achieves leading detection accuracy on benchmarks like nuScenes.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: 为多模态3D检测提供了有效的体素场融合范式，对BEV感知研究有启发。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出体素场融合方法Voxel Field Fusion用于多模态3D目标检测。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 在体素场中统一表示并融合多模态特征，增强跨模态交互。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的检测精度。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度线索利用不充分导致可靠性差的问题，本文提出一种充分利用深度线索的方法。作者通过多源深度估计与不确定性建模，将深度信息以多样化方式融入检测网络，并设计可靠性评估机制筛选高质量深度线索。相比仅依赖单一深度估计的方法，该工作显著提升了检测的鲁棒性和精度。在KITTI等数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，但具体数据未在摘要中给出。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: To address unreliable monocular 3D detection due to insufficient use of depth clues, this paper proposes a method that fully exploits depth information. It integrates multi-source depth estimates with uncertainty modeling into the detection network and designs a reliability assessment to select high-quality depth clues. Compared to single-depth-estimator methods, it significantly improves robustness and accuracy. Experiments on KITTI show superior performance.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 强调深度线索多样性与可靠性，为单目3D检测提供了新视角。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用深度线索的可靠单目3D目标检测方法。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 多源深度估计与不确定性建模相结合，筛选高质量深度线索。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上取得优于现有方法的性能。
