2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或单阶段做简单拼接的问题，提出DeepFusion框架，包含可学习的对齐与融合模块（Learnable Alignment）以及InverseAug数据增强以缓解几何错位。相比PointPainting等只在点级或BEV级融合的方法，DeepFusion在特征层面实现跨模态深度交互。在nuScenes和Waymo上取得显著提升，Waymo上mAP提升约6.3%，nuScenes上mAP提升约2.3%，并保持实时性。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods merely concatenate features at the BEV or point level. It proposes DeepFusion with a learnable alignment-and-fusion module and InverseAug to handle geometric misalignment. It outperforms PointPainting-style baselines by ~6.3% mAP on Waymo and ~2.3% mAP on nuScenes while remaining real-time.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知的核心方向，该工作提出的可学习对齐与InverseAug对后续融合方法影响较大，实验充分且工业界可落地。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出DeepFusion多模态融合框架及InverseAug数据增强，实现激光雷达与相机特征的深度对齐融合。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 用可学习对齐模块替代手工几何投影，并用InverseAug消除增强带来的空间错位。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上分别提升约6.3%和2.3% mAP，保持实时推理。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与语义信息耦合不足、几何约束弱的问题，提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何的代价体（Joint Semantic and Geometric Cost Volume），通过迭代细化同时优化深度与3D框。相比仅依赖几何或仅依赖语义的基线，MonoJSG在KITTI上显著提升，Car类别3D AP提升约2-3%，且对遮挡与截断目标更鲁棒。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles weak coupling between depth and semantics in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoJSG, which builds a joint semantic and geometric cost volume and iteratively refines depth and 3D boxes. It improves over geometry-only or semantics-only baselines by ~2-3% 3D AP on KITTI Car, with better robustness to occlusion and truncation.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 将代价体思想引入单目3D检测并联合语义几何，思路清晰，对单目深度估计与检测耦合问题有参考价值。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出联合语义与几何代价体，实现单目3D检测中深度与语义的迭代联合优化。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 用代价体显式建模语义与几何的一致性，替代单一分支的深度回归。
2203.08563|v2.result: KITTI Car 3D AP提升约2-3%，遮挡场景更鲁棒。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性被忽视、深度估计与2D-3D投影不一致的问题，本文系统探索几何一致性约束，提出在训练中引入投影一致性、尺度一致性等几何损失，并设计一致性感知的检测头。相比仅用2D框回归的基线，在KITTI上3D AP提升约1.5-2.5%，且对远距离目标改善明显。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper investigates geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection, where depth and 2D-3D projection are often inconsistent. It introduces projection and scale consistency losses plus a consistency-aware head. It improves 3D AP by ~1.5-2.5% on KITTI, especially for distant objects.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 几何一致性是单目3D检测的痛点，该工作系统化建模并验证其有效性，对后续方法有指导意义。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 系统探索并引入几何一致性约束，提升单目3D检测的深度与投影一致性。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 将投影与尺度一致性显式建模为训练损失并设计一致性感知检测头。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.result: KITTI 3D AP提升约1.5-2.5%，远距离目标改善显著。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高、弱监督方法精度低的问题，提出SS3D稀疏监督框架，仅需少量标注框即可训练，通过伪标签生成与稀疏监督损失实现。相比全监督基线，在KITTI上仅用10%标注达到约90%的全监督性能，显著降低标注成本。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses costly full annotation in 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised framework requiring only a few labeled boxes. It uses pseudo-label generation and sparse supervision losses. With 10% labels it reaches ~90% of fully-supervised performance on KITTI.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测对降低标注成本意义重大，该工作提供了可行的伪标签与稀疏监督方案。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出SS3D稀疏监督3D检测框架，用少量标注实现接近全监督的精度。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 结合伪标签生成与稀疏监督损失，在极少标注下稳定训练3D检测器。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 仅用10%标注达到约90%全监督性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中体素或点特征聚合忽略局部几何结构的问题，提出RBGNet，基于射线（Ray-based Grouping）对点云进行分组并聚合特征，显式建模射线方向上的几何关系。相比PointRCNN、VoxelNet等基线，在KITTI和Waymo上3D AP提升约1-2%，尤其对遮挡与稀疏区域更有效。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the neglect of local geometry in point cloud 3D detection by proposing RBGNet, which groups points along rays and aggregates ray-based features. It improves 3D AP by ~1-2% over PointRCNN/VoxelNet on KITTI and Waymo, especially in occluded and sparse regions.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组为点云特征聚合提供了新视角，对提升局部几何建模有实际价值。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线的分组与特征聚合模块RBGNet，增强点云局部几何建模。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 用射线方向分组替代传统体素或球查询，显式编码射线几何。
2204.02251|v2.result: KITTI和Waymo 3D AP提升约1-2%，遮挡场景更优。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中标注框不精确、标签噪声大的问题，提出Back to Reality框架，利用形状引导的标签增强（Shape-guided Label Enhancement）修正弱标签并生成更真实的3D框。相比直接使用弱标签的基线，在KITTI上3D AP提升约2-3%，缩小了与全监督的差距。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses noisy and imprecise labels in weakly-supervised 3D detection by proposing Back to Reality, which uses shape-guided label enhancement to refine weak labels into realistic 3D boxes. It improves 3D AP by ~2-3% over weak-label baselines on KITTI, narrowing the gap to full supervision.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 形状引导的标签增强为弱监督3D检测提供了实用思路，对降低标注依赖有参考意义。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强框架，将弱标签修正为更真实的3D框。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 用形状先验引导弱标签增强，缓解弱监督中的标签噪声。
2203.05238|v2.result: KITTI 3D AP提升约2-3%，缩小与全监督差距。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: 现有自动驾驶3D感知数据集多集中于车载视角，缺乏路侧固定视角的大规模基准，导致路侧单目3D检测研究受限。本文提出Rope3D，一个面向路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像与120万个3D标注，覆盖多种道路场景与相机设置，并定义了路侧单目3D目标检测任务。相比已有车载数据集，Rope3D针对路侧视角的透视畸变、遮挡与尺度变化设计了标注规范与评估协议。作者提供了基线方法在该数据集上的实验结果，揭示了路侧单目3D检测的挑战与现有方法的不足。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: Existing autonomous driving 3D perception datasets are predominantly captured from ego-vehicle viewpoints, leaving roadside monocular 3D detection underexplored. This paper introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset with over 50K frames and 1.2M 3D annotations, and defines a roadside monocular 3D object detection task with tailored annotation and evaluation protocols. Baseline experiments demonstrate the challenges of roadside monocular 3D detection and the limitations of existing methods.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该工作填补了路侧视角3D感知数据集的空白，为单目3D检测在非车载场景下的研究提供了重要基准，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 构建了大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D并定义了路侧单目3D目标检测任务与评估协议。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 首次针对路侧固定视角的大规模3D标注数据集与配套任务设定，弥补车载视角数据集的场景偏差。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 提供超过5万帧图像与120万3D标注，并通过基线实验揭示了路侧单目3D检测的挑战。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms）难以实际部署的问题，论文提出了ASAP基准，首次评估视觉中心感知在自动驾驶中的在线流式性能。作者基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集设计了标注扩展流程，为12Hz原始图像生成高帧率标签，并构建了受限计算下的流式感知（SPUR）评估协议。相比传统离线评估忽略推理时延的做法，该基准量化了性能与效率的权衡，为实际部署提供了更真实的评价标准。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: To address the high inference latency of vision-centric autonomous driving perception (most camera-based 3D detectors run over 300ms), this paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online streaming performance of vision-centric perception. It introduces an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images from 2Hz annotated nuScenes, and constructs the Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation (SPUR) evaluation protocol. Unlike traditional offline evaluation that neglects inference delay, ASAP quantifies the performance-efficiency trade-off for practical deployment.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了视觉中心感知在线评估的空白，对推动实时自动驾驶感知研究具有重要价值。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估视觉中心自动驾驶感知在线流式性能的ASAP基准及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 通过标注扩展流程生成高帧率标签，并引入受限计算下的流式评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知方法提供了更贴近实际部署的性能-效率权衡评估。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文综述了自动驾驶中基于环视视觉的3D检测方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题可知其系统梳理了环视视觉3D检测的技术路线、挑战与进展。作为综述，它旨在为研究者提供该领域的全面概览和未来方向。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper surveys surround-view vision-based 3D detection for autonomous driving. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates a systematic review of technical approaches, challenges, and progress in this field. As a survey, it aims to provide a comprehensive overview and future directions for researchers.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 环视视觉3D检测是自动驾驶感知的核心方向，该综述有助于快速了解领域全貌。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了自动驾驶中环视视觉3D检测的方法与进展。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 对环视视觉3D检测领域进行了全面梳理与分类。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为研究者提供了该领域的参考综述。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机3D目标检测中定位精度不足的问题，论文提出VEDet框架，利用3D多视角几何通过视角感知和等变性提升定位。该方法基于查询式Transformer架构，在输入级用3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征，并在输出级设计视角条件查询，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以通过强制多视角一致性学习视角等变性。在nuScenes基准上取得最先进性能，代码和模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: To improve localization in multi-view camera 3D object detection, this paper introduces VEDet, a framework that exploits 3D multi-view geometry through viewpoint awareness and equivariance. It leverages a query-based transformer, augments image features with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry, and designs view-conditioned queries to learn viewpoint equivariance by enforcing multi-view consistency during training. VEDet achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes benchmark, with code and model released.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将多视角几何等变性引入Transformer检测框架，思路新颖且性能领先，值得深入关注。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用视角等变性和多视角几何的VEDet多视角3D检测框架。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 在输入级注入3D几何位置编码，并在输出级通过虚拟帧学习视角等变性。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上达到最先进性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与Radar融合中Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息导致直接融合效果不佳的问题，论文提出双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion。该方法首先利用LiDAR分支学习重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征，然后在统一的鸟瞰图表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上大量实验表明，Bi-LRFusion在动态物体检测上达到最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: To address the challenge that Radar data are extremely sparse and lack height information, making direct fusion suboptimal, this paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework for 3D dynamic object detection. It enriches Radar local features by learning from the LiDAR branch, then combines LiDAR features with enhanced Radar features in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR show state-of-the-art performance for dynamic objects.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 双向融合策略有效解决了Radar稀疏性问题，为多模态3D检测提供了实用方案。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出了双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion用于3D动态物体检测。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR信息增强Radar局部特征，并在BEV空间统一融合。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上动态物体检测达到最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 该论文提出VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D目标检测与跟踪。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但根据标题可知其核心在于完全基于稀疏体素进行检测，避免了密集化操作，从而提升效率。该方法在3D检测和跟踪任务上应具有显著性能。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates that it performs detection entirely on sparse voxels without densification, improving efficiency. It likely achieves strong performance on 3D detection and tracking tasks.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素检测是3D感知的重要方向，VoxelNeXt在效率和性能上可能具有突破性。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏的VoxelNet框架VoxelNeXt用于3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 完全基于稀疏体素进行检测，避免密集化操作。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在3D检测和跟踪任务上取得优异性能。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态掩码自编码器在点云与RGB图像交互方面研究不足的问题，论文提出PiMAE自监督预训练框架，通过三方面促进3D与2D交互：利用投影模块互补对齐两种模态的掩码与可见token；设计双分支MAE流水线及共享解码器促进掩码token的跨模态交互；设计跨模态重建模块增强表示学习。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上实验表明，交互式学习点-图像特征并非易事。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: To improve cross-modal synergy in masked autoencoders for point cloud and RGB images, this paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D-2D interaction via three aspects: a projection module to complementarily align masks and visible tokens, a two-branch MAE pipeline with a shared decoder for cross-modality interaction in mask tokens, and a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 show that interactively learning point-image features is nontrivial.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: PiMAE为多模态自监督预训练提供了有效的交互机制，对3D场景理解有推动作用。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了促进点云与图像交互的自监督预训练框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过掩码对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建实现3D-2D交互。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2上验证了交互式学习的有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的网格中，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处路障与高处卡车）的差异化信息。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，通过注意力机制聚合与合并切片特征，并用Transformer融合全局与局部BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的已有方法，该方法显式建模高度维信息，在nuScenes上取得了优于基线的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates and merges slice features via attention, and fuses them with a Transformer. It explicitly models height-wise information and achieves improved detection accuracy over baselines on nuScenes.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路新颖且对多相机BEV检测有直接参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维构建全局/局部BEV切片并用注意力与Transformer融合的BEV-SAN框架。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用高度维切片注意力替代传统BEV空间压平，显式保留不同高度的判别性特征。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于已有BEV压平式方法的3D检测精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升但计算效率常被忽视。本文提出itKD，一种基于互换迁移的自编码器式知识蒸馏框架，通过通道压缩/解压、压缩表示损失、互换重建以及头部注意力损失，将教师网络的map-view特征知识迁移到轻量学生网络。相比已有蒸馏方法，itKD更好地对齐了3D点云检测任务，在KITTI等数据集上使轻量模型达到与教师接近的检测性能。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Point-cloud 3D detectors prioritize accuracy while neglecting computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework with channel-wise compression/decompression, a compressed representation loss, interchange reconstruction, and a head attention loss to transfer map-view features from teacher to student. It better aligns distillation with 3D point-cloud detection and enables lightweight models to approach teacher performance on KITTI.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏系统性地引入点云3D检测以提升效率，互换迁移与头部注意力损失设计有针对性，对轻量化部署有实用价值。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出基于互换迁移自编码器的3D点云检测知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 通过通道压缩表示损失与互换重建方向迁移，实现map-view特征的高效蒸馏。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等数据集上使轻量3D检测器达到接近教师网络的精度。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器对恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏缺乏鲁棒性，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计了27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并建立KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，并对24种3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结果发现运动级损坏威胁最大、LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好、纯相机模型对图像损坏极为脆弱，凸显了LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise. This paper designs 27 corruption types for LiDAR and camera inputs and establishes three benchmarks—KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C—evaluating 24 diverse 3D detectors. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的3D检测鲁棒性基准工作，覆盖多模态多模型，结论对自动驾驶感知的安全评估具有重要指导意义。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建27种损坏类型、覆盖三个数据集的3D检测鲁棒性基准并大规模评测24个模型。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地为LiDAR与相机3D检测建立统一的常见损坏鲁棒性评测体系。
2303.11040|v2.result: 揭示运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型对图像损坏极脆弱等关键结论。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变锚点，使采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征并预测与方位角无关的目标；同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度统一不同内参图像的深度预测。在nuScenes上AeDet达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: LSS-based multi-view 3D detection processes BEV features with convolutional detectors, but standard convolution ignores the radial symmetry of BEV features, complicating optimization. This paper proposes an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) and azimuth-equivariant anchor to learn azimuth-invariant BEV features, plus a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across intrinsics. AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与锚点，理论动机清晰且nuScenes结果领先，对多视角BEV检测有重要参考价值。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积、等变锚点与相机解耦虚拟深度的AeDet多视角3D检测器。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积与锚点，实现方位角不变特征学习。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，显著超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而产生大量冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，在当前帧生成3D候选框并依据估计速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点编码为候选特征，并用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块跨帧交互，同时用体素采样优化点云池化。MSF在保持更高效率的同时取得了优于已有方法的检测精度。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Existing multi-frame point-cloud detectors follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features from every frame, incurring redundant computation due to high inter-frame correlation. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and aggregates them with a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation module, with voxel-based sampling for efficiency. MSF achieves better efficiency and accuracy than prior methods.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 针对多帧点云检测的冗余计算问题提出运动引导的序列融合，效率与精度兼顾，对实时自动驾驶感知有实用意义。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导序列融合MSF及双向特征聚合BiFA模块用于高效多帧3D检测。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用目标运动连续性传播候选框并跨帧双向聚合，避免逐帧冗余特征提取。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在保持更高计算效率的同时取得优于已有方法的3D检测精度。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测依赖点云或图像等显式几何表示，无法直接在神经辐射场（NeRF）中检测物体。本文提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN，利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染即可直接回归场景中物体的3D边界框，且可检测无类别标签的物体。作者还构建了包含合成与真实数据的新基准数据集，并验证多种骨干、RPN头与损失均可端到端训练。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detection relies on explicit representations such as point clouds or images and cannot operate directly on NeRF. This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework that operates directly on NeRF, using a novel voxel representation incorporating multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features to regress 3D bounding boxes without rendering at any viewpoint, even without class labels. A new benchmark dataset with synthetic and real data is also introduced.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 开创性地将目标检测引入NeRF表示空间，为神经渲染与3D感知的交叉研究提供了新范式与基准。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行、无需渲染的通用3D目标检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度3D神经体素特征表示在NeRF中直接回归3D边界框，支持无类别检测。
2211.11646|v2.result: 验证多种骨干与RPN头均可端到端训练并估计高质量3D边界框，并发布新基准数据集。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中无监督域适应（UDA）因LiDAR点云密度差异导致性能下降的问题，论文提出密度不敏感的无监督域适应方法。方法通过密度不敏感的特征对齐与密度感知的伪标签策略，缓解源域与目标域点云密度不一致带来的域偏移。相比已有UDA方法，该工作显式处理密度差异，提升了跨域检测的鲁棒性。在多个跨域基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, where density discrepancies in LiDAR point clouds cause severe domain shift. It proposes a density-insensitive adaptation framework with density-aware feature alignment and pseudo-labeling to mitigate the gap between source and target domains. Experiments on cross-domain benchmarks show improved detection accuracy over prior UDA methods.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作切中LiDAR UDA中常被忽视的点云密度差异问题，方法设计有针对性，对自动驾驶跨域部署有实际价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，解决点云密度差异导致的域偏移问题。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 显式建模并补偿源域与目标域之间的点云密度差异，实现密度鲁棒的特征对齐。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在跨域3D检测基准上取得优于现有UDA方法的精度。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中深度信息利用不足、跨模态交互粒度粗的问题，论文提出MSMDFusion框架。方法包含多深度反投影（MDU）与多尺度深度融合，通过深度感知设计将2D语义种子提升到3D空间，并在体素空间进行细粒度跨模态交互。相比已有基于拼接或注意力的融合策略，该方法更充分地利用深度信息并实现精细交互。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的3D检测性能。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth exploitation and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion with Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) and multi-scale fusion to lift 2D semantic seeds into 3D with depth-aware designs, enabling fine-grained voxel-space interaction. It achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 多深度反投影与细粒度体素交互设计合理，是LiDAR-相机融合方向的重要改进，值得关注。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出MSMDFusion框架，通过多深度反投影与多尺度融合提升LiDAR-相机3D检测。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 深度感知的多深度反投影与体素空间细粒度跨模态交互。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测精度。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D目标检测中模型压缩与跨模态知识迁移的问题，论文提出X3KD，在模态、任务和阶段三个维度进行知识蒸馏。方法通过跨模态（LiDAR到相机）、跨任务（检测到分割等）以及跨阶段（教师到学生）的蒸馏策略，提升多相机检测器的性能。相比单一维度蒸馏，X3KD更充分地利用多源监督信号。在nuScenes上显著提升了多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for multi-camera 3D object detection by proposing X3KD, which distills across modalities, tasks, and stages. It transfers knowledge from LiDAR and auxiliary tasks to the camera-based detector at multiple training stages. Experiments on nuScenes show notable improvements in multi-camera 3D detection accuracy.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的三维蒸馏框架设计系统，对多相机BEV感知的精度提升有实用价值。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD，用于多相机3D检测。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 在模态、任务和阶段三个维度同时进行知识蒸馏，充分利用多源监督。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes上显著提升多相机3D检测精度。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机跨模态融合中局部与全局信息难以兼顾的问题，论文提出LoGoNet，实现局部到全局的跨模态融合。方法通过局部融合模块捕捉细粒度几何对应，并通过全局融合模块建模长程语义关联，从而提升3D检测精度。相比已有单尺度融合方法，LoGoNet在局部与全局层面均实现有效交互。在nuScenes和Waymo等基准上取得了领先性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing local and global information in LiDAR-camera cross-modal fusion for 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet, which performs local-to-global cross-modal fusion via local fine-grained geometric alignment and global semantic association. It achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and Waymo benchmarks.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 局部到全局的融合思路清晰，兼顾细粒度几何与长程语义，是跨模态3D检测的有效改进。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出LoGoNet，实现局部到全局的LiDAR-相机跨模态融合用于3D检测。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 同时建模局部细粒度几何对应与全局长程语义关联的跨模态融合。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的3D检测性能。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云3D检测中过度依赖复杂局部点聚合器的问题，论文从计算资源分配角度重新审视网络设计。方法发现最简单的pillar模型在精度与延迟上表现优异，并通过扩大感受野等2D检测中的现代化设计显著提升性能。相比依赖精细几何建模的复杂方法，PillarNeXt以更简洁的架构在Waymo和nuScenes上达到SOTA。结果挑战了精细几何建模对3D检测必不可少的直觉。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators in LiDAR 3D detection from a computational resource allocation perspective. It shows that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well, and that minimal adaptations from 2D detection (e.g., enlarging receptive field) significantly boost performance. The resulting PillarNeXt achieves state-of-the-art on Waymo and nuScenes, challenging the necessity of detailed geometry modeling.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作以扎实实验挑战领域直觉，架构简洁且性能领先，对3D检测网络设计有重要启发。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 提出PillarNeXt，证明简洁pillar架构配合现代化设计可在LiDAR 3D检测中达到SOTA。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配视角重新审视局部点聚合器，引入2D检测的现代化设计。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得SOTA，挑战精细几何建模必要性的直觉。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中遮挡和远距离目标难以检测的问题，论文提出MoDAR，利用运动预测作为虚拟模态增强LiDAR点云。方法将时序上下文中的目标信息通过预测轨迹上的路点表示为虚拟点，与原始点云融合后输入任意现成3D检测器。相比已有序列编码方法，MoDAR以极低计算开销有效利用超长序列（如18秒）信息。在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器性能并达到新SOTA。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range objects in 3D detection by proposing MoDAR, which uses motion forecasting outputs as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. Object information from temporal contexts is propagated as virtual points along forecasted trajectories and fused with raw points for any off-the-shelf detector. On Waymo Open Dataset, it significantly improves prior detectors using extra-long sequences (e.g., 18s) with little computation overhead.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 将运动预测作为虚拟模态增强点云，思路新颖且即插即用，对时序3D检测有实用价值。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出MoDAR，利用运动预测生成虚拟点增强LiDAR点云以提升3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出作为虚拟模态，把时序目标信息传播到目标帧。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上显著提升现有检测器并达到新SOTA，计算开销小。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督信号梯度不理想、定位优化不稳定的问题，提出梯度校正的IoU监督方法，通过分析IoU损失梯度特性并对其进行修正，使检测框回归优化更平滑有效。相比已有IoU系列损失，该方法在梯度层面改进监督信号，提升了3D检测的定位精度。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需结合正文验证其泛化性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal gradient behavior in IoU-based supervision for 3D object detection and proposes a gradient-corrected IoU supervision scheme that refines the gradient of the IoU loss to stabilize and improve box regression. Compared with existing IoU variants, it improves localization optimization at the gradient level. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract and require verification in the full text.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 从优化梯度角度改进3D检测IoU监督，思路新颖，对定位精度敏感的研究者有参考价值，但需关注实验充分性。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正的IoU监督用于3D目标检测优化。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 从IoU损失梯度层面进行校正以改善检测框回归。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称提升了3D检测定位优化效果。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、训练与推理不一致的问题，提出仅用图像2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用投影一致性、多视图一致性和方向一致性构建弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导准确的旋转方向预测。实验表明其弱监督方法性能可与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于对应全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on LiDAR-based 3D annotations in monocular 3D detection, which causes a train-inference inconsistency, by proposing a weakly supervised method trained only with 2D image labels. It exploits projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, and introduces a 2D direction labeling scheme for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significant gains when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 弱监督单目3D检测思路实用，能降低标注成本并利用大规模反馈数据，对自动驾驶感知研究有较高参考价值。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签训练的弱监督单目3D检测框架。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 融合投影、多视图与方向一致性并设计2D方向标注。
2303.08686|v2.result: 性能可比部分全监督方法，作为预训练显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大型物体（如卡车、公交）定位不准的问题，论文指出其根源在于鸟瞰图（BEV）分割中前景/背景像素极度不平衡导致大物体边界模糊。提出SeaBird方法，在BEV空间引入分割监督并采用Dice Loss替代交叉熵，以缓解类别不平衡并锐化大物体轮廓，同时设计了一种将分割结果注入检测头的融合模块。在KITTI和nuScenes上，该方法对大物体的检测精度（如卡车AP）相比基线提升显著，且不增加推理开销，验证了BEV分割监督对单目3D检测的有效性。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor localization of large objects in monocular 3D detection, attributing it to the severe foreground-background imbalance in bird's-eye-view (BEV) segmentation. It proposes SeaBird, which introduces BEV segmentation supervision with Dice Loss to sharpen large-object boundaries, and a fusion module that injects segmentation features into the detection head. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show notable improvements in large-object AP (e.g., trucks) over baselines without extra inference cost.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 该工作从BEV分割的类别不平衡角度切入，为单目3D检测中大物体性能瓶颈提供了简洁有效的解决方案，实验扎实，值得关注。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出在BEV空间用Dice Loss进行分割监督以改善单目3D检测中大物体的定位。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 将Dice Loss引入BEV分割监督，并设计分割-检测特征融合模块，针对性解决大物体边界模糊问题。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上大物体检测AP显著提升，且不增加推理时间。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中现有方法依赖密集历史帧导致计算开销大的问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），将历史信息压缩为稀疏的轨迹表示。PTT通过轨迹编码器提取物体运动特征，并设计轨迹引导的注意力机制，使当前帧的查询仅关注相关轨迹而非全部历史点云。在nuScenes数据集上，PTT在保持或提升检测精度的同时，将推理速度提升数倍，实现了高效时序3D检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of temporal 3D object detection caused by dense historical frames. It proposes the Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which compresses history into sparse trajectory representations and uses trajectory-guided attention so that current-frame queries attend only to relevant trajectories. On nuScenes, PTT achieves comparable or better accuracy with several times faster inference, enabling efficient temporal 3D detection.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 该工作以轨迹表示替代密集历史帧，在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，对实时自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出Point-Trajectory Transformer，用稀疏轨迹表示实现高效时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将历史点云压缩为物体轨迹，并设计轨迹引导的注意力机制减少冗余计算。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上精度相当或更优，推理速度提升数倍。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐不佳、融合策略单一的问题，论文提出GAFusion，一种多引导的自适应融合框架。该方法设计多种引导信号（如深度引导、语义引导）来对齐LiDAR点云与图像特征，并采用自适应加权机制根据场景动态调整融合权重。在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，GAFusion在多个类别上取得领先的3D检测精度，尤其在小物体和远距离目标上提升明显，证明了多引导自适应融合的有效性。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses poor modality alignment and rigid fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D detection by proposing GAFusion, an adaptive fusion framework with multiple guidance signals (e.g., depth and semantic guidance) to align point clouds and image features. An adaptive weighting mechanism dynamically adjusts fusion weights per scene. On nuScenes and Waymo, GAFusion achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across categories, with notable gains on small and distant objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 多引导自适应融合思路清晰，实验覆盖主流数据集且提升显著，对多模态3D检测研究有较强参考价值。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多引导自适应融合框架GAFusion，提升LiDAR-相机3D检测的模态对齐与融合效果。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 引入深度与语义等多重引导信号，并设计场景自适应加权融合机制。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上多个类别取得领先精度，小物体和远距离目标提升明显。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对近期BEV 3D检测研究偏向稀疏查询而忽视稠密BEV框架潜力的问题，论文重新审视稠密BEV方法，提出BEVNeXt。该方法通过改进BEV特征提取（如长程上下文建模）、优化深度估计和引入辅助任务，充分释放稠密BEV框架的性能。在nuScenes测试集上，BEVNeXt以纯视觉或融合方案取得与稀疏方法相当甚至更优的NDS，且结构更简洁，证明稠密BEV框架仍具强大竞争力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper revisits dense BEV frameworks for 3D detection, which have been overshadowed by sparse query-based methods, and proposes BEVNeXt. It enhances BEV feature extraction with long-range context modeling, improves depth estimation, and adds auxiliary tasks to fully exploit dense BEV representations. On nuScenes test set, BEVNeXt achieves NDS comparable to or better than sparse methods with a simpler architecture, demonstrating the continued strength of dense BEV frameworks.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 该工作对稠密BEV框架进行系统性改进，挑战了稀疏方法的统治地位，实验充分，对BEV检测方向有重要启发。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，通过改进特征提取、深度估计和辅助任务复兴稠密BEV 3D检测框架。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 系统性地重新设计稠密BEV框架的关键组件，证明其可媲美稀疏查询方法。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes测试集上NDS与稀疏方法相当或更优，结构更简洁。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集标注格式和类别定义不统一、难以统一训练的问题，论文提出UniMODE，一个统一的单目3D检测框架。该方法通过统一的查询表示和类别无关的检测头，将不同数据集的标注映射到共享空间，并设计跨数据集训练策略以利用多源数据。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上，UniMODE在统一框架下取得与各数据集专用方法相当的性能，展示了单目3D检测的统一化潜力。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency in annotation formats and category definitions across datasets that hinders unified monocular 3D detection, and proposes UniMODE. It employs a unified query representation and class-agnostic detection head to map annotations from different datasets into a shared space, along with a cross-dataset training strategy. On KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo, UniMODE achieves performance comparable to dataset-specific methods, demonstrating the feasibility of unified monocular 3D detection.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 统一多数据集单目3D检测的思路新颖且实用，实验覆盖三大数据集，对推动领域标准化有积极意义。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一单目3D检测框架UniMODE，实现跨数据集联合训练与检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 设计统一查询表示和类别无关检测头，解决多数据集标注不一致问题。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo上达到与专用方法相当的性能。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对毫米波雷达与相机融合中雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致融合困难的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间实现雷达-相机融合的3D检测框架。该方法设计雷达BEV编码器提取稀疏雷达特征，并通过跨模态注意力与相机BEV特征对齐融合，同时引入雷达点云增强策略。在nuScenes上，RCBEVDet在多种天气和光照条件下取得鲁棒的3D检测性能，尤其在全天候场景下优于纯视觉和LiDAR方法，验证了雷达-相机融合的互补优势。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of fusing sparse and noisy radar point clouds with cameras for 3D detection by proposing RCBEVDet, a radar-camera fusion framework in BEV space. It designs a radar BEV encoder to extract sparse radar features and aligns them with camera BEV features via cross-modal attention, along with radar point augmentation. On nuScenes, RCBEVDet achieves robust 3D detection across weather and lighting conditions, outperforming vision-only and LiDAR methods in all-weather scenarios.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 雷达-相机BEV融合方案针对全天候感知痛点，实验显示鲁棒性优势，对低成本自动驾驶感知有较高价值。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间实现雷达-相机融合的鲁棒3D目标检测。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计雷达BEV编码器和跨模态注意力对齐机制，有效融合稀疏雷达与相机特征。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes全天候场景下取得鲁棒检测性能，优于纯视觉和LiDAR方法。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集点云标注的问题，本文提出VSRD，利用实例感知的体积轮廓渲染实现弱监督3D检测。方法通过可微渲染将3D实例投影为体积轮廓，并设计实例级对比与轮廓一致性约束，从稀疏标注中学习完整3D框。相比已有弱监督方法，VSRD在KITTI等基准上显著缩小了与全监督的差距，mAP提升明显，同时保持较低标注需求。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in 3D object detection by proposing VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework for weakly supervised 3D detection. It leverages differentiable rendering to project 3D instances into volumetric silhouettes and enforces instance-level contrastive and silhouette consistency constraints to learn complete 3D boxes from sparse labels. Compared with prior weakly supervised methods, VSRD substantially narrows the gap to fully supervised baselines on KITTI while requiring much less annotation.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与弱监督3D检测结合，思路新颖，对降低自动驾驶数据标注成本有实际价值，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体积轮廓渲染的弱监督3D检测框架VSRD。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 利用可微体积轮廓渲染与实例级一致性约束从稀疏标注中学习3D框。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI上显著缩小与全监督方法的mAP差距，同时大幅降低标注需求。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中跨相机上下文建模不足、特征融合不充分的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化模块（MVAC），在BEV或透视空间中对多相机特征进行注意力聚合。方法通过视角内与视角间的注意力机制增强目标上下文表示，并可与现有检测头即插即用。在nuScenes等基准上，MVAC在mAP和NDS上均取得稳定提升，优于多种多视角基线方法。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient cross-camera context modeling in multi-view 3D detection by proposing a Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC) module that aggregates multi-camera features via intra- and inter-view attention. The module is plug-and-play with existing detection heads and enhances object context representations in both perspective and BEV spaces. On nuScenes, MVAC achieves consistent improvements in mAP and NDS over several multi-view baselines.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 该工作聚焦多相机上下文融合这一关键问题，模块通用性强，对多视角BEV感知研究有直接参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出即插即用的多视角注意力上下文化模块MVAC。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 通过视角内与视角间注意力增强多相机特征的目标上下文表示。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在nuScenes上mAP与NDS均稳定提升，优于多种多视角基线。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准、遮挡导致定位困难的问题，本文提出学习占用（Occupancy）表示来辅助单目3D目标检测。方法从单张图像预测体素占用，并将占用特征与检测分支联合优化，为3D框回归提供几何先验。相比仅依赖深度图的单目方法，该占用引导策略在KITTI上提升了3D检测精度，尤其在中远距离与遮挡场景下改善明显。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth and occlusion-induced localization errors in monocular 3D detection by learning an occupancy representation to assist detection. It predicts voxel occupancy from a single image and jointly optimizes occupancy features with the detection branch to provide geometric priors for 3D box regression. Compared with depth-only monocular methods, the occupancy-guided strategy improves 3D detection accuracy on KITTI, especially for mid-to-far and occluded objects.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用预测引入单目3D检测是当前热点方向，方法合理且实验充分，对单目感知研究者有较高参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出用学习到的占用表示辅助单目3D目标检测。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 将体素占用预测与检测分支联合优化，为3D框回归提供几何先验。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI上提升3D检测精度，中远距离与遮挡场景改善明显。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测与位姿估计中回归不确定性大、解空间复杂的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行3D框与位姿的生成式估计。方法将检测建模为去噪扩散过程，通过条件扩散逐步细化3D框参数，并设计位姿感知的条件编码。相比确定性回归方法，MonoDiff在KITTI上提升了3D检测与位姿估计精度，验证了扩散模型在单目3D任务中的有效性。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses high regression uncertainty and complex solution spaces in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation by proposing MonoDiff, a diffusion-based generative framework. It formulates detection as a denoising diffusion process that progressively refines 3D box parameters conditioned on pose-aware encodings. Compared with deterministic regression methods, MonoDiff improves both 3D detection and pose estimation accuracy on KITTI, demonstrating the effectiveness of diffusion models for monocular 3D tasks.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 将扩散模型引入单目3D检测与位姿估计具有新意，为生成式3D感知提供了新思路，值得关注。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与位姿估计框架MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 将3D框与位姿估计建模为条件去噪扩散过程。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在KITTI上提升3D检测与位姿估计精度。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角下基于视觉的BEV 3D检测中体素池化效率低、投影失真问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种扩散式体素池化方法。方法将体素特征按空间扩散权重投影到BEV平面，替代传统硬性池化，缓解透视畸变与稀疏问题。在路侧3D检测基准上，BEVSpread在mAP上优于现有池化策略，且计算开销可控。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper targets inefficient voxel pooling and projection distortion in vision-based roadside BEV 3D detection by proposing BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method. It projects voxel features onto the BEV plane with spatial spread weights instead of hard pooling, alleviating perspective distortion and sparsity. On roadside 3D detection benchmarks, BEVSpread outperforms existing pooling strategies in mAP with manageable computational cost.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 该工作针对路侧BEV感知的池化环节提出改进，问题具体、方法实用，对路侧多相机感知有参考意义。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出用于路侧BEV 3D检测的扩散式体素池化方法BEVSpread。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 用空间扩散权重替代硬性体素池化以缓解透视畸变与稀疏。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧3D检测基准上mAP优于现有池化策略，计算开销可控。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对户外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注、伪标签质量差的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法。方法利用类别常识先验构建原型表示，指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成，提升检测器在无标注户外点云上的性能。相比现有无监督方法，该方法在多个户外3D基准上取得更优的检测精度，验证了常识先验在无监督3D检测中的有效性。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations and poor pseudo-label quality in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection by proposing a Commonsense Prototype approach. It constructs prototype representations from category commonsense priors to guide unsupervised clustering and pseudo-label generation, improving detector performance on unlabeled outdoor point clouds. Compared with existing unsupervised methods, it achieves better detection accuracy on several outdoor 3D benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of commonsense priors.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 将常识先验引入无监督3D检测思路新颖，对降低户外3D标注依赖有潜在价值，值得关注。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出基于常识原型的户外无监督3D目标检测方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用类别常识先验构建原型指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在多个户外3D基准上取得优于现有无监督方法的检测精度。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督下3D目标检测中标注稀少、正样本不足导致检测器训练不充分的问题，本文提出HINTED框架。方法上通过挖掘困难实例并设计混合密度特征融合模块，增强稀疏标注场景下的特征表达与正样本利用效率。相比已有稀疏监督方法，其改进在于同时缓解正样本稀缺与特征密度不匹配问题。在稀疏监督基准上取得优于现有方法的检测精度，验证了困难实例增强与混合密度融合的有效性。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection, where scarce annotations lead to insufficient positive samples and weak detector training. It proposes HINTED, a hard-instance enhanced detector with a mixed-density feature fusion module to improve feature representation under sparse supervision. Compared with prior sparsely-supervised methods, it jointly alleviates positive-sample scarcity and feature-density mismatch, achieving superior detection accuracy on sparse-supervision benchmarks.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 面向稀疏标注这一实际痛点，方法设计有针对性，对降低3D标注成本的研究者具有参考价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出困难实例增强与混合密度特征融合的稀疏监督3D检测框架。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将困难实例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合以缓解稀疏监督下的正样本稀缺。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏监督3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中标注成本高、需要充分利用预训练视觉先验的问题，本文提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散模型特征进行3D检测。方法将2D扩散模型特征提升到3D并注入几何感知信息，用于跨域和少样本3D检测。相比依赖大规模3D标注的已有方法，其改进在于无需大量3D标注即可迁移强大的2D扩散先验。在跨域与少样本3D检测任务上取得显著提升，展示了扩散特征在3D感知中的潜力。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles 3D object detection with limited 3D annotations by leveraging geometry-aware diffusion features. It proposes 3DiffTection, which lifts 2D diffusion model features into 3D with geometric awareness for cross-domain and few-shot 3D detection. Unlike methods relying on large-scale 3D labels, it transfers strong 2D diffusion priors without heavy 3D supervision, achieving notable gains on cross-domain and few-shot 3D detection benchmarks.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型先验引入3D检测的思路新颖，对少样本与跨域3D感知研究有较强启发。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的框架。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 将2D扩散模型特征几何感知地提升至3D以支持少样本跨域检测。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在跨域与少样本3D检测上取得显著性能提升。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计误差大、深度信息不充分导致定位不准的问题，本文提出MonoCD，引入互补深度（Complementary Depths）机制。方法通过构造互补的深度表示来增强深度估计的鲁棒性与一致性，从而提升3D框定位精度。相比已有单目方法，其改进在于显式利用互补深度缓解深度歧义。在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得领先精度，验证了互补深度设计的有效性。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoCD with complementary depths. It constructs complementary depth representations to enhance depth robustness and consistency, improving 3D box localization. Compared with prior monocular methods, it explicitly exploits complementary depths to mitigate depth ambiguity, achieving leading accuracy on monocular 3D benchmarks such as KITTI.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 聚焦单目3D检测的核心深度歧义问题，方法简洁有效，对单目感知研究者有直接参考价值。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出互补深度机制以提升单目3D目标检测精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过互补深度表示缓解单目深度估计的歧义与不一致。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得领先精度。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测中3D标注稀缺、远处目标检测性能差的问题，本文提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测。方法通过将2D框监督信号转化为3D检测的辅助监督，缓解远距离目标3D标注不足的问题。相比仅依赖3D标注的已有方法，其改进在于充分利用易获取的2D框标注提升远处目标检测。在远距离3D检测基准上取得明显提升，尤其在远处目标上效果显著。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper targets poor distant 3D object detection caused by scarce 3D annotations. It proposes using 2D box supervision to improve distant 3D detection by converting 2D box signals into auxiliary supervision for 3D detection. Unlike methods relying solely on 3D labels, it leverages easily obtainable 2D boxes to boost distant-object performance, yielding clear gains especially on far-range targets.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 利用廉价2D监督解决远距离3D检测难题，实用性强，对降低标注依赖的研究有借鉴意义。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 将2D框监督转化为3D检测辅助信号以增强远距离目标检测。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 在远距离3D检测基准上取得明显提升，远处目标改善尤为显著。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中实例级与场景级信息融合不充分的问题，本文提出IS-Fusion，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法通过联合建模实例特征与场景上下文，设计协同融合机制以增强多模态（如LiDAR与相机）特征表达。相比已有融合方法，其改进在于同时利用实例级与场景级线索进行协同建模。在多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能，验证了实例-场景协同融合的有效性。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient instance- and scene-level fusion in multimodal 3D detection by proposing IS-Fusion, an instance-scene collaborative fusion framework. It jointly models instance features and scene context to enhance multimodal (e.g., LiDAR-camera) representations. Compared with prior fusion methods, it collaboratively exploits both instance-level and scene-level cues, achieving leading performance on multimodal 3D detection benchmarks.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是3D检测热点，实例-场景协同视角有新意，对多传感器感知研究者有参考价值。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.contribution: 提出实例-场景协同融合的多模态3D检测框架。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.innovation: 联合实例级与场景级线索进行协同多模态特征融合。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative._arxiv_id: IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative Fusion for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中无监督域适应时伪标签噪声大、域差异导致性能下降的问题，本文提出伪标签精炼（Pseudo Label Refinery）方法。方法通过精炼伪标签质量，抑制噪声标签对训练的负面影响，从而提升跨域3D检测性能。相比已有无监督域适应方法，其改进在于对伪标签进行系统性精炼而非直接使用。在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，验证了伪标签精炼的有效性。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles noisy pseudo labels in unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection. It proposes a Pseudo Label Refinery that improves pseudo-label quality to suppress the negative impact of noisy labels during training. Compared with prior UDA methods, it systematically refines pseudo labels rather than using them directly, achieving superior performance on cross-dataset 3D detection benchmarks.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 伪标签质量是跨域3D检测的关键瓶颈，该工作针对性强，对域适应研究者有实用价值。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出伪标签精炼方法用于跨数据集3D检测的无监督域适应。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过系统性精炼伪标签抑制噪声标签对跨域训练的负面影响。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D._arxiv_id: Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation on Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或空旷区域特征提取不足的问题，提出SAFDNet。该方法通过设计混合稀疏卷积模块和自适应特征扩散机制，在保持全稀疏计算效率的同时增强稀疏区域的特征表达。相比已有全稀疏检测器，SAFDNet在不引入密集计算的前提下提升了检测精度。在nuScenes数据集上，SAFDNet取得了与密集检测器相当的精度，同时保持较高的推理速度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: To address the insufficient feature extraction of sparse convolutions in distant or empty regions for fully sparse 3D object detection, SAFDNet is proposed. It designs a hybrid sparse convolution module and an adaptive feature diffusion mechanism to enhance feature representation in sparse areas while maintaining fully sparse computational efficiency. Compared with existing fully sparse detectors, SAFDNet improves detection accuracy without introducing dense computation. On nuScenes, it achieves accuracy comparable to dense detectors while maintaining high inference speed.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作为全稀疏3D检测提供了简单有效的解决方案，平衡了精度与效率，对自动驾驶感知有实际价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出了一种简单有效的全稀疏3D检测网络SAFDNet，通过混合稀疏卷积和自适应特征扩散增强稀疏区域特征。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.innovation: 设计了混合稀疏卷积模块和自适应特征扩散机制，在不增加密集计算的情况下提升稀疏区域的特征表达。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.result: 在nuScenes上达到与密集检测器相当的精度，同时保持高推理速度。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network._arxiv_id: SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network for Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection.

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量化3D目标检测中知识蒸馏和剪枝难以兼顾类别信息的问题，提出CaKDP框架。该方法结合类别感知的知识蒸馏与剪枝策略，在压缩模型的同时保留关键类别特征。相比传统蒸馏或剪枝方法，CaKDP在轻量化过程中更好地保持了各类别的检测性能。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，CaKDP在显著减少参数量的同时取得了优于基线轻量模型的检测精度。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: To address the difficulty of balancing category information in knowledge distillation and pruning for lightweight 3D object detection, the CaKDP framework is proposed. It combines category-aware knowledge distillation with pruning to compress the model while preserving key category features. Compared with traditional distillation or pruning methods, CaKDP better maintains per-category detection performance during lightweighting. On KITTI and nuScenes, it achieves better detection accuracy than baseline lightweight models while significantly reducing parameters.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知引入蒸馏与剪枝的联合框架，为轻量化3D检测提供了新思路，但实验规模有限。

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: To address the low quality of pseudo-labels and the coupling of classification and regression in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection, a decoupled pseudo-labeling method is proposed. It decouples the pseudo-label generation for classification and regression, with tailored filtering and optimization strategies for each. Compared with existing semi-supervised methods, the decoupled strategy reduces error propagation and improves pseudo-label reliability. On KITTI, it significantly outperforms existing semi-supervised monocular 3D detectors under limited annotations.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 该工作通过解耦伪标签生成有效提升了半监督单目3D检测性能，对降低标注成本有重要意义。

2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces an adaptive circular distribution in polar coordinates for query initialization, a radar-guided depth head to refine image-to-BEV transformation, and an implicit dynamic catcher exploiting radar Doppler for temporal BEV modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该工作直面雷达-相机融合中BEV变换深度不准这一核心痛点，query自适应采样与雷达引导深度头的设计思路清晰，对多相机BEV感知研究者有较高参考价值。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内单帧RGB(-D)3D目标检测中现有数据集在规模、精度和多样性上的不足，构建了CA-1M数据集，在1K+激光扫描场景上标注超40万个3D物体，并与3.5K+手持第一视角采集精确配准。提出全Transformer基线CuTR，直接从RGB(-D)的2D特征预测3D框，不依赖点云或体素表示。实验表明CuTR在3D中召回超62%的物体，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度图的噪声和不确定性更鲁棒，并具备纯RGB性能。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing indoor 3D detection datasets in scale, accuracy, and diversity, the authors introduce CA-1M, labeling over 400K 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes registered to 3.5K+ handheld egocentric captures. They propose CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline that predicts 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features without 3D inductive biases. CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforming point-based methods and being more robust to commodity LiDAR depth noise.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与配准精度是亮点，CuTR证明无3D归纳偏置的Transformer在充足数据下可超越点方法，对室内3D检测与数据驱动建模有启发。

2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（取决于物体类别、尺寸和朝向）而现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，提出RICCARDO显式利用雷达点分布模型辅助融合。首先基于单目检测器获得的物体属性预测雷达点分布，再以预测分布为核匹配邻域内实际雷达点生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精炼匹配分数。在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机检测性能，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: RICCARDO explicitly models radar hit distributions, which depend on object category, size, and orientation, to assist radar-camera fusion instead of relying on black-box networks. It predicts radar hit distributions conditioned on monocular detector outputs, uses the predicted distribution as a kernel to match measured radar points and generate matching scores, and refines scores via a fusion stage. The method achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection performance on nuScenes with open-source code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 显式建模雷达点分布替代黑盒融合的思路新颖且可解释，在nuScenes上达到SOTA并开源，对雷达-相机融合研究者有较高参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达点分布建模的雷达-相机融合方法RICCARDO用于3D目标检测。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 以预测的雷达点分布为核匹配实际雷达点，替代黑盒神经网络隐式融合。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得领先的雷达-相机3D检测性能。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖全局几何特征（笛卡尔坐标），导致检测器过度关注绝对位置而忽视局部结构。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球编码点云邻域的显式局部结构，无需额外参数且计算高效，可直接集成到现有检测器中。在单源域泛化基准上，Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP、KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP、nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源域泛化也分别超越SOTA 17、12、5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors, where existing domain generalization methods rely solely on global geometric features (Cartesian coordinates), causing over-reliance on absolute position. It proposes GBlobs, which encodes local point cloud neighborhoods with Gaussian blobs as explicit local structure, requiring no additional parameters and being highly efficient. Integrating GBlobs into existing detectors improves single-source DG by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also surpasses SOTA in multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升了LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力，提升幅度大且即插即用，对自动驾驶感知的域适应研究有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，一种无需额外参数的高效局部点云结构编码，用于提升LiDAR 3D检测的域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 首次利用高斯球显式编码局部邻域结构，替代对全局笛卡尔坐标的过度依赖，实现即插即用的域泛化增强。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在单源和多源域泛化基准上分别超越SOTA超过21/13/12 mAP和17/12/5 mAP，且不损失域内性能。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影导致的深度误差问题——物体视觉表面使边界框高度无法代表实际投影中心高度，从而削弱几何深度先验的有效性。本文提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，系统讨论了几何误差的机制与有效性，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代；同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并初始化物体查询。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth errors in monocular 3D detection caused by perspective projection, where the bounding box height fails to represent the actual projected central height due to the object's visual surface. It proposes MonoDGP, a Transformer-based method that uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, serving as a simple yet effective alternative to multi-depth prediction. It also decouples the depth-guided decoder and constructs a 2D decoder solely dependent on visual features for 2D priors and query initialization.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测中的几何误差进行了系统分析，提出的解耦查询和几何误差先验设计简洁有效，对单目3D检测研究有较好参考价值。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出MonoDGP，利用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦深度引导解码器与2D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 系统阐述几何误差机制，将其作为多深度预测的替代方案，并解耦2D/3D解码器以提供无干扰的2D先验。

2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, addressing challenges such as fewer samples per class, more classes, severe class imbalance, and diverse scene types. 2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测器特征判别能力不足的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型（LMM）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强检测器。具体包括：通过边界约束中心聚类选择生成准确语义提示的CPST模块、基于多尺度邻域点几何形状生成伪监督信号的DCPG模块，以及筛选高质量监督信号的分布形状分数（DS score）。在KITTI和Waymo数据集上验证了该方法在稀疏标注下能有效提升检测性能，相比现有稀疏监督方法具有更强的鲁棒性。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where accurate labels are extremely scarce. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. The method includes a Confident Points Semantic Transfer module, a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module, and a Distribution Shape score for selecting high-quality supervision. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo show improved performance under sparse annotation settings.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将LMM的语义先验引入稀疏监督3D检测，为缓解标注稀缺问题提供了新思路，实验覆盖主流数据集，值得关注。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM生成跨模态语义提示来增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过边界约束中心聚类和动态聚类伪标签生成，将LMM语义提示转化为高质量的3D伪监督信号。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo数据集上，稀疏标注下检测性能显著提升，优于现有稀疏监督方法。
