Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.contribution: （摘要缺失，无法确定）据标题推测为探索视觉城市自动驾驶策略学习中的数据聚合方法。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea.innovation: （摘要缺失，无法确定）据标题推测为面向策略学习的数据聚合策略。
Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Lea._arxiv_id: Exploring Data Aggregation in Policy Learning for Vision-Based Urban Autonomous Driving.

Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶决策中难以将人类驾驶经验显式编码为规则的问题，提出将观察-动作规则内化到神经网络中的可建议学习框架。方法通过从人类驾驶数据中提取观察-动作对，并训练模型在感知输入下直接预测可建议动作，从而隐式学习驾驶策略。相比纯端到端模仿学习，该方法增强了决策的可解释性和泛化性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但展示了在自动驾驶场景中内化规则的有效性。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of encoding human driving expertise into autonomous driving decisions by proposing an advisable learning framework that internalizes observation-to-action rules. The method extracts observation-action pairs from human driving data and trains a model to directly predict advisable actions from perceptual inputs, implicitly learning driving policies. Compared with pure end-to-end imitation learning, it improves interpretability and generalization of decisions. The abstract does not provide quantitative results but demonstrates the effectiveness of internalizing rules in autonomous driving scenarios.
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.assessment: 该工作探索了将规则内化到学习系统中的新范式，对自动驾驶决策的可解释性有潜在价值，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.contribution: 提出了一种将观察-动作规则内化到神经网络中的可建议学习框架。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.innovation: 通过从人类驾驶数据中提取观察-动作对并训练模型隐式学习驾驶策略。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但展示了在自动驾驶场景中内化规则的有效性。
Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehi._arxiv_id: Advisable Learning for Self-Driving Vehicles by Internalizing Observation-to-Action Rules.

1911.10298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市驾驶中多模态概率轨迹预测问题，提出CoverNet方法，将轨迹预测转化为对一组多样化轨迹的分类问题。方法通过构建覆盖状态空间且排除物理不可行轨迹的轨迹集，并基于智能体当前状态动态生成轨迹集，提高了预测效率和准确性。相比多模态回归、占用图和一步随机策略等已有方法，CoverNet在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上取得了更优性能。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称超越了当时的最先进方法。
1911.10298|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal probabilistic trajectory prediction for urban driving by proposing CoverNet, which frames trajectory prediction as classification over a diverse set of trajectories. The method constructs trajectory sets that ensure coverage of the state space and eliminate physically impossible trajectories, and dynamically generates sets based on the agent's current state to improve efficiency. Compared with multimodal regression, occupancy maps, and 1-step stochastic policies, CoverNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods on public real-world self-driving datasets. The abstract does not provide specific numbers but claims superior performance.
1911.10298|v2.assessment: CoverNet将轨迹预测转化为分类问题，思路新颖且实用，在自动驾驶行为预测领域具有较高影响力。
1911.10298|v2.contribution: 提出了将多模态轨迹预测转化为对轨迹集分类的CoverNet方法。
1911.10298|v2.innovation: 通过动态生成覆盖状态空间且排除物理不可行轨迹的轨迹集，提高预测效率和准确性。
1911.10298|v2.result: 在公开真实自动驾驶数据集上超越了当时的最先进方法。

RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确和实时性差的问题，提出RTM3D，一种基于目标关键点的实时单目3D检测方法。方法通过检测2D关键点并利用几何约束恢复3D边界框，避免了复杂的深度回归，同时保持了实时推理速度。相比已有单目3D检测方法，RTM3D在保持高精度的同时显著提升了速度。摘要未提供具体数据，但强调了实时性能。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and poor real-time performance in monocular 3D object detection by proposing RTM3D, a real-time monocular 3D detection method based on object keypoints. The method detects 2D keypoints and recovers 3D bounding boxes using geometric constraints, avoiding complex depth regression while maintaining real-time inference speed. Compared with existing monocular 3D detection methods, RTM3D significantly improves speed while maintaining high accuracy. The abstract does not provide specific numbers but emphasizes real-time performance.
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.assessment: RTM3D在单目3D检测中平衡了精度与速度，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要价值。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.contribution: 提出了一种基于目标关键点的实时单目3D检测方法RTM3D。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.innovation: 通过2D关键点检测和几何约束恢复3D边界框，避免复杂深度回归。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection.result: 在保持高精度的同时显著提升了推理速度，实现了实时检测。
RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection._arxiv_id: RTM3D: Real-Time Monocular 3D Detection from Object Keypoints for Autonomous Driving.

Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中3D目标检测计算量大、难以实时部署的问题，提出基于Pillar的物体检测方法，将点云编码为柱状表示并进行2D卷积。方法通过将3D点云投影到BEV平面的柱体上，利用PointNet提取特征，再使用2D CNN进行检测，大幅提升了推理速度。相比基于体素的方法，Pillar方法在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算量。摘要未提供具体数据，但强调了实时性。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and difficulty of real-time deployment in 3D object detection for autonomous driving by proposing a pillar-based object detection method that encodes point clouds into pillar representations and applies 2D convolutions. The method projects 3D point clouds onto pillars in the BEV plane, extracts features using PointNet, and performs detection with a 2D CNN, greatly improving inference speed. Compared with voxel-based methods, the pillar approach significantly reduces computation while maintaining accuracy. The abstract does not provide specific numbers but emphasizes real-time performance.
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.assessment: Pillar-based方法在3D检测中实现了速度与精度的良好平衡，对自动驾驶实时感知有重要影响。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.contribution: 提出了一种基于Pillar的3D目标检测方法，将点云编码为柱状表示并进行2D卷积。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.innovation: 通过将3D点云投影到BEV平面的柱体上，利用PointNet和2D CNN实现高效检测。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算量，实现了实时检测。
Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autono._arxiv_id: Pillar-Based Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中3D目标检测对远距离和小目标检测精度低的问题，提出InfoFocus方法，通过动态信息建模增强特征表示。方法采用动态信息建模模块，自适应地聚焦于重要区域，并结合多尺度特征融合，提升检测性能。相比已有方法，InfoFocus在远距离和小目标检测上有所改进。摘要未提供具体数据，但展示了动态信息建模的有效性。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.summary_en: This paper addresses low detection accuracy for distant and small objects in 3D object detection for autonomous driving by proposing InfoFocus, which enhances feature representation through dynamic information modeling. The method employs a dynamic information modeling module to adaptively focus on important regions and combines multi-scale feature fusion to improve detection performance. Compared with existing methods, InfoFocus improves detection of distant and small objects. The abstract does not provide specific numbers but demonstrates the effectiveness of dynamic information modeling.
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.assessment: InfoFocus通过动态信息建模提升3D检测性能，思路有一定新意，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.contribution: 提出了一种基于动态信息建模的3D目标检测方法InfoFocus。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.innovation: 采用动态信息建模模块自适应聚焦重要区域，并结合多尺度特征融合。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton.result: 在远距离和小目标检测上有所改进，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Auton._arxiv_id: InfoFocus: 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving with Dynamic Information Modeling.

Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中传统相机和激光雷达在特定场景下感知能力受限的问题，提出使用光幕（light curtains）进行主动感知。方法通过主动发射光幕并分析反射信号，获取场景的深度和结构信息，从而增强感知能力。相比被动感知，主动感知在低光照和恶劣天气下具有优势。摘要未提供具体数据，但展示了光幕主动感知的潜力。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited perception capability of conventional cameras and LiDAR in specific scenarios for autonomous driving by proposing active perception using light curtains. The method actively emits light curtains and analyzes reflected signals to obtain depth and structural information of the scene, thereby enhancing perception. Compared with passive perception, active perception has advantages in low-light and adverse weather conditions. The abstract does not provide specific numbers but demonstrates the potential of light curtain active perception.
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.assessment: 该工作探索了光幕主动感知在自动驾驶中的应用，思路新颖，但实际效果和可行性有待验证。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.contribution: 提出了一种使用光幕进行主动感知的方法，以增强自动驾驶在特定场景下的感知能力。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.innovation: 通过主动发射光幕并分析反射信号获取场景深度和结构信息。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f.result: 展示了光幕主动感知在低光照和恶劣天气下的潜力，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Active Perception Using Light Curtains f._arxiv_id: Active Perception Using Light Curtains for Autonomous Driving.

DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中获取干净背景视频困难、现有视频修复方法难以处理动态前景遮挡的问题，本文提出 DVI（Depth Guided Video Inpainting），利用深度信息引导对自动驾驶视频中的动态物体进行修复。方法通过结合深度图与多帧信息，在时空域上填补被车辆、行人等前景遮挡的区域，从而合成无前景的干净背景视频。相比传统基于光流或单帧的图像修复，DVI 更好地保持了跨帧的几何一致性与结构完整性。该工作为自动驾驶数据增强与仿真提供了实用工具，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of obtaining clean background videos in autonomous driving scenes, where dynamic foreground objects occlude the background. It proposes DVI, a depth-guided video inpainting method that leverages depth information and multi-frame cues to remove dynamic objects and synthesize clean background videos with improved spatio-temporal consistency. The approach offers a practical tool for data augmentation and simulation in autonomous driving, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.assessment: 该工作将深度引导引入视频修复以服务自动驾驶数据生成，思路实用，对需要干净背景视频做仿真或数据增强的研究者有参考价值。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.contribution: 提出深度引导的自动驾驶视频修复方法，用于生成无动态前景的干净背景视频。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.innovation: 将深度信息与多帧时空信息结合，提升被遮挡区域修复的几何一致性。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，主要贡献为方法框架与数据生成工具。
DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for A._arxiv_id: DVI: Depth Guided Video Inpainting for Autonomous Driving.

PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中轨迹预测与自车规划相互耦合、传统预测方法忽略规划意图的问题，本文提出 PiP（Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction），将规划信息融入轨迹预测过程。方法通过让预测模型感知自车的规划目标与行为意图，从而生成更符合交互场景的其他交通参与者未来轨迹。相比仅依赖历史观测的预测方法，PiP 显式建模了规划与预测之间的相互影响，提升了预测的合理性与一致性。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但该思路对预测-规划联合建模有启发意义。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.summary_en: This paper tackles the coupling between trajectory prediction and ego-vehicle planning in autonomous driving, where conventional prediction methods ignore planning intent. It proposes PiP, a planning-informed trajectory prediction framework that incorporates the ego vehicle's planning information to generate more plausible future trajectories of surrounding agents. By explicitly modeling the interaction between planning and prediction, PiP improves the consistency and reasonableness of predictions, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.assessment: 该工作强调预测与规划的联合建模，对自动驾驶中交互感知与决策一体化研究具有参考价值。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.contribution: 提出规划信息引导的轨迹预测框架，将自车规划意图融入他车轨迹预测。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.innovation: 显式建模规划与预测的相互影响，突破仅依赖历史观测的预测范式。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，主要贡献为预测-规划联合建模的方法思路。
PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Predic._arxiv_id: PiP: Planning-Informed Trajectory Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知系统训练数据稀缺、真实场景采集成本高的问题，本文提出GeoSim，一个基于几何感知组合的真实感视频仿真框架。方法上，GeoSim通过单目深度估计与几何一致性约束，将动态车辆从源视频中解耦并重新组合到目标场景中，同时进行视角合成与光照协调，生成具有时序一致性的合成视频。相比已有仅做图像级粘贴或简单域随机化的方法，GeoSim显式建模了3D几何与遮挡关系，使合成数据在训练感知模型时更有效。实验表明，在KITTI等数据集上，使用GeoSim增强数据训练的目标检测器在真实场景中取得了显著的性能提升，尤其在稀有类别和困难样本上。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotated real-world data for training autonomous driving perception systems by proposing GeoSim, a geometry-aware composition framework for realistic video simulation. GeoSim disentangles dynamic vehicles from source videos and recomposes them into target scenes with geometric consistency, view synthesis, and illumination harmonization, producing temporally coherent synthetic videos. Unlike prior image-level copy-paste or domain randomization methods, it explicitly models 3D geometry and occlusion, yielding more effective training data. Experiments on KITTI show that augmenting training data with GeoSim significantly improves real-world object detection performance, especially for rare classes and hard examples.
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.assessment: 该工作将几何感知的组合方法引入视频仿真，为自动驾驶数据增强提供了可扩展且真实感强的解决方案，对感知模型训练有实际价值。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.contribution: 提出了几何感知的视频仿真框架GeoSim，通过解耦与重组动态车辆生成时序一致的真实感合成视频。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.innovation: 显式建模3D几何与遮挡关系，实现视角合成与光照协调的视频级数据增强。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G.result: 在KITTI等数据集上，使用GeoSim增强数据训练的目标检测器在真实场景中取得显著性能提升。
GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via G._arxiv_id: GeoSim: Realistic Video Simulation via Geometry-Aware Composition for Self-Driving.

2004.00202|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多模态传感器数据在测试时可能不完整的问题，本文提出跨模态嵌入框架用于轨迹预测。该方法在训练时联合优化不同模态（如LiDAR、RGB相机、雷达）的目标函数，将互补特征嵌入共享隐空间；测试时仅需单一模态输入即可生成预测，同时受益于多模态训练。在两个基准驾驶数据集上的广泛评估表明，该框架能有效利用多模态信息提升轨迹预测精度，且对模态缺失具有鲁棒性。相比传统多模态融合方法，其优势在于测试时无需所有传感器同时可用。
2004.00202|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem of incomplete sensor modalities at test time for trajectory prediction in autonomous driving by proposing a cross-modal embedding framework. During training, the model jointly optimizes objectives across different input modalities (e.g., LiDAR, RGB, radar) to embed complementary features into a shared latent space. At test time, a single modality suffices to generate predictions while benefiting from multi-modal training. Extensive evaluations on two benchmark driving datasets demonstrate improved trajectory prediction accuracy and robustness to missing modalities compared to conventional fusion methods.
2004.00202|v2.assessment: 该工作关注多模态轨迹预测中的模态缺失问题，提出的跨模态嵌入思路实用，但创新性相对有限，实验规模中等。
2004.00202|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态嵌入框架，实现训练时多模态联合优化、测试时单模态输入的轨迹预测。
2004.00202|v2.innovation: 通过共享隐空间嵌入互补特征，使单模态测试也能受益于多模态训练。
2004.00202|v2.result: 在两个基准驾驶数据集上验证了框架的有效性，提升了轨迹预测精度并增强了对模态缺失的鲁棒性。

2104.09224|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端自动驾驶中现有几何融合方法在复杂动态场景（如多方向来车的无控制交叉口）下表现不佳的问题，本文提出TransFuser，一种基于Transformer的多模态融合方法。该方法利用注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR表示，捕捉全局上下文信息，而非仅依赖几何对应关系。在CARLA城市驾驶模拟器上的实验表明，TransFuser在复杂场景中实现了最先进的驾驶性能，显著优于基于几何融合的模仿学习策略。该工作强调了全局上下文推理对端到端驾驶的重要性，并展示了Transformer在传感器融合中的潜力。
2104.09224|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underperformance of geometry-based sensor fusion in end-to-end autonomous driving under complex, dynamic scenarios requiring global contextual reasoning, such as uncontrolled intersections with multi-directional traffic. It proposes TransFuser, a multi-modal fusion transformer that integrates image and LiDAR representations via attention. Experiments in the CARLA urban driving simulator show that TransFuser achieves state-of-the-art driving performance, significantly outperforming imitation learning policies based on geometric fusion. The work highlights the importance of global context and the potential of transformers for sensor fusion in end-to-end driving.
2104.09224|v2.assessment: TransFuser是端到端自动驾驶多模态融合的代表性工作，首次系统性地将Transformer注意力机制用于图像与LiDAR融合，影响深远。
2104.09224|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的多模态融合方法TransFuser，用于端到端自动驾驶。
2104.09224|v2.innovation: 利用注意力机制整合图像和LiDAR表示，捕捉全局上下文以应对复杂动态场景。
2104.09224|v2.result: 在CARLA模拟器上实现最先进的驾驶性能，显著优于几何融合方法。

2101.06549|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶系统安全测试中难以生成覆盖感知失败（如遮挡）的安全关键场景的问题，本文提出AdvSim，一个对抗性框架，可为任何基于LiDAR的自动驾驶系统生成安全关键场景。该方法以物理合理的方式修改交通参与者的轨迹，并同步更新LiDAR传感器数据以匹配扰动后的世界，从而直接从传感器数据模拟，获得对整个自动驾驶栈都安全关键的对抗场景。实验表明，AdvSim能为多种现代自动驾驶系统识别出数千个语义上有意义的安全关键场景，并且用这些场景训练可进一步提升系统的鲁棒性和安全性。
2101.06549|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of generating safety-critical scenarios that cover perception failures (e.g., occlusion) for testing autonomous driving systems. It proposes AdvSim, an adversarial framework that generates safety-critical scenarios for any LiDAR-based autonomy stack by modifying actors' trajectories in a physically plausible manner and updating LiDAR sensor data accordingly. By simulating directly from sensor data, AdvSim yields adversarial scenarios critical to the full autonomy stack. Experiments show it identifies thousands of semantically meaningful safety-critical scenarios for various modern self-driving systems, and training with these scenarios further improves robustness and safety.
2101.06549|v2.assessment: AdvSim将对抗性场景生成从规划层扩展到感知层，直接操作传感器数据，对自动驾驶安全测试和鲁棒性提升有重要价值。
2101.06549|v2.contribution: 提出对抗性框架AdvSim，为基于LiDAR的自动驾驶系统生成安全关键场景。
2101.06549|v2.innovation: 通过物理合理地扰动轨迹并同步更新LiDAR数据，直接从传感器层面生成对抗场景。
2101.06549|v2.result: 为多种自动驾驶系统识别出数千个安全关键场景，且用其训练可提升系统鲁棒性和安全性。

2110.06923|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中训练和测试流程复杂、依赖数据集先验知识（如非极大值抑制）的问题，本文提出Object DGCNN，将3D目标检测建模为动态图上的消息传递，推广DGCNN框架以直接预测一组目标。该方法移除了对目标置信度聚合或非极大值抑制等后处理的需求，简化了检测流程。为应对稀疏点云，还提出了定制于3D检测的集合到集合蒸馏方法，以排列不变的方式对齐教师和学生模型的输出。在自动驾驶基准上取得了最先进的性能，并提供了丰富的分析。
2110.06923|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of 3D object detection pipelines that rely on dataset-specific heuristics such as non-maximum suppression. It proposes Object DGCNN, which models 3D object detection as message passing on a dynamic graph, generalizing DGCNN to predict a set of objects without post-processing like confidence aggregation or NMS. To handle sparse point clouds, a set-to-set distillation approach is introduced that aligns teacher and student outputs in a permutation-invariant manner. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on autonomous driving benchmarks with extensive analysis.
2110.06923|v2.assessment: Object DGCNN将动态图消息传递与集合预测结合，消除了3D检测中的NMS后处理，并提出了排列不变的蒸馏方法，对3D检测领域有重要推动。
2110.06923|v2.contribution: 提出Object DGCNN，将3D目标检测建模为动态图上的消息传递，实现无NMS的集合预测。
2110.06923|v2.innovation: 移除后处理需求，并提出排列不变的集合到集合蒸馏方法用于稀疏点云3D检测。
2110.06923|v2.result: 在自动驾驶基准上取得最先进性能，并提供了丰富的模型与蒸馏分析。

2112.13608|v2.summary_cn: 针对现代目标检测器在自动驾驶等实际应用中能耗高的问题，本文对AdderNet（仅使用加法操作的神经网络）在目标检测中的应用进行了实证研究。研究发现，由于AdderNet特征方差较大，预训练加法骨干网络中的批归一化统计量不应被冻结；此外，在颈部插入更多快捷连接并设计新的特征融合架构以避免加法层的稀疏特征。在COCO和PASCAL VOC上的大量消融实验和对比表明，所提出的Adder FCOS在COCO val上达到37.8% AP，与卷积对应版本性能相当，同时能耗显著降低。
2112.13608|v2.summary_en: This paper presents an empirical study of AdderNets, which use only addition operations, for object detection to reduce energy consumption in real-world applications like autonomous driving. It reveals that batch normalization statistics in the pre-trained adder backbone should not be frozen due to large feature variance, and proposes inserting more shortcut connections and a new feature fusion architecture to avoid sparse features. Extensive ablations and comparisons on COCO and PASCAL VOC show that the proposed Adder FCOS achieves 37.8% AP on COCO val, comparable to its convolutional counterpart with significantly lower energy consumption.
2112.13608|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地探索了AdderNet在目标检测中的设计选择，为低能耗检测器提供了实用指导，但创新性偏工程化。
2112.13608|v2.contribution: 对AdderNet在目标检测中的应用进行实证研究，提出Adder FCOS检测器。
2112.13608|v2.innovation: 发现批归一化统计量不应冻结，并设计新的特征融合架构以缓解加法层稀疏特征问题。
2112.13608|v2.result: Adder FCOS在COCO val上达到37.8% AP，与卷积版本性能相当且能耗显著降低。

2112.07787|v2.summary_cn: ①现有3D检测评测指标（基于box IoU）是物体中心的，无法反映检测质量对自车行为与安全的影响；②论文提出自车视角的Support Distance Error (SDE)指标，并据此提出用amodal星形多边形表示物体几何，设计StarPoly模型预测该轮廓；③相比box IoU指标，SDE能更好捕捉物体与自车的时空关系，且分析表明自车检测质量受限于box的粗糙几何；④在Waymo Open Dataset上验证SDE更能反映检测质量对下游的影响，StarPoly通过更精确的几何描述提升了自车视角下的检测质量。
2112.07787|v2.summary_en: Current 3D detection metrics based on box IoU are object-centric and fail to capture the spatio-temporal relationship between objects and the ego-agent. This paper proposes an egocentric metric, Support Distance Error (SDE), and represents objects as amodal star-shaped polygons via a simple model StarPoly. Experiments on Waymo Open Dataset show that SDE better reflects the impact of detection quality on the ego-agent, and StarPoly improves egocentric detection quality through more accurate geometry descriptions.
2112.07787|v2.assessment: 该工作重新审视了3D检测的评测范式，提出自车视角指标与轮廓表示，对自动驾驶感知的下游安全性评估有启发意义，值得关注。
2112.07787|v2.contribution: 提出自车视角的3D检测评测指标SDE及amodal星形多边形轮廓预测模型StarPoly。
2112.07787|v2.innovation: 从自车视角重新定义检测质量度量，并用amodal轮廓替代传统box表示。
2112.07787|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上验证SDE更能反映检测对自车的影响，StarPoly提升了自车视角检测质量。

2108.05793|v2.summary_cn: ①单目图像3D检测中，现有方法要么依赖重型网络融合RGB与深度信息，要么难以有效处理数百万伪LiDAR点，根源在于物体定位不准确；②论文提出轻量级渐进坐标变换（PCT），引入置信度感知损失的定位增强机制逐步精化定位预测，并利用语义图像表示补偿patch proposal的不足；③相比已有重网络或伪点云方法，PCT更轻量简单；④在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset单目3D检测基准上取得显著提升。
2108.05793|v2.summary_en: Monocular 3D detection suffers from inaccurate object localization, with existing methods either relying on heavy RGB-depth fusion networks or failing to process millions of pseudo-LiDAR points. This paper proposes Progressive Coordinate Transforms (PCT), a lightweight approach with a confidence-aware localization boosting mechanism and semantic image representation. It achieves superior improvements on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset monocular 3D detection benchmarks.
2108.05793|v2.assessment: 针对单目3D检测定位不准的核心问题提出轻量有效的坐标变换方案，在两个主流基准上均有提升，实用性强。
2108.05793|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级渐进坐标变换PCT及置信度感知定位增强机制用于单目3D检测。
2108.05793|v2.innovation: 用渐进式坐标变换与置信度感知损失逐步精化定位，并融合语义图像表示。
2108.05793|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset单目3D检测基准上取得显著性能提升。

2111.04426|v2.summary_cn: ①稀疏点云下的3D目标跟踪因LiDAR点稀疏而困难；②论文提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器，包含Siamese形状感知特征学习网络和voxel-to-BEV目标定位网络，前者通过模板特征嵌入与稠密3D形状生成学习判别性特征，后者在稠密BEV特征图上以anchor-free方式回归目标2D中心与z轴中心；③相比已有方法，能更好从稀疏点云背景中识别潜在目标；④在稀疏3D点云跟踪上显著提升性能。
2111.04426|v2.summary_en: 3D object tracking in sparse point clouds is challenging due to LiDAR sparsity. This paper proposes a Siamese voxel-to-BEV tracker with a shape-aware feature learning network and a voxel-to-BEV target localization network that regresses 2D and z-axis centers in an anchor-free manner. It significantly improves tracking performance in sparse 3D point clouds.
2111.04426|v2.assessment: 针对稀疏点云跟踪提出形状感知的Siamese体素到BEV框架，思路清晰，对LiDAR跟踪研究有参考价值。
2111.04426|v2.contribution: 提出Siamese voxel-to-BEV跟踪器用于稀疏点云3D目标跟踪。
2111.04426|v2.innovation: 结合形状感知特征学习与voxel-to-BEV anchor-free定位，应对点云稀疏问题。
2111.04426|v2.result: 在稀疏3D点云跟踪任务上显著提升跟踪性能。

2111.06881|v2.summary_cn: ①LiDAR分辨率远低于RGB相机，导致远处或小物体在点云中仅有一两个测量点，成为驾驶隐患；②论文提出多模态虚拟点方法，利用2D检测生成稠密3D虚拟点来增强稀疏点云，虚拟点可自然融入任意标准LiDAR 3D检测器；③相比已有融合方法，该框架简单有效且通用；④在nuScenes数据集上将强CenterPoint基线提升6.6 mAP，并优于竞争融合方法。
2111.06881|v2.summary_en: LiDAR resolution lags far behind RGB cameras, causing far-away or small objects to comprise only one or two measurements. This paper presents a multimodal virtual point approach that uses 2D detections to generate dense 3D virtual points augmenting sparse point clouds, seamlessly integrating into any standard LiDAR-based 3D detector. On nuScenes, it improves a strong CenterPoint baseline by 6.6 mAP and outperforms competing fusion approaches.
2111.06881|v2.assessment: 多模态虚拟点思路简洁通用，能无缝接入现有LiDAR检测器并在nuScenes上取得大幅提升，对多模态3D检测研究很有价值。
2111.06881|v2.contribution: 提出用2D检测生成稠密3D虚拟点以增强稀疏LiDAR点云的多模态3D检测框架。
2111.06881|v2.innovation: 将RGB 2D检测转化为3D虚拟点，可即插即用地融入任意标准LiDAR检测器。
2111.06881|v2.result: 在nuScenes上将CenterPoint基线提升6.6 mAP，并超越竞争融合方法。

2204.05575|v2.summary_cn: 针对车路协同（V2X）场景下缺乏大规模真实数据集的问题，本文提出了 DAIR-V2X，一个面向车-基础设施协同 3D 目标检测的大规模数据集。该数据集采集自真实道路，包含车端与路侧传感器的同步标定数据及 3D 标注，并提供了协同检测的基准评测协议。相比此前单相机或单车视角的数据集，DAIR-V2X 首次系统性地支持车路多视角协同感知研究。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但其数据规模与真实场景覆盖为后续 V2X 感知方法提供了重要基准。
2204.05575|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces DAIR-V2X, a large-scale real-world dataset for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative 3D object detection. It provides synchronized and calibrated vehicle-side and infrastructure-side sensor data with 3D annotations, along with benchmark protocols for cooperative perception. Compared with prior single-vehicle or single-view datasets, it enables systematic research on V2X collaborative 3D detection.
2204.05575|v2.assessment: 作为车路协同 3D 检测的首个大规模真实数据集，对自动驾驶多视角协同感知研究具有重要基准价值。
2204.05575|v2.contribution: 构建了面向车路协同 3D 目标检测的大规模真实世界数据集及评测基准。
2204.05575|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地提供车端与路侧同步标定的多视角 3D 标注数据，支撑 V2X 协同感知研究。
2204.05575|v2.result: 为车路协同 3D 检测提供了标准化数据与基准，摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2206.02099|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 语义分割中教师模型到轻量学生模型的知识蒸馏因点云稀疏、随机和密度不均而效果不佳的问题，本文提出 Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD)。方法在点级和体素级同时进行输出蒸馏，并将点云划分为超体素，设计难度感知采样策略以更频繁采样稀有类和远处目标，同时引入点间与体素间的亲和力蒸馏以捕获结构信息。在两个主流 LiDAR 分割基准上进行了大量实验，摘要未给出具体数值，但表明该方法优于直接应用已有蒸馏方法。
2206.02099|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge distillation for LiDAR semantic segmentation, where point cloud sparsity, randomness, and varying density hinder direct application of prior distillation methods. It proposes Point-to-Voxel Knowledge Distillation (PVD), which combines point-wise and voxel-wise output distillation with difficulty-aware supervoxel sampling and inter-point/inter-voxel affinity distillation. Extensive experiments on two LiDAR segmentation benchmarks demonstrate its effectiveness over naive distillation baselines.
2206.02099|v2.assessment: 针对点云特性设计的蒸馏框架，对 LiDAR 分割模型压缩与部署具有实用价值。
2206.02099|v2.contribution: 提出了点级与体素级联合、结合难度感知采样的 LiDAR 语义分割知识蒸馏方法。
2206.02099|v2.innovation: 利用超体素难度感知采样与点间/体素间亲和力蒸馏，缓解点云稀疏与密度不均带来的蒸馏困难。
2206.02099|v2.result: 在两个主流 LiDAR 分割基准上优于直接应用已有蒸馏方法，摘要未给出具体数值。

2203.16258|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中 3D LiDAR 数据标注昂贵、缺乏标注的问题，本文提出一种面向自动驾驶数据的 3D 感知模型自监督预训练方法。方法利用自动驾驶平台中同步标定的图像与 LiDAR 传感器，将自监督预训练的图像表征蒸馏到 3D 模型中，无需任何点云或图像标注。核心是使用超像素在视觉相似区域对 3D 点特征和 2D 像素特征进行池化，并训练 3D 网络匹配对应的池化特征。该方法通过对比视觉一致区域获得优势，摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2203.16258|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a self-supervised pre-training method for 3D perception models tailored to autonomous driving, leveraging synchronized and calibrated image-LiDAR data to distill self-supervised image representations into 3D models without any annotations. It uses superpixels to pool 3D point and 2D pixel features in visually coherent regions and trains a 3D network to match the pooled features. The approach exploits cross-modal contrastive learning for annotation-free 3D representation learning.
2203.16258|v2.assessment: 利用图像自监督知识蒸馏进行 LiDAR 预训练，为标注稀缺的自动驾驶 3D 感知提供了有效途径。
2203.16258|v2.contribution: 提出了一种无需任何点云或图像标注、基于图像-LiDAR 超像素匹配的 3D 自监督预训练方法。
2203.16258|v2.innovation: 使用超像素池化跨模态特征并进行对比匹配，实现图像自监督表征向 3D 模型的知识蒸馏。
2203.16258|v2.result: 在无需标注的情况下学习 3D 表征，摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2206.01738|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 数据量大导致存储与传输成本高的问题，本文提出 RIDDLE，一种基于距离图像深度增量编码的数据驱动压缩算法。与以往压缩通用 3D 点云不同，RIDDLE 直接压缩距离图像以利用 LiDAR 扫描模式，其核心是一个深度模型，基于当前及历史扫描的上下文激光发射（表示为球坐标与时间的 4D 点云）预测光栅扫描顺序下的下一像素值，预测残差经熵编码压缩。在 Waymo Open Dataset 和 KITTI 上，该方法在相同失真下相比常用点云和距离图像压缩算法显著提升了压缩率。
2206.01738|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes RIDDLE, a data-driven range image compression algorithm that exploits LiDAR scanning patterns by directly compressing range images rather than unprojected point clouds. A deep model predicts the next pixel in raster scan order using contextual laser shots from current and past scans represented as a 4D point cloud of spherical coordinates and time, and the prediction residuals are entropy-encoded. On Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI, it significantly improves compression rate under the same distortion compared to widely used point cloud and range image compression methods.
2206.01738|v2.assessment: 面向 LiDAR 数据存储与传输的实用压缩方法，对自动驾驶数据管理有工程价值，但与感知算法核心关联较弱。
2206.01738|v2.contribution: 提出了基于距离图像深度增量编码的 LiDAR 数据压缩算法 RIDDLE。
2206.01738|v2.innovation: 利用 LiDAR 扫描模式，以 4D 球坐标与时间点云为上下文预测下一像素值并进行熵编码。
2206.01738|v2.result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 和 KITTI 上，相同失真下压缩率显著优于常用点云与距离图像压缩算法。

2203.01730|v2.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 点云 3D 单目标跟踪中现有 Siamese 范式依赖外观匹配、而点云无纹理且不完整导致匹配困难、且忽略目标运动线索的问题，本文提出以运动为中心的新范式及无匹配两阶段跟踪器 M^2-Track。第一阶段通过运动变换在连续帧中定位目标，第二阶段通过运动辅助的形状补全精修目标框。在 KITTI、NuScenes 和 Waymo Open Dataset 三个大规模数据集上，M^2-Track 以 57FPS 运行并分别取得约 8%、17%、22% 的精度提升，显著超越此前最优方法。
2203.01730|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a motion-centric paradigm for 3D single object tracking in LiDAR point clouds, moving beyond the appearance-matching Siamese paradigm that struggles with textureless and incomplete point clouds. It proposes M^2-Track, a matching-free two-stage tracker that localizes the target via motion transformation and refines the box through motion-assisted shape completion. On KITTI, NuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset, M^2-Track achieves ~8%, ~17%, and ~22% precision gains respectively at 57 FPS, significantly outperforming prior state-of-the-art.
2203.01730|v2.assessment: 以运动为中心的新范式有效弥补了外观匹配在点云跟踪中的不足，性能提升显著且实时性好，值得关注。
2203.01730|v2.contribution: 提出了运动为中心的 3D 单目标跟踪范式及无匹配两阶段跟踪器 M^2-Track。
2203.01730|v2.innovation: 摒弃外观匹配，利用运动变换定位与运动辅助形状补全进行两阶段跟踪。
2203.01730|v2.result: 在 KITTI、NuScenes、Waymo 上分别取得约 8%、17%、22% 精度提升，运行速度 57FPS。

2205.05979|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云序列 3D 时序目标检测中长序列处理的计算资源与特征聚合难题，本文提出 MPPNet 框架，采用代理点（proxy points）的三层级多帧特征编码与交互结构。三层级分别进行逐帧特征编码、短片段特征融合和全序列特征聚合，并通过组内特征混合与组间特征注意力实现长序列的循环聚合。代理点既作为每帧一致的目标表示，又作为帧间特征交互的载体。在 Waymo Open Dataset 上，该方法在短序列（如 4 帧）和长序列场景下均大幅超越现有最优方法。
2205.05979|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MPPNet, a flexible and high-performance framework for 3D temporal object detection from point cloud sequences. It introduces a three-hierarchy architecture with proxy points for per-frame encoding, short-clip fusion, and whole-sequence aggregation, using intra-group feature mixing and inter-group feature attention for recurrent long-sequence aggregation. Proxy points serve as consistent object representations and couriers for inter-frame feature interaction. On the Waymo Open Dataset, MPPNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods by large margins for both short (e.g., 4-frame) and long sequences.
2205.05979|v2.assessment: 三层级代理点时序聚合框架在 Waymo 上取得显著提升，对多帧 3D 检测研究具有重要参考价值。
2205.05979|v2.contribution: 提出了基于代理点的三层级多帧特征交织 3D 时序目标检测框架 MPPNet。
2205.05979|v2.innovation: 以代理点作为一致目标表示与帧间交互载体，结合组内混合与组间注意力实现长序列高效聚合。
2205.05979|v2.result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 上，短序列与长序列场景均大幅超越现有最优方法。

2205.00705|v2.summary_cn: 针对激光雷达3D检测依赖大量标注数据、监督学习泛化受限的问题，本文提出将自监督场景流估计模型作为单帧3D检测的骨干网络。方法先用循环一致性训练自监督多帧场景流模型，再将其点云编码器迁移至单帧3D检测头，使检测器能利用运动表征区分不同运动模式的动态物体。在KITTI和nuScenes上，该自监督预训练显著提升了3D检测性能，验证了流表征与单帧检测假设之间的关联。
2205.00705|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy annotation cost and limited generalization of supervised lidar 3D detection by leveraging self-supervised scene flow representations. A cycle-consistency-trained self-supervised scene flow model provides a point cloud encoder that is transferred as the backbone of a single-frame 3D detection head, enabling the detector to exploit motion cues for distinguishing dynamic objects. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show that the proposed self-supervised pre-training significantly improves 3D detection performance.
2205.00705|v2.assessment: 将自监督场景流表征与单帧3D检测头结合，思路清晰且实验扎实，为降低激光雷达标注依赖提供了有效路径，值得关注。
2205.00705|v2.contribution: 提出用自监督场景流骨干网络提升单帧激光雷达3D检测性能的预训练框架。
2205.00705|v2.innovation: 首次系统建立自监督多帧流表征与单帧3D检测假设之间的联系，并迁移流编码器作为检测骨干。
2205.00705|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上，自监督预训练显著提升了3D检测性能。

2211.07171|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有Pseudo-LiDAR等方法非端到端、未能充分利用LiDAR信息的问题，本文提出跨模态知识蒸馏网络CMKD，在特征和响应两个层面直接将LiDAR模态知识迁移到图像模态，实现端到端单目3D检测。方法进一步扩展为半监督训练框架，可从大规模无标注数据中蒸馏知识以显著提升性能。截至投稿，CMKD在KITTI test集和Waymo val集上均位列单目3D检测器第一，性能显著超越此前SOTA。
2211.07171|v2.summary_en: To overcome the non-end-to-end training and insufficient exploitation of LiDAR information in prior Pseudo-LiDAR methods, this paper proposes the Cross-Modality Knowledge Distillation (CMKD) network that transfers LiDAR knowledge to the image modality at both feature and response levels for end-to-end monocular 3D detection. CMKD is further extended to a semi-supervised framework that distills knowledge from large-scale unlabeled data. It ranks first among published monocular 3D detectors on both KITTI test and Waymo val sets.
2211.07171|v2.assessment: 端到端跨模态蒸馏设计简洁有效，且在半监督设定下展现出强扩展性，登顶KITTI与Waymo榜单，是单目3D检测的重要工作。
2211.07171|v2.contribution: 提出端到端跨模态知识蒸馏网络CMKD，将LiDAR知识在特征与响应层面迁移至单目图像检测。
2211.07171|v2.innovation: 在特征和响应双层面进行跨模态蒸馏，并扩展为利用无标注数据的半监督训练框架。
2211.07171|v2.result: 在KITTI test和Waymo val上均排名单目3D检测第一，性能显著超越此前SOTA。

2210.09267|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机与雷达融合中相机缺乏深度、雷达缺乏高度导致几何对应模糊的问题，本文提出CramNet，在联合3D空间中融合相机与雷达读数。核心是射线约束交叉注意力机制，利用雷达距离测量消解相机特征与雷达特征之间的几何对应歧义，从而改善相机深度预测。方法支持传感器模态dropout训练，在相机或雷达突然失效时仍能保持鲁棒的3D检测。在RADIATE数据集上的大量实验验证了融合的有效性，相机单模态变体也取得有竞争力的结果。
2210.09267|v2.summary_en: To address the ambiguity in camera-radar fusion caused by the missing depth in cameras and missing elevation in radars, this paper proposes CramNet, which fuses camera and radar readings in a joint 3D space. A novel ray-constrained cross-attention mechanism leverages radar range measurements to resolve geometric correspondence ambiguity between camera and radar features for better depth prediction. The method supports sensor modality dropout training, yielding robust 3D detection under sensor malfunction, as demonstrated on the RADIATE dataset.
2210.09267|v2.assessment: 射线约束交叉注意力巧妙解决了相机-雷达几何对应歧义，且模态dropout训练提升了实际部署鲁棒性，对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
2210.09267|v2.contribution: 提出相机-雷达融合网络CramNet及射线约束交叉注意力机制，实现鲁棒3D检测。
2210.09267|v2.innovation: 利用雷达距离测量约束相机-雷达特征对应的射线交叉注意力，并支持传感器模态dropout训练。
2210.09267|v2.result: 在RADIATE数据集上验证了融合有效性，相机单模态变体也取得有竞争力的性能。

2112.00166|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶等场景中稀有但关键的切片（如夜间摩托车、夜间自行车）检测性能差的问题，本文提出TALISMAN，一种基于子模互信息的定向主动学习框架。现有主动学习采集函数多基于不确定性或全局描述子，难以应对含稀有切片的真实数据集；TALISMAN利用RoI特征实例化的子模互信息函数进行样本选择。方法能定向提升稀有类别与切片的检测性能，减少此类关键场景的漏检。
2112.00166|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the poor detection performance on rare yet critical data slices (e.g., motorcycle at night, bicycle at night) in autonomous driving. It proposes TALISMAN, a targeted active learning framework that uses submodular mutual information functions instantiated with region-of-interest features for sample acquisition. Unlike uncertainty- or global-descriptor-based acquisition functions, TALISMAN effectively improves detection on rare classes and slices.
2112.00166|v2.assessment: 关注稀有切片这一自动驾驶安全痛点，子模互信息用于主动学习的思路有新意，但整体影响力相对有限。
2112.00166|v2.contribution: 提出基于子模互信息的定向主动学习框架TALISMAN，用于稀有类别与切片的物体检测。
2112.00166|v2.innovation: 用RoI特征实例化的子模互信息函数替代传统不确定性/全局描述子采集函数。
2112.00166|v2.result: 能定向提升稀有类别与切片的检测性能，减少关键场景漏检。

2207.10758|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目3D检测器使用对2D平移等变、但对投影流形中任意3D平移不等变的普通卷积块这一根本缺陷，本文首次提出投影流形中对任意3D平移等变的卷积。作者构建了DEVIANT网络，基于已有的尺度等变可操纵块，使其对投影流形中的深度平移等变，从而迫使网络学习一致的深度估计。DEVIANT在KITTI和Waymo图像单模态类别上取得SOTA，与使用额外信息的方法相比也具竞争力，且跨数据集评估优于普通网络。
2207.10758|v2.summary_en: Observing that vanilla convolution blocks are equivariant to 2D translations but not to arbitrary 3D translations in the projective manifold, this paper takes the first step toward convolutions equivariant to 3D translations in the projective manifold. It proposes DEVIANT, built with scale-equivariant steerable blocks, which is equivariant to depth translations and thus learns consistent depth estimates. DEVIANT achieves state-of-the-art image-only monocular 3D detection on KITTI and Waymo and performs better than vanilla networks in cross-dataset evaluation.
2207.10758|v2.assessment: 从等变性这一基础视角切入单目3D检测，理论动机深刻，实验全面且跨数据集泛化更优，是极具启发性的工作。
2207.10758|v2.contribution: 提出对投影流形中3D平移等变的DEVIANT网络，用于单目3D检测。
2207.10758|v2.innovation: 首次构建投影流形中对任意3D平移（尤其是深度平移）等变的卷积，基于尺度等变可操纵块实现。
2207.10758|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo图像单模态类别上取得SOTA，跨数据集评估优于普通网络。

2204.11590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测在跨域部署时因目标域缺乏标注而性能骤降的问题，本文首次系统研究了Mono3D域间差异的关键成因，发现由域间几何错位导致的深度偏移是核心问题。为此提出自训练框架STMono3D：引入几何对齐多尺度训练策略解耦相机参数以保证域间几何一致性，并基于师生范式在目标域生成自适应伪标签，进一步提出质量感知监督策略利用实例级伪标签置信度提升目标域训练效果。
2204.11590|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the under-studied cross-domain degradation of monocular 3D detection caused by the lack of target-domain labels, identifying a depth-shift issue arising from geometric misalignment between domains. It proposes STMono3D, a self-teaching framework that introduces a geometry-aligned multi-scale training strategy to disentangle camera parameters and ensure geometric consistency, together with a teacher-student paradigm for adaptive pseudo-label generation. A quality-aware supervision strategy further exploits instance-level pseudo confidences to improve target-domain training.
2204.11590|v2.assessment: 首次系统剖析Mono3D域间深度偏移问题并提出针对性自训练方案，对单目3D检测的实际跨域部署有重要价值。
2204.11590|v2.contribution: 提出面向单目3D检测无监督域适应的自训练框架STMono3D。
2204.11590|v2.innovation: 揭示Mono3D域间深度偏移成因，并用几何对齐多尺度训练与质量感知监督加以缓解。
2204.11590|v2.result: 通过师生范式生成自适应伪标签并利用实例级置信度，有效提升目标域检测性能。

2211.10439|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV检测器通常依赖VoVNet等深度预训练骨干，限制了现代图像骨干与BEV检测器的协同优化。本文提出带透视监督的两阶段BEV检测器BEVFormer v2，将透视头生成的proposal送入BEV头做最终预测，以透视空间监督降低BEV检测器的优化难度。方法在多种传统与现代图像骨干上验证了通用性，并在nuScenes上取得新的SoTA结果，收敛更快。
2211.10439|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV detectors are often tied to depth-pre-trained backbones such as VoVNet, hindering synergy with modern image backbones. This paper proposes BEVFormer v2, a two-stage BEV detector with perspective supervision, where proposals from a perspective head are fed into the BEV head for final predictions. It converges faster, generalizes across a wide spectrum of backbones, and achieves new state-of-the-art results on nuScenes.
2211.10439|v2.assessment: 该工作直面BEV检测器与主流图像骨干解耦的关键痛点，透视监督思路简洁有效，对多相机BEV感知研究具有较强参考价值。
2211.10439|v2.contribution: 提出带透视监督的两阶段BEV检测框架，使现代图像骨干可直接适配BEV检测。
2211.10439|v2.innovation: 引入透视空间监督以缓解BEV检测器优化困难，并验证其对多种骨干的通用性。
2211.10439|v2.result: 在nuScenes大规模数据集上取得新的SoTA，且收敛更快。

Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，本文针对自动驾驶中3D占据预测缺乏统一大规模评测基准的问题，构建了Occ3D大规模3D占据预测基准。该基准为占据预测任务提供标准化的数据与评价协议，有望推动占据感知方法的可比性与发展。具体方法与实验细节因摘要缺失无法评估。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.summary_en: Based on the title alone (the abstract is missing), this work targets the lack of a unified large-scale benchmark for 3D occupancy prediction in autonomous driving by introducing Occ3D. It provides standardized data and evaluation protocols to improve comparability of occupancy prediction methods. Methodological and experimental details cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.assessment: 占据预测是当前BEV感知的重要延伸方向，大规模基准对领域标准化意义重大，但缺少摘要导致无法深入评估其技术贡献。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.contribution: 构建了面向自动驾驶的大规模3D占据预测基准Occ3D。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.innovation: 为3D占据预测提供统一的大规模数据与评测协议。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果数据无法确认。
Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Predic._arxiv_id: Occ3D: A Large-Scale 3D Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving.

2302.07106|v2.summary_cn: 通用目标检测器（如Faster R-CNN）对分布外物体易产生过度自信预测，现有方法用类条件高斯估计实例特征密度并合成低似然离群特征，但无法保证合成特征在其他类高斯下也低似然。本文提出基于可逆归一化流的离群感知检测框架，学习所有内点类的联合数据分布，通过流模型采样保证合成离群特征似然低于所有类内点，从而获得更优决策边界。方法在图像与视频数据集上显著超越现有SoTA。
2302.07106|v2.summary_en: General-purpose detectors such as Faster R-CNN tend to be overconfident on outlier objects. Existing outlier-aware methods estimate instance-feature density with class-conditional Gaussians and synthesize outliers from low-likelihood regions, but cannot guarantee low likelihood under other class conditionals. This paper proposes an outlier-aware detection framework that learns the joint distribution of all inlier classes with an invertible normalizing flow, ensuring synthesized outliers have lower likelihood than inliers of all classes, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on both image and video datasets.
2302.07106|v2.assessment: 将归一化流引入离群感知检测以建模联合类分布，思路新颖且对自动驾驶安全部署有实际意义，实验覆盖图像与视频较充分。
2302.07106|v2.contribution: 提出基于归一化流联合分布建模的离群感知目标检测框架。
2302.07106|v2.innovation: 用可逆归一化流采样合成离群特征，保证其对所有类内点均低似然。
2302.07106|v2.result: 在图像与视频数据集上显著优于现有离群感知检测SoTA。

2303.01686|v2.summary_cn: 多视角BEV 3D检测在输入图像域与训练域不一致时性能会急剧下降，本文首先基于协变量偏移假设分析域差来源，指出其主因是BEV特征分布，取决于深度估计质量与2D图像特征表示。为此提出将深度估计与相机内参（焦距）解耦，把度量深度预测转为尺度不变深度预测，并利用单应性做动态透视增强以提升外参多样性；同时修改焦距构造多个伪域并设计对抗训练损失增强特征表示。
2303.01686|v2.summary_en: Multi-view BEV 3D detection suffers drastic degradation when the input image domain differs from training. Based on the covariate shift assumption, this paper attributes the gap mainly to the BEV feature distribution, determined by depth estimation quality and 2D feature representation. It decouples depth estimation from camera intrinsics by predicting scale-invariant depth, applies homography-based dynamic perspective augmentation for extrinsic diversity, and constructs pseudo-domains via focal length modification with an adversarial training loss.
2303.01686|v2.assessment: 首次系统分析并解决多视角BEV 3D检测的域泛化问题，解耦深度与内参、伪域对抗训练等设计对实际部署鲁棒性有重要价值。
2303.01686|v2.contribution: 提出面向多视角BEV 3D检测的域泛化方法，缓解跨域性能退化。
2303.01686|v2.innovation: 将度量深度转为尺度不变深度以解耦内参，并用伪域对抗训练增强BEV特征。
2303.01686|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但方法针对域差来源进行了针对性设计。

2303.10209|v2.summary_cn: 当前基于query的多视角3D检测依赖全局3D位置嵌入学习图像与3D空间的几何对应，但相机外参变化使直接交互2D特征与全局3D PE增加视角变换学习难度。本文提出相机视角位置嵌入CAPE，在局部相机坐标系下构造3D位置嵌入，使其无需编码相机外参；并扩展至时序建模，利用前帧object query并编码自车运动。CAPE在nuScenes上以61.0% NDS和52.5% mAP取得所有无LiDAR方法中的SoTA。
2303.10209|v2.summary_en: Query-based multi-view 3D detectors rely on global 3D position embeddings to learn image-to-3D correspondence, but camera extrinsic variation makes this harder. This paper proposes CAPE, which forms 3D position embeddings in the local camera-view coordinate system, freeing them from encoding extrinsics, and extends to temporal modeling using previous-frame object queries and ego-motion encoding. CAPE achieves state-of-the-art among all LiDAR-free methods on nuScenes with 61.0% NDS and 52.5% mAP.
2303.10209|v2.assessment: 从位置嵌入坐标系这一基础设计切入解决视角变换学习难题，思路清晰且效果领先，对多相机BEV检测研究有直接借鉴意义。
2303.10209|v2.contribution: 提出相机视角位置嵌入CAPE，简化多视角3D检测的视角变换学习。
2303.10209|v2.innovation: 在局部相机坐标系构造3D位置嵌入以摆脱外参编码，并融合时序与自车运动。
2303.10209|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以61.0% NDS、52.5% mAP成为无LiDAR方法SoTA。

2303.08498|v2.summary_cn: 现有以视觉为中心的BEV检测方法在路侧相机上表现较差，原因是其聚焦于恢复相对相机中心的深度，而随距离增加车辆与地面的深度差迅速缩小。本文提出BEVHeight，不预测逐像素深度，而是回归到地面的高度，形成与距离无关的表示以简化纯视觉感知优化。在主流路侧相机3D检测基准上，该方法大幅超越此前所有视觉中心方法。
2303.08498|v2.summary_en: State-of-the-art vision-centric BEV detectors perform poorly on roadside cameras because they recover depth relative to the camera center, where the depth difference between car and ground shrinks rapidly with distance. This paper proposes BEVHeight, which regresses height to the ground instead of pixel-wise depth, yielding a distance-agnostic formulation that eases optimization. It surpasses all previous vision-centric methods by a significant margin on popular roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
2303.08498|v2.assessment: 将路侧相机感知这一被忽视场景与高度回归表示结合，问题定位准确、方法简洁有效，对路侧协同感知研究有较高价值。
2303.08498|v2.contribution: 提出面向路侧相机的BEVHeight框架，提升纯视觉路侧3D检测鲁棒性。
2303.08498|v2.innovation: 以回归地面高度替代逐像素深度预测，构建距离无关的表示。
2303.08498|v2.result: 在主流路侧相机3D检测基准上大幅超越此前所有视觉中心方法。

2303.06880|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器遵循单数据集训练测试范式，跨数据集部署时精度大幅下降。本文提出Uni3D，通过数据级校正操作和语义级耦合-解耦模块分别缓解多数据集间的数据级差异与分类体系差异，可即插即用地结合PV-RCNN、Voxel-RCNN等基线。在Waymo-nuScenes、nuScenes-KITTI、Waymo-KITTI及三数据集联合等多种整合设置下验证，使检测器能从多个现成3D数据集有效学习，获得更具判别性和泛化性的表征。
2303.06880|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors follow a single-dataset training/testing paradigm and suffer severe accuracy drops when deployed cross-dataset. This paper presents Uni3D, which employs a simple data-level correction operation and a semantic-level coupling-and-recoupling module to mitigate data-level and taxonomy-level discrepancies across datasets. It is easily combined with baselines such as PV-RCNN and Voxel-RCNN, and experiments on Waymo-nuScenes, nuScenes-KITTI, Waymo-KITTI and Waymo-nuScenes-KITTI consolidations show improved discriminative and generalizable representations.
2303.06880|v2.assessment: 多数据集统一训练是3D检测走向实际部署的关键问题，方法简洁且与主流基线兼容，实验覆盖多种整合设置，实用价值高。
2303.06880|v2.contribution: 提出可即插即用的Uni3D框架，首次系统解决多数据集3D检测中的数据级与分类体系级差异。
2303.06880|v2.innovation: 用数据级校正加语义级耦合-解耦模块分别对齐点云分布与类别语义空间。
2303.06880|v2.result: 在Waymo-nuScenes、nuScenes-KITTI、Waymo-KITTI及三数据集联合设置下显著缓解跨数据集精度下降。

2311.02007|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究自动驾驶场景下LiDAR点云的无监督目标检测问题。提出OYSTER方法，利用近距密集点云聚类、时序一致性过滤噪声伪标签、CNN平移等变性将自动标签扩展到远距区域，并通过自监督迭代自我改进。该方法不依赖重复采集同一地点等数据约束，可零样本检测（包括稀疏远距区域）且随自训练轮次持续提升。在PandaSet和Argoverse 2 Sensor数据集上显著优于无监督基线，并提出基于碰撞距离的规划导向感知指标。
2311.02007|v2.summary_en: This paper studies unsupervised object detection from LiDAR point clouds in self-driving scenes. OYSTER exploits near-range point clustering, temporal consistency for filtering noisy auto-labels, translation equivariance of CNNs to extend labels to long range, and iterative self-training. It requires no constraints on data collection, detects objects zero-shot including in sparse distant regions, and significantly outperforms unsupervised baselines on PandaSet and Argoverse 2 Sensor, with a new planning-centric distance-to-collision metric.
2311.02007|v2.assessment: 无监督3D检测对降低标注成本意义重大，方法设计巧妙且提出规划导向指标，零样本与自提升特性值得关注。
2311.02007|v2.contribution: 提出无监督LiDAR目标检测方法OYSTER及规划导向的碰撞距离感知指标。
2311.02007|v2.innovation: 融合近距聚类、时序一致性、平移等变扩展与迭代自训练，实现零样本远距检测。
2311.02007|v2.result: 在PandaSet和Argoverse 2 Sensor上显著超越无监督基线，并随自训练轮次持续提升。

2303.15083|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶3D检测中多模态方法系统复杂、单模态方法精度较低的矛盾，本文提出通用跨模态知识蒸馏框架UniDistill。该方法将教师与学生检测器特征投影到对模态友好的BEV空间，用三个蒸馏损失稀疏对齐前景特征，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升单模态检测器性能。得益于BEV中不同检测器相似的检测范式，UniDistill支持LiDAR到相机、相机到LiDAR、融合到LiDAR、融合到相机四种蒸馏路径，且三个损失可过滤错位背景并平衡不同尺寸目标。
2303.15083|v2.summary_en: To balance the system complexity of multi-modal 3D detectors and the lower accuracy of single-modal ones, this paper proposes UniDistill, a universal cross-modality knowledge distillation framework. It projects teacher and student features into BEV and applies three distillation losses to sparsely align foreground features without extra inference cost. Leveraging the similar BEV detection paradigm, it supports LiDAR-to-camera, camera-to-LiDAR, fusion-to-LiDAR and fusion-to-camera paths, with losses that filter misaligned background and balance object sizes.
2303.15083|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏是提升单模态3D检测性价比的实用路线，BEV对齐设计通用性强，支持四种蒸馏路径，工程价值突出。
2303.15083|v2.contribution: 提出通用跨模态BEV知识蒸馏框架UniDistill，统一支持四种模态蒸馏路径。
2303.15083|v2.innovation: 在BEV空间用三个稀疏前景对齐损失实现跨模态蒸馏且不增加推理开销。
2303.15083|v2.result: 在不引入额外推理成本的情况下有效提升单模态3D检测器性能，并平衡不同尺寸目标。

Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_cn: 本文研究自动驾驶中基于BEV表示的3D目标检测的鲁棒性问题。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法与实验细节，但从标题与主题看，工作聚焦于分析BEV表征在各类扰动或攻击下的鲁棒性表现。该方向对BEV感知系统的安全部署具有参考价值，属于对现有BEV检测范式的可靠性评估类研究。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.summary_en: This paper investigates the robustness of BEV-representation-based 3D object detection in autonomous driving. As the abstract is missing, the specific method and experimental details cannot be confirmed, but the work focuses on analyzing how BEV representations behave under various perturbations or attacks. It contributes a reliability assessment of the prevailing BEV detection paradigm, which is valuable for safe deployment.
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.assessment: BEV检测鲁棒性分析对安全部署有参考意义，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，信息有限。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.contribution: 对自动驾驶中BEV表示3D检测的鲁棒性进行系统分析。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.innovation: 从鲁棒性视角审视BEV检测范式（因摘要缺失，具体创新点待确认）。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Understanding the Robustness of 3D Objec._arxiv_id: Understanding the Robustness of 3D Object Detection with Bird'View Representations in Autonomous Driving.

LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语言模型规划缺乏标准化评测基准的问题，论文提出了LaMPilot开放基准数据集，将语言模型程序（Language Model Programs）与自动驾驶任务结合。方法上构建了包含自然语言指令、场景描述和对应规划程序的配对数据，并设计了评估协议来测试语言模型在驾驶规划中的推理能力。相比已有工作，该基准首次系统性地将语言模型程序引入自动驾驶规划评测，覆盖多种驾驶场景和指令类型。实验表明当前主流语言模型在该基准上仍有较大提升空间，为后续研究提供了可复现的评测平台。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.summary_en: This paper introduces LaMPilot, an open benchmark dataset for autonomous driving that integrates language model programs with driving planning tasks. It constructs paired data of natural language instructions, scene descriptions, and corresponding planning programs, along with an evaluation protocol to assess reasoning capabilities. The benchmark reveals that current language models still have significant room for improvement, providing a reproducible platform for future research.
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.assessment: 该工作填补了语言模型驱动自动驾驶规划评测的空白，对VLM与自动驾驶交叉方向的研究者具有较高参考价值。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.contribution: 提出了首个面向语言模型程序自动驾驶规划的开放基准数据集LaMPilot。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.innovation: 将语言模型程序范式系统性地引入自动驾驶规划评测，构建了指令-场景-程序配对数据与评估协议。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for.result: 实验显示当前主流语言模型在该基准上表现有限，揭示了语言模型用于驾驶规划的挑战与提升空间。
LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for._arxiv_id: LaMPilot: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Language Model Programs.

Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中纯视觉4D占据预测缺乏统一基准的问题，论文提出了Cam4DOcc基准，专注于相机-only的4D占据预测任务。方法上定义了标准化的数据格式、评估指标和基线方法，涵盖多个公开数据集上的占据预测与 forecasting 任务。相比已有占据预测工作多依赖LiDAR或多模态输入，该基准首次系统性地聚焦纯相机输入的4D占据预测，降低了传感器成本。实验提供了多种基线方法的对比结果，为纯视觉占据预测研究建立了可比较的评测标准。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.summary_en: This paper presents Cam4DOcc, a benchmark for camera-only 4D occupancy forecasting in autonomous driving. It defines standardized data formats, evaluation metrics, and baseline methods across multiple public datasets, focusing exclusively on camera-based input. The benchmark establishes a comparable evaluation standard for pure-vision occupancy forecasting, addressing the gap left by existing LiDAR or multi-modal approaches.
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.assessment: 作为纯视觉4D占据预测的首个系统性基准，对BEV/Occupancy方向研究者具有重要参考意义，推动了低成本感知方案的发展。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.contribution: 提出了首个纯相机4D占据预测基准Cam4DOcc，包含标准化数据格式、评估指标和基线方法。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.innovation: 聚焦相机-only的4D占据预测与forecasting任务，填补了该方向缺乏统一评测基准的空白。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O.result: 提供了多数据集上的基线对比结果，建立了纯视觉占据预测的可比较评测标准。
Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D O._arxiv_id: Cam4DOcc: Benchmark for Camera-Only 4D Occupancy Forecasting in Autonomous Driving Applications.

AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶目标检测中标注数据稀缺和领域适应困难的问题，论文提出了AIDE自动数据引擎。方法上构建了一个自动化流程，通过伪标签生成、数据筛选和模型迭代训练，实现从无标注数据中自动挖掘高质量训练样本。相比已有工作依赖人工标注或简单伪标签策略，AIDE通过闭环数据引擎持续提升检测器性能。实验表明该方法在多个自动驾驶检测基准上显著优于基线，有效降低了标注成本并提升了模型在目标领域的检测精度。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.summary_en: This paper proposes AIDE, an automatic data engine for object detection in autonomous driving, addressing the scarcity of annotated data and domain adaptation challenges. It builds an automated pipeline with pseudo-label generation, data filtering, and iterative model training to mine high-quality samples from unlabeled data. Experiments show significant improvements over baselines on multiple autonomous driving detection benchmarks while reducing annotation costs.
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶检测中的数据高效利用提供了实用方案，对关注自动标注和领域适应的研究者有较高参考价值。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.contribution: 提出了AIDE自动数据引擎，实现从无标注数据中自动挖掘高质量训练样本以提升检测性能。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.innovation: 通过闭环伪标签生成、数据筛选与模型迭代训练的自动化流程，降低标注依赖并提升领域适应能力。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec.result: 在多个自动驾驶检测基准上显著优于基线，有效降低标注成本并提升检测精度。
AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Objec._arxiv_id: AIDE: An Automatic Data Engine for Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中预测式感知需要大量标注且难以扩展的问题，论文提出了视觉点云预测（Visual Point Cloud Forecasting）方法，通过预测未来点云实现可扩展的自动驾驶感知。方法上利用视觉输入预测未来场景的点云表示，作为自监督预训练任务来学习场景动态和几何先验。相比已有工作依赖昂贵的LiDAR标注或人工设计的预测任务，该方法通过视觉点云预测实现了可扩展的自监督学习。实验表明该预训练策略在多个下游自动驾驶任务上取得了显著性能提升，验证了其可扩展性和有效性。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.summary_en: This paper proposes visual point cloud forecasting to enable scalable autonomous driving by predicting future point clouds from visual input as a self-supervised pre-training task. The approach learns scene dynamics and geometric priors without expensive LiDAR annotations. Experiments demonstrate significant performance gains on multiple downstream autonomous driving tasks, validating its scalability and effectiveness.
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.assessment: 该工作将点云预测作为自监督预训练任务，为自动驾驶可扩展感知提供了新思路，对自监督视觉和3D感知方向研究者具有重要启发。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.contribution: 提出了视觉点云预测方法，通过预测未来点云实现可扩展的自动驾驶自监督预训练。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.innovation: 利用视觉输入预测未来点云作为自监督任务，学习场景动态与几何先验，避免依赖昂贵LiDAR标注。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S.result: 在多个下游自动驾驶任务上取得显著性能提升，验证了方法的可扩展性和有效性。
Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables S._arxiv_id: Visual Point Cloud Forecasting Enables Scalable Autonomous Driving.

Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计模型面对物理3D对抗攻击时的脆弱性问题，论文提出了物理3D对抗攻击方法。方法上通过在3D空间中构造对抗物体（如贴有对抗纹理的物体），使其在单目深度估计中产生错误的深度预测，并保持物理可实现性。相比已有数字域对抗攻击，该方法考虑了真实物理世界中的视角变化、光照和打印条件，更具实际威胁性。实验表明所提攻击能有效误导主流单目深度估计模型，揭示了自动驾驶感知系统的安全隐患。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.summary_en: This paper proposes physical 3D adversarial attacks against monocular depth estimation in autonomous driving. It constructs adversarial objects in 3D space with adversarial textures that cause erroneous depth predictions while maintaining physical realizability. Experiments show the attacks effectively mislead mainstream monocular depth estimation models, revealing security risks in autonomous driving perception systems.
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.assessment: 该工作揭示了单目深度估计在物理世界中的安全漏洞，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究者具有警示和参考价值。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.contribution: 提出了针对单目深度估计的物理3D对抗攻击方法，验证了自动驾驶感知系统的安全隐患。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.innovation: 在3D物理空间中构造对抗物体，考虑视角变化、光照和打印条件，实现物理可实现的深度估计攻击。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against.result: 实验表明所提攻击能有效误导主流单目深度估计模型，暴露了感知系统的安全脆弱性。
Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against._arxiv_id: Physical 3D Adversarial Attacks against Monocular Depth Estimation in Autonomous Driving.

Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多视角视觉预测与规划缺乏统一世界模型框架的问题，论文提出了基于世界模型的多视角视觉预测与规划方法。方法上构建了一个世界模型，能够基于多视角视觉输入预测未来场景的视觉表示，并将预测结果用于下游规划决策。相比已有工作将预测与规划分离，该方法通过世界模型实现了预测与规划的联合优化，提升了规划的前瞻性和安全性。实验表明该方法在多视角视觉预测和规划任务上取得了优于基线的效果，验证了世界模型在自动驾驶中的潜力。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.summary_en: This paper proposes a world model for multiview visual forecasting and planning in autonomous driving. The model predicts future visual representations from multiview inputs and uses them for downstream planning decisions, jointly optimizing forecasting and planning. Experiments demonstrate superior performance over baselines on multiview visual forecasting and planning tasks, validating the potential of world models in autonomous driving.
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.assessment: 该工作将世界模型引入多视角自动驾驶预测与规划，对VLM、视频理解和自动驾驶规划交叉方向研究者具有重要参考价值。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.contribution: 提出了基于世界模型的多视角视觉预测与规划框架，实现预测与规划的联合优化。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.innovation: 通过世界模型统一多视角视觉预测与规划决策，提升规划的前瞻性和安全性。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua.result: 在多视角视觉预测和规划任务上取得优于基线的效果，验证了世界模型在自动驾驶中的应用潜力。
Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visua._arxiv_id: Driving Into the Future: Multiview Visual Forecasting and Planning with World Model for Autonomous Driving.

DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中动态多相机环绕重建难题，现有基于NeRF的方法在动态物体建模与多相机一致性上效率低、质量差。本文提出DrivingGaussian，采用复合高斯泼溅（Composite Gaussian Splatting）框架，将静态背景与动态物体分别用3D高斯表示，并引入增量式静态高斯与动态高斯图传播机制实现多相机时序对齐。相比NeRF类方法，渲染速度与重建保真度显著提升，在Waymo等数据集上实现了高质量的新视角合成与动态场景重建。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of reconstructing surrounding dynamic autonomous driving scenes with multi-camera setups, where prior NeRF-based methods suffer from low efficiency and poor dynamic modeling. DrivingGaussian introduces a composite Gaussian Splatting framework that represents static backgrounds and dynamic objects with separate 3D Gaussians, coupled with incremental static Gaussians and dynamic Gaussian graph propagation for multi-camera temporal alignment. It achieves substantially faster rendering and higher fidelity than NeRF-based approaches, enabling high-quality novel view synthesis on datasets such as Waymo.
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.assessment: 将3D高斯泼溅成功扩展到自动驾驶环绕动态场景，重建质量与效率兼顾，是该方向值得跟进的工作。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.contribution: 提出复合高斯泼溅框架，实现自动驾驶环绕动态场景的高效高质量重建。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.innovation: 用静态/动态分离的3D高斯表示结合增量式传播机制解决多相机动态场景建模。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla.result: 在Waymo等数据集上实现优于NeRF方法的新视角合成质量与显著更快的渲染速度。
DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Spla._arxiv_id: DrivingGaussian: Composite Gaussian Splatting for Surrounding Dynamic Autonomous Driving Scenes.

Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中单目深度估计精度不足与多视图深度在远距离/稀疏区域失效的问题，本文提出自适应融合单视图与多视图深度的方法。通过设计自适应融合模块，根据场景几何与置信度动态加权单目深度与多视图立体深度，兼顾近处稠密与远处稀疏区域的精度。相比单一深度来源，融合策略在自动驾驶深度基准上降低了深度误差，提升了鲁棒性。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited accuracy of monocular depth and the failure of multi-view depth in distant or sparse regions for autonomous driving. It proposes an adaptive fusion of single-view and multi-view depth, where a fusion module dynamically weights the two sources based on scene geometry and confidence. Compared with using either source alone, the method reduces depth error and improves robustness on autonomous driving depth benchmarks.
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.assessment: 单目与多视图深度互补融合思路实用，对下游3D检测与BEV感知有直接价值。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.contribution: 提出单视图与多视图深度自适应融合框架，提升自动驾驶深度估计精度。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.innovation: 基于场景几何与置信度的动态加权融合机制，兼顾近远距离深度估计。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi.result: 在自动驾驶深度基准上降低深度误差并提升鲁棒性。
Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi._arxiv_id: Adaptive Fusion of Single-View and Multi-View Depth for Autonomous Driving.

Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型缺乏自动驾驶场景整体理解能力的问题，本文提出将BEV注入多模态大模型的方法，构建了面向自动驾驶的整体理解框架。通过将鸟瞰图特征注入大模型，使其具备对周围环境的全局空间推理能力，并构建了相应的指令数据集与评测基准。相比通用VLM，该方法在自动驾驶理解任务上显著提升了空间推理与场景问答性能。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of holistic scene understanding in existing multimodal large models for autonomous driving. It proposes injecting Bird's-Eye-View features into multimodal large models to enable global spatial reasoning, along with a dedicated instruction dataset and benchmark. Compared with general-purpose VLMs, the approach substantially improves spatial reasoning and scene question answering in autonomous driving understanding tasks.
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.assessment: 将BEV空间表征与多模态大模型结合，为自动驾驶场景理解提供了新范式，值得关注。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.contribution: 提出BEV注入的多模态大模型框架，实现自动驾驶整体场景理解。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.innovation: 将鸟瞰图空间特征注入大模型以增强全局空间推理能力。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin.result: 在自动驾驶理解基准上显著提升空间推理与场景问答性能。
Holistic Autonomous Driving Understandin._arxiv_id: Holistic Autonomous Driving Understanding by Bird'View Injected Multi-Modal Large Models.

On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_cn: 针对端到端运动规划模型参数量大、难以部署到车载平台的问题，本文提出压缩端到端运动规划器的方法。通过知识蒸馏与结构化剪枝相结合，在保持规划性能的前提下大幅压缩模型规模。相比原始规划器，压缩后模型在保持安全性与舒适性指标的同时显著降低计算开销，提升了可移植性。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.summary_en: This paper targets the deployment difficulty of large end-to-end motion planners on vehicle platforms. It proposes compressing the end-to-end motion planner via knowledge distillation combined with structured pruning, reducing model size while preserving planning performance. Compared with the original planner, the compressed model maintains safety and comfort metrics while significantly lowering computational cost and improving portability.
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.assessment: 面向部署的规划器压缩工作实用性强，对自动驾驶落地有参考价值。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.contribution: 提出结合知识蒸馏与剪枝的端到端运动规划器压缩方法。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.innovation: 在保持规划安全与舒适指标下实现规划器的高效压缩。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing.result: 压缩后模型显著降低计算开销并保持规划性能。
On the Road to Portability: Compressing._arxiv_id: On the Road to Portability: Compressing End-to-End Motion Planner for Autonomous Driving.

Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶雷达数据标注昂贵、监督学习依赖大量人工标注的问题，本文提出用自监督学习引导雷达感知模型训练。通过设计适用于雷达点云的自监督预训练任务，在无标注数据上学习通用表征，再迁移到下游检测等任务。相比从头监督训练，自监督预训练显著提升了雷达感知性能并降低了对标注的依赖。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of radar data in autonomous driving, where supervised learning relies heavily on manual labels. It proposes bootstrapping radar perception with self-supervised learning, designing pretext tasks tailored to radar point clouds to learn general representations that transfer to downstream detection tasks. Compared with supervised training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining significantly improves radar perception performance and reduces annotation dependence.
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.assessment: 将自监督学习引入雷达感知，缓解标注瓶颈，对多传感器自动驾驶感知有启发意义。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶雷达的自监督预训练框架，提升下游感知性能。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.innovation: 设计适配雷达点云的自监督任务以学习可迁移表征。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars.result: 自监督预训练显著提升雷达感知性能并降低标注依赖。
Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars._arxiv_id: Bootstrapping Autonomous Driving Radars with Self-Supervised Learning.

Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_cn: 针对夜间自动驾驶图像质量差、成对低光增强数据难以获取的问题，本文提出多条件扩散框架用于非配对低光增强。通过多条件引导的扩散模型在无配对数据下学习夜间到白天的映射，提升夜间感知图像质量。相比现有低光增强方法，该方法在非配对设定下改善了夜间自动驾驶视觉任务的输入质量与下游感知表现。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.summary_en: This paper addresses poor nighttime image quality in autonomous driving and the difficulty of obtaining paired low-light enhancement data. It proposes a multi-condition diffusion framework for unpaired low-light enhancement, learning nighttime-to-daytime mapping without paired supervision. Compared with existing low-light enhancement methods, it improves input quality and downstream perception performance in nighttime autonomous driving under the unpaired setting.
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.assessment: 非配对扩散增强思路新颖，对夜间自动驾驶感知鲁棒性有实际意义。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.contribution: 提出多条件扩散框架实现非配对夜间低光增强。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.innovation: 利用多条件引导扩散模型在无配对数据下完成夜间到白天映射。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu.result: 在非配对设定下改善夜间图像质量并提升下游感知表现。
Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffu._arxiv_id: Light the Night: A Multi-Condition Diffusion Framework for Unpaired Low-Light Enhancement in Autonomous Driving.

Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_cn: 针对开环端到端自动驾驶中感知与规划耦合不清的问题，作者系统分析了现有基准（如nuScenes）上自车状态信息对规划性能的支配作用。他们发现仅用自车状态即可达到与完整端到端模型相当的规划精度，并据此提出一种简单基线，在多个开环基准上取得有竞争力的结果。相比已有端到端方法，该工作揭示了开环评测的偏差，并呼吁更关注闭环或去偏评测。实验表明，仅自车状态输入在部分指标上甚至优于复杂感知-规划联合模型。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.summary_en: This paper investigates the role of ego status in open-loop end-to-end autonomous driving and finds that ego status alone can achieve planning performance comparable to full end-to-end models on existing benchmarks. It proposes a simple baseline that attains competitive results, revealing evaluation bias in open-loop settings. The work calls for more闭环 or debiased evaluation protocols.
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.assessment: 该工作对端到端自动驾驶评测的可靠性提出重要质疑，值得领域研究者关注。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.contribution: 揭示了开环端到端自动驾驶中自车状态信息的支配性作用，并提供了简单强基线。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.innovation: 首次系统量化自车状态对开环规划性能的贡献，指出基准偏差。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop.result: 仅用自车状态即可在多个开环基准上达到与完整端到端模型相当的规划精度。
Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop._arxiv_id: Is Ego Status All You Need for Open-Loop End-to-End Autonomous Driving?

DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中4D场景理解缺乏预训练的问题，作者提出DriveWorld，一种基于世界模型的4D预训练框架。该方法通过时空建模与多任务自监督学习，从大规模驾驶视频中学习动态场景表示，并迁移到下游感知与预测任务。相比现有2D或3D预训练方法，DriveWorld在多个自动驾驶基准上取得显著提升，例如在nuScenes检测与预测任务上分别提升若干mAP与ADE指标。实验证明4D预训练能有效增强场景理解能力。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.summary_en: This paper proposes DriveWorld, a 4D pre-training framework via world models for autonomous driving scene understanding. It learns dynamic scene representations from large-scale driving videos using spatiotemporal modeling and multi-task self-supervision, transferring to downstream perception and prediction tasks. Experiments show significant improvements on nuScenes detection and prediction benchmarks.
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.assessment: 该工作将世界模型与4D预训练结合，为自动驾驶场景理解提供了新范式，值得关注。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.contribution: 提出基于世界模型的4D预训练框架DriveWorld，用于自动驾驶场景理解。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.innovation: 利用世界模型进行时空自监督预训练，实现4D动态场景表示学习。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst.result: 在nuScenes检测与预测任务上分别提升若干mAP与ADE指标。
DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Underst._arxiv_id: DriveWorld: 4D Pre-Trained Scene Understanding via World Models for Autonomous Driving.

VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶规划中缺乏语言与视觉联合推理的问题，作者提出VLP（Vision Language Planning），将视觉语言模型引入规划任务。该方法通过多模态对齐与规划导向的微调，使模型能够根据自然语言指令与视觉输入生成驾驶轨迹。相比纯视觉或纯语言规划方法，VLP在复杂场景下展现出更好的泛化与可解释性，在CARLA等基准上取得优于基线的驾驶评分。实验表明语言先验有助于提升规划鲁棒性。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.summary_en: This paper proposes VLP, a vision-language planning framework for autonomous driving that integrates vision-language models into trajectory planning. It aligns multimodal inputs and fine-tunes for planning, enabling trajectory generation from natural language instructions and visual observations. Experiments on CARLA show improved driving scores and generalization over baselines.
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.assessment: 该工作探索了VLM在自动驾驶规划中的应用，具有前瞻性与实用潜力。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.contribution: 提出视觉语言规划框架VLP，将VLM引入自动驾驶轨迹生成。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.innovation: 通过多模态对齐与规划导向微调，实现语言指令驱动的驾驶规划。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono.result: 在CARLA基准上取得优于基线的驾驶评分，提升复杂场景泛化性。
VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autono._arxiv_id: VLP: Vision Language Planning for Autonomous Driving.

Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶轨迹预测模型易受后门攻击的问题，作者提出一种基于自然数据投毒的后门攻击方法。该方法通过生成自然istic的毒化轨迹样本，在不引起明显异常的情况下植入后门，使模型在特定触发条件下输出错误轨迹。相比传统噪声扰动攻击，该方法更隐蔽且难以检测，在多个轨迹预测基准上实现高攻击成功率。实验表明现有防御方法难以有效抵御该攻击。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.summary_en: This paper proposes a backdoor attack on trajectory prediction in autonomous driving via naturalistic data poisoning. It generates naturalistic poisoned samples to implant backdoors that trigger erroneous trajectories under specific conditions. Experiments show high attack success rates and difficulty for existing defenses to detect.
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.assessment: 该工作揭示了轨迹预测模型的安全隐患，对自动驾驶安全研究有警示意义。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.contribution: 提出基于自然数据投毒的后门攻击方法，针对自动驾驶轨迹预测。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.innovation: 利用自然istic毒化样本实现隐蔽后门植入，难以被现有防御检测。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis.result: 在多个轨迹预测基准上实现高攻击成功率，现有防御难以抵御。
Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalis._arxiv_id: Adversarial Backdoor Attack by Naturalistic Data Poisoning on Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving.

CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_cn: 针对轨迹预测在分布外场景下鲁棒性差的问题，作者提出CaDeT，一种因果解耦方法。该方法将轨迹预测中的因果因素（如意图、交互）与非因果因素（如环境偏差）解耦，从而提升模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性。相比传统端到端预测模型，CaDeT在多个鲁棒性基准上取得更好表现，例如在nuScenes上的ADE/FDE指标显著降低。实验证明因果解耦能有效缓解过拟合与偏差。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.summary_en: This paper proposes CaDeT, a causal disentanglement approach for robust trajectory prediction in autonomous driving. It disentangles causal factors (intent, interaction) from non-causal ones (environmental bias) to improve robustness under distribution shifts. Experiments on nuScenes show significant reductions in ADE/FDE compared to baselines.
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.assessment: 该工作将因果推断引入轨迹预测，为提升鲁棒性提供了新思路。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.contribution: 提出因果解耦方法CaDeT，用于鲁棒轨迹预测。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.innovation: 通过解耦因果与非因果因素，提升模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach.result: 在nuScenes上ADE/FDE指标显著降低，鲁棒性优于基线。
CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach._arxiv_id: CaDeT: A Causal Disentanglement Approach for Robust Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving.

NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景中神经渲染缺乏动态与多传感器建模的问题，作者提出NeuRAD，一种面向自动驾驶的神经渲染方法。该方法结合动态物体建模与多相机/激光雷达传感器仿真，能够从驾驶日志中重建高保真4D场景。相比现有NeRF类方法，NeuRAD在动态场景与多传感器一致性上表现更优，在nuScenes等数据集上取得更高的PSNR与更低的渲染误差。实验证明其可用于感知数据增强与闭环仿真。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.summary_en: This paper proposes NeuRAD, a neural rendering approach for autonomous driving that models dynamic objects and multi-sensor (camera/LiDAR) data. It reconstructs high-fidelity 4D scenes from driving logs, outperforming existing NeRF-based methods on dynamic scenes and multi-sensor consistency. Experiments on nuScenes show higher PSNR and lower rendering errors, enabling data augmentation and closed-loop simulation.
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.assessment: 该工作将神经渲染与自动驾驶多传感器仿真结合，具有重要的应用价值。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶的神经渲染方法NeuRAD，支持动态场景与多传感器建模。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.innovation: 结合动态物体建模与多相机/激光雷达仿真，实现高保真4D场景重建。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous.result: 在nuScenes上取得更高PSNR与更低渲染误差，可用于数据增强与闭环仿真。
NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous._arxiv_id: NeuRAD: Neural Rendering for Autonomous Driving.

Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶场景仿真中场景编辑困难、依赖人工建模的问题，本文提出基于协作式LLM智能体的可编辑场景仿真框架。方法通过多个LLM智能体分工协作，将自然语言指令转化为场景编辑操作，驱动仿真器生成可控的驾驶场景。相比已有依赖手工规则或单一模型的仿真方法，本工作实现了语言驱动的灵活编辑与多智能体协同。实验表明该方法能生成多样且合理的场景配置，提升了仿真数据的可控性与真实性。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of editable scene simulation for autonomous driving by proposing a collaborative LLM-agent framework. Multiple LLM agents decompose natural-language instructions into scene-editing operations that drive a simulator to produce controllable driving scenarios. Compared with prior rule-based or single-model simulation pipelines, it enables flexible language-driven editing and improves controllability and realism of generated scenes.
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.assessment: 将LLM多智能体引入驾驶场景仿真编辑，思路新颖，对数据生成与闭环仿真有实用价值。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.contribution: 提出协作式LLM智能体驱动的可编辑自动驾驶场景仿真框架。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.innovation: 用多LLM智能体协同将自然语言指令转化为场景编辑操作。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous.result: 实现语言驱动的灵活场景编辑，提升仿真场景的可控性与多样性。
Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous._arxiv_id: Editable Scene Simulation for Autonomous Driving via Collaborative LLM-Agents.

Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶视频生成中视角受限、可控性不足的问题，本文提出Panacea全景可控视频生成框架。方法结合全景表示与可控生成机制，支持多视角一致且属性可控的驾驶视频合成。相比已有单视角或弱可控的视频生成工作，本方法在视角覆盖与可控性上均有提升。实验显示其在生成质量与多视角一致性指标上优于基线，可用于驾驶数据增强。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.summary_en: This paper targets limited viewpoint coverage and weak controllability in autonomous driving video generation, proposing Panacea, a panoramic and controllable video generation framework. It combines panoramic representations with controllable generation to synthesize multi-view consistent driving videos with adjustable attributes. Compared with prior single-view or weakly controllable methods, it improves viewpoint coverage and controllability, yielding better generation quality and multi-view consistency.
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.assessment: 面向驾驶数据的全景可控视频生成，对数据增强与仿真有较高实用价值。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.contribution: 提出全景且可控的自动驾驶视频生成框架Panacea。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.innovation: 融合全景表示与可控生成实现多视角一致视频合成。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide.result: 在生成质量与多视角一致性上优于基线，支持可控驾驶视频生成。
Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Vide._arxiv_id: Panacea: Panoramic and Controllable Video Generation for Autonomous Driving.

PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶端到端架构中模块串行导致的延迟高、难以实时的问题，本文提出PARA-Drive并行化架构。方法将感知、预测、规划等模块并行化设计，减少串行依赖以提升推理效率。相比已有串行端到端方案，本工作在保持性能的同时显著降低延迟。实验表明其在实时性上取得明显提升，兼顾精度与效率。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the high latency of serial end-to-end autonomous driving architectures by proposing PARA-Drive, a parallelized architecture. It parallelizes perception, prediction, and planning modules to reduce serial dependencies and improve inference efficiency. Compared with prior serial end-to-end pipelines, it substantially lowers latency while maintaining performance, achieving a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.assessment: 并行化端到端架构对实时自动驾驶部署有直接价值，工程意义强。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.contribution: 提出面向实时自动驾驶的并行化端到端架构PARA-Drive。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.innovation: 通过模块并行化减少串行依赖以降低推理延迟。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo.result: 在保持性能的同时显著提升实时性。
PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture fo._arxiv_id: PARA-Drive: Parallelized Architecture for Real-Time Autonomous Driving.

SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶去雾研究缺乏真实感合成雾数据集的问题，本文提出SynFog数据集，基于端到端成像仿真生成逼真雾天图像。方法通过物理成像仿真建模雾的形成过程，生成配对的无雾/有雾图像用于训练与评测。相比已有合成雾数据，本数据集更贴近真实成像特性，有助于缩小仿真到真实的差距。实验验证了其在真实去雾任务上的有效性。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of photorealistic synthetic fog datasets for autonomous driving defogging by introducing SynFog, built on end-to-end imaging simulation. It models fog formation via physical imaging simulation to generate paired foggy/clear images for training and evaluation. Compared with prior synthetic fog data, it better matches real imaging characteristics, helping narrow the sim-to-real gap and improving real-world defogging.
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.assessment: 数据集类工作，对恶劣天气感知与去雾研究有支撑价值，但方法创新有限。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.contribution: 提出基于端到端成像仿真的逼真合成雾数据集SynFog。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.innovation: 用物理成像仿真生成贴近真实的配对雾天图像。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D.result: 验证了数据集在真实去雾任务上的有效性，缩小仿真到真实差距。
SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog D._arxiv_id: SynFog: A Photorealistic Synthetic Fog Dataset Based on End-to-End Imaging Simulation for Advancing Real-World Defogging in Autonomous Driving.

Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶世界模型泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出通用预测模型（Generalized Predictive Model）。方法在大规模驾驶数据上训练可预测未来场景演化的通用模型，支持多种下游任务。相比已有专用预测模型，本工作强调跨场景、跨任务的泛化能力。实验表明其在多个预测与规划任务上取得良好表现，展现出通用性。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited generalization of autonomous driving world models by proposing a Generalized Predictive Model. It is trained on large-scale driving data to predict future scene evolution and support multiple downstream tasks. Compared with prior task-specific predictive models, it emphasizes cross-scene and cross-task generalization, demonstrating strong performance across several prediction and planning tasks.
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.assessment: 通用驾驶预测模型契合世界模型趋势，对感知与规划统一建模有启发。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶的通用预测模型。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.innovation: 强调跨场景跨任务的泛化预测能力。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom.result: 在多个预测与规划任务上表现良好，展现通用性。
Generalized Predictive Model for Autonom._arxiv_id: Generalized Predictive Model for Autonomous Driving.

UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶3D感知缺乏通用预训练范式的问题，本文提出UniPAD通用预训练范式。方法设计统一的自监督预训练任务，适配多种3D感知下游任务与传感器配置。相比已有任务专用预训练，本工作提升了跨任务迁移能力。实验表明其在多个3D检测与分割基准上取得提升，验证了通用性。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a universal pre-training paradigm for autonomous driving 3D perception by proposing UniPAD. It designs unified self-supervised pre-training tasks adaptable to various 3D perception downstream tasks and sensor configurations. Compared with task-specific pre-training, it improves cross-task transferability, yielding gains on multiple 3D detection and segmentation benchmarks.
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.assessment: 通用3D预训练范式对自动驾驶感知迁移学习有较高价值，方向前沿。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶的通用3D感知预训练范式UniPAD。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.innovation: 设计统一自监督预训练任务适配多任务多传感器。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig.result: 在多个3D检测与分割基准上取得提升，验证通用性。
UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradig._arxiv_id: UniPAD: A Universal Pre-Training Paradigm for Autonomous Driving.
