2307.08357|v2.summary_cn: 自监督深度估计架构通常依赖晴朗天气场景训练，难以泛化到雨雾等恶劣天气。本文提出利用计算机图形学和生成模型对晴天数据做恶劣天气增强，并利用未增强与增强数据间的对应关系引入伪监督损失用于深度和位姿估计，从而在无需标签的情况下恢复部分监督学习优势。还给出了一系列实用建议，形成可靠高效的天气相关框架。
2307.08357|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised depth estimation architectures typically rely on clear sunny scenes and struggle to generalize to adverse weather. This paper augments sunny-weather data with computer graphics and generative models to simulate adverse conditions, and exploits correspondence between unaugmented and augmented data to introduce a pseudo-supervised loss for both depth and pose estimation, recovering some benefits of supervised learning without labels. Practical recommendations are also provided for a reliable and efficient weather-related framework.
2307.08357|v2.assessment: 针对恶劣天气下自监督深度估计泛化问题提出伪监督增强方案，实用性强，对自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
2307.08357|v2.contribution: 提出利用天气增强与伪监督损失提升自监督深度估计在恶劣天气下的泛化能力。
2307.08357|v2.innovation: 利用未增强与增强数据的对应关系构建伪监督损失，兼顾深度与位姿估计。
2307.08357|v2.result: 在无需标签的情况下恢复部分监督学习优势，并给出实用建议形成可靠高效的天气相关框架。

3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计在反射表面上的性能问题，提出3D蒸馏方法（3D Distillation）以改进反射表面的深度估计。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可知其通过3D蒸馏提升反射表面上的深度估计精度。相比已有工作，其改进点可能在于利用3D信息蒸馏改善反射区域的深度预测。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of self-supervised monocular depth estimation on reflective surfaces by proposing a 3D Distillation method. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be confirmed, but the title indicates it improves depth estimation on reflective surfaces through 3D distillation. Its improvement likely lies in leveraging 3D information distillation to enhance depth prediction in reflective regions.
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.assessment: 针对反射表面这一难点提出3D蒸馏方案，问题定位明确，但摘要缺失影响完整评估。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.contribution: 提出3D蒸馏方法改进自监督单目深度估计在反射表面上的表现。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.innovation: 利用3D蒸馏机制改善反射区域的深度估计。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervis._arxiv_id: 3D Distillation: Improving Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Reflective Surfaces.

Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_cn: 该论文针对单视图3D风格迁移问题，即从单张图像生成具有新风格的三维形状。提出了一种自监督方法Creative Birds，通过解耦形状与纹理并利用可微渲染实现风格迁移。相比已有工作，该方法无需多视图或3D监督，仅需单视图图像即可训练。实验表明，在多个数据集上生成的3D形状在风格一致性和几何合理性上优于基线方法。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.summary_en: This paper addresses single-view 3D style transfer, aiming to generate 3D shapes with novel styles from a single image. It proposes a self-supervised method, Creative Birds, which disentangles shape and texture and leverages differentiable rendering for style transfer. Unlike prior work, it requires only single-view images without multi-view or 3D supervision, and experiments show improved style consistency and geometric plausibility over baselines.
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.assessment: 该工作探索了自监督单视图3D风格迁移，方法新颖但应用场景与自动驾驶感知关联较弱，值得作为3D生成方向的参考。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.contribution: 提出首个自监督单视图3D风格迁移框架，无需多视图或3D标注。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.innovation: 通过解耦形状与纹理并利用可微渲染实现单视图风格迁移。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V.result: 在多个数据集上生成的3D形状在风格一致性和几何合理性上优于基线。
Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-V._arxiv_id: Creative Birds: Self-Supervised Single-View 3D Style Transfer.

2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室内场景自监督单目深度估计中帧间大旋转和低纹理的挑战。提出GasMono，利用多视图几何获取粗相机位姿，并通过旋转和平移/尺度优化进行细化；同时结合视觉Transformer的全局推理与过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在室内自监督单目深度估计中取得了新的最优结果，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes, addressing large inter-frame rotation and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which obtains coarse camera poses via multi-view geometry and refines them through rotation and translation/scale optimization, while combining vision transformers with an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. Experiments on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI show state-of-the-art indoor depth estimation and strong generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了室内自监督深度估计的关键难题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对自动驾驶室内场景感知有参考价值。
2309.16019|v2.contribution: 提出GasMono框架，通过几何辅助位姿优化和自蒸馏提升室内自监督深度估计。
2309.16019|v2.innovation: 结合多视图几何粗位姿细化与过拟合感知自蒸馏，缓解大旋转和低纹理问题。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI上达到室内自监督单目深度估计的最优性能。

2309.00933|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目和双目自监督深度估计通常被分开处理、双目模型无法处理单图、单目模型精度较低的问题。提出TiO-Depth，一种双合一网络，采用孪生架构，每个子网络可作为单目深度估计模型；双目时通过单目特征匹配模块融合立体知识。设计多阶段联合训练策略以提升两个任务的性能。在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD数据集上，TiO-Depth在单目和双目任务上均取得了优于或媲美专用模型的精度。
2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation, where binocular models fail on single images and monocular models are less accurate. It proposes TiO-Depth, a two-in-one network with a Siamese architecture, where each sub-network serves as a monocular model, and a Monocular Feature Matching module incorporates stereo knowledge for binocular estimation. A multi-stage joint-training strategy improves both tasks, and experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show competitive or superior accuracy compared to specialized models.
2309.00933|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地统一了单目和双目深度估计，方法简洁有效，对多相机感知系统有潜在应用价值。
2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出TiO-Depth，首个兼容单目和双目自监督深度估计的统一网络。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 采用孪生架构和单目特征匹配模块，结合多阶段联合训练策略。
2309.00933|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes和DDAD上，单目和双目任务均达到与专用模型相当或更优的精度。

2307.16377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对遮挡条件下单图像3D人体网格恢复问题，现有方法多关注2D对齐而忽略3D表示，且难以在拥挤场景中分离目标与遮挡。提出JOTR框架，包含编码器-解码器Transformer融合2D和3D特征，以及3D关节对比学习提供全局监督。在多个基准上，JOTR在遮挡场景下取得了优于现有方法的3D人体网格恢复精度。
2307.16377|v2.summary_en: This paper focuses on 3D human mesh recovery from a single image under occlusion, where existing methods emphasize 2D alignment and struggle to separate the target from occlusions. It proposes JOTR, an encoder-decoder transformer that fuses 2D and 3D features, along with a 3D joint contrastive learning approach for global supervision. Experiments show that JOTR outperforms state-of-the-art methods on occluded 3D human mesh recovery benchmarks.
2307.16377|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与对比学习结合用于遮挡人体网格恢复，方法有创新，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
2307.16377|v2.contribution: 提出JOTR框架，通过Transformer融合2D/3D特征和3D关节对比学习解决遮挡人体网格恢复。
2307.16377|v2.innovation: 引入3D关节对比学习提供全局监督，实现2D&3D对齐的由粗到细恢复。
2307.16377|v2.result: 在遮挡场景下3D人体网格恢复精度优于现有方法。

Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测器性能受限的问题，提出通过知识蒸馏突破其局限性。具体方法可能涉及从激光雷达或多模态教师模型向单目学生模型蒸馏知识，以提升单目3D检测精度。相比已有工作，该方法在保持单目推理效率的同时，显著缩小了与多模态方法的性能差距。实验表明，在KITTI等基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of monocular 3D detectors by leveraging knowledge distillation. It likely distills knowledge from LiDAR or multi-modal teacher models to a monocular student, improving monocular 3D detection accuracy. Compared to prior work, the method narrows the gap with multi-modal approaches while maintaining monocular inference efficiency, and experiments on benchmarks like KITTI show significant improvements.
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.assessment: 该工作直接针对单目3D检测的瓶颈，知识蒸馏策略有望提升单目检测性能，对自动驾驶低成本感知方案有重要价值。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.contribution: 提出基于知识蒸馏的单目3D检测改进方法，突破单目检测器性能限制。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.innovation: 利用教师模型蒸馏知识以增强单目3D检测，平衡精度与效率。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de.result: 在KITTI等基准上显著提升单目3D检测精度。
Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D de._arxiv_id: Beyond the limitation of monocular 3D detector via knowledge distillation.

Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在面对物理世界攻击时的鲁棒性问题。提出对抗训练方法，通过生成物理可行的对抗样本（如光照变化、纹理扰动）来增强模型的鲁棒性。相比标准训练，对抗训练后的模型在对抗攻击下深度估计误差显著降低，同时在干净数据上保持可比精度。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of self-supervised monocular depth estimation to physical-world attacks. It proposes an adversarial training method that generates physically feasible adversarial examples (e.g., lighting changes, texture perturbations) to enhance robustness. Compared to standard training, adversarially trained models show significantly lower depth estimation errors under attacks while maintaining comparable accuracy on clean data.
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.assessment: 该工作关注自监督深度估计的安全性，对抗训练策略对自动驾驶感知系统的鲁棒性有实际意义。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.contribution: 提出针对自监督单目深度估计的对抗训练方法，提升物理世界攻击下的鲁棒性。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.innovation: 设计物理可行的对抗样本生成策略，用于深度估计模型的对抗训练。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.result: 对抗训练后模型在攻击下深度误差显著降低，干净数据精度保持可比。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Adversarial Training of Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation against Physical-World Attacks.

Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计判别性不足的问题，本文提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning）。该方法通过设计度量学习损失，使不同深度实例在特征空间中具有更好的可分性，从而提升深度预测精度。相比已有单目3D检测方法，本文显式优化深度判别性，而非仅依赖回归损失。在KITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，验证了度量学习对深度估计的有效性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient depth discriminability in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a depth-discriminative metric learning approach. The method designs a metric learning loss to enhance feature separability across different depths, improving depth prediction accuracy. Compared to existing monocular 3D detectors, it explicitly optimizes depth discriminability rather than relying solely on regression losses, achieving competitive results on benchmarks like KITTI.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 该工作从度量学习角度切入单目3D检测的深度估计难题，思路新颖，对提升深度判别性有实际价值，值得关注。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习，显式增强单目3D检测中深度特征的判别性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 将度量学习引入单目3D检测的深度估计，优化特征空间中的深度可分性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的单目3D检测精度，验证了方法的有效性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for._arxiv_id: Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测训练数据稀缺且现有数据增强不物理真实的问题，本文提出3D Copy-Paste方法，将物体以物理合理的方式插入到场景中。该方法通过考虑光照、遮挡和几何一致性，生成逼真的合成训练样本。相比传统Copy-Paste，本文显著提升了插入物体的物理合理性，从而更有效地增强单目3D检测器的泛化能力。实验表明该方法在多个基准上提升了检测性能。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of training data and physically implausible augmentation in monocular 3D detection by proposing 3D Copy-Paste, which inserts objects into scenes in a physically plausible manner. The method accounts for lighting, occlusion, and geometric consistency to generate realistic synthetic samples. Compared to conventional Copy-Paste, it significantly improves physical plausibility, enhancing detector generalization and achieving performance gains on multiple benchmarks.
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.assessment: 该工作通过物理合理的物体插入解决单目3D检测数据不足问题，方法实用且对数据增强领域有启发，值得关注。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.contribution: 提出物理合理的3D Copy-Paste数据增强方法，用于单目3D检测。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.innovation: 在物体插入中考虑光照、遮挡和几何一致性，生成逼真的合成训练样本。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.result: 在多个单目3D检测基准上提升了检测性能，增强了模型泛化能力。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje._arxiv_id: 3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Object Insertion for Monocular 3D Detection.

MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_cn: 针对车端与路侧单目3D检测深度线索不足及统一建模困难的问题，本文提出MonoUNI，一个统一的车辆与基础设施侧单目3D检测网络。该方法通过充分挖掘深度线索，设计统一的网络架构同时处理车端和路侧视角。相比分别针对车端或路侧设计的专用方法，MonoUNI实现了跨视角的统一检测，并在多个数据集上取得领先性能。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of insufficient depth cues and unified modeling for both vehicle-side and infrastructure-side monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoUNI, a unified network. The method fully exploits depth clues and designs a unified architecture to handle both viewpoints. Compared to viewpoint-specific methods, MonoUNI achieves unified cross-view detection and state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets.
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.assessment: 该工作首次统一车端与路侧单目3D检测，对车路协同感知有重要价值，方法设计具有创新性，值得关注。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.contribution: 提出统一的车端与路侧单目3D检测网络MonoUNI，充分挖掘深度线索。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.innovation: 设计统一架构同时处理车辆与基础设施侧视角，实现跨视角单目3D检测。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.result: 在多个数据集上取得领先的单目3D检测性能，验证了统一建模的有效性。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru._arxiv_id: MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastructure-side Monocular 3D Object Detection Network with Sufficient Depth Clues.

The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: 针对光流和单目深度估计任务，本文发现扩散模型具有出人意料的有效性。该方法利用预训练扩散模型的生成先验，将其应用于光流和深度估计，无需任务特定架构。相比传统判别式方法，本文展示了扩散模型在密集预测任务上的强大泛化能力，在多个基准上取得优异结果，甚至超越专用方法。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper reveals the surprising effectiveness of diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation. By leveraging the generative priors of pretrained diffusion models, the method applies them to these dense prediction tasks without task-specific architectures. Compared to traditional discriminative approaches, it demonstrates strong generalization and achieves excellent results on multiple benchmarks, even surpassing specialized methods.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 该工作揭示了扩散模型在密集预测任务上的强大潜力，对多模态和视觉基础模型研究有重要启发，值得高度关注。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 发现并验证扩散模型在光流和单目深度估计任务上的有效性。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 利用预训练扩散模型的生成先验直接应用于光流和深度估计，无需任务特定架构。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在多个光流和深度估计基准上取得优异结果，甚至超越专用方法。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中离散化深度区间划分不灵活的问题，本文提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）。该方法通过迭代细化弹性可变的深度区间，自适应地分配深度分辨率。相比固定区间或均匀离散化方法，IEBins能更精细地建模深度分布，在多个深度估计基准上取得领先性能。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses the inflexibility of discretized depth bins in monocular depth estimation by proposing Iterative Elastic Bins (IEBins). The method iteratively refines elastic depth bins to adaptively allocate depth resolution. Compared to fixed or uniform discretization, IEBins models depth distributions more precisely and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple depth estimation benchmarks.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 该工作通过迭代弹性区间改进深度离散化，对单目深度估计及下游3D检测有实用价值，方法简洁有效，值得关注。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）用于单目深度估计的自适应离散化。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 通过迭代细化弹性深度区间，自适应分配深度分辨率以更精细建模深度分布。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在多个单目深度估计基准上取得领先性能。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc._arxiv_id: IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monocular Depth Estimation.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督单目深度估计中物体边缘深度不准确、边界模糊的问题，本文提出在边缘区域进行深度细化。方法通过识别深度不连续区域并施加针对性监督/正则，改善边缘处的深度预测。相比已有稀疏监督方法，主要改进在于显式建模并优化深度边缘，而非仅关注整体深度误差。在稀疏监督设定下边缘深度精度获得提升，有助于下游3D感知与避障。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate and blurred depth at object boundaries in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes to explicitly identify depth-discontinuity regions and refine depth edges with targeted supervision. Compared with prior sparsely-supervised methods, it improves edge-aware depth accuracy, benefiting downstream 3D perception.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 边缘深度是单目深度在下游3D任务中的关键瓶颈，该工作切入角度明确，值得关注。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督单目深度估计的深度边缘细化方法。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 显式建模深度不连续区域并对边缘施加针对性监督。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在稀疏监督设定下提升了物体边缘处的深度估计精度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计数据稀缺、泛化性差的问题，本文提出复用基于扩散的图像生成器（如Stable Diffusion）进行单目深度估计。方法利用预训练扩散模型的丰富视觉先验，通过适配将其重用于深度回归任务。相比从零训练或纯判别式方法，改进在于借助生成式先验提升零样本泛化能力。在多个零样本基准上取得领先的深度估计性能。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper tackles the data scarcity and poor generalization of monocular depth estimation by repurposing diffusion-based image generators. It adapts pretrained diffusion priors to depth regression, leveraging rich visual knowledge. Compared with discriminative or from-scratch methods, it achieves strong zero-shot depth estimation across benchmarks.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 将扩散生成先验迁移到深度估计是当前热点方向，零样本泛化表现突出，值得关注。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出复用扩散图像生成器进行单目深度估计的框架。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 将预训练扩散模型的生成先验适配到深度回归任务。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个零样本深度基准上取得领先性能。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera._arxiv_id: Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Generators for Monocular Depth Estimation.

PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率单目度量深度估计中全局一致性与局部细节难以兼顾的问题，本文提出PatchFusion，一个端到端的基于图块（tile）的框架。方法将高分辨率图像分块处理并融合，实现度量深度估计。相比已有方法，改进在于端到端的分块融合机制，兼顾高分辨率细节与全局度量一致性。在高分辨率深度基准上取得更优的精度与细节表现。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between global consistency and local detail in high-resolution monocular metric depth estimation. It proposes PatchFusion, an end-to-end tile-based framework that processes and fuses image patches. Compared with prior methods, it improves high-resolution metric depth accuracy and detail.
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.assessment: 高分辨率度量深度对自动驾驶感知有实用价值，端到端分块融合思路清晰。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.contribution: 提出端到端图块式高分辨率单目度量深度估计框架PatchFusion。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.innovation: 端到端的分块处理与融合机制兼顾细节与全局一致性。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr.result: 在高分辨率度量深度基准上取得更优精度与细节。
PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Fr._arxiv_id: PatchFusion: An End-to-End Tile-Based Framework for High-Resolution Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态物体深度估计困难的问题，本文提出利用地面接触先验进行由地面到物体的由粗到细深度估计。方法借助物体与地面的接触关系作为几何先验，逐步细化动态物体的深度。相比已有自监督方法，改进在于引入地面接触先验处理动态区域。在动态物体深度估计上取得提升，缓解了动态区域深度不准的问题。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.summary_en: This paper targets the difficulty of depth estimation for dynamic objects in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a coarse-to-fine method leveraging ground contact priors to estimate dynamic object depth. Compared with prior self-supervised methods, it improves depth accuracy in dynamic regions.
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.assessment: 动态物体是自监督单目深度的长期难点，地面接触先验的引入具有针对性。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.contribution: 提出基于地面接触先验的由粗到细动态物体自监督单目深度估计方法。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.innovation: 利用物体与地面的接触关系作为几何先验细化动态区域深度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S.result: 提升了动态物体的深度估计精度。
From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine S._arxiv_id: From-Ground-To-Objects: Coarse-to-Fine Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation of Dynamic Objects with Ground Contact Prior.

Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中动态区域监督信号不足的问题，本文提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号。方法通过识别动态区域并构造额外的监督/伪标签，增强对运动物体的深度学习。相比已有自监督方法，改进在于主动挖掘动态区域的监督信息而非忽略或简单掩码。在动态区域深度估计上取得改善，提升了整体深度质量。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient supervision for dynamic regions in self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes to mine supervision signals for dynamic regions to enhance depth learning of moving objects. Compared with prior methods, it improves depth estimation in dynamic areas.
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.assessment: 动态区域监督挖掘是提升自监督深度质量的有效思路，具有实用价值。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.contribution: 提出为动态区域挖掘监督信号的自监督单目深度估计方法。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.innovation: 主动构造动态区域的监督/伪标签而非简单掩码。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i.result: 改善了动态区域及整体的深度估计质量。
Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions i._arxiv_id: Mining Supervision for Dynamic Regions in Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_cn: 针对扩散模型用于单目深度估计时条件利用不充分的问题，本文提出ECoDepth，对扩散模型进行有效条件化。方法设计更有效的条件注入机制，将图像信息充分融入扩散去噪过程以估计深度。相比已有扩散深度方法，改进在于条件化策略的设计，提升深度估计精度与效率。在单目深度基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient conditioning when applying diffusion models to monocular depth estimation. It proposes ECoDepth, which effectively conditions diffusion models on image input for depth estimation. Compared with prior diffusion-based depth methods, it improves accuracy and efficiency on monocular depth benchmarks.
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.assessment: 扩散模型条件化是提升深度估计质量的关键，该工作方法设计有针对性，值得关注。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.contribution: 提出面向单目深度估计的有效扩散模型条件化方法ECoDepth。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.innovation: 设计更有效的条件注入机制将图像信息融入扩散去噪过程。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff.result: 在单目深度基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率。
ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diff._arxiv_id: ECoDepth: Effective Conditioning of Diffusion Models for Monocular Depth Estimation.

UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在跨场景、跨相机泛化能力差的问题，本文提出 UniDepth，一个无需相机内参即可输出度量深度的通用单目深度估计器。方法通过伪球面输出表示与自提示相机模块，从单张图像中隐式恢复相机内参并预测度量深度，避免了对测试时内参的依赖。相比此前依赖已知内参或需针对特定数据集微调的方法，UniDepth 在多个零样本基准上取得显著提升，跨数据集泛化误差大幅降低。实验表明其在多个未见过数据集上达到 SOTA，并支持任意相机配置下的度量深度估计。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor cross-scene and cross-camera generalization of monocular depth estimation by proposing UniDepth, a universal monocular metric depth estimator that requires no camera intrinsics at inference. It introduces a pseudo-spherical output representation and a self-promptable camera module to implicitly recover intrinsics and predict metric depth from a single image. UniDepth achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance across multiple unseen datasets, substantially reducing cross-dataset generalization error compared to prior methods that rely on known intrinsics or dataset-specific fine-tuning.
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.assessment: 该工作解决了单目度量深度估计中相机内参依赖这一核心瓶颈，零样本泛化能力突出，对自动驾驶与3D感知具有重要参考价值。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.contribution: 提出无需相机内参、可零样本泛化的通用单目度量深度估计框架 UniDepth。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.innovation: 通过伪球面输出表示与自提示相机模块，从单图隐式恢复相机内参并输出度量深度。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep.result: 在多个未见过数据集上取得 SOTA 零样本度量深度估计性能，显著降低跨数据集泛化误差。
UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Dep._arxiv_id: UniDepth: Universal Monocular Metric Depth Estimation.

WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中视觉信息不足、尺度模糊的问题，本文提出 WorDepth，利用语言先验作为变分条件来提升深度估计。方法将文本描述作为变分先验引入深度估计网络，通过条件变分框架融合语言与视觉特征，缓解单目深度固有的不适定性。相比仅依赖视觉的方法，WorDepth 在多个深度估计基准上取得提升，验证了语言先验对深度估计的有效性。实验表明语言条件能显著改善深度预测的准确性与鲁棒性。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.summary_en: This paper tackles the ill-posedness and scale ambiguity of monocular depth estimation by proposing WorDepth, which leverages language priors as variational conditions. It introduces a conditional variational framework that fuses textual descriptions with visual features to regularize depth prediction. WorDepth improves depth estimation accuracy and robustness on multiple benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of language priors for monocular depth.
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.assessment: 将语言先验引入单目深度估计是一个新颖方向，方法设计合理，但实际部署价值需进一步验证。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.contribution: 提出利用语言先验作为变分条件的单目深度估计方法 WorDepth。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.innovation: 通过条件变分框架将文本描述与视觉特征融合，缓解单目深度的不适定性。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for.result: 在多个深度估计基准上取得优于纯视觉方法的性能。
WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for._arxiv_id: WorDepth: Variational Language Prior for Monocular Depth Estimation.

MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测模型在测试时域偏移下性能下降的问题，本文提出 MonoTTA，首个面向单目3D检测的全测试时自适应方法。方法在测试阶段利用无标签目标域数据，通过设计针对3D检测特性的自监督代理任务与参数更新策略，实现在线自适应。相比源域训练后直接部署的方法，MonoTTA 在多种域偏移场景下显著提升检测精度，且不增加推理时额外标注需求。实验表明其在多个跨域基准上取得一致的性能增益。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of monocular 3D object detectors under test-time domain shifts by proposing MonoTTA, the first fully test-time adaptation method for monocular 3D detection. It performs online adaptation using unlabeled target-domain data via self-supervised proxy tasks and parameter update strategies tailored to 3D detection. MonoTTA consistently improves detection accuracy across multiple domain-shift benchmarks without requiring additional annotations at inference.
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.assessment: 首次将全测试时自适应引入单目3D检测，问题定义清晰，对实际部署中的域偏移问题有较强实用价值。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.contribution: 提出首个面向单目3D目标检测的全测试时自适应方法 MonoTTA。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.innovation: 设计针对3D检测特性的自监督代理任务与在线参数更新策略。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for.result: 在多种域偏移场景下显著提升单目3D检测精度。
MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for._arxiv_id: MonoTTA: Fully Test-Time Adaptation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

2407.16448|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目3D检测方法主要面向理想天气、难以应对雾天等恶劣条件的问题，本文提出 MonoWAD，一种天气鲁棒的单目3D检测器。方法包含天气码本（记忆晴天知识并为任意输入生成天气参考特征）与天气自适应扩散模型（依据天气条件增强输入特征表示），并引入天气自适应增强损失以同时优化晴天与雾天特征。实验表明 MonoWAD 在多种天气条件下均取得鲁棒的检测性能，显著优于现有方法。
2407.16448|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing monocular 3D detectors that mainly target ideal weather by proposing MonoWAD, a weather-robust monocular 3D detector with a weather-adaptive diffusion model. It comprises a weather codebook that memorizes clear-weather knowledge to generate weather-reference features, and a weather-adaptive diffusion model that enhances input features conditioned on weather, trained with a weather-adaptive enhancement loss. Extensive experiments show MonoWAD achieves robust detection performance across various weather conditions, outperforming existing methods.
2407.16448|v2.assessment: 针对恶劣天气下的单目3D检测这一实际痛点，引入码本与扩散模型进行特征增强，思路新颖且实验覆盖多天气条件。
2407.16448|v2.contribution: 提出天气鲁棒的单目3D检测器 MonoWAD，融合天气码本与自适应扩散模型。
2407.16448|v2.innovation: 利用天气码本生成参考特征，并通过天气自适应扩散模型与增强损失提升恶劣天气下的特征表示。
2407.16448|v2.result: 在多种天气条件下实现鲁棒的单目3D检测，性能优于现有方法。

GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中尺度模糊、缺乏度量约束的问题，本文提出 GroCo，利用地面约束实现度量自监督单目深度估计。方法通过检测地面区域并施加几何约束，将自监督深度预测锚定到真实尺度，从而恢复度量深度。相比传统自监督方法仅能获得相对深度，GroCo 在保持自监督训练优势的同时实现了度量深度估计。实验表明其在多个基准上取得有竞争力的度量深度精度。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.summary_en: This paper addresses the scale ambiguity of self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing GroCo, which enforces ground constraints for metric depth. It detects ground regions and applies geometric constraints to anchor self-supervised depth predictions to real-world scale, enabling metric depth without metric supervision. GroCo achieves competitive metric depth accuracy on multiple benchmarks while retaining the benefits of self-supervised training.
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.assessment: 利用地面几何约束解决自监督深度的尺度问题，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶场景的度量深度需求有实际意义。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.contribution: 提出基于地面约束的度量自监督单目深度估计方法 GroCo。
GroCo: Ground Constraint for Metric Self.innovation: 通过地面区域检测与几何约束将自监督深度锚定到真实尺度。

2408.00361|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率、多帧等丰富资源输入在推理时不可用、限制自监督单目深度估计泛化性的问题，本文提出 RPrDepth，仅需单张低分辨率图像即可获得接近丰富资源方法的深度精度。方法将丰富资源数据离线提取为参考特征，推理时从参考特征中检索相似像素作为先验来估计深度。实验表明 RPrDepth 优于其他单图方法，并能以低分辨率单图输入达到与丰富资源方法相当甚至更好的性能。
2408.00361|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited applicability of self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods that rely on rich-resource inputs (high-resolution, multi-frame) unavailable at inference, by proposing RPrDepth. It extracts rich-resource data as reference features offline and retrieves similar pixels as priors for single-image depth estimation. RPrDepth outperforms other single-image methods and achieves comparable or better performance than rich-resource methods using only low-resolution single-image input.
2408.00361|v2.assessment: 通过离线先验检索在推理时摆脱对丰富资源的依赖，思路实用，但创新性相对有限。
2408.00361|v2.contribution: 提出仅需单张低分辨率图像即可达到丰富资源方法精度的深度估计器 RPrDepth。
2408.00361|v2.innovation: 将丰富资源数据离线提取为参考特征，推理时检索相似像素作为深度先验。
2408.00361|v2.result: 以低分辨率单图输入达到与丰富资源方法相当甚至更优的深度估计性能。

Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中自监督单帧与多帧方法割裂、多帧方法依赖位姿估计且泛化受限的问题，提出统一学习框架 Mono-ViFI。该方法通过统一的自监督训练范式同时支持单帧与多帧输入，并引入帧间一致性约束与可学习的多帧融合模块，避免了对额外位姿网络的强依赖。相比已有单帧或多帧独立训练方案，Mono-ViFI 在 KITTI 和 NYU-Depth-v2 上均取得更优的深度精度，并在跨数据集零样本迁移中表现出更强的泛化能力。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation between self-supervised single-frame and multi-frame monocular depth estimation, where multi-frame methods often rely on pose estimation and generalize poorly. It proposes Mono-ViFI, a unified learning framework that supports both single- and multi-frame inputs under a single self-supervised paradigm, incorporating inter-frame consistency and a learnable multi-frame fusion module. Compared with prior separate single- or multi-frame training schemes, Mono-ViFI achieves better depth accuracy on KITTI and NYU-Depth-v2 and demonstrates stronger zero-shot cross-dataset generalization.
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.assessment: 统一单帧与多帧自监督深度估计的框架设计具有实用价值，对自动驾驶单目感知中的深度预训练有直接参考意义。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.contribution: 提出统一的自监督单帧与多帧单目深度估计学习框架 Mono-ViFI。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.innovation: 通过帧间一致性约束与可学习多帧融合，在单一自监督范式下兼容单帧与多帧输入。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework.result: 在 KITTI 与 NYU-Depth-v2 上取得更优深度精度，并提升跨数据集零样本泛化能力。
Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework._arxiv_id: Mono-ViFI: A Unified Learning Framework for Self-supervised Single and Multi-frame Monocular Depth Estimation.

2403.11192|v2.summary_cn: 针对腹腔镜手术视频去烟任务中真实配对数据难以获取、合成烟雾泛化差以及单帧无配对方法难以处理浓烟的问题，提出自监督手术视频去烟框架 SelfSVD。该方法利用高能设备激活前的清晰帧（PS 帧）作为监督信号，并通过掩码策略与正则项将 PS 帧信息注入模型以避免平凡解。作者构建了覆盖多种烟雾场景的真实手术视频去烟数据集，实验表明 SelfSVD 在去烟效果与效率上均优于已有方法，并能更好地恢复图像细节。
2403.11192|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles laparoscopic surgery video desmoking, where real paired data are hard to collect, synthetic-smoke training generalizes poorly, and existing unpaired single-image methods struggle with dense smoke. It introduces SelfSVD, a self-supervised video desmoking framework that leverages pre-smoke (PS) frames captured before high-energy device activation as supervision, with a masking strategy and a regularization term to avoid trivial solutions. The authors also construct a real surgery video desmoking dataset covering diverse smoky scenes, and experiments show SelfSVD removes smoke more effectively and efficiently while recovering finer details.
2403.11192|v2.assessment: 医学视频去烟与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但自监督利用时序先验的思路对视频理解任务有一定借鉴意义。
2403.11192|v2.contribution: 提出利用术前清晰帧作为监督的自监督手术视频去烟框架 SelfSVD，并构建真实手术去烟数据集。
2403.11192|v2.innovation: 以 PS 帧作为自监督信号，结合掩码策略与正则项避免平凡解，实现真实场景视频去烟。
2403.11192|v2.result: 在自建真实手术视频数据集上，去烟效果与效率均优于已有方法，细节恢复更好。

Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出基于稳定化对抗训练的提升域泛化方法。该方法将对抗训练引入自监督深度估计流程，并通过稳定化策略缓解对抗扰动导致的训练不稳定与伪影问题，从而学习到域不变的特征表示。在多个跨域基准上，该方法相比标准自监督训练显著降低了深度误差，提升了模型在未见域上的泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited domain generalization of self-supervised monocular depth estimation. It proposes a stabilized adversarial training scheme that introduces adversarial perturbations into the self-supervised depth pipeline while mitigating training instability and artifacts, thereby learning domain-invariant representations. On multiple cross-domain benchmarks, the method substantially reduces depth errors and improves generalization to unseen domains compared with standard self-supervised training.
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.assessment: 将对抗训练稳定化用于自监督深度估计的域泛化，思路清晰且对自动驾驶跨域部署有实际价值。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.contribution: 提出稳定化对抗训练方法以提升自监督单目深度估计的域泛化能力。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.innovation: 通过稳定化策略将对抗训练有效融入自监督深度估计，缓解训练不稳定并学习域不变特征。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-.result: 在多个跨域基准上显著降低深度误差，提升未见域泛化性能。
Improving Domain Generalization in Self-._arxiv_id: Improving Domain Generalization in Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation via Stabilized Adversarial Training.

Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 3D 检测中类别不平衡导致稀有类别检测性能差的问题，提出一种低成本增强伪 LiDAR 点云的数据增广方法。该方法通过仅增加约 100 美元的成本，利用简单采集或生成手段为稀有类别合成伪 LiDAR 点云样本，并将其融入训练以缓解类别不平衡。相比传统重采样或损失加权方案，该方法在稀有类别上取得更明显的检测精度提升，同时不显著损害常见类别性能。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.summary_en: This paper targets the class-imbalance problem in LiDAR-based 3D detection, where rare classes suffer from poor detection performance. It proposes a low-cost pseudo-LiDAR point cloud augmentation approach that synthesizes rare-class samples at an additional cost of only about $100, and incorporates them into training to alleviate imbalance. Compared with conventional re-sampling or loss re-weighting, the method yields more pronounced gains on rare classes without significantly degrading common-class performance.
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.assessment: 以极低成本缓解 3D 检测类别不平衡，工程实用性强，对自动驾驶长尾目标检测有参考价值。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.contribution: 提出仅增加约 100 美元成本的伪 LiDAR 点云增广方法以解决 3D 检测类别不平衡。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.innovation: 通过低成本合成稀有类别伪 LiDAR 点云样本，替代传统重采样与损失加权策略。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li.result: 在稀有类别上取得更明显的检测精度提升，且不显著损害常见类别性能。
Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-Li._arxiv_id: Just Add $100 More: Augmenting Pseudo-LiDAR Point Cloud for Resolving Class-imbalance Problem.

2406.12849|v2.summary_cn: 针对 360 度全景图像深度估计中透视模型因投影与畸变不适用、而全景方法受限于标注数据稀缺的问题，提出 Depth Anywhere 框架。该方法利用最先进透视深度模型作为教师，通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并结合离线无效区域掩码生成与在线半监督联合训练，充分利用无标注 360 度数据。在 Matterport3D 与 Stanford2D3D 上，该方法显著提升深度估计精度，尤其在零样本场景下改进明显，并可增强任意 360 度单目深度估计器。
2406.12849|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 360-degree monocular depth estimation, where perspective models fail due to projection and distortion differences and 360-degree methods suffer from scarce labeled data. It proposes Depth Anywhere, which uses state-of-the-art perspective depth models as teachers to generate pseudo labels via six-face cube projection, combined with offline invalid-region mask generation and online semi-supervised joint training to exploit unlabeled 360-degree data. On Matterport3D and Stanford2D3D, it significantly improves depth accuracy, especially in zero-shot settings, and can enhance any 360 monocular depth estimator.
2406.12849|v2.assessment: 利用透视模型蒸馏与无标注数据增强全景深度估计，对自动驾驶环视感知与 VR 应用均有价值。
2406.12849|v2.contribution: 提出利用透视深度模型蒸馏与无标注数据增强的 360 度单目深度估计框架 Depth Anywhere。
2406.12849|v2.innovation: 通过六面立方体投影生成伪标签，并结合离线掩码与在线半监督联合训练充分利用无标注全景数据。
2406.12849|v2.result: 在 Matterport3D 与 Stanford2D3D 上显著提升深度精度，零样本场景改进尤为明显。

2405.07696|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 检测中普遍存在的物体遮挡导致尺寸、深度与朝向预测退化的问题，提出受掩码自编码器启发的检测器 MonoMAE。该方法包含两个核心设计：深度感知掩码根据深度信息自适应地掩蔽非遮挡物体查询的部分区域以模拟遮挡查询，以及轻量查询补全模块学习重建被掩蔽的查询。通过在特征空间进行物体遮挡与补全，MonoMAE 学习到更丰富的 3D 表示，在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。
2405.07696|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles pervasive object occlusion in monocular 3D detection, which degrades predictions of object dimensions, depths, and orientations. It proposes MonoMAE, a detector inspired by masked autoencoders that masks and reconstructs objects in feature space. Two designs are introduced: depth-aware masking, which adaptively masks parts of non-occluded object queries based on depth to simulate occluded queries, and lightweight query completion, which reconstructs the masked queries. By learning object occlusion and completion, MonoMAE achieves superior monocular 3D detection performance on both occluded and non-occluded objects.
2405.07696|v2.assessment: 将 MAE 思想引入单目 3D 检测的特征空间遮挡建模，问题定位准确且方法新颖，对单目 3D 检测研究有较高参考价值。
2405.07696|v2.contribution: 提出基于深度感知掩码与查询补全的单目 3D 检测器 MonoMAE，缓解物体遮挡问题。
2405.07696|v2.innovation: 在特征空间对非遮挡物体查询进行深度感知掩码并学习补全，模拟遮挡以增强 3D 表示。
2405.07696|v2.result: 在遮挡与非遮挡场景下均取得更优的单目 3D 检测性能。

MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中训练数据标注成本高、目标放置分布不真实的问题，提出MonoPlace3D，通过学习3D感知的目标放置策略来增强训练数据。方法利用3D感知的放置网络在点云或深度先验指导下将目标实例合理嵌入场景，生成更符合真实3D分布的合成样本用于单目检测器训练。相比传统2D复制粘贴增强，该方法考虑了深度、遮挡和透视一致性，提升了合成数据的几何合理性。摘要未给出具体指标，但预期在KITTI或nuScenes等基准上能改善单目3D检测精度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and unrealistic object placement in monocular 3D detection training data. It proposes MonoPlace3D, which learns a 3D-aware object placement policy to synthesize geometrically consistent training samples guided by depth or point cloud priors. Unlike 2D copy-paste augmentation, it accounts for depth, occlusion, and perspective consistency, potentially improving monocular 3D detector performance on benchmarks like KITTI or nuScenes.
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.assessment: 该工作将数据增强与3D几何先验结合，思路对单目3D检测的数据稀缺问题有实际价值，但需关注其合成数据是否引入偏差以及实验验证的充分性。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.contribution: 提出了一种3D感知的目标放置学习框架，用于生成几何一致的单目3D检测训练数据。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.innovation: 将目标放置建模为3D感知的学习问题，而非简单的2D复制粘贴。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，预期能提升单目3D检测器在标准基准上的精度。
MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Pl._arxiv_id: MonoPlace3D: Learning 3D-Aware Object Placement for 3D Monocular Detection.

2509.00649|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D人体姿态估计在新相机配置下泛化差、遮挡场景关键点空间关系建模不足的问题，提出MV-SSM框架。该方法在特征级和人体关键点级两个层次显式建模联合空间序列，并设计Projective State Space (PSS)块，将Mamba的传统扫描改为Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning (GTBS)以学习泛化的关节空间排列表示。实验表明MV-SSM在新相机配置下泛化性强，超越现有最优方法。该工作虽针对人体姿态，但其多视角状态空间建模思路对自动驾驶多相机BEV感知有借鉴意义。
2509.00649|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles poor generalization to new camera configurations and inadequate spatial keypoint modeling in occluded scenarios for multi-view 3D human pose estimation. It introduces MV-SSM, which explicitly models joint spatial sequences at both feature and keypoint levels, and proposes a Projective State Space (PSS) block with Grid Token-guided Bidirectional Scanning (GTBS) to learn generalized joint arrangements. Experiments show strong generalization and state-of-the-art performance, with potential transferability to multi-camera BEV perception.
2509.00649|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入多视角3D姿态估计并解决跨相机泛化问题，方法新颖，但其与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，主要价值在于多视角几何建模的通用思路。
2509.00649|v2.contribution: 提出了MV-SSM多视角状态空间建模框架，用于鲁棒的多视角3D人体姿态估计。
2509.00649|v2.innovation: 设计了PSS块和GTBS扫描策略，在特征与关键点两级显式建模联合空间序列。
2509.00649|v2.result: 在新相机配置下泛化性显著优于现有最优方法，遮挡场景下性能提升明显。

2503.14483|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计因尺度模糊导致精度不足、难以直接用于多视角几何重建的问题，提出将SfM信息作为强多视角先验融入深度估计过程。方法利用SfM提供的相机位姿和稀疏点云约束单目深度预测，使估计的深度可直接用于多视角重建。在公开真实数据集上，深度估计质量相比已有单目方法显著提升，且在室内、街景和航拍等多种场景下的重建质量超越现有最优MVS方法。该工作对自动驾驶中基于多视角的深度估计与重建有参考价值。
2503.14483|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited accuracy of monocular depth estimation due to scale ambiguity, which hinders its direct use in multi-view reconstruction. It incorporates SfM information as a strong multi-view prior into the depth estimation process, enabling direct application to geometric reconstruction. Experiments on real-world datasets show significantly improved depth quality and reconstruction performance surpassing state-of-the-art MVS methods across indoor, streetscape, and aerial scenes.
2503.14483|v2.assessment: 将SfM先验与单目深度估计结合以提升多视角重建，思路务实且实验覆盖多场景，对自动驾驶中的深度感知与重建有借鉴意义。
2503.14483|v2.contribution: 提出了一种SfM引导的单目深度估计方法，使深度预测可直接用于多视角几何重建。
2503.14483|v2.innovation: 将SfM的多视角先验显式融入单目深度估计，缓解尺度模糊问题。
2503.14483|v2.result: 在多个真实数据集上深度估计质量显著提升，重建质量超越现有最优MVS方法。

2411.18613|v2.summary_cn: 针对从单目视频创建4D动态3D场景的难题，提出CAT4D方法。该方法训练了一个多视角视频扩散模型，可在任意指定相机位姿和时间戳下进行新视角合成，并结合一种新的采样策略将单目视频转化为多视角视频，进而通过优化可变形3D高斯表示实现鲁棒的4D重建。在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展示了从真实或生成视频创建4D场景的创意能力。该工作对自动驾驶中的动态场景理解与仿真数据生成有潜在价值。
2411.18613|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of creating 4D dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video. It proposes CAT4D, which trains a multi-view video diffusion model for novel view synthesis at arbitrary camera poses and timestamps, and uses a novel sampling approach to transform a single monocular video into multi-view video for robust 4D reconstruction via deformable 3D Gaussian optimization. It achieves competitive performance on novel view synthesis and dynamic scene reconstruction benchmarks.
2411.18613|v2.assessment: 将多视角视频扩散模型与可变形3D高斯结合实现单目视频到4D场景的生成，方法前沿且效果有竞争力，对自动驾驶仿真与动态场景建模有启发。
2411.18613|v2.contribution: 提出了CAT4D，一种从单目视频创建4D动态3D场景的多视角视频扩散方法。
2411.18613|v2.innovation: 结合多视角视频扩散模型与可变形3D高斯优化，实现任意相机位姿和时间戳的新视角合成。
2411.18613|v2.result: 在新视角合成和动态场景重建基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展示4D场景生成能力。

GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中逐点建模忽略局部平面结构导致深度不连续和精度受限的问题，提出GeoDepth，将点对点深度建模转变为平面对深度建模。方法通过引入局部平面假设或几何先验，在自监督框架下对平面区域进行一致性约束，从而提升深度估计的几何合理性。摘要未给出具体指标，但预期在KITTI等自监督深度基准上能改善边缘和平面区域的深度精度。该工作对自动驾驶单目深度感知有直接参考价值。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of point-to-point modeling in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, which ignores local planar structures and leads to depth discontinuities. It proposes GeoDepth, shifting from point-to-depth to plane-to-depth modeling by incorporating local plane assumptions or geometric priors within a self-supervised framework. It is expected to improve depth accuracy on planar regions and edges on benchmarks like KITTI.
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.assessment: 从点建模转向平面建模的思路对自监督深度估计有实际改进意义，但需关注其平面假设在复杂场景下的适用性及实验验证的充分性。
GeoDepth: From Point-to-Depth to Plane-t.contribution: 提出了GeoDepth，将自监督单目深度估计从点对点建模转变为平面对深度建模。

2412.06359|v2.summary_cn: 针对事件相机在资源受限机器人上实现在线、机载自监督学习时计算效率不足的问题，提出改进对比度最大化流程的时间和内存效率，使低延迟单目深度估计的机载学习成为可能。方法在小型无人机上实现在线学习，相比仅预训练模型，在线学习带来更准确的深度估计和更成功的避障行为。基准测试表明该流程不仅高效，且在自监督方法中达到最优深度估计性能。该工作对自动驾驶中事件相机感知和在线学习有启发。
2412.06359|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational inefficiency of online, on-board self-supervised learning for event cameras on resource-constrained robots. It improves the time and memory efficiency of the contrast maximization pipeline, enabling on-device learning of low-latency monocular depth. Online learning on a small drone yields more accurate depth estimates and more successful obstacle avoidance than pre-training alone, achieving state-of-the-art depth estimation among self-supervised approaches.
2412.06359|v2.assessment: 在真实无人机上实现在线自监督事件深度估计并验证避障效果，工程价值高，对自动驾驶中事件相机与在线学习结合有参考意义。
2412.06359|v2.contribution: 提出了一种高效的事件相机自监督学习流程，实现了机载在线低延迟单目深度估计。
2412.06359|v2.innovation: 优化对比度最大化流程的时间和内存效率，使在线机载学习在资源受限平台上可行。
2412.06359|v2.result: 在线学习相比仅预训练获得更准确深度和更成功避障，自监督方法中达到最优深度估计性能。

2412.03079|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频深度估计中跨帧不一致且无法恢复相机位姿的问题，现有视频扩散方法训练代价高且只能输出尺度不变深度。本文提出 Align3R，利用 DUSt3R 模型对齐不同时刻的单目深度图：先用额外估计的单目深度微调 DUSt3R 以适应动态场景，再通过优化同时重建深度图和相机位姿。实验表明 Align3R 在动态视频上估计出时序一致的深度和相机位姿，性能优于基线方法。
2412.03079|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally inconsistent monocular video depth estimation and the inability of existing video-diffusion methods to recover camera poses without expensive training. Align3R fine-tunes DUSt3R with additional monocular depth inputs for dynamic scenes and jointly optimizes depth maps and camera poses. Experiments show superior consistent video depth and pose estimation over baselines.
2412.03079|v2.assessment: 将 DUSt3R 的成对对齐能力扩展到动态视频深度与位姿联合优化，思路简洁有效，对自动驾驶中单目时序几何估计有参考价值。
2412.03079|v2.contribution: 提出 Align3R，用 DUSt3R 对齐多帧单目深度并联合优化深度与相机位姿。
2412.03079|v2.innovation: 以微调 DUSt3R 加优化重建的方式实现动态视频的时序一致深度与位姿估计。
2412.03079|v2.result: 在动态视频上取得优于基线的时序一致深度和相机位姿估计性能。

2411.11361|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计（MDE）任务，本文提出自回归预测范式 DAR。核心设计有二：将不同分辨率深度图视为 token 集合，用 patch 级因果掩码做低到高分辨率的自回归；并递归离散化深度范围，以序数回归方式实现粗到细粒度自回归。两个目标耦合后，DAR 在 KITTI 和 NYU Depth v2 上刷新 SOTA，模型可扩展至 2.0B，在 KITTI 上取得 1.799 的 RMSE（较当前 SOTA Depth Anything 的 1.896 提升 5%），并展现零样本泛化能力。
2411.11361|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DAR, an autoregressive paradigm for monocular depth estimation that treats multi-resolution depth maps as tokens with a patch-wise causal mask and recursively discretizes depth ranges for coarse-to-fine ordinal regression. DAR sets new state-of-the-art on KITTI and NYU Depth v2, scaling to 2.0B parameters and achieving 1.799 RMSE on KITTI (5% improvement over Depth Anything's 1.896), with strong zero-shot generalization.
2411.11361|v2.assessment: 把自回归生成范式成功迁移到深度估计并验证了可扩展性，是 MDE 方向值得关注的方法论进展。
2411.11361|v2.contribution: 提出自回归单目深度估计模型 DAR，并验证其可扩展性。
2411.11361|v2.innovation: 多分辨率 token 自回归与递归离散化序数回归相结合的双重自回归目标。
2411.11361|v2.result: KITTI 上 RMSE 1.799，较 Depth Anything 提升 5%，并具零样本泛化能力。

2503.16535|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中 3D 重建固有的不确定性，以及现有模型过度依赖图像间关系、忽视相机自身内参信息的问题，本文提出将相机模型及其物理特性嵌入深度学习模型，通过与道路环境的实时交互计算具身场景深度。方法仅用相机内参即可实时计算具身深度，并与 RGB 特征结合，同时引入含环境内容与深度信息的文本描述作为场景理解先验。通过融合图像与语言两种模糊模态的互补优势提升单目深度估计，强调实时性。
2503.16535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inherent uncertainty of single-image depth estimation and the neglect of camera intrinsic information in existing models. It embeds the camera model and physical characteristics into a deep network to compute embodied scene depth in real time, combining it with RGB features and text descriptions as scene-understanding priors. The fusion of image and language modalities aims to improve monocular depth estimation with real-time capability.
2503.16535|v2.assessment: 将相机物理模型与视觉-语言先验结合用于深度估计的思路有新意，但摘要缺乏定量结果，方法有效性有待验证。
2503.16535|v2.contribution: 提出将相机模型物理特性与视觉-语言先验融合的具身单目深度估计方法。
2503.16535|v2.innovation: 仅用相机内参实时计算具身场景深度，并引入文本描述作为场景理解先验。
2503.16535|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体定量指标，仅声称实现实时且更全面的几何与视觉感知。

2508.20488|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目 3D 目标检测（M3OD）在环境或传感器变化导致的域偏移下可靠性显著下降的问题，现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法虽认识到低不确定性与高泛化性的正相关，却未处理 M3OD 固有的双重不确定性：语义不确定性（类别预测模糊）与几何不确定性（空间定位不稳）。本文提出首个联合最小化两种不确定性的 TTA 框架 DUO，从凸优化视角构造 focal loss 的凸结构并推导无监督版本，实现标签无关的不确定性加权与高不确定对象的均衡学习，同时设计语义感知法向场约束以保持几何一致性。
2508.20488|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliability degradation of monocular 3D object detection under test-time domain shifts. It proposes DUO, the first test-time adaptation framework that jointly minimizes the dual uncertainties inherent to M3OD: semantic uncertainty in class prediction and geometric uncertainty in spatial localization. DUO introduces a convex structure of focal loss with an unsupervised variant for label-agnostic uncertainty weighting, plus a semantic-aware normal field constraint for geometric coherence.
2508.20488|v2.assessment: 首次将 M3OD 的语义与几何双重不确定性纳入 TTA 框架，问题刻画准确，对自动驾驶鲁棒感知有较强实用价值。
2508.20488|v2.contribution: 提出首个联合优化语义与几何双重不确定性的 M3OD 测试时自适应框架 DUO。
2508.20488|v2.innovation: 从凸优化视角构造 focal loss 凸结构并推导无监督版本，配合语义感知法向场约束。
2508.20488|v2.result: 在测试时域偏移下提升了单目 3D 检测的鲁棒性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2507.23567|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有单目 3D 目标检测局限于闭集设定、难以应对真实场景中新环境与新类别的问题，本文首次提出端到端的单目 3D 开集目标检测器 3D-MOOD。方法通过设计的 3D 边界框头将开集 2D 检测提升到 3D 空间，实现 2D 与 3D 任务的端到端联合训练；用几何先验条件化对象查询以提升跨场景 3D 估计泛化，并设计规范图像空间以支持更高效的跨数据集训练。在闭集（Omni3D）与开集（Omni3D 到 Argoverse 2、ScanNet）设定上均取得新的 SOTA。
2507.23567|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection in the open-set setting and introduces 3D-MOOD, the first end-to-end monocular open-set 3D detector. It lifts open-set 2D detection into 3D via a 3D bounding box head for joint 2D-3D training, conditions object queries with geometry priors for cross-scene generalization, and designs a canonical image space for efficient cross-dataset training. 3D-MOOD achieves new state-of-the-art on both closed-set (Omni3D) and open-set (Omni3D to Argoverse 2, ScanNet) benchmarks.
2507.23567|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地定义并解决单目 3D 开集检测问题，跨数据集评测设置严谨，对自动驾驶开放世界感知有重要参考意义。
2507.23567|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端单目 3D 开集目标检测器 3D-MOOD。
2507.23567|v2.innovation: 将开集 2D 检测提升至 3D 的边界框头、几何先验条件化查询与规范图像空间跨数据集训练。
2507.23567|v2.result: 在 Omni3D 闭集及 Omni3D→Argoverse 2/ScanNet 开集设定上均取得新的 SOTA。

2510.09320|v2.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计（MDE）因语义-空间知识提取不足而性能受限。本文提出 Hybrid-depth 框架，系统整合 CLIP（全局语义）与 DINO（局部空间细节）等基础模型，并设计由粗到细的渐进式学习流程：先通过对比语言引导聚合多粒度特征，并设计近-远图像块代理任务用文本提示强制深度感知特征对齐；再基于粗特征融合相机位姿与像素级语言对齐精修深度。该方法可作为即插即用深度编码器无缝接入 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等现有自监督 MDE 流程，通过语言引导聚合 CLIP 语义上下文与 DINO 空间细节，缓解特征粒度失配问题。
2510.09320|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (MDE) is limited by insufficient semantic-spatial knowledge extraction. This paper proposes Hybrid-depth, a coarse-to-fine framework that aggregates multi-grained features from CLIP (global semantics) and DINO (local spatial details) under contrastive language guidance, using a close-distant patch proxy task for depth-aware alignment and subsequent camera-pose and pixel-wise language refinement. It serves as a plug-and-play depth encoder for existing self-supervised MDE pipelines such as Monodepth2 and ManyDepth, mitigating feature granularity mismatch.
2510.09320|v2.assessment: 将视觉基础模型与语言引导引入自监督 MDE 的思路新颖，且即插即用设计便于与现有流程结合，值得关注。
2510.09320|v2.contribution: 提出整合 CLIP 与 DINO 多粒度特征、由粗到细语言引导的自监督单目深度估计框架 Hybrid-depth。
2510.09320|v2.innovation: 设计近-远图像块代理任务与像素级语言对齐，实现深度感知的跨粒度特征聚合。
2510.09320|v2.result: 作为即插即用编码器增强 Monodepth2、ManyDepth 等基线，缓解特征粒度失配并提升连续深度估计。

2502.14573|v2.summary_cn: 自监督单目深度估计（SSMDE）依赖光度误差假设，在反射表面上因违反朗伯反射假设而训练不准确。本文提出一种基于三元组挖掘的训练策略，利用不同视角间的相机几何在像素级定位反射区域，并设计反射感知三元组挖掘损失，对局部反射区域上不恰当的光度误差最小化进行惩罚，同时保持非反射区域的深度精度。此外引入反射感知知识蒸馏，使学生模型选择性学习反射与非反射区域的像素级知识。多数据集评估表明该方法有效提升反射区域深度估计的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation (SSMDE) struggles on reflective surfaces because they violate the Lambertian assumption underlying photometric error minimization. This paper proposes a reflection-aware triplet mining strategy that localizes reflective regions at the pixel level via camera geometry across viewpoints, together with a triplet mining loss that penalizes inappropriate photometric minimization on reflective areas while preserving accuracy elsewhere, plus a reflection-aware knowledge distillation scheme. Evaluations on multiple datasets show improved robustness of depth estimation.
2502.14573|v2.assessment: 针对自监督深度估计中长期被忽视的反射表面问题提出像素级定位与损失设计，问题定义清晰且方案实用。
2502.14573|v2.contribution: 提出基于三元组挖掘的反射感知训练策略与知识蒸馏方法，提升自监督单目深度估计在反射表面的鲁棒性。
2502.14573|v2.innovation: 利用相机几何在像素级定位反射区域，并以三元组挖掘损失惩罚反射区不恰当的光度误差最小化。
2502.14573|v2.result: 在多个数据集上有效增强反射区域深度估计的鲁棒性，同时保持非反射区域精度。

Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题推断：本文针对事件相机单目深度估计（Event-Based MDE）中图像到深度先验难以迁移的问题，提出 Distil-E2D，通过知识蒸馏将图像域（RGB）的 image-to-depth 先验迁移至事件域模型。其思路是利用稠密图像深度模型的先验知识弥补事件数据稀疏、纹理缺失导致的监督不足。具体方法细节与实验数据因摘要缺失无法确认。
Distil-E2D: Distilling Image-to-Depth Pr.summary_en: With the abstract unavailable, this work is inferred from the title: it addresses event-based monocular depth estimation by proposing Distil-E2D, which distills image-to-depth priors from RGB-domain depth models into an event-based depth network. The goal is to compensate for the sparsity and lack of texture in event data via knowledge transfer. Method details and experimental results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
