2303.07284|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态摘要中现有方法未能利用模态间时序对应关系和样本间内在关联的问题，本文提出A2Summ统一多模态Transformer模型，有效对齐和关注多模态输入，并提出两种新颖对比损失建模样本间和样本内相关性。在TVSum、SumMe、Daily Mail和CNN四个数据集上均达到SOTA，并收集了大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of existing multimodal summarization methods to leverage temporal correspondence across modalities and intrinsic correlations between samples. It proposes A2Summ, a unified multimodal transformer that aligns and attends to multimodal inputs, along with two novel contrastive losses modeling inter-sample and intra-sample correlations. A2Summ achieves state-of-the-art results on TVSum, SumMe, Daily Mail, and CNN, and the authors collect a large-scale dataset BLiSS.
2303.07284|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态摘要任务上引入对比学习建模跨样本和跨模态关系，方法完整且贡献了大规模数据集，对多模态理解研究者有参考价值。
2303.07284|v2.contribution: 提出A2Summ统一多模态Transformer模型及双对比损失，并构建大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.innovation: 双对比损失同时建模样本间和样本内相关性，结合时序对齐与注意力机制。
2303.07284|v2.result: 在四个标准数据集上均取得SOTA性能，并发布了BLiSS大规模数据集。

2303.00601|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于3D点云和RGB图像的多模态工业异常检测中，现有方法直接拼接多模态特征导致特征间强干扰、损害检测性能的问题，本文提出M3DM方法，采用混合融合方案：设计基于patch级对比学习的无监督特征融合促进模态交互，使用多记忆库的决策层融合避免信息丢失并引入新颖性分类器做最终决策，还提出点特征对齐操作。在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测和分割精度均超越SOTA。
2303.00601|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing multimodal industrial anomaly detection methods directly concatenate multimodal features, causing strong inter-feature disturbance and degraded detection performance. It proposes M3DM with a hybrid fusion scheme: an unsupervised feature fusion with patch-wise contrastive learning to encourage cross-modal interaction, and a decision-layer fusion with multiple memory banks and novelty classifiers for final decisions, plus a point feature alignment operation. M3DM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both detection and segmentation precision on MVTec-3D AD.
2303.00601|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多模态工业异常检测中的特征融合问题提出了系统性的混合融合方案，方法设计合理，但应用领域与自动驾驶感知距离较远。
2303.00601|v2.contribution: 提出M3DM混合融合方案，解决多模态工业异常检测中特征拼接导致的干扰问题。
2303.00601|v2.innovation: patch级对比学习无监督特征融合与多记忆库决策层融合相结合，并引入点特征对齐。
2303.00601|v2.result: 在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测和分割精度均超越SOTA方法。

Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_cn: 该论文针对远距离声学感知在场景理解中信息缺失的问题，提出利用长程声学波束成形与视觉模态融合的多模态场景理解框架。方法上通过声学波束成形获取远距离目标的空间与语义线索，并与视觉特征进行跨模态对齐与融合。相比纯视觉方案，其改进点在于引入声音这一在远距离和遮挡场景下更鲁棒的模态。摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果需结合正文实验验证。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited perception range of vision-only scene understanding by introducing long-range acoustic beamforming as an auxiliary modality. It fuses beamformed acoustic spatial cues with visual features for multimodal scene understanding. The main improvement over existing work is the exploitation of sound for long-range and occluded scenarios, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.assessment: 选题新颖，将声学波束成形引入自动驾驶多模态感知，但摘要信息极少，难以判断实验充分度，与主流视觉3D感知相关度有限。

Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.innovation: 将远距离声学感知作为视觉之外的补充模态用于场景理解。

Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对对话情感识别（ERC）任务，重新审视图神经网络在该任务中的建模方式，提出多变量、多频率、多模态的GNN框架。方法上从多变量关系、多频率信号分解和多模态融合三个角度重构图结构与时序建模。相比已有ERC方法，其改进在于更细粒度地刻画对话中的异构交互关系。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，效果需参考正文。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_en: This paper revisits graph neural networks for emotion recognition in conversation (ERC) and proposes a multivariate, multi-frequency, and multimodal GNN framework. It reformulates graph construction and temporal modeling from multivariate relations, frequency decomposition, and multimodal fusion perspectives. The improvement lies in finer-grained modeling of heterogeneous conversational interactions, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.assessment: 属于对话情感识别方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知几乎无关，仅在多模态融合方法论上有间接参考价值。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.contribution: 提出多变量、多频率、多模态的图神经网络用于对话情感识别。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.innovation: 从多频率与多变量角度重构对话图建模。

2306.07646|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨模态知识蒸馏中互信息最大化目标易导致“弱教师”捷径解的问题，提出在教师与辅助模态之间额外引入互信息项，并最小化给定学生条件下教师的条件熵以缩小信息差。方法上分别用对比学习和对抗学习设计训练方案来优化互信息与条件熵。相比已有跨模态KD方法，其改进在于避免了教师退化为与学生同等弱的问题。在三个多模态基准数据集上，该方法在视频识别、视频检索和情感分类任务上优于多种SOTA方法。
2306.07646|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the weak-teacher shortcut in cross-modal knowledge distillation, where maximizing mutual information alone drives the teacher to be as weak as the student. It introduces an additional mutual information term between the teacher and the auxiliary modality model, and minimizes the teacher's conditional entropy given the student to narrow the information gap. Contrastive and adversarial training schemes are designed accordingly, and the method outperforms a range of state-of-the-art approaches on three multimodal benchmarks for video recognition, video retrieval, and emotion classification.
2306.07646|v2.assessment: 对跨模态蒸馏的理论缺陷分析清晰，方法设计合理，实验覆盖多个任务，对多模态表示学习有参考价值，但与3D感知直接相关度一般。
2306.07646|v2.contribution: 提出防止弱教师捷径解的跨模态知识蒸馏目标与训练方案。
2306.07646|v2.innovation: 引入教师-辅助模态互信息与教师条件熵约束，结合对比与对抗学习优化。
2306.07646|v2.result: 在三个多模态基准上于视频识别、检索和情感分类任务超越多种SOTA方法。

SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D形状补全、重建与生成任务，提出SDFusion多模态框架，利用符号距离场（SDF）作为统一表示并结合多模态条件进行生成。方法上以扩散模型为基础，将文本、图像等多模态输入映射到SDF生成过程，实现从部分观测到完整形状的补全与生成。相比已有单模态3D生成方法，其改进在于统一了补全、重建与生成三类任务并支持多模态条件控制。摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需参考正文。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D shape completion, reconstruction, and generation with SDFusion, a multimodal framework built on signed distance fields (SDF). It leverages a diffusion-based generative model conditioned on multimodal inputs such as text and images to produce complete 3D shapes from partial observations. The improvement over prior single-modality 3D generation methods lies in unifying completion, reconstruction, and generation under multimodal conditioning, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.assessment: 多模态3D生成方向工作，SDF与扩散模型结合思路有启发性，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测感知任务相关度有限。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.contribution: 提出基于SDF与扩散模型的多模态3D形状补全、重建与生成统一框架。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.innovation: 以SDF为统一表示并支持文本、图像等多模态条件控制生成。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_cn: 针对多摄像头多目标跟踪（MTMC）在真实场景中缺乏大规模多模态基准的问题，论文提出了MTMMC，一个大规模真实世界多模态摄像头跟踪基准。该基准包含多摄像头、多模态（RGB和热成像）数据，覆盖不同天气和光照条件，并提供详细的标注。相比已有基准，MTMMC在规模、模态多样性和场景复杂性上均有显著提升，为多摄像头跟踪算法提供了更全面的评估平台。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale multimodal benchmarks for multi-target multi-camera tracking in real-world scenarios, this paper introduces MTMMC, a large-scale real-world multi-modal camera tracking benchmark. It includes multi-camera, multi-modal (RGB and thermal) data across diverse weather and lighting conditions with detailed annotations. Compared to existing benchmarks, MTMMC significantly improves scale, modality diversity, and scene complexity, providing a more comprehensive evaluation platform for multi-camera tracking algorithms.
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.assessment: 该基准填补了多模态多摄像头跟踪领域的空白，对自动驾驶和监控场景下的多摄像头感知研究具有重要价值。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.contribution: 提出了首个大规模真实世界多模态多摄像头跟踪基准MTMMC。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.innovation: 融合RGB和热成像模态，覆盖多样环境条件，推动多模态跟踪研究。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.result: 为多摄像头跟踪算法提供了更全面、更具挑战性的评估基准。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo._arxiv_id: MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Modal Camera Tracking Benchmark.

MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_cn: 针对专家级AGI评估中多学科多模态理解与推理能力缺乏系统基准的问题，论文提出了MMMU，一个大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准。该基准涵盖六大核心学科（艺术、商业、科学、健康、人文、技术）和30个学科，包含11.5K道由专家标注的多模态问题，要求模型具备大学水平的学科知识和 deliberate reasoning 能力。相比已有基准，MMMU在学科广度、问题难度和推理深度上均有大幅提升，实验显示当前最先进的多模态模型（如GPT-4V）准确率仅为56%，远低于人类专家的88.6%，揭示了巨大差距。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic benchmarks for evaluating expert-level AGI in multi-disciplinary multimodal understanding and reasoning, this paper introduces MMMU, a massive multi-discipline multimodal understanding and reasoning benchmark. It covers six core disciplines and 30 subjects with 11.5K expert-annotated multimodal questions, requiring college-level knowledge and deliberate reasoning. Compared to existing benchmarks, MMMU significantly increases disciplinary breadth, question difficulty, and reasoning depth. Experiments show that state-of-the-art multimodal models (e.g., GPT-4V) achieve only 56% accuracy, far below human experts' 88.6%, revealing a substantial gap.
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.assessment: MMMU是评估多模态大模型专家级推理能力的重要基准，对推动AGI研究具有里程碑意义。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.contribution: 提出了大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准MMMU。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.innovation: 覆盖30个学科、11.5K专家级问题，要求大学水平知识与推理。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.result: GPT-4V准确率仅56%，人类专家达88.6%，凸显模型与人类差距。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo._arxiv_id: MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI.

MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏全面基准的问题，论文提出了MVBench，一个涵盖20个视频理解任务的综合基准。该基准通过将静态图像任务自动转换为视频任务，系统评估模型在时间维度上的理解能力，包括动作序列、物体交互、场景转换等。相比已有视频基准，MVBench更注重时间推理和动态信息，实验表明现有视频LLM在多个任务上表现不佳，尤其在需要细粒度时间理解的任务上准确率较低。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_en: To address the lack of comprehensive benchmarks for multimodal video understanding, this paper introduces MVBench, a comprehensive benchmark covering 20 video understanding tasks. It automatically converts static image tasks into video tasks to systematically evaluate models' temporal understanding, including action sequences, object interactions, and scene transitions. Compared to existing video benchmarks, MVBench emphasizes temporal reasoning and dynamic information. Experiments show that current video LLMs perform poorly on many tasks, especially those requiring fine-grained temporal understanding.
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.assessment: MVBench为视频多模态理解提供了系统评估工具，对推动视频LLM的时间推理研究具有重要意义。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.contribution: 提出了涵盖20个任务的综合多模态视频理解基准MVBench。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.innovation: 通过静态到动态任务转换，系统评估时间维度理解能力。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.result: 现有视频LLM在细粒度时间理解任务上准确率较低，暴露不足。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid._arxiv_id: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark.

2402.17553|v2.summary_cn: 针对自主虚拟代理在桌面和Web环境中执行计算机任务的能力评估问题，论文提出了OmniACT，首个用于评估代理生成可执行程序以完成计算机任务的数据集和基准。该数据集涵盖桌面应用和Web任务，从简单操作（如播放下一首歌）到长时程任务（如发送邮件），要求代理根据屏幕图像和自然语言指令生成脚本。相比已有工作，OmniACT扩展了任务范围并提供了更真实的评估环境，实验显示现有模型在长时程任务上表现有限。
2402.17553|v2.summary_en: To evaluate autonomous virtual agents' ability to perform computer tasks in desktop and web environments, this paper introduces OmniACT, the first dataset and benchmark for assessing agents' capability to generate executable programs for computer tasks. It covers desktop applications and web tasks, from simple actions (e.g., play next song) to long-horizon tasks (e.g., send email), requiring agents to generate scripts from screen images and natural language instructions. Compared to prior work, OmniACT expands task scope and provides a more realistic evaluation environment. Experiments show that current models perform limitedly on long-horizon tasks.
2402.17553|v2.assessment: OmniACT为多模态自主代理在真实计算机环境中的任务执行提供了重要基准，但相关度相对较低。
2402.17553|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估代理生成可执行程序完成计算机任务的数据集和基准OmniACT。
2402.17553|v2.innovation: 涵盖桌面和Web应用，支持从简单到长时程任务的评估。
2402.17553|v2.result: 现有模型在长时程任务上表现有限，揭示了自主代理的挑战。

MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）安全性评估不足的问题，论文提出了MM-SafetyBench，一个用于评估MLLM安全性的基准。该基准通过构建包含恶意意图的图像-文本对，系统测试模型在生成有害内容方面的脆弱性，涵盖多种攻击类型和有害类别。相比已有安全基准，MM-SafetyBench更全面地覆盖了多模态场景下的安全风险，实验表明现有MLLM在面对精心设计的对抗性输入时容易生成不安全内容，安全对齐仍有较大提升空间。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_en: To address the insufficient safety evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this paper introduces MM-SafetyBench, a benchmark for safety evaluation of MLLMs. It constructs image-text pairs with malicious intent to systematically test model vulnerability in generating harmful content, covering multiple attack types and harm categories. Compared to existing safety benchmarks, MM-SafetyBench more comprehensively covers safety risks in multimodal scenarios. Experiments show that current MLLMs are prone to generating unsafe content under adversarial inputs, indicating significant room for improvement in safety alignment.
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.assessment: MM-SafetyBench对多模态大模型的安全评估至关重要，为构建可信多模态系统提供了基准。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.contribution: 提出了多模态大语言模型安全性评估基准MM-SafetyBench。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.innovation: 系统构建恶意图像-文本对，覆盖多种攻击类型和有害类别。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.result: 现有MLLM在对抗性输入下易生成不安全内容，安全对齐不足。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E._arxiv_id: MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models.

TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_cn: 针对夜间车辆监控中缺乏多模态航空基准的问题，论文提出了TrafficNight，一个用于夜间车辆监控的航空多模态基准。该基准包含配准的RGB和热成像视频，覆盖夜间复杂交通场景，并提供车辆检测和跟踪标注。相比已有白天或单模态基准，TrafficNight专注于夜间挑战，实验表明多模态融合能显著提升夜间车辆检测与跟踪性能，为夜间航空监控研究提供了重要数据支持。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_en: To address the lack of multimodal aerial benchmarks for nighttime vehicle surveillance, this paper introduces TrafficNight, an aerial multimodal benchmark for nighttime vehicle surveillance. It includes registered RGB and thermal videos covering complex nighttime traffic scenes with vehicle detection and tracking annotations. Compared to existing daytime or unimodal benchmarks, TrafficNight focuses on nighttime challenges. Experiments show that multimodal fusion significantly improves nighttime vehicle detection and tracking performance, providing important data support for nighttime aerial surveillance research.
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.assessment: TrafficNight填补了夜间航空多模态车辆监控基准的空白，对自动驾驶和监控领域有实用价值。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.contribution: 提出了夜间航空多模态车辆监控基准TrafficNight。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.innovation: 融合RGB和热成像，专注于夜间复杂交通场景。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.result: 多模态融合显著提升夜间车辆检测与跟踪性能。

2403.10943|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态意图识别中现有基准规模小、难以处理多轮对话中出现的域外（out-of-scope）样本的问题，论文构建了大规模基准数据集 MIntRec2.0。该数据集包含 1,245 段对话、15,040 个样本，采用 30 类细粒度意图分类体系，其中 9,304 个为域内样本、5,736 个为多轮语境下自然出现的域外样本，并提供了说话人信息。作者还建立了支持单轮/多轮数据组织、模态特征提取、多模态融合以及域内分类与域外检测的通用框架，并用经典融合方法和 ChatGPT 等进行了评测。相比已有基准，其规模更大且首次系统性地覆盖多轮对话中的域外检测。
2403.10943|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MIntRec2.0, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal intent recognition in multi-party conversations, addressing the limited scale of existing datasets and their inability to handle out-of-scope samples in multi-turn interactions. It contains 1,245 dialogues with 15,040 samples under a 30-class fine-grained intent taxonomy, including 9,304 in-scope and 5,736 out-of-scope samples, plus speaker information. A general framework supporting single/multi-turn data organization, modality fusion, in-scope classification and out-of-scope detection is established and evaluated with classic fusion methods and ChatGPT.
2403.10943|v2.assessment: 数据集构建扎实、标注体系细致，对多模态对话理解与开放集识别有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2403.10943|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多模态意图识别与域外检测基准 MIntRec2.0 及配套评测框架。
2403.10943|v2.innovation: 首次在多轮多方对话场景中系统引入并标注域外样本，支持域内分类与域外检测联合评测。
2403.10943|v2.result: 提供 1,245 段对话、15,040 个样本（含 5,736 个域外样本）的基准，并给出经典融合方法与 ChatGPT 的评测结果。

2402.04788|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）缺乏与人类偏好对齐的评测基准这一问题，论文提出 MLLM-as-a-Judge 基准，评估 MLLM 在打分评估、成对比较和批量排序三类任务中的评判能力。研究发现 MLLM 在成对比较上表现出接近人类的判别力，但在打分评估和批量排序上与人类偏好存在显著偏差，且即使 GPT-4V 等先进模型也普遍存在偏见、幻觉和不一致问题。该工作为将 MLLM 用作可靠评估者之前所需的改进提供了实证依据。
2402.04788|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MLLM-as-a-Judge, a benchmark assessing multimodal LLMs' ability to act as judges across Scoring Evaluation, Pair Comparison, and Batch Ranking tasks, motivated by the lack of human-preference-aligned multimodal benchmarks. It finds that MLLMs show human-like discernment in Pair Comparison but diverge significantly from human preferences in Scoring and Batch Ranking, with persistent biases, hallucinations, and inconsistencies even in GPT-4V. These findings highlight the need for further research before MLLMs can serve as reliable evaluators.
2402.04788|v2.assessment: 对 MLLM 评测可靠性提出了有价值的实证质疑，方法学上有借鉴意义，但与视觉感知任务本身关系不大。
2402.04788|v2.contribution: 提出了评估多模态大模型作为评判者的多任务基准 MLLM-as-a-Judge。
2402.04788|v2.innovation: 将 LLM-as-a-Judge 范式扩展到多模态场景，并系统揭示 MLLM 评判中的偏见与不一致。
2402.04788|v2.result: 发现 MLLM 在成对比较上接近人类水平，但在打分与批量排序上显著偏离人类偏好，GPT-4V 亦存在偏见与幻觉。

2406.05862|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）高阶图像感知能力缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出 II-Bench，一个评估图像隐含意义理解的基准。该基准通过多难度层次的图像与问题设计，覆盖抽象与复杂语义，并对多个 MLLM 进行广泛实验。相比已有基准，II-Bench 更聚焦于高阶感知而非基础识别，发现 MLLM 最高准确率仅 74.8%，而人类平均 90%、峰值 98%，且模型在抽象复杂图像上表现更差。此外，加入图像情感极性提示可提升多数模型准确率，揭示其依赖提示线索的缺陷。
2406.05862|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces II-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating higher-order perceptual capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on image implication understanding. Extensive experiments reveal a substantial gap between MLLMs (peak 74.8%) and humans (average 90%, peak 98%), with models performing worse on abstract and complex images. The study also finds that incorporating image sentiment polarity hints improves most models' accuracy, highlighting their reliance on explicit cues.
2406.05862|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了 MLLM 高阶感知评测的空白，实验发现对理解模型能力边界有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2406.05862|v2.contribution: 提出了首个针对图像隐含意义理解的多模态大模型基准 II-Bench。
2406.05862|v2.innovation: 聚焦高阶感知而非基础识别，并系统分析了情感提示对模型表现的影响。
2406.05862|v2.result: MLLM 最高准确率 74.8%，远低于人类平均 90% 和峰值 98%，且在抽象复杂图像上表现更差。

2406.10215|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型与儿童语言学习轨迹的对比问题，论文提出 DevBench，一个包含词汇、句法和语义三个维度共七项任务的多模态发展基准，并配有儿童和成人的行为数据。研究评估了多个视觉-语言模型，不仅比较准确率，还比较其响应模式与人类的相似度。发现模型在不同任务上与人类响应模式的接近程度存在差异，且任务表现越好的模型越接近人类行为；OpenCLIP 的训练轨迹显示更多训练使其更接近成人响应模式。
2406.10215|v2.summary_en: This paper presents DevBench, a multimodal developmental benchmark with seven language evaluation tasks spanning lexical, syntactic, and semantic abilities, accompanied by behavioral data from children and adults. Evaluating vision-language models, it finds that models' closeness to human response patterns varies across tasks, and better task performance correlates with closer resemblance to human behavior. OpenCLIP's training trajectory shows that more training leads to closer approximations of adult response patterns.
2406.10215|v2.assessment: 该工作为模型与人类语言学习对比提供了新工具，但主要面向认知科学与语言学习，与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关。
2406.10215|v2.contribution: 构建了包含儿童与成人行为数据的多模态语言发展基准 DevBench。
2406.10215|v2.innovation: 不仅比较准确率，还系统比较模型与人类的响应模式相似度。
2406.10215|v2.result: 模型在不同任务上与人类响应模式的接近程度各异，且表现越好的模型越接近人类行为。

2410.08593|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频语料时刻检索（VCMR）仅支持粗粒度理解、难以精确定位细粒度查询的问题，论文提出更难的细粒度 VCMR 基准，要求从包含部分匹配候选的语料中定位最佳匹配时刻。为高效构建高质量标注，提出 VERIFIED 自动视频-文本标注流水线，利用 LLM 和 LMM 结合静态与动态增强描述模块生成多样化细粒度描述，并通过细粒度感知噪声评估器过滤幻觉标注。基于 VERIFIED 构建了更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准。
2410.08593|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a more challenging fine-grained Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) benchmark that requires localizing the best-matched moment from a corpus with partially matched candidates. It introduces VERIFIED, an automatic video-text annotation pipeline leveraging LLMs and LMMs with statics and dynamics enhanced captioning modules, and a fine-granularity aware noise evaluator to filter hallucinated annotations. A more challenging fine-grained VCMR benchmark is constructed based on VERIFIED.
2410.08593|v2.assessment: 该工作推动了细粒度视频理解与检索，标注流水线设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2410.08593|v2.contribution: 提出了细粒度 VCMR 基准及自动标注流水线 VERIFIED。
2410.08593|v2.innovation: 结合静态与动态增强描述模块及噪声评估器，实现高质量细粒度视频标注。
2410.08593|v2.result: 构建了更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准，具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2406.14515|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统 VideoQA 基准无法全面覆盖视频内容且对时序理解评估不足的问题，论文提出 MMBench-Video，一个用于严格评估 LVLM 视频理解能力的定量基准。该基准采用 YouTube 长视频和自由形式问题，贴近实际使用场景，所有问题由人工根据精心构建的能力分类体系标注，并采用 GPT-4 进行自动评估，证明其比早期基于 LLM 的评估更准确和鲁棒。利用该基准对专有和开源图像/视频 LVLM 进行了全面评估。
2406.14515|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMBench-Video, a quantitative benchmark for rigorously evaluating LVLMs' video understanding, addressing limitations of traditional VideoQA benchmarks in content coverage and temporal comprehension. It incorporates lengthy YouTube videos and free-form questions, with all questions human-annotated according to a carefully constructed ability taxonomy, and employs GPT-4 for automated assessment, demonstrating superior accuracy and robustness over earlier LLM-based evaluations. Comprehensive evaluations of proprietary and open-source LVLMs are conducted.
2406.14515|v2.assessment: 该工作为长视频多镜头理解提供了更贴近实际的评测基准，对视频理解研究有推动意义，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
2406.14515|v2.contribution: 提出了面向长视频多镜头整体理解的高质量基准 MMBench-Video。
2406.14515|v2.innovation: 采用自由形式问题和 GPT-4 自动评估，结合人工标注的能力分类体系。
2406.14515|v2.result: GPT-4 自动评估比早期 LLM 评估更准确鲁棒，并对多种 LVLM 进行了全面评测。

2407.15754|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）输入越来越长、越来越丰富但缺乏公开基准来衡量的现状，本文提出了 LongVideoBench，一个视频-语言交错输入长达一小时的问答基准。作者将核心挑战定义为从长输入中准确检索并推理细粒度多模态信息，并据此提出名为 referring reasoning 的新视频问答任务：问题中包含引用查询（referring query）指向相关视频上下文（referred context），模型需在该上下文中推理相关视频细节。基于此范式，作者构建了 3,763 个不同长度、来自网络并带字幕的多主题视频，以及 6,678 个人工标注的多选题，覆盖 17 个细粒度类别，成为最全面的长视频理解基准之一。
2407.15754|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of public benchmarks for increasingly long and rich multimodal inputs, this paper introduces LongVideoBench, a question-answering benchmark featuring video-language interleaved inputs up to one hour long. The authors formulate a novel referring reasoning task, where a referring query in the question points to related video contexts over which the model must reason, and curate 3,763 web-collected videos with subtitles plus 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice questions across 17 fine-grained categories. This establishes one of the most comprehensive benchmarks for long-form video understanding.
2407.15754|v2.assessment: 长视频多模态理解评测是当前 VLM 研究的重要缺口，该基准规模大、任务设计有针对性，对做视频理解与多模态的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2407.15754|v2.contribution: 提出了面向长视频-语言交错理解的大规模问答基准 LongVideoBench 及 referring reasoning 新任务范式。
2407.15754|v2.innovation: 将长视频理解的核心挑战形式化为从引用上下文中检索并推理细粒度多模态信息，并据此设计 17 类细粒度评测。
2407.15754|v2.result: 构建了 3,763 个视频与 6,678 道人工标注多选题，成为最全面的长视频理解基准之一。

2506.21549|v2.summary_cn: 针对工业制造中单实例3D异常检测与分割（ADS）缺乏多视角多模态基准的问题，论文提出SiM3D，首个融合多视角与多模态信息、以体素级Anomaly Volume为输出的ADS基准。该基准包含用高端工业传感器与机器人采集的新数据集，覆盖8类物体共333个实例，提供12Mpx多视角图像与7M点云，并给出异常测试样本的手动3D分割GT，同时首次关注从合成训练数据泛化到真实测试数据的场景。作者将主流单视角方法适配到多视角3D ADS任务，并提出在Anomaly Volume上运行的新指标建立基线。该工作为工业3D异常检测提供了标准化评测平台，但摘要未给出具体性能数值。
2506.21549|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SiM3D, the first benchmark for multiview multimodal 3D anomaly detection and segmentation (ADS) that outputs a voxel-based Anomaly Volume, targeting the single-instance manufacturing scenario where only one real or synthetic object is available for training. It provides a new dataset with 12 Mpx multiview images and 7M-point point clouds for 333 instances across eight object types, plus manually annotated 3D segmentation ground truth, and uniquely addresses synthetic-to-real generalization. Prominent single-view methods are adapted as baselines and evaluated with novel metrics operating on Anomaly Volumes.
2506.21549|v2.assessment: 作为首个多视角多模态3D异常检测基准，数据集规模与传感器规格较高，对工业视觉与3D感知研究者有参考价值。
2506.21549|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向单实例、多视角多模态的3D异常检测与分割基准及配套数据集与评测指标。
2506.21549|v2.innovation: 首次将多视角多模态融合与合成到真实的泛化设定引入3D ADS，并以体素级Anomaly Volume为统一输出。
2506.21549|v2.result: 提供了333个实例、8类物体的多模态数据与手动3D分割GT，并建立了单视角方法适配的多视角基线。

2410.10139|v2.summary_cn: 针对交错式多模态理解与生成（模型按任意序列产生和解读图像与文本）评测不足、现有基准在数据规模、范围与评测深度上受限、评测指标昂贵或有偏的问题，论文提出MMIE，一个大规模知识密集型基准。MMIE包含2万条精心筛选的多模态查询，覆盖3大类、12个领域、102个子领域（含数学、编程、物理、文学、健康、艺术等），支持交错输入输出，混合选择题与开放式问答。作者还提出基于人工标注数据微调评分模型并结合系统化评价标准的可靠自动评测指标，以降低偏差。该工作为LVLM交错多模态能力提供了更全面的评测，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2410.10139|v2.summary_en: To address the insufficient evaluation of interleaved multimodal comprehension and generation, this paper introduces MMIE, a large-scale knowledge-intensive benchmark with 20K curated multimodal queries spanning 3 categories, 12 fields, and 102 subfields, supporting both interleaved inputs and outputs with mixed multiple-choice and open-ended formats. It further proposes a reliable automated metric based on a scoring model fine-tuned with human-annotated data and systematic criteria to reduce bias. MMIE enables more comprehensive evaluation of LVLMs in interleaved multimodal settings.
2410.10139|v2.assessment: MMIE在数据规模与领域覆盖上较为全面，并针对评测偏差提出自动指标，对多模态评测研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2410.10139|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模知识密集型交错多模态理解与生成基准MMIE及配套自动评测指标。
2410.10139|v2.innovation: 支持交错输入输出并覆盖102个子领域，同时用人工标注微调的评分模型降低评测偏差。
2410.10139|v2.result: 提供2万条多模态查询、3大类12领域102子领域的评测集与更可靠的自动评分方案。

2502.19870|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态知识编辑基准仅聚焦实体级简单三元组、无法刻画真实世界多模态知识复杂性的问题，作者提出 MMKE-Bench 综合基准。该基准包含视觉实体编辑、视觉语义编辑和用户特定编辑三类任务，并用自由形式自然语言表示和编辑知识。基准覆盖 33 个大类、2940 条知识和 8363 张图像，评测问题自动生成并经人工校验。作者在三种主流 LMM 上评估了五种 SOTA 知识编辑方法，为多模态知识更新提供了更贴近现实的评测平台。
2502.19870|v2.summary_en: Existing multimodal knowledge editing benchmarks focus on entity-level triplets and fail to capture real-world complexity. The authors introduce MMKE-Bench, covering visual entity editing, visual semantic editing, and user-specific editing with free-form natural language knowledge representations. It contains 2,940 knowledge items and 8,363 images across 33 categories, with human-verified questions, and evaluates five state-of-the-art editing methods on three LMMs.
2502.19870|v2.assessment: 为多模态知识编辑提供了更贴近真实场景的评测基准，对关注 LMM 知识更新的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2502.19870|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖三类编辑任务、用自由文本表示知识的大规模多模态知识编辑基准 MMKE-Bench。

2408.13257|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLM benchmarks suffer from small scale, model-based annotations, and insufficient difficulty due to limited image resolution. 2410.08474|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SPORTU, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on multi-level sports reasoning, comprising 900 text-based multiple-choice questions with human-annotated explanations and 1,701 slow-motion video clips across 7 sports with 12,048 QA pairs. The benchmark offers a fine-grained diagnostic tool for sports-domain multimodal reasoning, though it is not directly relevant to autonomous driving perception.
