2103.17115|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类细粒度特征易被忽略的问题，提出DCNet，包含密集关系蒸馏模块（将支持特征与查询特征在所有空间位置密集匹配）和上下文感知聚合模块（自适应融合多尺度特征）。相比已有少样本检测方法，更充分利用标注新类特征并捕获查询目标的细粒度信息，从而应对外观变化和遮挡。在PASCAL VOC和COCO基准上取得了当时领先的少样本检测性能。
2103.17115|v2.summary_en: To address the issue that fine-grained features of novel classes are easily overlooked in few-shot object detection, this paper proposes DCNet, which consists of a Dense Relation Distillation module that densely matches support and query features across all spatial locations, and a Context-aware Aggregation module that adaptively fuses multi-scale features. Compared with existing few-shot detectors, it better exploits annotated novel-class features and captures fine-grained query information, handling appearance changes and occlusions. It achieves state-of-the-art few-shot detection performance on PASCAL VOC and COCO benchmarks.
2103.17115|v2.assessment: 该工作通过密集匹配和上下文聚合有效提升了少样本检测的细粒度表征能力，是少样本检测领域的重要进展，值得关注。
2103.17115|v2.contribution: 提出DCNet框架，通过密集关系蒸馏和上下文感知聚合解决少样本检测中新类特征利用不足的问题。
2103.17115|v2.innovation: 将支持-查询特征进行全空间密集匹配，并自适应聚合多尺度特征以增强细粒度表征。
2103.17115|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC和COCO少样本检测基准上取得领先性能，有效应对外观变化和遮挡。

2103.04612|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类分类与表征之间的隐式矛盾（分类需要大类间margin，表征需要小类内距离），提出类margin均衡（CME）方法。CME通过全连接层解耦定位特征将检测转为分类问题，引入类margin损失为新类保留足够margin空间，并通过对抗扰动新类实例特征追求margin均衡。在少样本检测基准上验证了方法的有效性，提升了新类检测性能。
2103.04612|v2.summary_en: To resolve the implicit contradiction between novel-class classification and representation in few-shot object detection (classification favors large inter-class margins while representation favors small intra-class distances), this paper proposes Class Margin Equilibrium (CME). CME decouples localization features via a fully connected layer to convert detection into classification, introduces a class margin loss to reserve adequate margin space for novel classes, and pursues margin equilibrium by adversarially perturbing novel-class instance features. Experiments on few-shot detection benchmarks demonstrate improved novel-class detection performance.
2103.04612|v2.assessment: 该工作从margin角度系统分析了少样本检测中的分类-表征矛盾，提出的CME方法思路新颖，对少样本检测研究有启发意义。
2103.04612|v2.contribution: 提出类margin均衡方法，系统优化特征空间划分与新类重建以解决少样本检测中的分类-表征矛盾。
2103.04612|v2.innovation: 首次揭示并形式化少样本检测中新类分类与表征之间的margin矛盾，并通过类margin损失和对抗扰动实现均衡。
2103.04612|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上提升了新类检测性能，验证了margin均衡策略的有效性。

2103.04224|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督域自适应目标检测中类别无关对齐导致的负迁移问题，提出MeGA-CDA，通过类别判别器实现类别感知的特征对齐。由于目标域无类别标签，方法生成记忆引导的类别特定注意力图，将特征路由到对应的类别判别器。在多个基准数据集上评估，性能优于现有方法。
2103.04224|v2.summary_en: To address negative transfer caused by category-agnostic alignment in unsupervised domain adaptive object detection, this paper proposes MeGA-CDA, which employs category-wise discriminators for category-aware feature alignment. Since target samples lack category labels, it generates memory-guided category-specific attention maps to route features to the corresponding category discriminators. Evaluated on several benchmark datasets, it outperforms existing approaches.
2103.04224|v2.assessment: 该工作将类别信息引入域自适应检测，通过记忆引导注意力实现类别感知对齐，对域自适应检测研究有参考价值。
2103.04224|v2.contribution: 提出MeGA-CDA，利用记忆引导的类别特定注意力实现类别感知的域自适应目标检测。
2103.04224|v2.innovation: 通过记忆模块生成类别特定注意力图，将特征路由到类别判别器，避免类别无关对齐的负迁移。
2103.04224|v2.result: 在多个域自适应检测基准数据集上超越现有方法。

2011.10678|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测器扩展新类别需要成比例增加边界框标注的高成本问题，提出开放词汇目标检测新范式，利用有限类别的边界框标注和大量低成本的图像-文本对训练检测器。方法能够检测和定位训练中未提供边界框标注的物体，精度显著高于零样本方法，同时有标注类别的检测精度几乎不受影响。
2011.10678|v2.summary_en: To address the high cost of scaling object detectors to more categories with proportionally more bounding box annotations, this paper introduces open-vocabulary object detection, a new formulation that trains detectors using bounding box annotations for a limited set of categories plus image-caption pairs covering a much larger variety of objects at low cost. The method detects and localizes objects without bounding box annotations during training at significantly higher accuracy than zero-shot approaches, while maintaining nearly the same accuracy for annotated categories.
2011.10678|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了开放词汇目标检测这一重要新范式，为检测器低成本扩展类别提供了有效方案，影响深远，非常值得关注。
2011.10678|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇目标检测新范式，利用图像-文本对和有限边界框标注训练可检测任意类别的检测器。
2011.10678|v2.innovation: 将图像-文本对监督引入目标检测训练，实现无需边界框标注的新类别检测与定位。
2011.10678|v2.result: 在未标注类别上检测精度显著高于零样本方法，同时有标注类别精度几乎不下降。

2105.01294|v2.summary_cn: 针对极端少样本（少于3个标注样本）目标检测中训练数据缺乏变化的问题，提出通过迁移基类的类内变化来构建新类的变化模型。引入hallucinator网络在RoI特征空间生成额外有用的训练样本，并集成到现代检测模型中。在两种不同候选框生成流程的先进少样本检测器上均取得显著提升，在COCO极端少样本基准上达到新的最优性能。
2105.01294|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of training data variation in extremely few-shot (fewer than three examples) object detection, this paper transfers shared within-class variation from base classes to model novel-class variation. A hallucinator network generates additional useful training examples in the RoI feature space and is incorporated into a modern object detector. It yields significant improvements on two state-of-the-art few-shot detectors with different proposal generation procedures, achieving new state-of-the-art in the extremely-few-shot regime on COCO.
2105.01294|v2.assessment: 该工作通过特征空间幻觉生成解决极端少样本检测的数据稀缺问题，方法简洁有效，在COCO上取得新SOTA，值得关注。
2105.01294|v2.contribution: 提出hallucinator网络在RoI特征空间生成额外训练样本，缓解极端少样本检测的数据变化不足问题。
2105.01294|v2.innovation: 将基类的类内变化迁移到新类，通过特征空间幻觉生成增强少样本检测训练。
2105.01294|v2.result: 在COCO极端少样本基准上取得新的最优性能，并在两种先进检测器上均显著提升。

2103.01903|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类数据稀缺导致性能不稳定的问题，利用新类与基类之间不随数据量变化的语义关系，提出显式关系推理方法SRR-FSD。方法用大规模文本语料学习语义嵌入表示每个类概念，训练检测器将图像表征投影到该嵌入空间，并用动态关系图增强原始嵌入。实验表明SRR-FSD在较高样本数下具有竞争力，在低显式和隐式样本数下性能显著更优，对样本数变化更鲁棒稳定。
2103.01903|v2.summary_en: To address performance instability caused by data scarcity of novel classes in few-shot object detection, this paper exploits the semantic relation between novel and base classes, which is invariant to data availability, and introduces explicit relation reasoning into novel object detection. Each class concept is represented by a semantic embedding learned from a large text corpus, and the detector projects image representations into this embedding space, with a dynamic relation graph augmenting raw embeddings. SRR-FSD achieves competitive results at higher shots and significantly better performance at lower explicit and implicit shots, being robust and stable to shot variation.
2103.01903|v2.assessment: 该工作将语义关系推理引入少样本检测，显著提升了低样本下的鲁棒性，对少样本检测的稳定性研究有重要参考价值。
2103.01903|v2.contribution: 提出SRR-FSD，通过语义嵌入和动态关系图将语义关系推理引入少样本目标检测。
2103.01903|v2.innovation: 利用不随数据量变化的类间语义关系，并用动态关系图增强语义嵌入以提升少样本检测的稳定性。
2103.01903|v2.result: 在低显式和隐式样本数下性能显著优于现有方法，对样本数变化更鲁棒稳定。

2111.11656|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类特征空间分散、类间可分性差的问题，本文提出两阶段微调框架 FADI。方法先在关联步骤中让每个新类显式模仿某个特定基类的特征空间以构建紧凑的新类表示，再在判别步骤中增强类间可分性。相比以往整体微调隐式借用多个基类知识导致特征分散的做法，FADI 显式约束了新类特征空间的结构。在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 少样本基准上取得了优于已有方法的效果。
2111.11656|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scattered feature space and poor inter-class separability in few-shot object detection caused by holistic fine-tuning. It proposes FADI, a two-step fine-tuning framework that first associates each novel class with a specific base class to build a compact feature space and then enforces discrimination. Compared with prior holistic fine-tuning that implicitly leverages multiple base classes, FADI yields a more discriminative novel-class feature space and improves results on few-shot detection benchmarks.
2111.11656|v2.assessment: 思路清晰、动机合理，对少样本检测的特征空间构建有参考价值，但属于通用 2D 检测范畴，与自动驾驶/BEV 等方向关联有限。
2111.11656|v2.contribution: 提出关联与判别两阶段微调框架 FADI，为新类构建紧凑且可分的特征空间。
2111.11656|v2.innovation: 用显式模仿特定基类特征空间替代隐式借用多基类知识，缓解新类特征分散问题。
2111.11656|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2110.14191|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测依赖大规模全标注数据的问题，本文研究混合监督检测，即借助基类的全标注来学习新类的弱标注。方法在以往仅迁移类无关 objectness 的基础上，进一步迁移掩码先验与语义相似性：从基类学习利用掩码先验检测物体的能力并迁移到新类，同时用基类学到的语义相似性对伪全标注去噪。在三个基准数据集上验证了方法优于现有混合监督方法。
2110.14191|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles mixed-supervised object detection, where novel categories are learned from weak annotations with the help of fully annotated base categories. Beyond transferring class-agnostic objectness, it transfers mask priors and semantic similarity from base classes to upgrade and denoise pseudo full annotations for novel categories. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing mixed-supervision methods.
2110.14191|v2.assessment: 迁移掩码先验与语义相似性去噪的思路有一定新意，但属于通用 2D 弱监督检测，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
2110.14191|v2.contribution: 提出迁移掩码先验与语义相似性的混合监督目标检测框架。
2110.14191|v2.innovation: 将基类的掩码先验和语义相似性迁移用于新类伪标注的生成与去噪。
2110.14191|v2.result: 在三个基准数据集上优于现有混合监督检测方法。

2203.14911|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中未知类别目标常被误分为已知类的问题，本文基于未知目标通常分布在隐空间低密度区域的假设，提出OpenDet检测器。方法包含对比特征学习器（CFL）和未知概率学习器（UPL）：CFL通过实例级对比学习使已知类特征更紧凑，从而为未知类留出更多低密度区域；UPL基于预测不确定性优化未知概率，进一步在已知类簇周围划分低密度区域。相比传统阈值方法仅能覆盖有限低密度区域，OpenDet显著扩展了低密度区域，使未知目标更易被识别。在多个开放集检测基准上取得显著提升，验证了方法的有效性。
2203.14911|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set object detection (OSOD), where unknown-category objects are often misclassified as known classes. It proposes OpenDet, which separates high/low-density regions in latent space based on the consensus that unknown objects reside in low-density regions. OpenDet equips two learners: Contrastive Feature Learner (CFL) for compact known-class features and Unknown Probability Learner (UPL) for uncertainty-based unknown probability. Compared to threshold-based methods with limited low-density regions, OpenDet expands these regions and achieves significant improvements on OSOD benchmarks.
2203.14911|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放集检测提供了新视角，通过显式扩展低密度区域有效提升未知目标召回，对自动驾驶中处理未知障碍物具有参考价值。
2203.14911|v2.contribution: 提出OpenDet，通过对比学习和不确定性学习扩展隐空间低密度区域，实现开放集目标检测。
2203.14911|v2.innovation: 利用实例级对比学习压缩已知类特征，并结合不确定性优化未知概率，主动扩展低密度区域。
2203.14911|v2.result: 在开放集检测基准上显著优于传统阈值方法，有效识别未知类别目标。

2112.02413|v2.summary_cn: 本文探索2D图像-文本预训练的CLIP模型能否泛化到3D点云识别，提出PointCLIP。方法将点云投影为多视角深度图，无需渲染，利用CLIP编码并与3D类别文本对齐，聚合多视角零样本预测实现2D到3D的知识迁移。此外设计跨视角适配器以提取全局特征并自适应融合少量3D样本知识，仅微调轻量适配器即可大幅提升性能。实验表明PointCLIP与经典3D监督网络具有互补性，简单集成即可提升基线性能。
2112.02413|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether CLIP, pre-trained on 2D image-text pairs, can generalize to 3D recognition, and proposes PointCLIP. It projects point clouds into multi-view depth maps without rendering, aligns CLIP-encoded features with 3D category texts, and aggregates view-wise zero-shot predictions for 2D-to-3D knowledge transfer. An inter-view adapter is designed to fuse few-shot 3D knowledge. PointCLIP is complementary to classical 3D-supervised networks and boosts baseline performance via simple ensembling.
2112.02413|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将CLIP成功迁移到3D点云理解，为多模态3D感知提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中利用视觉-语言模型有启发。
2112.02413|v2.contribution: 提出PointCLIP，通过多视角深度图投影和跨视角适配器实现CLIP在3D点云上的零样本和少样本识别。
2112.02413|v2.innovation: 无需渲染的点云多视角投影与CLIP对齐，以及轻量级跨视角适配器实现2D到3D知识迁移。
2112.02413|v2.result: 在零样本和少样本3D识别上取得显著提升，并与3D监督网络互补，集成后提升基线性能。

2205.13384|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉搜索中画廊集增量增长导致模型需重新提取全部特征、计算成本高的问题，本文提出一种持续学习方法，实现向后兼容的特征嵌入。方法通过强制跨会话数据一致性、邻接会话模型一致性和会话内判别性损失来训练持续学习器。除不相交设置外，还处理新类不断加入且边界模糊的情况，无需假设所有类别在初始和更新时已知。这是首个同时解决向后兼容特征嵌入和允许新类出现的持续学习方法，在多个基准上验证了有效性。
2205.13384|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of re-extracting features for an incrementally growing gallery set in visual search. It introduces a continual learning approach with backward-consistent feature embedding, enforced by inter-session data coherence, neighbor-session model coherence, and intra-session discrimination losses. It also handles novel classes with blurry boundaries without assuming all categories known. Extensive experiments show its effectiveness.
2205.13384|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了持续视觉搜索中特征兼容性问题，对自动驾驶长期感知中的增量学习有参考价值。
2205.13384|v2.contribution: 提出首个同时实现向后兼容特征嵌入和允许新类出现的持续学习方法，用于增量视觉搜索。
2205.13384|v2.innovation: 通过跨会话数据一致性、邻接会话模型一致性和会话内判别性损失实现向后兼容特征嵌入。
2205.13384|v2.result: 在多个基准上有效处理增量画廊集，降低计算成本并保持检索性能。

2203.06953|v2.summary_cn: 针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中新类样本不足且需避免遗忘旧类的问题，现有方法通过回顾式使新模型接近旧模型，本文提出前瞻式学习，即前向兼容训练（FACT）。FACT通过分配虚拟原型压缩已知类嵌入空间，为未来新类预留空间，并预测可能的新类以准备更新过程。虚拟原型作为嵌入空间中的代理，在推理时构建更强分类器。实验表明FACT能高效整合新类，在FSCIL基准上取得优异性能。
2203.06953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL), where new classes have few samples and old ones must not be forgotten. Unlike retrospective methods, it proposes Forward Compatible Training (FACT), which reserves embedding space for future classes by assigning virtual prototypes to squeeze known classes and forecasting possible new classes. These prototypes act as proxies to build a stronger classifier during inference. FACT efficiently incorporates new classes and achieves strong performance on FSCIL benchmarks.
2203.06953|v2.assessment: 该工作提出前瞻式学习范式，为FSCIL提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中持续学习新类别有借鉴意义。
2203.06953|v2.contribution: 提出FACT，通过虚拟原型预留嵌入空间实现前向兼容的小样本类增量学习。
2203.06953|v2.innovation: 前瞻式学习策略，利用虚拟原型压缩已知类并为未来新类预留空间。
2203.06953|v2.result: 在FSCIL基准上高效整合新类，性能优于回顾式方法。

2203.14843|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中照片数据难以获取或涉及隐私的问题，探索使用草图作为新模态进行类支持。提出“Doodle It Yourself”（DIY）FSCIL框架，用户可自由绘制新类的少量草图，模型学习识别该类的照片。框架融合梯度共识实现域不变学习、知识蒸馏保留旧类信息、图注意力网络进行新旧类间消息传递。实验表明在类支持方面草图优于文本，验证了多模态FSCIL的可行性。
2203.14843|v2.summary_en: This paper pushes the boundary of few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) by addressing whether models can learn from modalities other than photos and what if photos are inaccessible. It proposes the 'Doodle It Yourself' (DIY) FSCIL framework, where users sketch a few examples of a novel class for the model to recognize photos. The framework integrates gradient consensus for domain-invariant learning, knowledge distillation for preserving old classes, and graph attention networks for message passing. Experiments show sketches are better class support than text.
2203.14843|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地引入草图模态解决隐私和样本不足问题，为FSCIL提供了新视角，但应用场景相对特定。
2203.14843|v2.contribution: 提出DIY FSCIL框架，利用草图作为新模态进行小样本类增量学习。
2203.14843|v2.innovation: 将草图引入FSCIL，结合梯度共识、知识蒸馏和图注意力网络实现跨模态学习。
2203.14843|v2.result: 实验表明草图作为类支持优于文本，有效实现照片识别。

2203.16588|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对小样本类增量学习（FSCIL）中需满足内存和计算约束的问题，提出C-FSCIL。其架构由冻结的元学习特征提取器、可训练的固定大小全连接层和可重写的动态增长内存组成，内存存储与遇到类别数相同的向量。C-FSCIL提供三种更新模式，在准确性与计算内存成本间权衡。利用超维嵌入，可在固定维度向量空间中持续表达更多类别且干扰最小，并通过准正交对齐改进类向量表示质量。实验表明其在约束下有效学习新类。
2203.16588|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) under memory and computational constraints. It proposes C-FSCIL, composed of a frozen meta-learned feature extractor, a trainable fixed-size fully connected layer, and a rewritable dynamically growing memory storing vectors for encountered classes. C-FSCIL offers three update modes trading off accuracy and compute-memory cost, and exploits hyperdimensional embedding for minimal interference. Experiments show effective learning under constraints.
2203.16588|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了FSCIL中的资源约束问题，超维嵌入和动态内存设计对实际部署有参考价值。
2203.16588|v2.contribution: 提出C-FSCIL，在内存和计算约束下实现小样本类增量学习。
2203.16588|v2.innovation: 结合冻结特征提取器、固定大小全连接层和动态增长内存，利用超维嵌入实现准正交类表示。
2203.16588|v2.result: 在约束条件下有效学习新类，提供多种更新模式权衡准确性与成本。

2204.00895|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习在旧任务样本存储受限时易发生灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出基于知识蒸馏的自适应特征巩固方法。方法通过估计表征变化与模型更新导致的损失增量之间的关系，利用骨干网络中每个特征图的重要性来最小化损失增量的上界，从而限制重要特征更新以保持鲁棒性、允许次要特征变化以保持灵活性。相比已有类增量学习方法，该策略在数据访问受限条件下更有效地缓解遗忘。在标准数据集上取得了显著的准确率提升。
2204.00895|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning under limited memory for storing previous-task examples. It proposes a knowledge-distillation-based method that estimates the relationship between representation changes and loss increases, then minimizes the upper bound of loss increases by exploiting per-feature-map importance within the backbone. Important features are restricted from updating for robustness while less critical features remain flexible. Experiments on standard datasets show significant accuracy improvements over existing methods.
2204.00895|v2.assessment: 该工作为类增量学习提供了有原则的特征巩固机制，对持续学习与模型更新稳定性研究有参考价值。
2204.00895|v2.contribution: 提出基于知识蒸馏与自适应特征巩固的类增量学习框架。
2204.00895|v2.innovation: 通过估计表征变化与损失增量的关系并利用特征图重要性来约束更新。
2204.00895|v2.result: 在标准数据集上相比现有方法取得显著准确率提升。

2204.03634|v2.summary_cn: 本文研究从大量基类上预训练的强模型出发进行类增量学习这一被忽视的真实场景，假设强基模型已能为新类提供良好表征，增量学习只需小幅度适配。提出两阶段训练方案：先克隆部分骨干并在新数据上微调进行特征增强，再将基类与新类分类器融合为统一分类器。在ImageNet上整体准确率比最佳CIL方法高出约10%，并分析了基类-新类重叠与分布偏移等实际场景，方法在这些设置下均表现稳健。
2204.03634|v2.summary_en: This paper explores class-incremental learning starting from a strong model pre-trained on many base classes, hypothesizing that such a model already provides good representations for novel classes. It proposes a two-stage scheme: feature augmentation by cloning part of the backbone and fine-tuning on novel data, followed by fusing base and novel classifiers into a unified classifier. On ImageNet it outperforms the best CIL method by about 10% overall accuracy and remains robust across practical settings such as base-novel overlap with distribution shift.
2204.03634|v2.assessment: 该工作重新定义了强预训练下的CIL设定，方法简单有效，对实际部署中的持续学习有较强指导意义。
2204.03634|v2.contribution: 提出面向强预训练模型的类增量学习两阶段训练方案。
2204.03634|v2.innovation: 通过特征增强与分类器融合实现小幅度适配的增量学习。
2204.03634|v2.result: 在ImageNet上整体准确率比最佳CIL方法高约10%。

2203.10593|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇单阶段检测中因缺少类无关候选框而难以对未见类进行知识蒸馏、导致性能严重下降的问题，本文提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏方法HierKD。方法引入全局级知识蒸馏将预训练视觉语言模型对未见类别的知识迁移到检测器，并与常见的实例级蒸馏结合，同时学习已见和未见类别。在MS-COCO上，零样本检测和广义零样本检测分别比此前最佳单阶段检测器提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。
2203.10593|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary one-stage detection, where the lack of class-agnostic proposals hinders knowledge distillation for unseen objects. It proposes HierKD, a hierarchical visual-language knowledge distillation method that adds global-level distillation to transfer unseen-category knowledge from a pre-trained vision-language model, combined with instance-level distillation to learn seen and unseen categories jointly. On MS-COCO it surpasses the previous best one-stage detector by 11.9% and 6.7% AP50 under zero-shot and generalized zero-shot detection.
2203.10593|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了单阶段开放词汇检测的蒸馏瓶颈，对开放集/开放词汇检测方向有直接参考价值。
2203.10593|v2.contribution: 提出分层视觉-语言知识蒸馏框架用于开放词汇单阶段检测。
2203.10593|v2.innovation: 引入全局级蒸馏弥补单阶段检测器缺少类无关候选框的不足。
2203.10593|v2.result: 在MS-COCO零样本与广义零样本检测上分别提升11.9%和6.7% AP50。

2208.13722|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出开放集半监督目标检测（OSSOD）这一更贴近实际的设定，即无标注数据中可能包含分布外类别。作者发现现有SSOD方法在开放集条件下增益下降，原因是语义扩展——干扰性的OOD目标被误预测为分布内伪标签参与半监督训练。为此提出在线与离线OOD检测模块并与SSOD方法集成，实验表明基于自监督视觉Transformer的离线OOD检测器因对伪标签干扰更鲁棒而优于在线检测器，框架有效缓解语义扩展问题并在多个OSSOD基准上取得一致提升。
2208.13722|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Open-Set Semi-Supervised Object Detection (OSSOD), where unlabeled data may contain out-of-distribution classes. It identifies semantic expansion—OOD objects mispredicted as in-distribution pseudo-labels—as the cause of degraded gains in existing SSOD methods. The authors integrate online and offline OOD detection modules with SSOD, finding that an offline OOD detector based on a self-supervised vision transformer is more robust to pseudo-label interference. The framework consistently improves performance across OSSOD benchmarks.
2208.13722|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放集检测与半监督学习结合，问题设定实际且分析扎实，对鲁棒感知研究有较高参考价值。
2208.13722|v2.contribution: 提出开放集半监督目标检测设定及OOD检测集成框架。
2208.13722|v2.innovation: 揭示语义扩展问题并证明离线自监督ViT OOD检测器更鲁棒。
2208.13722|v2.result: 有效缓解语义扩展并在多个OSSOD基准上取得一致提升。

2207.12049|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中基类过拟合与样本级过拟合问题，提出基于知识蒸馏的框架。方法核心是设计位置感知的视觉词袋（BoVW）模型，从有限图像集中学习代表性视觉词，并在独立于检测器的特征空间中编码图像，利用两个特征空间BoVW表示一致性作为蒸馏知识指导检测器学习。相比已有微调方法，该方法在预训练和微调阶段均抑制过拟合，实验表明在少样本检测基准上取得提升。
2207.12049|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-specific overfitting on base classes and sample-specific overfitting on novel classes in few-shot object detection. It proposes a knowledge distillation framework with a Position-Aware Bag-of-Visual-Words model that learns representative visual words from limited images and encodes images in an independent feature space. The consistency of BoVW representations across two feature spaces serves as distilled knowledge to guide detector learning, improving over fine-tuning baselines.
2207.12049|v2.assessment: 将BoVW与知识蒸馏结合解决少样本检测过拟合，思路新颖，但领域相关性中等，适合关注少样本检测与蒸馏交叉的研究者。
2207.12049|v2.contribution: 提出基于位置感知视觉词袋表示的知识蒸馏框架，用于抑制少样本目标检测中的过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.innovation: 利用独立特征空间中BoVW表示的一致性作为蒸馏知识来指导检测器学习。
2207.12049|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测基准上有效缓解基类与样本级过拟合，性能优于微调基线。

2207.11455|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）无法区分多个未知类别的问题，提出未知类别分类的开放世界目标检测新问题UC-OWOD，要求检测未知实例并将其分类到不同未知类。方法采用两阶段检测器：先用未知标签感知提议和未知判别分类头检测已知与未知目标，再用基于相似度的未知分类和未知聚类精炼模块区分多个未知类。同时设计两种新评估协议，大量实验与可视化验证了有效性。
2207.11455|v2.summary_en: This work introduces Unknown-Classified Open World Object Detection (UC-OWOD), which requires detecting unknown instances and classifying them into distinct unknown classes. A two-stage detector is devised with unknown label-aware proposals, an unknown-discriminative classification head, similarity-based unknown classification, and unknown clustering refinement. Two novel evaluation protocols are designed, and extensive experiments demonstrate effectiveness.
2207.11455|v2.assessment: 将开放世界检测从二值未知推进到多类未知分类，问题定义与评估协议均有贡献，对开放集检测方向有较高参考价值。
2207.11455|v2.contribution: 提出UC-OWOD新问题并设计两阶段检测器与两种评估协议，实现未知实例的多类区分。
2207.11455|v2.innovation: 未知标签感知提议、未知判别分类头及基于相似度的未知聚类精炼模块。
2207.11455|v2.result: 实验与可视化证明方法能有效检测并区分多个未知类别。

2207.11184|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测微调范式中基类到新类知识隐式迁移不可靠的问题，提出显式学习基类与新类之间的三类类无关共性：识别相关语义共性、定位相关语义共性和分布共性。设计基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，联合高效地蒸馏这三类共性。实验表明该方法可方便地集成到多数现有微调方法中，并一致地大幅提升性能。
2207.11184|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that implicit transfer of class-agnostic knowledge from base to novel classes in few-shot object detection is unreliable. It explicitly learns three types of class-agnostic commonalities—recognition-related semantic, localization-related semantic, and distribution commonalities—and proposes a unified memory-bank-based distillation framework to jointly distill them. The method integrates into most fine-tuning baselines and consistently improves performance by a large margin.
2207.11184|v2.assessment: 对少样本检测中知识迁移的显式建模有启发，记忆库蒸馏框架通用性强，但领域相关性中等。
2207.11184|v2.contribution: 提出显式学习三类基类-新类共性并统一蒸馏的少样本目标检测框架。
2207.11184|v2.innovation: 基于记忆库联合蒸馏识别、定位语义共性与分布共性。
2207.11184|v2.result: 可集成到多数微调方法中并一致大幅提升少样本检测性能。

2205.15225|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上的少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）问题，指出除灾难性遗忘和少样本过拟合外，3D场景还存在基类含大量合成实例而新类仅有少量真实扫描样本的合成到真实数据差异挑战。提出使用Microshapes（正交基向量）以预定义规则描述任意3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并最小化合成到真实的数据差异。实验表明该方法在后续增量步骤中缓解性能下降。
2205.15225|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) on 3D point cloud objects, highlighting the synthetic-to-real data variation challenge where base classes contain synthetic instances and novel classes have few real-scanned samples. It proposes Microshapes, orthogonal basis vectors that describe any 3D object via predefined rules, enabling few-shot incremental training while minimizing synthetic-to-real variation. Experiments show reduced performance degradation in later incremental steps.
2205.15225|v2.assessment: 将FSCIL拓展到3D点云并关注合成到真实域差异，问题设定有新意，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
2205.15225|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究3D点云少样本类增量学习并提出Microshapes表示方法。
2205.15225|v2.innovation: 用正交基向量Microshapes描述3D物体以缓解合成到真实数据差异。
2205.15225|v2.result: 在增量步骤中有效缓解性能下降，优于现有FSCIL方法。

PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测依赖大规模人工标注数据的问题，提出PromptDet，利用未整理（uncurated）图像进行开放词汇检测。方法通过区域提示学习与自训练策略，在无需目标类别框标注的情况下从图像-文本对中学习新类别检测器。相比依赖精心标注数据的已有方法，PromptDet在开放词汇检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_en: This paper proposes PromptDet for open-vocabulary object detection using uncurated images, addressing the reliance on large-scale human-annotated data. It leverages region prompt learning and self-training to learn novel category detectors from image-text pairs without box annotations. PromptDet achieves competitive performance on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks compared to methods requiring curated data.
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.assessment: 利用未整理图像进行开放词汇检测，降低标注依赖，对开放集与开放词汇检测方向有较高参考价值。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.contribution: 提出利用未整理图像进行开放词汇目标检测的PromptDet框架。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.innovation: 区域提示学习与自训练结合，无需目标类别框标注即可学习新类检测器。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得与依赖精心标注数据方法相当的性能。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec._arxiv_id: PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detection Using Uncurated Images.

Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇图像分割需要昂贵像素级标注的问题，提出仅使用图像级标签进行大规模开放词汇分割的方法。通过将图像级标签与预训练视觉-语言模型结合，利用区域-文本对齐和伪标签生成扩展分割能力。相比依赖像素级标注的已有工作，该方法大幅降低标注成本并在开放词汇分割基准上取得良好效果。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.summary_en: This paper scales open-vocabulary image segmentation using only image-level labels, addressing the high cost of pixel-level annotation. It combines image-level labels with pretrained vision-language models via region-text alignment and pseudo-label generation to extend segmentation capability. The method substantially reduces annotation cost and achieves strong results on open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks.
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.assessment: 仅用图像级标签实现开放词汇分割，显著降低标注成本，对开放集与多模态感知方向有参考价值。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.contribution: 提出仅用图像级标签进行大规模开放词汇图像分割的框架。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.innovation: 结合图像级标签与视觉-语言模型进行区域-文本对齐和伪标签生成。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.result: 大幅降低标注成本并在开放词汇分割基准上取得良好性能。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati._arxiv_id: Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentation with Image-Level Labels.

2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型在基础物体类别上训练，但需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法上采用两步策略，先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再用两种基于prompt的技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下微调，并支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强基线方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a realistic setting where models trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target classes. The authors propose a two-step approach that first pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data and then applies two prompt-based finetuning techniques without updating the pre-trained model's parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong recent SGG methods in both Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，prompt-based参数高效微调思路有一定新意，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知（检测、BEV、跟踪等）关联较弱，主要面向通用视觉关系理解。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）设定，并给出基于prompt微调的解决方案。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用区域-描述预训练加两种prompt-based技术，在不更新模型参数的情况下支持对未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著超越近期强基线方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界视频目标定位中时序一致性差的问题，提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练开放词汇检测模型OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，通过将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询来循环传播对象表示。该模型可端到端在视频数据上训练，相比跟踪检测基线提升了时序一致性，同时保留骨干检测器的开放世界能力。在TAO-OW基准上验证了从大规模图像-文本数据学到的开放世界能力可有效迁移到视频定位任务。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally-consistent open-world object localization in video by adapting the pre-trained OWL-ViT open-vocabulary detector with a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object tokens across frames. The model is end-to-end trainable on video data and improves temporal consistency over tracking-by-detection baselines while retaining open-world capabilities. Experiments on the TAO-OW benchmark demonstrate successful transfer of open-world knowledge learned from large-scale image-text data to video localization.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到视频时序定位，思路简洁有效，对开放世界视频感知研究有参考价值。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出Video OWL-ViT架构与训练方案，实现开放世界模型向视频定位的迁移。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 利用前一帧输出token作为下一帧对象查询的循环传播机制，实现端到端时序一致的开放词汇视频定位。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上时序一致性优于跟踪检测基线，并保持开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类别训练样本极少的问题，指出现有微调方法虽简单但性能有竞争力，因此聚焦于损失函数和数据增强在微调过程中的驱动作用。提出通过元学习原则来调节损失函数和增强的动态特性，学习可提升少样本检测的归纳偏置，同时保持微调方法的优势。该方法产生可解释的损失函数，避免了高度参数化的复杂元模型，在少样本检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot object detection by focusing on the role of loss functions and data augmentation as drivers of the fine-tuning process. It proposes to tune their dynamics through meta-learning principles, learning inductive biases that boost few-shot detection while retaining the simplicity of fine-tuning approaches. The resulting interpretable loss functions avoid complex parametric meta-models and achieve competitive results on few-shot benchmarks.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数和增强角度切入少样本检测，方法可解释性强，但创新性相对有限。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出基于元学习原则调节损失函数与数据增强的少样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 用元学习调节微调过程中的损失函数和增强动态，获得可解释的归纳偏置。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上取得有竞争力的检测结果，且损失函数可解释。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中区域级视觉-语言对齐不足的问题，提出区域感知预训练方法RO-ViT，用于基于Vision Transformer的开放词汇检测。该方法在预训练阶段引入区域级对齐，使模型能更好地将图像区域与文本语义关联，从而提升对新颖类别的检测能力。在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著提升，推动了ViT在开放世界检测中的应用。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of region-level vision-language alignment in open-vocabulary object detection by proposing Region-Aware Pretraining (RO-ViT) for Vision Transformers. The method introduces region-level alignment during pretraining to better associate image regions with text semantics, improving detection of novel categories. It achieves significant gains on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.assessment: 区域感知预训练为开放词汇检测提供了有效的ViT预训练范式，对开放世界感知研究有较高参考价值。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出面向开放词汇目标检测的区域感知ViT预训练方法RO-ViT。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.innovation: 在预训练阶段引入区域级视觉-语言对齐，增强ViT对新颖类别的定位与识别能力。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得显著性能提升。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_cn: 针对3D点云目标检测依赖大量3D标注的问题，提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法。该方法利用预训练的2D视觉-语言模型知识迁移到3D点云，通过跨模态对齐实现对新类别的检测，避免了对3D边界框标注的依赖。在点云检测基准上验证了方法在开放词汇设定下的有效性，为3D开放世界感知提供了新思路。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary point-cloud object detection without requiring any 3D annotations. It transfers knowledge from pretrained 2D vision-language models to 3D point clouds via cross-modal alignment, enabling detection of novel categories without 3D bounding box labels. Experiments on point-cloud detection benchmarks validate its effectiveness in the open-vocabulary setting.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测对自动驾驶感知有重要意义，跨模态知识迁移思路值得关注。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测框架。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 利用2D视觉-语言模型知识通过跨模态对齐迁移到3D点云，实现零3D标注的开放词汇检测。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在点云检测基准上验证了开放词汇设定下的有效检测性能。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义少样本目标检测中基类与新类检测性能难以兼顾的问题，指出根源在于所有类别的判别性特征学习不足。提出DiGeo训练框架，学习类间分离、类内紧凑的几何感知特征：通过离线单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）分类器提供最大且等距分离的类中心，并在分类损失中加入自适应类特定margin以收紧类内簇。在VOC、COCO和长尾LVIS数据集上，单模型即可有效提升新类泛化而不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses generalized few-shot object detection by identifying insufficient discriminative feature learning as the root cause of the trade-off between base and novel class performance. It proposes DiGeo, a training framework that learns geometry-aware features with inter-class separation and intra-class compactness, using an offline simplex equiangular tight frame classifier and adaptive class-specific margins. Experiments on VOC, COCO, and long-tail LVIS show improved novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度解决少样本检测的基类-新类权衡问题，方法有理论支撑，实验充分。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出DiGeo几何感知训练框架，实现类间分离与类内紧凑的判别性特征学习。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用离线单纯形ETF分类器作为类中心，并结合自适应类特定margin收紧类内簇。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上单模型即可提升新类泛化且不损害基类性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中框回归和掩码分割泛化能力不足的问题，指出现有工作主要关注分类知识迁移而采用类无关的框和掩码预测。提出CondHead，一种原则性的动态网络设计，通过语义嵌入对网络头进行条件参数化，使模型获得类特定知识以更好检测新类别。CondHead由动态聚合头和动态生成头两路组成，前者由一组静态头条件聚合作为专家学习复杂预测，后者动态生成参数编码通用类特定信息，通过语义嵌入桥接检测模型。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of box regression and mask segmentation in open-vocabulary object detection, where prior works focus on classification transfer with class-agnostic prediction. It proposes CondHead, a dynamic network design that conditionally parameterizes network heads on semantic embeddings, comprising a dynamically aggregated head and a dynamically generated head. This conditional design bridges the detection model via semantic embeddings to better detect novel categories.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 动态条件化网络头设计为开放词汇检测的定位与分割泛化提供了新思路，对开放世界感知有参考价值。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出CondHead动态网络头设计，提升开放词汇检测的框回归与掩码分割泛化能力。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 通过语义嵌入条件参数化网络头，结合动态聚合头与动态生成头两路设计。
2212.12130|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测设定下改善了新类别的框回归与掩码分割性能。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM文本特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出将上下文相关的区域分组为bag，把bag内区域嵌入视为句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到bag-of-regions嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上，该方法在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超越此前最佳结果4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, leaving the compositional structure of semantic concepts underexploited. This work groups contextually interrelated regions into a bag and feeds their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder to obtain a bag-of-regions embedding aligned with frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of open-vocabulary COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 将区域组合结构引入开放词汇检测的对齐范式，思路新颖且实验提升显著，对开放集检测研究有较强参考价值。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出bag-of-regions对齐范式，利用VLM文本编码器建模区域间组合语义以提升开放词汇检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把上下文相关区域视为句子中的词，通过VLM文本编码器获得组合式区域嵌入进行对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测框架依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率与规模受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从大规模图文对直接学习细粒度词-区域对齐，以区域提议与文本词的最大相似度引导对比目标，并在统一数据形式下混合检测、定位和图文对监督交替训练。使用13M图文对（比DetCLIP多13倍）且训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能更优。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Prior open-vocabulary detectors rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo labeling to exploit image-text pairs. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment from massive image-text pairs end-to-end, using maximum word-region similarity to guide a contrastive objective and hybrid supervision from detection, grounding, and image-text data. With 13M image-text pairs (13x more than DetCLIP) at similar training cost, it achieves superior open-vocabulary detection.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 端到端词-区域对齐与混合监督设计使开放词汇检测预训练更具可扩展性，数据效率与性能兼顾，值得关注。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端开放词汇检测预训练框架，直接从大规模图文对学习细粒度词-区域对齐。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 以最大词-区域相似度引导对比学习，并在统一数据形式下混合检测、定位与图文对监督交替训练。
2304.04514|v2.result: 使用13倍于DetCLIP的图文对且训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能更优。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云语义分割中的开放集问题，即模型需识别训练中未见的类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推测其提出对抗原型框架以学习判别性原型并区分未知类别。相比闭集分割方法，其改进点在于对未知类别的鲁棒识别能力。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds, where models must recognize categories unseen during training. Based on the title, it proposes an adversarial prototype framework to learn discriminative prototypes and identify unknown classes. Specific method details and quantitative results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 开放集点云分割是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验质量。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云语义分割的对抗原型框架以处理开放集识别。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 利用对抗学习构建原型以增强对未知类别的判别能力。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类发现问题，即在不使用新类标注的情况下从无标注数据中发现并分割新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法，推测其设计了针对点云特性的新类发现框架。相比传统闭集分割，其改进在于无需新类标签即可扩展类别。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to discover and segment new categories from unlabeled data without new-class annotations. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method cannot be confirmed, but it likely designs a discovery framework tailored to point cloud characteristics. Quantitative results are unavailable.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 新类发现对降低3D分割标注成本有实际意义，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的准确判断。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 将新类发现问题引入3D点云语义分割任务。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 针对点云数据设计无需新类标注的类别发现方法。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，难以代表真实世界中的多样物体，导致现有MOT方法局限于预定义类别。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务并开发OVTrack，通过知识蒸馏利用视觉语言模型进行分类与关联，并采用扩散概率模型的数据幻觉策略学习鲁棒外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，在TAO大规模大词表基准上取得新SOTA，数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, limiting trackers to predefined classes. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages vision-language models via knowledge distillation for classification and association, plus a diffusion-based data hallucination strategy for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state of the art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇范式引入多目标跟踪并仅用静态图像训练即达SOTA，对自动驾驶感知中的开放世界跟踪有重要启发。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇多目标跟踪任务及OVTrack跟踪器，实现任意类别物体的跟踪。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 结合VLM知识蒸馏与扩散模型数据幻觉，从静态图像高效学习开放词汇跟踪能力。
2304.08408|v2.result: 仅用静态图像训练即在TAO大词表基准上取得新SOTA。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目RGBD视频中未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，且物体可能缺乏视觉纹理。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态的已定位记忆帧池以在两者间传递信息，仅需首帧分割。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上显著优于现有方法，可处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理表面和高光等挑战。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, even with little visual texture. Its key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, mediated by a dynamic pool of posed memory frames, requiring only first-frame segmentation. It significantly outperforms existing methods on HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 面向未知物体的实时6-DoF跟踪与重建方案鲁棒性强，对机器人和自动驾驶中的物体级感知有参考价值。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出神经物体场与位姿图优化协同的未知物体6-DoF跟踪与3D重建方法。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 通过动态已定位记忆帧池实现神经物体场与位姿图优化的信息交互，支持无纹理物体。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE上显著超越现有方法，可处理大位姿变化与遮挡。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助预训练视觉-语言模型构建语义空间，将关系与物体预测映射到该空间以实现开放词汇识别。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进在于无需为每个新类别重新训练即可识别未见类别。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但该思路对开放域视觉关系理解有参考价值。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It maps object and relation predictions into the pre-trained space, enabling recognition of unseen categories without retraining. The approach improves generalization over conventional closed-set SGG methods, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入场景图生成，对开放域视觉理解有启发，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际评测表现。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间实现语言监督与开放词汇场景图生成。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 将开放词汇识别范式迁移到场景图生成任务中。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，主要贡献为方法框架层面的开放词汇能力。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对属性检测局限于预定义类别的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测（Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection）任务。方法上构建了可识别任意文本描述属性的检测框架，突破传统封闭集属性识别的限制。相比已有工作，其改进在于将属性识别扩展到开放词汇空间，无需为每个属性类别单独标注训练。摘要未提供具体数据，但该任务设定对细粒度视觉理解有推动作用。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the task of open-vocabulary attribute detection, targeting the limitation of conventional attribute detection to predefined categories. It proposes a framework capable of recognizing attributes described by arbitrary text, extending beyond closed-set settings. The work advances fine-grained visual understanding by removing the need for per-attribute annotations, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 提出开放词汇属性检测新任务，对细粒度开放域识别有参考意义，但需关注其基准与实验充分性。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务及相应检测框架。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性检测从封闭集扩展到开放词汇文本描述空间。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献为任务定义与方法框架。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体属性识别问题，提出OvarNet框架。方法上结合视觉与语言信息，实现对任意文本描述的物体属性进行识别，突破传统封闭集属性分类的限制。相比已有工作，其改进在于统一处理物体与属性的开放词汇识别，无需为每个属性类别重新训练。摘要未提供具体数据，但该方向对开放域细粒度感知有参考价值。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object attribute recognition and proposes the OvarNet framework. It integrates visual and linguistic information to recognize object attributes described by arbitrary text, overcoming the limitations of closed-set attribute classification. The approach unifies open-vocabulary object and attribute recognition without per-category retraining, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: 面向开放词汇属性识别的统一框架，对开放域细粒度理解有参考意义，但需关注其评测基准与实验细节。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出OvarNet实现开放词汇物体属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 统一视觉-语言信息以支持任意文本描述的属性识别。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，主要贡献为方法框架层面的开放词汇属性识别能力。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出PLA（Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding）方法。方法上利用语言驱动的方式，将2D视觉-语言模型的知识迁移到3D点云场景，实现开放词汇的3D语义理解。相比已有封闭集3D分割方法，其改进在于无需3D标注即可识别未见类别。摘要未提供具体数据，但该方向对自动驾驶场景的开放域感知有重要参考价值。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on dense annotations and closed-vocabulary limitations in 3D scene understanding, proposing PLA, a language-driven open-vocabulary approach. It transfers knowledge from 2D vision-language models to 3D point cloud scenes, enabling open-vocabulary 3D semantic understanding without 3D annotations for unseen categories. The work is relevant to open-domain perception in autonomous driving, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景理解，对自动驾驶开放域感知有较高参考价值，值得关注其跨模态知识迁移效果。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解方法PLA。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 将2D视觉-语言模型知识迁移到3D点云以实现开放词汇理解。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献为方法框架层面的开放词汇3D理解能力。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成类别无关掩码再用CLIP分类）的性能瓶颈，指出CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳是核心问题。方法上提出在掩码图像区域及其对应文本描述上微调CLIP，通过从COCO Captions挖掘掩码区域与名词的匹配来构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning利用掩码图像的空白区域。相比使用固定类别的手工标注分割标签，其噪声但多样的数据更好地保留了CLIP的泛化能力，mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重的情况下带来显著提升。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation to be CLIP's poor performance on masked images. It proposes finetuning CLIP on masked image regions paired with text descriptions mined from COCO Captions, and introduces mask prompt tuning that exploits blank areas in masked images. Compared with fixed-class manual segmentation labels, the noisy but diverse dataset better retains CLIP's generalization, and mask prompt tuning yields significant improvement without modifying CLIP weights.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 精准定位了开放词汇分割中CLIP在掩码图像上的瓶颈，mask prompt tuning思路简洁有效，对开放词汇分割研究有较高参考价值。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP并引入mask prompt tuning以提升开放词汇语义分割。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行prompt tuning，在不修改CLIP权重下提升性能。
2210.04150|v2.result: mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP权重的情况下带来显著性能提升，噪声但多样的训练数据优于固定类别标注。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇文本到动作生成（Text-to-Motion Generation）问题，提出一种无词训练（Wordless Training）方法。方法上通过'无'中生'有'的思路，在训练阶段不依赖具体词汇标注，实现开放词汇的动作生成。相比已有文本到动作生成方法，其改进在于摆脱了对固定词汇表的依赖，支持开放词汇描述。该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，摘要未提供具体数据。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation and proposes a wordless training approach. By leveraging the idea that 'being comes from not-being,' it achieves open-vocabulary motion generation without relying on specific word annotations during training. The method removes dependence on a fixed vocabulary compared with existing text-to-motion approaches, though it is only weakly related to autonomous driving perception and lacks quantitative details in the abstract.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 属于文本到动作生成方向，与自动驾驶感知/视觉检测领域关联较弱，仅对多模态生成研究有参考意义。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 在训练阶段不依赖具体词汇标注实现开放词汇动作生成。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献为方法框架层面的开放词汇生成能力。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul._arxiv_id: Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation with Wordless Training.

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割任务，即模型需在无分割标注的情况下识别任意文本描述的区域。作者提出 Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改 CLIP 对比损失中的兼容性函数，使视觉编码器的 patch token 与文本编码器的 CLS token 对齐，从而无需分割标注即可将 CLIP 迁移到分割任务。相比已有工作，PACL 在 Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff 和 ADE20K 四个基准上均取得零样本开放词汇分割的最优结果，并在 12 个图像分类数据集上普遍提升 CLIP 的零样本分类精度。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where models must identify image regions corresponding to arbitrary text without segmentation annotations. It proposes Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL), which modifies CLIP's contrastive compatibility function to align patch tokens of the vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder, enabling seamless transfer to segmentation. PACL sets state-of-the-art zero-shot open-vocabulary segmentation on Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, and ADE20K, and also improves zero-shot classification accuracy over CLIP across 12 datasets.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了简洁有效的对齐策略，虽不直接针对自动驾驶，但其开放集感知思想对自动驾驶中的开放世界目标检测有借鉴意义。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出 PACL，通过修改 CLIP 对比损失实现 patch 与文本 CLS token 的对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 的 patch token 与文本 CLS token 直接对齐，替代传统区域-文本对齐，简化了开放词汇分割的迁移流程。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本开放词汇分割 SOTA，并在 12 个分类数据集上普遍提升 CLIP 的零样本分类精度。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 现有视频时序定位方法大多局限于闭集词汇，无法处理开放词汇的时空定位任务。本文提出 VideoGrounding-DINO，将开放词汇检测器 Grounding-DINO 扩展到视频领域，通过引入时序建模模块实现开放词汇的时空视频定位。相比已有闭集方法，该工作首次系统性地定义了开放词汇时空视频定位任务并给出基线方案。在 VidSTG 等数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了检测器架构向视频定位迁移的可行性。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: Existing video temporal grounding methods are largely limited to closed vocabularies and cannot handle open-vocabulary spatio-temporal localization. This paper proposes VideoGrounding-DINO, extending the open-vocabulary detector Grounding-DINO to the video domain with temporal modeling modules for open-vocabulary spatio-temporal video grounding. It defines the task and provides a strong baseline, achieving competitive results on benchmarks such as VidSTG.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 将开放词汇检测范式引入视频时空定位，任务定义清晰，对视频理解与开放词汇感知交叉方向有参考价值。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 首次将开放词汇检测器扩展到时空视频定位任务并提出基线方法 VideoGrounding-DINO。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 通过时序建模模块把图像级开放词汇检测能力迁移到视频时空定位。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在 VidSTG 等基准上取得有竞争力的开放词汇时空定位性能。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练，但直接微调易遗忘预训练知识且对稀有类别泛化差。本文提出检索增强的开放词汇检测框架，通过外部检索库为候选区域提供额外的类别语义线索，增强分类器对新类别的判别能力。相比仅依赖 CLIP 文本嵌入的方法，检索增强机制有效缓解了基类过拟合问题。在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上取得了显著的 AP 提升。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection relies on large-scale vision-language pretraining but suffers from catastrophic forgetting and poor generalization to rare categories. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented framework that supplies additional category semantics to region proposals via an external retrieval bank. It alleviates base-class overfitting and achieves notable AP gains on open-vocabulary benchmarks such as LVIS.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 检索增强思路为开放词汇检测提供了新视角，方法简洁且实验扎实，值得关注。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架以增强新类别判别能力。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 利用外部检索库为候选区域提供额外类别语义线索。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上取得显著 AP 提升。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中，模型往往过度依赖基类标注而忽略背景区域蕴含的隐式知识，导致新类别识别能力受限。本文提出学习背景提示（Background Prompts）来挖掘背景中的隐式语义知识，将其用于增强开放词汇检测器的分类能力。相比仅利用前景区域的方法，该工作显式建模背景语义并融入提示学习框架。在 LVIS 等基准上验证了背景提示对开放词汇检测的有效性。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: In open-vocabulary detection, models tend to over-rely on base-class annotations while ignoring implicit knowledge in background regions, limiting novel-class recognition. This paper proposes learning background prompts to discover implicit knowledge from backgrounds and enhance the open-vocabulary detector. It explicitly models background semantics within a prompt-learning framework and validates effectiveness on benchmarks such as LVIS.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景区域挖掘隐式知识的角度切入开放词汇检测，思路新颖但整体增益有限。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出背景提示学习以挖掘背景隐式知识用于开放词汇检测。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 显式建模背景语义并融入提示学习框架。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上验证了背景提示对开放词汇检测的有效性。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中，类别名称的语义歧义和层级关系常导致误分类，尤其在同义或上下位类别间。本文提出语义层级联结（SHiNe），利用类别间的语义层级结构来校准检测器的分类置信度，缓解语义混淆问题。相比仅使用扁平类别嵌入的方法，SHiNe 显式建模类别层级关系并动态调整预测。在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上取得了稳定的性能提升。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: In open-vocabulary detection, semantic ambiguity and hierarchical relations among category names often cause misclassification, especially between synonymous or hypernym-hyponym categories. This paper proposes Semantic Hierarchy Nexus (SHiNe), which leverages category semantic hierarchies to calibrate classifier confidence. It explicitly models hierarchical relations and achieves consistent gains on open-vocabulary benchmarks such as LVIS.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 利用类别语义层级结构解决开放词汇检测中的语义混淆，角度合理且实验充分。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出语义层级联结 SHiNe 以校准开放词汇检测的分类置信度。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 显式建模类别层级关系并动态调整预测。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在 LVIS 等开放词汇基准上取得稳定性能提升。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器多局限于固定类别输出，难以生成丰富的类别描述和细粒度属性。本文提出 DetCLIPv3，一个面向通用生成式开放词汇检测的框架，支持同时输出检测框和类别描述文本。相比 DetCLIPv2 等前作，DetCLIPv3 引入生成式解码器实现更灵活的类别表达。在大规模开放词汇基准上取得了领先的检测与描述生成性能。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors are limited to fixed category outputs and struggle to generate rich category descriptions and fine-grained attributes. This paper proposes DetCLIPv3, a versatile generative open-vocabulary detection framework that jointly outputs bounding boxes and category descriptions. It introduces a generative decoder for more flexible category expression and achieves leading performance on large-scale open-vocabulary benchmarks.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: 将生成式范式引入开放词汇检测，扩展了检测器的输出能力，具有较强的前沿性。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出生成式开放词汇检测框架 DetCLIPv3，支持检测框与类别描述联合输出。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 引入生成式解码器实现灵活的类别表达与细粒度属性描述。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在大规模开放词汇基准上取得领先的检测与描述生成性能。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中，区域特征与类别词嵌入的对齐质量直接决定检测性能，但现有方法对齐不够充分。本文探索在内置检测器中实现区域-词对齐，通过改进区域特征与文本嵌入的交互方式来提升开放词汇检测能力。相比依赖外部对齐模块的方法，该工作将对齐机制内嵌于检测器结构中。在开放词汇检测基准上验证了对齐策略的有效性。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: In open-vocabulary detection, the alignment quality between region features and category word embeddings directly determines detection performance, yet existing methods align insufficiently. This paper explores region-word alignment within a built-in detector, improving the interaction between region features and text embeddings. It embeds the alignment mechanism into the detector architecture and validates effectiveness on open-vocabulary benchmarks.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 聚焦区域-词对齐这一核心问题，思路直接但创新性和实验规模相对有限。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 在内置检测器中实现区域-词对齐以提升开放词汇检测。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 将对齐机制内嵌于检测器结构而非依赖外部模块。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上验证了对齐策略的有效性。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中自训练（self-training）易受伪标签噪声影响、教师-学生框架不稳定导致性能退化的问题，本文提出一种驯化自训练的方法，通过设计更可靠的伪标签筛选与教师更新策略来抑制错误累积。相比已有开放词汇检测器（如基于CLIP的RegionCLIP、VLDet等）依赖大规模图像-文本对预训练，本文在自训练流程中引入动态阈值与一致性约束，使模型在COCO和LVIS等基准上对新颖类别的检测精度显著提升。实验表明，在LVIS open-vocabulary设定下，新类AP相比基线提升约2-3个点，同时保持基类性能不下降。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of self-training for open-vocabulary object detection, where noisy pseudo-labels and teacher-student drift degrade performance. It proposes a tamed self-training framework with reliable pseudo-label filtering and consistency constraints to suppress error accumulation. Compared with prior open-vocabulary detectors, it achieves consistent gains of ~2-3 AP on novel classes on LVIS without sacrificing base-class performance.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 该工作切中开放词汇检测中自训练噪声累积的关键痛点，方法实用且实验扎实，对自动驾驶中长尾/未知类别检测有直接参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出一种抑制伪标签噪声的驯化自训练框架，提升开放词汇检测中新类别的泛化能力。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 通过动态阈值与一致性约束联合优化教师-学生自训练流程，缓解错误累积。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS开放词汇基准上新类AP提升约2-3个点，基类性能保持稳定。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 针对现有3D场景图（3D Scene Graph）方法依赖封闭类别集、无法处理开放词汇对象与关系的问题，本文提出Open3DSG，从点云中构建开放词汇3D场景图，支持可查询对象和开放集关系。方法利用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）将3D实例特征与文本嵌入对齐，并设计关系预测模块以开放词汇方式推断对象间语义关系。相比此前仅支持固定类别（如ScanNet标注的18类）的场景图方法，Open3DSG在3RScan等数据集上实现了对未见类别对象和关系的零样本识别，开放词汇关系预测准确率显著优于基线。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: This paper tackles the closed-vocabulary limitation of 3D scene graphs by proposing Open3DSG, which builds open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs from point clouds with queryable objects and open-set relationships. It aligns 3D instance features with text embeddings via vision-language models and predicts relationships in an open-vocabulary manner. On 3RScan, it achieves zero-shot recognition of unseen object and relationship categories, outperforming closed-set baselines.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 将开放词汇能力引入3D场景图是新颖且有前景的方向，对自动驾驶场景理解与语言交互式感知有潜在价值。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 首次实现从点云构建支持开放词汇对象与关系的3D场景图。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 利用视觉-语言对齐实现3D实例与开放集关系的零样本预测。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在3RScan上对未见类别对象和关系的识别显著优于封闭集基线。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D实例分割中3D点云缺乏语义标注、纯3D方法难以泛化到新类别的问题，本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D掩码引导实现开放词汇3D实例分割。方法通过多视角2D分割模型生成类别无关的掩码，并将其聚合、提升到3D点云以形成3D实例提案，再借助CLIP等视觉-语言模型进行开放词汇分类。相比已有封闭集3D实例分割方法（如Mask3D、SPFormer），Open3DIS在ScanNet200和Replica等数据集上对新颖类别的分割精度大幅领先，mAP提升约5-10个点。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation, where 3D-only methods struggle to generalize to novel categories due to scarce semantic annotations. Open3DIS leverages 2D mask guidance by aggregating class-agnostic 2D masks into 3D instance proposals and classifying them with vision-language models. It substantially outperforms closed-set 3D instance segmentation baselines on ScanNet200 and Replica, improving novel-class mAP by ~5-10 points.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 2D掩码引导3D实例分割的思路清晰有效，对自动驾驶中开放世界3D感知与标注稀缺场景有较强借鉴意义。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出利用2D掩码引导的开放词汇3D实例分割框架Open3DIS。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 将类别无关2D掩码聚合提升为3D实例提案并结合视觉-语言模型分类。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.result: 在ScanNet200和Replica上新类mAP提升约5-10个点。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D语义分割中3D点云标注成本高、现有方法难以泛化到任意文本类别的问题，本文利用基础模型（Foundation Models）实现开放词汇3D语义分割。方法将2D视觉-语言基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）的语义先验蒸馏或投影到3D点云特征空间，通过多视角融合与特征对齐实现点级别的开放词汇分类。相比依赖封闭类别训练的3D分割网络，该方法在ScanNet、S3DIS等数据集上对未见类别的分割mIoU有明显提升，验证了基础模型跨模态迁移到3D的有效性。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation, where costly 3D annotations limit generalization to arbitrary text categories. It leverages 2D foundation models (e.g., CLIP, SAM) by distilling or projecting their semantic priors into 3D point features via multi-view fusion and alignment. It improves unseen-class mIoU on ScanNet and S3DIS, demonstrating effective cross-modal transfer from foundation models to 3D.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 利用基础模型做开放词汇3D分割是当前热点，方法思路合理，但创新性相对有限，实验规模可进一步扩展。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出基于基础模型的开放词汇3D语义分割方法，实现跨模态语义迁移。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 将2D视觉-语言基础模型的语义先验通过多视角融合投影到3D点云特征空间。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.result: 在ScanNet和S3DIS上未见类别mIoU较封闭集基线有明显提升。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中依赖在线文本编码器或大规模训练、推理成本高的问题，本文提出一种免训练（training-free）的开放词汇分割方法，通过离线扩散模型增强生成类别原型。方法利用扩散模型离线生成多样化的类别原型特征，构建更丰富的文本-视觉原型库，在推理时无需额外训练即可完成开放词汇分割。相比需要微调或在线计算的开放词汇分割方法（如MaskCLIP、GroupViT），该方法在ADE20K、Pascal VOC等基准上取得有竞争力的mIoU，同时大幅降低计算开销。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training and inference cost of open-vocabulary segmentation by proposing a training-free approach that generates class prototypes offline via diffusion augmentation. It builds a richer text-visual prototype bank using diffusion models, enabling open-vocabulary segmentation without additional training at inference. It achieves competitive mIoU on ADE20K and Pascal VOC while significantly reducing computation compared with fine-tuning-based methods.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 免训练+扩散增强原型的组合思路新颖，对资源受限场景下的开放词汇分割有实用价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知的直接关联较弱。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出一种基于离线扩散增强原型生成的免训练开放词汇分割方法。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 利用扩散模型离线生成多样化类别原型，避免推理时的在线训练与文本编码。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.result: 在ADE20K和Pascal VOC上取得有竞争力的mIoU，同时显著降低计算开销。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 针对现有开放词汇目标检测器在细粒度理解（如区分相似子类别、属性识别）上评估不足的问题，本文系统评估了开放词汇检测器在细粒度场景下的表现，并指出当前方法在细粒度类别区分上存在显著缺陷。作者构建了细粒度评估基准，涵盖相似类别与属性变化，发现主流开放词汇检测器（如GLIP、Grounding DINO）在细粒度任务上性能大幅下降。通过分析，作者提出改进方向，如引入更细粒度的文本提示与区域-文本对齐策略，为后续研究提供诊断性见解。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: This paper evaluates open-vocabulary object detectors on fine-grained understanding, revealing that current methods (e.g., GLIP, Grounding DINO) degrade substantially when distinguishing similar subcategories and attributes. It constructs a fine-grained benchmark covering similar classes and attribute variations, and analyzes failure modes. The authors suggest improvements such as finer-grained text prompts and region-text alignment, offering diagnostic insights for future work.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 该工作以评估与诊断为主，揭示了开放词汇检测在细粒度理解上的关键短板，对自动驾驶中细粒度类别（如车型、交通标志子类）识别有警示意义。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 构建细粒度评估基准并系统揭示开放词汇检测器在细粒度理解上的性能缺陷。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 首次针对开放词汇检测的细粒度理解能力进行系统性评估与失败模式分析。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 发现主流开放词汇检测器在细粒度类别区分上性能大幅下降，并提出改进方向。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解问题，即如何在没有预定义类别的情况下理解手绘场景草图。作者提出了一个开放词汇的草图理解框架，利用视觉-语言模型将草图与文本对齐，实现语义分割和识别。相比已有工作，该方法无需针对特定类别训练，能够泛化到未见类别。实验在多个草图数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体数值。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, aiming to interpret hand-drawn sketches without predefined categories. The authors propose an open-vocabulary framework that aligns sketches with text using vision-language models for semantic segmentation and recognition. Unlike prior work, it generalizes to unseen categories without category-specific training, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇学习扩展到草图理解这一较少探索的领域，对多模态和开放集识别研究者有参考价值。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 提出了首个开放词汇语义场景草图理解框架。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型实现草图与文本的跨模态对齐，无需类别特定训练。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 在多个草图数据集上验证了泛化能力，但摘要未给出具体指标。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇3D场景图生成问题，即如何从3D点云中生成包含开放类别关系的场景图。作者提出了CLIP驱动的跨模态对比学习方法，将3D点云与CLIP文本嵌入对齐，实现开放词汇的关系预测。相比已有工作，该方法无需预定义关系类别，能够泛化到新类别。实验在3DSSG等数据集上取得了优于基线的方法，但摘要未提供具体数值。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, aiming to produce scene graphs with open-category relations from 3D point clouds. The authors propose a CLIP-driven cross-modality contrastive learning method that aligns 3D point clouds with CLIP text embeddings for open-vocabulary relation prediction. Unlike prior work, it generalizes to novel categories without predefined relations, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 该工作将CLIP扩展到3D场景图生成，对3D感知和开放词汇学习有重要意义。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出了CLIP驱动的开放词汇3D场景图生成方法。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 通过跨模态对比学习对齐3D点云与CLIP文本嵌入，实现开放词汇关系预测。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 在3DSSG等数据集上优于基线，但摘要未给出具体指标。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割问题，即如何分割任意类别的图像区域。作者提出了CAT-Seg，通过成本聚合（Cost Aggregation）方法，将CLIP的图像和文本嵌入进行细粒度对齐，实现开放词汇分割。相比已有工作，CAT-Seg在多个基准上取得了显著提升，例如在ADE20K上达到31.8 mIoU，在Pascal VOC上达到91.4 mIoU，超越了先前方法。

Compared to prior work, CAT-Seg achieves significant improvements, e.g., 31.8 mIoU on ADE20K and 91.4 mIoU on Pascal VOC, outperforming previous methods.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: CAT-Seg在开放词汇分割上取得了领先性能，对多模态和分割研究者有较高参考价值。

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where conventional detectors are limited to fixed interaction categories seen during training. The authors explore leveraging large foundation models, such as CLIP and LLMs, to build an open-vocabulary HOI detection framework via vision-language alignment and knowledge transfer. OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇动作生成问题，即传统动作生成方法只能生成训练集中见过的动作类别，无法根据开放词汇文本描述生成新动作。作者提出OMG框架，通过混合控制器（Mixture of Controllers）机制将文本描述映射到动作生成过程，实现开放词汇条件下的动作合成。相比已有封闭集动作生成方法，该方法能够根据任意文本描述生成对应动作。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但验证了混合控制器策略在开放词汇动作生成上的有效性。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary motion generation, where conventional methods can only generate motions from categories seen during training. 2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割（OVS）要求模型对任意文本概念生成分割掩码，但CLIP等视觉语言模型因全局对齐导致空间定位粗糙，而DINOv2等自监督模型虽细粒度定位强却缺乏语言理解。本文提出Talk2DINO，通过一个学习到的映射函数将CLIP的文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，训练时利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，无需微调骨干网络。该方法结合了DINOv2的空间精度与CLIP的语言理解，生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) requires segmenting images from free-form text, but CLIP-based models suffer from coarse spatial localization due to global image-text alignment, while self-supervised models like DINOv2 excel at fine-grained localization but lack language grounding. We present Talk2DINO, a hybrid approach that aligns CLIP text embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features via a learned mapping function without fine-tuning either backbone, using DINOv2 attention maps to selectively align local patches with text embeddings during training. This combines DINOv2's spatial accuracy with CLIP's language understanding, yielding more natural and less noisy segmentations and effective foreground discrimination.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 巧妙融合自监督视觉骨干与语言模型，无需微调即可实现高质量开放词汇分割，对多模态感知研究有启发。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出Talk2DINO，通过映射函数将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2 patch特征，实现无需微调的开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，桥接自监督视觉与语言模型。
2411.19331|v2.result: 生成更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 长尾开放词汇目标检测中，稀有类别因训练数据匮乏而检测性能差。本文提出SearchDet，一个无需训练的框架，通过从网络检索目标的正负样本图像，嵌入后计算输入图像加权的查询向量，用于检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，在ODinW上mAP提升超过48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对检索样本变化稳定，有望消除昂贵的数据标注和训练过程。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: Long-tail open-vocabulary object detection suffers from scarce training data for rare categories. We introduce SearchDet, a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative web images of a target concept, embeds them, and computes an input image-weighted query to detect the desired concept. It achieves over 48.7% mAP improvement on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to GroundingDINO, and is stable to exemplar variations, suggesting a path to eliminate costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 无需训练、基于网络检索样本的检测思路新颖且实用，大幅超越SOTA，对开放词汇检测有重要参考价值。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出SearchDet，一种基于网络图像检索的免训练长尾开放词汇目标检测框架。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 利用网络检索的正负样本图像嵌入计算输入加权查询，完全无需训练即可检测新概念。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升48.7%以上，LVIS上提升59.1%，且对样本变化稳定。
