2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU硬件上因堆叠自注意力/交叉注意力块而难以加速部署的问题，本文设计了一套充分利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化的压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT：先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型稀疏化（FP16），再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练将浮点稀疏模型量化为定点模型，并在剪枝与量化过程中使用混合策略知识蒸馏。该方案支持监督与无监督学习，实验显示模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍、速度提升30.3-62倍，达到SOTA压缩效果。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of accelerating vision transformers on GPU hardware. It proposes GPUSQ-ViT, a compression scheme combining GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization: dense weights are first pruned to 2:4 sparse (FP16), then quantized to fixed-point via sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout. The scheme supports supervised and unsupervised learning, achieving 6.4-12.7× model size reduction and 30.3-62× speedup, setting a state-of-the-art compression result.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际部署的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案，工程价值高，压缩与加速数据亮眼。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4结构化剪枝、稀疏蒸馏感知量化与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到一套压缩流程中。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍、速度提升30.3-62倍，达到SOTA压缩水平。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法不可解释、忽视模型内部单元与目标类别关系而导致性能次优的问题，本文提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner：设计可解释性感知掩码，端到端学习以衡量每个可剪单元对预测各目标类别的贡献；并基于掩码值自适应搜索逐层阈值以区分保留与剪除单元、学习逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer等代表性模型上的综合实验验证了方法的有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unexplainable nature of existing ViT pruning methods, which overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes, leading to suboptimal performance. It proposes X-Pruner, an explainable pruning framework that learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each target class, and adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds to determine pruning rates. Comprehensive experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer validate its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则，视角新颖，对理解ViT内部结构与剪枝的关系有启发。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出基于可解释性感知掩码的ViT剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 用端到端学习的可解释性掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层剪枝阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT与Swin Transformer等模型上验证了方法的有效性，性能优于不可解释剪枝方法。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督语义分割中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种密度引导的对比学习方法。方法通过挖掘特征空间中的密度信息来指导对比学习，增强类内紧凑性和类间可分性。相比已有半监督分割方法，该方法更好地利用了未标注数据的分布结构。在标准半监督分割基准上取得了性能提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of labeled data in semi-supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning approach. The method leverages density information in feature space to guide contrastive learning, enhancing intra-class compactness and inter-class separability. It improves over existing semi-supervised segmentation methods by better exploiting the distribution structure of unlabeled data, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 该工作将密度引导引入半监督分割的对比学习，思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验效果。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导对比学习用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用特征空间密度信息指导对比学习以增强类间区分度。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在标准半监督分割基准上取得性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本因内存预算限制只能以少样本形式保存的问题，提出通过压缩样本突破少样本限制。方法利用类激活图（CAM）生成0-1掩码对非判别性像素进行下采样，从而在固定内存中保存更多压缩样本。提出类增量掩码（CIM）模型，通过双层优化自适应地为不同类别学习最优阈值，解决了CAM阈值选择中覆盖度与样本数量的权衡问题。在多个CIL基准上进行了广泛实验，验证了方法的有效性。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the few-shot limitation of exemplar storage in class-incremental learning (CIL) by compressing exemplars through downsampling non-discriminative pixels. It generates 0-1 masks from class activation maps (CAM) without manual annotation and proposes a class-incremental masking (CIM) model to adaptively resolve the trade-off between discriminative pixel coverage and exemplar quantity via bilevel optimization. Extensive experiments on CIL benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将样本压缩与类增量学习结合，通过自适应掩码生成突破了内存预算下的少样本限制，思路新颖且实用。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于CAM的自适应样本压缩方法，在固定内存下实现多样本类增量学习。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 通过类增量掩码模型和双层优化自适应学习各类别最优压缩阈值。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上通过广泛实验验证了方法的有效性。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝中参数分组模式因架构而异、导致现有方法难以泛化到新架构的问题，提出了任意架构结构化剪枝任务。核心难点在于结构耦合——不同层需同时剪枝且被移除参数需一致地不重要。提出依赖图（DepGraph）方法，显式建模层间依赖关系并全面分组耦合参数，实现全自动的通用结构化剪枝。在ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet和Vision Transformer等多种架构和任务上进行了广泛评估，验证了方法的通用性和有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of general structural pruning for arbitrary architectures by addressing structural coupling, where different layers must be pruned simultaneously and removed parameters must be consistently unimportant. It proposes Dependency Graph (DepGraph), a fully automatic method that explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and comprehensively groups coupled parameters for pruning. Extensive evaluations on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and Vision Transformer across multiple tasks demonstrate the generality and effectiveness of the approach.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了通用结构化剪枝框架DepGraph，解决了跨架构剪枝的泛化性难题，对模型压缩领域有重要推动作用。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出依赖图方法实现任意架构的全自动结构化剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过显式建模层间依赖关系解决结构耦合问题，实现跨架构通用剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在CNN、RNN、GNN和Transformer等多种架构上验证了通用性和有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有通道剪枝方法主要面向2D CNN、难以直接应用于3D点云网络（PNN）的问题，提出了一种面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP³。方法设计了坐标增强的通道重要性度量，反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收PNN采样过程中丢弃的点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。在多种PNN架构上的实验表明，该方法在保持精度的同时有效降低了计算和内存开销。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap in channel pruning for 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs), where directly applying 2D CNN pruning methods degrades performance due to representation and architecture differences. It proposes CP³, a channel pruning plug-in that introduces a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric and recycles discarded points from the sampling process to enhance pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures demonstrate effective reduction in computation and memory while maintaining accuracy.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了3D点云网络通道剪枝的空白，针对点云特性设计的度量方法有针对性，但应用场景相对小众。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件CP³。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 设计坐标增强通道重要性度量并回收采样丢弃点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种PNN架构上有效降低计算和内存开销并保持精度。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 该论文针对对应关系剪枝（correspondence pruning）中邻域一致性利用不充分的问题，提出了渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。方法通过渐进策略逐步挖掘和利用邻域一致性信息来区分正确与错误匹配。相比已有方法，该工作更充分地利用了局部邻域结构信息。在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得了性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数据。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient exploitation of neighbor consistency in correspondence pruning by proposing a progressive neighbor consistency mining approach. The method progressively mines and leverages neighbor consistency information to distinguish correct from incorrect matches. It improves over existing methods by more fully utilizing local neighborhood structural information, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 该工作聚焦对应关系剪枝中的邻域一致性挖掘，思路合理，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度较低。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 通过渐进策略逐步挖掘邻域一致性信息以区分正确与错误匹配。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络中的偏见问题，提出通过对比权重剪枝训练去偏见子网络。方法利用对比学习指导权重剪枝过程，在压缩模型的同时减少偏见。相比已有去偏见方法，该工作将剪枝与去偏见目标结合，在模型压缩和公平性之间取得平衡。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses bias in neural networks by proposing to train debiased subnetworks through contrastive weight pruning. The method leverages contrastive learning to guide the weight pruning process, simultaneously compressing the model and reducing bias. Compared to existing debiasing methods, it combines pruning with debiasing objectives to balance model compression and fairness, though specific experimental results are not provided in the abstract.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 该工作将权重剪枝与去偏见目标结合，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联度较低。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝方法训练去偏见子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 将对比学习引入权重剪枝过程以实现去偏见与压缩的联合优化。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在模型压缩的同时减少偏见（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（out-of-distribution）数据上鲁棒性差的问题，提出了一种语义剪枝（semantic pruning）框架，通过识别并剪除对OOD样本敏感的语义通道来提升模型鲁棒性。方法在标准半监督基准上结合OOD检测机制，动态调整网络稀疏结构。相比已有半监督方法，该工作首次将剪枝与OOD鲁棒性结合，在CIFAR-10/100等基准上取得了更优的OOD泛化性能。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor robustness of semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data by proposing a semantic pruning framework that identifies and prunes OOD-sensitive semantic channels. The method dynamically adjusts network sparsity combined with OOD detection on standard semi-supervised benchmarks. Compared to existing semi-supervised methods, it is the first to integrate pruning with OOD robustness, achieving improved OOD generalization on CIFAR-10/100.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝与半监督OOD鲁棒性结合有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验规模与自动驾驶场景的迁移性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出面向OOD鲁棒性的语义剪枝半监督学习框架。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 首次将语义通道剪枝用于提升半监督学习的分布外泛化能力。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在CIFAR-10/100等基准上取得更优的OOD泛化性能。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化（bi-level optimization）的剪枝参数化方法，自动搜索最优的通道剪枝结构。方法将剪枝率作为可学习参数，通过内外层交替优化平衡精度与效率。相比手工设计或单层剪枝方法，在Cityscapes等分割基准上实现了更高的精度-效率权衡。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization method based on bi-level optimization to automatically search optimal channel pruning structures. Pruning rates are treated as learnable parameters optimized via alternating inner-outer loops. Compared to manual or single-level pruning, it achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on Cityscapes.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 双层优化用于分割剪枝思路合理，对边缘部署有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度中等。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化的剪枝参数化方法用于边缘语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 将剪枝率作为可学习参数并通过双层优化自动搜索。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在Cityscapes等基准上实现更优的精度-效率权衡。

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图（matting）中计算量随分辨率急剧增长的问题，提出了时空稀疏性（spatio-temporal sparsity）方法，仅在关键区域和关键帧上进行高分辨率计算。方法通过稀疏采样与传播机制降低冗余计算。相比已有高分辨率抠图方法，在4K/8K视频上显著降低计算量同时保持抠图质量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the explosive computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by proposing a spatio-temporal sparsity approach that performs high-resolution computation only on key regions and frames. A sparse sampling and propagation mechanism reduces redundant computation. Compared to existing high-resolution matting methods, it significantly reduces computation on 4K/8K videos while maintaining matting quality.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 时空稀疏性思路对高分辨率视频处理有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务相关度较低。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏性方法用于超高分辨率图像/视频抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 仅在关键区域和关键帧进行高分辨率计算以降低冗余。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在4K/8K视频上显著降低计算量并保持抠图质量。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构（system heterogeneity）下客户端计算能力差异大的问题，提出了自适应通道稀疏（adaptive channel sparsity）方法，为不同能力的客户端分配不同的通道稀疏结构。方法通过自适应稀疏度控制平衡各客户端的计算负载与模型精度。相比固定稀疏或统一模型方法，在异构联邦学习基准上提升了收敛速度与最终精度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses system heterogeneity in federated learning where clients have diverse computational capabilities, proposing an adaptive channel sparsity method that assigns different channel sparsity structures to clients. Adaptive sparsity control balances computational load and model accuracy. Compared to fixed-sparsity or uniform-model methods, it improves convergence speed and final accuracy on heterogeneous federated benchmarks.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 面向联邦学习系统异构的通道稀疏方法，与自动驾驶感知领域相关度低，但稀疏化思想可借鉴。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏方法解决联邦学习系统异构问题。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 为不同能力客户端分配差异化通道稀疏结构。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在异构联邦学习基准上提升收敛速度与最终精度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率（VSR）模型计算量大的问题，提出了结构化稀疏学习（structured sparsity learning）方法，通过剪枝冗余的时空特征通道来加速VSR推理。方法在训练中引入结构化稀疏约束，自动识别并移除冗余通道。相比已有VSR加速方法，在多个VSR基准上实现了更高的加速比与相当的恢复质量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution (VSR) models by proposing structured sparsity learning that prunes redundant spatio-temporal feature channels to accelerate VSR inference. Structured sparsity constraints are introduced during training to automatically identify and remove redundant channels. Compared to existing VSR acceleration methods, it achieves higher speedup with comparable restoration quality on multiple VSR benchmarks.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏用于视频超分加速思路清晰，对视频感知任务的模型压缩有参考价值，但非自动驾驶核心方向。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习方法加速视频超分辨率模型。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过结构化稀疏约束自动剪枝冗余时空特征通道。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在多个VSR基准上实现更高加速比与相当恢复质量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏（feature map distillation）效果受限的问题，提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏（Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation）方法，利用判别器提供的对抗信号增强教师-学生特征对齐。方法将判别器作为辅助监督，引导学生生成更逼真的特征分布。相比已有GAN压缩蒸馏方法，在多个数据集上实现了更优的压缩比与生成质量。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited effectiveness of feature map distillation in GAN compression by proposing a Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation method that leverages adversarial signals from the discriminator to enhance teacher-student feature alignment. The discriminator serves as auxiliary supervision to guide more realistic feature distributions. Compared to existing GAN compression distillation methods, it achieves better compression ratios and generation quality on multiple datasets.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 判别器协同蒸馏为GAN压缩提供了新视角，蒸馏思想对感知模型压缩有借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶核心任务相关度中等。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器对抗信号增强教师-学生特征对齐。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在多个数据集上实现更优压缩比与生成质量。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏中教师与学生模型因3D点云稀疏性和不规则性导致的中间特征表示差异问题，指出现有KD方法仅在师生特征表示相似时有效。作者提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），从信息瓶颈（IB）视角出发，最小化师生在提议区域对上的特征与logits差异。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超越教师模型且仅需42% FLOPs，显著优于现有KD方法。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, where existing KD methods are effective only when teacher and student share similar intermediate features. It proposes a novel Representation Disparity-aware Distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective, minimizing the disparity of proposal region pairs in both features and logits. On nuScenes, RDD boosts CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% mAP, surpassing the teacher while using only 42% FLOPs, outperforming existing KD methods.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地指出并解决3D检测蒸馏中的表示差异问题，方法新颖且实验充分，对紧凑型3D检测器部署有重要价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏（RDD），从信息瓶颈角度缩小师生在提议区域对上的特征与logits差异。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次将信息瓶颈理论引入3D检测蒸馏，针对点云稀疏性导致的表示差异进行显式建模与最小化。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上使CP-Voxel-S达到57.1% mAP，超越教师模型且仅需42% FLOPs。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大、现有token剪枝方法忽略多模态交互的问题，提出MADTP，通过多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架，在剪枝过程中保持跨模态对齐。方法包括轻量级多模态对齐模块和动态剪枝策略，根据输入自适应决定剪枝比例。相比固定剪枝率方法，在多个VLT模型和任务上实现更优的精度-效率权衡，例如在BLIP上减少约40% FLOPs而精度损失小于1%。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: To address the high inference cost of vision-language Transformers (VLTs) and the neglect of multimodal interaction in existing token pruning methods, this paper proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that preserves cross-modal alignment during pruning. It introduces a lightweight multimodal alignment module and a dynamic pruning strategy that adaptively determines pruning ratios per input. Compared to fixed-ratio pruning, it achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on multiple VLT models and tasks, e.g., reducing ~40% FLOPs on BLIP with less than 1% accuracy drop.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 该工作将动态token剪枝扩展到多模态场景，对齐引导的思路对VLM加速有参考价值，实验较充分。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，用于加速视觉-语言Transformer。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 利用跨模态对齐信号动态决定token剪枝比例，而非固定剪枝率。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT模型上实现约40% FLOPs减少，精度损失小于1%。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型剪枝方法依赖任务特定微调、难以泛化的问题，提出MULTIFLOW，一种任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝框架。通过将剪枝建模为从预训练模型到剪枝模型的最优传输问题，并利用多模态流匹配来保持跨模态结构。在多个下游任务上无需任务特定微调即可达到与任务特定剪枝相当的性能，例如在Flickr30K检索任务上保持约95%的原始性能。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: To address the task-specific fine-tuning dependency and poor generalization of existing vision-language pruning methods, this paper proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic vision-language pruning framework. It formulates pruning as an optimal transport problem from the pre-trained model to the pruned model and leverages multimodal flow matching to preserve cross-modal structure. Without task-specific fine-tuning, it achieves performance comparable to task-specific pruning on multiple downstream tasks, e.g., retaining ~95% of original performance on Flickr30K retrieval.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝的思路新颖，但实验规模有限，对自动驾驶感知的直接相关性一般。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的视觉-语言剪枝框架MULTIFLOW，基于最优传输和多模态流匹配。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 将剪枝建模为最优传输问题并引入多模态流匹配保持跨模态结构。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 无需任务特定微调即可在多个下游任务上保持约95%的原始性能。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）结构化剪枝中缺乏有效误差度量的问题，提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差（Module-wise Pruning Error）度量来指导CLIP模型的结构化剪枝。通过分析不同模块对剪枝的敏感度，设计模块级剪枝策略，在保持跨模态对齐的同时压缩模型。在多个零样本和检索任务上，相比均匀剪枝方法，在相同压缩率下精度提升约2-3%。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: To address the lack of effective error metrics in structured pruning of vision-language models (VLMs), this paper proposes MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a Module-wise Pruning Error metric to guide structured pruning of CLIP. By analyzing module sensitivity to pruning, it designs a module-wise pruning strategy that preserves cross-modal alignment while compressing the model. On multiple zero-shot and retrieval tasks, it improves accuracy by ~2-3% over uniform pruning at the same compression rate.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量对VLM剪枝有实际指导意义，但创新性相对有限，实验覆盖较常规。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE，用于指导CLIP的结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 从模块敏感度角度设计剪枝误差度量，而非全局统一度量。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在相同压缩率下，零样本和检索任务精度比均匀剪枝提升约2-3%。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态数据集规模庞大、冗余严重的问题，提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型（image captioning models）对多模态数据集进行剪枝。通过评估图文对的信息量和多样性，筛选出高质量子集用于训练。相比随机采样和基于CLIP分数的剪枝方法，在相同数据量下训练出的模型在下游任务上性能更优，例如在COCO检索任务上提升约2-4%。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: To address the massive scale and redundancy of multimodal datasets, this paper proposes Sieve, which leverages image captioning models to prune multimodal datasets. It evaluates the informativeness and diversity of image-text pairs to select a high-quality subset for training. Compared to random sampling and CLIP-score-based pruning, models trained on the selected subset achieve better downstream performance at the same data budget, e.g., improving ~2-4% on COCO retrieval.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 数据剪枝是多模态学习的重要方向，Sieve利用caption模型评估样本价值，思路实用且实验较充分。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用caption模型评估图文对的信息量和多样性进行数据筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在相同数据量下，下游任务性能比随机采样和CLIP分数剪枝提升约2-4%。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性搜索和稀疏度搜索分离导致次优的问题，提出Once-for-Both（OFB），在单阶段中同时进行重要性和稀疏度搜索。通过可微分搜索框架联合优化通道重要性和剪枝率，实现端到端的ViT压缩。在ImageNet上，相比两阶段方法，在相同FLOPs下Top-1精度提升约0.5-1%，且搜索成本更低。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: To address the suboptimality of separate importance and sparsity searches in Vision Transformer compression, this paper proposes Once-for-Both (OFB), which performs importance and sparsity search in a single stage. It jointly optimizes channel importance and pruning ratios via a differentiable search framework for end-to-end ViT compression. On ImageNet, it improves Top-1 accuracy by ~0.5-1% over two-stage methods at the same FLOPs, with lower search cost.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合搜索简化了ViT压缩流程，实验表明其有效性，对模型加速有参考价值。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性和稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩框架OFB。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将重要性和稀疏度搜索统一到可微分单阶段框架中联合优化。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在ImageNet上相同FLOPs下Top-1精度比两阶段方法提升约0.5-1%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对少样本场景下视觉Transformer压缩困难的问题，提出一种密集ViT压缩方法，通过利用预训练模型的结构先验和少量样本进行高效压缩。方法结合了结构化剪枝和知识蒸馏，在仅有少量训练样本时仍能保持较高精度。在少样本设置下，相比直接微调剪枝模型，精度提升约3-5%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: To address the difficulty of compressing Vision Transformers with few samples, this paper proposes a dense ViT compression method that leverages structural priors of pre-trained models and a small number of samples for efficient compression. It combines structured pruning and knowledge distillation to maintain high accuracy with limited training data. Under few-shot settings, it improves accuracy by ~3-5% over directly fine-tuning pruned models.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本ViT压缩是一个实用但相对小众的方向，方法有效但实验规模有限。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本场景下的密集视觉Transformer压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合结构先验与知识蒸馏，在极少样本下实现ViT压缩。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 少样本设置下精度比直接微调剪枝模型提升约3-5%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧知识、且难以保持与已有压缩比特流向后兼容的问题，提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习框架。方法通过约束新旧模型在已编码比特流上的解码一致性，并结合参数正则或重放策略，使模型在增量更新时仍能正确解码旧比特流。相比直接微调或从头训练，该方法在保持压缩率的同时显著降低了旧域性能退化。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个增量阶段实现了兼容性与压缩效率的平衡。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting and backward compatibility in continual learning of image compression models. It proposes a framework that enforces decoding consistency on previously encoded bitstreams while incrementally adapting to new data or rates. Compared with naive fine-tuning, it preserves old-domain performance and bitstream compatibility without sacrificing compression efficiency.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 将持续学习引入图像压缩并强调比特流向后兼容，问题定义新颖，对实际部署有参考价值。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出向后兼容的图像压缩持续学习框架，保证增量更新后旧比特流仍可解码。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 把比特流兼容性约束显式建模进持续学习目标，缓解灾难性遗忘。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 在多个增量阶段保持压缩效率与旧域解码一致性，优于直接微调。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝容易导致生成多样性下降的问题，提出了一种多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法在剪枝过程中引入对生成样本多样性的度量与约束，联合优化剪枝掩码与生成器参数，避免仅保留少数主导模式。相比传统基于重构误差或FID的剪枝，该方法在压缩后更好地维持了潜在空间到图像分布的覆盖。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在显著压缩率下保持了生成质量与多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the diversity degradation caused by channel pruning in StyleGAN compression. It proposes a diversity-aware pruning method that jointly optimizes pruning masks and generator parameters under an explicit diversity constraint. Compared with reconstruction- or FID-only pruning, it better preserves the coverage of the latent-to-image mapping at high compression ratios.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 关注生成模型压缩中的多样性保持，角度实用，对GAN部署与轻量化有参考意义。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的StyleGAN通道剪枝方法，在压缩同时保持生成多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 将生成多样性度量显式引入剪枝目标，联合优化掩码与生成器。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 在显著压缩率下维持生成质量与多样性，优于仅优化重构/FID的剪枝。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离、剪枝策略难以自适应的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝CNN。方法让智能体在训练过程中生成剪枝决策，并通过对齐机制使剪枝后的子网络与完整网络表示保持一致，从而在训练早期就考虑剪枝影响。相比先训练后剪枝的两阶段流程，该方法减少了微调开销并提升了剪枝后精度。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个骨干网络上取得更优的精度-压缩权衡。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between training and pruning in CNN compression by jointly learning both via a learnable agent. The agent produces pruning decisions during training, and an alignment mechanism keeps the pruned subnet consistent with the full network. Compared with two-stage train-then-prune pipelines, it reduces fine-tuning cost and improves the accuracy-compression trade-off across backbones.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 用可学习智能体统一训练与剪枝，思路清晰，对自动化压缩有参考价值。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 在训练过程中由智能体生成剪枝决策，并用表示对齐约束子网络。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 在多个骨干网络上取得更优的精度-压缩权衡，减少微调开销。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中不同设备算力异构、难以用统一剪枝模型适配的问题，提出设备感知的联邦网络剪枝方法。方法在联邦聚合过程中为不同设备生成或选择不同的子网络结构，使各设备在自身资源约束下训练与推理，同时通过共享参数或掩码对齐保持全局知识。相比对所有设备使用同一剪枝率，该方法更好兼顾了异构设备的精度与效率。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多种设备配置下提升了整体性能。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device capabilities in federated learning, where a single pruned model cannot fit all clients. It proposes device-wise federated network pruning that assigns or learns per-device subnetworks while aligning shared parameters or masks during aggregation. Compared with uniform pruning, it better balances accuracy and efficiency across heterogeneous clients.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 把剪枝与联邦学习中的设备异构性结合，问题设定贴近实际部署。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出设备感知的联邦网络剪枝框架，为异构客户端分配不同子网络。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦聚合中联合优化各设备子网络结构与共享知识对齐。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 在多种设备配置下提升整体精度与效率，优于统一剪枝率方案。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有通道剪枝方法在动态剪枝与静态剪枝之间割裂、难以统一优化的问题，提出BilevelPruning统一动态与静态通道剪枝。方法将剪枝建模为双层优化：上层学习通道重要性/结构，下层在给定结构下优化权重，从而同时获得推理时的静态结构与训练时的动态选择能力。相比单一动态或静态方法，该框架在多个网络上取得更优的精度-FLOPs权衡。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调统一框架的通用性。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap between dynamic and static channel pruning by proposing BilevelPruning, a unified framework. It formulates pruning as bilevel optimization, where the upper level learns channel importance/structure and the lower level optimizes weights under that structure. Compared with purely dynamic or static methods, it achieves a better accuracy-FLOPs trade-off across networks.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 用双层优化统一动态与静态剪枝，形式化较完整，对剪枝理论有参考价值。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 将通道结构学习与权重优化建模为双层优化问题。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 在多个网络上取得更优的精度-FLOPs权衡，优于单一动态或静态剪枝。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对CapsNet中胶囊间冗余、路由计算量大且特征表示不够正交的问题，提出OrthCaps：一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交CapsNet。方法通过正交约束增强胶囊表示的独立性，用稀疏注意力路由降低计算量，并对冗余胶囊进行剪枝。相比原始动态路由CapsNet，该方法在保持或提升分类精度的同时显著减少参数量与计算。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在多个图像分类基准上取得更优效率-精度平衡。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper tackles redundancy and costly routing in CapsNets by proposing OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It enforces orthogonality among capsules, replaces dense routing with sparse attention, and prunes redundant capsules. Compared with standard dynamic routing, it reduces parameters and computation while maintaining or improving classification accuracy.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 把正交约束、稀疏路由与剪枝结合到CapsNet，对胶囊网络轻量化有参考价值。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出正交CapsNet OrthCaps，结合稀疏注意力路由与胶囊剪枝。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 用正交约束提升胶囊表示独立性，并以稀疏注意力替代密集路由。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 在多个分类基准上减少参数量与计算量，同时保持或提升精度。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下动态剪枝面临客户端内存开销大和通信成本高的问题。FedMef 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架，通过只维护子网络的梯度与动量、并设计稀疏度感知的聚合策略来降低客户端峰值内存。相比 FedTiny、FedDIP 等联邦剪枝方法，它在保持精度的同时显著减少内存占用。在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 上，FedMef 相比 FedDIP 降低约 1.9-3.5 倍客户端内存，并减少通信量，精度损失小于 1%。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: FedMef targets memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning, where clients suffer from high peak memory and communication costs. It maintains gradients and momentum only for the sub-network and adopts a sparsity-aware aggregation scheme to cut client-side memory. Compared with prior federated pruning methods such as FedDIP, it reduces client memory by roughly 1.9-3.5x with less than 1% accuracy drop on CIFAR and ImageNet benchmarks.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 把动态剪枝与联邦学习的资源约束结合得较自然，对边缘端协同训练有参考价值，但与视觉感知主线关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架 FedMef，降低客户端峰值内存与通信开销。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 仅对子网络维护梯度/动量并设计稀疏度感知聚合，避免全模型状态驻留。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上相比 FedDIP 降低约 1.9-3.5 倍客户端内存，精度损失小于 1%。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段的计算与显存开销限制了在下游任务上的部署。该文提出面向微调的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，在微调过程中联合优化剪枝掩码与权重，并引入资源感知的正则项以适配给定算力预算。相比只在预训练后一次性剪枝的方案，它能在微调中动态调整结构，获得更优的精度-效率折中。在 GLUE 与若干视觉 Transformer 基准上，方法在同等 FLOPs 下取得更高精度，或在同等精度下减少约 30-50% 计算量。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper addresses the compute and memory burden of finetuning large Transformer models. It proposes a resource-efficient pruning scheme that jointly optimizes pruning masks and weights during finetuning with resource-aware regularization. Compared with post-hoc one-shot pruning, it yields a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off, achieving higher accuracy at equal FLOPs or reducing computation by roughly 30-50% at comparable accuracy on GLUE and vision Transformer benchmarks.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 微调期剪枝的思路对部署大模型有实用价值，但方法层面的新颖性中等，实验规模有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向微调阶段的资源高效 Transformer 剪枝方法，联合优化掩码与权重。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 在微调过程中引入资源感知正则，实现结构随预算动态调整。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 同等 FLOPs 下精度更高，或在同等精度下减少约 30-50% 计算量。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）中寻找可训练稀疏子网络通常依赖昂贵的迭代幅值剪枝。该文提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝（spectral foresight pruning），利用激活的谱信息在训练前预测重要连接，从而一次性找到高质量彩票。相比 SNIP、GraSP 等前瞻剪枝方法，它更好地刻画了训练动态对连接重要性的影响。在 ResNet/ViT 上于 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 达到更高稀疏度下的精度，例如在 90%+ 稀疏度下优于 SNIP 数个点。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Finding lottery tickets typically requires expensive iterative magnitude pruning. This work proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning criterion that predicts important connections before training using spectral information of activations. It outperforms foresight baselines such as SNIP and GraSP, achieving higher accuracy at high sparsity (e.g., several points above SNIP at 90%+ sparsity) on ResNet and ViT across CIFAR and ImageNet.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 从谱角度重新审视前瞻剪枝，理论动机较清晰，但属于剪枝领域的增量改进。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝准则，在训练前一次性定位高质量彩票子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用激活谱信息刻画连接重要性，替代昂贵的迭代幅值剪枝。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 在 90%+ 稀疏度下精度优于 SNIP 等前瞻剪枝方法数个点。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF 物体位姿估计中，基于对应关系的方法受限于表面点云稀疏与错误匹配。HiPose 提出分层二值表面编码与对应关系剪枝，将物体表面编码为分层二值特征以实现粗到细的对应搜索，并设计剪枝策略剔除离群匹配。相比基于稠密对应或投票的方法，它在无纹理与遮挡场景下更鲁棒。在 LineMOD、Occlusion LineMOD 与 YCB-Video 上取得 SOTA 或接近 SOTA 的 ADD(-S) 精度，Occlusion LineMOD 上提升明显。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: HiPose tackles RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation, where correspondence-based methods suffer from sparse surfaces and outlier matches. It introduces hierarchical binary surface encoding for coarse-to-fine correspondence search and a correspondence pruning strategy to remove outliers. It achieves state-of-the-art or comparable ADD(-S) accuracy on LineMOD, Occlusion LineMOD, and YCB-Video, with notable gains under occlusion.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 分层二值编码与剪枝的组合在遮挡场景下有效，对机器人抓取与 AR 有实用价值，但与自动驾驶 BEV/占用感知主线关联有限。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出分层二值表面编码与对应关系剪枝的 RGB-D 6DoF 位姿估计框架 HiPose。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 用分层二值表面编码实现粗到细对应搜索，并显式剪枝离群匹配。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在 LineMOD、Occlusion LineMOD、YCB-Video 上达到 SOTA 或接近 SOTA 的 ADD(-S) 精度。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源自由（source-free）场景下模型知识产权保护缺乏有效手段，现有水印方法依赖源数据或易被微调破坏。该文提出 MAsk-Pruning（MAP），通过在模型中植入结构化掩码作为指纹，并利用掩码剪枝使指纹在微调后仍可验证。相比权重水印方法，它对微调与剪枝攻击更鲁棒。在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 上，MAP 在多种微调设置下保持高验证成功率，同时对模型精度影响小于 1%。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Source-free model intellectual property protection lacks robust watermarking. This paper proposes MAsk-Pruning (MAP), which embeds a structured mask fingerprint and leverages mask pruning so the fingerprint survives finetuning. It is more robust than weight-watermarking baselines against finetuning and pruning attacks, maintaining high verification success with less than 1% accuracy drop on CIFAR and ImageNet.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 把剪枝用作知识产权指纹的思路较新颖，但属于模型安全方向，与视觉感知研究相关性低。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出基于掩码剪枝的源自由模型知识产权保护方法 MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 以结构化掩码作为指纹并借剪枝增强其对微调的鲁棒性。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 多种微调设置下保持高验证成功率，精度损失小于 1%。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: ViT 推理中大量冗余 token 带来计算浪费，现有 token 剪枝多需微调或额外训练。Zero-TPrune 提出零样本 token 剪枝，利用预训练 Transformer 的注意力图构建 token 相似度图并进行谱聚类，从而在无需训练的情况下识别冗余 token。相比需重训练的 EViT、ToMe 等方法，它免去微调且保持精度。在 ImageNet 上对 DeiT/ViT 剪除 30-40% token 时精度损失小于 1%，并带来约 1.3-1.5 倍推理加速。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Zero-TPrune addresses redundant tokens in ViT inference without requiring finetuning. It builds a token similarity graph from the attention maps of pretrained Transformers and applies spectral clustering to identify redundant tokens in a zero-shot manner. Unlike training-based methods such as EViT and ToMe, it preserves accuracy without finetuning, losing less than 1% top-1 on ImageNet while pruning 30-40% of tokens and achieving roughly 1.3-1.5x speedup.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本、免微调的 token 剪枝对 ViT 部署很实用，注意力图建模思路清晰，与视觉主干网络优化相关度较高。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出基于注意力图的零样本 token 剪枝方法 Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 利用预训练注意力图构建相似度图并谱聚类，无需训练即可剪枝。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: ImageNet 上剪除 30-40% token 精度损失小于 1%，推理加速约 1.3-1.5 倍。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对从零训练（training-from-scratch）场景下网络剪枝难以确定各层稀疏度的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），用控制器网络引导自动剪枝。方法在训练过程中由控制器预测各层剪枝比例，并联合优化权重与控制器，实现端到端的自动稀疏结构搜索。相比依赖预训练权重或人工设定稀疏度的传统剪枝，ATO 免去了预训练与手工调参。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数据。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses automatic network pruning in the training-from-scratch setting, where per-layer sparsity is hard to determine. It proposes Auto-Train-Once (ATO), a controller-network-guided scheme that jointly learns the pruning ratios and the network weights in an end-to-end manner. Unlike prior pruning methods that rely on pre-trained weights or manually specified sparsity, ATO removes the need for pre-training and hand-tuning. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 把自动剪枝与从零训练结合是有价值的方向，但摘要信息有限，需看实验是否在主流基准上验证。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零训练自动剪枝框架 ATO。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 将稀疏度分配交由可学习控制器在训练中动态决定，摆脱预训练依赖。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 摘要未报告具体精度或压缩率数据。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝（dataset pruning）中样本重要性评估不充分的问题，本文提出时序双深度评分（TDDS），从训练进程的时间维度对样本打分。方法同时考虑样本在不同训练阶段的深度信息，跨训练进度聚合评分以筛选核心子集。相比仅用单一时点或单一深度指标的已有方法，TDDS 更全面地刻画样本价值。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度数据。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper targets dataset pruning, where existing sample-importance criteria are insufficient. It proposes Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which scores samples along the temporal dimension of training progress using dual-depth information. Compared with methods relying on a single checkpoint or a single depth metric, TDDS captures sample value more comprehensively. The abstract reports no specific accuracy or speedup numbers.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 数据集剪枝对训练效率有实际意义，时序视角有新意，但需实验验证其通用性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨训练进度的时序双深度样本评分准则用于数据集剪枝。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 从训练时间维度而非单一时点评估样本重要性。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 摘要未提供具体精度或加速数据。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全中稀疏深度图密度变化导致精度不稳定的问题，本文提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network），实现稀疏度自适应的深度细化。方法通过掩码机制控制空间传播过程，使网络能适应不同稀疏程度的输入深度。相比固定传播策略的已有方法，该设计对稀疏度变化更鲁棒。摘要未给出具体 RMSE 等指标数据。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses depth refinement under varying sparsity levels of depth maps. It proposes a Masked Spatial Propagation Network that performs sparsity-adaptive depth refinement by masking the spatial propagation process. Compared with fixed propagation schemes, the method is more robust to varying input sparsity. No quantitative metrics are reported in the abstract.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 深度补全对 3D 感知有支撑作用，稀疏度自适应思路合理，但需看是否在 KITTI 等基准上验证。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出掩码空间传播网络用于稀疏度自适应深度细化。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用掩码机制使空间传播过程随输入稀疏度自适应调整。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 摘要未报告具体精度指标。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对结构稀疏对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，本文提出通过精确组稀疏训练获得可迁移的结构稀疏对抗扰动。方法在训练中施加精确组稀疏约束，使生成的稀疏扰动在结构上更具语义性，从而提升跨模型迁移能力。相比逐像素稀疏攻击，组稀疏约束更符合真实场景并提高攻击成功率。摘要未给出具体迁移攻击成功率数据。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited transferability of structural sparse adversarial attacks. It proposes an exact group sparsity training scheme to generate transferable structural sparse perturbations. Compared with pixel-wise sparse attacks, the group-sparsity constraint yields more semantically structured perturbations and improves cross-model transferability. No specific attack success rates are given in the abstract.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 对抗攻击与感知鲁棒性相关，但与本领域主流检测/感知任务关联偏弱。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构稀疏对抗攻击方法。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 用精确组稀疏约束生成结构化稀疏扰动以提升迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 摘要未提供具体攻击成功率数据。

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 结构化稀疏中固定稀疏模式限制性能的问题，本文提出 MaxQ 多轴查询机制用于 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过多轴查询在权重张量的不同维度上搜索更优的稀疏掩码分配，突破单一维度剪枝的局限。相比标准 N:M 稀疏，MaxQ 在同等稀疏度下保留更多重要权重。摘要未给出具体精度数据。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of fixed sparsity patterns in N:M structured sparsity. It proposes MaxQ, a multi-axis query mechanism that searches for better sparse mask assignments across multiple tensor dimensions. Compared with standard N:M sparsity, MaxQ preserves more important weights at the same sparsity level. No quantitative accuracy results are reported in the abstract.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏与硬件加速紧密相关，多轴查询思路有工程价值，但需实验支撑。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询的 N:M 稀疏网络 MaxQ。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 在多个张量维度上联合搜索稀疏掩码分配。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 摘要未报告具体精度数据。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对训练后稀疏化（post-training sparsity）方法各自为政、缺乏统一框架的问题，本文提出 UniPTS 统一框架。方法将多种训练后稀疏化技术纳入统一视角，并在此基础上设计更高效的稀疏化流程。相比分散的已有方法，UniPTS 提供统一理解并提升稀疏化效果。摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数据。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of post-training sparsity methods by proposing UniPTS, a unified framework. It formulates various post-training sparsification techniques under a common view and designs a more effective sparsification pipeline. Compared with disparate existing methods, UniPTS offers unified understanding and improved sparsity performance. No specific compression or accuracy numbers are given in the abstract.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一视角对训练后稀疏化领域有整理价值，但需看实验是否覆盖主流 LLM/视觉模型。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出训练后稀疏化的统一框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种训练后稀疏化方法纳入统一形式化视角。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 摘要未提供具体压缩率或精度数据。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算与存储开销大的问题，论文提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法上结合了结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，在保持注意力结构的前提下压缩模型规模。相比已有ViT压缩工作，其改进在于联合考虑精度与边缘推理效率。摘要未给出具体数据集与加速比数据，效果需进一步验证。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework that combines structured pruning with knowledge distillation. Compared with prior ViT compression methods, it jointly optimizes accuracy and edge inference efficiency. The abstract lacks concrete benchmark numbers, so the reported gains remain to be verified.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: ViT边缘部署是实用方向，但摘要信息有限，需看实验细节判断其真实价值。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘部署的ViT结构化剪枝与蒸馏联合压缩框架。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 在保持注意力结构前提下联合优化精度与边缘推理效率。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与加速数据，效果待验证。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有检测方法多使用ISP压缩后的sRGB输入、在复杂光照与天气下丢失关键信息的问题，论文构建了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照与天气条件。基于该数据集建立RAW与sRGB检测基准，发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，进而提出直接在RAW域预训练并蒸馏sRGB预训练模型知识。方法在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，且无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces AODRaw, a dataset of 7,785 high-resolution real RAW images with 135,601 annotated instances across 62 categories and 9 lighting/weather conditions, to address information loss in sRGB-based detection under complex conditions. It shows that sRGB pre-training constrains RAW detection due to the domain gap, and proposes direct RAW-domain pre-training with knowledge distillation from an sRGB-pretrained model. The method achieves substantial improvements under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: RAW域检测数据集与基准填补了空白，对自动驾驶恶劣环境感知有直接价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模RAW域检测数据集AODRaw并建立RAW/sRGB检测基准。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 提出RAW域直接预训练并蒸馏sRGB模型知识以缓解域差距。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，无需额外预处理模块。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）在连续域偏移下计算效率被忽视的问题，论文提出基于剪枝的高效CTTA-OD方法。观察到并非所有源域特征都有益，部分域敏感通道会损害目标域性能，因此提出敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像与实例级别量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并通过加权稀疏正则抑制和剪除敏感通道，同时引入随机通道重激活机制恢复可能有用特征。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: This paper targets efficient continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) under continuous domain shifts, where prior methods overlook computational efficiency. It proposes a sensitivity-guided channel pruning strategy that quantifies channel sensitivity to domain discrepancies at image and instance levels, suppresses sensitive channels via weighted sparsity regularization, and adds stochastic channel reactivation to recover useful features. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance over existing methods.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入CTTA-OD以提升效率，思路新颖，对资源受限的在线自适应检测有参考价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导剪枝与通道重激活的高效CTTA-OD方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 从域敏感通道角度进行剪枝并引入随机重激活缓解早剪风险。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云属性压缩中高斯/拉普拉斯熵模型未充分利用熵参数信息的问题，论文提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计隐变量概率。同时指出现有方法在算术编码中使用固定似然区间限制性能，提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整似然区间。在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广至图像与视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses underutilized information in entropy parameters of Gaussian/Laplacian models for learned point cloud attribute compression by introducing a generalized Gaussian entropy model with a shape parameter to better estimate latent probabilities. It also proposes a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) to dynamically adjust likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding. Experiments show significant rate-distortion improvements on three VAE-based models, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩而非感知检测，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域相关度低。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与动态似然区间调整的点云属性压缩方法。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 用形状参数控制尾部并引入MED动态调整似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 论文提出TopNet，一个面向八叉树结构点云几何压缩的Transformer高效占用预测网络。方法利用Transformer对八叉树节点进行占用预测以提升压缩效率。摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。整体属于点云几何压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知检测相关度有限。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It leverages Transformers to predict occupancy of octree nodes for improved compression efficiency. The abstract is missing, so methodological details and experimental results cannot be verified; the topic is point cloud geometry compression, only loosely related to autonomous driving perception.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 点云几何压缩方向，与感知检测相关度低，且摘要缺失难以评估。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出面向八叉树点云几何压缩的Transformer占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer用于八叉树节点占用预测以提升压缩效率。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本驱动3D编辑中2D扩散模型缺乏多视图信息导致多视图不一致、以及3DGS编辑优化效率低的问题，论文提出EditSplat框架，集成多视图融合引导（MFG）与注意力引导修剪（AGT）。MFG将多视图信息融入扩散过程，结合无分类器引导与3DGS几何结构保证一致性；AGT利用3DGS显式表示选择性修剪和优化高斯，提升优化效率并支持精确局部编辑。定性与定量实验验证了其效果。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency and inefficient optimization in text-driven 3D scene editing with 3D Gaussian Splatting by proposing EditSplat, which integrates Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT). MFG injects multi-view information into the diffusion process with classifier-free guidance and 3DGS geometry, while AGT selectively prunes and optimizes Gaussians for efficient, semantically rich local editing. Qualitative and quantitative experiments validate the approach.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 3D场景编辑方向，与自动驾驶感知检测相关度一般，但多视图一致性思路有一定借鉴意义。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出结合多视图融合引导与注意力引导修剪的文本驱动3DGS编辑框架EditSplat。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 利用3DGS显式表示进行注意力引导修剪以提升编辑效率与一致性。
2412.11520|v2.result: 定性与定量实验验证了多视图一致性与编辑效率的提升。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器延迟高、token数多的问题，论文提出FastVLM，通过系统分析分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模之间的权衡，设计了混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，仅靠缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外的token剪枝。相比已有方法，FastVLM简化了模型设计并显著降低高分辨率编码时间，在延迟、模型大小与精度之间实现了更优的折中。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: FastVLM addresses the inefficiency of ViT-based visual encoders at high resolutions by introducing FastViTHD, a hybrid encoder that outputs fewer tokens and reduces encoding latency. Through a comprehensive efficiency analysis of resolution, latency, token count, and LLM size, it achieves an optimal trade-off without extra token pruning. The design simplifies the pipeline while scaling input images alone to balance visual tokens and resolution.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 对VLM高效视觉编码的系统性分析与混合编码器设计具有实用价值，尤其适合关注高分辨率多模态感知的研究者。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastViTHD混合视觉编码器与FastVLM模型，实现高分辨率下低延迟、少token的高效VLM。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 仅通过缩放输入图像即可平衡视觉token数与分辨率，无需额外token剪枝。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在延迟、模型大小与精度之间取得优化折中，显著降低高分辨率编码时间。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM视觉嵌入空间是否也像文本空间一样具有组合性结构，针对视觉数据噪声大、稀疏导致组合性分析困难的问题，提出Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE)框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入确实呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对比方法，并在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates whether visual embeddings of pre-trained VLMs exhibit compositional structure, proposing the Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) framework to approximate image representations with geometry-aware compositional structures. GDE outperforms linear-geometry counterparts in compositional classification and achieves higher results in group robustness, demonstrating compositional arrangement in visual embedding space.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 为理解VLM视觉表征的几何结构提供了新视角，对多模态表征学习与鲁棒性研究有参考意义。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，证明并利用VLM视觉嵌入的组合性几何结构。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的可分解嵌入替代线性假设来建模视觉组合性。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类上优于线性方法，组鲁棒性任务取得更高结果。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基准缺乏对VLM细粒度运动理解评估的问题，论文提出MotionBench，涵盖六类运动导向问题类型并采集多源真实视频数据。实验显示现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现很差，为此作者系统研究了面向视频特征压缩的VLM架构，提出高效的Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion方法。结果表明更高帧率输入与TE Fusion能提升运动理解，但仍存在较大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: MotionBench is proposed as a comprehensive benchmark for fine-grained motion comprehension in video VLMs, covering six motion-oriented question types from diverse real-world sources. Experiments reveal poor performance of existing VLMs, motivating the Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion method for efficient video feature compression. Higher frame rates and TE Fusion improve motion understanding, though substantial room remains.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 填补了视频VLM细粒度运动理解评测的空白，基准与TE Fusion方法对视频理解研究者有直接价值。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 提出MotionBench基准与TE Fusion方法，系统评估并改进VLM细粒度运动理解。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 面向运动理解的六类问题基准与Through-Encoder特征融合压缩策略。
2501.02955|v2.result: 现有VLM运动理解表现差，高帧率与TE Fusion带来提升但仍需改进。

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM处理小时级长视频时上下文长度受限与计算成本高的问题，论文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入。具体引入Visual Summarization Token (VST)，为每段视频区间总结视觉信息作为其关联KV，并通过指令微调训练，采用课程学习与复合数据策展两种优化策略，结合动态压缩进一步提升压缩质量。该方法在长视频理解上取得良好效果。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: Video-XL tackles hour-scale long video understanding under limited context and high cost by leveraging MLLMs' inherent KV sparsification. It introduces a Visual Summarization Token (VST) per video interval to summarize visual information as associated KV, trained via instruction fine-tuning with curriculum learning and composite data curation, plus dynamic compression. This enables efficient long-video understanding.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 利用KV稀疏化进行长视频压缩的思路新颖，对长视频多模态理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL与Visual Summarization Token，实现小时级长视频的高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 基于MLLM固有KV稀疏化能力的VST压缩与课程学习训练策略。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上取得良好性能，有效缓解上下文与计算瓶颈。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、难以统一处理的问题，论文提出渐进式视觉token压缩PVC，将每张图像扩展为静态视频，逐帧渐进编码并自适应压缩，以补充前帧未提取的信息。视频token利用时间冗余高效压缩，图像通过多帧逐步补充空间细节，从而统一图像与视频的token压缩。在每帧默认64 token下仍能保留空间细节与时间变化，并在多项视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: PVC addresses the separate token compression strategies for images and videos in VLMs by extending each image into a static video and progressively encoding and adaptively compressing tokens across frames. It exploits temporal redundancy for video and gradually supplements spatial details for images, unifying compression. With 64 tokens per frame, it preserves spatial and temporal information and achieves state-of-the-art results across video understanding tasks.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 统一图像与视频token压缩的思路简洁有效，对多模态高效推理与视频理解研究者有实用价值。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出渐进式视觉token压缩PVC，统一图像与视频的token压缩策略。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，通过逐帧渐进编码与自适应压缩统一处理。
2412.09613|v2.result: 每帧64 token下保留空间与时间信息，多项视频理解任务达到SOTA。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理开销大的问题，提出 Libra-Merging 方法，通过重要性-冗余度权衡与剪枝-合并的折中策略实现加速插件。相比已有剪枝或合并方法，它同时考虑 token 重要性和冗余性，在剪枝与合并之间取得平衡。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但方法定位为即插即用加速模块，可兼容现有 LVLM。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models by proposing Libra-Merging, a plug-in acceleration method that trades off importance-redundancy and pruning-merging. Unlike prior pruning or merging approaches, it jointly considers token importance and redundancy to balance pruning and merging. The abstract does not report specific numbers, but the method is positioned as a plug-and-play acceleration module compatible with existing LVLMs.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 VLM 推理中视觉 token 过多导致计算和显存开销大的问题，提出 TopV，一种兼容 FlashAttention 和 KV cache 的 token 剪枝方法。与依赖注意力分数或贪心启发式准则的已有方法不同，TopV 将 token 剪枝建模为优化问题，在预填充阶段仅执行一次剪枝，从而有效减小 KV cache 并保持与 FlashAttention 兼容。方法无需额外训练或微调，优化框架引入特征相似度、相对空间等视觉感知代价函数。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the excessive visual tokens in VLMs that incur high computation and memory costs, proposing TopV, a token pruning method compatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. Unlike prior methods relying on attention scores or greedy heuristics, TopV formulates token pruning as an optimization problem and performs pruning only once during prefilling, effectively reducing KV cache size. It requires no additional training or fine-tuning and incorporates a visual-aware cost function considering feature similarity and relative spatial factors.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: TopV 在兼容性和无需微调方面有实际工程价值，优化式剪枝思路比启发式更 principled，值得关注。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出兼容 FlashAttention 与 KV cache 的优化式视觉 token 剪枝方法 TopV。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 将 token 剪枝形式化为优化问题并在预填充阶段一次性完成。
2503.18278|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体加速与精度数据，但声称实现快速低显存推理。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 LVLM 中长视觉 token 计算开销大的问题，观察到剪枝比例的影响在不同 LLM 层和不同实例（图像-提示对）间存在差异，提出 ATP-LLaVA。方法引入自适应 token 剪枝（ATP）模块，根据输入实例自适应计算重要性分数和剪枝阈值，可无缝插入任意两个 LLM 层之间且开销可忽略；同时提出空间增强剪枝（SA）策略。相比固定或预定义剪枝比例的方法，实现了层间和实例间的自适应剪枝。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of long visual tokens in LVLMs, observing that the impact of pruning ratio varies across LLM layers and instances. It proposes ATP-LLaVA, which introduces an Adaptive Token Pruning (ATP) module that computes importance scores and pruning thresholds adaptively per instance, insertable between any two LLM layers with negligible overhead. A Spatial Augmented Pruning (SA) strategy is also developed. Unlike fixed-ratio methods, it achieves layer-wise and instance-wise adaptive pruning.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 层间与实例间自适应剪枝的观察合理，方法设计简洁可插拔，对 LVLM 效率研究有参考价值。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出 ATP-LLaVA，实现层间与实例间自适应的视觉 token 剪枝。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 自适应计算每层每实例的剪枝阈值与重要性分数。
2412.00447|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在计算成本与模型性能间取得更好平衡。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 VLM 处理高分辨率图像和视频时受限于上下文窗口和计算成本的问题，提出 VoCo-LLaMA，首个利用 LLM 自身压缩视觉 token 的方法。已有方法用外部模块压缩视觉 token 并强制 LLM 理解压缩结果，导致视觉信息损失；VoCo-LLaMA 在视觉指令微调阶段引入 Vision Compression token，并通过注意力蒸馏将 LLM 理解视觉 token 的方式蒸馏到 VoCo token 的处理中。方法在 576 倍压缩比下实现最小性能损失，FLOPs 减少最多 94.8%，推理时间加速 69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited context window and high computational cost of VLMs when processing high-resolution images and videos, proposing VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach to compress vision tokens using LLMs themselves. Unlike prior methods that compress with external modules and force LLMs to understand compressed tokens, VoCo-LLaMA introduces Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and distills how LLMs comprehend vision tokens into VoCo token processing via attention distillation. It achieves minimal performance loss at 576× compression, up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs, and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 利用 LLM 自身进行视觉压缩的思路新颖，压缩比和加速数据亮眼，对多模态效率研究有较强参考价值。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用 LLM 自身压缩视觉 token 的方法 VoCo-LLaMA。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 通过注意力蒸馏将 LLM 对视觉 token 的理解迁移到 Vision Compression token。
2406.12275|v2.result: 576 倍压缩下性能损失极小，FLOPs 减少 94.8%，推理加速 69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 MLLM 在适配下游任务时 LoRA 微调引入有害冗余、加剧通用知识遗忘的问题，提出 LoRASculpt。方法在理论保证下向 LoRA 引入稀疏更新以丢弃冗余参数，并提出冲突缓解正则化器（Conflict Mitigation Regularizer）优化 LoRA 更新轨迹，缓解与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明即使在极高稀疏度（≤5%）下，方法仍能同时提升泛化性和下游任务性能，有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the harmful redundancy introduced by LoRA during visual instruction tuning of MLLMs, which exacerbates forgetting of general knowledge. It proposes LoRASculpt, which introduces sparse updates into LoRA under theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, and a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer to refine the LoRA update trajectory and mitigate knowledge conflicts with pretrained weights. Experiments show that even at very high sparsity (≤5%), the method simultaneously improves generalization and downstream performance, effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 关注 LoRA 微调中的知识遗忘与冗余问题，稀疏化加正则化的组合有理论支撑，对持续学习与多模态适配有参考意义。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出 LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新与冲突缓解正则化协调通用与专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向 LoRA 引入稀疏更新并设计冲突缓解正则化器。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在 ≤5% 稀疏度下同时提升泛化性与下游任务性能。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对 LMM 中视觉 token 数量庞大导致推理延迟高的问题，指出已有 token 剪枝方法要么需要大量校准和微调，要么依赖次优重要性度量导致保留 token 冗余度高。作者将 token 剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP），目标是选择多样性最大的 token 子集，提出 DivPrune 求解该问题并剪除其余 token。方法无需微调即可降低冗余、实现保留 token 的最高多样性。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference latency of LMMs caused by the large number of visual tokens. It notes that existing token pruning methods either require extensive calibration and fine-tuning or rely on suboptimal importance metrics leading to high redundancy among retained tokens. The authors formulate token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) to select a subset maximizing diversity, and propose DivPrune to solve it and prune the rest. The method reduces redundancy and achieves highest diversity of selected tokens without fine-tuning.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 将 token 剪枝转化为多样性最大化问题视角独特，无需微调且理论形式清晰，对 LMM 效率研究有启发。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出基于多样性的视觉 token 剪枝方法 DivPrune。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 将 token 剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP）并求解。
2503.02175|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称实现保留 token 的最高多样性并降低冗余。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）低比特压缩研究不足的问题，论文发现多模态输入的冗余性导致注意力矩阵高度稀疏，并从理论和实验上证明注意力稀疏度可约束Query/Key权重矩阵的压缩误差。据此提出CASP：对Q/K权重做数据感知的低秩分解，再基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。CASP可与任意量化方法兼容，在图像和视频语言基准上平均将SOTA 2-bit量化方法（AQLM、QuIP#）提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models. It theoretically and experimentally shows that the sparsity of the attention matrix bounds the compression error of Query/Key weight matrices, and proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization across layers. CASP is compatible with any quantizer and improves state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM, QuIP#) by 21% on average on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 把多模态注意力稀疏性作为压缩误差上界的理论依据较有新意，且作为即插即用模块对现有2-bit量化方法增益显著，对多模态模型部署有实用价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩框架CASP，将Q/K低秩分解与最优比特分配量化结合。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 从理论上建立注意力矩阵稀疏度与Q/K权重压缩误差的界，并据此设计数据感知的低秩分解。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像与视频语言基准上平均超越AQLM、QuIP#等SOTA 2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时处理时序与空间定位，原因在于坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，以及视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息难以保留。论文提出LLaVA-ST：用Language-Aligned Positional Embedding将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间以简化细粒度时空对应，并用Spatial-Temporal Packer将时间与空间分辨率的特征压缩解耦为两条point-to-region注意力流。同时构建含4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空多模态理解。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to jointly handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of preserving fine-grained spatio-temporal cues during video feature compression. The authors propose LLaVA-ST, which introduces Language-Aligned Positional Embedding to embed textual coordinate tokens into visual space and a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams. They also build the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset for fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频MLLM中时空联合定位这一实际痛点给出对齐与压缩两方面的设计，并配套大规模数据集，对视频理解与多模态定位研究有参考价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出LLaVA-ST模型及ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空联合的多模态理解。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的point-to-region注意力压缩机制。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在细粒度时空定位任务上缓解了坐标对齐与特征压缩难题，并提供了4.3M训练样本。
