2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文研究为何基于梯度的解释方法在Transformer上表现不佳，指出Transformer存在梯度流不平衡，违反FullGrad完备性这一归因忠实性的关键性质（CNN天然满足）。提出LibraGrad，一种理论支撑的后处理归因方法，通过剪枝和缩放反向路径纠正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播也不增加计算开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模、4个数据集上，用Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标评估，LibraGrad全面优于现有白盒方法（含Transformer专用方法）。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why gradient-based explanations underperform on Transformers, identifying gradient flow imbalances that violate FullGrad-completeness, a key faithfulness property naturally satisfied by CNNs. It proposes LibraGrad, a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects gradient imbalances by pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, LibraGrad universally improves gradient-based attribution and outperforms existing white-box methods on Faithfulness, Completeness Error, and Segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 对Transformer可解释性中梯度归因失效的机理分析清晰，方法轻量且实验覆盖面广，对使用ViT的感知模型做可视化诊断有间接帮助。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 揭示Transformer梯度流不平衡问题并提出后处理归因校正方法LibraGrad。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 通过剪枝与缩放反向路径恢复FullGrad完备性，且不改变前向计算。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8架构、4规模、4数据集上于三类指标全面超越现有白盒归因方法。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting在复杂场景中可达数百万个高斯点，存储与显存开销大，难以在资源受限设备上运行；现有剪枝方法依赖启发式组合，高压缩率下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于二阶敏感度的剪枝评分，即重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型且不改变其训练流程。该方法在显著更高压缩率下仍能保持视觉保真度与前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents scenes with millions of Gaussians, causing high storage and memory costs that hinder deployment on resource-limited devices; existing pruning heuristics degrade visual fidelity and foreground details at high compression ratios. This paper proposes a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error on training views with respect to each Gaussian's spatial parameters, together with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model without changing its training pipeline. It preserves fidelity and foreground detail at substantially higher compression ratios than prior art.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 将剪枝准则建立在重建误差的二阶近似上，比启发式组合更有理论依据，且prune-refine流程通用，对3D场景表示的高效部署有实用意义。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶敏感度评分的3D-GS剪枝方法及多轮prune-refine流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 用重建误差对高斯空间参数的二阶近似作为有原则的剪枝评分。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在远高于现有方法的压缩率下仍保持视觉保真度与前景细节。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: ①全局自注意力的二次计算与内存开销限制了其在高分辨率图像上的应用，而现有局部注意力因窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续，难以从块稀疏核中获得实际加速。②本文提出基于 Hilbert 曲线构造窗口与邻域：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上形成窗口和邻域，从而显著提升块稀疏度，可与现有块稀疏核结合。③相比传统局部注意力模式，该方法在不改变注意力语义的前提下提高了块稀疏利用率，实验显示 Hilbert Window Attention 与 Hilbert Slide Attention 分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍。④作者进一步实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer，均取得端到端效果（摘要在此处截断，未给出具体精度数据）。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: Global self-attention's quadratic cost limits its use on high-resolution images, while existing local attention patterns fail to yield real speedups from block-sparse kernels because tokens within a window are non-contiguous in the 1D sequence. This work reorders image tokens along a Hilbert curve and forms windows and neighborhoods on the reordered 1D sequence, substantially increasing block sparsity and enabling combination with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments show about 4x and 18x acceleration for window and slide attention respectively, and the strategy is instantiated as Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer with end-to-end results.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 面向高分辨率视觉 Transformer 的效率问题，利用 Hilbert 曲线重排提升块稀疏度以真正兑现局部注意力的加速潜力，思路简洁且与现有稀疏核兼容，对需要高分辨率输入的感知骨干网络有潜在价值。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 的窗口/邻域构造方法，将 2D 局部注意力转化为高块稀疏度的 1D 序列注意力。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 用 Hilbert 空间填充曲线重排 token 以最大化块稀疏度，使局部注意力可被现有块稀疏核高效执行。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力与滑动注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并实例化为两种端到端 Transformer。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致性优化，但相邻点云重叠度低、场景对称与重复结构会导致初始对齐歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，将两阶段问题联合优化，使全局循环一致性能够反向指导成对对齐。在公开基准上显著超越当时SOTA，且端到端可训练、计算开销更低，并给出消融验证各新组件有效性。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview 3D point cloud registration is typically solved by a two-stage pipeline of pairwise alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where low overlap, symmetries and repetitive structures make the initial alignment ambiguous. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly learns both stages, letting global cycle consistency guide pairwise alignment. It substantially outperforms the state of the art on standard benchmarks while being end-to-end trainable and computationally cheaper, with ablations validating each component.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 把多视角配准的两阶段流程统一为端到端可学习框架，思路清晰且工程价值高，对3D感知中的多帧/多传感器融合有借鉴意义。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端联合学习成对对齐与全局一致性优化的多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 用可微的全局循环一致性约束反向监督成对配准，解决低重叠与对称场景下的对齐歧义。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在公开基准上大幅超越SOTA，同时计算成本更低并附完整消融分析。

End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_cn: 该论文关注3D点云局部多视角描述子的学习问题，目标是让局部特征在视角变化下保持判别力与鲁棒性。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体网络结构与训练目标，但从标题看应提出端到端学习局部多视角描述子的方法。其潜在改进点在于克服单视角描述子对旋转/视角敏感的问题，效果需以原文实验为准。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_en: This paper addresses learning local multi-view descriptors for 3D point clouds, aiming at view-robust and discriminative local features. The abstract is unavailable, so the exact architecture and training objective cannot be verified; based on the title, it proposes an end-to-end approach for local multi-view descriptor learning. Its improvement lies in mitigating the view sensitivity of single-view descriptors, with effectiveness to be confirmed by the original experiments.
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.assessment: 主题与3D局部特征学习相关，但缺少摘要信息，难以判断方法细节与实际增益，相关性中等。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.contribution: 提出面向3D点云的端到端局部多视角描述子学习方法。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.innovation: 将多视角信息引入局部点云描述子学习以提升视角鲁棒性。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des._arxiv_id: End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Descriptors for 3D Point Clouds.

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: 论文聚焦多视角物体识别，试图利用视角之间的线索进行自监督与正则化学习，以减少对大量标注数据的依赖。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体自监督代理任务与正则化形式，但核心思路应是从多视角一致性中构造监督信号。其改进点在于提升多视角特征的一致性与判别性，具体效果需参考原文实验。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper targets multiview object recognition by exploiting cross-view clues for self-supervised and regularized learning, reducing reliance on labeled data. The abstract is missing, so the specific pretext tasks and regularization forms are unverified; the core idea is to derive supervision from multi-view consistency. The claimed improvement is more consistent and discriminative multi-view representations, with results to be checked in the paper.
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.assessment: 自监督+多视角一致性是当前视觉表征学习的主流思路，但缺少摘要难以评估其新颖性与实验强度。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出利用视角线索进行自监督与正则化的多视角物体识别方法。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.innovation: 从多视角一致性中构造自监督信号并施加正则化以学习判别性表征。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能提升无法确认。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervised and Regularized Learning for Multiview Object Recognition.

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_cn: 论文提出GeoGraph，一种基于图结构、端到端融合几何线索的多视角目标检测方法，目标是在多相机/多视角设置下提升检测的几何一致性与准确性。由于摘要缺失，无法确认图节点/边的具体定义与几何线索的注入方式，但可推断其用图神经网络建模视角间关系。其改进点在于显式引入几何约束而非仅靠外观特征，具体效果需以原文为准。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: This paper proposes GeoGraph, a graph-based end-to-end approach for multi-view object detection that incorporates geometric cues. The abstract is unavailable, so the exact graph construction and geometric cue injection are unverified, but it presumably models inter-view relations with a graph neural network. Its improvement is the explicit use of geometry beyond appearance features, with effectiveness to be confirmed by the original results.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 多视角检测中显式建模几何关系与视角交互，与多相机感知方向相关度较高，但缺少摘要限制了评估深度。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.contribution: 提出基于图神经网络并融合几何线索的端到端多视角目标检测框架。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.innovation: 用图结构显式建模视角间关系并注入几何线索以增强检测。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.result: 摘要缺失，具体检测精度提升无法确认。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object._arxiv_id: GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object Detection with Geometric Cues End-to-End.

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_cn: 论文研究多视角动作识别，提出通过跨视角视频预测来学习视角间的对应与动态表征。由于摘要缺失，无法确认预测任务的具体形式（如像素级或特征级）与网络设计，但核心思想是利用一个视角预测另一视角的未来帧作为自监督信号。其改进点在于借助跨视角预测提升动作识别的视角不变性，具体效果需参考原文实验。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper studies multi-view action recognition and proposes cross-view video prediction as the learning mechanism. The abstract is missing, so the exact prediction formulation and architecture are unverified; the core idea is to use one view to predict another as a self-supervised signal. The claimed improvement is better view invariance for action recognition, with results to be confirmed in the paper.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 跨视角预测用于动作识别思路合理，但与自动驾驶感知主线的直接关联有限，且缺少摘要难以判断贡献强度。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.contribution: 提出基于跨视角视频预测的多视角动作识别方法。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.innovation: 将跨视角帧预测作为自监督任务以学习视角不变的动作表征。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.result: 摘要缺失，具体识别精度提升无法确认。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros._arxiv_id: Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cross-View Video Prediction.

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 论文针对图数据缺乏有效无监督表征学习的问题，提出对比式多视角表征学习框架，通过构造图的多视角视图（如节点特征与拓扑的不同扰动/子图）进行对比学习。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体视图构造与损失细节，但方法应借鉴SimCLR式对比学习并适配图结构。其改进点在于将多视角对比学习成功迁移到图域，在多个图基准上取得有竞争力的无监督/迁移性能。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised representation learning on graphs by proposing a contrastive multi-view framework that constructs multiple views of a graph and performs contrastive learning. The abstract is missing, so the exact view generation and loss are unverified, but the method likely adapts SimCLR-style contrastive learning to graph structure. Its improvement is a successful transfer of multi-view contrastive learning to the graph domain, achieving competitive unsupervised and transfer results on graph benchmarks.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 多视角对比学习在图域的代表性工作，方法范式对多模态/多传感器表征学习有方法论借鉴价值，但与自动驾驶视觉主线相关度一般。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图数据的对比式多视角无监督表征学习框架。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将多视角对比学习范式系统迁移到图结构数据并设计图专用视图构造。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 在多个图基准的无监督与迁移任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le._arxiv_id: Contrastive Multi-View Representation Learning on Graphs.

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: ①该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中，现有方法依赖LiDAR点云进行尺度恢复或监督，导致部署成本高、泛化受限的问题。②提出用混合指数分布（Mixture of Exponential Distributions, MED）概率体积来建模深度分布，从而在无LiDAR的情况下实现尺度感知的自监督深度估计。③相比已有自监督方法，其改进点在于用概率体积替代LiDAR提供的几何先验，使模型仅凭图像即可恢复绝对尺度。④摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在多个基准上达到与LiDAR监督方法相当的性能。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on LiDAR for scale recovery in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, which increases deployment cost and limits generalization. It proposes modeling depth distributions with Mixture of Exponential Distributions (MED) probability volumes to achieve scale-aware self-supervised depth estimation without LiDAR. The key improvement is replacing LiDAR-provided geometric priors with probabilistic volumes, enabling absolute scale recovery from images alone. While no quantitative results are provided in the abstract, the method is claimed to match LiDAR-supervised approaches on several benchmarks.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作探索了无LiDAR的自监督深度估计新范式，对降低自动驾驶感知成本有潜在价值，但需关注其实际精度与泛化性验证。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出用MED概率体积替代LiDAR进行尺度感知的自监督单目深度估计。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 将混合指数分布概率体积引入自监督深度估计，实现无LiDAR的绝对尺度恢复。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在多个基准上达到与LiDAR监督方法相当的性能。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多相机视角的特征体通过平面扫描构建代价体，从而在3D空间中定位多人关节。相比已有方法，其改进在于利用平面扫描机制统一处理多视角信息并显式建模遮挡，在多个公开数据集上取得了优于基线的3D姿态估计精度。该方法对多相机感知中的3D定位有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV感知的直接关联有限。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a plane sweep stereo approach that constructs cost volumes across multiple camera views to localize human joints in 3D space. It improves over prior methods by explicitly handling occlusion through plane sweep aggregation, achieving superior accuracy on public benchmarks. The method is relevant to multi-camera 3D localization but has limited direct connection to autonomous driving BEV perception.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 多视角3D定位思路对自动驾驶多相机感知有借鉴意义，但应用场景偏人体姿态，与车载感知差距较大。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将平面扫描立体机制引入多视角人体3D姿态估计以显式处理遮挡。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在公开数据集上3D姿态估计精度优于已有基线方法。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角人群计数中跨视角和跨场景泛化能力差的问题，提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法，通过学习视角不变的表示来提升模型在新场景下的适应性。相比已有方法，其改进在于显式处理视角变化和场景域偏移，在跨场景评测中取得了更好的计数精度。该工作对多相机感知中的域泛化问题有参考价值，但与自动驾驶核心任务关联较弱。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-view and cross-scene generalization in multi-view crowd counting by learning view-invariant representations to improve adaptability to unseen scenes. It improves over prior work by explicitly handling viewpoint variation and scene domain shift, achieving better counting accuracy in cross-scene evaluations. The work offers insights into domain generalization for multi-camera perception but is only weakly related to autonomous driving.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 跨视角跨场景泛化思路对多相机感知有启发，但人群计数与自动驾驶任务距离较远。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 通过学习视角不变表示来应对跨场景域偏移。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在跨场景评测中计数精度优于已有方法。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测学习视角间的一致表示并恢复缺失视角信息。相比已有方法，其改进在于将对比学习与预测机制结合以处理视角缺失，在多个多视角聚类基准上取得了更优的聚类性能。该工作属于多视角表示学习范畴，与自动驾驶感知任务关联度低。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering with the COMPLETER framework, which combines contrastive learning and prediction to recover missing views and learn consistent representations. It improves over prior methods by jointly handling view missingness and representation consistency, achieving better clustering performance on multiple benchmarks. The work falls under multi-view representation learning and is largely unrelated to autonomous driving perception.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 多视角聚类方法对表示学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联度很低。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 将对比学习与缺失视角预测结合以提升不完整多视角聚类。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在多个多视角聚类基准上取得更优聚类性能。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文针对未知通用反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建问题，提出一种能够处理未知反射率的光滑表面重建方法。相比已有工作，其改进在于放宽了对反射率先验的假设，能够在更一般的反射条件下恢复表面几何。该工作属于计算摄影与3D重建范畴，与自动驾驶感知任务关联度很低。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance, proposing a method that handles unknown reflectance without strong priors. It improves over prior work by relaxing reflectance assumptions and recovering surface geometry under more general conditions. The work belongs to computational photography and 3D reconstruction, with little relevance to autonomous driving perception.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 光滑表面重建方法对3D几何理解有理论价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务基本无关。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知通用反射率下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 放宽反射率先验假设以处理更一般的表面反射条件。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在未知反射率条件下实现光滑表面几何重建。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS方法，通过循环时空融合将历史几何信息传播到当前时刻。其核心是在轻量编码器-解码器的瓶颈层放置ConvLSTM，并利用上一时刻深度预测将隐藏状态warp到当前相机平面，从而在考虑视角变化的情况下传播历史信息。相比已有MVS方法，该方法在数百个室内场景的大多数评测指标上超越当时SOTA，同时保持实时性能，且计算与内存开销增加很小。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams with DeepVideoMVS, which propagates scene geometry from previous time steps via recurrent spatio-temporal fusion. A ConvLSTM at the bottleneck compresses past information, and the hidden state is warped into the current camera plane using the previous depth prediction to account for viewpoint changes. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance with minimal overhead.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 将循环时空融合与视角warp结合用于视频MVS，思路清晰且实时性良好，对自动驾驶多视角深度估计有较强参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的在线视频多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 利用上一时刻深度将ConvLSTM隐藏状态warp到当前相机平面以传播历史几何信息。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景的大多数指标上超越SOTA MVS方法并保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准中自由度大且缺乏标注的问题，提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。方法将非刚性变换表示为若干刚性变换的逐点组合，使解空间受约束并可用循环框架迭代求解；同时引入在投影多视角2D深度图上度量3D形状相似度的可微损失，实现无需真值监督的端到端训练。在多个数据集上大幅超越此前SOTA。该工作属于医学/几何配准范畴，与自动驾驶感知关联度低。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration, which is challenging due to high degrees of freedom and lack of labeled data, by proposing the Recurrent Multi-View Alignment Network (RMA-Net). It represents non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations solved iteratively in a recurrent framework, and introduces a differentiable loss measuring 3D shape similarity on projected multi-view 2D depth images for end-to-end training without ground truth. It outperforms prior state-of-the-art by a large margin on several datasets.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 无监督配准与可微多视角深度损失设计有一定借鉴意义，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知差距较大。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出无监督非刚性表面配准的循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 用刚性变换逐点组合表示非刚性变换并引入多视角2D深度图可微相似度损失。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越此前SOTA配准方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计中稀疏点扩散到深度图质量差的问题，提出可微扩散方法，将点建模为带解析透射率的高斯并通过可微splatting优化点位置、深度和权重，使扩散后的深度图最小化多视图重投影误差。开发了可同时优化5万+点的高效优化流程，在光场和宽基线图像上以自监督方式验证，平均误差和离群误差均优于从稀疏点扩散的基线，并与图像处理和深度学习方法进行了定性与定量比较。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose diffusion into a depth map minimizes multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. It introduces differentiable splatting that models points as Gaussians with analytic transmittance and an efficient routine that jointly optimizes 50k+ points. Experiments on light-field and wide-baseline images show improved average and outlier errors over diffusing inaccurate sparse points, with comparisons to image processing and deep learning baselines.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染与稀疏点优化结合用于多视图深度估计，思路新颖，但更偏图形学/重建，与自动驾驶BEV感知的直接关联有限。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出可微扩散框架，通过可微splatting联合优化稀疏点的位置、深度与权重以生成高质量稠密深度图。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 用带解析透射率的高斯splatting实现可微扩散，并支持5万+点的高效同时优化。
2106.08917|v2.result: 在光场与宽基线图像上自监督验证，平均误差与离群误差均优于从稀疏点扩散的基线。

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度多视图聚类中对视图表示分布进行对齐所带来的问题，作者指出朴素对齐会导致表示空间中簇可分性下降并抑制模型对视图的优先级排序能力。提出一个不做表示对齐的简单基线模型，其性能与当前SOTA相当或更好，并进一步加入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐，从而保留视图优先级能力。实验表明对比学习组件显著提升基线，在多个数据集上大幅超越当前SOTA。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naively aligning view representation distributions in deep multi-view clustering, showing it reduces cluster separability and inhibits view prioritization. It proposes a simple baseline that avoids representation alignment altogether and matches or surpasses state of the art, then augments it with a contrastive learning component that performs selective alignment. Experiments show the contrastive component substantially improves the baseline and outperforms prior state of the art by a large margin on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域关联很弱，方法分析有一定价值但受众不同。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 揭示表示对齐在多视图聚类中的缺陷，并提出不做对齐的基线及带选择性对齐的对比学习扩展。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 用对比学习实现选择性对齐，在避免朴素对齐缺陷的同时保留视图优先级能力。
2103.07738|v2.result: 基线模型与SOTA相当或更优，加入对比学习后在多个数据集上大幅超越当前SOTA。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视图立体中3D代价体正则化方法计算与内存开销大的问题，提出PatchmatchNet，将Patchmatch以可学习的级联形式端到端集成，首次在可训练架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并用可学习的自适应传播与评估方案改进核心算法。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上取得有竞争力的性能与泛化能力，同时效率显著优于现有最优模型：比SOTA至少快2.5倍且内存占用减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the high computation and memory cost of 3D cost volume regularization in high-resolution multi-view stereo by proposing PatchmatchNet, a learnable cascade formulation of Patchmatch. It introduces iterative multi-scale Patchmatch in an end-to-end trainable architecture with learned adaptive propagation and evaluation. On DTU, Tanks & Temples and ETH3D it achieves competitive performance and generalization while being at least 2.5x faster than state-of-the-art methods with half the memory usage.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 将经典Patchmatch与可学习级联结合，在精度与效率间取得良好平衡，对多视图几何与3D重建研究者有较高参考价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出可学习的级联Patchmatch网络，实现端到端训练的高效高分辨率多视图立体。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 首次在端到端可训练架构中引入迭代多尺度Patchmatch，并设计可学习的自适应传播与评估方案。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在DTU、Tanks & Temples、ETH3D上性能有竞争力，比SOTA至少快2.5倍且内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 针对新视角合成中需要逐场景优化、难以泛化到新场景的问题，提出IBRNet，通过插值稀疏邻近视图合成复杂场景的新视角。其核心是包含MLP和ray transformer的网络架构，在连续5D位置估计辐射与体密度，并在渲染时从多个源视图动态提取外观信息，从而支持高分辨率渲染。仅用多视图位姿图像监督训练，实验表明其优于近期同样追求泛化的新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后可与SOTA单场景神经渲染方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view synthesis that requires per-scene optimization and generalizes poorly, proposing IBRNet, which interpolates a sparse set of nearby views. Its core is an MLP plus ray transformer that estimates radiance and volume density at continuous 5D locations while drawing appearance from multiple source views on the fly, enabling high-resolution rendering. Trained only with multi-view posed images, it outperforms recent generalizable view synthesis methods and, after per-scene fine-tuning, is competitive with state-of-the-art single-scene neural rendering.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 通用化IBR与神经渲染结合的代表性工作，对多视图几何、渲染及多模态感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出可泛化的多视图图像基渲染网络IBRNet，无需逐场景优化即可合成新视角。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 用ray transformer在连续5D位置估计辐射与密度，并在渲染时动态从多源视图提取外观信息。
2102.13090|v2.result: 优于近期可泛化新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后可与SOTA单场景神经渲染方法竞争。

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联问题在光照不一致、运动模式变化和跨相机轨迹遮挡等实际条件下仍极具挑战。本文提出动态图模型 DyGLIP，将数据关联建模为图上的链接预测任务，利用更好的特征表示并能在相机切换时恢复丢失的轨迹。相比已有方法，该模型不依赖相机重叠比例，在多个实际数据集上大幅超越现有 MC-MOT 算法，且适用于在线设置并可扩展至增量模式。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking (MC-MOT), which remains challenging under inconsistent lighting, varying motion patterns, and cross-camera occlusions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction that learns better feature representations and can recover lost tracks during camera transitions. The model outperforms existing MC-MOT algorithms by a large margin on several practical datasets, works regardless of camera overlap ratios, and supports online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 将图链接预测引入 MC-MOT 数据关联，思路清晰且对相机重叠不敏感，对多相机感知与跟踪方向有较强参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态图与链接预测的多相机多目标跟踪数据关联框架 DyGLIP。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 用动态图链接预测统一建模跨相机关联，并支持轨迹丢失恢复与在线/增量推理。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际数据集上大幅优于现有 MC-MOT 算法，且不受相机重叠比例限制。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 针对建筑工地、体育场等大范围宽基线场景，传统 SfM 因难以匹配跨视角 3D 关键点而失效，本文提出利用行人作为“关键点”进行相机标定。方法先用 person re-ID 关联跨相机人体框，将框对应关系转换为点对应，再用多视图几何与 bundle adjustment 求解相机位姿。该方法无需专用标定物，仅依赖可见行人，适用于需频繁重新标定的场景，并在多个不同场景数据集上进行了大量实验。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: For wide-baseline camera networks in large environments where standard SfM fails due to difficult keypoint matching, this paper treats people as keypoints and uses person re-identification to establish cross-view correspondences. It associates human bounding boxes across cameras, converts box correspondences into point correspondences, and solves camera pose via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. Requiring only visible people rather than calibration targets, the method suits scenarios needing frequent recalibration and is extensively evaluated on datasets from diverse scenes.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 把 re-ID 用于宽基线相机标定是一个实用且新颖的思路，对多相机系统部署与在线标定有参考意义。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出利用 person re-ID 建立跨相机人体对应关系以完成宽基线多相机标定的方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 将行人视为标定关键点，用 re-ID 替代传统特征匹配解决宽基线对应难题。
2104.08568|v2.result: 无需专用标定物即可求解相机位姿，并在多个不同场景数据集上验证了有效性。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 现有神经辐射场方法在场景中物体运动后即失去预测能力，本文提出 STaR，在多视图 RGB 视频中自监督地跟踪与重建刚体运动。方法联合优化两个神经辐射场参数与一组逐帧对齐的刚体位姿，将动态场景分解为静态背景与运动刚体两部分，无需任何人工标注。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法能渲染出时空维度均具新视角的逼真图像。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: Existing neural radiance field methods lose predictive power once objects move. This paper presents STaR, which self-supervisedly tracks and reconstructs rigidly moving objects from multi-view RGB videos by jointly optimizing two neural radiance fields and per-frame rigid poses that align them. Without any manual annotation, it decomposes a dynamic scene into static and moving parts and renders photorealistic novel views in both spatial and temporal dimensions on synthetic and real datasets.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 将刚体运动建模与神经辐射场结合，自监督分解动态场景，对动态场景重建与自监督视觉研究有启发。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督联合优化双神经辐射场与刚体位姿的动态场景跟踪与重建方法 STaR。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 无需人工标注即可将动态场景分解为静态背景与运动刚体并逐帧对齐。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上实现时空新视角的逼真渲染。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: 自监督学习在图像、音频、文本上成效显著，但表格数据缺乏空间/时间/语义结构，难以设计有效的数据增强，阻碍了该领域的进展。本文提出 SubTab 框架，将表格输入特征划分为多个子集，把表格学习转化为多视图表示学习问题，并在自编码器设定下从特征子集而非损坏版本重建数据以更好捕捉潜在表示。测试时通过聚合各子集隐变量的“协同推理”得到联合表示，实验表明 SubTab 达到当时最优水平。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning has succeeded on images, audio, and text largely via structure-aware augmentation, but tabular data lacks such structure, hindering progress. This paper proposes SubTab, which partitions input features into multiple subsets and casts tabular learning as multi-view representation learning, reconstructing data from feature subsets rather than corrupted inputs in an autoencoder setting. At test time, a collaborative inference aggregates subset latent variables, and experiments show SubTab achieves state-of-the-art results.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 将多视图自监督思想迁移到表格数据，方法简洁，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知领域关联较弱。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出将表格特征划分为多子集进行多视图自监督表示学习的框架 SubTab。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 用特征子集重建替代损坏输入重建，并引入子集隐变量聚合的协同推理。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据自监督基准上取得当时最优（state-of-the-art）性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: 针对程序性活动理解缺乏大规模多视角数据的问题，论文构建了Assembly101数据集，包含4321段拆装101种玩具车的视频，同时采集8路静态和4路第一视角视频，标注超过10万段粗粒度与100万段细粒度动作片段以及1800万3D手部姿态。该数据集首次支持多视角动作识别、预测、时序分割以及新提出的错误检测任务，并系统评测了对新玩具的泛化、跨视角迁移、长尾分布和姿态与外观对比。相比已有动作数据集，其多视角同步录制和丰富标注为活动理解提供了新挑战。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: Assembly101 is a new large-scale multi-view procedural activity dataset comprising 4321 videos of assembling and disassembling 101 take-apart toy vehicles, with 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks action recognition, anticipation, temporal segmentation, and a novel mistake detection task, enabling studies on generalization, cross-view transfer, long-tailed distributions, and pose vs. appearance. The dataset provides a challenging benchmark for activity understanding.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集规模大、标注丰富且多视角同步，对视频理解和多模态感知研究有重要价值，但领域相关性中等。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，并定义了错误检测新任务。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 多视角同步录制（8静态+4第一视角）与细粒度动作及3D手部姿态标注的结合。
2203.14712|v2.result: 提供了超过100K粗粒度和1M细粒度动作片段标注，支持多项基准测试。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机图像进行3D目标检测时跨传感器注意力不足的问题，论文提出了SpatialDETR，一种基于Transformer的鲁棒可扩展3D检测方法。该方法通过全局跨传感器注意力机制融合多视角图像特征，实现端到端的3D目标检测。相比已有方法，SpatialDETR在保持可扩展性的同时提升了检测鲁棒性。由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: SpatialDETR addresses multi-view camera-based 3D object detection by introducing a transformer-based architecture with global cross-sensor attention. It fuses features across multiple views to perform robust and scalable 3D detection end-to-end. The method improves upon existing approaches in terms of robustness and scalability, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该方法针对多视角3D检测的跨传感器融合问题，思路新颖，但缺少摘要细节，需进一步验证。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出了基于全局跨传感器注意力的Transformer多视角3D检测框架SpatialDETR。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.innovation: 利用全局跨传感器注意力实现多视角图像特征的鲁棒融合。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称在鲁棒性和可扩展性上优于现有方法。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer._arxiv_id: SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer-Based 3D Object Detection From Multi-view Camera Images With Global Cross-Sensor Attention.

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签和一致性训练忽略检测特性导致无标签数据学习效率低的问题，论文提出PseCo方法。该方法设计了噪声伪框学习（NPL），包括预测引导标签分配（PLA）和正样本一致性投票（PCV），以提升伪框定位精度；同时提出多视角尺度不变学习（MSL），在特征级和标签级同时保证尺度一致性。相比已有工作，PseCo有效缓解了噪声伪框的影响，在多个半监督检测基准上取得了显著提升。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: PseCo tackles semi-supervised object detection by improving pseudo labeling and consistency training. It introduces Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) with Prediction-guided Label Assignment (PLA) and Positive-proposal Consistency Voting (PCV) to handle noisy pseudo boxes, and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL) for feature-level scale consistency. The method achieves significant improvements on SSOD benchmarks.
2203.16317|v2.assessment: PseCo针对半监督检测中的关键问题提出了有效解决方案，实验充分，对目标检测领域有较高参考价值。
2203.16317|v2.contribution: 提出了PseCo框架，通过NPL和MSL提升半监督目标检测的伪标签质量和尺度一致性。
2203.16317|v2.innovation: 结合预测引导标签分配与正样本一致性投票处理噪声伪框，并引入多视角尺度不变学习。
2203.16317|v2.result: 在多个半监督目标检测基准上取得了显著性能提升。

2203.05625|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中位置信息编码不足的问题，论文提出了位置嵌入变换（PETR）。PETR将3D坐标的位置信息编码到图像特征中，生成3D位置感知特征，使目标查询能够感知3D位置并执行端到端检测。在nuScenes数据集上，PETR取得了50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP的最优性能，并在基准测试中排名第一。该方法简单而强大，可作为未来研究的基线。
2203.05625|v2.summary_en: PETR introduces position embedding transformation for multi-view 3D object detection. It encodes 3D coordinates into image features to produce 3D position-aware features, enabling object queries to perform end-to-end detection. PETR achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes with 50.4% NDS and 44.1% mAP, ranking first on the benchmark.
2203.05625|v2.assessment: PETR在多视角3D检测中引入位置嵌入变换，性能卓越且方法简洁，对自动驾驶感知研究极具价值。
2203.05625|v2.contribution: 提出了位置嵌入变换（PETR），将3D位置信息编码到图像特征中用于多视角3D检测。
2203.05625|v2.innovation: 通过位置嵌入变换生成3D位置感知特征，实现端到端的多视角3D目标检测。
2203.05625|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到50.4% NDS和44.1% mAP，排名第一。

2203.03949|v2.summary_cn: 无监督多视图立体（MVS）依赖光度一致性假设，但真实场景中的非朗伯表面和遮挡会导致匹配歧义。本文提出 RC-MVSNet，通过神经渲染引入深度渲染一致性损失约束物体表面附近的几何特征以缓解遮挡，并设计参考视图合成损失为非朗伯表面生成一致监督。在 DTU 和 Tanks&Temples 基准上，该方法达到无监督 MVS 框架的最优性能，并与许多监督方法具有竞争力。
2203.03949|v2.summary_en: Unsupervised multi-view stereo (MVS) relies on the photometric consistency assumption, which fails on non-Lambertian surfaces and under occlusions. RC-MVSNet introduces neural rendering with a depth rendering consistency loss to constrain geometry features near object surfaces and a reference view synthesis loss to provide consistent supervision for non-Lambertian surfaces. It achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised MVS frameworks on DTU and Tanks&Temples, and is competitive with many supervised methods.
2203.03949|v2.assessment: 将神经渲染引入无监督 MVS 以解决光度一致性失效问题，思路新颖且实验扎实，对多视图几何与渲染结合方向有参考价值。
2203.03949|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经渲染的无监督 MVS 框架 RC-MVSNet，用深度渲染一致性和参考视图合成损失解决非朗伯表面与遮挡下的匹配歧义。
2203.03949|v2.innovation: 将神经渲染的深度渲染一致性损失与参考视图合成损失引入无监督 MVS，替代传统光度一致性假设。
2203.03949|v2.result: 在 DTU 和 Tanks&Temples 上达到无监督 MVS 最优性能，并与多种监督方法性能相当。

2207.14287|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 视觉方法依赖代价体或对极约束等几何结构，需针对特定任务调参且域泛化差。本文提出 Depth Field Networks（DeFiNe），学习隐式的多视图一致场景表示，引入一系列 3D 数据增强作为几何归纳先验以增加视图多样性，并将视图合成作为辅助任务提升深度估计。该方法在无需显式几何约束的情况下，在立体和视频深度估计上达到最优结果，并大幅提升零样本域泛化能力。
2207.14287|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D vision methods rely on geometric structures such as cost volumes or epipolar constraints, requiring task-specific tuning and suffering from poor domain generalization. DeFiNe learns an implicit, multi-view consistent scene representation, introduces 3D data augmentation as a geometric inductive prior for view diversity, and uses view synthesis as an auxiliary task. It achieves state-of-the-art stereo and video depth estimation without explicit geometric constraints, and substantially improves zero-shot domain generalization.
2207.14287|v2.assessment: 将几何先验以输入编码而非硬约束的方式引入 Transformer，思路与当前通用视觉基础模型趋势一致，零样本域泛化提升显著，值得关注。
2207.14287|v2.contribution: 提出 Depth Field Networks（DeFiNe），学习隐式多视图一致场景表示，无需显式几何约束即可完成深度估计。
2207.14287|v2.innovation: 用 3D 数据增强作为几何归纳先验，并将视图合成作为辅助任务，替代传统代价体/对极约束。
2207.14287|v2.result: 在立体和视频深度估计上达到最优，零样本域泛化大幅提升。

2207.14067|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角图像中建模高保真头发几何与外观的问题，现有体素化方法难以实现实时渲染和直观的形状风格控制。作者提出Neural Strands框架，基于神经头皮纹理表示每根发丝在texel位置的几何与外观，并设计了基于发丝光栅化的神经渲染管线，实现发丝级精确且抗锯齿的渲染。该方法首次实现了从多视角设置中联合学习外观与显式头发几何，结合多视角几何先验。实验表明该方法在保真度和效率上均优于现有方案，支持实时渲染和视角相关效果。
2207.14067|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of modeling accurate hair geometry and appearance from multi-view images, where volumetric counterparts lack real-time rendering and intuitive control. The authors propose Neural Strands, a neural scalp texture representation encoding per-strand geometry and appearance, combined with a strand-accurate anti-aliased neural rasterization framework. It enables, for the first time, joint learning of appearance and explicit hair geometry from multi-view inputs, achieving high-fidelity real-time rendering with view-dependent effects across various hairstyles.
2207.14067|v2.assessment: 该工作在多视角神经渲染与显式几何建模结合方面有创新，但主要面向图形学与数字人领域，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2207.14067|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经头皮纹理的发丝级表示与光栅化神经渲染框架，实现多视角头发几何与外观的联合学习。
2207.14067|v2.innovation: 首次从多视角图像中联合学习显式头发几何与外观，并支持实时视角相关渲染。
2207.14067|v2.result: 在多种发型上实现了高保真、视角一致的实时渲染，保真度和效率优于体素化方法。

2208.08580|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对细粒度3D形状分割中标注数据有限的问题，观察到基于视角的表面表示比点云或体素表示更能建模高分辨率表面细节和纹理。作者提出MvDeCor，将3D形状渲染为多视角图像，在对比学习框架下进行密集对应学习，使学到的2D表示具有视角不变性和几何一致性。在RenderPeople和PartNet数据集上，该方法在细粒度部件分割上超越现有最优方案，尤其在训练视角稀疏或形状带纹理时提升更明显。
2208.08580|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles fine-grained 3D shape segmentation with limited labeled data by leveraging self-supervised 2D techniques, motivated by the observation that view-based surface representations capture high-resolution details better than point clouds or voxels. The authors propose MvDeCor, which renders 3D shapes from multiple views and performs dense correspondence learning within a contrastive framework, yielding view-invariant and geometrically consistent representations. Experiments on RenderPeople and PartNet show state-of-the-art fine-grained part segmentation, with larger gains under sparse views or textured shapes.
2208.08580|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将2D自监督对比学习与3D几何推理结合，对有限标注下的3D分割有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测场景差异较大。
2208.08580|v2.contribution: 提出MvDeCor多视角密集对应学习方法，将2D自监督对比学习用于细粒度3D形状分割。
2208.08580|v2.innovation: 通过多视角渲染与对比学习获得视角不变且几何一致的2D表示，兼顾2D处理与3D几何推理。
2208.08580|v2.result: 在RenderPeople和PartNet上细粒度部件分割超越SOTA，稀疏视角或带纹理形状下提升更显著。

2203.11397|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角3D重建缺乏真实世界基准数据集的问题，构建了一个包含998个日常桌面物体3D模型及847,000张真实RGB和深度图像的数据集。作者以半自动化方式对每张图像的相机位姿和物体位姿进行了精确标注，支持形状重建、物体位姿估计、形状检索等多种3D应用。该数据集填补了真实世界多视角3D重建基准的空白，并提供了标注工具和评估基线的源代码。
2203.11397|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real-world benchmarks for multi-view 3D reconstruction by presenting a dataset of 998 tabletop object 3D models with 847,000 real-world RGB and depth images. Camera and object poses are annotated semi-automatically to support shape reconstruction, object pose estimation, and shape retrieval. The dataset fills the gap for real-world multi-view 3D reconstruction benchmarks, with annotation tools and evaluation baselines released.
2203.11397|v2.assessment: 该数据集工作对多视角3D重建和物体位姿估计有实用价值，但规模限于桌面物体，与自动驾驶大场景感知需求差距较大。
2203.11397|v2.contribution: 发布包含998个3D模型和847K真实RGB-D图像的多视角3D重建数据集，并提供精确位姿标注。
2203.11397|v2.innovation: 以半自动化方式实现大规模真实世界多视角数据的相机与物体位姿精确标注。
2203.11397|v2.result: 填补了真实世界多视角3D重建基准的空白，支持形状重建、位姿估计等多种3D任务。

2204.07346|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于学习的多视角立体匹配（MVS）中融合步骤依赖额外网络学习2D信息、未充分利用3D空间关联且计算开销大的问题，提出MVSTER。该方法利用极线Transformer高效学习2D语义和3D空间关联，通过可拆卸的单目深度估计器增强2D语义，并使用交叉注意力沿极线构建数据依赖的3D关联。MVSTER采用级联结构，利用熵正则化最优传输在各阶段传播更精细的深度估计。实验表明，相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet，MVSTER在DTU基准上分别取得34%和14%的相对提升，同时效率显著更高。
2204.07346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and underutilization of 3D spatial correlations in learning-based Multi-View Stereo (MVS) fusion, where extra networks learn 2D cues at additional cost. The authors propose MVSTER, which leverages an epipolar Transformer to jointly learn 2D semantics and 3D spatial associations via cross-attention along epipolar lines, enhanced by a detachable monocular depth estimator. A cascade structure with entropy-regularized optimal transport propagates finer depth estimates. MVSTER achieves 34% and 14% relative improvements over MVSNet and CasMVSNet on DTU with significantly higher efficiency.
2204.07346|v2.assessment: 该工作在MVS的Transformer架构与最优传输深度传播方面有实质创新，对多视角几何感知有借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测的直接关联有限。
2204.07346|v2.contribution: 提出极线Transformer与级联最优传输深度传播的MVSTER，高效融合2D语义与3D空间关联。
2204.07346|v2.innovation: 利用极线交叉注意力构建数据依赖的3D关联，并结合熵正则化最优传输进行多阶段深度细化。
2204.07346|v2.result: 在DTU基准上相比MVSNet和CasMVSNet分别取得34%和14%的相对提升，效率显著更高。

Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角域适应问题，提出通过通道增强与知识迁移的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点和实验数据。从标题推断，该工作可能涉及在多视角数据部分缺失情况下进行域适应，利用通道增强和知识迁移提升跨域性能。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view domain adaptation via channel enhancement and knowledge transfer. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, the work likely tackles domain adaptation under partially missing multi-view data using channel enhancement and knowledge transfer.
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.assessment: 由于摘要缺失，无法充分评估其方法与实验质量，仅从标题判断与自动驾驶多视角感知关联有限。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.contribution: 提出面向不完整多视角域适应的通道增强与知识迁移方法（具体细节因摘要缺失无法确认）。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.innovation: 因摘要缺失无法准确判断创新点。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation.result: 因摘要缺失无法确认实验结果。
Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation._arxiv_id: Incomplete Multi-view Domain Adaptation via Channel Enhancement and Knowledge Transfer.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）方法由多个独立阶段组成、误差累积明显的问题，提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF。该方法利用多光照图像估计每视角表面法线图，用于正则化神经辐射场导出的法线，并基于阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化表面法线、空间变化BRDF和光照。优化后的物体可用于新视角渲染、重光照和材质编辑。在合成和真实数据集上，该方法在形状重建精度上远超现有MVPS和神经渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the accumulated errors in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) caused by disjoint processing stages, proposing PS-NeRF, a neural inverse rendering method based on implicit representation. It estimates per-view surface normals from multi-light images to regularize NeRF-derived normals, then jointly optimizes normals, spatially-varying BRDFs, and lights via a shadow-aware differentiable rendering layer. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show far more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 该工作在神经逆渲染与光度立体结合方面有创新，但主要面向物体级重建与材质估计，与自动驾驶感知场景关联较弱。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法PS-NeRF，联合估计多视角光度立体中的几何、材质和光照。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 利用多光照法线图正则化NeRF法线，并通过阴影感知可微渲染层联合优化法线、BRDF和光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成和真实数据集上形状重建精度远超现有MVPS和神经渲染方法，支持新视角渲染、重光照和材质编辑。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: 论文针对购物场景下多视角非模态实例分割（amodal instance segmentation）缺乏大规模基准的问题，构建了 MUVA 数据集。方法上提供了多视角同步图像与完整的非模态掩码标注，覆盖遮挡与截断目标，并给出配套评测协议与基线模型。相比已有单视角或小规模非模态数据集，MUVA 在场景复杂度、视角数量与标注完整性上有明显提升。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但基准的规模与任务设定使其可作为该方向的标准评测平台。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios by introducing MUVA. It provides synchronized multi-view images with complete amodal mask annotations covering occluded and truncated objects, together with evaluation protocols and baselines. Compared with prior single-view or small-scale amodal datasets, MUVA offers greater scene complexity and annotation completeness, serving as a standard testbed for the task.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 对多视角感知与实例分割研究者有参考价值，但偏数据集/基准贡献，方法创新有限。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 构建了购物场景下大规模多视角非模态实例分割基准 MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将非模态分割从单视角扩展到多视角购物场景并提供完整标注。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 提供了配套评测协议与基线，摘要未给出具体性能数值。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有 V2V 协同感知仅支持同构传感器、限制跨模态协作规模的问题，研究异构模态多智能体协同感知。提出 HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，可对不同数量与类型智能体协同预测 3D 目标，并设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合推理智能体间与智能体内交互以融合多视角图像与 LiDAR 点云。在 OPV2V 数据集上，HM-ViT 在 V2V 异构模态协同感知上超越 SOTA 方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hetero-modal multi-agent cooperative perception where vehicles carry different sensor modalities, which prior homogeneous V2V works cannot handle. It proposes HM-ViT, the first unified framework for hetero-modal V2V collaboration, with a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer that jointly reasons inter-agent and intra-agent interactions to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR. Experiments on OPV2V show HM-ViT outperforms state-of-the-art cooperative perception methods.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 异构模态协同感知是 V2V 的重要且现实的方向，图 Transformer 融合设计合理，实验有说服力。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多智能体异构模态 V2V 协同感知框架 HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 用异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合建模智能体间与智能体内交互以融合图像与点云。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在 OPV2V 上超越现有 SOTA 协同感知方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对域偏移导致目标检测模型在未见域性能下降的问题，指出现有域对抗学习（DAL）因单视角特性忽略了共同特征中隐含的非因果因素。提出基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含随机增强扩充源域多样性的虚假相关生成器（SCG）与将特征映射到多个潜在空间的多视角域分类器（MVDC），从而去除非因果因素、纯化域不变特征。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法从因果视角改进了域泛化检测的特征解耦。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses performance degradation of object detectors under domain shift, arguing that existing domain adversarial learning ignores insignificant non-causal factors hidden in common features due to its single-view nature. It proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) domain generalization model with a Spurious Correlations Generator for source-domain augmentation and a Multi-View Domain Classifier mapping features to multiple latent spaces to purify domain-invariant features. The causal perspective offers a principled improvement over prior DAL-based detection.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 从因果机制切入域泛化检测有新意，但摘要未提供量化结果，需看实验验证。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出多视角对抗判别器 MAD 用于域泛化目标检测。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多视角对抗训练去除共同特征中的非因果因素以纯化域不变特征。
2304.02950|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体性能数值。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对纯视觉 3D 检测因缺乏直接 3D 测量导致深度估计不准的问题，提出通过多智能体协作来改进，而非仅靠网络结构设计。提出协同纯视觉 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D，智能体间通过通信共享互补信息，并选择最具信息量的线索以优化通信效率，多视角消息可消歧单智能体深度估计并补全遮挡与远距离区域。在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%，初步结果显示纯视觉协作可超越 LiDAR。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper targets inaccurate depth estimation in camera-only 3D detection and proposes improving it via multi-agent collaboration rather than network design alone. It presents CoCa3D, a collaborative camera-only 3D detection framework where agents share complementary information through communication and select the most informative cues for efficiency; multi-view messages disambiguate depth and complement occluded and long-range regions. CoCa3D improves prior SOTA by 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ in AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 以协作通信提升纯视觉 3D 检测的思路新颖，跨三个数据集的大幅提升很有说服力。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协同纯视觉 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D，通过多智能体通信提升深度估计。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 用多视角协作消息消歧单智能体深度并优化通信线索选择。
2303.13560|v2.result: AP@70 在 DAIR-V2X/OPV2V+/CoPerception-UAVs+ 上分别提升 44.21%/30.60%/12.59%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: 论文针对多视角点云配准在低重叠与噪声条件下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出可靠的位姿图初始化与历史重加权方法。方法通过构建可靠的位姿图初始化来避免错误初始边，并利用历史重加权策略迭代优化配准结果，从而提升对离群边与噪声的鲁棒性。相比已有配准方法，该工作强调初始化可靠性与迭代重加权，摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragility of multi-view point cloud registration under low overlap and noise by proposing reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. The method constructs a reliable pose graph initialization to avoid erroneous initial edges and applies history reweighting to iteratively refine registration, improving robustness to outlier edges and noise. It emphasizes initialization reliability and iterative reweighting over prior registration approaches, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 点云配准与自动驾驶感知相关但非核心，方法思路合理，需实验数据支撑。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权的鲁棒多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 结合可靠初始化与历史重加权提升配准对离群与噪声的鲁棒性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 摘要未给出具体性能数值。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: 论文针对纯视觉自动驾驶中感知与预测联合建模缺乏时序多尺度 BEV 表示的问题，提出 TBP-Former。方法学习时序鸟瞰图金字塔（Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid），在 BEV 空间构建多尺度时序特征以同时支持目标感知与未来轨迹预测。相比已有单帧或单尺度 BEV 方法，该框架通过时序金字塔增强了对动态场景的建模能力，摘要未给出具体数值结果。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of temporal multi-scale BEV representations for joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving by proposing TBP-Former. It learns a Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid that builds multi-scale temporal BEV features to support both object perception and future trajectory prediction. Compared with prior single-frame or single-scale BEV methods, the temporal pyramid better models dynamic scenes, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 时序 BEV 金字塔用于感知-预测联合是纯视觉自动驾驶的合理且有前景的方向。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出 TBP-Former，学习时序 BEV 金字塔用于联合感知与预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 在 BEV 空间构建多尺度时序特征以统一感知与轨迹预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 摘要未给出具体性能数值。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角输入进行3D-4D视图合成的问题，提出神经像素合成方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节，但从标题推断其利用神经渲染技术实现多视角到3D/4D场景的合成。相比已有工作，可能改进了视图合成的连续性和时空一致性。具体效果数据未知。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-view inputs via neural pixel composition. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The work likely improves spatio-temporal consistency in view synthesis compared to prior approaches.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知中的新视角合成和场景重建相关，但摘要缺失导致无法深入评估其技术贡献。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出了一种基于神经像素合成的多视角3D-4D视图合成框架。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将神经像素合成扩展到多视角时空视图生成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）中样本缺失导致聚类性能下降的问题，提出跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号构建视图间实例对应关系，并解决原型偏移问题。相比现有对比学习方法，避免强制跨视图表示完全一致，保留了视图差异性和表示灵活性。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) where missing samples degrade performance. It proposes CPSPAN, which uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and addresses prototype misalignment. Unlike contrastive methods that force identical cross-view representations, it preserves view discrepancy and flexibility. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但其中跨视图对齐思路对多传感器融合有一定参考价值。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出CPSPAN网络，通过成对观测对齐和原型对齐解决不完整多视图聚类问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 用成对观测数据对齐替代强制跨视图一致性约束，并处理原型偏移。
2303.15689|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景中多帧深度估计因多视图几何一致性被破坏而精度下降的问题，提出学习融合单目与多视图线索的方法。方法将多视图和单目线索编码为代价体，通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块实现静态区域几何信息向动态区域单目表示的传播，以及单目线索对多视图代价体表示的增强，无需启发式掩码。相比依赖显式动态掩码的方法，避免了掩码质量不可控和线索融合不充分的问题。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-frame depth estimation in dynamic scenes where multi-view geometric consistency is violated. It proposes encoding multi-view and monocular cues as volumes and fusing them via a cross-cue fusion (CCF) module, enabling geometric information from static areas to propagate to monocular representations in dynamic areas without heuristic masks. This avoids the limitations of mask quality and underutilized cue fusion in prior methods. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 直接面向自动驾驶动态场景的深度估计，跨线索融合思路对多传感器BEV感知有借鉴意义，值得关注。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出跨线索融合模块，实现多视图与单目线索在代价体层面的自适应融合。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 无需动态掩码，通过代价体编码和跨线索传播实现静态几何与动态上下文的互补。
2304.08993|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市多层级多视角理解缺乏统一数据集的问题，构建了OmniCity数据集。数据集包含多视角卫星图像、街景全景图和单视图图像，覆盖纽约市25K地理位置的超过100K像素级标注图像，并提出利用卫星标签图和跨视角变换关系的街景标注流水线以降低标注成本。相比现有基准，OmniCity图像数量更多、标注类型更丰富、视角更多样，并引入了街景全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。提供了多种任务的基准测试结果。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OmniCity, a dataset for omnipotent city understanding from multi-level and multi-view images, containing over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K geo-locations in New York City. It proposes an efficient street-view annotation pipeline leveraging satellite label maps and cross-view transformations. Compared to existing benchmarks, OmniCity offers more images, richer annotations, more views, and introduces a novel fine-grained building instance segmentation task on street-level panoramas, with benchmark results for multiple tasks.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 大规模多层级多视角城市理解数据集，对自动驾驶场景理解和跨视角感知研究有重要价值。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建了OmniCity多层级多视角城市理解数据集及配套标注流水线。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星-街景跨视角变换实现高效标注，并引入全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 包含100K+像素级标注图像，覆盖25K地理位置，提供多任务基准结果。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D表面重建缺乏多传感器多模态大规模数据集的问题，构建了一个新的多传感器数据集。数据集包含来自智能手机、Intel RealSense、Microsoft Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪的配准RGB和深度数据，涵盖107个场景、约140万张图像、100个视角方向和14种光照条件，场景选择强调对现有算法具有挑战性的多样材质属性。该数据集可用于3D重建算法的评估和训练。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a multi-sensor large-scale dataset for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction, including registered RGB and depth data from smartphones, RealSense, Kinect, industrial cameras, and structured-light scanners. It contains ~1.4M images of 107 scenes from 100 viewing directions under 14 lighting conditions, with scenes emphasizing diverse material properties challenging for existing algorithms. The dataset supports evaluation and training of 3D reconstruction methods.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 多传感器3D重建数据集，对自动驾驶中的深度估计和三维重建研究有数据支撑价值，但任务本身与感知检测关联有限。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 发布了包含多传感器配准RGB-D数据的大规模多视图3D重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 覆盖多分辨率、多模态传感器和多样材质场景，提供丰富的光照和视角变化。
2203.06111|v2.result: 包含约140万张图像、107个场景、100个视角和14种光照条件。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多视图聚类方法在视图级聚合时忽略所有样本结构关系的问题，提出全局与跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，充分利用相似样本的互补性，并采用结构引导对比学习模块对齐共识表示与视图特定表示，使结构关系强的不同样本的视图特定表示趋于相似。该模块可灵活嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of view-wise aggregation in multi-view clustering that ignores structural relationships among all samples. It proposes GCFAggMVC, which obtains consensus representations via cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation, and aligns consensus and view-specific representations through structure-guided contrastive learning. The module is flexible and can be plugged into incomplete multi-view clustering. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但跨视图聚合和对比对齐思路对多传感器特征融合有间接参考价值。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出GCFAggMVC网络，通过全局跨视图特征聚合和结构引导对比学习实现多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 跨样本跨视图聚合共识表示，并用结构引导对比学习对齐视图特定表示。
2305.06799|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场重建质量受限的问题，提出将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化进行交叉引导的联合框架。方法上通过超分辨率分支与辐射场分支相互提供监督信号，在优化过程中迭代提升纹理细节与几何一致性。相比先超分再重建或先重建再超分的串行方案，该工作强调两个任务的耦合优化。摘要未给出具体量化指标，效果需参考正文实验。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses high-resolution novel view synthesis by jointly optimizing radiance fields and multi-view image super-resolution in a cross-guided manner. The two branches mutually provide supervision, improving texture detail and geometric consistency compared with serial pipelines. Quantitative results are not stated in the abstract.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 属于神经渲染与超分交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，但对高分辨率重建有一定参考价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出辐射场与多视角超分辨率的交叉引导联合优化框架。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 将超分与辐射场优化从串行解耦改为双向交叉引导。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，需查阅正文验证提升幅度。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角手部网格重建中3D几何信息被压缩到2D特征而损失的问题，提出POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上进行重建。方法设计了基于点的特征融合与跨集合点注意力机制，使一组3D点携带多视角图像特征并环绕手部，从而表示复杂手部网格。相比以往将3D信息编码进2D特征的做法，POEM在三个挑战性多视角数据集上超越现有最优方法。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hand mesh reconstruction from multi-view stereo, where prior methods compress 3D information into 2D features. POEM directly operates on 3D points embedded in the multi-view stereo, using point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention to represent the hand mesh. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three challenging multi-view datasets.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 点云式多视角特征融合思路对多相机3D感知有借鉴意义，但应用场景为手部重建，与自动驾驶直接相关性有限。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上进行手部网格重建的POEM方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 用携带多视角特征的3D点集合表示手部网格，并设计跨集合点注意力。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个多视角数据集上超越现有最优方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对无纹理区域导致多视角立体匹配失败的问题，提出自适应块变形策略以提升无纹理场景下的重建鲁棒性。方法通过自适应调整匹配块的形状与采样方式，缓解弱纹理区域匹配代价不具区分性的问题。相比固定窗口或固定形状的块匹配方法，该工作强调块形状随局部几何与纹理自适应变化。摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view stereo failure in textureless regions by proposing adaptive patch deformation. The matching patch shape and sampling are adaptively adjusted to improve cost discriminability in weakly textured areas, in contrast to fixed-window or fixed-shape matching. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 属于传统多视角立体几何方向，与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联较弱，但无纹理鲁棒性思路对深度估计有一定启发。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出面向无纹理场景的自适应块变形多视角立体匹配方法。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 让匹配块形状随局部纹理与几何自适应变形以增强代价区分度。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，需查阅正文验证。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离、难以端到端联合优化的问题，本文提出ADA-Track，将检测与数据关联交替进行并统一到端到端框架中。方法通过交替执行检测与关联模块，使两者相互提供特征与位置先验，从而在遮挡与截断场景下提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比传统两阶段跟踪器，该方法在nuScenes跟踪基准上显著降低AMOTA误差并减少ID切换，达到当时领先水平。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between detection and association in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking by proposing ADA-Track, an end-to-end framework that alternates detection and association. The alternating design lets each module supply priors to the other, improving robustness under occlusion and truncation. It achieves state-of-the-art AMOTA on nuScenes tracking benchmarks with fewer identity switches than two-stage baselines.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 面向自动驾驶多相机3D MOT的端到端方案，交替检测-关联思路新颖，实验扎实，值得跟踪领域研究者关注。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架ADA-Track。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 将检测与数据关联从串行两阶段改为交替迭代、相互提供先验的联合优化。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得领先AMOTA并显著减少ID切换。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像进行室内3D目标检测时深度估计不准、体素特征聚合粗糙的问题，本文提出CN-RMA，结合网络与光线步进（ray marching）聚合来构建3D特征。方法利用ray marching沿相机光线采样并聚合多视角特征，替代传统体素化或BEV投影，从而更精确地定位室内物体。在ScanNet等室内3D检测基准上，该方法相比基于体素或BEV的基线取得更高的mAP，验证了光线聚合的有效性。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: This paper tackles inaccurate depth and coarse feature aggregation in multi-view indoor 3D object detection by proposing CN-RMA, which combines a detection network with ray marching aggregation. Instead of voxelization or BEV projection, it samples and aggregates multi-view features along camera rays for more precise localization. Experiments on indoor benchmarks such as ScanNet show improved mAP over voxel- and BEV-based baselines.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 将ray marching引入多视角室内3D检测，思路有一定新意，但领域偏室内，与自动驾驶室外场景相关度中等。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出结合光线步进聚合的多视角室内3D目标检测网络CN-RMA。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 用ray marching沿光线聚合多视角特征替代传统体素化/BEV投影。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在ScanNet等室内3D检测基准上mAP优于体素与BEV基线。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: 针对无参考点云质量评估（NR-PCQA）中标注数据稀缺、单一视角特征不足的问题，本文提出多视角融合的对比预训练框架。方法通过多视角投影与对比学习预训练编码器，再微调用于质量分数回归，从而在少量标注下获得更鲁棒的质量表征。在多个点云质量数据集上，该方法相比从头训练和单视角基线取得更高的PLCC/SROCC相关性。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This paper addresses scarce labels and limited single-view features in no-reference point cloud quality assessment by proposing a multi-view fusion contrastive pre-training framework. It pre-trains encoders via multi-view projection and contrastive learning, then fine-tunes for quality regression. On several PCQA datasets it achieves higher PLCC/SROCC than from-scratch and single-view baselines.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 属于点云质量评估方向，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，方法常规，参考价值有限。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出面向无参考点云质量评估的多视角融合对比预训练方法。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 将多视角对比预训练引入点云质量评估以缓解标注稀缺。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在多个PCQA数据集上PLCC/SROCC优于单视角与从头训练基线。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: 针对帕金森病运动症状评估依赖主观量表、缺乏客观量化的问题，本文提出TULIP多相机3D精确评估系统。方法用多相机采集患者运动并进行3D重建与关键点跟踪，从中提取运动学指标用于疾病严重度评分。实验表明该系统提取的3D运动特征与临床UPDRS评分具有良好相关性，为客观评估提供了新手段。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: This paper targets subjective rating scales in Parkinson's disease assessment by proposing TULIP, a multi-camera 3D precision assessment system. It reconstructs patient motion from multiple cameras and tracks keypoints to extract kinematic biomarkers correlated with clinical severity. Results show good correlation between the extracted 3D motion features and UPDRS scores.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 属医学多相机3D应用，方法偏工程，与自动驾驶感知研究相关度低。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出用于帕金森病客观评估的多相机3D运动分析系统TULIP。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 将多相机3D重建与关键点跟踪用于临床运动症状量化。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 提取的3D运动特征与UPDRS临床评分呈现良好相关性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: 针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖大量3D标注的问题，本文提出自监督框架SelfPose3d。方法利用多视角几何一致性构造自监督信号，在无3D真值情况下训练多人3D姿态估计网络，并处理遮挡与人物匹配。在Human3.6M等基准上，该方法在无3D标注设定下接近甚至超过部分弱监督方法，显著降低标注成本。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy 3D annotation requirement in multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing SelfPose3d, a self-supervised framework. It exploits multi-view geometric consistency as supervision to train the network without 3D ground truth while handling occlusion and person matching. On benchmarks such as Human3.6M it approaches or surpasses some weakly supervised methods without 3D labels.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角3D姿态估计思路清晰，几何一致性利用得当，对多视角感知研究者有借鉴意义。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出无需3D标注的多视角多人3D姿态估计自监督框架SelfPose3d。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性构造自监督信号替代3D真值监督。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在Human3.6M等基准上无3D标注下接近弱监督方法性能。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: 针对实际多视角场景中视图噪声导致自监督聚类性能下降的问题，本文系统研究了噪声视图的副作用并提出缓解方法。作者分析噪声视图如何破坏视图一致性与聚类结构，进而设计鲁棒的视图加权与一致性约束来抑制噪声影响。在多个多视角聚类基准上，所提方法在含噪视图设定下相比标准自监督聚类取得更稳定的聚类精度。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in practical multi-view self-supervised clustering and proposes mitigation strategies. It analyzes how noisy views corrupt view consistency and cluster structure, then designs robust view weighting and consistency constraints. On several multi-view clustering benchmarks the method yields more stable accuracy under noisy-view settings than standard self-supervised clustering.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 属多视角自监督聚类方向，与自动驾驶感知主线关联弱，方法分析有一定价值但参考面窄。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统分析并缓解多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 提出鲁棒视图加权与一致性约束以抑制噪声视图影响。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在含噪视图的多视角聚类基准上取得更稳定的聚类精度。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督的两个问题：LiDAR点云深度仅分布在物体表面，缺乏3D物体中心的深度信息，且远距离物体细粒度深度估计困难。提出OPEN检测器，通过object-wise depth encoder以像素级深度图为先验估计物体级深度，并设计object-wise position embedding将物体深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比已有像素级深度监督方法，显式建模物体级深度更契合DETR类检测器需求。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但方法在深度监督范式上有明显改进。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in multi-view 3D detection with pixel-wise depth supervision: LiDAR depth only lies on object surfaces lacking 3D center depth, and fine-grained depth for distant objects is hard to estimate. It proposes OPEN, which uses an object-wise depth encoder taking pixel-wise depth maps as prior to estimate object-wise depth, and an object-wise position embedding to inject this depth into the transformer decoder. Unlike prior pixel-wise supervision, it explicitly models object-level depth, better matching DETR-based detectors, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该工作切中多视角3D检测中深度监督的关键痛点，object-wise position embedding思路清晰，对BEV/多相机感知方向有较强参考价值。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出object-wise position embedding，将物体级深度信息有效注入多视角3D检测的Transformer解码器。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 用物体级深度替代像素级深度监督，并设计专用位置编码适配DETR类3D检测器。
2407.10753|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在深度监督范式上优于现有像素级方法。

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: 该论文标题为AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion，但提供的摘要为空，无法获取具体问题、方法、改进点和实验数据。从标题推测，工作聚焦于点云补全任务，提出自适应嵌入与多视角感知解耦方法。该方向与自动驾驶3D检测有一定关联，但更偏向点云生成与补全，与用户核心研究领域相关度较低。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: The paper is titled 'AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion', but the abstract is empty, so the problem, method, improvements, and results cannot be assessed. 2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在核心视觉感知能力上缺乏系统评估的问题，提出Blink基准，将14类经典计算机视觉任务（如相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测、多视角推理）重构为3,807道多选题，配以单/多图和视觉提示。实验发现人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%，表明这些感知能力尚未在多模态LLM中涌现。分析还指出专用CV模型表现更好，为未来改进指明方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: To systematically evaluate core visual perception abilities missing in prior benchmarks, this paper introduces Blink, which reformats 14 classic CV tasks (e.g., relative depth estimation, visual correspondence, forensics detection, multi-view reasoning) into 3,807 multiple-choice questions with single/multiple images and visual prompting. Humans average 95.70% accuracy, while the best GPT-4V and Gemini achieve only 51.26% and 45.72%, just 13.17% and 7.63% above random guessing, showing such perception abilities have not emerged in multimodal LLMs. Analysis also shows specialist CV models perform much better, suggesting future improvement pathways.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: Blink揭示了当前多模态LLM在基础视觉感知上的显著短板，对VLM与自动驾驶感知交叉方向有重要参考价值，基准设计严谨。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 构建了聚焦核心视觉感知能力的多模态LLM基准Blink，包含14类任务、3,807道多选题。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 将经典CV感知任务重构为视觉提示下的多选题，系统暴露多模态LLM的感知缺陷。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类准确率95.70%，GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅略高于随机猜测。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 针对微小目标异常检测缺乏大规模多视角与视觉-文本联合基准的问题，作者构建了MANTA数据集：包含38个类别、137.3K张图像（其中8.6K张有像素级异常标注），每张图像从5个视角采集，并配套875词的声明性知识（含what/why/how解释）与2K道多难度选择题的建构性学习子集。作者还提出了视觉-文本任务基线并在多种设置下进行广泛基准测试。该工作填补了微小目标异常检测中多视角与语言监督结合的空白，实验揭示了现有先进方法在该数据集上的挑战性。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces MANTA, a large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection dataset for tiny objects, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories with 8.6K pixel-level anomalous annotations captured from five viewpoints. It also provides declarative knowledge (875 words) and constructivist learning (2K multiple-choice questions) text subsets, along with a visual-text baseline and extensive benchmarking. The dataset highlights challenges for advanced methods in tiny-object anomaly detection under multi-view and language supervision.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集为微小目标异常检测提供了多视角与视觉-文本联合标注的新基准，对开放集检测和多模态理解有参考价值，但任务本身与自动驾驶BEV/3D感知的直接关联有限。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向微小目标的多视角视觉-文本异常检测大规模数据集MANTA，并提供基线评测。
2412.04867|v2.innovation: 将多视角采集与声明性/建构性文本知识结合，用于微小目标异常检测。
2412.04867|v2.result: 数据集含137.3K图像、8.6K像素级异常标注、875词知识及2K选择题，基准实验揭示了现有方法的不足。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中解空间大导致结果不理想、以及获取图像与部分点云配对数据困难的问题，作者提出PCDreamer，利用大模型中的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视角图像，编码全局与局部形状线索。设计了形状融合模块从图像和点云多模态输入生成初始完整形状，并引入形状巩固模块丢弃扩散先验不一致导致的不可靠点。实验表明该方法在恢复精细细节方面具有优越性能。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: To address the large solution space in point cloud completion and the difficulty of obtaining paired image-partial point cloud data, PCDreamer leverages multi-view diffusion priors from large models to generate novel views encoding global and local shape cues. A shape fusion module produces an initial complete shape from multi-modal inputs, and a shape consolidation module removes unreliable points from diffusion inconsistencies. Experiments demonstrate superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 该工作将扩散先验引入点云补全，思路新颖，但任务本身（点云补全）与自动驾驶感知的核心检测/跟踪任务关联较弱，更多属于3D生成与重建方向。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视角扩散先验进行点云补全的PCDreamer框架。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 设计形状融合与形状巩固模块，有效利用扩散先验并处理其不一致性。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在点云补全任务上取得优越性能，尤其在恢复精细细节方面表现突出。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本到3D生成中多视角重建方法易产生几何伪影、而原生3D生成模型分辨率受限导致质量低的问题，作者提出Sharp-It，一个多视角到多视角的扩散模型。该方法接收从低质量物体渲染的3D一致多视角图像，通过并行处理并在生成视角间共享特征，丰富其几何细节与纹理，从而重建高质量3D模型。该工作弥合了直接生成3D表征与从多视角图像重建3D物体之间的质量差距。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: To bridge the quality gap between direct 3D generative models and multi-view reconstruction approaches, Sharp-It is a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that takes 3D-consistent multi-view images rendered from a low-quality object and enriches geometric details and texture. It operates on the multi-view set in parallel with shared features across generated views, enabling high-quality 3D reconstruction. The method addresses geometric artifacts and limited controllability in prior approaches.

2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视角到多视角扩散模型Sharp-It，用于3D合成与操控。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 在多视角扩散中并行处理并跨视角共享特征，提升3D几何细节与纹理质量。
2412.02631|v2.result: 弥合了直接3D生成与多视角重建方法之间的质量差距，可重建高质量3D模型。

2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在人脸感知能力上缺乏系统评测基准的问题，作者构建了 FaceBench——一个包含五视角、最多三级属性、超过 210 个属性与 700 个属性值的层次化人脸属性 VQA 数据集，含 49,919 个评测对与 23,841 个微调对。基于该数据训练了 Face-LLaVA 基线模型，并与主流 MLLM 及人类表现进行对比。结果显示现有 MLLM 在细粒度人脸属性理解上远未令人满意，而 Face-LLaVA 显著优于对比模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view, multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset (49,919 evaluation and 23,841 fine-tuning pairs, 210+ attributes) to benchmark face perception in MLLMs. A Face-LLaVA baseline is trained on the proposed data and compared against mainstream MLLMs and human performance. Results show existing MLLMs struggle with fine-grained facial attributes, while Face-LLaVA substantially outperforms them.
