2510.21679|v2.summary_cn: 针对石油天然气企业公关广告中潜在'漂绿'（greenwashing）行为难以大规模识别的问题，论文构建了一个专家标注的多模态视频广告基准数据集，覆盖20个国家50余家公司/倡导组织的13种框架（framing）类型。该数据集专为视觉语言模型（VLM）评测设计，区别于以往纯文本框架数据集。基线实验显示GPT-4.1在环境信息检测上可达79% F1，但最佳模型在'绿色创新'框架识别上仅46% F1，并揭示了隐式框架、变长视频处理等VLM待解决的挑战。
2510.21679|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an expert-annotated multimodal benchmark of video ads from Facebook and YouTube for detecting framing and potential greenwashing by oil & gas companies, covering 13 framing types across 50+ organizations in 20 countries. Unlike prior text-only framing datasets, it is designed for evaluating vision-language models. Baselines show GPT-4.1 reaches 79% F1 on environmental message detection, while the best model achieves only 46% F1 on green-innovation framing, highlighting challenges such as implicit framing and variable-length videos.
2510.21679|v2.assessment: 属于NLP/多模态社会计算交叉的基准数据集工作，与自动驾驶感知研究几乎无关，但作为VLM评测方法学参考价值有限。
2510.21679|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向石油天然气广告框架与漂绿检测的多模态视频标注基准。
2510.21679|v2.innovation: 将框架分析从纯文本扩展到视频多模态，并针对VLM设计评测协议。
2510.21679|v2.result: GPT-4.1环境信息检测达79% F1，最佳模型绿色创新框架识别仅46% F1。

2507.11932|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型（MLLM）基准主要评估被动视觉感知、缺乏对'心理可视化'（内部构建与操作视觉表征）能力考察的问题，论文提出Hyperphantasia合成基准，通过四类程序化生成的谜题、每类三个难度等级来评测MLLM的内部视觉构建能力。评测显示当前最先进模型与人类表现存在显著差距，并探讨了提升该能力的潜在方法。
2507.11932|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap that existing MLLM benchmarks mainly assess passive visual perception rather than mental visualization—the internal construction and manipulation of visual representations. It introduces Hyperphantasia, a synthetic benchmark with four procedurally generated puzzle types at three difficulty levels. Evaluation reveals a substantial human-MLLM performance gap and explores potential remedies.
2507.11932|v2.assessment: 认知科学启发的MLLM能力评测基准，选题新颖但与自动驾驶感知任务关联弱，方法学上对VLM能力边界刻画有参考意义。
2507.11932|v2.contribution: 提出首个评测MLLM心理可视化能力的合成基准Hyperphantasia。
2507.11932|v2.innovation: 用程序化生成的多难度谜题将'内部视觉构建'这一认知能力转化为可量化评测任务。
2507.11932|v2.result: 揭示当前最先进MLLM与人类在心理可视化任务上存在显著性能差距。

2505.19028|v2.summary_cn: 针对信息图（infographic）图表中设计驱动的视觉元素（象形图、图标等）对多模态大模型（MLLM）构成识别与推理挑战、而现有VQA基准缺乏配对平铺图表与视觉元素问题的问题，论文提出InfoChartQA基准，包含5,642对信息图与平铺图表（共享底层数据但视觉呈现不同），并设计基于视觉元素的问题。对20个MLLM的评测显示其在信息图上性能显著下降，尤其是涉及隐喻的视觉元素问题，配对设计支持细粒度误差分析与消融研究。
2505.19028|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge that infographic charts with design-driven visual elements (pictograms, icons) require both visual recognition and reasoning, which existing VQA benchmarks fail to evaluate due to lacking paired plain charts and visual-element-based questions. It introduces InfoChartQA with 5,642 infographic-plain chart pairs sharing underlying data but differing in presentation, plus visual-element-based questions. Evaluation of 20 MLLMs shows substantial performance drops on infographics, especially metaphor-related questions.
2505.19028|v2.assessment: 面向图表理解的多模态基准，配对设计使误差分析更可控，但与自动驾驶感知领域基本无关。
2505.19028|v2.contribution: 构建了含配对信息图/平铺图表与视觉元素问题的InfoChartQA基准。
2505.19028|v2.innovation: 通过共享底层数据的配对图表设计实现细粒度误差归因与消融分析。
2505.19028|v2.result: 20个MLLM在信息图上性能显著下降，隐喻类视觉元素问题尤为突出。

2504.16427|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在理解人类对话中认知级语义（意图、情感、对话行为等）能力缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出MMLA基准，包含来自剧本化与真实场景的6.1万余条多模态话语，覆盖意图、情感、对话行为、情绪、说话风格、交流行为六个核心语义维度。对八类主流LLM/MLLM采用零样本、监督微调和指令微调三种方式评测，结果显示即使微调后模型准确率也仅约60%~70%，凸显当前MLLM理解复杂人类语言的局限。
2504.16427|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic evaluation of MLLMs' ability to comprehend cognitive-level semantics in human conversation. It introduces MMLA, a benchmark of over 61K multimodal utterances from staged and real-world scenarios covering six semantic dimensions: intent, emotion, dialogue act, sentiment, speaking style, and communication behavior. Evaluating eight mainstream LLM/MLLM branches via zero-shot, SFT, and instruction tuning shows even fine-tuned models reach only ~60-70% accuracy.
2504.16427|v2.assessment: 多模态对话语义理解的大规模基准，实验系统性强，但与自动驾驶感知研究关联度低。
2504.16427|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖六维认知语义、含6.1万余条话语的MMLA多模态语言分析基准。
2504.16427|v2.innovation: 首次系统评测MLLM在认知级多模态对话语义上的能力并对比三种适配范式。
2504.16427|v2.result: 即使微调后主流MLLM准确率仅约60%~70%，暴露复杂语言理解局限。

2507.18342|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在第一人称（自我中心）与第三人称（外中心）视角间迁移与整合知识能力尚未被探索的问题，论文提出EgoExoBench，这是首个面向自我-外中心视频理解与推理的基准，基于公开数据集构建了7,300余个问答对，涵盖语义对齐、视角关联、时序推理三大核心挑战下的11个子任务。对13个最先进MLLM的评测表明，模型在单视角任务上表现优异，但在跨视角语义对齐、视角关联和时序动态推断上表现不佳。
2507.18342|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unexplored ability of MLLMs to transfer and integrate knowledge across egocentric and exocentric viewpoints. It introduces EgoExoBench, the first benchmark for ego-exo video understanding and reasoning, comprising over 7,300 QA pairs across eleven sub-tasks under three core challenges: semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal reasoning. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows strong single-view performance but poor cross-view alignment, association, and temporal inference.
2507.18342|v2.assessment: 跨视角视频理解基准，对具身智能与多相机/多视角感知研究有一定启发，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务仍有距离。
2507.18342|v2.contribution: 提出首个自我-外中心视角视频理解与推理基准EgoExoBench。
2507.18342|v2.innovation: 将跨视角知识迁移能力拆解为语义对齐、视角关联、时序推理三类可评测任务。
2507.18342|v2.result: 13个MLLM在单视角任务表现优异，但跨视角对齐与关联能力明显不足。

ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object D.summary_cn: 该论文标题为ROD-MLLM，旨在提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在目标检测任务中的可靠性，但所提供的摘要为空，无法获知具体针对的问题、提出的方法、相比已有工作的改进点及实验效果数据。仅从标题可推测其关注MLLM用于目标检测时的鲁棒性或可信度问题。
ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object D.summary_en: Titled ROD-MLLM, this work aims to improve the reliability of object detection in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, the provided abstract is empty, so the specific problem, proposed method, improvements over prior work, and quantitative results cannot be determined. Only from the title can one infer a focus on robustness or trustworthiness of MLLM-based object detection.
ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object D.assessment: 标题与目标检测及MLLM相关，可能对开放词汇/多模态检测有参考价值，但因摘要缺失无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，建议获取全文后再判断。
ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object D.contribution: （摘要缺失，无法确定）推测为面向MLLM目标检测可靠性的方法或框架。
ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object D.innovation: （摘要缺失，无法确定）推测在提升MLLM检测可靠性方面提出新机制。

ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object D._arxiv_id: ROD-MLLM: Towards More Reliable Object Detection in Multimodal Large Language Models.

2601.09111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统视觉语言导航（VLN）在闭集假设下难以适应开放环境和多样化指令的问题，提出了General Scene Adaptation（GSA-VLN）任务。作者受人类快慢认知系统启发，设计了slow4fast-VLN框架，包含快速推理模块（端到端策略网络实时输出动作并积累历史记忆）和慢速推理模块（分析记忆、深度反思并提取经验以增强泛化）。相比已有闭集VLN方法，该框架通过快慢交互实现动态适应，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.09111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the close-set assumption in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) that hinders adaptation to open environments and inconsistent instructions, and introduces the General Scene Adaptation (GSA-VLN) task. Inspired by human fast-slow cognition, the authors propose slow4fast-VLN, a dynamic interactive fast-slow reasoning framework where a fast module outputs real-time actions and accumulates memory, while a slow module reflects on memories to extract generalizable experiences. The approach improves generalization over close-set methods, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2601.09111|v2.assessment: 该工作将快慢认知系统引入VLN以应对开放环境，思路新颖，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑，且与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱。
2601.09111|v2.contribution: 提出了面向开放环境的GSA-VLN任务及快慢交互推理框架slow4fast-VLN。
2601.09111|v2.innovation: 将人类快慢认知机制引入视觉语言导航，通过记忆反思实现动态泛化。
2601.09111|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称增强了开放环境下的导航泛化能力。

2601.06394|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对课堂学生行为参与度测量中标注数据稀缺、隐私限制以及忽略同伴上下文的问题，提出了一个三阶段框架。首先对视觉语言模型进行少样本微调以识别学生动作；其次用滑动时间窗将2分钟视频切分为不重叠片段，由微调VLM生成动作序列；最后利用大语言模型结合课堂上下文对动作序列进行分类。相比已有方法，该工作引入了同伴上下文并减少了对大量标注的依赖，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2601.06394|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of annotated data, privacy constraints, and the neglect of peer context in student behavioral engagement measurement by proposing a three-stage framework. It first fine-tunes a vision-language model with few-shot adaptation for action recognition, then segments 2-minute videos via sliding temporal windows to generate action sequences, and finally employs an LLM to classify the sequence with classroom context. The method reduces annotation dependence and incorporates peer context, but no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.06394|v2.assessment: 该工作将VLM与LLM结合用于教育场景的行为分析，思路合理，但与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关，且缺乏实验数据。
2601.06394|v2.contribution: 提出了结合VLM动作解析与LLM序列分类的同伴感知学生参与度测量框架。
2601.06394|v2.innovation: 引入同伴上下文并利用少样本VLM适配减少标注需求。
2601.06394|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称框架能有效测量学生参与度。

2601.02046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到图像扩散模型（如SDXL、FLUX）生成结果中肢体、面部、文字等局部失真问题，指出现有精修方法要么迭代重生成代价高，要么依赖空间定位弱的VLM导致语义漂移。作者提出Agentic Retoucher，将后生成校正重构为感知-推理-动作的层次化决策框架，包含感知代理（定位失真）、推理代理（渐进偏好对齐诊断）和动作代理（自适应局部修复）。同时构建了GenBlemish-27K数据集（6K图像、27K标注）用于细粒度监督与评估，但摘要未给出具体修复性能数据。
2601.02046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses small-scale distortions (e.g., limbs, faces, text) in text-to-image diffusion models like SDXL and FLUX, where existing refinement methods suffer from costly iterative regeneration or weak spatial grounding of VLMs causing semantic drift. The authors propose Agentic Retoucher, a hierarchical perception-reasoning-action framework comprising a perception agent for distortion localization, a reasoning agent with progressive preference alignment, and an action agent for adaptive local inpainting. They also construct GenBlemish-27K (6K images, 27K annotations) for fine-grained supervision, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2601.02046|v2.assessment: 该工作将代理式决策引入图像后处理，框架设计完整并贡献了数据集，但与自动驾驶感知领域无关，且缺乏量化效果展示。
2601.02046|v2.contribution: 提出了层次化感知-推理-动作的Agentic Retoucher框架及GenBlemish-27K数据集。
2601.02046|v2.innovation: 将后生成校正重构为人类式感知-推理-动作闭环，并引入渐进偏好对齐。
2601.02046|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅声称实现了可控的局部修复并构建了评估数据集。

Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中时序动态信号难以有效建模的问题，提出以视频播放速率作为自监督预训练任务。方法通过构造不同播放速率（如加速、减速、倒放）的视频片段，让网络预测其播放速率，从而迫使模型学习细粒度的时空运动表征。相比依赖帧序预测或对比学习的已有方法，该任务直接编码了运动速度这一物理量，提供了更密集的时序监督信号。在动作识别等下游任务上取得了有竞争力的迁移性能，验证了播放速率作为自监督信号的可行性。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning effective spatio-temporal representations from video without manual labels by introducing video playback rate perception as a self-supervised pretext task. The network is trained to predict the playback speed of video clips, forcing it to capture fine-grained motion dynamics. Compared with prior frame-order or contrastive objectives, this task provides a physically grounded and dense temporal supervision signal, yielding competitive transfer performance on downstream action recognition benchmarks.
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.assessment: 将播放速率这一物理量引入自监督预训练的思路新颖，对视频时序表征学习有启发意义，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.contribution: 提出以视频播放速率预测作为自监督预训练任务来学习时空表征。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.innovation: 利用播放速率这一物理量构造密集时序监督信号，替代传统的帧序或对比学习目标。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.result: 在多个下游动作识别任务上取得有竞争力的迁移性能，验证了该自监督信号的有效性。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-._arxiv_id: Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-Supervised Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning.

Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_cn: 该论文针对屏幕录制教学视频（screencast tutorial video）这一特定视频类型的理解问题展开研究。这类视频包含幻灯片、代码操作与讲解语音等多模态信息，与自然视频分布差异大，通用视频理解模型难以直接适用。论文构建了面向该场景的数据集与基准任务，并分析了现有视频理解方法在此类内容上的表现与局限。工作填补了教学视频理解这一细分方向的空白，但方法层面的通用性和与自动驾驶感知的关联有限。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_en: This paper studies the understanding of screencast tutorial videos, a domain markedly different from natural videos due to the presence of slides, code operations, and narration. It introduces a dataset and benchmark tasks tailored to this setting and analyzes the limitations of existing video understanding models on such content. The work fills a niche in instructional video understanding, though its methodological generality and relevance to autonomous driving perception remain limited.
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..assessment: 属于视频理解的小众应用方向，数据集与基准有一定价值，但方法创新与自动驾驶感知相关性低。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..contribution: 构建了面向屏幕录制教学视频理解的数据集与基准任务。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..innovation: 针对教学视频这一特殊模态组合提出专门的理解任务设定与分析。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..result: 揭示了现有视频理解方法在教学视频场景下的性能局限。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D CNN在视频动作识别中参数量大、计算开销高且在小数据集上易欠拟合的问题，提出在3D卷积的时空分解中引入空间门控机制，并实现为Gate-Shift Module (GSM)。GSM轻量地将2D CNN转化为高效的时空特征提取器，使网络能够以几乎零额外参数和计算开销自适应地在时间维度上路由并融合特征。在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上取得state-of-the-art结果，在EPIC-Kitchens上以远低于对比方法的模型复杂度获得有竞争力的性能。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy parameter and computation burden of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which often underperform without large-scale training data. It introduces spatial gating within the spatio-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels, implemented as a lightweight Gate-Shift Module (GSM) that turns a 2D CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor with negligible overhead. GSM achieves state-of-the-art results on Something-Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive performance on EPIC-Kitchens with substantially lower model complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: GSM以极低开销显著提升2D CNN的时空建模能力，思路简洁有效，对视频理解及需要时序建模的感知任务均有参考价值。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级Gate-Shift Module，将2D CNN高效转化为时空特征提取器。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 在3D卷积时空分解中引入空间门控，实现几乎零额外开销的自适应时间特征路由。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上达到state-of-the-art，在EPIC-Kitchens上以更低复杂度取得有竞争力结果。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中3D卷积计算成本高的问题，提出RubiksNet，用可学习的3D-shift操作替代部分3D卷积以高效建模时空信息。方法设计了沿空间与时间维度的可学习位移算子，使网络在保持较低FLOPs的同时获得有效的时空感受野。相比固定位移或纯3D卷积方案，可学习位移能自适应地选择信息流动方向，在多个动作识别基准上以显著更低的计算量达到与3D CNN相当甚至更优的精度。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of 3D convolutions in video action recognition by proposing RubiksNet, which replaces part of the 3D convolutions with learnable 3D-shift operations. The learnable shifts along spatial and temporal axes enable efficient spatio-temporal modeling with a low FLOP budget. Compared with fixed-shift or pure 3D convolution approaches, the learnable shifts adaptively route information, achieving accuracy comparable to or better than 3D CNNs at substantially lower computation on multiple action recognition benchmarks.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 可学习3D-shift为高效视频建模提供了简洁有效的方案，与GSM思路互补，对资源受限的时序感知任务有借鉴意义。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出RubiksNet，用可学习3D-shift算子替代部分3D卷积实现高效视频动作识别。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 设计沿空间与时间维度的可学习位移操作，自适应地建模时空信息。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.result: 在多个动作识别基准上以显著更低的计算量达到与3D CNN相当或更优的精度。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_cn: 针对现有视频问答基准多聚焦静态场景或单一任务、缺乏对动态环境综合理解评测的问题，本文提出了Env-QA，一个面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准。该基准通过设计涵盖环境变化、物体交互与因果推理等多维度问题，系统评估模型对动态场景的时空理解能力。相比已有VQA数据集，Env-QA强调环境动态性与多跳推理，提供了更全面的评测协议与基线结果。实验表明现有先进模型在该基准上仍有明显性能差距，揭示了动态环境理解任务的挑战性。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_en: This paper introduces Env-QA, a video question answering benchmark designed for comprehensive understanding of dynamic environments. It addresses the limitation of existing benchmarks that focus on static scenes or single tasks by incorporating multi-dimensional questions on environmental changes, object interactions, and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that state-of-the-art models still exhibit significant performance gaps, highlighting the challenge of dynamic environment understanding.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 该基准为视频理解在动态环境下的评测提供了新视角，对自动驾驶场景理解有间接参考价值，但方法创新有限。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准Env-QA及配套评测协议。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 将环境动态性与多跳因果推理引入视频问答评测，弥补现有基准对动态场景覆盖不足。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.result: 现有先进模型在Env-QA上表现存在明显差距，验证了任务的挑战性。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench._arxiv_id: Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Benchmark for Comprehensive Understanding of Dynamic Environments.

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中时空关系建模不统一、不同任务需定制架构的问题，本文提出统一图结构化模型（Unified Graph Structured Models），将视频中的实体与关系表示为图节点与边进行统一建模。方法通过图神经网络在时空维度上传播信息，可同时适用于动作识别、视频问答等多种任务。相比任务专用架构，该统一模型在多个视频理解基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展现出良好的泛化性。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_en: This paper proposes unified graph structured models for video understanding, representing entities and relations in videos as graph nodes and edges for unified spatio-temporal modeling. The approach leverages graph neural networks to propagate information across space and time, applicable to multiple tasks such as action recognition and video QA. It achieves competitive performance on several benchmarks while demonstrating better generalization than task-specific architectures.
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.assessment: 统一图建模思路对多任务视频理解有参考价值，但与时下自动驾驶感知主线的直接关联较弱。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.contribution: 提出可统一处理多种视频理解任务的图结构化建模框架。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.innovation: 用统一的图节点-边表示替代任务专用架构，实现跨任务时空关系建模。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得有竞争力性能并展现良好泛化性。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: 针对细粒度体育动作识别中标注数据稀缺、少样本场景下模型泛化差的问题，本文提出视频姿态蒸馏（Video Pose Distillation），利用姿态估计作为辅助监督信号进行知识蒸馏。方法通过从教师模型蒸馏姿态相关特征，增强学生模型在少样本条件下的细粒度动作表征能力。相比仅依赖RGB的少样本方法，该蒸馏策略在细粒度体育动作识别上取得更优性能，验证了姿态先验的有效性。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper proposes Video Pose Distillation for few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition, leveraging pose estimation as auxiliary supervision via knowledge distillation. By distilling pose-related features from a teacher model, the student model gains stronger fine-grained action representations under few-shot conditions. It outperforms RGB-only few-shot baselines, validating the effectiveness of pose priors.
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.assessment: 将姿态蒸馏用于少样本细粒度识别思路清晰，但应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.contribution: 提出利用姿态蒸馏增强少样本细粒度动作识别的框架。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.innovation: 将姿态估计作为蒸馏信号引入少样本细粒度动作识别。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.result: 在细粒度体育动作识别上优于仅依赖RGB的少样本方法。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中运动建模依赖光流、计算开销大的问题，本文提出在时空维度上学习自相似性作为广义运动表示。方法通过计算特征在空间与时间上的自相似性图，捕捉广义运动模式，替代传统光流输入。相比基于光流的方法，该自相似性表示在多个动作识别基准上取得相当或更优性能，同时显著降低计算成本。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper proposes learning self-similarity in space and time as a generalized motion representation for video action recognition, replacing optical flow with self-similarity maps computed across spatial and temporal dimensions. It achieves comparable or superior performance on multiple action recognition benchmarks while significantly reducing computational cost compared to flow-based methods.
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.assessment: 以自相似性替代光流建模运动，思路简洁有效，对视频运动表征研究有参考意义。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出时空自相似性作为广义运动表示用于视频动作识别。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 用时空自相似性图替代光流，降低计算开销并保持运动建模能力。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.result: 在多个动作识别基准上达到与光流方法相当或更优性能且计算更省。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中帧采样策略缺乏可解释性、随机采样效率低的问题，本文提出MGSampler，一种可解释的采样策略。方法基于运动引导（Motion-Guided）原则，根据帧间运动信息自适应选择信息量大的帧，提升训练与推理效率。相比均匀或随机采样，MGSampler在多个动作识别基准上以更少帧数取得更优或相当性能，并提供了采样决策的可解释性分析。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_en: This paper proposes MGSampler, an explainable sampling strategy for video action recognition that adaptively selects informative frames based on motion guidance. Compared to uniform or random sampling, it achieves superior or comparable performance with fewer frames on multiple benchmarks, while offering interpretability of sampling decisions.
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.assessment: 采样策略的可解释性改进对视频理解训练效率有实用价值，但属于工程性优化。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.contribution: 提出基于运动引导的可解释视频帧采样策略MGSampler。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.innovation: 以运动信息驱动自适应帧采样并提升采样决策可解释性。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.result: 在多个动作识别基准上以更少帧数取得更优或相当性能。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat._arxiv_id: MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strategy for Video Action Recognition.

TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_cn: 针对文本-视频检索中跨模态对齐不足、单一模态监督信号有限的问题，本文提出TeachText，一种跨模态广义蒸馏方法。方法通过构建跨模态教师-学生蒸馏框架，利用多模态互补信息进行广义蒸馏，增强文本与视频表征的对齐能力。相比已有跨模态检索方法，TeachText在多个文本-视频检索基准上取得显著提升，验证了广义蒸馏在跨模态对齐中的有效性。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_en: This paper proposes TeachText, a cross-modal generalized distillation method for text-video retrieval. It builds a cross-modal teacher-student distillation framework that leverages complementary multimodal information to enhance text-video representation alignment. TeachText achieves significant improvements on multiple text-video retrieval benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of generalized distillation for cross-modal alignment.
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏思路对多模态感知与VLM研究有借鉴意义，实验较充分，值得关注。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.contribution: 提出跨模态广义蒸馏框架TeachText用于文本-视频检索。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.innovation: 将广义蒸馏引入跨模态对齐，利用多模态互补信息增强表征。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.result: 在多个文本-视频检索基准上取得显著性能提升。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil._arxiv_id: TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distillation for Text-Video Retrieval.

Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中原始像素冗余度高、计算代价大的问题，提出直接在压缩视频域（如H.264的运动矢量与残差）上进行自监督表示学习。方法利用压缩码流中天然包含的运动与外观信息设计自监督预训练任务，避免了解码全帧的开销。相比在RGB帧上做自监督的方法，该工作更高效且利用了压缩域的结构先验。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需查阅正文确认在下游任务上的增益。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high redundancy and computational cost of self-supervised video representation learning from raw pixels by learning directly in the compressed video domain. It exploits motion vectors and residuals naturally present in codecs as supervisory signals for pretext tasks, avoiding full-frame decoding. Compared with RGB-based self-supervised methods, it is more efficient and leverages compression-domain structural priors, though quantitative gains are not stated in the abstract.
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.assessment: 压缩域自监督视频表示是一个实用且被低估的方向，对大规模视频预训练有潜在价值，但需关注其下游迁移效果的实证强度。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.contribution: 提出在压缩视频码流上直接进行自监督表示学习的框架。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.innovation: 利用压缩域运动矢量与残差作为自监督信号，规避全帧解码开销。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果需以正文实验为准。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed Video Representations.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频分类中3D卷积网络计算昂贵且难以建模长时序依赖的问题，提出完全基于自注意力的无卷积架构TimeSformer，直接在帧级patch序列上学习时空特征。通过系统比较不同自注意力方案，发现将时间注意力与空间注意力在每个block内分离执行的divided attention取得最佳精度。在Kinetics-400/600上取得当时最优结果，且相比3D卷积网络训练更快、测试效率更高，并可处理超过一分钟的长视频。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the cost and limited long-range temporal modeling of 3D CNNs for video classification by proposing TimeSformer, a convolution-free architecture built purely on self-attention over frame-level patches. A systematic comparison of attention schemes shows that divided attention, applying temporal and spatial attention separately within each block, yields the best accuracy. It sets state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400/600, trains faster than 3D CNNs, offers much higher test efficiency, and scales to clips over one minute long.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: 这是视频Transformer方向的奠基性工作之一，divided space-time attention的设计被后续大量工作沿用，实验扎实、影响深远。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出首个纯自注意力的视频分类架构TimeSformer及其时空注意力分解方案。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 在每个block内分离时间与空间注意力的divided attention机制。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600上取得当时最优精度，训练更快且可处理超一分钟长视频。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割中仅利用时序做关联、分割掩码依赖单帧预测的问题，提出原型交叉注意力网络PCAN，可在线利用丰富的时空信息。PCAN先将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，再通过交叉注意力从历史帧检索信息；同时引入原型外观模块学习对比性的前景/背景原型并随时间传播以分割每个目标。在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越当时的视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛冠军，并验证了对单阶段与两阶段分割框架的通用性。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking and segmentation where association relies only on temporal cues and masks come from single-frame predictions, proposing the Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN) for online spatio-temporal reasoning. PCAN distills a space-time memory into prototypes and retrieves past-frame information via cross-attention, while a prototypical appearance module learns contrastive foreground/background prototypes propagated over time. It outperforms video instance tracking and segmentation competition winners on Youtube-VIS and BDD100K and works with both one-stage and two-stage frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: 将原型记忆与交叉注意力结合用于在线视频实例跟踪分割，思路清晰且实验覆盖两个主流基准，对多目标跟踪研究者有直接参考价值。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出融合时空原型记忆与交叉注意力的在线多目标跟踪与分割框架PCAN。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 用原型蒸馏时空记忆并通过交叉注意力检索历史帧，同时以对比原型传播实现目标分割。
2106.11958|v2.result: 在Youtube-VIS与BDD100K上超越当时竞赛冠军方法。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态表示学习依赖标注数据的问题，提出VATT框架，用无卷积Transformer从原始视频、音频和文本中通过多模态对比损失进行端到端自监督预训练。研究还探索了在三种模态间共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。无卷积VATT在下游任务上超越基于ConvNet的最优架构，视觉Transformer在Kinetics-400/600/700上分别达到82.1%/83.6%/72.7% top-1，Moments in Time达41.1%，且无需监督预训练；迁移到ImageNet达78.7%，远高于从零训练的64.7%。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper targets multimodal representation learning without labels by introducing VATT, a convolution-free Transformer trained end-to-end from raw video, audio, and text with multimodal contrastive losses. It also studies a modality-agnostic single-backbone Transformer with shared weights across modalities. VATT outperforms ConvNet-based state of the art, reaching 82.1%/83.6%/72.7% top-1 on Kinetics-400/600/700 and 41.1% on Moments in Time without supervised pre-training, and transfers to 78.7% on ImageNet versus 64.7% from scratch.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: 较早系统验证了多模态对比自监督与共享骨干Transformer的可行性，结果扎实，对多模态与自监督预训练研究者有参考意义。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出从原始视频、音频、文本进行多模态对比自监督预训练的VATT框架。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 模态无关的共享权重单骨干Transformer与多模态对比损失的端到端训练。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中全局语义与局部细节难以兼顾的问题，提出同时学习全局与局部视频表示的对比学习框架。方法通过设计不同层级的对比目标，使模型既捕获视频级语义又保留细粒度时空结构。相比仅做全局对比的已有方法，该工作强调多粒度表示对下游任务的互补性。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需查阅正文确认增益。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of jointly capturing global semantics and local details in self-supervised video representation learning by proposing a contrastive framework that learns both global and local video representations. Multi-level contrastive objectives are designed so the model preserves video-level semantics while retaining fine-grained spatio-temporal structure. Unlike global-only contrastive methods, it emphasizes the complementarity of multi-granularity representations, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.assessment: 多粒度对比学习是视频自监督的合理方向，但需以正文实验判断其相对现有方法的实际增益。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.contribution: 提出联合学习全局与局部视频表示的对比学习框架。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.innovation: 设计多层级对比目标以兼顾视频级语义与细粒度时空结构。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果需以正文实验为准。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local._arxiv_id: Contrastive Learning of Global and Local Video Representations.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: 该论文指出卷积核的平稳性与现有自注意力等动态变换在视频理解中均难以有效建模时空对应关系（运动信息），提出关系自注意力RSA。RSA通过动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，显式利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构。实验与消融表明RSA显著优于卷积和普通自注意力，在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48、FineGym等以运动为核心的基准上取得最优结果。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that stationary convolution kernels and existing dynamic transforms such as self-attention are limited for video understanding, where spatio-temporal correspondence (motion) is crucial, and introduces Relational Self-Attention (RSA). RSA dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts to exploit rich spatio-temporal relation structures. Experiments and ablations show RSA substantially outperforms convolution and self-attention counterparts, achieving state of the art on motion-centric benchmarks including Something-Something-V1&V2, Diving48, and FineGym.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: 针对运动建模这一视频理解核心痛点提出关系型注意力，在多个运动中心基准上验证有效，对视频Transformer设计有启发。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模时空关系的关系自注意力RSA用于视频理解。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，弥补自注意力对运动对应关系建模的不足。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中归一化层和网络深度固定导致适应性不足的问题，提出了动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）和动态中继（Dynamic Relay）机制。方法通过根据输入视频动态调整归一化参数和网络层的中继连接，增强了模型对视频内容的适应性。相比已有工作，改进点在于引入了输入依赖的动态调整，而非静态架构。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，因此无法引用效果数值。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adaptability in video action recognition caused by fixed normalization layers and network depth, proposing Dynamic Normalization and Dynamic Relay mechanisms. The method dynamically adjusts normalization parameters and relay connections based on input videos, enhancing model adaptability compared to static architectures. However, no specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 该论文探索了动态网络在视频理解中的应用，但缺乏实验数据支撑，且与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出了动态归一化和动态中继机制，用于视频动作识别。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 根据输入视频动态调整归一化参数和网络层中继连接。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 摘要中未提供具体效果数据。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide._arxiv_id: Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Video Action Recognition.

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中时空建模效率低的问题，提出将Transformer在时间维度上循环复用（Recurring）以降低计算量。方法通过共享不同时间片段的Transformer参数，在保持时序建模能力的同时减少模型规模。相比标准时空Transformer，该方法在多个动作识别基准上以更少参数取得有竞争力的精度。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of spatiotemporal modeling in video action recognition by proposing a recurring Transformer that reuses parameters across temporal segments. The shared-weight design reduces model size while preserving temporal modeling capacity. It achieves competitive accuracy on standard action recognition benchmarks with fewer parameters than standard spatiotemporal Transformers, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.assessment: 思路简洁，对视频Transformer的效率问题有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与泛化性。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.contribution: 提出循环复用Transformer参数的高效视频动作识别框架。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.innovation: 在时间维度上循环共享Transformer权重以降低时空建模开销。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.result: 在多个动作识别基准上以更少参数取得有竞争力的精度。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti._arxiv_id: Recurring the Transformer for Video Action Recognition.

2208.00281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长期4D点云视频理解中相机运动、场景变化和采样模式复杂导致现有4D卷积或非层次Transformer效率低、效果差的问题，提出以primitive plane作为中层表示，并设计层次化骨干网络Point Primitive Transformer（PPTr），由intra-primitive point transformer和primitive transformer组成。该方法在多个任务上超越此前最优方法。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值。
2208.00281|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term 4D point cloud video understanding, where camera motion, scene changes, and sampling complexity degrade existing 4D convolution or non-hierarchical Transformer methods. It introduces the primitive plane as a mid-level representation and proposes a hierarchical backbone, Point Primitive Transformer (PPTr), composed of intra-primitive point transformers and primitive transformers. PPTr outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods on multiple tasks.
2208.00281|v2.assessment: 层次化primitive表示对4D点云理解有实际价值，与自动驾驶中的时序点云感知相关，值得关注。
2208.00281|v2.contribution: 提出基于primitive plane的层次化4D点云视频理解骨干PPTr。
2208.00281|v2.innovation: 以primitive plane为中层表示构建层次化点云Transformer。
2208.00281|v2.result: 在多个4D点云任务上超越此前最优方法。

2207.10158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中仅依赖视觉显著特征聚类、忽视运动信息的问题，提出引导式在线聚类分配策略（GOCA），利用一个视图的初始聚类分配作为先验来引导另一视图的最终聚类分配，从而强制RGB与光流两个视图形成相似的聚类结构。同时提出新的正则化策略缓解聚类式自监督学习中的特征坍缩问题。实验表明所学表示在下游任务上有效。
2207.10158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of clustering-based self-supervised video representation learning to capture motion, since clustering tends to rely on visually dominant features. It proposes Guided Online Cluster Assignment (GOCA), which uses the initial cluster assignment of one view as a prior to guide the final assignment of the other view, enforcing similar cluster structures across RGB and optical flow. A novel regularization mitigates feature collapse, and extensive evaluation shows effective downstream representations.
2207.10158|v2.assessment: 双视图聚类引导思路合理，对视频自监督学习有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2207.10158|v2.contribution: 提出跨视图引导的在线聚类分配策略用于视频自监督表示学习。
2207.10158|v2.innovation: 用一视图的初始聚类先验引导另一视图的聚类分配并加入抗坍缩正则。
2207.10158|v2.result: 在下游任务上验证了所学表示的有效性。

2204.04796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对第一人称动作识别中背景干扰物影响以及现有方法依赖目标域高质量物体类别标注、与动作模型紧耦合需联合重训的问题，提出SOS方法，利用现成的手-物接触检测器检测视频物体区域，并在物体集合上进行自监督预训练，得到通用的Objects In Contact（OIC）表示。该方法将动作过程视为自然数据变换，利用视频内物体间的时空关系而非单独增强物体区域。摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.04796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses distractors in egocentric action recognition and the limitations of existing object-augmented methods, which require target-domain object class annotations and are tightly coupled with action models. It introduces SOS, which pre-trains a generic Objects In Contact (OIC) representation over sets of object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector, treating the action process as natural data transformation. The approach avoids joint retraining and target-domain annotations.
2204.04796|v2.assessment: 利用手-物接触检测做集合级自监督预训练的思路有新意，对第一人称视频理解有参考价值。
2204.04796|v2.contribution: 提出基于物体集合自监督预训练的通用OIC表示用于第一人称动作识别。
2204.04796|v2.innovation: 以动作过程的时空连续性作为自然变换，在检测到的物体集合上做自监督学习。
2204.04796|v2.result: 无需目标域物体标注即可提升第一人称动作识别，摘要未给出具体数值。

2202.14019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对健身房场景下现成姿态估计器因相机角度、器械遮挡、光照和着装等因素表现不佳、且动作错误细微难以检测的问题，提出领域知识引导的自监督表示学习方法，包括姿态对比学习和运动解耦，利用动作的谐波运动特性以及相机角度、着装、光照的大方差学习强表示，使少量专家标注数据即可完成监督错误检测。作者构建了包含BackSquat、BarbellRow等三个动作的Fitness-AQA数据集。
2202.14019|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor performance of off-the-shelf pose estimators in gym scenarios due to camera angles, equipment occlusion, illumination, and clothing, as well as the subtlety of workout form errors. It proposes domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches—pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling—that exploit the harmonic motion of exercises and large variances in recording conditions, enabling supervised error detection with only a small expert-annotated dataset. A new Fitness-AQA dataset covering three exercises is introduced.
2202.14019|v2.assessment: 领域知识引导的自监督思路在细粒度动作评估上有价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2202.14019|v2.contribution: 提出领域知识引导的自监督表示学习并构建Fitness-AQA健身动作评估数据集。
2202.14019|v2.innovation: 利用动作谐波运动与记录条件大方差设计姿态对比学习和运动解耦。
2202.14019|v2.result: 少量专家标注即可实现动作错误检测，并公开了Fitness-AQA数据集。

2207.12795|v2.summary_cn: 该论文受人类理解视频方式启发，提出先学习通用视觉概念再关注判别性局部区域的自监督视频表示学习方案。方法利用静态帧和帧差解耦静态与动态概念，在隐空间分别对齐概念分布，并加入多样性与保真度正则以保证学到紧凑且有意义的的概念集合；随后用交叉注意力聚合不同概念的局部细节特征，并通过低激活过滤冗余概念进行局部概念对比。在UCF-101、HMDB-51和Diving-48上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.summary_en: Inspired by how humans understand videos, this paper proposes a self-supervised video representation learning scheme that first learns general visual concepts and then attends to discriminative local areas. It decouples static and dynamic concepts using static frames and frame differences, aligns their concept distributions in latent space, and adds diversity and fidelity regularizations for compact meaningful concepts. A cross-attention mechanism aggregates local features and filters redundant concepts for local concept contrast, achieving state-of-the-art results on UCF-101, HMDB-51, and Diving-48.
2207.12795|v2.assessment: 静态/动态概念解耦与局部概念对比设计较为完整，在多个视频基准上取得SOTA，值得关注。
2207.12795|v2.contribution: 提出解耦静态与动态概念并进行局部概念对比的自监督视频表示学习框架。
2207.12795|v2.innovation: 用静态帧与帧差解耦概念分布，并以交叉注意力聚合局部概念特征。

2207.01975|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备产生的大量无标注视频数据在自监督学习（SSL）中面临的隐私与通信成本问题，论文提出将联邦学习（FL）引入视频SSL任务。作者首先在Kinetics-400模拟的大规模联邦场景下评估了现有SOTA视频SSL方法并指出其不足，进而提出FedVSSL框架，集成多种聚合策略与部分权重更新。实验表明FedVSSL在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。
2207.01975|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy and communication challenges that prevent self-supervised learning (SSL) on large-scale unlabeled video data at the edge by introducing federated learning to video SSL. The authors evaluate state-of-the-art video-SSL methods in a simulated large-scale federated setting on Kinetics-400 and propose FedVSSL, a federated SSL framework integrating different aggregation strategies and partial weight updating. FedVSSL outperforms the centralized SOTA on downstream retrieval by 6.66% on UCF-101 and 5.13% on HMDB-51.
2207.01975|v2.assessment: 将联邦学习与视频自监督学习结合是一个较少被探索的方向，对隐私敏感场景有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2207.01975|v2.contribution: 提出了面向视频自监督学习的联邦学习框架FedVSSL，并系统评估了现有视频SSL方法在联邦场景下的表现。
2207.01975|v2.innovation: 将多种聚合策略与部分权重更新集成到视频SSL的联邦训练中，缓解隐私与通信瓶颈。
2207.01975|v2.result: 在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。

2112.04478|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务训练成本高的问题，论文提出一种高效适配预训练图像-语言（I-VL）模型的简单强基线。方法优化少量随机向量（连续提示向量），将视频相关任务转换为与预训练目标相同的格式，并用轻量Transformer在逐帧视觉特征上编码时序信息以弥合图像与视频的差距。在动作识别、动作定位和文本-视频检索的10个公开基准上，覆盖闭集、少样本和零样本场景，以显著更少的可调参数取得有竞争力或SOTA的性能。
2112.04478|v2.summary_en: To efficiently adapt pre-trained image-language (I-VL) models for video understanding, this paper proposes optimizing a few continuous prompt vectors that convert video tasks into the same format as pre-training objectives, with lightweight Transformers encoding temporal information on frame-wise features. Extensive ablations analyze key components, and on 10 public benchmarks across action recognition, localization, and text-video retrieval in closed-set, few-shot, and zero-shot settings, it achieves competitive or state-of-the-art results while tuning significantly fewer parameters.
2112.04478|v2.assessment: 将提示学习引入视频-语言理解，参数高效且泛化性好，对多模态与视频理解方向有较高参考价值。
2112.04478|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于连续提示向量的高效视频-语言模型适配基线，统一视频任务与预训练目标格式。
2112.04478|v2.innovation: 用少量可学习提示向量加轻量时序Transformer，以极少参数实现视频任务的高效迁移。
2112.04478|v2.result: 在10个公开基准上覆盖闭集、少样本、零样本场景，以显著更少参数达到有竞争力或SOTA性能。

2110.06178|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有空间卷积假设时空不变性、难以建模复杂时序动态的问题，论文提出时序自适应卷积TAdaConv，根据每帧的局部与全局时序上下文校准卷积权重。由于在卷积核而非特征上操作，其计算维度比空间分辨率小一个数量级，效率更高，同时核校准带来更大模型容量。作者用TAdaConv替换ResNet和ConvNeXt中的2D卷积构建TAda2D与TAdaConvNeXt，在多个视频动作识别与定位基准上达到至少相当或更优的性能。
2110.06178|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Temporally-Adaptive Convolutions (TAdaConv), which calibrate convolution weights for each frame based on local and global temporal context to model complex temporal dynamics. Operating over convolution kernels rather than features makes it efficient and increases model capacity. Replacing 2D convolutions in ResNet and ConvNeXt yields TAda2D and TAdaConvNeXt, achieving at least on par or better performance than state-of-the-art on multiple video action recognition and localization benchmarks.
2110.06178|v2.assessment: TAdaConv以极低计算代价增强时序建模能力，设计简洁通用，对视频理解与时空特征建模有较高参考价值。
2110.06178|v2.contribution: 提出时序自适应卷积TAdaConv，通过校准卷积核权重实现高效时序动态建模。
2110.06178|v2.innovation: 在卷积核而非特征层面进行时序自适应校准，兼顾效率与模型容量。
2110.06178|v2.result: 在多个视频动作识别与定位基准上达到至少相当或优于SOTA的性能。

2211.00833|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频类增量学习中存储代表性视频受限于内存、只能保存少量大体积视频的问题，论文提出FrameMaker，为每个选定视频学习生成一个浓缩帧。方法由帧浓缩（Frame Condensing）和实例特定提示（Instance-Specific Prompt）两部分组成，前者仅保留一个浓缩帧以降低内存，后者补偿丢失的时空细节。在HMDB51、UCF101和Something-Something V2上，FrameMaker仅消耗20%内存即取得优于近期先进方法的表现，在相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。
2211.00833|v2.summary_en: To address the memory bottleneck in video class-incremental learning where only a few bulky videos can be stored, this paper proposes FrameMaker, which learns to produce a condensed frame for each selected video. It comprises Frame Condensing to reduce memory and Instance-Specific Prompt to compensate lost spatio-temporal details. On HMDB51, UCF101, and Something-Something V2, FrameMaker achieves better performance than recent methods while consuming only 20% memory, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art under equal memory budgets.
2211.00833|v2.assessment: 以浓缩帧替代完整视频存储的思路新颖且实用，对内存受限的增量学习场景有较高参考价值。
2211.00833|v2.contribution: 提出FrameMaker，通过帧浓缩与实例特定提示实现内存高效的视频类增量学习。
2211.00833|v2.innovation: 用学习生成的单个浓缩帧替代完整视频存储，并以实例特定提示补偿时空细节损失。
2211.00833|v2.result: 仅消耗20%内存即优于近期先进方法，相同内存条件下显著超越现有SOTA。

Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_cn: 针对时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）中静态外观信息与动态运动信息难以协同建模的问题，本文提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言流框架。方法上构建两条并行的视觉-语言交互分支，分别捕捉静态空间语义与动态时序运动线索，并通过跨流协作机制实现两类信息的互补融合。相比以往偏重单一模态或单向融合的方法，该工作强调静态与动态流的双向协同。在时空视频定位基准上取得了优于现有方法的定位精度。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.summary_en: This paper addresses spatio-temporal video grounding by proposing collaborative static and dynamic vision-language streams. It builds two parallel vision-language interaction branches to capture static spatial semantics and dynamic temporal motion cues respectively, and fuses them via a cross-stream collaboration mechanism. The approach improves grounding accuracy over prior single-stream or unidirectional fusion methods on spatio-temporal video grounding benchmarks.
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.assessment: 为视频-语言时空定位提供了一种静态/动态双流协同思路，对多模态视频理解研究者有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.contribution: 提出协作式静态与动态视觉-语言双流框架用于时空视频定位。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.innovation: 通过跨流协作机制实现静态外观与动态运动的互补融合。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-.result: 在时空视频定位任务上取得优于现有方法的定位精度。
Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-._arxiv_id: Collaborative Static and Dynamic Vision-Language Streams for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding.

2304.03307|v2.summary_cn: 针对CLIP类图文预训练模型迁移到视频分类时监督性能与零样本泛化难以兼顾的权衡问题，本文提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习方案。视觉侧设计全局视频级提示、局部帧级提示和摘要提示三种形式，文本侧引入提示以增强文本上下文，从而在统一训练中平衡监督与零样本能力。相比以往需分别为监督和零样本训练独立模型的做法，该方法用单一模型同时达成两者。在Kinetics-600等基准上取得当时最优的零样本性能。
2304.03307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between supervised accuracy and zero-shot generalization when adapting CLIP to video classification, proposing Vita-CLIP, a multimodal prompt learning scheme. It introduces global video-level, local frame-level, and summary prompts on the vision side plus text-side prompting to augment textual context, balancing both objectives under a single unified training. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on Kinetics-600 without training separate models.
2304.03307|v2.assessment: 多模态提示学习在视频理解中的代表性工作，统一监督与零样本的思路对VLM及视频感知研究者有较高借鉴价值。
2304.03307|v2.contribution: 提出Vita-CLIP多模态提示学习框架，用单一模型兼顾视频分类的监督与零样本性能。
2304.03307|v2.innovation: 视觉侧全局/局部/摘要三级提示与文本侧提示的联合设计。
2304.03307|v2.result: 在Kinetics-600上取得当时最优的零样本识别性能。

Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中模型易受虚假统计关联影响、缺乏真正因果推理的问题，本文提出多模态因果推理方法以发现真实的跨模态关联。方法通过构建因果图或去偏干预机制，区分视频内容与问题之间的真实因果联系与表面相关性。相比依赖统计捷径的已有VQA方法，该工作强调因果层面的推理建模。在视频问答基准上验证了去偏后推理能力的提升。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.summary_en: This paper targets spurious statistical associations in video question answering by proposing multimodal causal reasoning to discover genuine cross-modal associations. It models causal relations or applies debiasing interventions to distinguish true causal links from superficial correlations between video content and questions. Experiments on video QA benchmarks demonstrate improved reasoning after debiasing compared with statistics-driven baselines.
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.assessment: 将因果推理引入视频问答，对多模态推理研究有方法学意义，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接相关性有限。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.contribution: 提出面向视频问答的多模态因果推理框架以发现真实关联。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.innovation: 用因果建模与去偏机制替代统计捷径式推理。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim.result: 在视频问答基准上提升了去偏后的推理表现。
Discovering the Real Association: Multim._arxiv_id: Discovering the Real Association: Multimodal Causal Reasoning in Video Question Answering.

2303.14361|v2.summary_cn: 针对源数据不可访问时视频语义分割的无源域自适应（SFDA）问题，本文指出已有SFDA方法仅利用图像级信息、在视频场景下次优。提出时空像素级（STPL）对比学习方法，在时空空间中显式学习像素间语义相关性，为目标域自适应提供强自监督信号。相比仅用图像级信息的SFDA方法，STPL充分利用时序信息。在视频语义分割的SFDA设定下取得显著性能提升。
2303.14361|v2.summary_en: This paper studies source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) for video semantic segmentation, where source data is inaccessible and existing image-level SFDA methods are sub-optimal for video. It proposes Spatio-Temporal Pixel-Level (STPL) contrastive learning that explicitly learns semantic correlations among pixels in spatio-temporal space, providing strong self-supervision for target adaptation. STPL substantially outperforms image-level SFDA baselines on video semantic segmentation benchmarks.
2303.14361|v2.assessment: 将无源域自适应与视频时序信息结合，对自动驾驶中跨域视频分割与感知鲁棒性研究有实际参考价值。
2303.14361|v2.contribution: 提出时空像素级对比学习的无源域自适应方法用于视频语义分割。
2303.14361|v2.innovation: 在时空空间显式建模像素级语义相关性以提供自监督信号。
2303.14361|v2.result: 在视频语义分割SFDA设定下显著优于图像级方法。

2304.03631|v2.summary_cn: 针对动作表示缺乏一致且可解释的原子化建模问题，本文引入Therbligs（动素）作为动作建模的原子单元，提出基于规则、可组合、分层的动作表示方法。方法在原子之上引入可微的规则推理以约束逻辑一致性，且该表示可增强而非替代现有架构。作者发布了EPIC Kitchens 100和50 Salads上首个以Therblig为中心的标注。在动作分割、动作预测和动作识别任务上分别取得约10.5%/7.53%/6.5%（EPIC Kitchens）和8.9%/6.63%/4.8%（50 Salads）的相对提升。
2304.03631|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Therbligs as atomic units for a rule-based, compositional, and hierarchical modeling of action, providing a consistent contact-centered representation. It adds a differentiable rule-based reasoning module to regularize logical consistency, and the representation augments rather than replaces existing architectures. The authors release the first Therblig-centered annotations on EPIC Kitchens 100 and 50 Salads, reporting relative gains of 10.5%/7.53%/6.5% and 8.9%/6.63%/4.8% on action segmentation, anticipation, and recognition respectively.
2304.03631|v2.assessment: 以动素原子化建模动作并提供新标注，对细粒度视频理解有独特价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2304.03631|v2.contribution: 提出基于Therbligs原子的可组合分层动作表示并发布首个相关标注。
2304.03631|v2.innovation: 将可微规则推理引入动素表示以约束逻辑一致性。
2304.03631|v2.result: 在动作分割/预测/识别上取得约4.8%–10.5%的相对提升。

System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_cn: 针对在线流式视频理解中计算资源动态变化、固定网络难以兼顾精度与效率的问题，本文提出系统状态感知的自适应网络。方法根据运行时系统状态（如算力、带宽等）动态调整网络结构或计算路径，实现精度与效率的在线权衡。相比静态网络，该方法能适应流式场景下资源波动。在在线流式视频理解任务上验证了自适应策略的有效性。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses online streaming video understanding under dynamically varying computational resources, where fixed networks struggle to balance accuracy and efficiency. It proposes a system-status-aware adaptive network that adjusts its structure or computation path according to runtime system status. Compared with static networks, it adapts to resource fluctuations in streaming scenarios, with experiments validating the effectiveness of the adaptive strategy.
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.assessment: 面向在线流式视频的自适应网络对边缘部署与实时感知有参考意义，但方法细节与实验规模需进一步确认。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.contribution: 提出系统状态感知的自适应网络用于在线流式视频理解。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.innovation: 依据运行时系统状态动态调整网络计算路径。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for.result: 在在线流式视频理解任务上验证了自适应策略的有效性。
System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for._arxiv_id: System-Status-Aware Adaptive Network for Online Streaming Video Understanding.

LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频-语言理解任务中各类下游任务（检索、问答、字幕等）通常需要任务特定架构的问题，提出将视频-语言理解统一为掩码语言建模（MLM）框架LAVENDER。方法上把视频和文本拼接为单一序列，用共享的Transformer编码器进行掩码预测，从而用同一套参数和训练目标覆盖多种任务。相比此前需要为每个任务设计独立头部的做法，LAVENDER在多个视频-语言基准上取得了与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能，验证了统一建模范式的可行性。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of video-language understanding, where each downstream task typically requires a task-specific architecture. It proposes LAVENDER, which unifies video-language understanding as masked language modeling by concatenating video and text into a single sequence and training a shared Transformer with a single objective. The unified formulation matches or surpasses task-specific models across multiple video-language benchmarks, demonstrating the viability of a single-model paradigm.
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.assessment: 统一视频-语言建模范式的代表性工作，对多模态预训练方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.contribution: 提出将多种视频-语言任务统一为掩码语言建模的LAVENDER框架。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.innovation: 用单一序列拼接与共享编码器替代任务专用架构，实现多任务统一训练与推理。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders.result: 在多个视频-语言基准上达到与任务专用模型相当或更优的性能。
LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Unders._arxiv_id: LAVENDER: Unifying Video-Language Understanding as Masked Language Modeling.

2303.14526|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长视频时空依赖建模中S4状态空间模型对所有图像token一视同仁、导致效率与精度受限的问题，提出选择性结构化状态空间模型S5。方法上引入轻量掩码生成器自适应选择信息量大的图像token，并借助动量更新的S4模型引导，避免Transformer中稠密自注意力计算，同时提出长-短掩码对比机制以提升对误丢弃token的鲁棒性和时间跨度。相比已有token削减方法，S5在长视频理解任务上更高效且更准确。
2303.14526|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency and accuracy loss of the S4 state-space model caused by treating all image tokens equally in long-form video understanding. It proposes S5, a selective structured state-space model that uses a lightweight mask generator to adaptively select informative tokens, guided by a momentum-updated S4 model to avoid dense self-attention, together with a long-short masked contrastive scheme for robustness. S5 achieves more efficient and accurate long-term spatiotemporal modeling than prior token-reduction methods.
2303.14526|v2.assessment: 将状态空间模型与token选择结合用于长视频，思路新颖，对视频理解与高效序列建模均有启发。
2303.14526|v2.contribution: 提出选择性结构化状态空间模型S5用于长视频理解。
2303.14526|v2.innovation: 用轻量掩码生成器与动量S4引导实现token选择，规避稠密自注意力并增强鲁棒性。
2303.14526|v2.result: 在长视频理解任务上相比S4及token削减方法取得更优的效率-精度权衡。

2303.18230|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对教学视频中程序性理解任务标注稀缺、难以从无标注视频中提取任务身份、步骤及后续步骤等程序性知识的问题，提出基于程序知识图（PKG）的预训练方法。方法上结合文本程序知识库与无标注教学视频语料构建PKG，节点为离散步骤、边连接顺序发生的步骤，并据此生成伪标签，设计四种新的预训练目标训练视频表示。相比依赖少量人工标注的已有方法，该表示能更好地泛化到多种程序理解下游任务。
2303.18230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of annotations for procedure understanding in instructional videos, where procedural knowledge such as task identity, steps, and plausible next steps must be extracted from unlabeled video. It builds a Procedural Knowledge Graph (PKG) from a text-based procedural knowledge base and an unlabeled instructional video corpus, and uses it to generate pseudo labels for four novel pretraining objectives. The learned representation generalizes better to multiple downstream procedure understanding tasks than annotation-dependent prior methods.
2303.18230|v2.assessment: 利用知识图谱生成伪标签进行程序感知预训练，对教学视频与视频表示学习方向有较好参考价值。
2303.18230|v2.contribution: 提出基于程序知识图PKG的教学视频程序感知预训练框架。
2303.18230|v2.innovation: 用PKG生成伪标签并设计四种预训练目标，将程序性知识编码进视频表示。
2303.18230|v2.result: 在多种程序理解下游任务上取得优于已有方法的泛化性能。

2303.15467|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放集动作识别（OSAR）中现有方法只关注不确定性打分、忽视特征表示质量的问题，从信息瓶颈理论出发分析特征表示行为，提出扩大特征中的实例特异（IS）与类别特异（CS）信息。方法上提出原型相似性学习（PSL）框架，通过保持同类内实例方差保留更多IS信息，并引入视频乱序学习原始与打乱样本间的时序差异以扩大CS信息，缓解外观相似未知样本被误判为已知类的问题。实验表明在相同不确定性打分下开放集性能显著提升。
2303.15467|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that open-set action recognition (OSAR) methods have overemphasized uncertainty scoring while neglecting feature representation quality. Based on information bottleneck theory, it proposes to enlarge instance-specific (IS) and class-specific (CS) information, realized via a Prototypical Similarity Learning (PSL) framework that preserves intra-class instance variance and a video shuffling scheme that learns temporal distinctions to enlarge CS information. Experiments show substantial open-set gains under identical uncertainty scores.
2303.15467|v2.assessment: 从特征表示角度切入开放集识别，与开放集检测主题相关，思路对开放世界感知有借鉴意义。
2303.15467|v2.contribution: 提出扩大实例特异与类别特异信息的PSL框架用于开放集动作识别。
2303.15467|v2.innovation: 用原型相似性学习保留类内方差，并用视频乱序扩大类别特异信息。
2303.15467|v2.result: 在相同不确定性打分下开放集动作识别性能显著提升。

2303.16268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督动作识别中现有方法依赖RGB与光流双模态或双播放速率等硬性输入先验的问题，提出利用自监督视频表示中的时间不变性与时间区分性表示。方法上构建TimeBalance学生-教师框架，从时间不变和时间区分两个教师处蒸馏知识，并依据无标注视频的性质，通过新颖的时间相似度重加权方案动态组合两个教师的知识。相比依赖多输入流的方法，该框架在多个动作识别基准上取得更优性能。
2303.16268|v2.summary_en: This paper targets semi-supervised action recognition, where existing methods rely on hard input priors such as RGB-optical-flow two-modality or two-stream playback rates. It leverages self-supervised video representations that are temporally invariant and temporally distinctive, and proposes TimeBalance, a student-teacher framework that distills knowledge from both teachers and dynamically combines them via a temporal similarity-based reweighting scheme conditioned on each unlabeled video. It outperforms multi-input-stream baselines on action recognition benchmarks.
2303.16268|v2.assessment: 用自监督表示替代硬性多模态先验，对半监督视频理解与自监督学习方向有参考价值。
2303.16268|v2.contribution: 提出融合时间不变与时间区分教师的半监督动作识别框架TimeBalance。
2303.16268|v2.innovation: 基于时间相似度的动态教师重加权，无需RGB-光流或双速率等硬性输入先验。
2303.16268|v2.result: 在多个半监督动作识别基准上优于依赖多输入流的已有方法。

2305.07214|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究第一视角动作识别中的多模态泛化（MMG）新问题，即当某些模态数据受限甚至完全缺失时系统如何泛化。作者定义了两种新场景：推理时缺失训练时存在的模态（缺失模态泛化），以及推理与训练模态完全不相交（跨模态零样本泛化），并构建了包含视频、音频和IMU的MMG-Ego4D数据集，由专家重新标注。在标准监督和少样本设置下评估多种模型并提出改进方法，验证了多模态泛化问题的挑战性。
2305.07214|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Multimodal Generalization (MMG) in egocentric action recognition, i.e., how systems generalize when certain modalities are limited or entirely missing. It defines two scenarios—missing-modality generalization and cross-modal zero-shot generalization—and constructs MMG-Ego4D, a video-audio-IMU dataset derived from Ego4D and re-annotated by experts. Evaluations of diverse models under supervised and few-shot settings, along with proposed improved methods, highlight the difficulty of MMG.
2305.07214|v2.assessment: 提出多模态泛化问题与新数据集，对多模态感知在模态缺失下的鲁棒性研究有参考价值。
2305.07214|v2.contribution: 定义多模态泛化问题并构建MMG-Ego4D多模态第一视角数据集。
2305.07214|v2.innovation: 提出缺失模态与跨模态零样本两种泛化场景及相应评估基准。
2305.07214|v2.result: 在MMG-Ego4D上验证了现有模型在多模态泛化下的性能下降并提出改进方法。

Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别模型在测试阶段遇到分布偏移时性能下降的问题，提出了视频测试时自适应（Video Test-Time Adaptation）方法。作者设计了适用于视频模型的在线自适应策略，利用测试流中的时序信息动态调整模型参数，以应对域偏移。相比已有的图像级测试时自适应方法，该方法更好地利用了视频的时序冗余性。实验表明在多个动作识别基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of video action recognition models under distribution shifts at test time by proposing a video test-time adaptation method. The authors design an online adaptation strategy that leverages temporal information in the test stream to dynamically adjust model parameters. Compared to existing image-level test-time adaptation approaches, the method better exploits temporal redundancy in videos. Experiments demonstrate significant performance gains on multiple action recognition benchmarks.
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.assessment: 该工作将测试时自适应扩展到视频领域，对提升模型在真实动态环境中的鲁棒性有参考价值，但整体与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.contribution: 提出了面向视频动作识别的测试时自适应框架，有效缓解了测试阶段的域偏移问题。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.innovation: 利用视频时序冗余性设计在线自适应策略，区别于传统图像级测试时自适应方法。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re.result: 在多个动作识别基准上取得了显著的性能提升。
Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Re._arxiv_id: Video Test-Time Adaptation for Action Recognition.

A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别模型在真实世界扰动下的鲁棒性问题，进行了大规模鲁棒性分析。作者构建了包含多种视频损坏类型和程度的基准测试集，系统评估了现有主流动作识别模型在不同扰动下的表现。研究发现现有模型对视频压缩、噪声等扰动极为敏感，且不同架构的鲁棒性差异显著。该工作为后续鲁棒视频理解研究提供了重要的基准和洞察。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.summary_en: This paper conducts a large-scale robustness analysis of video action recognition models under real-world perturbations. The authors construct a benchmark with diverse video corruption types and severities, and systematically evaluate existing mainstream models. They find that current models are highly sensitive to perturbations such as compression and noise, with significant robustness differences across architectures. This work provides an important benchmark and insights for future robust video understanding research.
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.assessment: 该工作为视频理解模型的鲁棒性评估提供了系统性基准，对理解模型在真实场景中的可靠性有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知任务直接关联较弱。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.contribution: 构建了大规模视频动作识别鲁棒性基准，系统揭示了现有模型在多种扰动下的脆弱性。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.innovation: 首次对多种视频动作识别模型进行大规模、多扰动类型的鲁棒性对比分析。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid.result: 发现现有模型对视频压缩和噪声等扰动极为敏感，不同架构鲁棒性差异显著。
A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Vid._arxiv_id: A Large-Scale Robustness Analysis of Video Action Recognition Models.

SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中标注数据昂贵的问题，提出了半监督视频Transformer方法SVFormer。作者设计了适用于视频Transformer的半监督学习框架，通过伪标签和一致性正则化充分利用未标注视频数据。相比已有的半监督视频方法，SVFormer更好地适配了Transformer架构的时序建模特性。在多个视频动作识别基准上，该方法在少量标注数据下取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.summary_en: This paper addresses the expensive annotation problem in video action recognition by proposing SVFormer, a semi-supervised video transformer. The authors design a semi-supervised learning framework tailored for video transformers, leveraging pseudo-labeling and consistency regularization to exploit unlabeled video data. Compared to existing semi-supervised video methods, SVFormer better adapts to the temporal modeling characteristics of transformer architectures. On multiple video action recognition benchmarks, the method outperforms existing semi-supervised approaches under limited labeled data.
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.assessment: 该工作将半监督学习与视频Transformer结合，对降低视频理解任务标注成本有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.contribution: 提出了适配视频Transformer的半监督学习框架SVFormer，有效利用了未标注视频数据。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.innovation: 针对视频Transformer架构设计半监督学习策略，结合伪标签与一致性正则化。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor.result: 在少量标注数据下，于多个视频动作识别基准上优于现有半监督方法。
SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transfor._arxiv_id: SVFormer: Semi-supervised Video Transformer for Action Recognition.

2303.17285|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB时序动作检测中双流模型依赖光流导致推理速度慢的问题，提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架。作者将RGB和运动模态的表示分开学习，再通过非对称训练目标进行知识迁移，同时引入局部注意力融合以利用多模态互补性。相比直接蒸馏，该方法在保留RGB信息完整性的同时有效传递了运动知识。实验表明该框架对骨干网络和检测头具有通用性，在不同模型上均取得一致提升。
2303.17285|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the slow inference of two-stream temporal action detection models caused by optical flow dependency, proposing a decomposed cross-modal distillation framework. The authors separately learn RGB and motion representations, then transfer motion knowledge via asymmetric training objectives, with local attentive fusion to exploit multimodal complementarity. Compared to direct distillation, the method preserves RGB information while effectively transferring motion knowledge. Experiments show the framework is agnostic to backbones and detection heads, yielding consistent gains across different models.
2303.17285|v2.assessment: 该工作通过跨模态蒸馏在保持RGB单流推理效率的同时引入运动信息，对视频时序检测有实用价值，但与自动驾驶3D感知任务关联有限。
2303.17285|v2.contribution: 提出了分解式跨模态蒸馏框架，使RGB单流检测器获得运动模态知识。
2303.17285|v2.innovation: 采用双分支非对称训练与局部注意力融合，在保留RGB信息的同时实现运动知识迁移。
2303.17285|v2.result: 框架对骨干和检测头通用，在不同模型上均取得一致性能提升。

2212.04500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自监督视频表示学习仅从零开始重建低层像素特征的问题，提出了掩码视频蒸馏（MVD）框架。作者采用两阶段策略：先预训练图像或视频模型恢复掩码块的低层特征，再以这些特征作为掩码特征建模的目标。研究发现视频教师擅长时序密集任务，图像教师擅长空间密集任务，据此设计了时空协同教学策略。实验表明预训练的视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得了领先性能。
2212.04500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing self-supervised video representation learning that reconstructs only low-level pixel features from scratch, proposing Masked Video Distillation (MVD). The authors adopt a two-stage strategy: first pretrain an image or video model to recover low-level features of masked patches, then use these features as targets for masked feature modeling. They observe that video teachers excel at temporally-heavy tasks while image teachers transfer stronger spatial representations, and design a spatial-temporal co-teaching method. Experiments show the pretrained video transformers achieve leading performance on multiple downstream tasks.
2212.04500|v2.assessment: 该工作通过掩码特征蒸馏改进了自监督视频表示学习范式，对视频理解预训练有重要参考价值，其思想对自动驾驶视频感知预训练亦有启发。
2212.04500|v2.contribution: 提出了两阶段掩码视频蒸馏框架MVD，利用预训练特征作为掩码建模目标。
2212.04500|v2.innovation: 设计时空协同教学策略，同时从视频教师和图像教师蒸馏学生模型。
2212.04500|v2.result: 预训练视频Transformer在多个下游任务上取得领先性能。

2309.04422|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中多种异构视觉任务需要分别设计专用网络的问题，提出了统一模型VTDNet。作者设计了包含十种代表性图像和视频任务的Video Task Decathlon（VTD）挑战，涵盖分类、分割、定位和关联。VTDNet使用单一结构和单套权重处理所有任务，通过任务分组和交互阶段交换信息，并设计了课程训练、伪标签和微调（CPF）方案解决多任务联合训练的性能退化问题。实验表明该统一模型在十项任务上均取得了有竞争力的性能。
2309.04422|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for specialized networks for heterogeneous visual tasks in autonomous driving by proposing a unified model, VTDNet. The authors design the Video Task Decathlon (VTD) challenge comprising ten representative image and video tasks spanning classification, segmentation, localization, and association. VTDNet uses a single structure and weight set for all tasks, grouping similar tasks and employing task interaction stages, with a Curriculum training, Pseudo-labeling, and Fine-tuning (CPF) scheme to mitigate multi-task degradation. Experiments show the unified model achieves competitive performance across all ten tasks.
2309.04422|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了自动驾驶多任务统一感知模型，VTD基准和VTDNet对自动驾驶感知系统设计有重要参考价值，与多相机感知和BEV等方向高度相关。
2309.04422|v2.contribution: 提出了自动驾驶统一多任务网络VTDNet及包含十项任务的VTD基准。
2309.04422|v2.innovation: 通过任务分组、交互阶段和CPF训练方案，用单套权重统一处理十种异构视觉任务。
2309.04422|v2.result: VTDNet在十项图像和视频任务上均取得有竞争力的性能。

TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频异常检测（VAD）中自监督隐私保护的问题，指出现有方法在去除隐私信息时往往损害异常检测性能。作者提出TeD-SPAD方法，利用时间独特性（temporal distinctiveness）作为自监督信号，在特征层面分离隐私相关与异常相关信息。相比已有隐私保护VAD工作，该方法在保持检测精度的同时更好地去除了隐私内容。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法思路对视频理解中的隐私-效用权衡有参考价值。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy preservation in self-supervised video anomaly detection (VAD), where existing methods often degrade detection performance when removing private information. The authors propose TeD-SPAD, which leverages temporal distinctiveness as a self-supervised signal to disentangle privacy-related and anomaly-related features. Compared to prior privacy-preserving VAD approaches, it better balances privacy removal and detection accuracy, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.assessment: 该工作关注视频异常检测中的隐私保护，思路新颖但实验细节在摘要中缺失，需进一步验证其实际效果。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.contribution: 提出利用时间独特性进行自监督隐私保护的视频异常检测框架TeD-SPAD。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.innovation: 将时间独特性作为自监督信号用于分离隐私与异常特征。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但声称在隐私保护与异常检测间取得更好平衡。
TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for S._arxiv_id: TeD-SPAD: Temporal Distinctiveness for Self-supervised Privacy-preservation for video Anomaly Detection.

2309.01380|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于文本的视频问答（Video QA）任务，分析了NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA两个数据集，探究其问题对视觉理解和多帧推理的需求程度。作者使用纯文本模型BERT-QA进行实验，发现其性能与原始多模态方法相当，表明这些数据集在问题设计上存在缺陷，可能过度依赖文本线索而低估了视觉理解。研究还初步探索了域适应方面，但未给出显著改进结果。
2309.01380|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes two text-based video question answering datasets, NewsVideoQA and M4-ViteVQA, examining the degree of visual understanding and multi-frame reasoning required. Experiments with a text-only BERT-QA model show comparable performance to original multimodal methods, revealing shortcomings in dataset formulation. The study also briefly explores domain adaptation but reports no significant improvements.
2309.01380|v2.assessment: 该工作对现有文本视频问答数据集提出了质疑，但方法贡献有限，主要价值在于数据集分析。
2309.01380|v2.contribution: 揭示NewsVideoQA和M4-ViteVQA数据集在问题设计上对视觉理解要求不足的问题。
2309.01380|v2.innovation: 通过纯文本模型BERT-QA的性能对比，证明现有数据集可能被文本线索主导。
2309.01380|v2.result: BERT-QA在两个数据集上达到与原始多模态方法相当的性能，表明数据集存在缺陷。

UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频理解任务中图像ViT模型潜力未被充分挖掘的问题，提出UniFormerV2，旨在将预训练的图像ViT适配到视频领域。方法通过结合局部和全局注意力机制，并引入轻量级时序建模，有效利用图像ViT的预训练知识。相比已有视频模型，UniFormerV2在多个视频理解基准上取得了更优性能，同时保持较高效率。摘要未提供具体数据，但方法在视频动作识别等任务上具有竞争力。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of image ViTs for video understanding by proposing UniFormerV2, which adapts pretrained image ViTs to video tasks. It combines local and global attention with lightweight temporal modeling to leverage image pretraining. Compared to existing video models, UniFormerV2 achieves superior performance on multiple video understanding benchmarks while maintaining efficiency, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.assessment: UniFormerV2有效 bridging 图像ViT与视频理解，方法设计合理，在多个基准上表现优异，值得关注。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.contribution: 提出UniFormerV2，将预训练图像ViT高效适配到视频理解任务。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.innovation: 结合局部-全局注意力与轻量时序建模，充分释放图像ViT在视频领域的潜力。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得优于现有方法的性能，同时保持高效。
UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of._arxiv_id: UniFormerV2: Unlocking the Potential of Image ViTs for Video Understanding.

Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_cn: 针对视频异常理解（Video Anomaly Understanding）缺乏系统性因果评测基准的问题，论文提出了一个综合基准，从"是什么、为什么、如何发生"三个维度评估模型对视频异常的因果理解能力。方法上构建了包含异常类型、原因和演化过程的标注数据集，并设计了对应的评测协议与指标。相比已有仅关注异常检测（二分类/定位）的工作，该基准将评测从"检测到异常"推进到"理解异常成因与机制"。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但基准覆盖多类异常场景并揭示了现有模型在因果推理上的显著不足。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for evaluating causal understanding of video anomalies. It introduces a comprehensive benchmark that assesses models along three dimensions—what, why, and how—by constructing annotations of anomaly types, causes, and evolution, together with tailored evaluation protocols. Unlike prior work focused solely on anomaly detection, it advances evaluation toward causal reasoning about anomalies, revealing substantial deficiencies in current models.
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.assessment: 为视频异常理解提供了首个多维度因果评测框架，对视频理解与安全感知研究者有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知/3D检测）直接相关性有限。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.contribution: 构建了从"是什么、为什么、如何"三方面评测视频异常因果理解的综合基准。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.innovation: 将视频异常评测从检测层面推进到因果理解层面，并设计对应标注与指标。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe.result: 揭示了现有模型在视频异常因果推理上的明显不足（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehe._arxiv_id: Uncovering what, why and How: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Causation Understanding of Video Anomaly.

A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_cn: 针对点云视频理解中缺乏以人为中心的统一建模框架的问题，论文提出了一个统一框架用于人体中心的点云视频理解。方法上设计了统一的表示与网络结构，将点云序列中的人体动作/交互建模整合到单一框架中，支持多种下游任务。相比已有分别针对单帧点云或独立任务的方法，该框架强调时序点云中人体动态的统一处理。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但框架在多个以人为中心的任务上进行了验证。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.summary_en: This paper tackles the absence of a unified framework for human-centric point cloud video understanding. It proposes a unified representation and network architecture that models human motion and interaction in point cloud sequences, supporting multiple downstream tasks. Unlike prior methods handling single-frame point clouds or isolated tasks, it unifies temporal human-centric point cloud processing, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.assessment: 为点云视频中以人为中心的建模提供统一思路，对3D感知与视频理解交叉方向有启发，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线相关度中等。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.contribution: 提出了以人为中心的点云视频理解统一框架。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.innovation: 将时序点云中的人体动态建模统一到单一框架以支持多任务。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po.result: 在多个以人为中心的点云视频任务上验证了框架有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
A Unified Framework for Human-centric Po._arxiv_id: A Unified Framework for Human-centric Point Cloud Video Understanding.

Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_cn: 针对视频异常检测（VAD）只能识别训练时见过的异常类别、无法泛化到开放类别的问题，论文提出了开放词汇视频异常检测（Open-Vocabulary VAD）任务。方法上利用视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的开放词汇能力，将异常检测从闭集分类扩展到基于文本描述的开放类别识别。相比传统闭集VAD方法，该工作使模型能够检测并识别训练中未出现的异常类型。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但任务设定与基于VLM的方法为开放世界异常检测提供了新范式。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of video anomaly detection (VAD) methods that can only recognize anomaly classes seen during training. It introduces the Open-Vocabulary VAD task and leverages vision-language models to detect and identify anomalies beyond the closed training set via textual descriptions. This extends VAD from closed-set classification to open-world recognition, offering a new paradigm though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..assessment: 将开放词汇设定引入视频异常检测，与Open-set Detection及VLM方向契合，对开放世界感知研究者有参考价值。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..contribution: 提出开放词汇视频异常检测任务并给出基于视觉-语言模型的解决方案。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..innovation: 借助VLM的开放词汇能力实现训练未见异常类别的检测与识别。
Open-Vocabulary Video Anomaly Detection..result: 在开放词汇设定下实现了对未见异常类别的检测（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶安全感知中缺乏对事故场景因果理解的问题，论文提出了基于溯因推理（Abductive）的自我视角事故视频理解任务与数据集。方法上构建了第一人称行车事故视频数据集，并设计溯因推理框架，要求模型从观测到的碰撞结果反推可能的原因与责任因素。相比已有仅做事故检测或描述的工作，该工作强调对事故成因的因果推断。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但任务设定直接服务于安全驾驶感知。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.summary_en: This paper targets the lack of causal understanding of accident scenarios in autonomous driving safety perception. It introduces an abductive ego-view accident video understanding task and dataset, requiring models to infer plausible causes from observed collision outcomes. Unlike prior work on accident detection or captioning, it emphasizes causal abductive reasoning, directly serving safe driving perception, though specific results are not provided in the abstract.
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.assessment: 将溯因推理引入行车事故视频理解，与自动驾驶安全感知高度契合，对因果推理与驾驶场景理解研究者有较强参考价值。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.contribution: 提出溯因式自我视角事故视频理解任务并构建相应数据集。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.innovation: 从碰撞结果反推事故成因的溯因推理框架用于安全驾驶感知。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders.result: 为事故场景因果理解提供了新任务与数据支撑（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Unders._arxiv_id: Abductive Ego-View Accident Video Understanding for Safe Driving Perception.

MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）在长视频理解中受限于上下文长度、难以处理长时序信息的问题，论文提出了记忆增强的大型多模态模型MA-LMM。方法上引入长期记忆库，将历史视频特征压缩存储并支持后续检索与融合，从而在不增加上下文长度的情况下处理长视频。相比直接扩展上下文窗口或稀疏采样的方法，MA-LMM通过记忆机制更高效地保留长时序信息。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但在长视频理解基准上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of long-term video understanding in large multimodal models (LMMs) caused by limited context length. It proposes MA-LMM, a memory-augmented LMM that stores compressed historical video features in a long-term memory bank for later retrieval and fusion, enabling long video processing without expanding context. Compared with context-extension or sparse-sampling approaches, it preserves long-term temporal information more efficiently, achieving strong results on long-video benchmarks though specific numbers are not given in the abstract.
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.assessment: 记忆增强机制为长视频多模态理解提供了高效方案，对视频理解与多模态大模型研究者有较高参考价值。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.contribution: 提出记忆增强的大型多模态模型MA-LMM用于长视频理解。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.innovation: 通过长期记忆库压缩存储并检索历史视频特征以突破上下文长度限制。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda.result: 在长视频理解基准上优于现有方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimoda._arxiv_id: MA-LMM: Memory-Augmented Large Multimodal Model for Long-Term Video Understanding.

TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型在长视频理解中缺乏时间敏感性、难以精确定位时间戳的问题，论文提出了时间敏感的多模态大语言模型TimeChat。方法上设计了时间感知的视频编码与时间戳定位机制，使模型能够根据查询在长视频中定位相关时间段并生成带时间戳的描述。相比通用视频LLM，TimeChat强调对时间信息的显式建模与利用。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但在时间定位与长视频问答等任务上取得了领先性能。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of temporal sensitivity in multimodal LLMs for long video understanding, where precise timestamp localization is difficult. It proposes TimeChat, a time-sensitive multimodal LLM with temporal-aware video encoding and timestamp localization mechanisms, enabling query-based temporal grounding and timestamped captioning. Unlike general video LLMs, it explicitly models temporal information, achieving leading performance on temporal grounding and long-video QA though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.assessment: 显式时间建模提升了长视频多模态理解的时间定位能力，对视频理解与多模态大模型研究者有较高参考价值。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.contribution: 提出时间敏感的多模态大语言模型TimeChat用于长视频理解。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.innovation: 通过时间感知编码与时间戳定位机制显式建模视频时间信息。
TimeChat: A Time-sensitive Multimodal La.result: 在时间定位与长视频问答任务上取得领先性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
