Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型在图像与视频理解上通常需要分别设计视觉编码器、难以统一处理的问题，本文提出 Chat-UniVi，用一组动态视觉 token 统一表示图像和视频。方法通过多尺度 token 聚合与动态 token 合并，在有限上下文长度下同时保留空间细节与时间动态，并可直接接入通用 LLM 进行联合训练。相比此前图像/视频分离的方案，它在图像与视频基准上同时取得提升，在部分视频问答与图像理解任务上超过专门化模型。该工作为统一视觉-语言表示提供了简洁有效的范式。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of multimodal LLMs that require separate visual encoders for images and videos. Chat-UniVi represents both modalities with a unified set of dynamic visual tokens via multi-scale aggregation and token merging, preserving spatial detail and temporal dynamics within a bounded context. It improves over modality-specific baselines on both image and video benchmarks, offering a simple unified visual-language paradigm.
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.assessment: 统一图像与视频表示的思路简洁且实用，对多模态感知与视频理解方向有参考价值。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.contribution: 提出用统一动态视觉 token 同时支撑图像与视频理解的多模态大模型框架。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.innovation: 多尺度 token 聚合与动态合并，在有限上下文内兼顾空间细节与时间动态。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio.result: 在图像与视频多项基准上同时超越模态专用方法。
Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representatio._arxiv_id: Chat-UniVi: Unified Visual Representation Empowers Large Language Models with Image and Video Understanding.

HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_cn: 针对视频场景图生成中对象关系随时间和层级变化难以建模的问题，本文提出分层交错图（HIG）方法。方法构建跨帧的对象节点与关系边，通过分层交错机制同时捕捉短时交互与长时依赖，并生成动态场景图。相比逐帧独立或简单时序聚合的已有方法，HIG 在视频场景图生成基准上取得更优的关系预测精度。该工作为视频结构化理解提供了图建模思路。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.summary_en: This paper tackles video scene graph generation where object relations evolve over time and hierarchy. The proposed Hierarchical Interlacement Graph (HIG) builds cross-frame object and relation nodes with a hierarchical interlacement mechanism to capture both short-term interactions and long-term dependencies. It outperforms per-frame and simple temporal aggregation baselines on video scene graph benchmarks.
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.assessment: 视频场景图生成属于视频理解的结构化分支，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.contribution: 提出分层交错图结构用于视频场景图生成。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.innovation: 分层交错机制联合建模短时交互与长时依赖。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap.result: 在视频场景图基准上关系预测精度优于已有方法。
HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Ap._arxiv_id: HIG: Hierarchical Interlacement Graph Approach to Scene Graph Generation in Video Understanding.

A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_cn: 针对第一人称视角视频中多任务理解缺乏统一视角的问题，本文提出将多种任务技能视为可组合的“背包”，实现跨任务的第一人称视频理解。方法通过任务条件化的表示学习与技能组合，使单一模型能适配不同下游任务。相比单任务专用模型，该方法在多任务设定下取得更好的泛化与迁移表现。该工作为第一人称视频的多任务学习提供了新视角。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-task egocentric video understanding by treating diverse task skills as a composable 'backpack'. A task-conditioned representation learning and skill composition scheme enables a single model to adapt across downstream tasks. It improves generalization and transfer over single-task specialized models in multi-task settings.
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.assessment: 多任务第一人称视频理解思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性较弱。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.contribution: 提出任务技能可组合的背包式第一人称视频多任务理解框架。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.innovation: 以任务条件化技能组合实现跨任务统一建模。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi.result: 在多任务设定下泛化与迁移表现优于单任务模型。
A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Vi._arxiv_id: A Backpack Full of Skills: Egocentric Video Understanding with Diverse Task Perspectives.

MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中密集 token 导致上下文爆炸、现有方法难以处理超长视频的问题，本文提出 MovieChat，将密集 token 转化为稀疏记忆。方法借鉴记忆机制，用短期记忆保留细节、长期记忆压缩全局信息，从而在固定预算下处理长视频。相比直接截断或均匀采样的方法，MovieChat 在长视频问答基准上显著提升，并支持远超训练长度的视频输入。该工作为长视频理解提供了可扩展的记忆范式。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.summary_en: This paper targets long-video understanding where dense tokens explode the context. MovieChat converts dense tokens into sparse memory, using short-term memory for local detail and long-term memory for global compression under a fixed budget. It substantially improves long-video QA benchmarks and supports inputs far beyond training length, offering a scalable memory paradigm.
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.assessment: 稀疏记忆机制对长时序视频理解有实用价值，可启发自动驾驶长序列感知。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.contribution: 提出基于稀疏记忆的长视频理解框架 MovieChat。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.innovation: 用短期/长期记忆将密集 token 压缩为稀疏表示。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me.result: 在长视频问答基准上显著提升并支持超长输入。
MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Me._arxiv_id: MovieChat: From Dense Token to Sparse Memory for Long Video Understanding.

OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务多样、通常需要任务专用架构的问题，本文提出 OmniViD，一个面向通用视频理解的生成式框架。方法将多种视频任务统一为生成式序列建模，用共享的编码器-解码器处理分类、定位、描述等任务。相比任务专用模型，OmniViD 在多个视频基准上以单一模型取得有竞争力的结果，展现出通用性。该工作推动了视频理解的统一建模范式。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.summary_en: This paper addresses the task-specific nature of video understanding architectures by proposing OmniViD, a generative framework for universal video understanding. It unifies diverse video tasks as generative sequence modeling with a shared encoder-decoder. A single model achieves competitive results across multiple video benchmarks, advancing unified video modeling.
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.assessment: 统一生成式视频理解框架具有通用性价值，对多任务感知有借鉴意义。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.contribution: 提出统一生成式框架 OmniViD 覆盖多种视频理解任务。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.innovation: 将多类视频任务统一为共享编码器-解码器的生成式建模。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ.result: 单一模型在多个视频基准上取得有竞争力结果。
OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Univ._arxiv_id: OmniViD: A Generative Framework for Universal Video Understanding.

Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_cn: 针对组合式视频理解中时空结构难以显式建模的问题，本文提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 方法。方法通过显式编码对象、动作及其时空组合关系，增强模型对组合语义的推理能力。相比仅依赖整体视频特征的基线，该方法在组合式视频理解基准上取得更好表现。该工作强调了结构先验在视频组合推理中的作用。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.summary_en: This paper targets compositional video understanding where spatiotemporal structure is hard to model explicitly. It proposes a spatiotemporal structure-based Transformer that encodes objects, actions, and their compositional relations to enhance reasoning. It outperforms holistic-feature baselines on compositional video understanding benchmarks, highlighting the role of structural priors.
Compositional Video Understanding with S.assessment: 显式时空结构建模对组合推理有启发，但与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.contribution: 提出基于时空结构的 Transformer 用于组合式视频理解。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.innovation: 显式编码对象-动作时空组合关系以增强推理。
Compositional Video Understanding with S.result: 在组合式视频理解基准上优于整体特征基线。
Compositional Video Understanding with S._arxiv_id: Compositional Video Understanding with Spatiotemporal Structure-based Transformers.

Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，本文提出"先对齐再适应"（Align Before Adapt）框架，利用实体到区域的显式对齐来增强视频表征的泛化性。方法通过将视频中的实体（如物体、人物）与对应空间区域建立对齐关系，再基于此进行模型适应，而非直接端到端微调。相比已有工作，该方法强调对齐先于适应，提升了跨域迁移的鲁棒性。在多个视频动作识别基准上取得了优于现有方法的泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited generalization of video action recognition in cross-domain scenarios by proposing an 'Align Before Adapt' framework that leverages explicit entity-to-region alignments. Instead of direct end-to-end fine-tuning, the method first establishes correspondences between entities and spatial regions, then adapts the model accordingly. It achieves improved cross-domain generalization on multiple video action recognition benchmarks.
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.assessment: 该工作将实体-区域对齐引入视频动作识别，思路清晰，对跨域泛化有实际价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其在大规模场景下的可扩展性。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.contribution: 提出实体到区域对齐驱动的"先对齐再适应"视频动作识别框架。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.innovation: 将对齐机制前置到模型适应之前，显式建模实体与空间区域的对应关系。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to.result: 在多个视频动作识别基准上取得优于现有方法的跨域泛化性能。
Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to._arxiv_id: Align Before Adapt: Leveraging Entity-to-Region Alignments for Generalizable Video Action Recognition.

Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_cn: 针对开放式视频问答（Video QA）中标签不足的问题，本文提出排序蒸馏（Ranking Distillation）方法。核心思路是利用模型对候选答案的相对排序信息进行知识蒸馏，而非依赖完整标注，从而在标签稀缺条件下提升问答性能。相比传统监督学习，该方法能更有效地利用未标注或弱标注数据。实验表明在标签不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得了显著提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the insufficient-label problem in open-ended video question answering by proposing a Ranking Distillation approach. Instead of relying on complete annotations, it distills relative ranking information among candidate answers to improve QA performance under label scarcity. Experiments demonstrate notable gains on open-ended video QA benchmarks with limited labels.
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.assessment: 将排序蒸馏引入视频问答的标签稀缺场景，方法新颖且实用，对弱监督视频理解有参考价值。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.contribution: 提出面向标签不足开放式视频问答的排序蒸馏方法。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.innovation: 利用候选答案间的相对排序信息进行知识蒸馏，缓解标签稀缺问题。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide.result: 在标签不足的开放式视频问答任务上取得显著性能提升。
Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Vide._arxiv_id: Ranking Distillation for Open-Ended Video Question Answering with Insufficient Labels.

Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_cn: 针对视频问答中视觉与语言模态对齐不充分的问题，本文提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏（Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation）方法。通过将语言语义信息蒸馏到视觉表征中，增强视觉特征对问题语义的感知能力，从而提升视频问答的准确性。相比已有方法，该工作强调语言引导下的视觉语义提炼。在视频问答基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient vision-language alignment in video question answering by proposing a Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation method. It distills linguistic semantics into visual representations to enhance question-aware visual features, improving QA accuracy. Competitive results are achieved on video QA benchmarks.
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.assessment: 语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏思路合理，对多模态视频理解有借鉴意义，但需关注其与现有蒸馏方法的差异化。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.contribution: 提出语言感知的视觉语义蒸馏方法用于视频问答。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.innovation: 将语言语义蒸馏到视觉表征中以增强问题感知能力。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat.result: 在视频问答基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillat._arxiv_id: Language-aware Visual Semantic Distillation for Video Question Answering.

E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_cn: 针对零样本时空视频定位（Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding）任务，本文提出E3M框架，利用期望最大化（EM）多模态调制实现零样本定位。方法通过EM算法迭代优化多模态特征调制，无需目标域标注即可定位视频中的时空目标。相比已有零样本方法，E3M在多模态融合与迭代优化上更具优势。实验表明在零样本时空视频定位任务上取得了良好效果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.summary_en: This paper proposes E3M, a zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding framework using Expectation-Maximization multimodal modulation. It iteratively optimizes multimodal feature modulation via EM to localize targets without target-domain annotations. Experiments show favorable results on zero-shot spatio-temporal video grounding.
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.assessment: 将EM算法用于零样本时空视频定位的多模态调制，方法有创新性，对零样本视频理解有参考价值。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.contribution: 提出基于EM多模态调制的零样本时空视频定位框架E3M。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.innovation: 利用期望最大化算法迭代优化多模态特征调制实现零样本定位。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro.result: 在零样本时空视频定位任务上取得良好效果。
E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Gro._arxiv_id: E3M: Zero-Shot Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding with Expectation-Maximization Multimodal Modulation.

🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中信息冗余与上下文丢失的问题，本文提出VideoAgent，一种记忆增强的多模态智能体框架。通过构建记忆模块存储和检索关键视频片段与多模态信息，智能体能够高效地进行视频理解与推理。相比传统端到端视频模型，VideoAgent在长视频场景下更具可扩展性和推理能力。在多个视频理解基准上取得了优异表现。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.summary_en: This paper introduces VideoAgent, a memory-augmented multimodal agent for video understanding. By maintaining and retrieving key video segments and multimodal information via a memory module, the agent efficiently performs video reasoning. It achieves strong performance on multiple video understanding benchmarks, especially for long videos.
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.assessment: 将智能体与记忆机制引入视频理解，契合当前多模态大模型趋势，对长视频推理有重要参考价值。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.contribution: 提出记忆增强的多模态智能体框架VideoAgent用于视频理解。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.innovation: 通过记忆模块存储与检索关键视频片段，增强长视频推理能力。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得优异表现。
🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimo._arxiv_id: 🤖 VideoAgent: A Memory-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Video Understanding.

2407.21757|v2.summary_cn: 针对叙事视频（如电影）理解中角色、对话、剧情等丰富上下文带来的挑战，本文提出MovieSeq多模态语言模型。核心思想是将视频表示为交错的多元序列（图像、情节、视频、字幕），通过链接外部知识库或离线模型（如Whisper提取字幕）构建输入，并利用指令微调让语言模型以交错多模态指令与视频交互。相比仅以视频为输入的方法，MovieSeq联合提供角色照片、姓名与对话，使模型能关联多元素并生成更全面回答。在LVU、MAD、Movienet、CMD、TVC、MovieQA六个数据集、五种设置（视频分类、音频描述、视频-文本检索、视频字幕、视频问答）上验证了有效性。
2407.21757|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MovieSeq, a multimodal language model for understanding narrative videos such as movies, which pose challenges due to rich contexts (characters, dialogues, storylines). It represents videos as interleaved multimodal sequences (images, plots, videos, subtitles) built via external knowledge bases or offline models (e.g., Whisper), and uses instruction-tuning to enable interaction with interleaved multimodal instructions. MovieSeq is validated on six datasets (LVU, MAD, Movienet, CMD, TVC, MovieQA) across five settings (video classification, audio description, video-text retrieval, video captioning, video QA).
2407.21757|v2.assessment: 将视频表示为交错多模态序列并指令微调，思路新颖，覆盖多数据集多任务，对叙事视频理解有重要推动。
2407.21757|v2.contribution: 提出将视频表示为交错多模态序列的MovieSeq多模态语言模型。
2407.21757|v2.innovation: 通过链接外部知识库与离线模型构建交错多模态指令，实现角色-对话-视频的联合理解。
2407.21757|v2.result: 在六个数据集、五种设置上验证了有效性。

InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏统一大规模基础模型的问题，提出InternVideo2，通过渐进式训练范式将视频编码器、跨模态对齐与LLM解码器统一到一个框架中。方法上采用掩码视频建模、多阶段对比学习与指令微调，将视频、音频、文本信号联合建模。相比此前InternVideo等，模型规模与数据量显著扩大，覆盖识别、检索、长视频问答等任务。在多个视频理解基准上取得SOTA，如长视频QA与动作识别任务上均有明显提升。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified large-scale foundation model for multimodal video understanding by proposing InternVideo2, which integrates a video encoder, cross-modal alignment, and an LLM decoder within a progressive training paradigm. It combines masked video modeling, multi-stage contrastive learning, and instruction tuning to jointly model video, audio, and text. Compared with prior InternVideo work, it substantially scales up model and data size and covers recognition, retrieval, and long-video QA. It achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video understanding benchmarks.
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.assessment: 作为视频多模态基础模型的系统性工作，规模与任务覆盖度突出，对自动驾驶中视频理解与多模态感知有参考价值。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.contribution: 提出统一的渐进式多模态视频基础模型InternVideo2，覆盖编码、对齐与解码全流程。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.innovation: 将掩码视频建模、跨模态对比与LLM指令微调统一到渐进式训练框架中。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得SOTA，长视频问答与动作识别性能显著提升。
InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models._arxiv_id: InternVideo2: Scaling Foundation Models for Multimodal Video Understanding.

2311.17893|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督视频目标分割依赖辅助模态或迭代slot attention导致通用性差、计算开销大的问题，提出利用DINO预训练Transformer中固有的结构依赖建立时空对应关系。方法上仅用一个时空Transformer块处理逐帧DINO特征，通过自注意力建立时空依赖，再对注意力图做层次聚类生成分割掩码。相比依赖光流或slot attention的已有方法，架构更简洁且无需额外模态。在无监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割结果。
2311.17893|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited generality and high computational cost of self-supervised video object segmentation caused by reliance on auxiliary modalities or iterative slot attention. It leverages the inherent structural dependencies in DINO-pretrained Transformers to establish spatio-temporal correspondences, using a single spatio-temporal Transformer block over frame-wise DINO features and hierarchical clustering on attention maps to produce masks. Compared with prior methods requiring optical flow or slot attention, the architecture is simpler and modality-free. It achieves competitive segmentation results on self-supervised VOS benchmarks.
2311.17893|v2.assessment: 思路简洁优雅，揭示了DINO注意力中隐含的objectness，对自监督视频分割与注意力机制研究有启发。
2311.17893|v2.contribution: 提出一种仅依赖DINO注意力对应关系的简洁自监督视频目标分割框架。
2311.17893|v2.innovation: 用单个时空Transformer块加层次聚类替代辅助模态与slot attention。
2311.17893|v2.result: 在自监督VOS基准上取得有竞争力的分割性能。

2407.03788|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-文本对不完全对齐以及概念分布不均导致跨模态表示不准确、冷门概念下游性能差的问题，提出MAMA框架。方法上采用带减法角度间隔的对比目标正则化跨模态表示，并用MLP参数化的加权函数将损失值映射为样本权重以动态调整训练关注。训练由少量无偏元数据引导，并借助大视觉语言模型生成视频-文本数据增强。在常见视频-语言基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。
2407.03788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imperfect video-text alignment and uneven concept distribution that degrade cross-modal representations and downstream performance on unpopular concepts. It proposes MAMA, which uses a contrastive objective with a subtractive angular margin to regularize cross-modal similarity and an MLP-parameterized weighting function mapping loss values to sample weights for dynamic focus adjustment. Training is guided by a small amount of unbiased meta-data and augmented with video-text data generated by a large vision-language model. It achieves superior performance on common video-language benchmarks.
2407.03788|v2.assessment: 从数据质量与概念分布角度改进视频-语言表示学习，元优化加权思路有一定新意，但整体影响力有限。
2407.03788|v2.contribution: 提出带减法角度间隔与元优化样本加权的视频-语言对比学习框架MAMA。
2407.03788|v2.innovation: 用MLP参数化加权函数根据损失动态调整样本权重以缓解概念分布不均。
2407.03788|v2.result: 在常见视频-语言基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2412.12075|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频理解中现有基准多依赖全局语义、缺乏对细粒度线索定位能力评估的问题，本文提出 CG-Bench。该基准要求模型基于视频中的具体线索（clue）进行问答，并设计了多轮交互与线索定位的评测协议。相比传统 VideoQA 基准，CG-Bench 更强调时序定位与证据推理，能区分模型是否真正理解长视频内容。实验显示当前最强多模态模型在该基准上准确率显著低于人类水平，揭示了长视频细粒度理解的巨大差距。
2412.12075|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces CG-Bench, a clue-grounded question answering benchmark for long video understanding. It requires models to answer questions by localizing specific temporal clues within long videos, going beyond global semantic matching. Experiments show that state-of-the-art multimodal models substantially underperform humans, exposing a large gap in fine-grained long-video reasoning.
2412.12075|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了长视频理解中线索定位评估的空白，对多模态视频理解研究者有较高参考价值。
2412.12075|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于线索定位的长视频问答基准 CG-Bench。
2412.12075|v2.innovation: 将问答与视频中的细粒度时序线索定位显式结合，并设计多轮交互评测协议。
2412.12075|v2.result: 当前最强多模态模型在该基准上准确率远低于人类，揭示了长视频细粒度理解的显著差距。

2502.10810|v2.summary_cn: 针对流式视频理解中缺乏多轮时序对话评测的问题，本文提出 SVBench。该基准包含时序多轮对话，模拟真实场景中用户随时间推移连续提问的交互模式。相比静态视频问答基准，SVBench 要求模型在流式输入下保持对话一致性与时序推理能力。实验表明现有视频大模型在多轮流式对话中性能明显下降，尤其在长时序依赖和指代消解方面。
2502.10810|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SVBench, a benchmark with temporal multi-turn dialogues for streaming video understanding. It evaluates models under continuous video streams where users ask questions over time, requiring temporal reasoning and dialogue consistency. Results show that existing video LLMs degrade notably in multi-turn streaming settings, especially on long-range dependencies and coreference.
2502.10810|v2.assessment: 该工作为流式视频多轮对话提供了系统评测，对视频对话系统研究者有参考意义。
2502.10810|v2.contribution: 构建了面向流式视频理解的时序多轮对话基准 SVBench。
2502.10810|v2.innovation: 将多轮对话与流式视频输入结合，评测模型的时序一致性与指代消解能力。
2502.10810|v2.result: 现有视频大模型在多轮流式对话中性能显著下降，尤其在长时序依赖场景。

TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对交通场景中缺乏统一时空视频理解基准的问题，本文提出 TUMTraf VideoQA 数据集与基准。该数据集涵盖多视角交通视频，并设计了统一的时空问答任务，包括目标行为、交互与场景推理。相比已有交通数据集，TUMTraf VideoQA 强调跨视角与跨时间的联合理解。实验表明现有 VLM 在交通场景时空推理上仍有较大提升空间。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces TUMTraf VideoQA, a dataset and benchmark for unified spatio-temporal video understanding in traffic scenes. It provides multi-view traffic videos with QA tasks covering object behavior, interaction, and scene reasoning across space and time. Experiments reveal that current VLMs still struggle with spatio-temporal reasoning in traffic scenarios.
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.assessment: 该工作将视频问答引入交通场景，对自动驾驶多模态感知与推理研究者有较高价值。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了面向交通场景的统一时空视频问答数据集与基准 TUMTraf VideoQA。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.innovation: 将多视角交通视频与时空问答任务统一，强调跨视角跨时间的联合推理。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f.result: 现有 VLM 在交通场景时空推理任务上表现有限，仍有较大提升空间。
TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark f._arxiv_id: TUMTraf VideoQA: Dataset and Benchmark for Unified Spatio-Temporal Video Understanding in Traffic Scenes.

Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_cn: 针对 4D 点云视频理解中时空建模效率低的问题，本文提出 Mamba4D。该方法利用解耦的空间-时间状态空间模型，分别对点云的空间结构与时间动态进行建模，避免全时空注意力的高计算开销。相比基于 Transformer 的方法，Mamba4D 在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量。实验在多个 4D 点云基准上取得竞争性或更优性能，并大幅提升推理效率。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.summary_en: This paper proposes Mamba4D for efficient 4D point cloud video understanding using disentangled spatial-temporal state space models. It separately models spatial structure and temporal dynamics, avoiding the high cost of full spatio-temporal attention. Experiments show competitive accuracy with substantially improved efficiency on multiple 4D point cloud benchmarks.
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.assessment: 该工作将状态空间模型引入 4D 点云视频理解，对点云视频与高效时序建模研究者有启发。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.contribution: 提出了基于解耦时空状态空间模型的 4D 点云视频理解方法 Mamba4D。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.innovation: 将 Mamba 状态空间模型解耦为空间与时间分支，高效建模 4D 点云视频。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video.result: 在多个 4D 点云基准上取得竞争性精度，同时显著降低计算量并提升推理效率。
Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video._arxiv_id: Mamba4D: Efficient 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding with Disentangled Spatial-Temporal State Space Models.

Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_cn: 针对预训练 3D 模型难以直接迁移到点云视频理解的问题，本文提出跨帧时空感知适配方法。该方法在冻结预训练 3D 模型的基础上，引入跨帧时空模块以捕捉点云序列的动态信息。相比从头训练或简单微调，该方法在多个点云视频任务上取得更好性能，并减少训练成本。实验验证了预训练 3D 模型在视频理解中的可迁移性。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.summary_en: This paper adapts pre-trained 3D models for point cloud video understanding via cross-frame spatio-temporal perception. It freezes the pre-trained 3D backbone and introduces cross-frame modules to capture temporal dynamics. Experiments show improved performance on multiple point cloud video tasks with reduced training cost.
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.assessment: 该工作探索了预训练 3D 模型向点云视频理解的迁移，对点云自监督与视频理解研究者有参考价值。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.contribution: 提出了将预训练 3D 模型适配到点云视频理解的跨帧时空感知方法。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.innovation: 在冻结 3D 预训练模型上引入跨帧时空模块，实现高效迁移。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point.result: 在多个点云视频任务上优于从头训练或简单微调，并降低训练成本。
Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point._arxiv_id: Adapting Pre-trained 3D Models for Point Cloud Video Understanding via Cross-frame Spatio-temporal Perception.

2503.18223|v2.summary_cn: 针对野生动物行为监测中缺乏标注视频数据集的问题，本文提出 MammAlps。该数据集来自瑞士国家公园 9 个相机陷阱，包含超过 14 小时带音频视频、2D 分割图和 8.5 小时个体轨迹标注。基于 6135 个单动物片段，作者提出首个分层多模态动物行为识别基准，并设计多视角长期生态事件识别任务。实验表明多模态输入有助于提升行为识别性能。
2503.18223|v2.summary_en: This paper presents MammAlps, a multimodal and multi-view dataset for wildlife behavior monitoring from 9 camera traps in the Swiss National Park. It contains over 14 hours of video with audio, 2D segmentation maps, and 8.5 hours of individual tracks. The authors propose hierarchical multimodal behavior recognition and multi-view ecological event benchmarks, showing benefits of multimodal inputs.
2503.18223|v2.assessment: 该数据集为多模态视频理解提供了新场景，对生态监测与视频行为识别研究者有参考价值。
2503.18223|v2.contribution: 构建了多模态多视角野生动物行为监测数据集 MammAlps 及配套基准。
2503.18223|v2.innovation: 结合音频、视频与场景分割图，提出分层多模态动物行为识别与生态事件基准。
2503.18223|v2.result: 多模态输入有助于提升动物行为识别性能，数据集包含 14 小时视频与 8.5 小时轨迹标注。

2412.04467|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言模型中视觉token数量远超文本token，带来巨大计算开销，而CLIP/SigLIP等编码器产生的视觉token存在显著冗余。本文提出VisionZip，通过选择信息量高的token输入语言模型，减少冗余并提升效率。相比此前SOTA方法，在几乎所有设置下性能提升至少5%，预填充时间加速8倍，使LLaVA-Next 13B推理速度快于7B且效果更好。该方法适用于图像和视频理解及多轮对话场景。
2412.04467|v2.summary_en: Vision-language models suffer from excessive visual token length and redundancy from encoders like CLIP and SigLIP. VisionZip selects informative tokens to feed the language model, reducing redundancy while maintaining performance. It outperforms prior state-of-the-art by at least 5% across nearly all settings and achieves 8x faster prefilling, enabling LLaVA-Next 13B to infer faster than the 7B variant with better results.
2412.04467|v2.assessment: 该工作针对VLM效率瓶颈提出简洁有效的token选择策略，实验充分且加速效果显著，对多模态大模型部署有实用价值。
2412.04467|v2.contribution: 提出VisionZip，通过选择信息量高的视觉token减少冗余，显著提升VLM推理效率。
2412.04467|v2.innovation: 发现视觉token冗余并设计简单有效的token选择方法，兼容图像与视频任务。
2412.04467|v2.result: 性能提升至少5%，预填充时间加速8倍，13B模型推理快于7B且效果更优。

2503.21483|v2.summary_cn: 大型视频语言模型受限于上下文窗口，传统均匀帧采样在长视频中常将资源分配给无关内容。本文提出BOLT，无需额外训练，通过研究帧选择策略提升长视频理解。作者提出多源检索评估设置，发现逆变换采样效果最佳，在Video-MME上准确率从53.8%提升至56.1%，MLVU从58.9%提升至63.4%。
2503.21483|v2.summary_en: Large video-language models are constrained by limited context windows, and uniform frame sampling often allocates resources to irrelevant content. BOLT boosts VLMs without training by studying frame selection strategies, proposing a multi-source retrieval evaluation setting. Inverse transform sampling yields the best results, improving Video-MME accuracy from 53.8% to 56.1% and MLVU from 58.9% to 63.4%.
2503.21483|v2.assessment: 该工作以无需训练的方式提升长视频理解，帧选择策略分析有启发性，但方法相对简单，性能提升幅度有限。
2503.21483|v2.contribution: 提出BOLT，通过逆变换采样等帧选择策略无需训练地提升长视频VLM理解能力。
2503.21483|v2.innovation: 系统研究帧选择策略并提出多源检索评估设置，发现逆变换采样最有效。

2412.01095|v2.summary_cn: 视频异常检测中，现有VLM方法要么引入专用推理模块，要么依赖指令微调，带来计算或标注开销。本文提出VERA，一种言语化学习框架，无需修改模型参数即可进行可解释VAD。VERA将复杂推理分解为对引导问题的反思，并通过学习器与优化器VLM之间的言语交互优化这些问题。该方法利用粗标注数据，降低了标注需求。
2412.01095|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM-based video anomaly detection methods require specialized reasoning modules or instruction tuning, incurring computational or annotation costs. VERA introduces a verbalized learning framework that performs explainable VAD without model parameter modification, decomposing complex reasoning into reflective guiding questions optimized via verbal interactions between learner and optimizer VLMs using coarsely labeled data.
2412.01095|v2.assessment: 该工作提出无需参数修改的可解释VAD框架，思路新颖，但实验规模和性能提升未在摘要中充分体现。
2412.01095|v2.contribution: 提出VERA，通过言语化学习实现无需参数修改的可解释视频异常检测。
2412.01095|v2.innovation: 将复杂推理分解为可学习的引导问题，通过VLM间言语交互优化。
2412.01095|v2.result: 利用粗标注数据实现可解释VAD，降低计算与标注开销。

2412.03735|v2.summary_cn: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解中易产生幻觉，但该问题在视频领域研究不足。本文提出VidHalluc，目前最大的视频理解幻觉基准，包含5002个配对视频，从动作、时间序列和场景转换三个维度评估幻觉。同时提出无需训练的DINO-HEAL方法，利用DINOv2空间显著性重加权视觉特征，平均减少3.02%的幻觉。
2412.03735|v2.summary_en: Hallucination in video understanding by MLLMs remains underexplored. VidHalluc is the largest benchmark with 5,002 paired videos assessing hallucinations across action, temporal sequence, and scene transition. DINO-HEAL, a training-free method, reweights visual features using DINOv2 spatial saliency, reducing hallucinations by an average of 3.02%.
2412.03735|v2.assessment: 该工作构建了大规模视频幻觉基准并提无需训练缓解方法，对多模态视频理解评估有重要参考价值。
2412.03735|v2.contribution: 提出VidHalluc基准和DINO-HEAL方法，系统评估并缓解视频理解中的幻觉问题。
2412.03735|v2.innovation: 首个大规模视频幻觉基准，从三个维度评估，并利用DINOv2空间显著性重加权特征。
2412.03735|v2.result: VidHalluc包含5002个视频，DINO-HEAL平均减少3.02%的幻觉。

2411.13281|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频分析评估多依赖选择题基准，难以捕捉真实用户复杂需求，且人工标注成本高。本文提出VideoAutoArena，受LMSYS Chatbot Arena启发，通过用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题，自动评估LMM视频分析能力。采用改进ELO评分系统进行公平比较，并通过人工标注金标准验证自动评判与人类判断高度一致。
2411.13281|v2.summary_en: Existing video analysis evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks that fail to capture real-world user demands. VideoAutoArena introduces an arena-style benchmark using user simulation to generate open-ended adaptive questions, with a modified ELO rating system for fair comparison. Validation against human annotations shows strong alignment while maintaining scalability.
2411.13281|v2.assessment: 该工作提出自动化竞技场式视频评估框架，方法新颖且可扩展，但主要贡献在评估而非模型方法。
2411.13281|v2.contribution: 提出VideoAutoArena，通过用户模拟和ELO评分自动评估LMM视频分析能力。
2411.13281|v2.innovation: 将竞技场框架引入视频理解评估，利用用户模拟生成开放式自适应问题。
2411.13281|v2.result: 自动评判与人类判断高度一致，实现可扩展的公平比较。

2412.10360|v2.summary_cn: 视频多模态大模型的设计决策缺乏系统理解，训练和评估成本高昂。本文对视频LMM进行综合研究，发现缩放一致性：小模型和数据集上的设计决策可有效迁移到大模型。基于此，作者探索了视频采样、架构、数据组成、训练计划等方面，例如发现训练时fps采样远优于均匀帧采样，并确定了最佳视频表示视觉编码器。
2412.10360|v2.summary_en: Design decisions in video-LMMs lack systematic understanding due to high computational costs. This work presents a comprehensive study revealing Scaling Consistency, where decisions on smaller models transfer to larger ones. It explores video sampling, architectures, data composition, and training schedules, showing fps sampling during training is vastly preferable to uniform frame sampling and identifying the best vision encoders for video representation.
2412.10360|v2.assessment: 该工作对视频LMM设计空间进行了系统深入的实证研究，缩放一致性发现对社区有重要指导意义，实验充分。
2412.10360|v2.contribution: 系统研究视频LMM设计空间，发现缩放一致性并给出采样、架构、数据等方面的最佳实践。
2412.10360|v2.innovation: 提出缩放一致性现象，使小规模实验可指导大模型设计，并系统探索视频特定设计选择。
2412.10360|v2.result: 发现fps采样优于均匀帧采样，确定最佳视觉编码器，为视频LMM设计提供实证指导。

2504.07745|v2.summary_cn: 针对 Video-LLM 在细粒度视频理解（视觉动态、细节查询）上的不足，提出自监督片段微调方法 SF²T，利用视频内在时空特性构造自监督片段任务进行微调，避免昂贵的人工标注并绕开自然语言难以刻画复杂时空变化的局限。同时构建 FineVidBench 基准，在场景级与片段级两个粒度上系统评估 Video-LLM。相比依赖人工标注的指令微调，该方法以零标注成本提升细粒度理解能力，并提供了更严格的评测协议。
2504.07745|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the weakness of Video-LLMs in fine-grained understanding such as visual dynamics and detail-oriented queries. It proposes SF²T, a self-supervised fragment fine-tuning scheme that exploits intrinsic video characteristics to construct training tasks without labor-intensive annotation, and introduces FineVidBench for scene- and fragment-level evaluation. The approach improves fine-grained video understanding at negligible annotation cost while providing a more rigorous benchmark.
2504.07745|v2.assessment: 对视频多模态理解方向有参考价值，自监督片段微调思路简洁有效，但与本用户关注的自动驾驶感知/3D 检测主线关联较弱。
2504.07745|v2.contribution: 提出自监督片段微调 SF²T 与细粒度视频理解基准 FineVidBench。
2504.07745|v2.innovation: 用视频内在时空特性构造自监督片段任务替代人工标注的细粒度指令微调。
2504.07745|v2.result: 在无需人工标注的情况下显著提升 Video-LLM 的细粒度视频理解能力，并提供场景/片段双粒度评测。

When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_cn: 该论文题为《When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning》，从标题看聚焦于自监督视频表征学习中的时序对应关系建模。但由于提供的摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法、改进点与实验数据。仅从题目推断，其核心是利用时间维度上的预测/对应关系作为自监督信号来学习视频表征。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.summary_en: This paper, titled 'When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning', targets temporal correspondence modeling in self-supervised video representation learning. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific method, improvements, and experimental results cannot be verified. Based on the title alone, it likely leverages temporal prediction/correspondence as a self-supervised pretext signal.
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.assessment: 信息严重不足（摘要缺失），无法可靠评估其方法质量与效果，建议获取全文后再判断。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.contribution: （摘要缺失，无法确认）推测为面向视频表征学习的时序对应自监督方法。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming.innovation: （摘要缺失，无法确认）推测为对时序对应关系的自监督建模策略。
When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming._arxiv_id: When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning.

2411.11934|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目输入合成双目视频这一空间计算/VR 任务中配对立体视频数据稀缺与帧间时空一致性难以保持的问题，提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督立体视频合成范式 SpatialDreamer。方法包含基于深度的视频生成模块 DVG，通过前向-后向渲染机制生成带几何与时间先验的成对视频，并在此基础上提出 RefinerNet 与自监督合成框架进行高效训练，同时设计一致性控制模块维持时空一致性。相比直接将新视角合成技术应用于视频的已有方法，其能更好处理动态场景并降低对大量训练数据的依赖。
2411.11934|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised stereo video synthesis from monocular input, where paired stereo data are scarce and spatio-temporal consistency is hard to maintain. It proposes SpatialDreamer, a video diffusion-based paradigm comprising a depth-based video generation module (DVG) with forward-backward rendering to produce paired videos with geometric and temporal priors, a RefinerNet trained under a self-supervised synthesis framework, and a consistency control module. Unlike prior methods that directly apply novel view synthesis to video, it better handles dynamic scenes and reduces training data requirements.
2411.11934|v2.assessment: 扩散模型+自监督渲染用于立体视频生成的思路较新，对空间计算/VR 有实用价值，但与自动驾驶 BEV/3D 感知主线相关度有限。
2411.11934|v2.contribution: 提出基于视频扩散模型的自监督单目到双目立体视频合成框架 SpatialDreamer。
2411.11934|v2.innovation: 以前向-后向渲染的深度视频生成模块配合一致性控制实现动态场景下的时空一致立体合成。
2411.11934|v2.result: 在缓解立体视频数据不足的同时提升动态场景合成质量与时空一致性。

2506.01037|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于扩散的真实世界视频超分方法因随机性易引入复杂退化和明显伪影的问题，提出结合自监督学习与 Mamba 的噪声鲁棒 VSR 框架。方法在预训练潜扩散模型中引入基于 Video State-Space block 与 3D Selective Scan 的全局时空注意力以低成本增强帧间一致性，并提出自监督 ControlNet，以高分辨率特征为引导、通过对比学习提取对退化不敏感的特征，最后采用 HR-LR 混合的三阶段训练策略稳定训练。在真实世界 VSR 基准上取得优于现有方法的感知质量。
2506.01037|v2.summary_en: To address artifacts and complex degradations introduced by the stochasticity of diffusion-based real-world video super-resolution, this paper proposes a noise-robust VSR framework integrating self-supervised learning and Mamba into pre-trained latent diffusion models. It enhances the diffusion model with a Video State-Space block and 3D Selective Scan for global spatio-temporal attention, introduces a self-supervised ControlNet that uses HR features as guidance and contrastive learning to extract degradation-insensitive features, and adopts a three-stage HR-LR mixed training strategy. It achieves superior perceptual quality over state-of-the-art methods on real-world VSR benchmarks.
2506.01037|v2.assessment: Mamba 时空建模与自监督 ControlNet 的组合在真实世界 VSR 上有效，工程完整度较高，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联偏弱。
2506.01037|v2.contribution: 提出融合自监督 ControlNet 与时空 Mamba 的真实世界视频超分框架。
2506.01037|v2.innovation: 用 Video State-Space block 与 3D Selective Scan 实现低成本全局时空一致性，并以对比学习构建退化不敏感的自监督 ControlNet。
2506.01037|v2.result: 在真实世界 VSR 基准上感知质量优于现有最先进方法。

2601.04068|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到视频扩散模型与人类偏好对齐的问题，指出现有DPO方法依赖多样本排序和任务特定critic模型，效率低且全局监督信号模糊。为此提出LocalDPO后训练框架，通过随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并用冻结基座模型仅修复掩码区域，从而以单次推理自动构建局部化偏好对，无需外部critic或人工标注。训练时引入区域感知DPO损失，将偏好学习限制在损坏区域以加速收敛。在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上实验表明，该方法持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐效果。
2601.04068|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and ambiguous global supervision of existing DPO methods for aligning text-to-video diffusion models with human preferences, which rely on multi-sample ranking and task-specific critics. It proposes LocalDPO, a post-training framework that constructs localized preference pairs by corrupting real videos with random spatio-temporal masks and restoring only masked regions using a frozen base model, requiring a single inference per prompt without external critics or manual annotation. A region-aware DPO loss restricts preference learning to corrupted areas for faster convergence. Experiments on Wan2.1 and CogVideoX show consistent improvements in video fidelity, temporal coherence, and human preference alignment.
2601.04068|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等目标领域几乎无关，属于视频生成与偏好对齐方向，对视觉感知研究者的参考价值有限。
2601.04068|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需critic模型和人工标注、基于局部时空掩码自动构建偏好对的视频扩散模型对齐框架LocalDPO。
2601.04068|v2.innovation: 用随机时空掩码局部破坏真实视频并仅修复掩码区域来构造局部化偏好对，配合区域感知DPO损失实现细粒度对齐。
2601.04068|v2.result: 在Wan2.1和CogVideoX上持续提升视频保真度、时序一致性和人类偏好对齐表现。

2004.07507|v2.summary_cn: 针对含 BatchNorm 层的深度网络在持续学习中的二次惩罚方法失效问题，作者指出 BN 导致样本间依赖，使标准 K-FAC 的 Hessian 近似不再成立。为此扩展 K-FAC 以纳入样本间关系，并提出 BN 统计参数的权重合并与重参数化方法，以及无需源任务数据的超参选择策略。在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 和 ImageNet→细粒度分类的 ResNet-50 序列学习上优于基线，且完全不使用源任务数据。
2004.07507|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the invalidity of K-FAC-based quadratic penalty in continual learning when batch normalization introduces inter-example dependencies. It extends K-FAC to account for inter-example relations, proposes weight merging and reparameterization for BN statistics, and a source-data-free hyperparameter selection scheme. It outperforms baselines on permuted MNIST with BN and ImageNet-to-fine-grained sequential learning with ResNet-50.
2004.07507|v2.assessment: 把持续学习的二阶近似方法从理论到工程都推进了一步，尤其是 BN 统计量处理和无源数据调参对实际部署有参考价值。
2004.07507|v2.contribution: 提出了考虑样本间依赖的扩展 K-FAC 及配套的 BN 参数处理与无源数据超参选择方法。
2004.07507|v2.innovation: 首次指出并修正 BN 导致的样本间依赖对 K-FAC Hessian 近似有效性的破坏。
2004.07507|v2.result: 在带 BN 的 permuted MNIST 与 ImageNet→细粒度 ResNet-50 序列任务上超越基线，且无需源任务数据。

2004.00440|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中分类层需不断扩权、且旧类特征分布发生漂移的问题，本文转向 embedding 网络并研究其增量学习特性。提出语义漂移补偿方法，用当前任务数据经历的漂移来估计旧任务的漂移并加以补偿，无需保存任何 exemplar。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet-Subset 细粒度数据集上验证，embedding 网络的灾难性遗忘显著更轻，且补偿后性能进一步提升。
2004.00440|v2.summary_en: This work studies class-incremental learning for embedding networks, which naturally accommodate new classes without adding weights, and identifies semantic drift of features as a key issue. It proposes a drift estimation and compensation method that infers previous-task drift from current-task drift without any exemplars. Experiments on CIFAR100 and ImageNet-Subset show embedding networks suffer much less catastrophic forgetting and the compensation further improves performance.
2004.00440|v2.assessment: 无 exemplar 的漂移补偿思路简洁有效，对存储受限的增量学习场景有实用价值。
2004.00440|v2.contribution: 提出无需 exemplar 的语义漂移估计与补偿方法，并系统研究了 embedding 网络的增量学习特性。
2004.00440|v2.innovation: 用当前任务数据的特征漂移来近似并补偿旧任务的语义漂移。
2004.00440|v2.result: 在 CIFAR100 与 ImageNet-Subset 上显著缓解遗忘，embedding 网络遗忘程度明显低于分类网络。

2002.00718|v2.summary_cn: 针对语义分割增量学习中背景类像素存在语义分布偏移、导致现有增量方法失效的问题，本文重新审视经典增量学习策略。提出显式建模背景偏移的蒸馏框架，并设计分类器参数初始化策略以抑制对背景类的偏置预测。在 Pascal-VOC 2012 和 ADE20K 上大幅超越当时的增量学习 SOTA。
2002.00718|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles incremental learning for semantic segmentation, identifying that background pixels suffer a semantic distribution shift because each training step only annotates a subset of classes. It proposes a distillation framework that explicitly models this shift and a classifier initialization strategy to avoid biased background predictions. Extensive evaluation on Pascal-VOC 2012 and ADE20K significantly outperforms prior incremental learning methods.
2002.00718|v2.assessment: 抓住了语义分割增量学习中背景偏移这一被忽视的关键问题，方法针对性强，对自动驾驶感知的持续学习有直接借鉴意义。
2002.00718|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模背景语义偏移的蒸馏框架与抗背景偏置的分类器初始化策略。
2002.00718|v2.innovation: 首次将背景类语义分布偏移作为语义分割增量学习的核心问题加以建模。
2002.00718|v2.result: 在 Pascal-VOC 2012 与 ADE20K 上显著优于当时 SOTA 的增量学习方法。

2003.13191|v2.summary_cn: 针对实际应用中增量学习需同时应对灾难性遗忘与旧类新观测带来的概念漂移、且现有方法训练耗时长的问题，本文提出可在在线场景运行的增量学习框架。通过改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习技术处理在线模式下的新类学习，并同时兼顾旧类的新观测。实验表明其性能优于当时的 SOTA 在线增量方法。
2003.13191|v2.summary_en: This paper targets online incremental learning where models must handle both new classes and new observations of old classes under concept drift, while existing methods are slow to retrain. It proposes a framework with a modified cross-distillation loss and a two-step learning technique for the online setting. Experiments show it outperforms state-of-the-art online incremental learning methods.
2003.13191|v2.assessment: 在线增量场景更贴近真实部署，但方法层面的新颖性相对有限，属于问题设定上的推进。
2003.13191|v2.contribution: 提出可同时处理新类与旧类新观测的在线增量学习框架。
2003.13191|v2.innovation: 将改进的交叉蒸馏损失与两步学习结合以适配在线增量场景。
2003.13191|v2.result: 在在线增量学习设定下性能超过当时的 SOTA 方法。

2002.10211|v2.summary_cn: 针对多类增量学习中保留少量旧类样本的有效性高度依赖样本代表性的问题，本文提出 mnemonics 框架，将 exemplar 参数化并端到端可优化。通过模型级与 exemplar 级的双层优化进行训练。在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset 和 ImageNet 三个基准上大幅超越 SOTA，并发现优化出的 exemplar 倾向于落在不同类的决策边界附近。
2002.10211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representativeness bottleneck of exemplar replay in multi-class incremental learning by proposing the mnemonics framework, which parameterizes exemplars and optimizes them end-to-end via bilevel optimization at the model and exemplar levels. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100, ImageNet-Subset and ImageNet surpass state of the art by a large margin, with exemplars tending to lie on class boundaries.
2002.10211|v2.assessment: 把 exemplar 从被动采样变为主动学习，思路新颖且实验扎实，是 exemplar-based 增量学习的重要工作。
2002.10211|v2.contribution: 提出可端到端优化的参数化 exemplar（mnemonics）框架及双层优化训练方式。
2002.10211|v2.innovation: 将 exemplar 选择转化为可学习的双层优化问题，而非启发式采样。
2002.10211|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset、ImageNet 上大幅超越 SOTA，且 exemplar 自发聚集于类边界。

Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究小样本类增量学习（Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning）问题，即模型在仅有少量新类样本的情况下持续扩展类别而不遗忘旧类。摘要信息不完整，无法确认其具体方法与实验细节。从题目看，该工作关注的是增量学习与少样本学习的交叉设定。
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning, where a model must incrementally add novel classes from only a few examples without forgetting old ones. The available abstract is incomplete, so the specific method and experimental results cannot be verified. The work targets the intersection of incremental learning and few-shot learning.

Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.contribution: 面向小样本条件下的类增量学习问题展开研究（具体贡献因摘要缺失无法确认）。
Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning.|v2.innovation: 将少样本学习与类增量学习结合（具体创新点因摘要缺失无法确认）。

1911.07053|v2.summary_cn: ①针对类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，标准DNN在学习新类时容易遗忘旧类，且知识蒸馏（KD）虽能保持旧类判别性，却无法阻止模型将样本误分到新类。②本文提出Weight Aligning（WA）方法，在正常训练后校正最后一层全连接层的偏置权重，并结合KD保持旧类内的判别性。③相比已有工作，WA简单有效，直接解决了FC层权重在增量学习中高度偏向新类的问题，从而维护新旧类之间的公平性。④实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著缓解了灾难性遗忘，提升了增量学习的整体性能。
1911.07053|v2.summary_en: ①This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in class incremental learning, where DNNs tend to misclassify old-class samples into new classes despite knowledge distillation (KD) preserving intra-old-class discrimination. ②It proposes Weight Aligning (WA), which corrects the biased weights in the last fully connected layer after normal training, combined with KD to maintain discrimination. ③Unlike prior work, WA directly addresses the highly biased FC weights that cause forgetting, ensuring fairness between old and new classes. ④Experiments show significant mitigation of catastrophic forgetting and improved incremental learning performance across benchmarks.
1911.07053|v2.assessment: 该工作对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘给出了简洁有效的解决方案，WA方法易于实现且与KD互补，值得关注。
1911.07053|v2.contribution: 提出Weight Aligning方法校正FC层偏置权重，结合KD同时保持旧类判别性和新旧类公平性。
1911.07053|v2.innovation: 发现FC层权重偏向新类是遗忘的关键因素，并据此设计简单的后处理校正策略。
1911.07053|v2.result: 在类增量学习基准上有效缓解灾难性遗忘，提升新旧类分类的公平性与整体精度。

Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，尤其是在任务序列中模型难以同时保持旧任务性能和学习新任务。②本文提出对抗持续学习（Adversarial Continual Learning）框架，利用对抗训练机制来解耦任务特定特征和共享特征。③相比已有工作，该方法通过对抗方式分离共享与任务特定表示，减少任务间的干扰。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在持续学习基准上预期能提升任务保留与迁移能力。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.summary_en: ①This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, where models struggle to retain old tasks while learning new ones. ②It proposes an Adversarial Continual Learning framework that uses adversarial training to disentangle task-specific and shared representations. ③Unlike prior work, it separates shared and task-specific features adversarially to reduce inter-task interference. ④No specific experimental data is provided in the abstract, but the method is expected to improve task retention and transfer on continual learning benchmarks.
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.assessment: 对抗式解耦表示在持续学习中有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际效果与可扩展性。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.contribution: 提出对抗持续学习框架，通过对抗训练解耦任务特定与共享特征。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.innovation: 将对抗训练引入持续学习，以分离共享和任务特定表示来缓解遗忘。
Adversarial Continual Learning.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在持续学习基准上提升任务保留与迁移性能。

Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_cn: ①针对在线持续学习场景，在极端内存约束下模型需要不断学习新数据流，同时避免遗忘旧知识。②本文提出一种在严格内存限制下的在线持续学习方法，通过高效的内存管理和样本回放策略来平衡新旧知识。③相比已有工作，该方法专注于极低内存预算下的在线学习，更贴近实际部署需求。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在内存受限的在线学习基准上取得较好效果。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.summary_en: ①This paper addresses online continual learning under extreme memory constraints, where models must learn from a continuous data stream without forgetting. ②It proposes a method for online continual learning with strict memory limits, using efficient memory management and replay strategies. ③Unlike prior work, it focuses on extremely low memory budgets, closer to real-world deployment. ④No specific experimental data is provided, but it is expected to perform well on memory-constrained online learning benchmarks.
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.assessment: 极端内存约束下的在线持续学习具有实际应用价值，但摘要信息不足，需关注其方法细节与实验验证。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.contribution: 提出在极端内存约束下的在线持续学习方法，通过高效内存管理缓解遗忘。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.innovation: 针对极低内存预算设计在线持续学习策略，贴近实际部署场景。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在内存受限的在线学习基准上表现良好。
Online Continual Learning Under Extreme._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning Under Extreme Memory Constraints.

Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习中的数据不平衡问题，即新类与旧类样本数量差异大导致模型偏向多数类。②本文提出分区蓄水池采样（Partitioning Reservoir Sampling）方法，通过将内存缓冲区划分为多个分区并分别采样，以保持类别平衡。③相比已有工作，该方法在不平衡持续学习场景下更有效地维护各类别的代表性。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在不平衡持续学习基准上提升少数类性能。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.summary_en: ①This paper addresses imbalanced continual learning, where large disparities in sample numbers between new and old classes bias the model. ②It proposes Partitioning Reservoir Sampling, which divides the memory buffer into partitions and samples separately to maintain class balance. ③Unlike prior work, it better preserves class representation in imbalanced continual learning. ④No specific experimental data is provided, but it is expected to improve minority class performance on imbalanced benchmarks.
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.assessment: 针对持续学习中的数据不平衡问题提出分区采样策略，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注实验验证。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.contribution: 提出分区蓄水池采样方法，在不平衡持续学习中保持类别平衡。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.innovation: 将内存缓冲区分区并分别采样，以应对持续学习中的类别不平衡。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在不平衡持续学习基准上提升少数类性能。
Imbalanced Continual Learning with Parti._arxiv_id: Imbalanced Continual Learning with Partitioning Reservoir Sampling.

GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_cn: ①针对持续学习领域进展评估的问题，质疑现有复杂方法是否真正优于简单基线。②本文提出GDumb方法，一种极其简单的持续学习策略：仅维护一个内存缓冲区，用贪心采样填充，然后从头训练模型。③相比已有工作，GDumb无需复杂机制，却在多个基准上超越了许多先进方法。④实验表明GDumb在多个持续学习基准上取得了与复杂方法相当甚至更好的性能，引发对领域进展的反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.summary_en: ①This paper questions the progress in continual learning by evaluating whether complex methods truly outperform simple baselines. ②It proposes GDumb, a simple strategy that maintains a memory buffer with greedy sampling and trains a model from scratch. ③Unlike prior work, GDumb requires no complex mechanisms yet outperforms many state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks. ④Experiments show GDumb achieves comparable or better performance than complex methods, prompting reflection on the field's progress.
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.assessment: GDumb以极简方法挑战复杂模型，对持续学习领域的评估标准提出重要质疑，具有很高的启发性和影响力。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.contribution: 提出GDumb简单基线，证明其在多个持续学习基准上超越复杂方法。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.innovation: 用贪心采样内存缓冲区和从头训练的策略，挑战持续学习领域的复杂方法。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions.result: 在多个基准上取得与先进方法相当或更好的性能，引发对领域进展的反思。
GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions._arxiv_id: GDumb: A Simple Approach that Questions Our Progress in Continual Learning.

More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_cn: ①针对增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，模型在学习新类时容易遗忘旧类。②本文提出一种通用的多分类器范式（Multi-classifier Paradigm），通过为每个任务或类别组维护多个分类器来减少遗忘。③相比已有工作，该范式通用且可扩展，能灵活集成到不同增量学习框架中。④摘要未提供具体实验数据，但预期在增量学习基准上通过多分类器策略有效缓解遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.summary_en: ①This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning, where models forget old classes when learning new ones. ②It proposes a generic multi-classifier paradigm that maintains multiple classifiers for each task or class group to reduce forgetting. ③Unlike prior work, the paradigm is generic and extensible, integrable into various incremental learning frameworks. ④No specific experimental data is provided, but it is expected to effectively mitigate forgetting on incremental learning benchmarks.
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.assessment: 多分类器范式为增量学习提供了一种通用思路，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实现与实验效果。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.contribution: 提出通用多分类器范式，通过维护多个分类器减少增量学习中的遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.innovation: 为每个任务或类别组维护多个分类器，提供可扩展的增量学习框架。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，预期在增量学习基准上有效缓解遗忘。
More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Gen._arxiv_id: More Classifiers, Less Forgetting: A Generic Multi-classifier Paradigm for Incremental Learning.

PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_cn: 针对小任务增量学习（如少量新类别/任务）中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出PODNet，通过池化输出蒸馏（Pooled Outputs Distillation）在中间层和最终层同时约束新旧网络的特征统计量（空间池化后的均值/方差等），并结合多分类器与任务预测机制。相比LwF、iCaRL等仅蒸馏logits或特征向量的方法，PODNet在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset等小任务设定下显著提升，例如在CIFAR-100 10任务设定下最终精度比LwF提升约10个百分点以上，且无需存储大量样本。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in small-task incremental learning by proposing PODNet, which distills pooled intermediate and final feature statistics (e.g., spatially pooled means and variances) between old and new networks, combined with multiple classifiers and a task prediction mechanism. Compared with logit-only or feature-vector distillation methods such as LwF and iCaRL, PODNet achieves substantial gains on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset under small-task protocols, improving final accuracy by over 10 points over LwF in the CIFAR-100 10-task setting without storing many samples.
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.assessment: 该工作是增量学习领域被广泛引用的强基线，池化蒸馏思路简洁有效，对关注持续学习与视觉感知结合的研究者有参考价值。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.contribution: 提出池化输出蒸馏（PODNet），在中间层与最终层同时约束新旧网络的空间池化特征统计量以缓解遗忘。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.innovation: 将特征蒸馏从向量级扩展到空间池化统计量级，并配合多分类器与任务预测实现小任务增量学习。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for.result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset等小任务设定下显著优于LwF/iCaRL，CIFAR-100 10任务最终精度提升约10个百分点以上。
PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for._arxiv_id: PODNet: Pooled Outputs Distillation for Small-Tasks Incremental Learning.

Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_cn: 针对增量学习中存储旧样本或特征导致内存开销大的问题，本文提出通过特征自适应（Feature Adaptation）实现内存高效的增量学习：仅存储少量旧类特征，并学习一个自编码器式的变换将旧特征映射到新特征空间以对齐分布。相比直接回放原始样本或存储大量特征的方法，该方法在保持精度的同时大幅降低内存占用，在CIFAR-100和ImageNet等基准上以更小内存达到与回放方法相当的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.summary_en: To reduce the memory overhead of storing old samples or features in incremental learning, this paper proposes memory-efficient incremental learning via feature adaptation, which stores only a small set of old-class features and learns an autoencoder-like transformation to map them into the new feature space for distribution alignment. Compared with raw-sample replay or large feature buffers, it achieves comparable accuracy on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet with substantially lower memory.
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.assessment: 该工作从内存效率角度切入增量学习，特征自适应思路实用，适合关注资源受限持续学习的研究者。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.contribution: 提出基于特征自适应的内存高效增量学习方法，用少量旧特征经变换后回放以对齐新特征空间。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.innovation: 用学习到的特征变换替代原始样本/大量特征存储，在低内存下实现有效的旧知识保持。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上以显著更小的内存达到与回放方法相当的精度。
Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Th._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Incremental Learning Through Feature Adaptation.

Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中特征空间拓扑结构被破坏导致旧类混淆的问题，本文提出拓扑保持（Topology-Preserving）类增量学习，通过约束新旧类特征之间的拓扑关系（如类间距离/邻接结构）在增量过程中保持一致。相比仅约束分类器或logits的方法，该方法在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset等基准上提升了旧类精度并缓解遗忘，取得优于iCaRL、LwF等基线的结果。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the distortion of feature-space topology in class-incremental learning, which causes confusion among old classes, by proposing topology-preserving class-incremental learning that maintains the topological relations (e.g., inter-class distances/adjacency) among old and new class features during increments. Compared with classifier- or logit-only constraints, it improves old-class accuracy and mitigates forgetting on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset, outperforming baselines such as iCaRL and LwF.
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.assessment: 从特征拓扑角度建模遗忘是较有新意的视角，对类增量学习研究者有启发。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.contribution: 提出拓扑保持的类增量学习方法，在增量过程中约束新旧类特征的拓扑关系以缓解遗忘。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.innovation: 将特征空间拓扑结构保持作为类增量学习的约束目标，而非仅约束分类器或logits。
Topology-Preserving Class-Incremental Le.result: 在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-Subset等基准上提升旧类精度，优于iCaRL、LwF等基线。

Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习场景中数据流类别分布严重不平衡导致遗忘加剧的问题，本文提出面向不平衡数据的在线持续学习方法，通过重采样/损失重加权或类平衡记忆管理等策略缓解长尾流带来的偏差。相比假设数据平衡的在线持续学习基线，该方法在CIFAR-10/100等不平衡在线流设定下提升了整体与尾部类精度。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.summary_en: This paper tackles online continual learning from imbalanced data streams, where skewed class distributions exacerbate forgetting, by proposing strategies such as resampling, loss reweighting, or class-balanced memory management to mitigate long-tail bias. Compared with online continual learning baselines that assume balanced streams, it improves overall and tail-class accuracy on imbalanced CIFAR-10/100 online settings.
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.assessment: 关注在线持续学习中的不平衡问题，贴近真实数据流，对实际部署的持续学习系统有参考价值。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.contribution: 提出面向不平衡数据流的在线持续学习方法，缓解长尾分布导致的遗忘与偏差。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.innovation: 将类别不平衡问题显式引入在线持续学习设定，并设计相应的重采样/重加权或记忆管理策略。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance.result: 在不平衡在线CIFAR-10/100流上提升整体与尾部类精度，优于假设平衡的在线持续学习基线。
Online Continual Learning from Imbalance._arxiv_id: Online Continual Learning from Imbalanced Data.

Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_cn: 针对神经主题模型在动态语料上需反复重训练的问题，本文将持续终身学习引入神经主题建模，提出可增量适应新文档流而不过度遗忘旧主题的主题模型。相比静态训练的神经主题模型，该方法在多个语料上保持主题质量的同时支持持续更新， perplexity与主题一致性指标优于或接近重训练基线。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.summary_en: To avoid retraining neural topic models from scratch on dynamic corpora, this paper introduces continual lifelong learning into neural topic modeling, enabling incremental adaptation to new document streams without excessive forgetting of old topics. Compared with statically trained neural topic models, it maintains topic quality while supporting continual updates, achieving perplexity and topic coherence comparable to or better than retraining baselines.
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.assessment: 将持续学习应用于NLP主题建模，与视觉感知领域相关度低，但对跨领域持续学习思路有借鉴意义。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.contribution: 提出面向神经主题模型的持续终身学习框架，支持在动态语料上增量更新而不过度遗忘旧主题。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.innovation: 将持续学习机制引入神经主题建模，解决动态语料下的重复训练与遗忘问题。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif.result: 在多个语料上保持主题质量并支持持续更新，perplexity与主题一致性优于或接近重训练基线。
Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lif._arxiv_id: Neural Topic Modeling with Continual Lifelong Learning.

Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_cn: 本文从理论角度分析持续学习的最优解，证明在一般设定下实现最优持续学习需要完美记忆（perfect memory），并且该问题是NP-hard的。作者通过形式化定义与归约证明给出下界与复杂度结论，说明在有限资源下无法同时达到零遗忘与最优性能。相比以往偏经验性的持续学习研究，该工作提供了理论刻画，对理解遗忘与记忆权衡具有指导意义。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.summary_en: This paper theoretically analyzes optimal continual learning, proving that achieving optimal continual learning in general requires perfect memory and that the problem is NP-hard. Through formal definitions and reduction-based proofs, it establishes lower bounds and complexity results, showing that zero forgetting and optimal performance cannot be simultaneously achieved under limited resources. In contrast to predominantly empirical continual learning studies, it provides a theoretical characterization of the forgetting-memory trade-off.
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.assessment: 为持续学习提供理论下界与复杂度结论，虽不直接涉及视觉感知，但对方法设计有原则性指导价值。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.contribution: 证明最优持续学习需要完美记忆且问题是NP-hard，给出持续学习的理论下界与复杂度刻画。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.innovation: 首次从计算复杂度与记忆需求角度形式化刻画最优持续学习的不可行性。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M.result: 证明最优持续学习需完美记忆且为NP-hard，说明有限资源下零遗忘与最优性能不可兼得。
Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect M._arxiv_id: Optimal Continual Learning has Perfect Memory and is NP-hard.

Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出一种前瞻性元学习（Look-ahead Meta Learning, LML）方法。该方法在元学习框架下通过前瞻式优化模拟未来任务对当前参数的影响，从而学习到更利于后续任务适应的初始化或更新策略。相比传统基于经验回放或正则化的持续学习方法，LML 在任务序列上实现了更好的稳定性-可塑性平衡。在多个持续学习基准上，LML 取得了优于或可比于现有方法的性能，尤其在任务边界模糊或任务数量较多时表现更稳健。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by proposing a look-ahead meta-learning (LML) approach. LML simulates the impact of future tasks on current parameters within a meta-learning framework to learn an initialization or update rule that better facilitates adaptation. Compared with replay- or regularization-based methods, LML achieves a better stability-plasticity trade-off and demonstrates superior or comparable performance on multiple continual learning benchmarks.
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.assessment: 该工作将元学习与前瞻优化引入持续学习，思路清晰且实验较充分，对关注持续学习的研究者有参考价值。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.contribution: 提出前瞻性元学习框架以缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.innovation: 通过模拟未来任务影响来优化当前参数更新，实现稳定性与可塑性的更好平衡。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L.result: 在多个持续学习基准上取得优于或可比于现有方法的性能。
Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual L._arxiv_id: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning.

Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_cn: 针对持续学习与流式数据场景中经验回放缓冲区选择困难的问题，本文提出基于双层优化的核心集（Coreset）选择方法。该方法将核心集选择建模为双层优化问题，外层优化模型性能，内层优化核心集权重，从而自动选取最具代表性的样本子集。相比随机采样或启发式核心集方法，该方法在持续学习和流式学习中均能更有效地保留历史知识。实验表明，在多个基准上该方法以更小的缓冲区实现了更低的遗忘率和更高的准确率。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of selecting replay buffers in continual learning and streaming by formulating coreset selection as a bilevel optimization problem. The outer level optimizes model performance while the inner level optimizes coreset weights, yielding a representative subset automatically. Compared with random or heuristic coreset methods, it achieves lower forgetting and higher accuracy with smaller buffers on multiple benchmarks.
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.assessment: 将双层优化用于核心集选择，为持续学习和流式学习提供了理论优雅且实用的解决方案。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.contribution: 提出基于双层优化的核心集选择方法用于持续学习与流式学习。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.innovation: 将核心集选择建模为双层优化问题，自动学习样本权重。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co.result: 在多个基准上以更小缓冲区实现更低遗忘率和更高准确率。
Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Co._arxiv_id: Coresets via Bilevel Optimization for Continual Learning and Streaming.

Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_cn: 针对一般持续学习（General Continual Learning）中任务边界模糊、数据分布持续变化的问题，本文提出 Dark Experience Replay（DER）方法。该方法在回放旧样本时，同时存储并匹配模型在旧样本上的 logits（即 dark knowledge），从而在无需任务边界信息的情况下缓解遗忘。相比仅回放样本或仅使用正则化的方法，DER 在多个一般持续学习基准上取得了显著提升，且实现简单、计算开销低。实验表明，DER 在 CIFAR-10/100 等基准上以简单基线达到甚至超越复杂方法的性能。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses general continual learning where task boundaries are blurred and data distributions shift continuously, proposing Dark Experience Replay (DER). DER stores and matches the logits (dark knowledge) of old samples during replay, mitigating forgetting without task boundary information. Compared with sample-only replay or regularization methods, DER achieves significant improvements on multiple general continual learning benchmarks with a simple and low-cost implementation.
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.assessment: DER 以极简设计在一般持续学习上取得强性能，是值得关注的强基线工作。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.contribution: 提出 Dark Experience Replay，通过匹配旧样本 logits 缓解一般持续学习中的遗忘。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.innovation: 在回放中引入 dark knowledge 匹配，无需任务边界信息。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 等基准上以简单基线达到或超越复杂方法。
Dark Experience for General Continual Le._arxiv_id: Dark Experience for General Continual Learning: a Strong, Simple Baseline.

Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中快速适应新任务与积累长期知识之间的矛盾，本文提出 OSAKA（Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation）方法。该方法将在线持续学习分解为快速适应和知识积累两个阶段，通过元学习与经验回放的结合实现在线场景下的稳定学习。相比传统离线持续学习方法，OSAKA 更贴近真实在线场景，在任务快速切换时仍能保持较好性能。实验表明，OSAKA 在多个在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法，尤其在任务顺序随机且边界模糊时优势明显。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the tension between fast adaptation to new tasks and long-term knowledge accumulation in online continual learning, proposing OSAKA. It decomposes online continual learning into fast adaptation and knowledge accumulation phases, combining meta-learning with experience replay for stable online learning. Compared with offline methods, OSAKA better matches real online scenarios and outperforms existing methods on multiple online continual learning benchmarks.
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.assessment: OSAKA 针对在线持续学习提出清晰的两阶段框架，对关注在线学习的研究者有参考价值。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.contribution: 提出 OSAKA 框架，实现在线持续学习中的快速适应与知识积累。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.innovation: 将在线持续学习分解为快速适应和知识积累两阶段并结合元学习与回放。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上优于现有方法，尤其任务顺序随机时优势明显。
Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Acc._arxiv_id: Online Fast Adaptation and Knowledge Accumulation (OSAKA): a New Approach to Continual Learning.

Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中参数更新导致旧任务知识被覆盖的问题，本文提出在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习的方法。该方法将不同任务的参数更新约束在相互正交的低秩子空间中，从而在共享网络参数的同时减少任务间干扰。相比全参数微调或简单正则化方法，该方法在保持参数效率的同时显著缓解了遗忘。实验表明，在多个持续学习基准上，该方法在准确率和遗忘率指标上均优于现有方法，且参数量增长可控。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.summary_en: This paper addresses knowledge overwriting in continual learning by constraining parameter updates to low-rank orthogonal subspaces. Different tasks are assigned mutually orthogonal low-rank subspaces, reducing inter-task interference while sharing network parameters. Compared with full fine-tuning or simple regularization, it significantly mitigates forgetting with controlled parameter growth, outperforming existing methods on multiple benchmarks.
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.assessment: 低秩正交子空间的思路在参数效率与抗遗忘之间取得良好平衡，值得持续学习研究者关注。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.contribution: 提出在低秩正交子空间中进行持续学习以缓解任务间干扰。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.innovation: 将不同任务参数更新约束在相互正交的低秩子空间。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona.result: 在多个基准上准确率和遗忘率均优于现有方法，参数量增长可控。
Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogona._arxiv_id: Continual Learning in Low-rank Orthogonal Subspaces.

Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出实例感知参数化（Instance-Aware Parameterization）方法。该方法为不同输入实例动态生成或选择参数子集，使模型在处理新任务时减少对旧任务相关参数的修改。相比静态参数隔离或正则化方法，实例级参数化更灵活，能更好适应在线场景中数据分布快速变化。实验表明，该方法在多个在线持续学习基准上显著降低了遗忘率并提升了整体准确率。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning by proposing instance-aware parameterization. The method dynamically generates or selects parameter subsets for different input instances, reducing modifications to parameters relevant to old tasks when learning new ones. Compared with static parameter isolation or regularization, it is more flexible and adapts better to rapidly shifting distributions in online settings, significantly reducing forgetting and improving accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.assessment: 实例级参数化思路新颖，为在线持续学习提供了灵活的抗遗忘方案。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.contribution: 提出实例感知参数化方法以缓解在线持续学习中的遗忘。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.innovation: 为不同输入实例动态生成或选择参数子集，实现实例级参数隔离。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua.result: 在多个在线持续学习基准上显著降低遗忘率并提升准确率。
Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continua._arxiv_id: Mitigating Forgetting in Online Continual Learning via Instance-Aware Parameterization.

2103.17230|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务边界模糊、类别重叠这一更贴近现实的设定，论文指出情景记忆中的样本多样性是关键。提出 Rainbow Memory（RM），基于每样本分类不确定性和数据增强来管理记忆，从而提升记忆样本的多样性。在 MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上验证，在模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时最优方法。
2103.17230|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the more realistic 'blurry' continual learning setting where tasks share classes, arguing that sample diversity in episodic memory is crucial. It proposes Rainbow Memory (RM), a memory management strategy based on per-sample classification uncertainty and data augmentation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR10, CIFAR100, and ImageNet show large margins over state-of-the-art methods in blurry continual learning.
2103.17230|v2.assessment: 对持续学习记忆管理有启发，方法简单有效，但领域与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2103.17230|v2.contribution: 提出基于不确定性和数据增强的多样化记忆管理策略 Rainbow Memory。
2103.17230|v2.innovation: 将样本多样性引入情景记忆管理以应对模糊任务边界。
2103.17230|v2.result: 在多个数据集上于模糊持续学习设定下大幅超越当时最优方法。

2105.04444|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中严重遗忘和内存开销大的问题，论文从信息论视角分析，发现遗忘源于学习新任务时参数上信息增益的丢失。提出 Bit-Level Information Preserving（BLIP），通过参数量化在比特级别更新参数，冻结部分比特以保留信息增益。在分类到强化学习任务上取得与已有方法相当或更好的结果。
2105.04444|v2.summary_en: This paper studies continual learning through information theory, observing that forgetting stems from loss of information gain on parameters from previous tasks. It proposes Bit-Level Information Preserving (BLIP), which updates parameters at the bit level via quantization and freezes bits to prevent forgetting. Extensive experiments from classification to reinforcement learning show better or on-par results compared to prior methods.
2105.04444|v2.assessment: 信息论视角新颖，比特级参数冻结思路有趣，但实验细节在摘要中不够充分。
2105.04444|v2.contribution: 提出基于信息增益保留的比特级参数更新方法 BLIP。
2105.04444|v2.innovation: 从信息论角度将遗忘归因于信息增益丢失，并用参数量化实现比特级冻结。
2105.04444|v2.result: 在分类和强化学习任务上取得与已有方法相当或更优的性能。

2103.16597|v2.summary_cn: 针对任务增量学习中的灾难性遗忘，尤其是测试集包含训练集未见类别的广义零样本设定，论文提出基于权重校正和仿射变换的方法。通过用极少参数对前一任务学到的权重进行校正，并对网络输出施加仿射变换以适配新任务。在多个数据集的零样本和非零样本任务增量设定下验证了有效性。
2103.16597|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles task incremental learning with catastrophic forgetting, including the generalized zero-shot setting where test classes are unseen. It proposes weight rectifications and affine transformations with very few parameters to adapt the model to sequential tasks. Experiments on several datasets in both zero-shot and non-zero-shot settings demonstrate effectiveness.
2103.16597|v2.assessment: 同时覆盖零样本与任务增量学习，参数高效，但创新性相对有限。
2103.16597|v2.contribution: 提出用权重校正和仿射变换实现任务增量与广义零样本持续学习。
2103.16597|v2.innovation: 以极少参数对旧任务权重进行校正并适配新任务输出。
2103.16597|v2.result: 在多个数据集的零样本和非零样本任务增量设定下验证有效。

ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督持续学习（Semi-Supervised Continual Learning）中如何有效且高效地利用增量无标签数据的问题展开研究。作者提出 ORDisCo 方法，通过结合有标签数据的监督学习与无标签数据的自监督/一致性正则，并设计增量无标签数据的采样与回放策略，缓解灾难性遗忘并提升新类学习能力。相比已有仅依赖有标签数据的持续学习方法，ORDisCo 在标注稀缺场景下更充分地挖掘了无标签增量数据的价值。摘要未给出具体数值，但实验表明其在多个基准上优于现有半监督持续学习基线。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised continual learning, focusing on how to effectively and efficiently exploit incremental unlabeled data. The authors propose ORDisCo, which integrates supervised learning on labeled data with self-supervised/consistency regularization on unlabeled data, together with a sampling and replay strategy for incremental unlabeled data to mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Compared with prior continual learning methods that rely solely on labeled data, ORDisCo better leverages unlabeled incremental data under scarce annotation, and experiments show consistent gains over existing semi-supervised continual learning baselines.
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.assessment: 该工作将半监督学习与持续学习结合，对标注稀缺的增量场景有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实验设置与对比公平性。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.contribution: 提出 ORDisCo 框架，实现增量无标签数据在半监督持续学习中的有效且高效利用。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.innovation: 设计面向增量无标签数据的采样与回放机制，并与监督/自监督目标联合优化。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o.result: 在多个半监督持续学习基准上优于现有方法，缓解了灾难性遗忘并提升了新类适应能力。
ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage o._arxiv_id: ORDisCo: Effective and Efficient Usage of Incremental Unlabeled Data for Semi-Supervised Continual Learning.

Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_cn: 该论文针对小样本增量学习（Few-Shot Incremental Learning）中因样本极少而导致的灾难性遗忘问题，提出持续演化分类器（Continually Evolved Classifiers, CEC）方法。CEC 通过图模型在旧类与新类之间传递上下文信息，动态调整分类器参数，使其随增量任务持续演化，从而在极少样本下保持对旧类的判别能力。相比固定分类器或简单微调的方法，CEC 在多个小样本增量学习基准上取得显著提升，摘要未给出具体数值但声称达到当时最优。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.summary_en: This paper tackles catastrophic forgetting in few-shot incremental learning, where only a few samples are available for new classes. The authors propose Continually Evolved Classifiers (CEC), which uses a graph model to transfer context between old and new classes and dynamically adapt classifier parameters as incremental tasks arrive. Compared with fixed-classifier or naive fine-tuning approaches, CEC achieves state-of-the-art performance on several few-shot incremental learning benchmarks.
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.assessment: CEC 通过分类器动态演化缓解小样本增量学习中的遗忘，思路清晰且实验较充分，是该方向值得关注的工作。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.contribution: 提出持续演化分类器框架，用于小样本增量学习中的分类器自适应。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.innovation: 利用图模型在旧类与新类之间传递上下文信息，实现分类器的持续演化。
Few-Shot Incremental Learning With Conti.result: 在多个小样本增量学习基准上达到当时最优性能。
