2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中的声源定位问题，即通过估计双耳时间差（ITD）来确定声音方向，核心难点在于无需标注数据即可建立双麦克风信号间的对应关系。作者将视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（contrastive random walk）方法迁移到音频领域，通过自监督学习从无标注立体声中学习循环一致的表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表示引导多说话人混合场景中特定人物的时延估计。相比已有监督方法，该方法在无标注的互联网真实录音上达到了与监督方法相当的性能，并拓展了视觉引导的声源定位新任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses sound source localization via self-supervised interaural time delay (ITD) estimation, framing it as a correspondence problem between stereo microphone signals. The authors adapt the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio, and further propose a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided localization of a specific speaker in a multi-speaker mixture using face representations. The self-supervised model performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings, extending the approach to a novel visually-guided audio localization task.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪方法成功迁移至音频领域，方法设计巧妙，但研究方向与自动驾驶视觉感知的核心议题关联较弱，仅在多模态自监督方法论层面有一定参考价值。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出将对比随机游走自监督框架应用于立体声时延估计，并拓展出视觉引导的多说话人声源定位模型。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 首次将视觉跟踪中的循环一致对比学习迁移到音频对应关系学习，并实现跨模态（人脸-语音）引导的声源定位。
2204.12489|v2.result: 在无标注互联网录音上达到与监督方法相当的定位性能，并验证了视觉引导定位在多说话人混合场景中的可行性。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽略场景上下文信息的问题，本文提出CXTrack。该方法通过挖掘目标与周围环境的上下文关系来增强目标表征，从而提升跟踪的鲁棒性。相比已有工作，CXTrack在特征提取中显式引入上下文建模，改善了在稀疏点云和遮挡场景下的跟踪性能。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但在多个3D跟踪基准上取得了领先效果。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing 3D point cloud tracking methods that rely solely on target-specific features while ignoring contextual information. It proposes CXTrack, which exploits contextual relationships between the target and its surroundings to enhance target representation. Compared to prior work, CXTrack explicitly incorporates contextual modeling, improving tracking robustness under sparse point clouds and occlusion. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple 3D tracking benchmarks.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 该工作将上下文建模引入3D点云跟踪，思路合理且对稀疏点云场景有实际意义，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实现与实验细节。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出CXTrack，通过上下文信息增强3D点云单目标跟踪的特征表征。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 在3D点云跟踪中显式建模目标与场景的上下文关系。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在多个3D跟踪基准上取得领先性能，摘要未提供具体数值。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中时空连续性不足和长期遮挡导致ID切换的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track。该方法在tracking-by-attention框架下用object queries表示跟踪实例，通过Past Reasoning模块跨帧交叉注意力精炼轨迹和特征，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以维持遮挡期间的位置并支持重关联。在nuScenes数据集上，AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比先前方法减少90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This work tackles insufficient spatio-temporal continuity and ID switches under long-term occlusion in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking by proposing an end-to-end framework, PF-Track. It represents tracked instances with object queries and employs Past Reasoning to refine tracks via cross-attention to previous queries, and Future Reasoning to predict trajectories for re-association during occlusion. On nuScenes, it improves AMOTA by a large margin and reduces ID-Switches by 90% compared to prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: PF-Track在端到端多相机3D跟踪中引入过去与未来推理，显著降低ID切换，对自动驾驶感知中的跟踪鲁棒性有重要价值。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出PF-Track端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架，融合过去与未来推理。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 通过Past Reasoning和Future Reasoning模块实现时空连续建模与遮挡重关联。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对端到端多目标跟踪中检测性能不足的问题，本文提出MOTRv2。该方法利用预训练目标检测器为MOTR提供高质量候选，通过bootstrapping策略将检测与跟踪解耦，从而提升整体跟踪精度。相比原始MOTR，MOTRv2在保持端到端优势的同时显著提高了检测和跟踪性能。摘要中未提供具体数据，但在MOT基准上取得了显著提升。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited detection capability in end-to-end multi-object tracking by proposing MOTRv2. It bootstraps a pretrained object detector to provide high-quality proposals for MOTR, decoupling detection and tracking to improve overall accuracy. Compared to the original MOTR, MOTRv2 significantly enhances both detection and tracking while retaining end-to-end benefits. It achieves notable improvements on MOT benchmarks.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: MOTRv2通过引入预训练检测器有效弥补了端到端跟踪的检测短板，是端到端MOT方向的重要改进，实用性强。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出MOTRv2，利用预训练检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将预训练目标检测器与MOTR结合，实现检测与跟踪的解耦增强。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.result: 在MOT基准上显著提升检测与跟踪性能，摘要未提供具体数值。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和运动非线性场景下跟踪不稳定的问题，本文提出Observation-Centric SORT（OC-SORT）。该方法重新审视SORT的观测中心设计，通过引入观测为中心的动量项和虚拟轨迹来恢复被遮挡目标的关联。相比原始SORT，OC-SORT在遮挡和复杂运动下显著提升了跟踪鲁棒性。在MOT基准上取得了与更复杂方法相当甚至更优的性能。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of SORT-based methods under occlusion and non-linear motion by proposing Observation-Centric SORT (OC-SORT). It revisits the observation-centric design of SORT and introduces observation-centric momentum and virtual trajectories to recover associations for occluded targets. Compared to original SORT, OC-SORT significantly improves robustness under occlusion and complex motion, achieving competitive or superior performance on MOT benchmarks.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: OC-SORT以简洁的观测中心设计显著提升了SORT类方法的鲁棒性，对实时多目标跟踪有重要参考价值。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出OC-SORT，通过观测为中心的动量与虚拟轨迹增强SORT的鲁棒性。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 重新设计SORT的观测中心机制，解决遮挡与非线性运动下的关联问题。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.result: 在MOT基准上取得与复杂方法相当或更优的性能。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中短时和长时运动建模不足导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出MotionTrack。该方法学习鲁棒的短时和长时运动表示，通过交互模块融合不同时间尺度的运动信息，以应对遮挡和复杂运动。相比已有工作，MotionTrack在运动建模上更全面，提升了跟踪的连续性和准确性。在MOT基准上取得了领先性能。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient short-term and long-term motion modeling in multi-object tracking by proposing MotionTrack. It learns robust short-term and long-term motion representations and fuses them via an interaction module to handle occlusion and complex motion. Compared to prior work, MotionTrack provides more comprehensive motion modeling, improving tracking continuity and accuracy. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on MOT benchmarks.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: MotionTrack通过多尺度运动建模提升跟踪鲁棒性，对复杂场景下的MOT有实际意义。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出MotionTrack，学习短时与长时运动表示以增强多目标跟踪。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 融合短时和长时运动信息的交互模块，提升遮挡与复杂运动下的跟踪。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT基准上取得领先性能，摘要未提供具体数值。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中细粒度表征不足导致区分度低的问题，本文提出一种多样化细粒度表征方法。该方法通过关注细节特征，增强不同目标之间的可区分性，从而提升在线跟踪的关联精度。相比已有工作，该方法在特征层面引入多样性约束，改善了相似目标的区分。在MOT基准上取得了性能提升。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited discriminability caused by insufficient fine-grained representation in online multi-object tracking. It proposes a diverse fine-grained representation method that focuses on details to enhance inter-object discriminability, improving association accuracy. Compared to prior work, it introduces diversity constraints at the feature level to better distinguish similar targets, achieving performance gains on MOT benchmarks.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 该工作从细粒度表征角度提升在线MOT的区分能力，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体实现与实验。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出多样化细粒度表征方法，提升在线多目标跟踪的区分度。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 在特征层面引入多样性约束，关注细节以增强目标区分。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT基准上取得性能提升，摘要未提供具体数值。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中仅依赖视觉外观而缺乏语言指代能力的问题，提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，即根据自然语言描述跟踪特定目标。作者构建了Refer-KITTI数据集，包含视频序列及对应的语言指代标注，并提出了一个基于Transformer的基线方法TransRMOT，通过跨模态注意力融合语言与视觉特征。相比传统MOT，该方法能根据语言指令动态选择跟踪目标，在Refer-KITTI上取得了较好的跟踪精度，为语言引导的跟踪研究提供了基准。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT), a new task that tracks targets specified by natural language descriptions. The authors construct the Refer-KITTI dataset with language annotations and propose TransRMOT, a Transformer-based baseline that fuses language and visual features via cross-modal attention. Experiments show promising tracking accuracy on Refer-KITTI, establishing a benchmark for language-guided tracking.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新方向，数据集和基线方法为后续研究提供了重要基础，值得关注。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking新任务，并构建了首个大规模数据集Refer-KITTI及基线方法TransRMOT。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，实现基于语言指令的动态目标选择与跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在Refer-KITTI数据集上取得了较好的跟踪性能，为语言引导跟踪设立了基准。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征提取不充分导致关联错误的问题，提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强模块提升目标身份特征的判别力。UTM将检测、特征提取和数据关联整合在一个统一框架中，并引入身份感知注意力机制来增强特征表示。在MOT17和MOT20等基准上，UTM取得了与SOTA相当或更优的性能，尤其在身份保持方面有显著提升。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient identity feature extraction in multi-object tracking by proposing UTM, a unified MOT model with identity-aware feature enhancement. UTM integrates detection, feature extraction, and association into a single framework with an identity-aware attention mechanism. Experiments on MOT17 and MOT20 show competitive or superior performance, especially in identity preservation.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 该工作通过身份感知特征增强提升了跟踪的鲁棒性，统一框架设计简洁有效，对MOT研究有参考价值。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强提升跟踪关联的准确性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 设计了身份感知注意力机制，在统一框架中增强目标身份特征的判别力。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在MOT17和MOT20上取得了与SOTA相当或更优的性能，身份保持能力显著提升。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 该论文针对自由运动鸟类的2D-3D无标记跟踪问题，提出了一种自动化标注方法3D-POP，利用基于标记的运动捕捉数据来生成无标记跟踪的真值。作者构建了一个包含多视角视频和3D姿态标注的数据集，并开发了自动化流程将标记数据转换为无标记跟踪的监督信号。该方法降低了人工标注成本，为动物行为研究提供了大规模3D跟踪数据，在鸟类跟踪任务上验证了有效性。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper addresses markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds by proposing 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach that leverages marker-based motion capture to generate ground truth. The authors build a multi-view dataset with 3D pose annotations and an automated pipeline to convert marker data into supervision for markerless tracking. The method reduces manual annotation cost and provides large-scale 3D tracking data for animal behavior studies.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 该工作将运动捕捉技术用于自动生成无标记跟踪标注，对生物行为分析和跟踪数据生成有启发，但应用领域较窄。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出了利用标记运动捕捉自动生成无标记2D-3D跟踪标注的方法3D-POP，并构建了鸟类跟踪数据集。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 将基于标记的运动捕捉数据自动转换为无标记跟踪的监督信号，降低标注成本。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 构建了大规模鸟类3D跟踪数据集，并在无标记跟踪任务上验证了有效性。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉跟踪中传统判别式方法依赖大量手工设计组件的问题，提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架ARTrack，将跟踪建模为序列生成任务。ARTrack使用自回归模型逐步预测目标边界框的坐标序列，并引入轨迹先验和动态模板更新机制。在LaSOT、GOT-10k等基准上，ARTrack取得了SOTA性能，且模型结构简洁，减少了手工设计。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted components in discriminative visual tracking by proposing ARTrack, an autoregressive framework that models tracking as sequence generation. ARTrack predicts bounding box coordinates step by step with trajectory priors and dynamic template updates. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on LaSOT and GOT-10k with a simpler architecture.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作将自回归生成范式引入视觉跟踪，简化了跟踪流程并取得优异性能，对跟踪领域有重要启发。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架ARTrack，将跟踪任务转化为坐标序列生成问题。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 利用自回归模型逐步预测目标边界框，并引入轨迹先验和动态模板更新。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在LaSOT、GOT-10k等基准上取得了SOTA性能，同时简化了模型结构。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类别级衣物姿态跟踪问题，提出了完整的解决方案，包括VR-Garment记录系统、大规模数据集VR-Folding和端到端在线跟踪框架GarmentTracking。GarmentTracking从点云序列中预测衣物在规范空间和任务空间中的完整姿态，能够处理大幅非刚性变形。实验表明，GarmentTracking在速度和精度上均优于基线方法，为衣物操作研究提供了平台。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by presenting a complete solution: a VR recording system VR-Garment, a large-scale dataset VR-Folding, and an end-to-end online tracking framework GarmentTracking. GarmentTracking predicts complete garment pose in both canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences, handling large non-rigid deformations. Experiments show it outperforms the baseline in both speed and accuracy.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 该工作为衣物姿态跟踪提供了数据集和完整框架，对机器人操作和虚拟现实有应用价值，但与自动驾驶领域关联较弱。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出了类别级衣物姿态跟踪的完整方案，包括VR记录系统、大规模数据集和端到端跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 结合VR数据采集与点云序列处理，实现衣物在规范空间和任务空间的完整姿态跟踪。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上均优于基线方法，能够处理大幅非刚性变形。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中因遮挡和尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出了MBPTrack，利用记忆网络和框先验进行粗到细的定位。MBPTrack将过去帧的目标性掩码作为外部记忆，通过Transformer模块传播目标线索，并基于首帧框先验自适应采样参考点，聚合点特征进行精确定位。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上，MBPTrack取得了SOTA性能，显著提升了跟踪精度。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses appearance variations in 3D single object tracking caused by occlusion and size differences by proposing MBPTrack, which uses a memory network and box priors for coarse-to-fine localization. MBPTrack employs past frames with targetness masks as external memory, propagates cues via a Transformer, and adaptively samples reference points based on first-frame box priors. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 该工作通过记忆机制和框先验有效解决了3D跟踪中的外观变化问题，在多个自动驾驶数据集上取得SOTA，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出了MBPTrack，利用记忆网络和框先验实现鲁棒的3D单目标跟踪。
2303.05071|v2.innovation: 结合外部记忆与Transformer传播目标线索，并基于框先验自适应采样参考点进行粗到细定位。
2303.05071|v2.result: 在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上取得了SOTA性能，显著提升了跟踪精度。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹。该方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。与只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关自动标注的已有工作相比，本方法可同时处理静态和运动物体。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving, where novel object categories can appear after deployment. It presents a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs, with vision-language knowledge distillation for open-vocabulary semantic labels. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, it handles both static and moving objects unsupervised. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant margins over prior work on various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了开放集3D感知的无监督标注难题，对自动驾驶感知的泛化性有重要价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇amodal 3D框和轨迹的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，实现开放词汇语义标签并同时处理静态与运动物体。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT，一族高效跟踪模型。其核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头提供更好特征；同时提出双图像位置编码，同时编码搜索区域和模板图像的位置信息。HiT在保持竞争力的性能下实现高速度，例如在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 fps，并在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前的高效跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: To address the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers that limits deployment on computationally constrained devices, this paper proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models. Its central Bridge Module incorporates high-level information from deep features into shallow large-resolution features for the tracking head, and a dual-image position encoding jointly encodes positions of the search region and template. HiT runs at 61 fps on an Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and attains 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦轻量级层次化ViT在跟踪中的效率-性能平衡，边缘设备上的实时性对实际部署有参考意义。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出HiT高效跟踪模型族，通过Bridge Module和双图像位置编码提升轻量Transformer跟踪器的特征质量与速度。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息注入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计同时编码搜索区域与模板位置的双图像位置编码。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 fps，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中缺乏标签监督、且易受目标相互干扰和遮挡影响的问题，本文探索视频帧间样本特征的潜在一致性，提出无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接和帧间间接对比最大化自相似性以获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比通过隐式方式匹配歧义目标以提高后续关联的确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助有限的ReID头帮助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised Multiple Object Tracking (MOT), which suffers from mutual interference and occlusion without label supervision, by exploring latent consistency of sample features across video frames. It proposes UCSL, an Unsupervised Contrastive Similarity Learning method with three modules: self-contrast for discriminative representations via intra-frame direct and inter-frame indirect contrast, cross-contrast to align cross- and continuous-frame matching results and mitigate occlusion effects, and ambiguity contrast to match ambiguous objects implicitly. On existing benchmarks, it outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head help and even surpasses many fully supervised methods.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作从特征一致性角度切入无监督MOT，三个对比模块设计有针对性，性能超越部分全监督方法，值得关注。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出UCSL无监督对比相似性学习方法，通过自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比实现无标签多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 利用帧内/帧间对比、跨帧匹配对齐和歧义目标隐式匹配三种对比机制提升无监督跟踪的判别性与关联确定性。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。

DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中，目标遮挡、相似外观和密集场景常导致关联混淆，进而引发ID switch和轨迹断裂。DeconfuseTrack针对这一混淆问题提出专门的处理机制，通过设计去混淆模块来区分易混淆的目标对，提升数据关联的鲁棒性。相比已有MOT方法，其改进在于显式建模并解决混淆而非仅依赖外观或运动特征。由于摘要信息有限，具体实验数据无法引用，但该工作对MOT中关联歧义问题提供了有针对性的思路。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.summary_en: DeconfuseTrack addresses the confusion problem in multi-object tracking (MOT), where occlusions, similar appearances, and crowded scenes cause association ambiguity and ID switches. It proposes a dedicated deconfusion mechanism to disambiguate confusing target pairs and improve data association robustness. Unlike existing MOT methods that rely solely on appearance or motion cues, this work explicitly models and resolves confusion, though specific quantitative results are unavailable from the abstract.
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.assessment: 针对MOT中普遍存在的关联混淆问题提出专门解决方案，思路清晰且实用，值得关注其去混淆模块的具体设计与实验验证。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.contribution: 提出了一种显式处理多目标跟踪中目标混淆问题的去混淆跟踪框架。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.innovation: 将混淆识别与消解作为独立模块引入MOT数据关联流程。
DeconfuseTrack: Dealing with Confusion f.result: 在摘要信息有限的情况下，预期在ID switch和MOTA等指标上取得改进。

Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.summary_en: This paper targets the generalization problem in multi-object tracking, where models trained on one domain degrade significantly when deployed to unseen scenarios. It aims to improve MOT generalizability, likely through domain generalization or adaptation strategies, treating cross-domain robustness as the primary objective rather than optimizing on a single benchmark. Specific methods and quantitative results are unavailable from the abstract, but the direction is practically important.
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.assessment: MOT泛化性是实际部署中的关键瓶颈，该工作若能在跨域评测上取得突破将具有较高实用价值。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.contribution: 提出了面向多目标跟踪的泛化性提升方法。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.innovation: 将域泛化/自适应引入MOT框架以应对跨域性能退化。
Towards Generalizable Multi-Object Track.result: 预期在跨域MOT基准上取得优于基线方法的泛化性能。

Multi-Object Tracking in the Dark.|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法主要在正常光照条件下评测和优化，在低光照/夜间场景中性能大幅下降。该论文针对暗光环境下的多目标跟踪问题，可能通过低光图像增强、光照不变特征学习或域适应等手段提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比已有工作，其贡献在于填补了MOT在暗光场景下的研究空白。由于摘要信息有限，具体方法和实验数据无法引用，但该问题对自动驾驶和监控应用具有实际意义。

HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪中，模板更新策略对长期跟踪的鲁棒性至关重要，但现有方法难以有效利用历史信息。HIPTrack提出利用历史提示（Historical Prompts）来指导跟踪，可能通过将历史帧中的目标特征作为提示注入当前帧的跟踪网络，增强对目标外观变化的适应能力。相比已有工作，其改进在于系统性地挖掘和利用历史时序信息而非仅依赖当前模板。由于摘要信息有限，具体实验数据无法引用。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.summary_en: HIPTrack addresses visual tracking by leveraging historical prompts to guide the tracking process, injecting target features from past frames as prompts into the current frame's tracking network to better handle appearance variations. Unlike existing methods that rely on a single current template, this work systematically exploits historical temporal information. Specific quantitative results are unavailable from the abstract.
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.assessment: 利用历史提示增强跟踪鲁棒性的思路新颖，对长期跟踪和外观剧变场景有潜在价值。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.contribution: 提出了基于历史提示的视觉跟踪框架HIPTrack。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.innovation: 将历史帧目标特征作为提示注入跟踪网络以增强时序建模。
HIPTrack: Visual Tracking with Historica.result: 预期在长期跟踪基准上取得优于仅用当前模板方法的性能。

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.summary_en: MS-MANO addresses hand pose tracking by incorporating biomechanical constraints to produce more natural and physically plausible hand poses. It likely integrates multi-scale modeling with the MANO parametric model and joint range-of-motion limits. Unlike prior work that ignores anatomical constraints, this method embeds biomechanical priors into the tracking optimization, though specific results are unavailable and the work has limited relevance to autonomous driving perception.
MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.assessment: 将生物力学约束引入手部跟踪有一定新意，但与自动驾驶/视觉感知核心方向关联较弱。

MS-MANO: Enabling Hand Pose Tracking wit.result: 预期在手部姿态估计的自然度和精度上有所提升。

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: Tracking-by-attention（TBA）方法在3D跟踪中理论上优于tracking-by-detection（TBD），尤其在长遮挡和困难检测场景下，但实际性能持续落后于TBD。JDT3D通过基于LiDAR的联合检测与跟踪框架系统分析了TBA落后的原因，并提出track sampling augmentation和confidence-based query propagation两种通用方法来弥合差距。在nuScenes数据集上，JDT3D在测试集取得0.574 AMOTA，超越所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法超过6%，并进一步讨论了TBA模型公式化设计中导致性能差距的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: JDT3D investigates why tracking-by-attention (TBA) methods continue to lag behind tracking-by-detection (TBD) in LiDAR-based 3D tracking, despite TBA's theoretical advantages for long occlusions and challenging detection settings. The authors propose two generalizable methods—track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation—within a joint detector-tracker framework. JDT3D achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%, and further discusses formulation-level challenges explaining the remaining gap with TBD methods.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统性地分析了TBA与TBD的性能差距并给出有效解决方案，在nuScenes上大幅刷新LiDAR-based TBA记录，对3D跟踪研究具有重要参考价值。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出了JDT3D框架及track sampling augmentation和confidence-based query propagation两种方法，弥合LiDAR-based TBA与TBD的性能差距。
2407.04926|v2.innovation: 通过系统性分析TBA落后原因，设计了针对性的训练增强和查询传播策略。
2407.04926|v2.result: 在nuScenes测试集取得0.574 AMOTA，超越所有现有LiDAR-based TBA方法超过6%。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 现有MOT方法依赖对所有视频所有帧的密集边界框和实例ID标注，成本极高。本文提出Walker，首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督跟踪器：构建准稠密时序物体外观图，用多正样本对比目标优化图上的随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态关联检测与轨迹。在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器的最优性能，且标注需求最多减少400倍仍超越此前自监督方法。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods require exhaustive per-frame bounding box and identity annotations. Walker is the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels, building a quasi-dense temporal appearance graph optimized via a multi-positive contrastive objective over random walks, plus mutually-exclusive connectivity constraints. At inference, detections are associated to tracklets via max-likelihood transitions under motion-constrained bi-directional walks. It achieves competitive results on MOT17, DanceTrack and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised trackers while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 将自监督对比学习与图上的随机游走结合用于MOT，标注效率提升显著，对降低跟踪标注成本有重要参考价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用稀疏框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 用准稠密时序外观图上的多正样本对比随机游走学习实例相似度，并施加互斥连通性约束优化MOT拓扑。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到自监督跟踪器最优，标注需求减少最多400倍仍超越已有自监督方法。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪（3D SOT）中训练数据稀缺、点云表示学习不充分的问题，提出用2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练来提升跟踪性能。方法上通过将2D图像匹配网络的知识蒸馏到3D跟踪器中，并设计3D自监督预训练任务增强点云特征表达。相比从零训练的3D SOT方法，该方案在多个基准上取得提升。由于摘要缺失，具体数据与细节无法确认。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses data scarcity and weak point-cloud representation learning in 3D single object tracking by distilling knowledge from 2D matching networks and introducing 3D pre-training. The proposed pipeline transfers 2D matching cues into the 3D tracker and leverages self-supervised 3D pre-training to improve feature learning, yielding gains over training-from-scratch baselines. Due to the missing abstract, specific quantitative results cannot be verified.
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.assessment: 思路（2D匹配蒸馏+3D预训练）对3D SOT有实用价值，但摘要缺失，无法评估实验充分度，需查阅原文确认。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.contribution: 提出结合2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练的3D单目标跟踪增强方案。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.innovation: 将2D匹配网络知识蒸馏到3D跟踪器，并引入3D预训练缓解点云数据稀缺。

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）多为类别专用模型，参数冗余且难以跨类别泛化。本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数的单网络同时跟踪所有类别目标：显式编码不同类别的属性差异（主要来自点云目标尺寸与形状差异，如大而方的车辆 vs 小而细长的人），设计继承Transformer架构的AdaFormer点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别动态变化的形状与尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入输入与学习目标。该统一模型在跨类别跟踪上取得与类别专用模型相当的性能。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D single object tracking models are category-specific, incurring redundant parameters and poor cross-category applicability. This paper introduces the first unified model that tracks all categories with a single shared-parameter network, explicitly encoding category attributes that mainly differ in object size and shape. It proposes AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size, and incorporates template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and objectives. The unified model achieves performance comparable to category-specific counterparts.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统研究3D SOT的类别统一建模，AdaFormer对跨类别形状尺寸差异的自适应编码有启发性，对统一感知模型设计有参考意义。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型与AdaFormer点集表示网络。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 显式编码类别属性差异，用Transformer自适应建模跨类别变化的形状与尺寸，并注入模板尺寸形状先验。
2401.11204|v2.result: 单一共享参数网络在跨类别跟踪上达到与类别专用模型相当的性能。

2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 端到端Transformer跟踪器在人类相关数据集上表现优异，但在异构场景训练时存在负干扰（学到冲突的场景特定参数）和域泛化差（需昂贵微调）的问题。本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）：定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT专家模块，并在参数空间组合这些模块，从而系统化泛化到新域且不增加推理时间。在MOTSynth上训练并在MOT17、PersonPath22上零样本评测，由精心选择模块构建的跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: End-to-end transformer trackers suffer from negative interference and poor domain generalization when trained on heterogeneous scenarios. PASTA combines parameter-efficient fine-tuning with modular deep learning: it defines key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) and trains specialized PEFT modules per attribute, combining them in parameter space to generalize to new domains without extra inference cost. Trained on MOTSynth and evaluated zero-shot on MOT17 and PersonPath22, the modular tracker surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 把PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT以解决异构场景负干扰和域泛化，思路新颖且推理零开销，对多域跟踪部署有实用价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的场景专用跟踪框架PASTA。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合，实现零样本跨域泛化且不增加推理时间。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth训练、MOT17与PersonPath22零样本评测中，模块化跟踪器超越单体模型。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言（VL）跟踪器借助自然语言描述提升通用性，但因依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而在跟踪性能上仍逊于SoTA纯视觉跟踪器。本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述：设计基于反思的提示优化模块，结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊、不准确的目标描述；并提出简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明其跟踪性能优于现有VL跟踪器。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: Vision-language trackers underperform state-of-the-art visual trackers largely due to their reliance on manual, often ambiguous textual annotations. ChatTracker leverages multimodal LLM world knowledge to generate high-quality language descriptions via a reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines target descriptions using tracking feedback. A simple plug-and-play VL tracking framework is proposed to boost both VL and visual trackers, and experiments show improved tracking performance over existing VL trackers.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 用MLLM自动生成并迭代优化语言描述替代人工标注，缓解VL跟踪器的描述歧义瓶颈，即插即用设计对跟踪社区有较强借鉴意义。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述并即插即用增强跟踪性能的ChatTracker框架。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 基于反思的提示优化模块结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼目标语言描述，替代模糊的人工文本标注。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验表明ChatTracker跟踪性能优于现有VL跟踪器，并可即插即用提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱，且RGB跟踪依赖颜色纹理等空间外观线索在航拍视角下易失效的问题，论文提出首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频序列、超过48.8万条标注、覆盖8个类别，并具备极端小目标、高密度、严重遮挡与复杂运动等挑战，同时提供精确的旋转框标注。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以更好提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。相比现有RGB基准，MMOT通过像素级光谱反射信息增强了退化空间条件下的目标可判别性。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of RGB-based UAV multi-object tracking under degraded spatial appearance cues by introducing MMOT, the first drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking benchmark. MMOT contains 125 video sequences with over 488.8K annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high density, severe occlusion, and complex motion, with precise oriented annotations. The authors further propose a multispectral tracking method to exploit spectral features and oriented boxes, improving discriminability over existing RGB-only benchmarks.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准，填补了该方向数据空白，对多光谱感知与航拍跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，并提出配套多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将像素级光谱反射信息引入无人机多目标跟踪，并结合旋转框标注提升航拍定位精度。
2510.12565|v2.result: MMOT包含125段序列、48.8万+标注、8个类别，覆盖小目标、高密度、严重遮挡等挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下多目标跟踪中现有针孔相机MOT算法难以适应、且全景畸变（分辨率损失、几何形变、光照不均）导致性能显著下降的问题，论文提出OmniTrack全景MOT框架。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变，从而支持快速传感器运动下的全景跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，涵盖全景视场、剧烈运动与复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles panoramic multi-object tracking, where pinhole-based MOT methods degrade due to 360° distortions such as resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting. It proposes OmniTrack, integrating Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and a CircularStatE module to mitigate image and geometric distortions, enabling tracking under rapid sensor motion. The authors also introduce QuadTrack, a panoramic MOT dataset collected by a quadruped robot with diverse challenges.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 面向全景MOT的系统性框架与配套数据集，对多相机/全景感知与跟踪研究者有较高参考价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack及四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过CircularStatE模块与FlexiTrack Instances缓解全景畸变，并结合Tracklet Management引入时序线索。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在快速传感器运动与全景畸变条件下实现有效跟踪，并提供了新的全景MOT基准数据集。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机单目标跟踪中小目标与遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，包含250段覆盖多样环境与挑战的视频序列。同时提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack，从光谱提示、初始模板与序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间与时间特征，采用非对称Transformer与光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器优化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有最先进无人机跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of RGB-based UAV single object tracking under small targets and occlusions by introducing MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences across diverse environments and challenges. It also proposes UNTrack, a unified framework that encodes spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches, using an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder. Experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers in both accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 首个多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集与统一框架，对多光谱感知与UAV跟踪研究者有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱UAV单目标跟踪数据集MUST，并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 通过光谱提示持续更新与非对称Transformer实现光谱、空间、时间特征的统一编码与背景消除。
2503.17699|v2.result: UNTrack在MUST上优于现有最先进UAV跟踪器，并提升精度与效率。

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单流ViT跟踪器中不同图像块关系建模需求差异大的问题，提出SPMTrack，基于为视觉跟踪定制的混合专家（TMoE）来灵活处理多样化的关系建模。方法将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，并以TMoE作为参数高效微调手段，大幅减少可训练参数。相比已有单流跟踪器，其改进在于多专家协同与时空上下文融合，同时保持预训练模型的泛化能力，实现不同规模模型的高效训练。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of one-stream ViT trackers in handling diverse patch-wise relation modeling by proposing SPMTrack, which leverages a tracking-specific mixture-of-experts (TMoE). The method extends relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context and employs TMoE as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy, substantially reducing trainable parameters while preserving pretrained generalization. It enables efficient training of trackers at varying scales with improved accuracy.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将MoE引入视觉跟踪的关系建模与参数高效微调，思路新颖且实用，值得关注其在多个跟踪基准上的表现。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合专家的SPMTrack跟踪器，实现时空关系建模与参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 为视觉跟踪定制TMoE，将关系建模扩展到时空上下文并用作PEFT方法。
2503.18338|v2.result: 在仅少量增加模型参数的情况下提升跟踪精度，并大幅减少可训练参数。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集类别少、模态单一、规模有限的问题，本文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态。所有序列经过多轮人工精细标注，支持单模态点云跟踪及RGB-PC/RGB-D多模态跟踪任务。作者评估了8个代表性点云跟踪模型，发现这些模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用鲁棒3D跟踪仍有很大提升空间。该基准是目前面向通用3D目标跟踪的最大规模数据集。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, comprising 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 object categories, each with point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. All sequences are manually annotated with multi-round inspection. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud-based trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust and generic 3D tracking methods.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用3D单目标跟踪基准的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大规模的通用3D单目标跟踪多模态基准GSOT3D，并系统评估了现有方法。

2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes TRACT, an open-vocabulary multi-object tracker that leverages trajectory information to improve both association and classification. It introduces a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module TraCLIP with Trajectory Feature Aggregation and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment. The method enhances adaptability to novel classes, especially under occlusion and category ambiguity.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作指出轨迹信息在OV-MOT中被忽视的问题，提出的轨迹感知框架对开放词汇跟踪有实际推动意义。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强关联与分类的开放词汇多目标跟踪器TRACT。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 引入轨迹一致性强化策略和即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，融合轨迹特征聚合与语义丰富。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类准确率，增强了对新类别的适应能力。

2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目跟踪器存在深度模糊和遮挡问题、现有多相机方法需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化的问题，本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器。该方法在已知相机位姿和多视角深度条件下，将多视角特征融合为统一点云，利用k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新模块实现长程3D对应估计，仅需4个相机即可在线跟踪。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8个相机、24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that tracks arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four). It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update for long-range 3D correspondence estimation. Trained on 5K synthetic Kubric sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, respectively.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪，仅需少量相机即可在线运行，对动态场景3D理解有重要价值。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，实现少量相机下的鲁棒在线3D点跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新模块，在遮挡下仍能估计长程3D对应。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别达到3.1cm和2.0cm中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8相机、24-150帧。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态时间上不完整、现有跟踪器因刚性架构而性能显著下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过异构混合专家（MoE）融合机制实现自适应复杂度，并设计视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。实验表明，该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整计算，在缺失模态情况下保持鲁棒跟踪性能。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, showing that existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. It proposes a flexible framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism featuring adaptive complexity and a video-level masking strategy for temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, maintaining robust tracking under missing modalities.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应MoE框架对实际部署中传感器缺失场景有重要实用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应鲁棒多模态跟踪框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 提出异构混合专家融合机制与视频级掩码策略，实现根据缺失率和场景复杂度动态调整计算。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同模态缺失率并保持鲁棒跟踪性能，同时根据场景复杂度调整计算量。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖手工启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将可学习的数据关联模块嵌入端到端 Transformer 跟踪框架。方法通过可微的关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价函数，使关联策略能够随检测与 ReID 特征联合训练。相比已有 MOTR 类方法，改进点在于关联过程可学习且与跟踪目标联合优化。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，需参考正文验证其在 MOT17/MOT20 等基准上的提升。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking, which hinders end-to-end optimization. LA-MOTR introduces a learnable association module into an end-to-end Transformer tracking framework, replacing fixed cost functions in Hungarian matching with a differentiable association predictor jointly trained with detection and ReID features. The key improvement over prior MOTR-style methods is that association becomes learnable and jointly optimized with tracking objectives.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 将可学习关联引入端到端 MOT 是合理方向，但需关注其相对启发式关联的实际增益与泛化性。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习数据关联模块，实现端到端多目标跟踪中关联策略与检测/ReID 的联合优化。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 用可微关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价函数。

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中现有概念互补但未被有效整合的问题，提出一套两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成 3D 提议，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠或部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道获得对象中心表示，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤假阳性。相比已有工作，改进在于系统整合互补概念并精炼关键环节，在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS), where existing concepts are complementary but not effectively combined. It proposes a two-stage recipe: 3D proposal generation via tracking-based aggregation with iterative merging/removal, and instance classification using Alpha-CLIP with object masks as an alpha channel plus a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to normalize text-to-proposal similarity and filter false positives. The systematic integration and refinement yield a new state-of-the-art on OV-3DIS benchmarks.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 工程整合与细节打磨扎实，Alpha-CLIP 与 SMS 的设计对开放词汇 3D 分割有实际参考价值。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合互补概念的两阶段 OV-3DIS 方案，达到新的 SOTA。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码 alpha 通道与 SMS 分数归一化提升对象中心表示与假阳性过滤。
2507.23134|v2.result: 在 OV-3DIS 基准上取得新的 state-of-the-art 性能。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶动态城市场景建模与渲染中依赖昂贵人工轨迹标注、自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需全面语义标注，通过简化伪 2D 分割自动分离物体与背景，用动态高斯和双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则增强鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses high-quality free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic urban driving scenes without costly manual tracklet annotations, where self-supervised methods struggle with accurate motion capture and scene decomposition. AD-GS introduces a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, automatic object/background separation via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians with bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and visibility reasoning plus physically rigid regularization. The annotation-free model significantly outperforms prior annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 将 B 样条与高斯泼溅结合用于自监督驾驶场景渲染，思路新颖且实用性强。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅框架 AD-GS，实现高质量动态驾驶场景渲染。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 局部 B 样条与全局三角函数融合的可学习运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR，首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略为后续帧建立高层类别先验，引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，并在解码器中加入保护策略。实验表明该方法在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前跟踪器，同时推理更快并显著减少参数量。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary multiple object tracking, where existing trackers suffer from rigid frameworks, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interaction. OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker jointly modeling motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy for high-level category priors, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective strategies in the decoder. It surpasses prior trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark with faster inference and significantly reduced parameters.
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 首个端到端开放词汇跟踪器，CIP 策略与双分支设计对开放世界跟踪有参考意义。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR，同时建模运动、外观与类别。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播策略与双分支多模态交互结构。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越先前方法，推理更快且参数量显著减少。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级长序列稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或跟踪稀疏的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法采用联合全局-局部注意力机制在降分辨率下跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器获得高分辨率预测；同时探索深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。实验表明 DELTA 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，并在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上均取得新的 SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense 3D motion tracking from monocular videos, where existing methods are limited by computational inefficiency or sparse tracking. DELTA leverages joint global-local attention for reduced-resolution tracking followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. It runs over 8x faster than prior methods and achieves new state-of-the-art results on both 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 在稠密 3D 跟踪的效率与精度上同时取得突破，log-depth 的发现对后续工作有指导意义。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密 3D 像素级跟踪方法 DELTA，兼顾速度与精度。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力加 Transformer 上采样器，并确定 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 比先前方法快 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪任务上取得新的 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、物体精确网格未知），提出一套方法。首先在无物体先验下估计任意物体 6D 位姿：从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型、与输入图像进行 6D 对齐、并基于场景确定绝对尺度；其次通过跨帧跟踪提取平滑 6D 物体轨迹，再经轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles extracting temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, where uncontrolled capture, subtle dynamic motion, and unknown object meshes pose challenges. The method estimates 6D pose of any object without prior knowledge by retrieving a similar CAD model, aligning it to the image, and grounding absolute scale, then extracts smooth 6D trajectories via cross-frame tracking and retargets them to a robot manipulator through trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的互联网视频 6D 位姿跟踪，问题设定新颖但与本领域核心方向相关度中等。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出从互联网视频提取物体 6D 位姿轨迹并重定向到机械臂的完整流程。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 无物体先验的 CAD 检索-对齐-尺度接地流程与轨迹优化重定向。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融，验证方法有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对复杂场景（如群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪的难题：目标运动高度协调、相互遮挡、轨迹存在长期依赖，而现有方法难以同时建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡。作者提出 Samba——一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query 并保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆表示；基于此构建了 tracking-by-propagation 框架 SambaMOTR，并引入处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。相比已有工作，SambaMOTR 首次在统一框架内有效应对长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡三类问题，同时保持线性复杂度。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但强调其在上述复杂协调场景中的有效性。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex scenarios where objects move in coordinated patterns, occlude each other, and exhibit long-term trajectory dependencies, which existing methods struggle to model jointly. It introduces Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces to jointly process tracklets, autoregressively predicting future track queries while maintaining synchronized long-term memory across sequences. Built into a tracking-by-propagation framework as SambaMOTR, it is the first tracker to effectively handle long-range dependencies, tracklet interdependencies, and temporal occlusions, with an additional MaskObs technique for uncertain observations.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将 Mamba/状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪并显式建模轨迹间同步依赖，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中多目标交互与遮挡场景的跟踪有借鉴价值。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出线性时间的集合序列模型 Samba 及基于其的跟踪框架 SambaMOTR，统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间对多条轨迹进行联合建模，并配合 MaskObs 处理不确定观测。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在群舞、团队运动等复杂协调场景中有效缓解长程依赖、轨迹交互与遮挡问题，且保持线性时间复杂度。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪通常分阶段处理，且运动模型多依赖线性假设，难以应对复杂非线性运动。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（motion modelling）以联合优化检测与轨迹关联。相比已有分阶段方法，其改进在于将检测与运动预测耦合，减少误差累积。在 MOT 基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度（如 MOTA/IDF1 提升），具体数据见原文。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-object tracking (MOT) where detection and tracking are typically decoupled and motion models rely on linear assumptions. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with motion modelling to jointly optimize detection and trajectory association. Compared to staged pipelines, it reduces error accumulation and achieves competitive tracking accuracy on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 将检测与运动建模联合优化，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有直接参考价值。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出同时检测与跟踪并融合运动建模的 MOT 框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 把运动模型嵌入检测-跟踪联合优化，缓解分阶段误差累积。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度（MOTA/IDF1 提升）。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文指出仅攻击目标检测不足以破坏多目标跟踪，因为跟踪器可通过时序关联恢复部分目标。作者提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，同时干扰检测与数据关联。相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，其改进在于联合攻击检测与跟踪关联模块，显著降低跟踪性能。实验表明该攻击能有效使 MOT 指标大幅下降。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper shows that fooling detection alone is insufficient to break multi-object tracking, since trackers can recover targets via temporal association. It proposes an adversarial attack against MOT that jointly perturbs detection and data association. Compared to detection-only attacks, it substantially degrades tracking performance, as demonstrated on MOT benchmarks.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 从对抗鲁棒性角度揭示 MOT 的脆弱性，对自动驾驶感知安全有警示意义。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出联合攻击检测与关联的 MOT 对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 证明仅攻击检测不够，需同时干扰数据关联才能有效破坏跟踪。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 攻击使 MOT 跟踪指标大幅下降。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的数据关联可建模为最小代价流或不相交路径问题，但传统方法难以处理长时序与复杂约束。该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将问题提升到更高维空间以联合优化轨迹与关联。相比已有不相交路径方法，其改进在于能更灵活地表达多目标约束并求解全局最优。在 MOT 基准上取得了优于基线方法的跟踪性能。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-object tracking, which can be formulated as minimum-cost flow or disjoint paths but struggles with long sequences and complex constraints. It proposes a Lifted Disjoint Paths model that lifts the problem to a higher-dimensional space to jointly optimize trajectories and associations. Compared to existing disjoint path methods, it better captures multi-object constraints and achieves improved tracking performance on MOT benchmarks.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 为 MOT 数据关联提供更强的组合优化建模，理论扎实且实验充分。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型用于 MOT 数据关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 通过问题提升（lifting）更灵活地表达多目标约束并求全局最优。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在 MOT 基准上跟踪性能优于基线方法。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉Transformer（ViT）在局部特征建模上的不足，提出了一种双重融合ViT（Doubly-Fused ViT）架构，旨在将全局自注意力与局部表示更有效地结合。方法上可能通过设计双路径融合模块，在多个阶段融合局部卷积特征与Transformer特征。相比已有ViT变体，其改进点在于更充分地利用局部信息以提升密集预测任务的性能。摘要未提供具体实验数据，因此无法引用定量结果。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of Vision Transformers (ViTs) in modeling local representations by proposing a Doubly-Fused ViT architecture that effectively combines global self-attention with local features. The method likely introduces a dual-path fusion module to integrate convolutional local features with transformer features at multiple stages. Compared to existing ViT variants, it better exploits local information for dense prediction tasks. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 该工作探索了ViT中局部与全局信息融合的改进方向，对视觉骨干网络设计有一定参考价值，但缺乏具体实验数据支撑其有效性。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出了一种双重融合ViT架构，将局部表示与全局自注意力更充分地结合。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 通过双路径融合机制在多个阶段整合局部卷积特征与Transformer特征。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习需要像素级伪造位置标注的问题，提出了一种基于Vision Transformer的无监督不一致性感知方法UIA-ViT。方法仅使用视频级标签，通过自注意力机制自然表示patch间的一致性关系，并设计了无监督patch一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式学习等关键组件。相比需要像素级标注或成对真实/伪造图像的方法，UIA-ViT无需额外标注即可学习不一致性特征，提升了泛化能力。摘要未给出具体定量结果，但强调了其克服标注依赖的优势。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of learning intra-frame inconsistency for face forgery detection without pixel-level annotations, proposing an Unsupervised Inconsistency-Aware method based on Vision Transformer (UIA-ViT). It leverages only video-level labels and exploits the self-attention mechanism to naturally represent consistency relations among patch embeddings, with key components including Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and progressive learning. Compared to methods requiring pixel-level annotations or paired real/fake images, UIA-ViT learns inconsistency-aware features without extra annotations, improving generalization. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙利用ViT的自注意力特性实现无监督不一致性学习，为人脸伪造检测提供了新思路，但需验证其在标准基准上的实际性能。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出了一种仅需视频级标签的无监督不一致性感知ViT方法，用于人脸伪造检测。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图自然表示patch一致性关系，并设计无监督patch一致性学习与渐进式学习组件。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体定量结果，但声称无需像素级标注即可学习不一致性特征。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）缺乏可解释性的问题，提出了ViT-NeT，一种带有神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构。方法上可能将ViT的特征表示与神经决策树结合，以提供可解释的预测路径。相比标准ViT，其改进点在于增强了模型决策的透明度和可解释性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，因此无法引用定量结果。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability in Vision Transformers (ViTs) by proposing ViT-NeT, an interpretable ViT architecture with a neural tree decoder. The method likely combines ViT feature representations with a neural decision tree to provide interpretable prediction paths. Compared to standard ViTs, it improves the transparency and interpretability of model decisions. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 该工作探索了ViT的可解释性改进，对需要理解模型决策的应用场景有潜在价值，但缺乏实验数据支撑。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出了一种带有神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构ViT-NeT。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 将ViT与神经决策树结合，提供可解释的预测路径。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在目标检测和实例分割中多尺度架构复杂的问题，提出了一种简单的单尺度ViT（Simple Single-Scale ViT）用于目标检测和实例分割。方法上可能通过简化多尺度设计，仅使用单尺度特征图并配合适当的检测头，在保持性能的同时降低计算复杂度。相比多尺度ViT（如Swin、PVT等），其改进点在于架构更简单且易于实现。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但标题暗示其在检测和分割任务上具有竞争力。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of multi-scale Vision Transformer architectures for object detection and instance segmentation by proposing a simple single-scale ViT. The method likely simplifies the multi-scale design by using only a single-scale feature map with appropriate detection heads, reducing computational complexity while maintaining performance. Compared to multi-scale ViTs (e.g., Swin, PVT), it offers a simpler and more implementable architecture. No quantitative results are provided in the abstract, but the title suggests competitive performance on detection and segmentation tasks.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 该工作挑战了多尺度ViT在检测任务中的必要性，提出简化方案，对高效检测器设计有参考意义，但需实验验证其性能。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出了一种简单的单尺度ViT架构，用于目标检测和实例分割。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 通过简化多尺度设计，仅使用单尺度特征图实现检测与分割。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果未知。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer自注意力机制随图像尺寸增长而缺乏可扩展性的问题，提出了多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），包括分块局部注意力和膨胀全局注意力，实现了线性复杂度的全局-局部空间交互。方法上还提出了一种将注意力与卷积有效融合的架构元素，并构建了简单的分层视觉骨干网络MaxViT。相比已有ViT，MaxViT能在整个网络（包括高分辨率早期阶段）实现全局感知。实验表明，在ImageNet-1K上无需额外数据达到86.5% top-1准确率，在ImageNet-21K预训练后性能进一步提升，并在多种视觉任务上取得领先结果。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scalability limitation of self-attention in Vision Transformers with respect to image size by introducing multi-axis attention, which consists of blocked local and dilated global attention, enabling global-local spatial interactions with linear complexity. It also presents an architectural element that effectively blends attention with convolutions, leading to a simple hierarchical vision backbone called MaxViT. Notably, MaxViT can 'see' globally throughout the entire network, even in early high-resolution stages. Experiments show that MaxViT achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy without extra data, and further improvements with ImageNet-21K pre-training, achieving state-of-the-art results on a broad spectrum of vision tasks.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT通过创新的多轴注意力机制在保持线性复杂度的同时实现了全局感知，在多个视觉任务上取得领先性能，是视觉骨干网络设计的重要进展。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出了多轴注意力机制和MaxViT分层视觉骨干网络，实现了线性复杂度的全局-局部交互。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 结合分块局部注意力与膨胀全局注意力，并将注意力与卷积有效融合。
2204.01697|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1K上达到86.5% top-1准确率，ImageNet-21K预训练后性能进一步提升，并在多种视觉任务上取得领先结果。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对在线持续学习（online CL）中从无任务边界的在线数据流学习时缓解灾难性遗忘的问题，提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架。方法上设计了基于Transformer的外部注意力机制以隐式捕获先前任务信息，并为每个类别引入可学习焦点以积累旧类知识，同时提出焦点对比损失来重新平衡新旧类间的对比学习，并采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与所有已见类平衡。实验表明，该方法在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到最先进性能，有效缓解了遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning (online CL) from an online data stream without task boundaries, proposing a Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT) framework. It designs an external attention mechanism for online CL that implicitly captures previous task information, and introduces learnable focuses for each class to accumulate knowledge of previous classes. A focal contrastive loss rebalances contrastive learning between new and past classes, and a dual-classifier structure decouples learning current classes and balancing all observed classes. Experiments show that CVT achieves state-of-the-art performance with even fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks, effectively alleviating forgetting.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，通过外部注意力和焦点对比损失有效平衡稳定性与可塑性，在基准上取得领先结果。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出了对比视觉Transformer（CVT）框架，用于在线持续学习。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 设计了外部注意力机制、可学习焦点和焦点对比损失，以及双分类器结构。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上以更少参数达到最先进性能，有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计（尤其是token embedding层，即卷积嵌入CE）如何为分层ViT注入归纳偏置。作者系统揭示了CE的作用机制并给出最优CE配置，将其应用于4个最新SOTA ViT上均带来性能提升，并发布了通用骨干网络CETNets。CETNets在ImageNet-1K上取得84.9% Top-1准确率。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models, particularly the convolutional embedding (CE) token embedding layer, injects desirable inductive bias into hierarchical ViTs. The authors systematically reveal the mechanism of CE, derive an optimal CE configuration, and apply it to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs to boost their performance. They release a family of efficient hybrid backbones, CETNets, achieving 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干设计有实用参考价值，CE配置的系统性分析与通用性验证较扎实，但主要面向分类任务，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示卷积嵌入为分层ViT注入归纳偏置的机制并给出最优配置，发布通用混合骨干CETNets。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面而非微观CNN模块层面研究混合CNN/ViT的归纳偏置注入方式。
2207.13317|v2.result: CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率，并一致提升4个SOTA ViT的性能。

The improvement lies in introducing ViT-based contextual modeling into video ReID. Quantitative results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出可扩展自注意力（SSA），用两个缩放因子解耦query/key/value矩阵维度与输入，并设计交互式窗口自注意力（IWSA）通过重合并独立value token与聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域间的交互。交替堆叠SSA与IWSA构成ScalableViT，在通用视觉任务上达到SOTA。ScalableViT-S在ImageNet-1K上分别超过Twins-SVT-S 1.4%和Swin-T 1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: To address the inflexibility of vanilla self-attention that relies on predefined computational dimensions, this paper proposes Scalable Self-Attention (SSA) with two scaling factors that decouple query/key/value dimensions from the input, and an Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) that re-merges value tokens and aggregates adjacent-window spatial information. Stacking SSA and IWSA yields ScalableViT, achieving state-of-the-art results on general vision tasks, e.g., ScalableViT-S surpasses Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制的维度灵活性做了有价值的探索，精度-成本权衡思路清晰，但实验集中在分类任务，感知下游验证有限。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力SSA与交互式窗口自注意力IWSA，构建ScalableViT骨干。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 用缩放因子解耦注意力矩阵维度与输入，实现面向上下文的泛化与更优精度-成本权衡。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，本文针对360°全景视频中的显著性检测问题，提出全景视觉Transformer（Panoramic Vision Transformer），以应对全景图像特有的畸变与球面几何带来的挑战。相比已有工作，其改进点在于将ViT应用于全景显著性检测。具体方法与效果因摘要缺失无法评估。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: Based on the title alone (abstract unavailable), this work targets saliency detection in 360° panoramic videos and proposes a Panoramic Vision Transformer to handle the distortion and spherical geometry of omnidirectional imagery. The improvement lies in adapting ViT to panoramic saliency detection. Method details and quantitative results cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较带来巨大计算负担、而现有硬性丢弃token的方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。其核心是Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为少量信息量大的token，即使在高瘦身率下也不切断判别性token关系；并引入特征重校准蒸馏（FRD）框架，用反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式重校准非结构化token。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: To address the heavy computation of ViTs caused by exhaustive token-to-token comparison and the loss of vital tokens in hard token-dropping at high ratios, this paper proposes a generic self-slimmed learning approach, SiT. It designs a Token Slimming Module (TSM) that softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic token aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM (RTSM) to recalibrate unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token软聚合与蒸馏结合的思路对ViT推理加速有实用价值，方法设计较完整，但主要面向分类，感知任务验证有限。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT，含Token Slimming Module与特征重校准蒸馏FRD。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token软聚合替代硬性丢弃，并配合反向TSM的自编码器式特征重校准蒸馏。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，提升ViT推理效率（摘要未给出具体数值）。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，仅从标题判断，本文针对ViT在多尺度视觉建模上的不足，提出CrossFormer，一种以跨尺度注意力（cross-scale attention）为核心的通用视觉Transformer。相比已有工作，其改进点在于显式建模不同尺度特征间的注意力交互。具体方法与效果因摘要缺失无法评估。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: Based on the title alone (abstract unavailable), this work proposes CrossFormer, a versatile vision transformer hinging on cross-scale attention, to address the limitation of ViTs in multi-scale visual modeling. The improvement lies in explicitly modeling attention interactions across different scales. Method details and quantitative results cannot be assessed due to the missing abstract.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 跨尺度注意力对多尺度目标检测等感知任务有潜在价值，但摘要缺失，无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出以跨尺度注意力为核心的通用视觉Transformer骨干CrossFormer。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 显式建模跨尺度特征间的注意力交互以增强多尺度表征。
