2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中需同时解决实体识别、语义关系推断与系统性泛化三个难题，本文以ViT为基础模型，引入概念特征字典，在训练时用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为HICO和GQA构建了系统性划分。RelViT在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This work tackles visual relational reasoning, which jointly requires entity identification, semantic relation inference, and systematic generalization. It augments ViTs with a concept-feature dictionary enabling concept-guided global relational and local object-centric auxiliary tasks, and introduces systematic splits for HICO and GQA. RelViT improves relational reasoning and systematic generalization over baselines, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 将概念字典与ViT结合以提升关系推理和系统性泛化，思路对视觉推理与多模态理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT（RelViT）及概念特征字典与两个辅助任务，并给出HICO/GQA系统性泛化划分。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 用概念键在训练时检索图像特征，以全局与局部概念引导任务增强ViT的关系推理与物体中心对应学习。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在关系推理与系统性泛化上优于基线，摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 针对ImageNet训练的ViT过度依赖局部纹理、对形状信息利用不足、难以泛化到分布外真实数据的问题，本文在ViT输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散token，与连续像素token互补。离散token对小扰动不变且单token信息量少，促使ViT学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体、七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上，鲁棒性最高提升12%，同时保持ImageNet性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses ViTs' over-reliance on local textures and poor shape utilization, which harms out-of-distribution generalization. It adds discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder to ViT's input layer, complementing continuous pixel tokens and encouraging invariant global representations. Across four architecture variants and seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks, robustness improves by up to 12% while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 以极简的输入层改动显著提升ViT鲁棒性，方法简单有效，对视觉骨干网络设计有借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶3D感知任务直接相关度有限。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层引入矢量量化离散token的简单架构修改，以增强鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散token的小扰动不变性与低单token信息量，引导ViT学习不变的全局信息。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在四种架构变体、七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上鲁棒性最高提升12%，ImageNet性能保持。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度随token数二次增长、且全局注意力缺乏局部归纳偏置的问题，本文提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention（PaCa-ViT），将patch级query与聚类级key/value进行注意力计算，从而在保留语义聚合能力的同时降低计算量。相比标准self-attention和窗口注意力，PaCa通过可学习的聚类分配实现更高效的全局-局部信息交互。在ImageNet分类及下游任务上取得了与主流ViT相当或更优的精度，同时显著减少FLOPs。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic complexity and weak local inductive bias of standard self-attention in Vision Transformers by proposing Patch-to-Cluster Attention (PaCa-ViT), which computes attention between patch-level queries and cluster-level keys/values. Compared with window or sparse global attention, PaCa achieves efficient global-local interaction via learnable clustering assignments. It attains competitive or superior accuracy on ImageNet and downstream tasks with substantially reduced FLOPs.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 为ViT注意力效率与局部性平衡提供了一种可学习的聚类式方案，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其聚类开销与泛化性。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster Attention，将patch query与聚类key/value进行注意力计算以降低ViT计算量。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 用可学习聚类替代固定窗口或稀疏全局注意力，兼顾语义聚合与效率。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet等任务上以更少FLOPs达到与主流ViT相当或更优的精度。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而在保持精度的同时压缩计算量。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性近似，避免了直接训练线性注意力带来的精度下降。在ImageNet分类和下游任务上实现了与标准ViT相近的精度，同时显著降低推理FLOPs和延迟。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: To reduce the inference cost of self-attention in ViTs, this paper proposes Castling-ViT, which switches standard softmax attention to a linear-angular attention at inference time. By training with standard attention and replacing it with a linear approximation only during inference, it avoids the accuracy drop of directly trained linear attention. It achieves accuracy comparable to standard ViTs on ImageNet and downstream tasks while substantially reducing inference FLOPs and latency.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 提出了一种训练-推理解耦的注意力压缩策略，对ViT边缘部署有实用价值，但线性近似的通用性和极端压缩比下的表现仍需验证。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出Castling-ViT，在推理时将softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力以压缩计算。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练用标准注意力、推理用线性角度注意力的解耦设计，兼顾精度与效率。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet及下游任务上以显著更低的推理FLOPs达到与标准ViT相近的精度。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时量化推理仍依赖浮点运算、而CNN的dyadic算术不适用于ViT非线性组件的问题，本文提出I-ViT，一种面向ViT的整数量化方案，使整个推理计算图仅用整数算术和位移完成。线性操作（MatMul、Dense）沿用dyadic整数流水线，非线性操作（Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm）则用提出的轻量整数近似方法（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU、ShiftLayerNorm）替代。在ImageNet上实现了与浮点模型几乎无损的精度，同时显著降低延迟和能耗，是ViT整数量化推理的重要进展。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge that quantized ViT inference still relies on floating-point arithmetic, since dyadic arithmetic designed for CNNs does not apply to ViT non-linearities. It proposes I-ViT, an integer-only quantization scheme that performs the entire inference graph with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting, using dyadic pipelines for linear ops and lightweight integer approximations (Shiftmax, ShiftGELU, ShiftLayerNorm) for non-linear ops. It achieves near-lossless accuracy on ImageNet with substantial latency and energy reduction, marking a significant advance in integer-only ViT inference.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 解决了ViT整数量化推理中非线性算子无法整数化的关键开放问题，方法系统且实验扎实，对ViT边缘部署有直接工程价值。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出I-ViT整数量化方案，使ViT全推理图仅用整数算术和位移完成。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 为Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm设计轻量整数近似（Shift系列），突破dyadic算术对ViT非线性的限制。
2207.01405|v2.result: 在ImageNet上实现与浮点模型几乎无损的精度，同时显著降低推理延迟与能耗。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因骨干网络老旧且未考虑人类交互感知过程而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，本文提出ViPLO，基于ViT骨干的姿态条件自环图。首先提出Masking with Overlapped Area（MOA）模块，利用patch与给定区域的重叠面积解决ViT骨干下的量化问题；其次设计姿态条件自环图结构，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦特定关节以识别交互类型。在HICO-DET等基准上取得了优于现有两阶段方法的性能。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: To address the inferior performance of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and neglect of human interaction perception, this paper proposes ViPLO, a ViT-based pose-conditioned self-loop graph. It introduces a Masking with Overlapped Area (MOA) module that uses patch-region overlap to handle quantization issues with ViT backbones, and a pose-conditioned self-loop graph that updates human node encodings with local joint features. It outperforms existing two-stage methods on benchmarks such as HICO-DET.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 将ViT骨干与姿态条件图结构结合用于HOI检测，MOA模块对ViT区域特征提取有借鉴意义，但领域相关性偏窄。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出ViPLO，基于ViT骨干的姿态条件自环图用于两阶段HOI检测。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块利用patch与区域重叠面积解决ViT量化问题，姿态条件自环图聚焦人体关节特征。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HICO-DET等HOI基准上优于现有两阶段方法。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于距离投影的LiDAR点云3D语义分割方法长期依赖2D CNN、尚未验证ViT能否带来增益的问题，本文提出RangeViT，将ViT引入距离图像分割。关键设计包括：保持与RGB图像相同的ViT骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识；通过定制卷积等补偿ViT缺乏的归纳偏置；并针对距离图像特性进行适配。在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得了优于基于CNN的投影方法的分割精度，验证了ViT在LiDAR语义分割中的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based LiDAR 3D semantic segmentation can benefit from Vision Transformers, which have dominated image benchmarks but have not been validated for range-view segmentation. It proposes RangeViT, which preserves the RGB ViT backbone to exploit large-scale image pre-training, compensates for ViT's lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutions, and adapts to range-image characteristics. It outperforms CNN-based projection methods on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes, demonstrating the potential of ViTs for LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将ViT引入距离图像LiDAR语义分割，预训练迁移与归纳偏置补偿的设计对自动驾驶3D感知有直接参考价值。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出RangeViT，将ViT骨干用于距离投影LiDAR点云3D语义分割。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 复用RGB图像ViT预训练权重并定制卷积补偿归纳偏置，适配距离图像特性。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上超越基于CNN的投影方法。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力要么采用稀疏全局注意力、要么采用窗口注意力，导致局部特征学习受损或依赖手工设计的问题，本文提出Slide Attention，一种基于普通卷积操作实现的高效局部注意力模块。方法将基于列的Im2Col函数从行视角重新解释，用Depthwise Convolution高效替代，并在此基础上提出deformed shifting模块。相比依赖特定CUDA内核的局部注意力，Slide Attention具有更好的效率、灵活性和跨设备泛化性，在ImageNet分类和下游任务上取得有竞争力的精度与速度。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of sparse global or window attention in ViTs, which compromise local feature learning or rely on handcrafted designs, this paper proposes Slide Attention, an efficient local attention module built on common convolution operations. It reinterprets the column-based Im2Col function from a row-based perspective, substitutes it with Depthwise Convolution, and introduces a deformed shifting module. Compared with CUDA-specific local attention, it offers better efficiency, flexibility, and generalizability, achieving competitive accuracy and speed on ImageNet and downstream tasks.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 用通用卷积算子实现局部注意力，避免了CUDA内核依赖，对ViT在非CUDA设备上的部署有实用意义，但创新幅度相对有限。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出Slide Attention，用Depthwise Convolution替代Im2Col实现高效可泛化的局部注意力。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重新解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，配合deformed shifting模块。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在ImageNet及下游任务上取得有竞争力的精度与速度，且不依赖特定CUDA内核。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中像素级标注昂贵、纯监督 Transformer 训练数据效率低的问题，本文提出 SemiCVT，将卷积与 Vision Transformer 结合用于半监督语义分割。方法上利用卷积归纳偏置增强局部特征提取，并在少量标注与大量无标注数据上联合训练，通过一致性正则/伪标签利用无标注数据。相比纯 ViT 或纯 CNN 的半监督方案，SemiCVT 在标注稀缺时兼顾了全局建模与局部细节。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认增益幅度。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of pixel-level annotation in semantic segmentation by proposing SemiCVT, a semi-supervised convolutional vision transformer. It combines convolutional inductive biases with transformer global modeling and leverages unlabeled data via consistency regularization/pseudo-labels. Compared with pure ViT or CNN semi-supervised baselines, it aims to improve segmentation under scarce labels, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 半监督分割与卷积-Transformer 混合是实用方向，但摘要信息有限，需看实验规模与增益是否显著。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出卷积与 ViT 混合的半监督语义分割框架 SemiCVT。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 将卷积归纳偏置引入 ViT 并用于半监督一致性训练。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证其在标注稀缺下的分割增益。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练 ViT 的 token 表示及其自注意力相关性，通过独立任务头同时输出分类与分割预测。方法用自监督 ViT 生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，无需训练时像素标注；并进一步提出混合监督设置，用少量真值像素标签训练伪标签增强器来提升伪标签质量。在 Pascal-5i 和 COCO-20i 上多种监督设置下取得显著提升，尤其在小样本像素级监督极少时优势明显。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting token representations and self-attention correlations from a self-supervised ViT. Attention maps serve as pixel-level pseudo-labels, enabling training with only image-level labels, and a pseudo-label enhancer trained on a few ground-truth masks improves them in a mixed-supervision setup. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show significant gains across supervision settings, especially with little-to-no pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 把自监督 ViT 的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割思路清晰，混合监督的伪标签增强实用，实验基准有说服力。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出基于自监督 ViT 注意力伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割框架。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督 ViT 注意力图作像素伪标签，并引入真值监督的伪标签增强器。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在 Pascal-5i 与 COCO-20i 多种监督设置下取得显著性能提升。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对 Vision Transformer 中注意力机制容易过拟合、训练数据需求大的问题，提出 DropKey 正则化方法。方法将注意力 logits 视为键（key）并对其进行随机丢弃，相当于在注意力层面做结构化 dropout，从而缓解注意力头对特定 token 的过度依赖。相比标准 dropout 或 DropPath，DropKey 直接作用于注意力矩阵，理论上可视为一种数据增强式的注意力正则。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值，需正文确认在分类/检测等任务上的提升。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DropKey, a regularization method for Vision Transformers that randomly drops attention keys (logits) to alleviate overfitting and over-reliance on specific tokens. Unlike standard dropout or DropPath, it operates directly on the attention matrix as a structured regularizer. The abstract lacks quantitative results, so gains on classification/detection must be verified in the paper.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: 注意力正则化是 ViT 训练的常见痛点，DropKey 简单通用，但需看其相对已有正则方法的实际增益。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出面向 ViT 注意力键的随机丢弃正则化方法 DropKey。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 将 dropout 作用于注意力 logits/键，形成注意力层面的结构化正则。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，需正文验证其训练稳定性与精度提升。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对音视频任务中需要大规模音频预训练或外部音频编码器、微调成本高的问题，本文研究冻结的纯视觉预训练 ViT 能否泛化到音视频数据。提出 LAVISH 适配器，在冻结 ViT 的每一层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组 latent token 构成注意力瓶颈来融合视觉与音频线索，避免标准交叉注意力的二次复杂度。相比模态专用音视频方法，在多个音视频任务上取得相当或更好性能，同时可调参数更少，且不依赖昂贵的音频预训练或外部音频编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work studies whether frozen, visually pretrained ViTs can generalize to audio-visual data without finetuning original parameters. It proposes the LAVISH adapter, which injects a small number of trainable parameters into every layer of a frozen ViT and uses latent tokens as an attention bottleneck to fuse visual and audio cues, avoiding quadratic cross-attention cost. It matches or surpasses modality-specific audio-visual methods on several tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoders.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效地把冻结视觉 ViT 迁移到音视频任务，latent bottleneck 设计简洁有效，对多模态适配研究有参考价值。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的音视频适配器 LAVISH，将冻结视觉 ViT 迁移到音视频任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用 latent token 注意力瓶颈替代标准交叉注意力，实现低参数音视频融合。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多个音视频任务上达到或超过模态专用方法，且可调参数更少、无需音频预训练。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对 ViT 计算量大、难以实时部署的问题，本文提出高效视觉 Transformer 家族 EfficientViT。作者发现现有 Transformer 速度常受限于内存低效操作，尤其是 MHSA 中的张量重排与逐元素函数，因此设计 sandwich 布局模块，在高效 FFN 之间放置单个内存受限的 MHSA 以改善内存效率并增强通道通信。同时发现不同注意力头注意力图高度相似导致冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同分片分别送入各头，既省算力又提升注意力多样性。实验表明 EfficientViT 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，如 EfficientViT-M5 在保持竞争力的同时显著提速。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes EfficientViT, a family of high-speed vision transformers, motivated by the observation that existing transformers are bounded by memory-inefficient operations such as tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA. It designs a sandwich-layout block placing a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and introduces cascaded group attention that feeds different splits of features to different heads to reduce redundancy and improve attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than existing efficient models, e.g., EfficientViT-M5.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从内存效率与注意力冗余两个角度切入，工程洞察扎实，速度-精度权衡结果有竞争力，对实时视觉部署有实用价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出兼顾内存效率与注意力多样性的高效 ViT 家族 EfficientViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: sandwich 布局的 MHSA-FFN 模块与级联组注意力机制。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，EfficientViT-M5 等配置取得有竞争力的表现。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准ViT在欧几里得平面上建模、难以处理球面信号（如全景/鱼眼图像、地球观测数据）的问题，本文提出HEAL-SWIN，一种在球面HEALPix网格上运行的层次化Vision Transformer。方法将自注意力与卷积操作适配到球面层级网格，利用其等面积、层次化特性实现多尺度建模。相比直接在平面投影上做ViT的方案，避免了极点畸变与边界不连续。在球面信号任务上取得优于平面ViT基线的精度，并保持计算效率。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between standard Euclidean ViTs and spherical signals such as panoramic or fisheye imagery. It proposes HEAL-SWIN, a hierarchical Vision Transformer operating on the spherical HEALPix grid, adapting self-attention and convolution to the grid's equal-area, hierarchical structure. Compared with planar-projection ViT baselines, it avoids polar distortion and boundary discontinuity, achieving better accuracy on spherical-signal tasks at comparable efficiency.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 球面ViT对全景/鱼眼感知有潜在价值，但当前与自动驾驶主流BEV/多相机范式关联有限，属于方法储备型工作。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出首个在HEALPix球面层次网格上构建的层次化Vision Transformer。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将自注意力与卷积算子适配到等面积球面网格，消除平面投影畸变。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 在球面信号任务上精度优于平面ViT基线并保持计算效率。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对医学图像可变形配准中CNN感受野受限、难以建模长程形变的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层次化Vision Transformer配准框架。方法在多个尺度上提取ViT特征，并通过跨尺度交互与形变场迭代细化实现稠密位移估计。相比纯卷积配准网络，H-ViT能捕获更大范围的空间依赖，提升大形变场景下的配准精度。在公开配准基准上取得优于CNN基线的Dice与形变场平滑度指标。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where CNNs struggle with long-range deformation due to limited receptive fields. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer that extracts multi-scale ViT features and iteratively refines the deformation field via cross-scale interaction. Compared with CNN-based registration, it captures broader spatial dependencies and improves accuracy under large deformations, yielding better Dice and deformation smoothness on public benchmarks.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 层次化ViT用于稠密预测的思路对自动驾驶中的光流/配准类任务有借鉴意义，但应用域为医学影像，直接相关性一般。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出面向可变形配准的层次化ViT框架H-ViT。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 多尺度ViT特征与跨尺度交互驱动的迭代形变场细化。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 在公开配准基准上Dice与形变平滑度优于CNN基线。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对ViT在长尾数据集上训练时尾部类别性能严重退化、且缺乏归纳偏置导致数据饥饿的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法采用CNN教师提供归纳偏置，并设计多阶段蒸馏策略：早期用教师引导表征学习，后期逐步解耦以适配长尾分布，同时引入针对尾部类的蒸馏加权。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT或常规蒸馏，DeiT-LT显著提升尾部类精度。在iNaturalist等长尾基准上整体精度与尾部类精度均超过此前SOTA。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe tail-class degradation of ViTs trained on long-tailed datasets, where the lack of inductive bias causes data starvation. It proposes DeiT-LT, which revisits distillation by using a CNN teacher for inductive bias and a multi-stage strategy that gradually decouples distillation to fit the long-tailed distribution, with tail-aware distillation weighting. It substantially improves tail-class accuracy and surpasses prior state of the art on long-tailed benchmarks such as iNaturalist.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 长尾蒸馏对自动驾驶中稀有类别（如FOD、异形障碍物）检测有直接启发，方法简洁且实验扎实，值得关注。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出面向长尾ViT训练的多阶段CNN-to-ViT蒸馏框架DeiT-LT。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 用CNN教师的归纳偏置缓解ViT数据饥饿，并设计尾部类感知的蒸馏解耦策略。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 在iNaturalist等长尾基准上整体与尾部类精度均超越此前SOTA。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在稠密预测任务（检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征交互、局部细节建模不足的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互模块嵌入ViT主干。方法设计CNN金字塔与ViT并行的双分支结构，通过CNN-ViT交互模块与多尺度特征金字塔融合，兼顾全局语义与局部细节。相比Swin、ViT-Adapter等方案，ViT-CoMer在保持简洁结构的同时提升稠密预测性能。在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上取得优于同量级ViT-Adapter的结果，且无需复杂预训练。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of multi-scale interaction and local detail modeling in ViTs for dense prediction. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which embeds a convolutional multi-scale feature interaction module into the ViT backbone via a parallel CNN-ViT dual-branch design and a CNN-ViT interaction module. Compared with Swin and ViT-Adapter, it improves dense prediction while remaining simple, outperforming comparable ViT-Adapter on COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation without heavy pretraining.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 稠密预测主干设计对自动驾驶2D/3D检测与BEV感知均有迁移价值，方法简洁、结果有竞争力，值得关注。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出融合卷积多尺度交互的ViT主干ViT-CoMer用于稠密预测。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: CNN-ViT并行双分支与交互模块，兼顾全局语义与局部多尺度细节。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 在COCO检测与ADE20K分割上优于同量级ViT-Adapter。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT训练后量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度骤降、且校准数据不可得（数据无关）场景的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种对比式数据无关学习框架用于自适应PTQ。方法通过对比学习从生成式先验中合成判别性校准样本，并对每层量化参数进行自适应搜索，缓解激活分布偏移。相比现有数据无关量化方法，CLAMP-ViT在极低比特下保持更高精度。在ImageNet分类与下游检测任务上，低比特量化精度损失显著小于基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy collapse of post-training quantization for ViTs at low bit-widths, especially when calibration data is unavailable. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning framework that synthesizes discriminative calibration samples from generative priors and adaptively searches per-layer quantization parameters. Compared with existing data-free quantization, it retains higher accuracy at very low bit-widths on ImageNet classification and downstream detection.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 数据无关量化对车载端侧部署有实用价值，但属于模型压缩方向，与感知算法本身相关性中等。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出对比式数据无关学习驱动的ViT自适应训练后量化框架CLAMP-ViT。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习合成判别性校准样本并自适应搜索逐层量化参数。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 在极低比特下ImageNet分类与下游检测精度损失显著小于基线。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量过大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，通过预采集调制降低采集数据量。方法核心是可学习的欠采样掩码，在采集前对像素进行选择性采样，并配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调以适配光学计算硬件。相比全采样方案，LUM-ViT仅采样10%像素即可将ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper targets bandwidth-limited signal acquisition, where huge data volumes (e.g., hyperspectral) hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a ViT variant with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, combined with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy for optical hardware. Sampling only 10% of pixels, it limits ImageNet accuracy loss to 1.8% and maintains near-original accuracy on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 预采集调制与可学习欠采样掩码思路新颖，对带宽受限的传感/检测系统有启发，但与自动驾驶主流感知管线关联有限。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出带可学习欠采样掩码的ViT变体LUM-ViT用于预采集调制。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 将可学习欠采样掩码与核级权值二值化结合，适配光学计算硬件。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失不超过1.8%，真实光学硬件上接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉token与文本问题交互不足的问题，提出Question Aware Vision Transformer（QA-ViT），将文本问题信息注入视觉编码器，使视觉特征在编码阶段即具备问题导向性。方法上通过在ViT中引入问题感知模块，让视觉token在自注意力过程中与问题embedding交互，从而生成更贴合下游推理任务的视觉表示。相比仅在LLM侧进行跨模态对齐的已有方案，该方法把多模态融合前移到视觉编码器，减少了视觉编码与语言推理之间的语义鸿沟。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但该思路对多模态推理与自动驾驶中的VLM感知具有参考价值。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual tokens are encoded independently of the textual query. It proposes Question Aware Vision Transformer (QA-ViT), which injects question information into the ViT encoder so that visual tokens interact with the query embedding during self-attention, producing query-conditioned visual representations. Unlike prior work that performs cross-modal alignment only inside the LLM, this approach moves multimodal fusion earlier into the vision backbone, narrowing the semantic gap between visual encoding and language reasoning. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 把问题信息前移到视觉编码器的思路对多模态推理和VLM感知有启发，但摘要信息有限，需看实验验证其实际增益。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出问题感知的视觉Transformer，将文本问题注入视觉编码过程以生成任务导向的视觉表示。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 将多模态融合从LLM侧前移至ViT视觉编码阶段，实现问题条件化的视觉token编码。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果需以正文实验为准。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐困难、ViT在未见类上泛化不足的问题，提出渐进式语义引导的Vision Transformer（PS-ViT）。方法通过渐进式语义引导机制，在ViT的不同层级逐步引入类语义信息，引导视觉特征向语义空间靠拢，从而增强对未见类别的识别能力。相比传统ZSL方法依赖固定语义嵌入或单阶段对齐，该工作采用分层渐进策略，缓解了视觉-语义鸿沟。摘要未给出具体数据集上的数值结果，但其语义引导的分层设计对开放集/零样本检测有借鉴意义。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of aligning visual features with semantic attributes and the poor generalization of ViTs to unseen classes in zero-shot learning (ZSL). It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer (PS-ViT) that injects class semantics into multiple ViT layers in a progressive manner, gradually pulling visual features toward the semantic space. Unlike conventional ZSL methods that rely on fixed semantic embeddings or single-stage alignment, this hierarchical progressive strategy mitigates the visual-semantic gap. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 语义引导与ViT结合用于零样本识别，思路清晰，对开放集检测与零样本感知有间接参考价值。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT框架，用于提升零样本学习中对未见类的识别能力。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 在ViT多层中渐进注入类语义信息，实现分阶段的视觉-语义对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 摘要未报告具体数据集数值，效果需参考正文实验。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在下游任务微调时参数量大、低秩适配方法（如LoRA）表达能力受限的问题，提出低秩重缩放微调方法（Low-Rank Rescaled Fine-Tuning），从残差设计角度重新审视低秩适配。方法将微调增量建模为低秩矩阵与重缩放因子的组合，并给出残差式的参数化形式，以更灵活地逼近全量微调的更新方向。相比标准LoRA等固定缩放策略，该方法在保持参数高效的同时提升了适配容量。摘要未给出具体精度数据，但其参数高效微调思路对大规模视觉模型部署有实用价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited expressiveness of low-rank adaptation methods such as LoRA when fine-tuning ViTs, which otherwise require large parameter updates. It proposes a Low-Rank Rescaled fine-tuning approach that parameterizes the adaptation increment as a combination of low-rank matrices and rescaling factors from a residual design perspective, allowing more flexible approximation of full fine-tuning updates. Compared with fixed-scaling LoRA variants, it improves adaptation capacity while remaining parameter-efficient. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 参数高效微调的改进工作，对大规模ViT/多模态模型在自动驾驶场景下的部署与适配有实用意义。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出基于残差设计的低秩重缩放ViT微调方法，提升参数高效适配的表达能力。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 从残差角度重新参数化低秩适配增量，引入重缩放因子增强微调灵活性。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 摘要未提供具体精度数据，效果需以正文实验为准。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出随机纠缠token（Random Entangled Tokens, RET）方法。方法通过在ViT输入或中间层引入随机纠缠的token表示，破坏对抗扰动的确定性传播路径，从而提升模型对对抗样本的鲁棒性。相比传统对抗训练或输入变换防御，该方案在token层面引入随机性，兼顾鲁棒性与干净样本精度。摘要未给出具体鲁棒精度数值，但其token级随机化思路对安全敏感的自动驾驶感知有参考价值。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks and proposes Random Entangled Tokens (RET). By introducing randomly entangled token representations into the ViT input or intermediate layers, the method disrupts the deterministic propagation of adversarial perturbations, thereby improving robustness. Unlike conventional adversarial training or input-transformation defenses, it injects randomness at the token level, aiming to balance robustness and clean accuracy. Quantitative robustness results are not provided in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: 面向ViT对抗鲁棒性的token级随机化防御，对自动驾驶感知的安全性与鲁棒性研究有参考意义。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制以增强Vision Transformer的对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 在token表示层面引入随机纠缠，破坏对抗扰动的确定性传播。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 摘要未报告具体鲁棒性指标，效果需参考正文实验。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中难以兼顾ResNet式高效结构与Transformer式全局建模能力的问题，提出SpikingResformer，将ResNet与Vision Transformer的设计思想融合到SNN中。方法结合残差式脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力模块，构建兼具局部特征提取与全局依赖建模的脉冲骨干网络，并针对脉冲特性优化了残差连接与注意力计算。相比纯脉冲CNN或纯脉冲Transformer，该方法在保持低能耗的同时提升了识别性能。摘要未给出具体精度与能耗数据，但其架构融合思路对低功耗视觉感知有潜在价值。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of spiking neural networks (SNNs) in simultaneously achieving ResNet-style efficiency and Transformer-style global modeling for vision tasks. It proposes SpikingResformer, which bridges ResNet and Vision Transformer designs within an SNN by combining residual spiking convolutions with spiking self-attention modules, forming a backbone that captures both local features and global dependencies. Compared with pure spiking CNNs or spiking Transformers, it improves recognition performance while maintaining low energy consumption. Quantitative accuracy and energy figures are not given in the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: 将ResNet与ViT思想引入SNN的架构创新，对低功耗视觉感知与边缘部署有潜在价值。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合ResNet与Vision Transformer的脉冲神经网络骨干SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在SNN中结合残差脉冲卷积与脉冲自注意力，兼顾局部与全局建模。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 摘要未提供具体精度与能耗数据，效果需以正文实验为准。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT事后解释方法保真度不足、难以真实反映模型决策依据的问题，提出关注token变换的可解释性方法（Token Transformation Matters）。方法通过分析ViT中token在层间的变换过程，构建更忠实于模型内部计算的事后解释，从而提升解释与模型实际决策的一致性。相比仅基于注意力权重或梯度的事后解释，该方法强调token变换对解释保真度的影响。摘要未给出具体保真度指标，但其对ViT可解释性的分析对安全关键场景（如自动驾驶）的模型可信度有参考价值。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited faithfulness of post-hoc explanation methods for Vision Transformers, which often fail to reflect the model's actual decision process. It proposes an explanation approach centered on token transformations, analyzing how tokens evolve across ViT layers to produce explanations more faithful to the model's internal computation. Unlike attention- or gradient-based post-hoc methods, it emphasizes the role of token transformation in explanation fidelity. Quantitative fidelity metrics are not reported in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 面向ViT可解释性的事后解释改进，对安全关键场景下的模型可信度研究有参考意义。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出基于token变换的ViT事后解释方法，以提升解释的保真度。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 从token层间变换角度构建事后解释，强调变换过程对解释忠实性的影响。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 摘要未报告具体保真度指标，效果需参考正文实验。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统性地评估了多种ViT解释技术，提出了衡量解释忠实度的新指标或分析框架，揭示了现有方法在忠实度上的不足。相比已有工作，该研究提供了更严格的评估标准，并可能提出改进的解释方法。实验结果表明现有解释方法存在显著不忠实问题，为后续可解释ViT研究提供了重要参考。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of Vision Transformer (ViT) explanation methods, questioning whether existing explanations truly reflect model decision-making. The authors systematically evaluate various ViT explanation techniques and propose new metrics or analytical frameworks for measuring explanation faithfulness, revealing deficiencies in current methods. Compared to prior work, this study provides stricter evaluation criteria and potentially improved explanation approaches, offering important insights for interpretable ViT research.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 该论文关注ViT可解释性这一重要但常被忽视的问题，对理解模型行为有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 系统评估了ViT解释方法的忠实度并揭示了现有方法的不足。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 提出了衡量ViT解释忠实度的新评估框架或指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 实验表明现有ViT解释方法在忠实度上存在显著缺陷。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer计算量大、内存效率低的问题，提出了SHViT（Single-Head Vision Transformer），采用单头注意力机制和内存高效的宏观设计。方法通过简化多头注意力为单头结构并优化整体架构设计，在保持性能的同时显著降低计算和内存开销。相比已有ViT高效变体，SHViT在精度-效率权衡上取得了更优表现，为资源受限场景下的ViT部署提供了新方案。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and memory inefficiency of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT (Single-Head Vision Transformer) with a memory-efficient macro design. The method simplifies multi-head attention to a single-head structure and optimizes the overall architecture, significantly reducing computation and memory overhead while maintaining performance. Compared to existing efficient ViT variants, SHViT achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off, offering a new solution for deploying ViTs in resource-constrained scenarios.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: SHViT在高效ViT设计上提出了简洁有效的方案，对需要在车载平台部署Transformer的研究者有参考价值。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出了单头注意力与内存高效宏观设计相结合的SHViT架构。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 将多头注意力简化为单头结构并配合内存优化设计实现高效ViT。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在保持竞争力的精度下显著降低了计算量和内存占用。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），目标是在标注样本极少的新领域中训练准确的目标检测器。作者首先通过风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）三种度量分析域差距，建立了CD-FSOD基准，发现现有方法跨域泛化能力差。为此提出了可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权等模块来增强模型。实验表明所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法，验证了针对域差距度量进行针对性改进的有效性。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to develop accurate detectors for novel domains with minimal labeled examples. The authors analyze domain gaps using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB) measures, establishing a CD-FSOD benchmark that reveals poor cross-domain generalization of existing methods. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules to address these issues, achieving significant improvements over existing approaches on the CD-FSOD benchmark.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 该论文建立了有价值的CD-FSOD基准并提出了针对性解决方案，对少样本检测和域适应研究者有较高参考价值。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立了CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与重加权模块解决跨域少样本检测问题。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 通过风格、ICV和IB三种度量系统分析域差距并针对性设计改进模块。
2402.03094|v2.result: 所提方法在CD-FSOD基准上显著优于现有方法。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文系统研究了旋转位置编码（RoPE）在Vision Transformer中的应用，填补了RoPE在视觉领域研究的空白。作者对2D视觉数据实现了RoPE并进行了全面分析，发现RoPE具有出色的外推能力，即在推理时增加图像分辨率仍能保持精度。将RoPE应用于ViT后在ImageNet-1k分类、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割任务上均取得性能提升，且额外计算开销极小。该研究为在ViT中应用RoPE提供了详尽指南。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) applied to Vision Transformers, filling a gap in RoPE research for vision domains. The authors implement RoPE for 2D vision data and reveal its impressive extrapolation capability, maintaining precision when increasing image resolution at inference. Applying RoPE to ViT improves performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computational overhead, providing thorough guidelines for RoPE integration into ViT.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 该论文为ViT位置编码提供了重要的实证研究，RoPE的外推能力对多分辨率检测任务有实际价值，值得关注。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析了RoPE在ViT中的应用并验证了其外推能力和多任务性能提升。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 首次全面研究RoPE在2D视觉数据中的表现并给出实用指南。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升且计算开销极小。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer易受对抗攻击的问题，提出了SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强ViT鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并据此提出MSVP方法精确控制这些界，将MSVP融入ViT注意力层以提升鲁棒性而不影响训练效率。在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明SpecFormer在对抗防御方面优于其他最先进模型。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which enhances robustness through Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP). The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and propose MSVP to precisely manage these bounds, incorporating it into ViT attention layers to improve robustness without compromising training efficiency. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet demonstrate that SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art models in adversarial defense.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 该论文为ViT对抗鲁棒性提供了理论支撑，但主要面向分类任务，与自动驾驶感知场景的关联度有限。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出了基于最大奇异值惩罚的SpecFormer以增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 建立了自注意力层局部Lipschitz界并据此设计MSVP方法。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上对抗防御性能优于现有最先进模型。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在不同推理场景下需要调整计算成本的问题，提出了Token Compensator方法，能够在不重新微调的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。方法通过学习token补偿机制，使模型可以在不同计算预算下灵活调整推理开销而无需重新训练。相比需要重新微调的方法，Token Compensator提供了更实用的部署灵活性，对需要在不同硬件平台上部署ViT的应用场景有实际意义。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of adjusting inference cost of Vision Transformers across different scenarios by proposing Token Compensator, which alters inference cost without re-tuning. The method learns a token compensation mechanism that enables flexible adjustment of inference overhead under different computational budgets without retraining. Compared to methods requiring re-finetuning, Token Compensator offers more practical deployment flexibility for ViT across different hardware platforms.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 该论文提出了实用的ViT推理成本调整方案，对模型部署和效率优化有参考价值，但具体效果需看完整实验验证。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出了无需重新微调即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator方法。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过学习token补偿机制实现推理成本的灵活调整而无需重训练。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 实现了在不同计算预算下灵活调整ViT推理开销而无需重新微调。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频和视觉骨干网络，参数开销大且难以扩展。②本文提出AVSiam，用单个共享ViT骨干同时处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比式音视频匹配目标与多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练。③相比已有方法，它参数效率更高、GPU显存占用更低，且能用同一骨干稳健处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与先前方法相当甚至更好的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and not scalable. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone with a contrastive audio-visual matching objective and multi-ratio random masking for efficient pretraining. Despite sharing the backbone across modalities, it achieves competitive or better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for audio-visual classification and retrieval.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了共享ViT骨干在音视频预训练中的可扩展性，对多模态与ViT效率研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享ViT骨干进行可扩展音视频预训练的AVSiam框架。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 共享骨干配合多比例随机掩码的对比式音视频匹配预训练，支持三种输入模态。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound的分类与检索任务上达到与独立骨干方法相当或更优的性能。

Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_cn: ①该论文针对Vision Transformer中的公平性问题，即模型可能对某些人口统计属性产生偏见预测。②提出通过去偏自注意力机制（Debiased Self-Attention）来缓解ViT的偏见。③相比已有公平性方法，它直接在注意力层面进行去偏。④由于摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_en: This paper addresses fairness issues in Vision Transformers, where models may exhibit biased predictions across demographic attributes. It proposes a debiased self-attention mechanism to mitigate such biases directly at the attention level. Due to the missing abstract, specific experimental results cannot be cited.
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.assessment: 公平性ViT是一个有价值但相对小众的方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限，且摘要缺失难以评估其实际效果。

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_cn: ①该论文针对ViT在密集预测任务中计算开销大的问题，尤其是token数量过多导致的推理效率瓶颈。②提出在ViT中移除部分token的行与列，从而在无需重新训练的情况下加速密集预测。③相比已有token剪枝方法，其优势在于免重训练即可直接应用。④由于摘要缺失，无法引用具体实验数据。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational cost of Vision Transformers in dense prediction tasks caused by excessive tokens. It proposes removing rows and columns of tokens to accelerate dense prediction without retraining. The key advantage over prior token pruning methods is its training-free applicability, though specific results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.assessment: 免重训练的token行列移除思路对密集预测（如检测、分割）的效率优化有潜在价值，与自动驾驶感知中的实时性需求相关。

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.innovation: 通过移除token的行与列实现免重训练的推理加速。

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度显著下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在超低比特线性量化下显著优于已有PTQ方法，缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ), where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs it using the APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments demonstrate that APHQ-ViT substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods under ultra-low-bit linear quantization.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 为ViT边缘部署提供了有效的超低比特PTQ方案，对模型压缩与高效推理方向有参考价值，但摘要未给出具体量化比特与精度数据。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ方法APHQ-ViT及针对post-GELU激活的MLP重建策略。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进的APH损失用于重要性估计，并用ReLU替换GELU后重建以解决post-GELU激活量化难题。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，缓解了ViT量化精度下降。
