2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据存在长尾(LT)分布问题，以往工作多聚焦CLIP/ViT及识别分类任务，对LLaVA等LVLM及VQA、视觉推理等通用任务探索不足。本文深入分析LVLM中的LT问题，识别出头部概念过表示与尾部概念欠表示两个核心原因，提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)与数据合成(DS)两阶段：DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成数据。该框架旨在改善LVLM在长尾分布下的平衡表示能力。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the long-tail (LT) problem in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), where prior work mainly focuses on CLIP/ViT and recognition tasks, leaving LVLMs like LLaVA and general tasks such as VQA and visual reasoning under-explored. The authors identify two core causes—overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts—and propose an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages: Data Rebalancing (DR) that adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, and Data Synthesis (DS) that leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models. The framework aims to achieve balanced representation in LVLMs under long-tail distributions.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 针对LVLM长尾数据问题提出系统性数据精炼框架，对多模态与VLM方向有较高参考价值，但摘要未给出具体性能提升数据。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，通过数据重平衡与扩散合成解决LVLM长尾问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 识别LVLM长尾的两个核心原因，并设计DR与DS两阶段自适应数据精炼机制。
2503.12821|v2.result: 改善了LVLM在长尾分布下的平衡表示能力（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难及直接套用CNN二值化策略导致性能大幅下降的问题，本文提出BHViT——一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型。BHViT利用从粗到细的局部信息交互与层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算；提出基于移位操作的新模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加开销；并提出基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。该工作旨在实现ViT的高效二值化部署。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices and the significant performance drop when directly applying binary CNN strategies to ViTs. The authors propose BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model, guided by three observations. BHViT employs coarse-to-fine local information interaction and hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant token computation, introduces a shift-based module to enhance the binary MLP without significant overhead, and proposes a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method to evaluate token importance. The work aims to enable efficient binarized ViT deployment.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 为ViT二值化提供了架构与模块层面的系统设计，对模型压缩与边缘部署方向有参考价值，但摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 结合层次特征聚合、移位增强二值MLP与量化分解注意力二值化三项设计。
2503.02394|v2.result: 在保持较低计算开销下提升了二值ViT的性能（具体数据未在摘要中给出）。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实人脸图像缺乏标注、难以学习可泛化人脸表征的问题，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，融合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID）。方法上设计了CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性与区域间连贯性，并通过自蒸馏将ID网络与MIM耦合建立局部到全局对应，形成3C学习目标。预训练后仅用普通ViT即可作为通用视觉基础模型，在跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域人脸反欺骗和未见扩散伪造检测三类下游任务上验证。在10个公开数据集上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of labeled real faces for learning generalizable facial representations by proposing FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework combining masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID). It introduces CRFR-P masking to enforce intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and couples an ID network with MIM via tailored self-distillation to establish local-to-global correspondence. A vanilla ViT pretrained with these 3C objectives serves as a universal foundation model, achieving superior generalization on cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion facial forgery detection across 10 public datasets.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 将MIM与实例判别结合用于人脸安全基础模型，思路清晰且下游任务覆盖全面，但与人脸安全而非通用视觉感知更相关，对自动驾驶/3D检测领域借鉴有限。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出融合MIM与ID的自监督人脸安全基础模型FSFM及CRFR-P掩码策略。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: 通过自蒸馏耦合实例判别与掩码建模，同时编码局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集的三类人脸安全任务上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇多视角室内3D目标检测在无人工标注下训练困难的问题，提出OpenM3D单阶段检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失与体素-语义对齐损失，前者依赖高质量3D伪框，后者对齐多样化的CLIP特征。作者提出基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成方法，将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构，伪框的精度和召回均优于OV-3DET等方法。在OV-3DET设定下无需3D框或类别标注即可训练出高精度单阶段检测器。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D object detection without human annotations by introducing OpenM3D, a single-stage detector built on 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly trains a class-agnostic 3D localization loss requiring high-quality pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss using diverse CLIP features, with a graph-embedding-based 3D pseudo box generation method that merges 2D segments into coherent 3D structures. The pseudo boxes achieve higher precision and recall than prior methods including OV-3DET, enabling accurate single-stage detection under the annotation-free OV-3DET setting.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测与无标注训练结合到多视角3D场景，图嵌入伪框生成思路新颖，对开放集3D感知研究有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无人工标注的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 用图嵌入将2D分割合并为连贯3D伪框，并对齐多样化CLIP特征训练单阶段检测器。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度与召回超过OV-3DET等方法，实现无标注下的高精度开放词汇3D检测。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于query的3D目标检测模型因密集特征、大图像尺寸和多层transformer导致计算量大、难以在边缘设备运行的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC。方法将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个key的重要性分数，在每层transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝key，无需重训练或蒸馏。在最新ToC3D模型上实现transformer解码器1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备部署。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of query-based 3D object detectors with dense features and multiple transformer layers, which hinders edge deployment, by proposing tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime key pruning method. It multiplies classification scores with attention maps to compute per-key importance and gradually prunes keys after each transformer layer without retraining or distillation. On the latest ToC3D model, it achieves a 1.99x speedup in the transformer decoder with less than 1% performance loss, sometimes even improving accuracy, and is deployed on edge devices.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 零样本、免重训练的运行时剪枝对3D检测部署非常实用，加速比显著且精度损失极小，工程价值高。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D检测transformer解码器的零样本运行时key剪枝方法tgGBC。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 用分类分数加权的注意力图评估key重要性并逐层渐进剪枝，无需重训练。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能反升。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差、中间注意力改进难以传播到最终输出且缺乏与文本交互的问题，提出免训练的反馈驱动自适框架。方法将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈回中间注意力，利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏剪枝和自适应集成等模块。该方法作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有CLIP分割流程中，提升语义一致性。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's poor localization in open-vocabulary segmentation, where intermediate attention improvements fail to propagate to final outputs and lack text interaction, by proposing a training-free feedback-driven self-adaptive framework. It feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention, using final predictions as a stronger spatial coherence prior, with modules for attention isolation, confidence-based sparse pruning, and adaptation ensemble. The method acts as a plug-in module that seamlessly integrates into existing CLIP segmentation pipelines to improve semantic consistency.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 反馈式自适注意力思路有一定新意，但属于分割任务且为免训练方法，与3D感知/自动驾驶主线相关度中等。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出将输出级对应关系反馈回中间注意力的免训练开放词汇分割框架。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型输出作为空间连贯先验反向引导中间注意力，并设计稀疏剪枝与集成模块。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升CLIP分割的语义一致性（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP图像级表征在像素级开放词汇语义分割中空间表征不足的问题，提出分层框架CLIPer。方法包含早期层融合模块和细粒度补偿模块：前者利用早期层嵌入与注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图，后者用扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient spatial representation of image-level CLIP for pixel-level open-vocabulary semantic segmentation by proposing CLIPer, a hierarchical framework with an early-layer fusion module and a fine-grained compensation module. The early-layer fusion exploits embeddings and attention maps at early layers that preserve spatial structure to produce more spatially coherent segmentation, while the compensation module uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. CLIPer achieves state-of-the-art performance on seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层利用早期层空间信息与扩散模型细节补偿的组合合理，在多个分割基准上SOTA，但任务与3D/自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表征的开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 融合早期层空间结构信息并用扩散模型自注意力补偿细粒度局部细节。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式视觉Transformer推理效率问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性。方法将Swin块内的批量窗口计算分离，对不重要窗口的激活分配更低比特宽度，并设计双分支Swin块分别以高/低比特处理激活，可无缝集成到多数QAT和PTQ方法。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现免训练1.35倍加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝在仅降1% mAP下达到1.53倍加速。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MixA-Q, a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity for efficient inference of window-based vision transformers. It separates batched window computations within Swin blocks, assigning lower bit widths to less important windows, and introduces a Two-Branch Swin Block processing activations in high and low precision, compatible with most QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, it achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and 1.25x lossless speedup with QAT, reaching 1.53x speedup with only 1% mAP drop when combined with activation pruning.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合用于Swin类ViT，加速比与精度权衡合理，但面向通用视觉任务，与3D检测/自动驾驶直接相关度一般。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度激活量化框架Mixa-Q。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 设计双分支Swin块按窗口重要性分配高低比特，兼容QAT与PTQ。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ免训练加速1.35倍无损失，QAT无损加速1.25倍，结合剪枝1.53倍仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗迁移性不足的问题，指出现有方法多依赖监督学习的中间特征，而忽视了自监督ViT表示的潜力。作者提出dSVA，一种生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击方法，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成器训练框架结合联合特征与自监督ViT的注意力机制来生成对抗样本。相比仅用监督特征的方法，CL与MIM使ViT关注互补的特征倾向，从而提升黑盒迁移性。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称该方法有效提升了对抗扰动的泛化能力。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) representations can improve adversarial transferability. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT features attack that exploits both global structural features from contrastive learning and local textural features from masked image modeling, with a novel generative training framework incorporating a generator and self-supervised ViT attention. The method yields more generalizable black-box adversarial examples compared to supervised-feature-based approaches.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT的双重特征（CL+MIM）引入对抗攻击生成，为提升黑盒迁移性提供了新视角，但整体与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT的对比学习与掩码图像建模双特征来生成高迁移性对抗样本的生成式攻击框架dSVA。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 首次联合CL全局结构特征与MIM局部纹理特征，并设计结合自监督ViT注意力机制的生成器训练策略。
2506.21046|v2.result: CL与MIM使ViT关注互补特征，生成的对抗扰动在黑盒迁移性上优于仅用监督特征的方法。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练Vision Transformer在下游任务适配时全量微调成本高的问题，提出一种基于近似正交微调策略的高效适配方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节与实验设置，但从标题推断其核心是在微调过程中引入近似正交约束以保持预训练特征、减少可训练参数。相比现有Adapter或LoRA类方法，其改进点可能在于正交性带来的特征保持与参数效率。具体效果数据摘要未提供。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning pre-trained Vision Transformers for downstream adaptation by proposing an approximately orthogonal fine-tuning strategy. The method likely enforces near-orthogonality to preserve pre-trained representations while updating a small set of parameters. Concrete experimental results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 参数高效微调是ViT落地的关键方向，正交约束思路有潜力，但缺少摘要无法评估其实际效果与创新程度。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出一种基于近似正交约束的预训练ViT高效微调策略。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 将近似正交性引入ViT微调以在参数高效的同时保持预训练特征。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi._arxiv_id: Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Vision Transformer Underpinned by Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning Strategy.

An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_cn: 该论文面向TinyML应用场景，针对在资源极度受限设备上部署Vision Transformer的难题，提出一种高效的混合ViT架构。由于摘要缺失，无法获知具体的混合设计（如卷积与注意力结合方式）、参数量与精度权衡策略。其目标应是在保持可接受精度的同时显著降低计算与内存开销，以适配微控制器等边缘硬件。具体实验数据与对比结果摘要未提供。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.summary_en: This paper targets TinyML applications and proposes an efficient hybrid Vision Transformer architecture for deployment on severely resource-constrained devices. The hybrid design likely combines convolutional and attention components to balance accuracy and efficiency. Specific design choices and experimental results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.assessment: TinyML与ViT结合有实际部署价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度低，且缺少摘要难以判断质量。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.contribution: 提出一种面向TinyML的高效混合Vision Transformer架构。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.innovation: 针对极端资源受限场景设计混合ViT结构以平衡精度与效率。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer f._arxiv_id: An Efficient Hybrid Vision Transformer for Tinyml Applications.

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需大量重训练（有时达数百epoch甚至从头训练）才能恢复精度的问题，提出Variance-Based Pruning——一种简单的一次性结构化剪枝技术。方法先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪神经元，同时将激活均值整合回模型以在剪枝后保持高性能，仅需极少微调。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能，避免了昂贵的重训练。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy. It introduces Variance-Based Pruning, a simple one-shot structured pruning technique that gathers activation statistics to select neurons and integrates mean activations back into the model to preserve performance with minimal fine-tuning. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 一次性剪枝且几乎免重训练，对复用大规模预训练模型并部署到资源受限平台具有实用价值，方法简洁有效。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出基于激活方差的单次结构化剪枝方法，通过回填激活均值在极少微调下保持模型性能。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 将激活统计量同时用于神经元选择与均值回填，实现免重训练的高效结构化剪枝。
2507.12988|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力计算与内存开销大的问题，提出PADRe——一种统一的多项式注意力替代框架。PADRe基于多项式函数与近似理论，用Hadamard积等硬件友好的乘法非线性实现，仅需线性计算与内存成本，且无需Softmax；作者指出Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等近期注意力机制均可视为PADRe的特例。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测等任务上，PADRe作为自注意力的即插即用替代，运行显著更快且精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement for self-attention in transformers. Built on polynomial functions and approximation theory, PADRe uses hardware-friendly multiplicative nonlinearities (e.g., Hadamard products) with only linear computational and memory costs, avoiding Softmax, and subsumes several recent attention variants such as Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, and Castling-ViT. Across image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection, PADRe runs significantly faster with comparable or superior accuracy.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 统一框架视角清晰，覆盖2D/3D检测任务，对自动驾驶感知中ViT骨干的加速具有直接参考价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出统一多项式注意力替代框架PADRe，将多种高效注意力机制纳入同一理论体系。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 基于近似理论用硬件友好的多项式乘法非线性替代Softmax自注意力，实现线性复杂度。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在图像分类、2D检测与3D点云检测上运行显著更快，精度相当或更优。

CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_cn: 该论文针对算子学习（operator learning）中连续函数映射的建模问题，提出CViT——连续Vision Transformer。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体如何将ViT扩展到连续域（如坐标嵌入、连续位置编码或隐式表示），以及所求解的偏微分方程或物理场任务。其目标应是在保持ViT表达力的同时实现对连续输入/输出的泛化。具体实验数据与对比结果摘要未提供。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.summary_en: This paper proposes CViT, a Continuous Vision Transformer for operator learning, aiming to model continuous function-to-function mappings. The approach likely extends ViT with continuous coordinate embeddings or implicit representations to handle continuous inputs and outputs. Specific methodology and experimental results are unavailable due to the missing abstract.
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.assessment: 将ViT用于连续算子学习是新兴交叉方向，但与自动驾驶视觉感知主线关联有限，且缺少摘要难以评估。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.contribution: 提出面向算子学习的连续Vision Transformer架构CViT。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.innovation: 将ViT扩展到连续函数映射建模，用于算子学习任务。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for._arxiv_id: CViT: Continuous Vision Transformer for Operator Learning.

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉Transformer结合时，传统自注意力机制在脉冲域中计算开销大、难以高效实现的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉Transformer。方法上借鉴生物视觉中的扫视机制，设计了一种稀疏、事件驱动的注意力计算方式，替代标准ViT中的稠密自注意力，从而降低脉冲神经网络的能耗与延迟。相比已有脉冲Transformer工作，其改进点在于将注意力聚焦于少数关键区域而非全局稠密计算，更符合SNN的稀疏事件特性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，因此无法引用定量结果，但该方向对低功耗视觉感知有潜在价值。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and inefficiency of standard self-attention when integrated into spiking neural networks (SNNs) for vision transformers. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention, inspired by biological saccadic eye movements, which performs sparse, event-driven attention over selected regions instead of dense global attention. Compared with existing spiking transformers, the method better exploits the sparse event-driven nature of SNNs, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 该工作探索了生物启发式稀疏注意力与脉冲视觉Transformer的结合，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶/3D感知等核心领域关联较弱，且摘要缺乏实验验证，实际影响力有待观察。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出了一种基于扫视机制的稀疏脉冲注意力视觉Transformer架构。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将生物扫视注意力机制引入脉冲视觉Transformer，实现事件驱动的稀疏注意力计算。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic._arxiv_id: Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic Attention.

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练开销高的问题，本文首次系统探索在ViT中端到端地引入稀疏性，而非先训练完整模型再剪枝。方法上动态抽取并训练固定小参数预算的稀疏子网络，同时联合优化模型参数与连接结构，并将非结构化稀疏扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），还通过可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。在ImageNet上，该方法在降低训练内存与推理复杂度的同时保持了可达到的精度，为ViT高效训练与部署提供了统一框架。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive end-to-end exploration of integrating sparsity into Vision Transformers, dynamically extracting and training sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget instead of training full ViTs. It jointly optimizes model parameters and connectivity, extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding the prune-and-grow of self-attention heads, and co-explores data and architecture sparsity via a learnable token selector. Extensive ImageNet results show reduced training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing achievable accuracy.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将端到端稀疏化引入ViT，兼顾训练与推理效率，对高效视觉Transformer研究有较强参考价值。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次在ViT中端到端联合探索参数、结构与数据稀疏性，实现训练与推理双重加速。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 动态抽取并训练固定预算稀疏子网络，并将稀疏性从非结构化扩展到自注意力头的结构化剪枝与生长。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上于固定小参数预算下保持精度，同时降低训练内存开销与推理复杂度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构依赖人工设计的问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索自动化该过程，不仅搜索架构还搜索搜索空间本身。核心思想是利用权重共享超网计算E-T Error，引导不同搜索维度逐步演化，并据此给出通用视觉Transformer的设计准则。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和视觉问答等下游任务上验证了通用性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes to automate Vision Transformer design via neural architecture search that searches not only the architecture but also the search space, gradually evolving search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed with a weight-sharing supernet. It further provides design guidelines for general vision transformers derived from the space searching process. The searched S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT and ViT on ImageNet and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation and visual question answering.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间本身的演化，并给出ViT设计准则，对自动化视觉骨干设计有启发意义。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出通用ViT设计准则。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 以权重共享超网的E-T Error引导搜索维度逐步演化，实现搜索空间的自动进化。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT、ViT，并在检测、分割与VQA等下游任务上验证通用性。

Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_cn: 该论文关注视觉Transformer的训练后量化问题，旨在不重新训练的情况下降低ViT的存储与计算开销。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体量化方法、对注意力模块的处理方式以及实验设置。从题目看，其贡献应在于针对ViT结构特点设计训练后量化方案。整体信息不足，难以评估其相对已有量化工作的具体改进与效果数据。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses post-training quantization for Vision Transformers, aiming to reduce storage and computation costs without retraining. Due to the missing abstract, the specific quantization scheme, treatment of attention modules, and experimental settings cannot be verified. The contribution presumably lies in tailoring post-training quantization to ViT-specific structures, but the improvements and quantitative results remain unclear.
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.assessment: 主题与高效ViT相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅原文确认价值。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.contribution: 面向视觉Transformer提出训练后量化方案以降低部署开销。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.innovation: 针对ViT结构特点设计免重训练量化策略（因摘要缺失，具体创新点待确认）。
Post-Training Quantization for Vision Tr.result: 摘要缺失，具体量化精度与压缩效果无法确认。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT中不连续的patch化tokenization隐式引入锯齿伪影、导致注意力图出现混叠（aliasing）的问题，本文首次分析并探索在视觉Transformer中引入抗混叠特性。提出即插即用的混叠抑制模块ARM来缓解该问题，并在多种任务和多个ViT家族上验证其有效性与泛化性。该轻量设计在多个知名结构上稳定带来明显提升，同时改善了ViT的数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes the previously uncharted aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch-wise tokenization, which introduces jagged artifacts into attention maps. It proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM) to alleviate this issue, validated across multiple tasks and various ViT families. This lightweight design consistently boosts several well-known architectures and also improves data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度揭示ViT的混叠问题并提出轻量即插即用模块，视角新颖且实用性强。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 首次系统分析ViT中的混叠效应并提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将抗混叠思想引入视觉Transformer，以轻量模块缓解patch化tokenization带来的锯齿伪影。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多个ViT家族与多种任务上稳定提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_cn: 该论文提出面向视觉Transformer的Adder Attention机制，推测其目标是用加法运算替代注意力中的乘法运算以降低计算能耗。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体设计、与标准多头自注意力的差异以及实验配置。从题目看，其贡献应在于将Adder网络思想引入ViT注意力计算。整体信息不足，难以评估其相对已有高效注意力工作的改进与效果数据。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.summary_en: This paper proposes Adder Attention for Vision Transformers, presumably replacing multiplication with addition in attention computation to reduce energy cost. Due to the missing abstract, the specific design, its differences from standard multi-head self-attention, and experimental settings cannot be verified. The contribution likely lies in introducing Adder-network ideas into ViT attention, but improvements and quantitative results remain unclear.
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.assessment: 主题与高效ViT注意力相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅原文确认价值。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.contribution: 提出面向视觉Transformer的Adder Attention计算机制。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.innovation: 将加法网络思想引入ViT注意力以降低计算开销（因摘要缺失，具体创新点待确认）。
Adder Attention for Vision Transformer.|.result: 摘要缺失，具体精度与效率收益无法确认。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer将图像视为一维token序列、缺乏局部结构与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置、需依赖大规模数据和长训练周期的问题，本文提出ViTAE，从卷积中显式引入内在归纳偏置。技术上通过多个不同膨胀率的卷积构成空间金字塔缩减模块，将输入下采样并嵌入为具有丰富多尺度上下文的token，从而获得尺度不变性；同时在每个Transformer层中并行加入卷积块，与多头自注意力特征融合后送入前馈网络，获得局部性归纳偏置。该设计在多种视觉任务上以更少数据与训练成本取得优于基线ViT的表现。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of intrinsic inductive bias in vision transformers, which treat images as 1D token sequences and require large-scale data and long schedules, this paper proposes ViTAE that explicitly incorporates convolutions. It uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multiple dilation rates to embed multi-scale context and acquire scale invariance, and adds a parallel convolution block in each transformer layer fused with self-attention features to obtain locality bias. ViTAE achieves superior performance over baseline ViTs with less data and training cost across multiple vision tasks.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 通过卷积显式注入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置，思路清晰且实验扎实，对ViT结构改进有参考价值。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，用卷积显式赋予视觉Transformer尺度不变性与局部性内在归纳偏置。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 以多膨胀率空间金字塔缩减模块和并行卷积块，将多尺度上下文与局部性融入ViT各层。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多种视觉任务上以更少数据与训练成本取得优于基线ViT的性能。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法性能明显落后于单任务基线的问题，在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务。作者提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的视觉示例提示（visual exemplar prompting）引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征。相比已有方法，其核心改进在于引入视觉示例作为提示来缓解任务间干扰，从而缩小多任务与单任务之间的性能差距。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但强调现有方法虽有进步仍存在较大性能鸿沟。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the substantial performance gap between existing multi-task methods and single-task baselines. The authors extensively evaluate popular multi-task learning approaches on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and propose VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide the model toward high-quality task-specific representations. The key improvement is the use of visual exemplar prompting to mitigate task interference and narrow the multi-task versus single-task gap.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较为系统的评测分析，并给出一个简洁有效的提示式多任务框架，对关注多任务感知与提示学习的研究者有参考价值。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 系统评测了自动驾驶多任务感知方法，并提出基于视觉示例提示的 VE-Prompt 多任务框架。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 将任务特定的视觉示例提示引入多任务感知，以引导任务特定表征学习。
2303.01788|v2.result: 揭示了现有多任务方法与单任务基线间仍存在较大性能差距，VE-Prompt 有效缓解该问题（摘要未给出具体数值）。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（road anomaly detection）问题，即识别训练集中未出现的陌生物体（如落石、动物、杂物等），这类目标对行车安全至关重要但难以通过常规监督检测覆盖。作者提出基于部分图像重建（partial image reconstruction）的方法，并引入语义分割耦合（segmentation coupling）机制，利用分割先验约束重建过程，使异常区域的重建误差更显著。相比纯重建或纯分割的已有方法，该方法通过耦合两者提升了异常定位的准确性。摘要中未给出具体量化指标，但方法在道路异常基准上验证了有效性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, where the goal is to identify out-of-distribution objects unseen during training. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction approach coupled with semantic segmentation, using segmentation priors to constrain reconstruction so that anomalous regions yield larger reconstruction errors. Compared with pure reconstruction or segmentation baselines, the coupling improves anomaly localization, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative results.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 面向自动驾驶安全的长尾/开放集异常检测问题，思路清晰且与感知系统实际需求契合，值得关注其重建与分割耦合的设计。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出将部分图像重建与语义分割耦合的道路异常检测框架。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 利用分割先验约束重建过程以增强异常区域的重建误差响应。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 在道路异常检测任务上验证了方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶环视语义占用感知缺乏大规模统一基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占用感知基准。方法上构建了包含多相机输入与密集语义占用标注的数据集，并设计了相应的评估协议与基线模型。相比已有工作，它首次系统性地覆盖环视场景下的占用预测评测，弥补了现有基准规模小、视角受限的不足。该基准为环视占用感知提供了标准化评测平台，推动了该方向的可复现研究。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving by introducing OpenOccupancy. It constructs a dataset with multi-camera inputs and dense semantic occupancy annotations, along with evaluation protocols and baseline models. Compared with prior small-scale or limited-view benchmarks, it provides a standardized platform for surrounding occupancy perception and advances reproducible research.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 作为环视占用感知的大规模基准，填补了该方向评测标准缺失的空白，对领域发展具有基础性推动作用。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了大规模环视语义占用感知基准OpenOccupancy及配套评估协议与基线。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 首次系统性地构建覆盖环视场景的密集语义占用标注与标准化评测体系。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占用感知提供了统一的大规模评测平台，支撑后续方法的公平比较。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有感知与预测方法要么依赖低召回的目标检测加轨迹预测、要么计算昂贵的稠密占用流网格的问题，本文提出隐式占用流场方法，用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占用与流。方法可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免对无关区域的冗余计算，并通过架构设计克服显式占用预测中感受野受限的缺陷。相比已有工作，它在保持预测能力的同时显著降低计算开销并提升查询灵活性。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the trade-off between detection-based forecasting and computationally expensive dense occupancy-flow grids by proposing an implicit occupancy flow field that represents occupancy and flow over time with a single network. The method can be queried directly by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations, avoiding unnecessary computation, and overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction via architectural design. It improves efficiency and query flexibility while maintaining prediction capability.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 将隐式神经表示引入占用与流预测，兼顾效率与规划器查询需求，思路新颖且具实用价值。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出统一感知与预测的隐式占用流场表示，支持连续时空查询。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 用单一网络隐式建模占用与流，避免稠密网格计算并突破感受野限制。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在降低计算开销的同时实现对运动规划器的灵活连续查询。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样与细化中任意尺度放大及局部几何保持的问题，本文提出ASUR3D，利用局部占用场实现点云的任意尺度上采样与细化。方法通过建模局部占用场来指导点的生成与位置优化，从而在放大过程中保持几何细节。相比已有固定尺度或几何失真较大的上采样方法，它支持任意尺度并提升了几何保真度。该工作为点云超分辨率与细化提供了新思路。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper addresses arbitrary-scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds by proposing ASUR3D, which leverages local occupancy fields to guide point generation and position refinement. Unlike prior fixed-scale or geometrically distorted upsampling methods, it supports arbitrary scales while preserving local geometric detail. It offers a new perspective for point cloud super-resolution and refinement.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 将局部占用场用于点云任意尺度上采样，方法有一定新意，但与本领域核心任务相关度中等。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出基于局部占用场的点云任意尺度上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占用场指导点生成，实现任意尺度且几何保真的上采样。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 在支持任意尺度放大的同时提升了几何细节保持能力。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对图像匹配在遮挡区域易失效的问题，本文提出Occ2Net，基于3D占用估计实现鲁棒的图像匹配。方法通过估计场景的3D占用结构来推断被遮挡区域的几何关系，从而在遮挡条件下建立更可靠的匹配。相比传统仅依赖2D外观的匹配方法，它引入3D占用先验显著提升遮挡区域的匹配鲁棒性。该工作为遮挡场景下的匹配提供了新方案。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of image matching in occluded regions by proposing Occ2Net, which performs robust matching based on 3D occupancy estimation. By estimating scene occupancy to infer geometry in occluded areas, it establishes more reliable correspondences than 2D appearance-only methods. It provides a new solution for matching under occlusion.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 将3D占用估计引入图像匹配以应对遮挡，思路有针对性，但整体与自动驾驶感知主线相关度一般。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出基于3D占用估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占用结构推断遮挡区域几何以提升匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 在遮挡区域实现了比传统2D匹配更可靠的对应关系。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对多相机视觉下3D语义占用预测的问题，本文提出SurroundOcc，实现自动驾驶环视场景的多相机3D占用预测。方法通过多相机特征提取与3D体素化重建，生成稠密语义占用表示，并设计了相应的监督与训练策略。相比BEV平面表示，它进一步提供垂直方向的结构信息，提升了场景理解的完整性。该工作推动了视觉占用预测从BEV向3D体素的发展。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-camera 3D semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing SurroundOcc. It extracts multi-camera features and reconstructs 3D voxels to produce dense semantic occupancy, with tailored supervision and training strategies. Compared with BEV plane representations, it provides vertical structural information and improves scene understanding completeness, advancing vision-based occupancy from BEV to 3D voxels.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 多相机3D占用预测的代表性工作，方法完整且对环视场景理解有重要推动，值得重点关注。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出多相机3D语义占用预测框架SurroundOcc。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过多相机特征重建稠密3D体素占用，补充垂直方向结构信息。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 实现了环视场景下稠密语义占用预测，推动视觉占用从BEV向3D发展。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D语义占用预测中3D体素处理计算量大、稀疏与类别不平衡的问题，本文提出OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络。方法将沉重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部与全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的体素特征编码，并在解码器中通过preserve-pooling与类别引导采样缓解稀疏与类别不平衡。相比已有方法，它在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上均显著超越现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation and sparsity/class-imbalance issues in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction by proposing OccFormer, a dual-path transformer. It decomposes 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient voxel encoding, and adapts Mask2Former with preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling to mitigate sparsity and imbalance. It significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 双路径Transformer设计有效平衡了效率与精度，在多个基准上取得领先，是占用预测方向的重要进展。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出用于视觉3D语义占用预测的双路径Transformer网络OccFormer。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部与全局路径，并用preserve-pooling与类别引导采样应对稀疏与不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著超越现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 占据预测方法依赖闭集语义标签、无法识别开放词汇类别的问题，提出 POP-3D，一种仅从多视角图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法。其核心思路是将图像特征与 3D 占据网格对齐，并借助视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的文本嵌入实现任意类别的语义查询，从而在无需 3D 标注的情况下预测体素级开放词汇语义。相比传统闭集 3D 占据方法，POP-3D 摆脱了固定类别限制，可直接用自然语言描述查询新类别。实验表明该方法在开放词汇 3D 占据预测任务上取得了显著优于基线的性能，验证了从 2D 视觉-语言知识向 3D 占据空间迁移的可行性。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of closed-set semantics in existing 3D occupancy prediction methods by proposing POP-3D, an open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction approach that operates solely from multi-view images. It aligns image features with a 3D occupancy grid and leverages vision-language model text embeddings (e.g., CLIP) to enable semantic queries for arbitrary categories without 3D annotations. Experiments demonstrate that POP-3D substantially outperforms baselines on open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction, showing the feasibility of transferring 2D vision-language knowledge to 3D occupancy space.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占据预测，契合自动驾驶感知对长尾/未知类别识别的需求，思路新颖且实用性强，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅从图像输入进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法 POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型文本嵌入实现体素级开放词汇语义查询，无需 3D 标注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在开放词汇 3D 占据预测任务上显著优于基线方法。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D占据预测中密集网格表示计算开销大、细节丢失的问题，本文提出COTR（Compact Occupancy TRansformer）。方法上通过紧凑的占据表示与Transformer结构减少冗余计算，在保持精度的同时提升效率。相比已有密集网格方法，COTR在计算量与内存占用上更具优势。摘要未提供具体数值，但整体定位为高效视觉占据预测方案。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and detail loss of dense grid representations in vision-based 3D occupancy prediction by proposing COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer. It reduces redundant computation while maintaining accuracy through a compact occupancy representation and transformer architecture. Compared with dense-grid methods, COTR achieves better efficiency, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占据预测的效率问题，思路清晰，适合关注BEV/Occupancy落地的研究者参考。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占据Transformer以降低视觉3D占据预测的计算开销。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 用紧凑表示替代密集网格，减少冗余体素计算。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在保持精度的同时提升计算效率（摘要未给出具体数值）。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D检测中边界框无法刻画物体精细几何的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占据（object-centric occupancy）作为边界框的补充。数据方面，构建了首个物体中心占据数据集；算法方面，提出带隐式形状解码器的占据补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占据生成。相比仅用边界框的检测，该方法为检测到的物体提供更高体素分辨率的几何细节，并增强了对不准确检测的鲁棒性。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: To address the inability of 3D bounding boxes to capture fine-grained object geometry, this paper introduces object-centric occupancy as a complement to bounding boxes. It constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset via an automated pipeline and proposes an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder that handles dynamic-size occupancy generation. This provides higher-resolution geometric details for detected objects and improves robustness to inaccurate detections.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 数据与算法双贡献，物体中心占据补全思路新颖，对3D检测与占据交叉方向有较高参考价值。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 构建首个物体中心占据数据集并提出占据补全网络。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 用隐式形状解码器实现动态尺寸的物体中心占据生成。
2412.05154|v2.result: 为检测物体提供精细几何细节并提升对不准确检测的鲁棒性。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占据预测依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出RadarOcc，直接处理4D成像雷达张量进行占据预测。方法上引入多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少坐标变换插值误差。相比稀疏雷达点云方法，RadarOcc保留了更多场景细节，提升了全天候感知鲁棒性。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: To improve robustness of 3D occupancy prediction under adverse weather, this paper proposes RadarOcc, which directly processes 4D imaging radar tensors instead of relying on LiDAR or cameras. It employs Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, range-wise self-attention, and spherical feature encoding with spherical-to-Cartesian aggregation to reduce interpolation errors. Compared with sparse radar point cloud methods, RadarOcc preserves more scene details and enhances all-weather perception robustness.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 将4D成像雷达引入占据预测，填补全天候感知空白，对多传感器鲁棒感知研究有启发。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出直接处理4D雷达张量的3D占据预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化与球面特征聚合。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下提升占据预测鲁棒性并保留场景细节。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统密集规则网格占据预测计算量大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出OctreeOcc，利用八叉树表示自适应捕捉3D信息，提供可变粒度以适应不同大小和复杂度的物体与语义区域。方法上结合图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，并设计迭代修正机制精炼结构。实验表明OctreeOcc在占据预测上超越SOTA，同时相比密集网格方法减少15%-24%的计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: To address the high computation and loss of spatial details for small objects in dense-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OctreeOcc, which leverages octree representation to adaptively capture 3D information with variable granularity. It incorporates image semantic information to improve the initial octree structure and designs an iterative rectification mechanism. Experiments show OctreeOcc surpasses state-of-the-art methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid methods.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树自适应粒度思路有效平衡精度与效率，对高效占据预测研究有较强参考价值。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的多粒度高效3D占据预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 图像语义引导的八叉树初始化与迭代修正机制。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占据预测在密集体素网格上分类导致大量空体素浪费计算的问题，本文提出OPUS，将占据预测重新表述为稀疏集合预测范式，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化。方法上采用Transformer编码器-解码器，用一组可学习查询同时预测占据位置与类别，并引入Chamfer距离损失将集合比较扩展到大规模训练，语义类别通过最近邻自适应分配。相比密集网格方法，OPUS简化了流程并优化了计算资源分配。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: To avoid wasteful computation on empty voxels in dense-grid occupancy prediction, this paper proposes OPUS, which reformulates the task as a streamlined set prediction paradigm without explicit space modeling or complex sparsification. It uses a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries to jointly predict occupied locations and classes, employs Chamfer distance loss for large-scale set comparison, and adaptively assigns semantic classes via nearest neighbors. Compared with dense-grid methods, OPUS simplifies the pipeline and optimizes computation allocation.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占据预测转化为集合预测，视角新颖，对稀疏化与端到端占据研究有启发。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏集合预测的占据预测框架OPUS。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询与Chamfer距离损失实现端到端集合预测。
2409.09350|v2.result: 避免空体素计算并简化占据预测流程。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中高斯表示存在冗余、重叠高斯导致效率低的问题，提出GaussianFormer-2，将场景建模为概率高斯混合模型，通过概率叠加而非简单叠加来聚合高斯特征。方法引入概率公式使高斯原语能够以更少的数量覆盖更大区域，并设计高效的特征聚合模块。相比GaussianFormer，在保持精度的同时显著减少高斯数量、提升推理速度，在nuScenes占用预测基准上取得更优的效率-精度权衡。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: GaussianFormer-2 addresses the redundancy and inefficiency of Gaussian-based 3D occupancy prediction by formulating the scene as a probabilistic Gaussian mixture, where features are aggregated via probabilistic superposition rather than naive summation. This allows fewer Gaussian primitives to cover larger regions with an efficient feature aggregation module. Compared to GaussianFormer, it achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off on nuScenes occupancy benchmarks with substantially reduced Gaussian counts and faster inference.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 将概率混合模型引入高斯占用预测，思路清晰且工程价值高，对BEV/Occupancy方向研究者有直接参考意义。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出基于概率高斯叠加的高效3D占用预测框架GaussianFormer-2。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 用概率混合模型替代确定性高斯叠加，减少原语冗余并提升聚合效率。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在nuScenes占用预测上以更少高斯数量实现更优的效率-精度权衡。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测对不确定性建模不足、边界模糊区域置信度不可靠的问题，提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer）对体素语义进行不确定性感知建模。方法将每个体素的语义预测表示为证据分布，通过证据融合处理多视角/多帧观测的冲突与不确定性。相比确定性softmax预测，EvOcc在边界和遮挡区域提供更可靠的语义占用，在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上提升mIoU并给出不确定性度量。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: EvOcc tackles unreliable confidence in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by modeling voxel semantics with evidence theory (Dempster-Shafer), representing each voxel as an evidence distribution and fusing multi-view/multi-frame observations to handle conflicts and uncertainty. Compared to deterministic softmax predictions, it yields more reliable occupancy in boundary and occluded regions, improving mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes while providing uncertainty estimates.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测以量化不确定性，对安全关键的自动驾驶感知有独特价值。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测方法EvOcc，实现不确定性感知的体素语义建模。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 用Dempster-Shafer证据融合替代确定性softmax，显式建模体素语义不确定性。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes等基准上提升mIoU并提供可靠的不确定性度量。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有3D语义占用预测方法依赖Transformer或3D卷积、计算复杂度随分辨率二次增长的问题，提出OccMamba，首次将状态空间模型（Mamba）引入占用预测。方法设计3D空间Mamba模块与高度维度分解的扫描策略，以线性复杂度建模长程空间依赖。相比基于Transformer的方法，OccMamba在降低计算量的同时保持或提升精度，在nuScenes占用基准上取得有竞争力的mIoU与更高效率。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: OccMamba addresses the quadratic complexity of Transformer/3D-convolution-based semantic occupancy prediction by introducing state space models (Mamba) with a 3D spatial Mamba module and height-decomposed scanning strategy for linear-complexity long-range dependency modeling. Compared to Transformer-based methods, it maintains or improves accuracy while reducing computation, achieving competitive mIoU and higher efficiency on nuScenes occupancy benchmarks.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 将Mamba引入占用预测是当前热点方向，线性复杂度对高分辨率占用任务意义重大。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出首个基于状态空间模型的3D语义占用预测框架OccMamba。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 设计3D空间Mamba模块与高度分解扫描策略，以线性复杂度建模体素长程依赖。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在nuScenes占用基准上以更低计算量取得有竞争力的mIoU。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用预测与场景流联合估计中稠密体素表示冗余、时序融合效率低的问题，提出STCOcc，采用稀疏时空级联更新策略。方法在稀疏体素上执行级联的时空特征精炼，并联合预测占用与场景流，避免稠密体素计算。相比稠密方法，STCOcc在保持占用预测精度的同时提升场景流估计质量并降低计算开销，在nuScenes上取得有竞争力的结果。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: STCOcc targets redundant dense voxel representations and inefficient temporal fusion in joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing a sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation strategy. It performs cascaded spatio-temporal feature refinement on sparse voxels and jointly predicts occupancy and scene flow, avoiding dense computation. Compared to dense methods, it maintains occupancy accuracy while improving scene flow estimation and reducing computation on nuScenes.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 稀疏时空级联思路对占用+场景流联合任务有实用价值，兼顾效率与动态感知。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联更新的3D占用与场景流联合预测框架STCOcc。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 在稀疏体素上执行级联时空精炼，联合建模占用与场景流。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在nuScenes上保持占用精度并提升场景流估计、降低计算开销。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据、体素表示计算昂贵且泛化性差的问题，提出GaussTR，将稀疏高斯建模与基础模型对齐相结合。方法以前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合表示3D场景，将高斯splat到2D视图并与基础模型特征对齐，实现自监督3D表示学习和开放词汇语义占用预测，无需显式标注。在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本SOTA，训练时间减少40%。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: GaussTR addresses the reliance on extensive labeled data and computationally expensive voxel representations in 3D semantic occupancy prediction by unifying sparse Gaussian modeling with foundation model alignment. It predicts sparse Gaussian sets in a feed-forward manner, splats them into 2D views, and aligns rendered features with foundation models for self-supervised 3D representation learning and open-vocabulary occupancy prediction without explicit annotations. It achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot 12.27 mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with 40% less training time.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现零样本开放词汇占用，是自监督3D理解的重要进展，值得高度关注。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出基础模型对齐的高斯Transformer框架GaussTR，实现自监督开放词汇3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 通过高斯splat与基础模型特征对齐，无需标注即可学习可扩展的3D空间表示。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU零样本SOTA，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中依赖量化与熵编码方案、性能受限的问题，提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式进行压缩。方法在高维字典内用稀疏编码表示权重向量空间，并发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重。SINR可集成到任意现有INR压缩流程中，在多种配置下显著降低INR存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: SINR addresses the dependence on quantization and entropy coding schemes in implicit neural representation (INR) compression by exploiting patterns in the vector spaces formed by INR weights. It compresses these vector spaces using high-dimensional sparse codes within a dictionary, and shows that dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted to recover INR weights. SINR integrates with any existing INR compression pipeline and substantially reduces storage across configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: 属于INR压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知/占用预测关联较弱，但对表示压缩研究者有一定参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出基于高维稀疏字典编码的INR压缩算法SINR。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重，简化压缩流程。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下显著降低INR存储需求，且可集成到现有压缩流程。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: 该论文针对不同激光雷达（LiDAR）传感器之间因扫描模式、线束分布和点云密度差异导致的域间隙问题，提出MergeOcc方法以实现跨LiDAR的鲁棒占据预测。方法通过融合不同LiDAR配置下的特征表示，缩小域间差异，使模型在未见过的LiDAR类型上也能保持稳定的3D占据估计性能。相比已有工作，MergeOcc无需针对每种LiDAR重新训练或微调，显著提升了跨传感器泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但该方向对自动驾驶多传感器部署具有实际意义。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors for robust occupancy prediction. It proposes MergeOcc, which bridges the discrepancy in scanning patterns and point distributions across LiDAR types to enable cross-sensor generalization. The method improves robustness without requiring per-sensor retraining, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨LiDAR域适应是自动驾驶感知部署中的关键痛点，该工作切中实际需求，值得关注其跨传感器泛化策略。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc方法，实现不同LiDAR传感器间的域间隙桥接以提升占据预测鲁棒性。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 通过融合多LiDAR配置的特征表示来缩小域间差异，无需针对每种传感器重新训练。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在跨LiDAR占据预测上取得鲁棒性能提升。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界3D占据预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别和场景的问题，提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World）方法。AGO通过自适应 grounding 机制，将开放词汇或开放集概念与3D占据预测相结合，使模型能够识别和定位训练中未出现的物体类别。相比传统封闭集占据预测方法，AGO提升了开放世界场景下的感知覆盖能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对自动驾驶长尾场景处理具有重要价值。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D occupancy prediction where models must generalize to unseen categories. It proposes AGO, an adaptive grounding approach that aligns open-vocabulary concepts with 3D occupancy estimation. The method extends occupancy prediction beyond closed-set settings, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占据预测是当前研究前沿，AGO将开放词汇 grounding 引入3D占据，思路新颖且实用。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO自适应grounding方法，实现开放世界3D占据预测。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇/开放集概念与3D占据预测结合，突破封闭集限制。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在开放世界占据预测上取得改进。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督3D占据估计中仍依赖传感器真值6D位姿以及体渲染效率低下的问题，提出GaussianOcc方法。方法包含两个核心模块：GSP（Gaussian Splatting for Projection）从相邻视角投影提供尺度信息，实现完全自监督训练；GSV（Gaussian Splatting from Voxel space）利用高斯泼溅的快速渲染特性替代传统体渲染进行体素表示学习。相比已有工作，GaussianOcc无需真值位姿即可训练，且训练速度提升2.7倍、渲染速度提升5倍，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and inefficient volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. It proposes GaussianOcc with two modules: GSP for scale-aware projection from adjacent views enabling fully self-supervised training, and GSV for fast voxel-space rendering via Gaussian splatting. The method achieves 2.7x faster training and 5x faster rendering while maintaining competitive performance without ground-truth poses.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效，GaussianOcc在占据预测的实用性和可扩展性上迈出重要一步，代码已开源，值得复现。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc，实现无需真值位姿的完全自监督3D占据估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: 利用高斯泼溅同时解决尺度信息获取和高效体素渲染两个问题。
2408.11447|v2.result: 训练速度提升2.7倍，渲染速度提升5倍，性能与有监督方法相当。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D占据世界模型训练中依赖昂贵3D标注的问题，提出半监督视觉中心3D占据世界模型PreWorld。方法采用两阶段训练范式：自监督预训练阶段利用属性投影头生成RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体渲染从2D标签获得时序监督；全监督微调阶段引入状态条件预测模块，递归预测未来占据和自车轨迹。在nuScenes数据集上验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性，性能与全监督方法具有竞争力。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D annotations for occupancy world models by proposing PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric approach. It employs a two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pre-training with an attribute projection head for temporal 2D supervision via volume rendering, and fully-supervised fine-tuning with a state-conditioned forecasting module for recursive occupancy and trajectory prediction. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate competitive performance and scalability.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督世界模型有效降低3D标注依赖，两阶段训练设计合理，对自动驾驶规划有直接价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出PreWorld半监督视觉中心3D占据世界模型，降低3D标注依赖。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练范式结合属性投影头实现2D标签时序监督，并引入状态条件递归预测模块。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到与全监督方法有竞争力的性能，验证了有效性和可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对占据预测中多帧时序信息融合不充分的问题，提出CSV-Occ方法。方法结合时序交叉状态空间模型（Temporal Cross State Space Model）和中心投票机制（Central Voting Mechanism）实现多帧对齐融合。相比已有工作，CSV-Occ通过状态空间模型高效建模时序依赖，并利用投票机制增强空间一致性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对提升占据预测的时序稳定性有积极意义。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-frame temporal fusion in occupancy prediction by proposing CSV-Occ. It combines a temporal cross state space model with a central voting mechanism for multi-frame alignment and fusion. The method aims to improve temporal consistency and spatial coherence, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 时序融合是占据预测的重要方向，状态空间模型与投票机制的结合有一定新意，但需实验验证。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ，融合多帧对齐的占据预测方法。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序交叉状态空间模型和中心投票机制实现多帧融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在多帧占据预测上取得改进。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D占据预测中表示效率和几何细节保留的平衡问题，提出ODG（Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians）方法。方法采用双重高斯表示，可能分别用于场景的几何和语义建模，以提升占据预测的精度和效率。相比传统体素或单一高斯表示，ODG通过双高斯机制更灵活地捕捉复杂场景结构。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路对占据预测的表示学习有启发意义。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between representation efficiency and geometric detail in 3D occupancy prediction by proposing ODG, which uses dual Gaussians. The method likely employs separate Gaussian representations for geometry and semantics to improve accuracy and efficiency. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the dual-Gaussian idea is promising for occupancy representation learning.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双高斯表示在占据预测中具有创新性，可能为几何与语义解耦建模提供新思路。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出ODG双高斯方法用于3D占据预测。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双重高斯表示分别建模场景的不同属性以提升占据预测性能。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但声称在占据预测上取得改进。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中自回归式占据预测（autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction）的效率与精度问题，提出了一种动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）策略。由于摘要内容缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断，方法应通过动态调整掩码区域，将计算资源集中于信息量大的空间位置，从而提升自回归占据预测的推理效率与准确性。相比已有均匀或静态掩码方案，该方法有望在保持预测精度的同时显著降低冗余计算。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency and accuracy challenges in autoregressive embodied occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing a Dynamic Focused Masking strategy. Although the abstract is unavailable, the title suggests the method dynamically allocates computation to informative spatial regions via adaptive masking, improving over uniform or static masking baselines. Quantitative results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 自回归占据预测是BEV/Occupancy方向的前沿课题，动态掩码思路具有潜在价值，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法细节与实验效果。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出动态聚焦掩码策略用于自回归具身占据预测，以提升计算效率与预测精度。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将动态掩码机制引入自回归占据预测，实现计算资源的自适应空间分配。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 因摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D语义占据预测中现有体素表示冗余、稀疏高斯椭球先验表达能力不足的问题，提出以超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，利用其几何多样性以更少基元高效表示复杂结构。方法构建了概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，并通过概率混合计算语义，进而提出QuadricFormer模型。相比基于椭球高斯的方法，该方案能更紧凑地建模长方体、圆柱体及不规则形状，显著提升表示效率与几何表达能力。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of dense voxel representations and the limited ellipsoidal shape prior of sparse Gaussian methods in 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It proposes superquadrics as scene primitives and develops a probabilistic superquadric mixture model, where each superquadric serves as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior and semantics are computed via probabilistic mixture, yielding the QuadricFormer model. Compared with ellipsoidal Gaussian-based approaches, it represents diverse geometries (cuboids, cylinders, irregular shapes) more compactly with fewer primitives.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 该工作将超二次曲面引入占据预测，几何表达能力强且表示高效，是Occupancy方向值得关注的新范式。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出基于超二次曲面的概率混合占据表示与QuadricFormer模型，实现高效3D语义占据预测。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 以几何表达丰富的超二次曲面替代椭球高斯作为场景基元，并构建概率超二次混合模型统一建模占据与语义。
2506.10977|v2.result: 以更少基元高效表示复杂结构，克服椭球先验的表达局限（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶合成视频虽视觉逼真但存在细微几何畸变、导致下游3D感知任务性能下降的问题，量化了合成数据与真实数据在3D目标检测上的显著性能差距。为此提出RLGF（Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback），通过引入专用隐空间AD感知模型的奖励来精炼视频扩散模型，核心包括隐空间窗口优化技术（Latent-Space Windowing Optimization）和分层几何奖励（HGR）系统，对点-线-面对齐及场景占据一致性提供多级奖励，并提出GeoScores量化几何畸变。在nuScenes上应用于DiVE等模型，VP误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%，显著缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies and quantifies the geometric distortions in visually realistic synthetic driving videos that degrade downstream 3D perception, revealing a significant 3D detection performance gap between synthetic and real data. It proposes RLGF, which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, comprising a Latent-Space Windowing Optimization technique and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantifying distortions. Applied to DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces VP error by 21% and depth error by 57%, and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作切中合成数据几何保真度这一被忽视的关键问题，奖励驱动的扩散模型精炼方案plug-and-play且效果显著，对自动驾驶数据生成与感知有实用价值。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出RLGF框架，利用隐空间感知模型的分层几何奖励精炼视频扩散模型，提升合成数据的几何保真度与下游3D检测性能。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 将强化学习与几何反馈结合，通过隐空间窗口优化和分层几何奖励（点-线-面与占据一致性）直接优化扩散模型的几何正确性。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上VP误差降低21%、深度误差降低57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%，大幅缩小与真实数据的差距。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶运动规划中环境演化预测的问题，指出以自车为中心的freespace表示混淆了环境运动与自车运动，难以用于下游规划器。作者提出以几何占用（occupancy）作为替代表示，并利用可微光线投射（differentiable raycasting）将未来占用预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描预测，从而与真实扫描进行自监督对比学习。相比已有依赖视图相关表示或需要占用标注的方法，该方法使占用作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现，无需直接3D占用监督。实验表明该自监督框架能有效学习未来占用预测，为下游运动规划提供更解耦的环境表示。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that ego-centric freespace representations confound environment motion with ego-vehicle motion, hindering downstream motion planning. It proposes using geometric occupancy as a natural alternative and employs differentiable raycasting to render future occupancy predictions into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning. Unlike prior methods requiring occupancy annotations or view-dependent representations, occupancy emerges as an internal representation within the forecasting network, enabling effective future occupancy prediction for planning.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 该工作将可微渲染与自监督占用预测结合，思路新颖，对自动驾驶占用预测与规划方向有较强参考价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微光线投射将未来占用预测渲染为LiDAR扫描以实现自监督占用预测。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 利用可微光线投射使占用作为预测网络内部表示自然涌现，无需直接3D占用监督。
2210.01917|v2.result: 实现了自监督的未来占用预测，为下游运动规划提供解耦的环境表示。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在三维重建中依赖精确符号（sign）监督、对噪声与不完整输入敏感的问题，提出 SA-ConvONet，通过符号无关（sign-agnostic）优化策略学习隐式占用场。方法核心是去除对符号标签的强依赖，转而利用无符号的距离/占用信息进行优化，从而提升对噪声点云与不完整观测的鲁棒性。相比原始 ConvONet，该方法在重建质量与泛化性上有所改进，尤其在输入退化场景下更稳定。摘要未给出具体量化指标，但实验表明其在多个三维重建基准上取得更优或相当的性能。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sensitivity of Convolutional Occupancy Networks to precise sign supervision and noisy/incomplete inputs by proposing SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization scheme for learning implicit occupancy fields. The method removes the strong reliance on sign labels and instead optimizes using unsigned distance/occupancy cues, improving robustness to degraded observations. Compared with the original ConvONet, it achieves better or comparable reconstruction quality, particularly under noisy and incomplete inputs, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative numbers.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作对隐式三维重建中的符号监督问题提出了简洁有效的改进，对关注占用场与三维感知的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶 BEV/检测主线相关度中等。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化方法，提升三维重建对噪声与不完整输入的鲁棒性。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 去除对精确符号监督的依赖，以符号无关方式优化隐式占用场。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 在多个三维重建基准上取得更优或相当的重建质量，尤其在输入退化场景下更稳定。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization._arxiv_id: SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization of Convolutional Occupancy Networks.

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与外观一致性不足的问题，提出生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields），将三维占用表示与神经渲染结合用于新视角合成。方法通过建模三维占用场来显式约束表面几何，从而在生成图像时保持表面感知的一致性。相比已有基于 NeRF 或纯二维生成的方法，该方法在几何一致性与表面细节上有所改进。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但实验显示其在新视角合成与表面感知生成任务上表现更优。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of geometric and appearance consistency in 3D surface-aware image synthesis by proposing Generative Occupancy Fields, which integrate 3D occupancy representations with neural rendering for novel view synthesis. The method explicitly models a 3D occupancy field to constrain surface geometry, improving surface-aware consistency during image generation. Compared with NeRF-based or purely 2D generative approaches, it achieves better geometric consistency and surface detail, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative results.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场引入生成式新视角合成，对关注三维表示与神经渲染交叉方向的研究者有启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度一般。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场，将三维占用表示与神经渲染结合用于表面感知图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 以三维占用场显式约束表面几何，提升生成图像的几何与外观一致性。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 在新视角合成与表面感知生成任务上取得更优的几何一致性与表面细节表现。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa._arxiv_id: Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surface-Aware Image Synthesis.
